原文摘要
摘要 研究设计：中国真实世界回顾性研究，比较DIMS、HAL、DIMS+0.01%阿托品（DIMSA）和HAL+0.01%阿托品（HALA）。 结果：校正后年AL进展量分别为DIMS 0.23mm、HAL 0.15mm、DIMSA 0.20mm、HALA 0.12mm；HAL/HALA优于DIMS/DIMSA，HALA获得良好反应的概率最高。 结论：HAL相关方案在该真实世界研究中显示出更优的眼轴控制表现，但0.01%阿托品联合光学治疗对平均AL或SER结局未显示稳定额外获益。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: Myopia is a global public health issue, necessitating effective control strategies. Defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) and highly aspherical lenslet (HAL) spectacle lenses, as well as their combination with low-concentration atropine (0.01%), have been shown to control myopia effectively. However, direct comparisons among these regimens, DIMS, HAL, DIMSA (DIMS + atropine), and HALA (HAL + atropine), are lacking. In this real-world study, we compared their effectiveness in slowing myopia progression. METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort study included 347 children (694 eyes) aged 6-14 years who received one of the four interventions for at least 1 year. The primary outcome was the annual change in axial length (AL). The secondary outcome was the annual change in spherical equivalent refraction (SER). The treatment response was categorized as good, fair, or poor. Linear mixed models and generalized estimating equations were used for analysis, adjusting for covariates. RESULTS: After adjustment, annual axial elongation differed significantly among the groups (P < 0.001), with marginal means of 0.23 mm (DIMS), 0.15 mm (HAL), 0.20 mm (DIMSA), and 0.12 mm (HALA). Post hoc comparisons revealed that both HAL and HALA were superior to DIMS (P < 0.001) and that HALA was superior to DIMSA (P = 0.022). Adding 0.01% atropine to either optical monotherapy did not provide a significant additional benefit in terms of mean AL or SER outcomes. Compared with DIMS, HALA significantly increased the odds of a good response for AL (OR = 4.34, P < 0.001) and SER (OR = 5.85, P < 0.001), whereas this effect was not observed with DIMSA. Older age independently predicted better response (AL: OR = 1.46/year; SER: OR = 1.26/year; both P < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: In this non-randomized real-world comparison, HAL monotherapy was associated with slower SER progression, compared with DIMS. Although adding atropine did not improve mean outcomes, HALA showed the highest likelihood of a good response, suggesting a clinically meaningful benefit in response distribution. Although HALA did not consistently outperform HAL monotherapy across analyses, its advantage in achieving favourable individual responses supports its consideration for children requiring maximal intervention. These findings require confirmation in prospective randomized trials.

摘要 研究设计：欧洲3年真实世界回顾性研究，纳入288名5–12岁儿童，比较0.01%、0.025%、0.05%阿托品，DIMS/HAL，DIMS/HAL+0.01%阿托品及SVL。 结果：DIMS/HAL及DIMS/HAL+0.01%阿托品均较SVL减缓近视进展，整体效果接近0.01%阿托品；0.05%阿托品效果最明显。 结论：在欧洲儿童真实世界数据中，DIMS/HAL及其与0.01%阿托品联合均具有近视控制效果，但低浓度阿托品呈剂量依赖性，0.05%效果最强。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: Myopia control is crucial for pediatric eye care professionals. Although various treatments exist, their comparative efficacy, particularly in European populations, remains unclear. In real-life conditions, this study aimed to compare different strategies to slow myopia progression. METHODS: This retrospective, nonrandomized study evaluated the efficacy of 0.01%, 0.025%, and 0.05% atropine, defocus incorporated multiple segments/highly aspherical lenslets (DIMS/HAL) spectacles, combined atropine and DIMS/HAL, and single vision spectacles in 288 European children (aged 5-12 years) with myopia progression (≥0.75 D in the past 12 months). Primary outcomes were changes in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length measured every 6 months for 3 years. RESULTS: The mean cumulative 3-year SER progressions were -0.75 ± 0.49, -0.92 ± 0.52, and -1.31 ± 0.75 D for the 0.05%, 0.025%, and 0.01% atropine groups, respectively, -1.31 ± 0.76 D for the DIMS/HAL group, and -1.11 ± 0.65 D for the 0.01% atropine + DIMS/HAL group, showing better myopia progression control compared to those of the control group (-2.14 ± 0.72 D). Atropine exhibited a dose-dependent effect, with 0.05% atropine achieving the greatest reduction in myopia progression and axial elongation. CONCLUSIONS: This study demonstrates the efficacy of low-dose atropine and DIMS/HAL spectacles in slowing myopia progression in European children. The 0.05% atropine exhibited the most pronounced myopia control effect.

HAL佩戴一年后治疗反应不佳（眼轴增长量仍然 ≥0.26 mm/年）继续佩戴HAL效果最不理想，转换为DOT镜片的效果最好，转换为OK镜也有明显改善；HAL联合0.01%阿托品的改善没有达到统计学显著性。 2. 转换为DOT或OK镜后，第二年眼轴仍快速增长的风险显著下降；单纯在HAL基础上增加0.01%阿托品，未显示出统计学显著优势。

原文摘要
摘要 目的：为了比较在不同的二线近视控制干预措施后，对高度非球面晶状体 (HAL) 磨损反应不佳的儿童的轴向长度 (AL) 伸长率。 方法：这项回顾性研究包括 4097 名完成 1 年 HAL 磨损的近视儿童。尽管进行了 HAL 治疗，不良反应者仍被定义为轴向伸长≥0.26 mm/年的儿童。这些儿童再随访一年，并根据第二年的干预措施分为四组：持续 HAL 磨损 (HAL-HAL),HAL 与 0.01% 阿托品 (HAL-HALA) 结合，转换为扩散光学技术眼镜 (HAL-DOT)，以及转换为直角矫形镜 (HAL-OK)。主要结果包括球面等效折射 (SER) 和 AL 的变化。进行了 Logit 模型回归和多变量线性回归分析。 结果：倾向评分匹配后，共纳入 168 名受试者 (每组 42 名)。各组在第二年 SER 进展和 AL 伸长率方面存在显著差异 (均 p<0.001)。与其他组相比，HAL-DOT 组表现出最小的 AL 伸长率和较少的 SER 进展。Logit 模型回归显示，与 HAL-HAL 组相比，HAL-DOT 组 (优势比 (OR)=0.11,p<0.001) 和 HAL-OK 组 (OR=0.34,p=0.04) 出现不良反应的概率显著较低 (轴向伸长率≥0.26 mm/年)。HAL-HALA 组没有发现显著相关性 (p=0.12)。多变量模型回归显示，所有干预组都降低了 AL 伸长率，其中 HAL-DOT 组的影响最大 (β=-0.227 mm,p<0.001)。 结论：在对初始 HAL 治疗反应不佳的儿童中，改用替代干预措施，特别是 DOT，与更有利的轴向伸展结果和较少的 SER 进展有关。早期治疗修正可能有助于改善高风险儿童的预后。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To compare axial length (AL) elongation in children with poor response to highly aspherical lenslet (HAL) wear, following different second-line myopia control interventions. METHODS: This retrospective study included 4097 myopic children who completed 1 year of HAL wear. Poor responders were defined as children with axial elongation ≥0.26 mm/year despite HAL therapy. These children were followed for an additional year and categorised into four groups based on the second-year interventions: continued HAL wear (HAL-HAL), HAL combined with 0.01% atropine (HAL-HALA), switching to diffusion optics technology spectacles (HAL-DOT) and switching to orthokeratology lenses (HAL-OK). Primary outcomes included changes in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and AL. Logistic regression and multivariable linear regression analyses were performed. RESULTS: After propensity score matching, 168 subjects (42 per group) were included. Significant differences in second-year SER progression and AL elongation were observed among groups (both p < 0.001). The HAL-DOT group exhibited the smallest AL elongation and less SER progression compared with the other groups. Logistic regression showed that, compared with the HAL-HAL group, the HAL-DOT (Odds Ratio (OR) = 0.11, p < 0.001) and HAL-OK groups (OR = 0.34, p = 0.04) had significantly lower odds of a poor response (axial elongation ≥0.26 mm/year). No significant association was found for the HAL-HALA group (p = 0.12). Multivariable regression showed all intervention groups reduced AL elongation, with the greatest effect in the HAL-DOT group (β = -0.227 mm, p < 0.001). CONCLUSION: Among children with a poor response to initial HAL treatment, switching to alternative interventions, especially DOT, was associated with more favourable axial elongation outcomes and less SER progression. Early treatment modification may help improve outcomes in high-risk children.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在探讨近视控制干预措施的有效性。在本系统综述中，主要结局指标为治疗组与对照组在近视进展（屈光度，D）和眼轴长度（AL）增长（毫米，mm）方面的平均差值（MD）。 结果：以下干预措施被证实有效（p<0.001）：高非球面微透镜（HAL，近视进展减缓 0.80 D，95% 置信区间 0.77-0.83；眼轴长度增长减少 - 0.35 mm，95% 置信区间 - 0.36 至 - 0.34）、MiSight 隐形眼镜（近视进展减缓 0.66 D，95% 置信区间 0.63-0.69；眼轴长度增长减少 - 0.28 mm，95% 置信区间 - 0.29 至 - 0.27）、0.05% 低浓度阿托品（近视进展减缓 0.54 D，95% 置信区间 0.38-0.70；眼轴长度增长减少 - 0.21 mm，95% 置信区间 - 0.28 至 - 0.14）、Biofinity +2.50 D 隐形眼镜（近视进展减缓 0.45 D，95% 置信区间 0.29-0.61；眼轴长度增长减少 - 0.24 mm，95% 置信区间 - 0.33 至 - 0.15）、离焦整合多段式（DIMS）眼镜（近视进展减缓 0.44 D，95% 置信区间 0.42-0.46；眼轴长度增长减少 - 0.34 mm，95% 置信区间 - 0.35 至 - 0.33）以及角膜塑形镜（眼轴长度增长减少 - 0.24 mm，95% 置信区间 - 0.33 至 - 0.15）。 结论：在两项研究中，0.01% 低浓度阿托品在减缓眼轴长度（AL）进展方面无效。0.05% 低浓度阿托品的治疗效果良好。眼镜（HAL 和 DIMS）和隐形眼镜（MiSight 和 Biofinity）在减缓近视进展方面，可能产生与阿托品相当的治疗效果。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study aims to investigate the effectiveness of interventions to control myopia progression. In this systematic review, the primary outcomes were mean differences (MD) between treatment and control groups in myopia progression (D) and axial length (AL) elongation (mm). RESULTS: The following interventions were found to be effective (p < 0.001): highly aspherical lenslets (HAL, 0.80 D, 95% CI, 0.77-0.83; -0.35 mm, 95% CI -0.36 to -0.34), MiSight contact lenses (0.66 D, 95% CI, 0.63-0.69; -0.28 mm, 95% CI -0.29 to -0.27), low dose atropine 0.05% (0.54 D, 95% CI, 0.38-0.70; -0.21 mm, 95% CI-0.28 to -0.14), Biofinity +2.50 D (0.45 D, 95% CI, 0.29, 0.61; -0.24 mm, 95% CI -0.33 to -0.15), defocus incorporated multiple segments [DIMS] (0.44 D, 95% CI, 0.42-0.46; -0.34 mm, 95% CI -0.35 to -0.33) and ortho-k lenses (-0.24 mm, 95% CI -0.33 to -01.5). CONCLUSION: Low-dose atropine 0.01% was not effective in reducing AL progression in two studies. Treatment efficacy with low-dose atropine of 0.05% showed good efficacy. Spectacles (HAL and DIMS) and contact lenses (MiSight and Biofinity) may confer a comparable treatment benefit compared to atropine, to slow myopia progression.

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2025年👥 D'Andrea Luca, Rinaldi Michele, Piscopo Raffaele, Iorio Fabiana, La Padula Simone, Maqsood Sundas, Elalfy Mohamed, Melenzane Antonietta, Confalonieri Filippo, Ozkan Ozlem, Utine Canan Asli, Costagliola Ciro

参考文献6-1-2 框架眼镜控制近视效果的Meta分析：基于随机对照试验的证据 样本量：13135人 SE：HAL控制量： -0.52D, DIMS控制量：-0.45 D ，PALs控制量：-0.21D ,Bifocal Lenses控制量：-0.60D AL：HAL控制量：-0.28mm , DIMS控制量：-0.32mm ，PALs控制量：-0.05mm ,Bifocal Lenses控制量：-0.19mm
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-1 meta / 6-1-2
原文摘要
摘要 目的：通过综合随机对照试验（RCTs）数据，明确先进框架眼镜技术在延缓儿童和青少年近视进展中对等效球镜度数（SER）变化和眼轴长度（AL）增长的影响。 方法：开展系统综述与荟萃分析，检索截至 2025 年 2 月 27 日所有对比近视控制镜片干预组与标准单光镜片（SVLs）对照组的随机对照试验（RCTs）。将符合纳入标准的研究数据提取至专门设计的数据收集表中，且不改变原始数据。计算连续型结局指标的均数和标准差（SD），并导入 RevMan 软件进行分析。 结果：本荟萃分析共纳入 23 项随机对照试验（RCTs），涉及 13,315 名受试者。与单光镜片（SVLs）相比，近视控制镜片可显著减少眼轴长度（AL）增长（-0.15mm；95% 置信区间 - 0.20 至 - 0.09；p<0.00001）和等效球镜度数（SER）进展（-0.31 屈光度；95% 置信区间 - 0.42 至 - 0.20；p<0.00001）。高非球面微透镜（HAL）可显著减少眼轴长度增长（-0.28mm；95% 置信区间 - 0.37 至 - 0.19）和等效球镜度数进展（-0.52 屈光度；95% 置信区间 - 0.84 至 - 0.20）。离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS）也可显著减少等效球镜度数进展（-0.45 屈光度；95% 置信区间 - 0.65 至 - 0.26），但仅有 1 项符合纳入标准的随机对照试验报告了眼轴长度（AL）数据。其他类型镜片的效果则较温和或存在差异。 结论：本荟萃分析仅基于随机对照试验（RCTs），为近视控制用框架眼镜设计提供了最新且详细的对比评估。研究结果支持将专用镜片作为一种有效的无创策略，以降低高度近视相关风险，并为临床实践中优化镜片选择提供指导。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To determine the effects of advanced spectacle lens technologies on changes in spherical equivalent of refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) elongation in slowing down the progression of myopia in children and adolescents, by synthesising data from randomised controlled trials (RCTs). METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted to identify all RCTs up to 27 February 2025 that compared intervention groups with myopia control lenses and control groups with standard single vision lenses (SVLs). Data from eligible studies were extracted into specially-designed data collection forms without changing the original values. Means and SD for continuous outcomes were determined and imported into RevMan. RESULTS: This meta-analysis included 23 RCTs with a total of 13.315 subjects. Compared with SVLs, myopia control lenses significantly reduced AL (-0.15 mm; 95% CI -0.20 to -0.09; p<0.00001) and SER progression (-0.31 D; 95% CI -0.42 to -0.20; p<0.00001). Highly Aspherical Lenslet lenses significantly reduced AL (-0.28 mm; 95% CI -0.37 to -0.19) and SER progression (-0.52 D; 95% CI -0.84 to -0.20). Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments lenses also significantly reduced SER (-0.45 D; 95% CI -0.65 to -0.26), although only one eligible RCT reported AL data. Other lens types had modest or variable effects. CONCLUSIONS: This meta-analysis provides an up-to-date and detailed comparative evaluation of spectacle lens designs for myopia control, based exclusively on RCTs. These findings support the use of specialty lenses as an effective, non-invasive strategy to reduce the risks associated with high-myopia and guide optimal lens selection in clinical practice. PROSPERO REGISTRATION NUMBER: CRD420251009898.

原文摘要
摘要 本研究旨在明确各类干预措施延缓儿童近视进展的有效性。于 2023 年 12 月 2 日检索以下文献数据库：PubMed、Embase、Cochrane 中心数据库、Web of Science 核心合集、BIOSIS Previews、Current Contents Connect、数据引用索引（Data Citation Index）、Derwent Innovations Index、KCI - 韩国期刊数据库、预印本引用索引（Preprint Citation Index）、ProQuest™学位论文引用索引及 SciELO 引用索引。研究遵循 PRISMA 声明（系统综述与 meta 分析优先报告条目）及《Cochrane 手册》推荐规范。为得出具有临床应用价值的结果，对每一项独特的干预措施均进行单独分析。主要结局指标为眼轴长度进展；次要结局指标包括新发角膜浸润、畏光、干预相关过敏反应发生情况、近距及远距视力，以及退出指定干预 / 对照组的情况。 本研究共纳入 74 项随机对照试验（RCT），涉及 12154 名 6-18 岁受试者。通过网络 meta 分析，比较了 45 种干预措施与安慰剂或单光眼镜在干预 1 年后的眼轴长度差异。以加权均数差（WMD）及 95% 置信区间（95% CI）表示，最有效的干预措施依次为：低强度红光（−0.33 mm，95% CI：−0.40~−0.25）、治疗区直径为 5mm 的角膜塑形镜（OK 镜）（−0.32 mm，95% CI：−0.41~−0.24）、非球面基弧 OK 镜（−0.29 mm，95% CI：−0.37~−0.22）、1.0% 阿托品（−0.28 mm，95% CI：−0.30~−0.26）、0.01% 阿托品联合 OK 镜（−0.24 mm，95% CI：−0.37~−0.11）、高非球面微透镜眼镜（−0.23 mm，95% CI：−0.26~−0.19）、高压缩系数 OK 镜（−0.23 mm，95% CI：−0.28~−0.17）、0.05% 阿托品（−0.21 mm，95% CI：−0.30~−0.13）及多焦点离焦框架镜（−0.21 mm，95% CI：−0.27~−0.15）。 阿托品干预组报告有畏光及近距视力下降情况，且 1.0% 阿托品组的治疗依从性较低。未发现任何干预措施与角膜浸润或过敏反应存在显著关联。超 70% 的研究在亚洲人群中开展。 本系统综述与网络 meta 分析证实，多种干预措施（包括 OK 镜、阿托品、高非球面微透镜眼镜及多焦点离焦框架镜）可有效延缓儿童眼轴伸长；低强度红光疗法同样能减缓眼轴长度进展，但需进一步研究评估其潜在副作用。未来研究应纳入多样化人群并采用标准化方法，以提高研究结果的适用性与可比性。 6-1-4 摘要 目的：通过整合随机对照试验（RCT）的数据，评估先进框架眼镜镜片技术对儿童和青少年近视进展的控制效果，具体考察其对等效球镜度数（SER）变化和眼轴长度（AL）延长的影响。 方法：本研究开展了系统综述和Meta分析，检索截至2025年2月27日的所有随机对照试验，纳入比较近视控制镜片干预组与标准单光镜片（SVLs）对照组的研究。将符合纳入标准的研究数据提取至专门设计的数据收集表中，并保持原始数值不变。连续性结局指标采用均值和标准差表示，并导入 RevMan 软件进行分析。 结果：本次Meta分析共纳入23项随机对照试验，总计13,315名受试者。与单光镜片（SVLs）相比，近视控制镜片可显著减少眼轴增长（AL：-0.15 mm；95% CI：-0.20 至 -0.09；p<0.00001）和等效球镜进展（SER：-0.31 D；95% CI：-0.42 至 -0.20；p<0.00001）。高非球面微透镜（Highly Aspherical Lenslet, HAL）镜片可显著降低眼轴增长（-0.28 mm；95% CI：-0.37 至 -0.19）和SER进展（-0.52 D；95% CI：-0.84 至 -0.20）。多区正向离焦镜片（Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments, DIMS）同样可显著减缓SER进展（-0.45 D；95% CI：-0.65 至 -0.26），但仅有1项符合条件的RCT报告了AL数据。其他类型镜片的控制效果较为有限或存在差异。 结论：本项Meta分析基于随机对照试验，提供了截至目前关于近视控制框架眼镜镜片设计的最新且较为详细的比较性评价。研究结果支持将功能性近视控制镜片作为一种有效、非侵入性的干预策略，以降低高度近视相关风险，并为临床实践中的最佳镜片选择提供依据。 6-1-5摘要 本研究旨在比较儿童近视控制中不同光学干预措施〔眼镜、软性角膜接触镜（SCL）和角膜塑形镜（OK）〕的治疗效果，探讨治疗期间疗效是否具有一致性，并评估基线等效球镜度数（SER）、眼轴长度（AL）和年龄对治疗效果的影响。研究通过检索 EMBASE、PubMed 和 Google Scholar 数据库，纳入 2000 年 1 月至 2022 年 4 月期间发表的文献，共筛选出 220 篇文章，这些研究报告了干预组与对照组之间 SER 和 AL 变化差异所体现的治疗效果。最终共有 35 篇文章纳入分析。研究计算了治疗效应量（ES）：对于 SER，效应量越大且为正，表示疗效越好；对于 AL，效应量越小且为负，表示疗效越好。结果显示，在 SER 方面，外围加光设计眼镜和软性角膜接触镜的效应量分别为 0.66 和 0.53，均为较大的治疗效应，且两类干预之间差异无统计学意义（p=0.69）。在 AL 方面，外围加光设计眼镜、软性角膜接触镜和 OK 镜的效应量分别为 -0.37、-0.55 和 -0.93，均表现出较大疗效，其中 OK 镜的效果显著优于外围加光设计眼镜（p≤0.001）。在治疗时间维度上，所有干预在治疗前 12 个月内 的效应均较大，而在 24–36 个月 时疗效有所下降。基线 SER 仅对外围加光设计眼镜的治疗效果有影响。总体而言，光学干预对控制儿童近视进展是有效的，但其治疗效果主要在前 12 个月最为显著，随后会随时间减弱 6-1-6摘要： 目的：总结已发表 Meta 分析中各种近视控制干预措施的合并疗效估计。 方法：研究者检索了 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science 数据库，自建库起至 2024 年 2 月，纳入报告各种近视控制策略治疗效果的系统综述和 Meta 分析。采用 16 项的 AMSTAR 2 工具评估纳入 Meta 分析的方法学质量。若某种干预使**等效球镜（SER）每年变化达到 ≥0.50 D，或使眼轴长度（AL）**每年变化达到 ≤−0.18 mm，则定义为具有临床意义的疗效。 结果：共纳入 38 项研究。SER 和 AL 的总体变化均值差（MD，95% CI）分别为： 高浓度（≥0.5%）阿托品：0.67 D（0.58–0.77） 和 −0.24 mm（−0.36 至 −0.11）； 中浓度（>0.05% 至 <0.5%）阿托品：0.48 D（0.34–0.62） 和 −0.23 mm（−0.27 至 −0.19）； 低浓度（0.01%、0.025%、0.05%）阿托品：0.33 D（0.23–0.43） 和 −0.14 mm（−0.19 至 −0.09）； 角膜塑形镜：−0.47 mm（−0.66 至 −0.28）； 周边加光软性接触镜：0.30 D（0.18–0.42） 和 −0.35 mm（−0.62 至 −0.08）； 周边加光框架眼镜：0.77 D（0.40–1.14） 和 −0.43 mm（−0.78 至 −0.08）； 多焦点框架眼镜：0.21 D（0.11–0.31）； 重复低强度红光治疗：0.55 D（0.46–0.65） 和 −0.25 mm（−0.29 至 −0.20）； 户外活动：0.17 D（0.16–0.18） 和 −0.04 mm（−0.06 至 −0.01）。 结论：在减缓眼轴延长方面，高浓度和中浓度阿托品、角膜塑形镜、周边加光框架眼镜以及重复低强度红光显示出具有临床意义的效果；在减缓屈光度进展方面，高浓度和中浓度阿托品、周边加光框架眼镜以及重复低强度红光显示出具有临床意义的效果。 6-1-7摘要 研究背景：近视患病率不断上升，已成为全球公共卫生问题，不仅表现为未矫正屈光不正发生率增加，更重要的是，近视相关眼部并发症会提高视力损害风险。儿童期是近视进展最快的阶段，因此需要在这一时期采取干预措施以减缓近视进展。本研究是该动态系统综述的更新版本。 研究目的：采用网络Meta分析，评估儿童近视控制干预措施在减缓近视进展方面的相对有效性和安全性；对不同干预措施进行疗效排序；并通过简要经济学评论总结相关经济学评价结果。 检索方法：研究者检索了 CENTRAL、MEDLINE、Embase 以及 3个临床试验注册平台，最新检索时间为 2024年2月19日。 纳入标准：纳入对象为 18岁及以下儿童近视控制相关随机对照试验（RCT），干预类型包括光学干预、药物干预、光疗以及行为干预。 结局指标：关键结局包括：干预组与对照组在 1年及以上随访中的等效球镜屈光度（SER，单位D）变化差异，以及眼轴长度（AL，单位mm）变化差异；同时关注停药后的屈光和眼轴反跳变化。 偏倚风险评估：研究采用 Cochrane RoB 2 工具对 SER 和 AL 结局的偏倚风险进行评估。 资料合成方法：研究遵循 Cochrane 标准方法，采用 GRADE 方法评价 1年和2年 SER 与 AL 变化证据的确定性，并使用 SUCRA（累积排序曲线下面积）对各干预措施进行疗效排序。 纳入研究。本次更新共纳入 104项研究（其中 40项为新增研究），共随机分配 17,509名 4–18岁儿童。多数研究来自中国及其他亚洲国家（66.3%）和北美（14.4%）。84项研究（80.8%）将近视控制干预与非活性对照进行比较。研究随访时间为 12–48个月。 结果：由于网络Meta分析中的大多数证据网络连接较差，除特别说明外，估计结果主要基于直接的两两比较。 在1年随访时，对照组 SER 中位变化为 −0.65 D。与对照相比，下列干预可能减缓 SER 进展：重复低强度红光（RLRL，MD 0.80 D，95%CI 0.71–0.89）、高浓度阿托品（≥0.5%，MD 0.90 D，95%CI 0.62–1.18）、中浓度阿托品（0.1%至<0.5%，MD 0.55 D，95%CI 0.17–0.93）、低浓度阿托品（<0.1%，MD 0.25 D，95%CI 0.16–0.35）、周边离焦/周边加光框架镜（PPSL，MD 0.45 D，95%CI 0.16–0.74）、多焦点软性接触镜（MFSCL，MD 0.27 D，95%CI 0.18–0.35）以及多焦点框架镜（MFSL，MD 0.14 D，95%CI 0.08–0.21）。 在1年随访时，对照组 AL 中位变化为 0.33 mm。与对照相比，下列干预可能减缓眼轴延长：RLRL（MD −0.33 mm，95%CI −0.37至−0.29）、高浓度阿托品（MD −0.33 mm，95%CI −0.35至−0.30）、中浓度阿托品（MD −0.24 mm，95%CI −0.34至−0.15）、低浓度阿托品（MD −0.10 mm，95%CI −0.13至−0.07）、角膜塑形镜（Ortho-K，MD −0.18 mm，95%CI −0.21至−0.14）、周边离焦/周边加光框架镜（MD −0.13 mm，95%CI −0.21至−0.05）、多焦点软性接触镜（MD −0.11 mm，95%CI −0.13至−0.09）以及多焦点框架镜（MD −0.06 mm，95%CI −0.09至−0.04）。此外，角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品较单用角膜塑形镜可能进一步减少眼轴延长（MD −0.12 mm，95%CI −0.15至−0.09）。 在2年随访时，SER 和 AL 的干预排序与 1年结果大体相似，但目前数据仍不足以判断累积效应。SER 排名较高的干预为高浓度阿托品、中浓度阿托品和周边离焦/周边加光框架镜；AL 排名较高的干预为角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品、高浓度阿托品和中浓度阿托品。关于停药后是否出现超出年龄预期进展速度的反跳，证据有限。不良事件和治疗依从性报告不一致。仅有两项研究报告生活质量，结果显示干预组与对照组差异很小或无差异。对于不同近视控制策略的相对成本或成本效益，目前尚无法得出明确结论。 结论：大多数研究将药物和光学治疗与非活性对照进行比较。这些干预可能减缓屈光变化并减少眼轴延长，但结果常存在异质性。关于 2年以上随访的数据较少，因此这些干预措施是否具有持续效果仍存在不确定性。未来需要开展更长期、质量更高的研究，比较单一或联合近视控制干预，并改进不良反应的监测与报告。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
To determine the effectiveness of various interventions in reducing myopia progression in children. Literature databases were searched on December 2, 2023: PubMed, Embase, the Cochrane Central, Web of Science Core Collection, BIOSIS Previews, Current Contents Connect, Data Citation Index, Derwent Innovations Index, KCI-Korean Journal Database, Preprint Citation Index, ProQuest™ Dissertations and Theses Citation Index and SciELO Citation Index. PRISMA guidelines and the Cochrane Handbook recommendations were followed. All unique interventions were analyzed individually in order to generate clinically applicable results. The main outcome was axial length progression. Secondary outcomes were incident corneal infiltrates, photophobia, development of an allergic response towards the intervention, visual acuity at near and distance and drop-out from allocated intervention/control. We identified 74 RCTs involving 12 154 participants aged 6-18 years. Network meta-analysis compared axial length after 1 year between 45 interventions and placebo or single-vision spectacles. The most effective interventions reported in weighted mean difference and 95% confidence interval were low-level red-light (-0.33 mm (-0.40, -0.25)), ortho-K with 5 mm treatment zone (-0.32 mm (-0.41, -0.24)), ortho-K with aspheric base curve (-0.29 mm (-0.37, -0.22)), atropine 1.0% (-0.28 mm (-0.30, -0.26)), combined atropine 0.01% and ortho-K (-0.24 mm (-0.37, -0.11)), spectacles with highly aspherical lenslets (-0.23 mm (-0.26, -0.19)), ortho-K with increased compression factor (-0.23 mm (-0.28, -0.17), atropine 0.05% (-0.21 mm (-0.30, -0.13)) and defocus incorporated multiple segments spectacles (-0.21 mm (-0.27, -0.15)). Photophobia and reduced near-visual acuity were reported for atropine, and lower adherence to treatment was found for atropine at 1.0%. There was no significant association between any interventions and corneal infiltrates or allergic reactions. Over 70% of the studies were conducted in Asian populations. This systematic review and network meta-analysis highlights the efficacy of various interventions, including orthokeratology lenses, atropine, highly aspherical lenslets and defocus incorporated multiple segments spectacles in slowing axial elongation in children. Low-level red-light therapy also slowed axial length progression, but further research is needed to assess the potential side effects. Future studies should include diverse populations and standardized methodologies to enhance the applicability and comparability of results.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-1 meta / 6-1-4
原文摘要
摘要 目的：通过整合随机对照试验（RCT）的数据，评估先进框架眼镜镜片技术对儿童和青少年近视进展的控制效果，具体考察其对等效球镜度数（SER）变化和眼轴长度（AL）延长的影响。 方法：本研究开展了系统综述和Meta分析，检索截至2025年2月27日的所有随机对照试验，纳入比较近视控制镜片干预组与标准单光镜片（SVLs）对照组的研究。将符合纳入标准的研究数据提取至专门设计的数据收集表中，并保持原始数值不变。连续性结局指标采用均值和标准差表示，并导入 RevMan 软件进行分析。 结果：本次Meta分析共纳入23项随机对照试验，总计13,315名受试者。与单光镜片（SVLs）相比，近视控制镜片可显著减少眼轴增长（AL：-0.15 mm；95% CI：-0.20 至 -0.09；p<0.00001）和等效球镜进展（SER：-0.31 D；95% CI：-0.42 至 -0.20；p<0.00001）。高非球面微透镜（Highly Aspherical Lenslet, HAL）镜片可显著降低眼轴增长（-0.28 mm；95% CI：-0.37 至 -0.19）和SER进展（-0.52 D；95% CI：-0.84 至 -0.20）。多区正向离焦镜片（Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments, DIMS）同样可显著减缓SER进展（-0.45 D；95% CI：-0.65 至 -0.26），但仅有1项符合条件的RCT报告了AL数据。其他类型镜片的控制效果较为有限或存在差异。 结论：本项Meta分析基于随机对照试验，提供了截至目前关于近视控制框架眼镜镜片设计的最新且较为详细的比较性评价。研究结果支持将功能性近视控制镜片作为一种有效、非侵入性的干预策略，以降低高度近视相关风险，并为临床实践中的最佳镜片选择提供依据。 6-1-5摘要 本研究旨在比较儿童近视控制中不同光学干预措施〔眼镜、软性角膜接触镜（SCL）和角膜塑形镜（OK）〕的治疗效果，探讨治疗期间疗效是否具有一致性，并评估基线等效球镜度数（SER）、眼轴长度（AL）和年龄对治疗效果的影响。研究通过检索 EMBASE、PubMed 和 Google Scholar 数据库，纳入 2000 年 1 月至 2022 年 4 月期间发表的文献，共筛选出 220 篇文章，这些研究报告了干预组与对照组之间 SER 和 AL 变化差异所体现的治疗效果。最终共有 35 篇文章纳入分析。研究计算了治疗效应量（ES）：对于 SER，效应量越大且为正，表示疗效越好；对于 AL，效应量越小且为负，表示疗效越好。结果显示，在 SER 方面，外围加光设计眼镜和软性角膜接触镜的效应量分别为 0.66 和 0.53，均为较大的治疗效应，且两类干预之间差异无统计学意义（p=0.69）。在 AL 方面，外围加光设计眼镜、软性角膜接触镜和 OK 镜的效应量分别为 -0.37、-0.55 和 -0.93，均表现出较大疗效，其中 OK 镜的效果显著优于外围加光设计眼镜（p≤0.001）。在治疗时间维度上，所有干预在治疗前 12 个月内 的效应均较大，而在 24–36 个月 时疗效有所下降。基线 SER 仅对外围加光设计眼镜的治疗效果有影响。总体而言，光学干预对控制儿童近视进展是有效的，但其治疗效果主要在前 12 个月最为显著，随后会随时间减弱 6-1-6摘要： 目的：总结已发表 Meta 分析中各种近视控制干预措施的合并疗效估计。 方法：研究者检索了 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science 数据库，自建库起至 2024 年 2 月，纳入报告各种近视控制策略治疗效果的系统综述和 Meta 分析。采用 16 项的 AMSTAR 2 工具评估纳入 Meta 分析的方法学质量。若某种干预使**等效球镜（SER）每年变化达到 ≥0.50 D，或使眼轴长度（AL）**每年变化达到 ≤−0.18 mm，则定义为具有临床意义的疗效。 结果：共纳入 38 项研究。SER 和 AL 的总体变化均值差（MD，95% CI）分别为： 高浓度（≥0.5%）阿托品：0.67 D（0.58–0.77） 和 −0.24 mm（−0.36 至 −0.11）； 中浓度（>0.05% 至 <0.5%）阿托品：0.48 D（0.34–0.62） 和 −0.23 mm（−0.27 至 −0.19）； 低浓度（0.01%、0.025%、0.05%）阿托品：0.33 D（0.23–0.43） 和 −0.14 mm（−0.19 至 −0.09）； 角膜塑形镜：−0.47 mm（−0.66 至 −0.28）； 周边加光软性接触镜：0.30 D（0.18–0.42） 和 −0.35 mm（−0.62 至 −0.08）； 周边加光框架眼镜：0.77 D（0.40–1.14） 和 −0.43 mm（−0.78 至 −0.08）； 多焦点框架眼镜：0.21 D（0.11–0.31）； 重复低强度红光治疗：0.55 D（0.46–0.65） 和 −0.25 mm（−0.29 至 −0.20）； 户外活动：0.17 D（0.16–0.18） 和 −0.04 mm（−0.06 至 −0.01）。 结论：在减缓眼轴延长方面，高浓度和中浓度阿托品、角膜塑形镜、周边加光框架眼镜以及重复低强度红光显示出具有临床意义的效果；在减缓屈光度进展方面，高浓度和中浓度阿托品、周边加光框架眼镜以及重复低强度红光显示出具有临床意义的效果。 6-1-7摘要 研究背景：近视患病率不断上升，已成为全球公共卫生问题，不仅表现为未矫正屈光不正发生率增加，更重要的是，近视相关眼部并发症会提高视力损害风险。儿童期是近视进展最快的阶段，因此需要在这一时期采取干预措施以减缓近视进展。本研究是该动态系统综述的更新版本。 研究目的：采用网络Meta分析，评估儿童近视控制干预措施在减缓近视进展方面的相对有效性和安全性；对不同干预措施进行疗效排序；并通过简要经济学评论总结相关经济学评价结果。 检索方法：研究者检索了 CENTRAL、MEDLINE、Embase 以及 3个临床试验注册平台，最新检索时间为 2024年2月19日。 纳入标准：纳入对象为 18岁及以下儿童近视控制相关随机对照试验（RCT），干预类型包括光学干预、药物干预、光疗以及行为干预。 结局指标：关键结局包括：干预组与对照组在 1年及以上随访中的等效球镜屈光度（SER，单位D）变化差异，以及眼轴长度（AL，单位mm）变化差异；同时关注停药后的屈光和眼轴反跳变化。 偏倚风险评估：研究采用 Cochrane RoB 2 工具对 SER 和 AL 结局的偏倚风险进行评估。 资料合成方法：研究遵循 Cochrane 标准方法，采用 GRADE 方法评价 1年和2年 SER 与 AL 变化证据的确定性，并使用 SUCRA（累积排序曲线下面积）对各干预措施进行疗效排序。 纳入研究。本次更新共纳入 104项研究（其中 40项为新增研究），共随机分配 17,509名 4–18岁儿童。多数研究来自中国及其他亚洲国家（66.3%）和北美（14.4%）。84项研究（80.8%）将近视控制干预与非活性对照进行比较。研究随访时间为 12–48个月。 结果：由于网络Meta分析中的大多数证据网络连接较差，除特别说明外，估计结果主要基于直接的两两比较。 在1年随访时，对照组 SER 中位变化为 −0.65 D。与对照相比，下列干预可能减缓 SER 进展：重复低强度红光（RLRL，MD 0.80 D，95%CI 0.71–0.89）、高浓度阿托品（≥0.5%，MD 0.90 D，95%CI 0.62–1.18）、中浓度阿托品（0.1%至<0.5%，MD 0.55 D，95%CI 0.17–0.93）、低浓度阿托品（<0.1%，MD 0.25 D，95%CI 0.16–0.35）、周边离焦/周边加光框架镜（PPSL，MD 0.45 D，95%CI 0.16–0.74）、多焦点软性接触镜（MFSCL，MD 0.27 D，95%CI 0.18–0.35）以及多焦点框架镜（MFSL，MD 0.14 D，95%CI 0.08–0.21）。 在1年随访时，对照组 AL 中位变化为 0.33 mm。与对照相比，下列干预可能减缓眼轴延长：RLRL（MD −0.33 mm，95%CI −0.37至−0.29）、高浓度阿托品（MD −0.33 mm，95%CI −0.35至−0.30）、中浓度阿托品（MD −0.24 mm，95%CI −0.34至−0.15）、低浓度阿托品（MD −0.10 mm，95%CI −0.13至−0.07）、角膜塑形镜（Ortho-K，MD −0.18 mm，95%CI −0.21至−0.14）、周边离焦/周边加光框架镜（MD −0.13 mm，95%CI −0.21至−0.05）、多焦点软性接触镜（MD −0.11 mm，95%CI −0.13至−0.09）以及多焦点框架镜（MD −0.06 mm，95%CI −0.09至−0.04）。此外，角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品较单用角膜塑形镜可能进一步减少眼轴延长（MD −0.12 mm，95%CI −0.15至−0.09）。 在2年随访时，SER 和 AL 的干预排序与 1年结果大体相似，但目前数据仍不足以判断累积效应。SER 排名较高的干预为高浓度阿托品、中浓度阿托品和周边离焦/周边加光框架镜；AL 排名较高的干预为角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品、高浓度阿托品和中浓度阿托品。关于停药后是否出现超出年龄预期进展速度的反跳，证据有限。不良事件和治疗依从性报告不一致。仅有两项研究报告生活质量，结果显示干预组与对照组差异很小或无差异。对于不同近视控制策略的相对成本或成本效益，目前尚无法得出明确结论。 结论：大多数研究将药物和光学治疗与非活性对照进行比较。这些干预可能减缓屈光变化并减少眼轴延长，但结果常存在异质性。关于 2年以上随访的数据较少，因此这些干预措施是否具有持续效果仍存在不确定性。未来需要开展更长期、质量更高的研究，比较单一或联合近视控制干预，并改进不良反应的监测与报告。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To determine the effects of advanced spectacle lens technologies on changes in spherical equivalent of refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) elongation in slowing down the progression of myopia in children and adolescents, by synthesising data from randomised controlled trials (RCTs). METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted to identify all RCTs up to 27 February 2025 that compared intervention groups with myopia control lenses and control groups with standard single vision lenses (SVLs). Data from eligible studies were extracted into specially-designed data collection forms without changing the original values. Means and SD for continuous outcomes were determined and imported into RevMan. RESULTS: This meta-analysis included 23 RCTs with a total of 13.315 subjects. Compared with SVLs, myopia control lenses significantly reduced AL (-0.15 mm; 95% CI -0.20 to -0.09; p<0.00001) and SER progression (-0.31 D; 95% CI -0.42 to -0.20; p<0.00001). Highly Aspherical Lenslet lenses significantly reduced AL (-0.28 mm; 95% CI -0.37 to -0.19) and SER progression (-0.52 D; 95% CI -0.84 to -0.20). Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments lenses also significantly reduced SER (-0.45 D; 95% CI -0.65 to -0.26), although only one eligible RCT reported AL data. Other lens types had modest or variable effects. CONCLUSIONS: This meta-analysis provides an up-to-date and detailed comparative evaluation of spectacle lens designs for myopia control, based exclusively on RCTs. These findings support the use of specialty lenses as an effective, non-invasive strategy to reduce the risks associated with high-myopia and guide optimal lens selection in clinical practice. PROSPERO REGISTRATION NUMBER: CRD420251009898.

研究背景：近视患病率不断上升，已成为全球公共卫生问题，不仅表现为未矫正屈光不正发生率增加，更重要的是，近视相关眼部并发症会提高视力损害风险。儿童期是近视进展最快的阶段，因此需要在这一时期采取干预措施以减缓近视进展。本研究是该动态系统综述的更新版本。 研究目的：采用网络Meta分析，评估儿童近视控制干预措施在减缓近视进展方面的相对有效性和安全性；对不同干预措施进行疗效排序；并通过简要经济学评论总结相关经济学评价结果。 检索方法：研究者检索了 CENTRAL、MEDLINE、Embase 以及 3个临床试验注册平台，最新检索时间为 2024年2月19日。 纳入标准：纳入对象为 18岁及以下儿童近视控制相关随机对照试验（RCT），干预类型包括光学干预、药物干预、光疗以及行为干预。 结局指标：关键结局包括：干预组与对照组在 1年及以上随访中的等效球镜屈光度（SER，单位D）变化差异，以及眼轴长度（AL，单位mm）变化差异；同时关注停药后的屈光和眼轴反跳变化。 偏倚风险评估：研究采用 Cochrane RoB 2 工具对 SER 和 AL 结局的偏倚风险进行评估。 资料合成方法：研究遵循 Cochrane 标准方法，采用 GRADE 方法评价 1年和2年 SER 与 AL 变化证据的确定性，并使用 SUCRA（累积排序曲线下面积）对各干预措施进行疗效排序。 纳入研究。本次更新共纳入 104项研究（其中 40项为新增研究），共随机分配 17,509名 4–18岁儿童。多数研究来自中国及其他亚洲国家（66.3%）和北美（14.4%）。84项研究（80.8%）将近视控制干预与非活性对照进行比较。研究随访时间为 12–48个月。 结果：由于网络Meta分析中的大多数证据网络连接较差，除特别说明外，估计结果主要基于直接的两两比较。 在1年随访时，对照组 SER 中位变化为 −0.65 D。与对照相比，下列干预可能减缓 SER 进展：重复低强度红光（RLRL，MD 0.80 D，95%CI 0.71–0.89）、高浓度阿托品（≥0.5%，MD 0.90 D，95%CI 0.62–1.18）、中浓度阿托品（0.1%至<0.5%，MD 0.55 D，95%CI 0.17–0.93）、低浓度阿托品（<0.1%，MD 0.25 D，95%CI 0.16–0.35）、周边离焦/周边加光框架镜（PPSL，MD 0.45 D，95%CI 0.16–0.74）、多焦点软性接触镜（MFSCL，MD 0.27 D，95%CI 0.18–0.35）以及多焦点框架镜（MFSL，MD 0.14 D，95%CI 0.08–0.21）。 在1年随访时，对照组 AL 中位变化为 0.33 mm。与对照相比，下列干预可能减缓眼轴延长：RLRL（MD −0.33 mm，95%CI −0.37至−0.29）、高浓度阿托品（MD −0.33 mm，95%CI −0.35至−0.30）、中浓度阿托品（MD −0.24 mm，95%CI −0.34至−0.15）、低浓度阿托品（MD −0.10 mm，95%CI −0.13至−0.07）、角膜塑形镜（Ortho-K，MD −0.18 mm，95%CI −0.21至−0.14）、周边离焦/周边加光框架镜（MD −0.13 mm，95%CI −0.21至−0.05）、多焦点软性接触镜（MD −0.11 mm，95%CI −0.13至−0.09）以及多焦点框架镜（MD −0.06 mm，95%CI −0.09至−0.04）。此外，角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品较单用角膜塑形镜可能进一步减少眼轴延长（MD −0.12 mm，95%CI −0.15至−0.09）。 在2年随访时，SER 和 AL 的干预排序与 1年结果大体相似，但目前数据仍不足以判断累积效应。SER 排名较高的干预为高浓度阿托品、中浓度阿托品和周边离焦/周边加光框架镜；AL 排名较高的干预为角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品、高浓度阿托品和中浓度阿托品。关于停药后是否出现超出年龄预期进展速度的反跳，证据有限。不良事件和治疗依从性报告不一致。仅有两项研究报告生活质量，结果显示干预组与对照组差异很小或无差异。对于不同近视控制策略的相对成本或成本效益，目前尚无法得出明确结论。 结论：大多数研究将药物和光学治疗与非活性对照进行比较。这些干预可能减缓屈光变化并减少眼轴延长，但结果常存在异质性。关于 2年以上随访的数据较少，因此这些干预措施是否具有持续效果仍存在不确定性。未来需要开展更长期、质量更高的研究，比较单一或联合近视控制干预，并改进不良反应的监测与报告。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
To compare the treatment efficacy of childhood myopia control optical interventions [spectacles, soft contact lenses (SCLs) and orthokeratology (OK) lenses], explore the consistency of treatment efficacies during the treatment period and evaluate the impact of baseline spherical equivalent refraction (SER), axial length (AL) and age on the treatment effect. A literature search of EMBASE, PubMed and Google Scholar databases identified 220 articles published between January 2000 and April 2022, which reported the treatment efficacy by differences in the SER and AL change between intervention and control groups. Thirty-five articles were included in the analysis. Treatment effect sizes (ESs) were calculated, where more positive and negative directions indicated greater treatment efficacy for SER and AL respectively. For SER, the ESs with peripheral add design spectacles (0.66) and SCLs (0.53) were large but not significantly different between treatment types (p = 0.69). For AL, ESs with peripheral add design spectacles (-0.37), SCLs (-0.55) and OK lenses (-0.93) were large, but OK lenses had a significantly greater effect than peripheral add design spectacles (p ≤ 0.001). ESs were large during the first 12 months of treatment for all interventions [peripheral add design SCLs and OK (F ≥ 5.39, p ≤ 0.01), peripheral add design spectacles (F = 0.47, p = 0.63)] but reduced towards the end of 24-36 months of treatment. Baseline SER had an impact on the treatment effect with peripheral add design spectacles only. Optical interventions are efficacious in controlling childhood myopia progression. However, treatment effects were largest only during the first 12 months of treatment and reduced over time.

原文摘要
摘要： 目的：总结已发表 Meta 分析中各种近视控制干预措施的合并疗效估计。 方法：研究者检索了 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science 数据库，自建库起至 2024 年 2 月，纳入报告各种近视控制策略治疗效果的系统综述和 Meta 分析。采用 16 项的 AMSTAR 2 工具评估纳入 Meta 分析的方法学质量。若某种干预使**等效球镜（SER）每年变化达到 ≥0.50 D，或使眼轴长度（AL）**每年变化达到 ≤−0.18 mm，则定义为具有临床意义的疗效。 结果：共纳入 38 项研究。SER 和 AL 的总体变化均值差（MD，95% CI）分别为： 高浓度（≥0.5%）阿托品：0.67 D（0.58–0.77） 和 −0.24 mm（−0.36 至 −0.11）； 中浓度（>0.05% 至 <0.5%）阿托品：0.48 D（0.34–0.62） 和 −0.23 mm（−0.27 至 −0.19）； 低浓度（0.01%、0.025%、0.05%）阿托品：0.33 D（0.23–0.43） 和 −0.14 mm（−0.19 至 −0.09）； 角膜塑形镜：−0.47 mm（−0.66 至 −0.28）； 周边加光软性接触镜：0.30 D（0.18–0.42） 和 −0.35 mm（−0.62 至 −0.08）； 周边加光框架眼镜：0.77 D（0.40–1.14） 和 −0.43 mm（−0.78 至 −0.08）； 多焦点框架眼镜：0.21 D（0.11–0.31）； 重复低强度红光治疗：0.55 D（0.46–0.65） 和 −0.25 mm（−0.29 至 −0.20）； 户外活动：0.17 D（0.16–0.18） 和 −0.04 mm（−0.06 至 −0.01）。 结论：在减缓眼轴延长方面，高浓度和中浓度阿托品、角膜塑形镜、周边加光框架眼镜以及重复低强度红光显示出具有临床意义的效果；在减缓屈光度进展方面，高浓度和中浓度阿托品、周边加光框架眼镜以及重复低强度红光显示出具有临床意义的效果。 6-1-7摘要 官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To summarise pooled estimates of the efficacies of various myopia control interventions, as drawn from published meta-analyses. METHOD: PubMed, SCOPUS and Web of Science were searched from inception to February 2024 for systematic reviews and meta-analyses reporting treatment effects of various myopia control strategies. The qualities of the included meta-analyses were assessed using the 16-item A MeaSurement Tool to Assess systematic Reviews (AMSTAR) 2. An intervention was defined as having a clinically significant effect if it resulted in a change in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) of ≥0.50 D/year or axial length (AL) change of ≤-0.18 mm/year. RESULTS: A total of 38 studies were identified. The overall respective changes in SER and AL, mean difference (95% CI) were high-concentration (≥0.5%) atropine 0.67 D (0.58-0.77) and -0.24 mm (-0.36 to -0.11); moderate-concentration (>0.05% to <0.5%) atropine 0.48 D (0.34-0.62) and -0.23 mm (-0.27 to -0.19); low-concentration (0.01%, 0.025%, 0.05%) atropine 0.33 D (0.23-0.43) and -0.14 mm (-0.19 to -0.09); orthokeratology -0.47 mm (-0.66 to -0.28); peripheral plus soft contact lenses 0.30 D (0.18-0.42) and -0.35 mm (-0.62 to -0.08); peripheral plus spectacles 0.77 D (0.40-1.14) and -0.43 mm (-0.78 to -0.08); multifocal spectacles 0.21 D (0.11-0.31); repeated low-level red light therapy 0.55 D (0.46-0.65) and -0.25 mm (-0.29 to -0.20); outdoor time 0.17 D (0.16-0.18) and -0.04 mm (-0.06 to -0.01). CONCLUSION: High and moderate concentrations of atropine, orthokeratology, peripheral plus spectacles and repeated low-level red light demonstrated clinically significant effects on slowing AL elongation, while high and moderate concentrations of atropine, peripheral plus spectacles and repeated low-level red light demonstrated clinically significant effects on slowing SER progression.

原文摘要
摘要 研究背景：近视患病率不断上升，已成为全球公共卫生问题，不仅表现为未矫正屈光不正发生率增加，更重要的是，近视相关眼部并发症会提高视力损害风险。儿童期是近视进展最快的阶段，因此需要在这一时期采取干预措施以减缓近视进展。本研究是该动态系统综述的更新版本。 研究目的：采用网络Meta分析，评估儿童近视控制干预措施在减缓近视进展方面的相对有效性和安全性；对不同干预措施进行疗效排序；并通过简要经济学评论总结相关经济学评价结果。 检索方法：研究者检索了 CENTRAL、MEDLINE、Embase 以及 3个临床试验注册平台，最新检索时间为 2024年2月19日。 纳入标准：纳入对象为 18岁及以下儿童近视控制相关随机对照试验（RCT），干预类型包括光学干预、药物干预、光疗以及行为干预。 结局指标：关键结局包括：干预组与对照组在 1年及以上随访中的等效球镜屈光度（SER，单位D）变化差异，以及眼轴长度（AL，单位mm）变化差异；同时关注停药后的屈光和眼轴反跳变化。 偏倚风险评估：研究采用 Cochrane RoB 2 工具对 SER 和 AL 结局的偏倚风险进行评估。 资料合成方法：研究遵循 Cochrane 标准方法，采用 GRADE 方法评价 1年和2年 SER 与 AL 变化证据的确定性，并使用 SUCRA（累积排序曲线下面积）对各干预措施进行疗效排序。 纳入研究。本次更新共纳入 104项研究（其中 40项为新增研究），共随机分配 17,509名 4–18岁儿童。多数研究来自中国及其他亚洲国家（66.3%）和北美（14.4%）。84项研究（80.8%）将近视控制干预与非活性对照进行比较。研究随访时间为 12–48个月。 结果：由于网络Meta分析中的大多数证据网络连接较差，除特别说明外，估计结果主要基于直接的两两比较。 在1年随访时，对照组 SER 中位变化为 −0.65 D。与对照相比，下列干预可能减缓 SER 进展：重复低强度红光（RLRL，MD 0.80 D，95%CI 0.71–0.89）、高浓度阿托品（≥0.5%，MD 0.90 D，95%CI 0.62–1.18）、中浓度阿托品（0.1%至<0.5%，MD 0.55 D，95%CI 0.17–0.93）、低浓度阿托品（<0.1%，MD 0.25 D，95%CI 0.16–0.35）、周边离焦/周边加光框架镜（PPSL，MD 0.45 D，95%CI 0.16–0.74）、多焦点软性接触镜（MFSCL，MD 0.27 D，95%CI 0.18–0.35）以及多焦点框架镜（MFSL，MD 0.14 D，95%CI 0.08–0.21）。 在1年随访时，对照组 AL 中位变化为 0.33 mm。与对照相比，下列干预可能减缓眼轴延长：RLRL（MD −0.33 mm，95%CI −0.37至−0.29）、高浓度阿托品（MD −0.33 mm，95%CI −0.35至−0.30）、中浓度阿托品（MD −0.24 mm，95%CI −0.34至−0.15）、低浓度阿托品（MD −0.10 mm，95%CI −0.13至−0.07）、角膜塑形镜（Ortho-K，MD −0.18 mm，95%CI −0.21至−0.14）、周边离焦/周边加光框架镜（MD −0.13 mm，95%CI −0.21至−0.05）、多焦点软性接触镜（MD −0.11 mm，95%CI −0.13至−0.09）以及多焦点框架镜（MD −0.06 mm，95%CI −0.09至−0.04）。此外，角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品较单用角膜塑形镜可能进一步减少眼轴延长（MD −0.12 mm，95%CI −0.15至−0.09）。 在2年随访时，SER 和 AL 的干预排序与 1年结果大体相似，但目前数据仍不足以判断累积效应。SER 排名较高的干预为高浓度阿托品、中浓度阿托品和周边离焦/周边加光框架镜；AL 排名较高的干预为角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品、高浓度阿托品和中浓度阿托品。关于停药后是否出现超出年龄预期进展速度的反跳，证据有限。不良事件和治疗依从性报告不一致。仅有两项研究报告生活质量，结果显示干预组与对照组差异很小或无差异。对于不同近视控制策略的相对成本或成本效益，目前尚无法得出明确结论。 结论：大多数研究将药物和光学治疗与非活性对照进行比较。这些干预可能减缓屈光变化并减少眼轴延长，但结果常存在异质性。关于 2年以上随访的数据较少，因此这些干预措施是否具有持续效果仍存在不确定性。未来需要开展更长期、质量更高的研究，比较单一或联合近视控制干预，并改进不良反应的监测与报告。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
RATIONALE: The increasing prevalence of myopia is a growing global public health problem, in terms of rates of uncorrected refractive error and significantly, an increased risk of visual impairment due to myopia-related ocular morbidity. Interventions to slow its progression are needed in childhood, when myopia progression is most rapid. This is a review update, conducted as part of a living systematic review. OBJECTIVES: To assess the comparative efficacy and safety of interventions for slowing myopia progression in children using network meta-analysis (NMA). To generate a relative ranking of interventions according to their efficacy. To produce a brief economic commentary, summarising economic evaluations. SEARCH METHODS: We searched CENTRAL, MEDLINE, Embase, and three trial registers. The latest search date was 19 February 2024. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: We included randomised controlled trials (RCTs) of optical, pharmacological, light therapy and behavioural interventions for slowing myopia progression in children, up to 18 years old. OUTCOMES: Critical outcomes were progression of myopia (mean difference (MD) in the change in spherical equivalent refraction (SER, dioptres (D)), and axial length (AL, mm) in the intervention and control groups at one year or longer), and difference in the change in SER and AL following cessation of treatment (rebound). RISK OF BIAS: We assessed the risk of bias (RoB) for SER and AL using the Cochrane RoB 2 tool. SYNTHESIS METHODS: We followed standard Cochrane methods. We rated the certainty of evidence using the GRADE approach for change in SER and AL at one and two years. We used the surface under the cumulative ranking curve (SUCRA) to rank the interventions for all available outcomes. INCLUDED STUDIES: We included 104 studies (40 new for this update) that randomised 17,509 children, aged 4 years to 18 years. Most studies were conducted in China or other Asian countries (66.3%), and North America (14.4%). Eighty-four studies (80.8%) compared myopia control interventions against inactive controls. Study durations ranged from 12 months to 48 months. SYNTHESIS OF RESULTS: Since most of the networks in the NMA were poorly connected, our estimates are based on direct (pairwise) comparisons, unless stated otherwise. The median change in SER for controls was -0.65 D (55 studies, 4888 participants; one-year follow-up). These interventions may reduce SER progression compared to controls: repeated low intensity red light (RLRL: MD 0.80 D, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.71 to 0.89; SUCRA = 93.8%; very low-certainty evidence); high-dose atropine (HDA (≥ 0.5%): MD 0.90 D, 95% CI 0.62 to 1.18; SUCRA = 93.3%; moderate-certainty evidence); medium-dose atropine (MDA (0.1% to < 0.5%): MD 0.55 D, 95% CI 0.17 to 0.93; NMA estimate SUCRA = 75.5%; low-certainty evidence); low dose atropine (LDA (< 0.1%): MD 0.25 D, 95% CI 0.16 to 0.35; SUCRA = 53.2%; very low-certainty evidence); peripheral plus spectacle lenses (PPSL: MD 0.45 D, 95% CI 0.16 to 0.74; SUCRA = 50.2%; very low-certainty evidence); multifocal soft contact lenses (MFSCL: MD 0.27 D, 95% CI 0.18 to 0.35; SUCRA = 49.9%; very low-certainty evidence); and multifocal spectacle lenses (MFSL: MD 0.14 D, 95% CI 0.08 to 0.21; SUCRA = 30.8%; low-certainty evidence). The median change in AL for controls was 0.33 mm (58 studies, 9085 participants; one-year follow-up). These interventions may reduce axial elongation compared to controls: RLRL (MD -0.33 mm, 95% CI -0.37 to -0.29; SUCRA = 98.6%; very low-certainty evidence); HDA (MD -0.33 mm, 95% CI -0.35 to -0.30; SUCRA = 88.4%; moderate-certainty evidence); MDA (MD -0.24 mm, 95% CI -0.34 to -0.15; NMA estimate SUCRA = 75.8%; low-certainty evidence); LDA (MD -0.10 mm, 95% CI -0.13 to -0.07; SUCRA = 36.1%; very low-certainty evidence); orthokeratology (ortho-K: MD -0.18 mm, 95% CI -0.21 to -0.14; SUCRA = 79%; moderate-certainty evidence); PPSL (MD -0.13 mm, 95% CI -0.21 to -0.05; SUCRA = 52.6%; very low-certainty evidence); MFSCL (MD -0.11 mm, 95% CI -0.13 to -0.09; SUCRA = 45.6%; low-certainty evidence); and MFSL (MD -0.06 mm, 95% CI -0.09 to -0.04; SUCRA = 26.3%; low-certainty evidence). Ortho-K plus LDA probably reduces axial elongation more than ortho-K monotherapy (MD -0.12 mm, 95% CI -0.15 to -0.09; SUCRA = 81.8%; moderate-certainty evidence). At two-year follow-up, change in SER was reported in 34 studies (3556 participants). The median change in SER for controls was -1.01 D. The ranking of interventions to reduce SER progression was close to that observed at one year; there were insufficient data to draw conclusions on cumulative effects. The highest-ranking interventions were: HAD (SUCRA = 97%); MDA (NMA estimate SUCRA = 69.8%); and PPSL (SUCRA = 69.1%). At two-year follow-up, change in AL was reported in 33 studies (3334 participants). The median change in AL for controls was 0.56 mm. The ranking of interventions to reduce axial elongation was similar to that observed at one year; there were insufficient data to draw conclusions on cumulative effects. The highest-ranking interventions were: ortho-K plus LDA (SUCRA = 94.2%); HAD (SUCRA = 96.8%); and MDA (NMA estimate SUCRA = 88.4%). There was limited evidence on whether cessation of myopia control therapy increases progression beyond the expected rate of progression with age. Adverse events and treatment adherence were not consistently reported. Two studies reported quality of life, showing little to no difference between intervention and control groups. We were unable to draw firm conclusions regarding the relative costs or efficiency of different myopia control strategies in children. AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: Most studies compared pharmacological and optical treatments to slow the progression of myopia with an inactive comparator. These interventions may slow refractive change and reduce axial elongation, although results were often heterogeneous. Less evidence is available for two years and beyond; uncertainty remains about the sustained effect of these interventions. Longer term and better quality studies comparing myopia control interventions alone or in combination are needed, with improved methods for monitoring and reporting adverse effects. FUNDING: Cochrane Eyes and Vision US Project is supported by grant UG1EY020522, National Eye Institute, National Institutes of Health. REGISTRATION: The previous version of this living systematic review is available at doi: 10.1002/14651858.CD014758.pub2.

参考文献6-1-8｜HAL叙述性综述——现有研究总体支持HAL减缓儿童眼轴增长 主要作者：Olga Prenat（第一作者）；Mark A. Bullimore（通讯作者） 检索时间及数据库：2025年12月，PubMed及Scopus 纳入研究：26项独立研究，包括4项RCT、6项前瞻性研究、16项回顾性研究 样本量：共 4,079名HAL配戴儿童 观察时间：各研究至少6个月 主要结果 - HAL vs. SVL：含单光对照组的研究中，一年AL增长的中位数为HAL组 0.12 mm、SVL组 0.32 mm。 - HAL vs. OK镜：10项比较研究中，6项在至少一个亚组观察到HAL组眼轴增长更少。 - HAL联合阿托品：5项研究涉及联合治疗，结果总体支持联合方案具有额外获益。 - SE：未报告统一汇总的进展量或控制率

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：探讨并总结评估高非球面微透镜技术（HAL）眼镜镜片的相关研究。 方法：于2025年12月检索PubMed和Scopus数据库，检索词包括(myopi*) AND (child* OR adolescen*) AND (aspherical lenslets OR Stellest OR high aspherical lenticule)。审查所有摘要，并在适用且可获取时评估全文。提取研究持续时间、平均年龄、平均近视进展和平均眼轴增长等数据。 结果：在确定的78篇讨论HAL镜片的文献中，共有26项独立研究报告了儿童配戴HAL镜片至少6个月的近视进展、眼轴增长或两者（其中17项在中国开展）。26篇文献共报告了4079名配戴HAL镜片儿童的数据，除2篇外均报告了眼轴数据。其中包括4项随机临床试验、6项前瞻性研究和16项回顾性研究；11项研究包含单光眼镜对照组，8项与配戴其他近视控制眼镜儿童对比，10项与夜戴角膜塑形镜对比，5项报告了HAL镜片联合阿托品使用。配戴HAL镜片儿童的所有平均眼轴增长值均低于未治疗儿童。在包含单光对照组的研究中（平均年龄10.2岁），HAL配戴者的1年中位眼轴增长为0.12 mm，而单光组为0.32 mm。在与夜戴角膜塑形镜对比的研究中，6项显示HAL镜片在至少一个亚组中眼轴增长更慢。阿托品增加了HAL镜片的有效性，反之亦然。 结论：无论研究设计和地区如何，证据表明配戴HAL镜片儿童的眼轴增长均低于配戴单光眼镜者。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: A new generation of myopia control spectacles has emerged, including spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslet technology (HAL lenses). To date, HAL lenses have only been thoroughly evaluated in a single site randomized clinical trial in China and a recently published, multicenter, North American clinical trial. The goal of this review is to explore and summarize additional studies of HAL lenses. Methods: A search of both PubMed and Scopus was conducted in December 2025 using the terms: (myopi*) AND (child* OR adolescen*) AND (aspherical lenslets OR Stellest OR high aspherical lenticule). All abstracts were reviewed and, when appropriate and available, full papers were evaluated. Data extracted included study duration, mean age, mean myopia progression, and mean axial elongation. Results: Among the 78 papers identified that discuss HAL lenses, many reported vision or choroidal changes, or were review articles. Overall, 26 independent studies reported myopia progression, axial elongation, or both for children wearing HAL lenses for at least 6 months, of which 17 were conducted in China. Collectively, the 26 papers report data on 4079 children wearing HAL lenses and all but two report axial length data. There were four randomized clinical trials, six prospective studies, and 16 retrospective studies. Eleven studies included a single vision comparison group, eight compared HAL lens wearers to children wearing other myopia control spectacles, 10 compared HAL lenses to overnight orthokeratology, and five studies reported on HAL lenses used in combination with atropine. All mean axial elongations values for children wearing HAL lenses were below those for untreated children. Among studies with a single vision comparison group (mean age 10.2 years), median 1‐year axial elongation for HAL wearers was 0.12 mm compared with 0.32 mm in the single vision group. Among studies comparing HAL lenses to overnight orthokeratology, six showed slower axial elongation for HAL lenses in at least one subgroup. Atropine increased the effectiveness of HAL lenses and vice versa. Conclusion: Regardless of study design and location, evidence suggests that axial elongation in children wearing HAL lenses is lower than those wearing single vision lenses.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-1
原文摘要
摘要 比较高非球面微透镜（HAL）与离焦整合多段式（DIMS）框架眼镜在 1 年内对近视进展的控制效果。本回顾性队列研究纳入了中国广州爱尔眼科医院中处方 HAL 、DIMS 框架眼镜儿童的数据。为解决部分儿童随访时间不足 1 年或超过 1 年这一差异，本研究计算了标准化的 1 年球镜当量屈光度（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）较基线的变化值。采用多变量线性回归模型比较两组间变化值的均值差异，模型中纳入了年龄、性别、基线 SER/AL 及治疗方式等变量。共纳入 257 名符合纳入标准的儿童进行分析（HAL 组 193 名，DIMS 组 64 名）。控制基线变量后，HAL 和 DIMS 框架眼镜使用者标准化的 1 年 SER 变化校正均值（标准误，SE）分别为 - 0.34（0.04）D 和 - 0.63（0.07）D。与 DIMS 眼镜相比，HAL 眼镜在 1 年内可减少 0.29 D 的近视进展（95% 置信区间 [CI]：0.13~0.44 D）。相应地，佩戴 HAL 眼镜和 DIMS 眼镜的儿童，其 AL 校正均值（SE）分别增加 0.17（0.02）mm 和 0.28（0.04）mm。与 DIMS 使用者相比，HAL 使用者的 AL 增长少 0.11 mm（95% CI：-0.20~-0.02 mm）。基线年龄与 AL 增长显著相关。佩戴 HAL 设计框架眼镜的中国儿童，其近视进展和眼轴增长程度均低于佩戴 DIMS 设计框架眼镜的儿童。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
To compare spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) versus defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) on myopia progression control in 1 year. This retrospective cohort study involved data from children prescribed HAL or DIMS spectacle lenses in Guangzhou Aier Eye Hospital, China. To address the discrepancy that some children followed up at less than or more than 1 year, the standardized 1-year spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) changes from baseline were calculated. The mean differences in the changes between the two groups were compared with linear multivariate regression models. Age, sex, baseline SER/AL, and treatment were included in the models. A total of 257 children who qualified for the inclusion criteria were included for the analyses (193 in the HAL group and 64 in the DIMS group). After controlling baseline variates, the adjusted mean (standard error, SE) of the standardized 1-year changes in SER for HAL and DIMS spectacle lens users were - 0.34 (0.04) D and - 0.63 (0.07) D, respectively. HAL spectacle lenses reduced myopia progression by 0.29 D (95% confidence interval [CI] 0.13 to 0.44 D) at 1 year compared to DIMS lenses. Accordingly, the adjusted mean (SE) ALs increased by 0.17 (0.02) and 0.28 (0.04) mm for children wearing HAL lenses and DIMS lenses, respectively. HAL users had 0.11 mm less AL elongation (95% CI - 0.20 to - 0.02 mm) than DIMS users. Age at baseline was significantly associated with AL elongation. Chinese children wearing spectacle lenses designed with HAL had less myopia progression and axial elongation than those wearing spectacle lenses designed with DIMS.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-2
原文摘要
摘要 目的：在真实世界研究中评估镜片对近视控制的有效性。 方法：本研究为基于法国近视队列（French Myopia Cohort）的真实世界纵向回顾性对比观察研究。2020 年至 2023 年期间，从 1500 名验光师处收集了光学矫正处方记录、性别及年龄信息。研究队列纳入 4-15 岁近视儿童，分为三组：两组对照组（佩戴单光镜片，SVL）和一组干预组（佩戴近视控制眼镜，MCS），其中 MCS 组包括佩戴多焦点离焦镜片（DIMS，n=1786）和高非球面微透镜（HAL，n=585）的儿童。第一组 SVL 对照组与 MCS 组在年龄、性别和初始屈光不正方面进行匹配（首次匹配）；第二组 SVL 对照组除上述匹配标准外，还增加了随访前 6 个月的近视进展情况匹配（二次匹配）。计算 SVL 对照组与 MCS 组之间的近视进展差异，并比较 DIMS 与 HAL 的近视控制效果。 结果：三组各纳入 2542 名儿童（基线平均年龄 9.5 岁，平均等效球镜度数为 - 2.3 D）。与 SVL 对照组相比，首次匹配后 MCS 组的平均近视进展减缓幅度为 + 0.59 D（95% 置信区间 [CI]：+0.57 至 + 0.62 D，p<0.001）；二次匹配后，该减缓幅度为 + 0.30 D（95% CI：+0.28 至 + 0.32 D，p<0.001）。与佩戴 DIMS 镜片的儿童相比，佩戴 HAL 镜片的儿童近视进展略慢（进展差异 =+0.14 D，95% CI：+0.10 至 + 0.18，p<0.001）。 结论：尽管本研究存在局限性（包括回顾性设计、缺乏生活方式和环境因素数据、采用等效球镜度数 [SE] 而非眼轴长度作为评估指标），但结果表明，在真实世界场景中，DIMS 和 HAL 镜片均能有效减缓近视进展。虽然 HAL 组的近视进展速率在统计学上显著更低，但该差异无临床意义。本研究还显示，DIMS 和 HAL 镜片对 4-6 岁低龄儿童的近视进展同样具有减缓作用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
AIMS: To evaluate the efficacy of myopia control by spectacle lenses in a real-world study. METHODS: This is a longitudinal, retrospective, comparative, observational, real-world study of the French Myopia Cohort. Records of prescriptions for optical correction, gender and age were collected from 1500 opticians between 2020 and 2023. The study cohort consisted of myopic children aged 4 to 15 years who were assigned to three groups: two control groups wearing single vision lenses (SVL) and one intervention group wearing myopia control spectacles (MCS); either defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS, n=1786) or highly aspheric lenses (HAL, n=585). The first SVL group was matched to the MCS group for age, sex and initial refractive error (first matching), and the second SVL group was matched for the same criteria and myopia progression during the first 6 months of follow-up (second matching).The difference in myopia progression was calculated between SVL groups and the MCS group. DIMS and HAL were also compared for myopia progression. RESULTS: A total of 2542 children (mean age of 9.5 years and mean spherical equivalent of -2.3 D at baseline) were included in each of the three groups. The mean progression rates for MCS were by +0.59 D (95% CI +0.57 to +0.62D; p<0.001) after the first matching and by +0.30 D (95% CI +0.28 to +0.32D; p<0.001) after the second matching, in comparison to the SVL groups. Children wearing HAL spectacles showed slightly less myopia progression (difference in progression = +0.14 D, 95% CI = +0.10 to +0.18, p<0.001) compared with the DIMS group. CONCLUSIONS: Although there are some limitations, including its retrospective design, the lack of lifestyle and environmental data and the use of SE rather than axial length, this study showed that in a real-world setting, both DIMS and HAL spectacles demonstrated efficacy in reducing myopia progression. While a statistically significant lower myopia progression rate was observed in the HAL group, this difference was not clinically meaningful. This study also showed that DIMS and HAL reduce myopia progression among younger children aged 4 to 6 years.

摘要 目的：针对两种不同设计的多点微透镜近视离焦眼镜［多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）与高非球面微透镜（HAL）］对于儿童近视控制效果开展临床研究。 方法：收集2020年9月5日至2021年8月3日在北京爱尔英智眼科医院配框架眼镜并建立档案的287例儿童，其中观察组190例配戴多点微透镜近视离焦眼镜（DIMS组88例，HAL组102例），对照组97例配戴单焦点镜片（SVL）。取右眼数据统计分析，观察三组儿童配戴后近视进展情况，比较配戴前及配戴后6、12个月等效球镜（SER）和眼轴变化。 结果：两组配戴镜12个月后等效球镜（SER）增长幅度得到有效减少。DIMS组12个月屈光度变化为（-0.44±0.37）D，HAL组为（0.36±0.49）D，SVL组为（-0.91±0.60）D；DIMS组和HAL组12个月屈光度增长均小于SVL组（均P＜0.05），HAL组屈光度增长较DIMS组差异无显著性（P=0.29）。两组配戴镜12个月后眼轴增长幅度均得到有效减少，DIMS组、HAL组和SVL组12个月眼轴变化分别为（0.25±0.17）mm、0.16±0.12 mm和（0.47±0.31）mm；DIMS组和HAL组12个月眼轴增长均小于SVL组（均P＜0.05），且HAL组12个月眼轴增长小于DIMS组（P＜0.05）。 结论：DIMS镜片和HAL设计镜片均可有效延缓儿童近视进展速度；HAL设计与多区正向光学离焦设计镜片控制近视效果在屈光度变化上差异无显著性，而在眼轴变化上HAL设计控制近视效果优于DIMS设计效果，差异有显著性。

摘要 目的：比较佩戴角膜塑形镜（OK镜）和特殊设计框架眼镜对低龄近视儿童眼轴控制的效果。 方法：回顾性队列研究。纳入2021年9月至2023年5月在成都爱迪眼科医院配镜的低龄中低度近视儿童129例（248眼）。分为OK镜组（60例，115眼）和特殊设计框架眼镜组（69例，133眼，含三种设计亚组）。在小瞳下使用生物测量仪测量基线及戴镜12个月后的眼轴长度（AL），分别采用独立样本t检验和单因素方差比较OK镜组与框架镜组及不同框架亚组间AL增长量的差异。 结果：戴镜12个月，OK镜组与框架镜组眼轴增长量分别为（0.27±0.17）mm和（0.26±0.20）mm，差异无统计学意义（t=-0.26，P=0.798）。高度非球微透镜眼镜（HAL）、多焦点正向光学离焦眼镜（DIMS）和周边视力控制技术眼镜（蔡司成长乐加强版ZMAA）三种不同设计框架眼镜的眼轴增长量分别为（0.17±0.19）、（0.29±0.22）和（0.35±0.16）mm，总体差异有统计学意义（F=13.77，P<0.001）；HAL控制效果优于ZMAA和DIMS（P<0.001，P=0.007），DIMS与ZMAA眼轴年增加量差异无统计学意义（P=0.212）。 结论：对于低龄近视儿童，佩戴OK镜与特殊设计框架眼镜对眼轴控制效果相当。

Objective To compare the efficacy of orthokeratology lenses(OK lenses) and specially designed spectacle lenses for the control of axial length in low-age myopic children. Methods This was a retrospective cohort study. One hundred and twenty-nine low-age myopic children (248 eyes) who were fitted with lenses at Chengdu Aidi Eye Hospital from Sep. 2021 to May 2023 were included. Participants were divided into two groups based on the methods of correction: an OK lenses group (60 cases,115 eyes) and a special spectacle lenses group (69 cases,133 eyes )(including three design subgroups). All children underwent biometric measurements under small pupil conditions to assess axial length (AL) baseline and the 12-months follow-up AL. Independent sample t-tests and one-way ANOVA were utilized to compare the changes in AL between the OK lens group and the spectacle lens group, as well as among different spectacle lens subgroups. Results At 12 months after wearing, AL growth was (0. 27±0. 17) mm in the OK lens group and (0. 26±0. 20)mm in the spectacle group, with no statistically significant difference (t = -0. 26, P= 0. 798). AL growth was (0. 17±0. 19), (0. 29±0. 22), and (0. 35±0. 16)mm, resulted from the three different designs of frame glasses: highly aspheric multifocal ( HAL), defocus incorporated multiple segments ( DIMS), and peripheral vision control technology ( ZEISS Myovision ACE Asiana ZMMA), respectively, with statistically significant differences (F= 13. 77, P<0. 001). The control effect of HAL was superior to that of ZMAA and DIMS (P<0. 001, P = 0. 007), while there was no statistically significant difference in the annual increase of AL between DIMS and ZMAA (P= 0. 212). DIMS vs HALT vs CARE—三臂RCT

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2025年👥 Gupta Vinay, Saxena Rohit, Dhiman Rebika, Phuljhele Swati, Sharma Namrata

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-5
原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在评估并对比不同基于周边离焦的眼镜设计 [离焦诱导多段式（DIMS）、高非球面微透镜（HALT）和柱面环形屈光元件（CARE）] 在控制近视进展中的疗效。 方法：本研究为一项前瞻性、干预性、双盲随机临床试验。纳入 5-15 岁近视儿童，其近视度数范围为 - 1 屈光度（D）至 - 8 屈光度（D），且经记录的近视年进展量≥0.5 屈光度 / 年，将其按 1:1:1 比例随机分配，分别全天佩戴 DIMS、HALT 或 CARE 眼镜。在基线时和 1 年后进行睫状肌麻痹验光和眼轴长度测量。主要结局指标为近视进展速率的变化。所有分析均基于意向性治疗原则进行。 结果：共纳入 120 名受试者（DIMS、HALT、CARE 三组各 40 人），平均年龄为 10.1±3.3 岁，其中男性占 57%。1 年随访时，DIMS 组、HALT 组、CARE 组的近视进展速率分别降低了 0.38±0.13 屈光度 / 年（56.7%）、0.36±0.12 屈光度 / 年（58.1%）和 0.31±0.15 屈光度 / 年（47%）；各组眼轴长度变化分别为 0.2±0.11 毫米、0.19±0.12 毫米和 0.23±0.14 毫米。组间比较显示，HALT 组与 CARE 组在等效球镜度数变化方面存在显著差异（p=0.04），DIMS 组与 CARE 组在近视进展速率方面存在显著差异（p=0.04）；而 HALT 组与 DIMS 组在所有指标上均无显著差异。 结论：采用周边离焦技术的眼镜镜片（DIMS、HALT、CARE）均能显著降低近视进展速率，且未观察到不良反应。在 1 年随访时，三种设计中 DIMS 和 HALT 的疗效相当，且显著优于 CARE 眼镜。然而，仍需进一步开展长期研究以验证上述结果。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study aimed to evaluate and compare the efficacy of different peripheral defocus-based spectacle designs [Defocus Induced Multiple Segment (DIMS), Highly Aspherical Lenslets (HALT) and Cylindrical Annular Refractive Elements (CARE)] in controlling myopia progression. METHODS: This was a prospective, interventional, double-blinded, randomised clinical trial. Children aged 5 to 15 years, with myopia ranging from -1 D to -8 D and documented myopia progression of ≥0.5 D/year, were randomly assigned (1:1:1) to wear either DIMS, HALT or CARE spectacles full-time. Cycloplegic refraction and axial length measurements were taken at baseline and after 1 year. The primary outcome was the change in the rate of myopia progression. All analyses were performed based on the intention-to-treat principle. RESULTS: A total of 120 participants (40 in each group: DIMS, HALT and CARE) with a mean age of 10.1 ± 3.3 years (57% male) were enrolled. At the 1-year follow-up, the rate of myopia progression reduced by 0.38 ± 0.13 D/year (56.7%), 0.36 ± 0.12 D/year (58.1%) and 0.31 ± 0.15 D/year (47%) for the DIMS, HALT and CARE groups, respectively. The respective change in axial length was 0.2 ± 0.11 mm, 0.19 ± 0.12 mm and 0.23 ± 0.14 mm. Inter-group comparisons showed a significant difference in spherical equivalent refractive error changes between HALT and CARE (p = 0.04) and in the rate of myopia progression between DIMS and CARE (p = 0.04). No significant differences were found between HALT and DIMS for any parameter. CONCLUSIONS: Spectacle lenses incorporating peripheral defocus (DIMS, HALT and CARE) were all effective in reducing the rate of myopia progression significantly, with no adverse effects being observed. Among the three designs, DIMS and HALT exhibited comparable and significantly better efficacy than CARE spectacles at 1 year follow-up. However, further long-term studies are required to validate these findings.

摘要 目的：比较使用0.01%阿托品滴眼液（0.01%A）和高非球面微透镜设计的镜片（HAL）治疗近视儿童1年内的疗效差异，并分析影响疗效的因素。 方法：回顾性系列病例研究。连续纳入2021年9月至2024年6月期间在温州医科大学附属眼视光医院接受0.01%A治疗的近视儿童99例（99眼，年龄8.8岁）和验配HAL的儿童296例（296眼，年龄9.1岁）。主要观察指标为随访12个月的AL增长量，次要观察指标为SE和散光度数变化量。均纳入右眼数据分析，采用Mann-Whitney U检验、Cliff's Delta、广义线性模型及多元线性回归模型进行分析。 结果：HAL组随访12个月AL增长量为0.15（0.05，0.26）mm，明显小于0.01%A组的0.28（0.13，0.39）mm（Z=-4.88，P<0.001，Cliff's Delta=0.33）；SE变化量亦小于0.01%A组（Z=2.42，P=0.016，Cliff's Delta=-0.16），但角膜散光变化量大于0.01%A组（Z=-2.48，P=0.013，Cliff's Delta=0.17）。广义线性模型校正后亦显示HAL组12个月AL增长量和SE变化量均小于0.01%A组（Wald χ2=40.19，P<0.001；Wald χ2=7.19，P=0.007），角膜散光变化量大于0.01%A组（Wald χ2=4.71，P=0.030）。多元线性回归显示基线年龄越大两组AL增长均越慢（均P<0.001）；基线柱镜度越高，HAL组AL增长量增加（β=-0.06，P=0.003）。交互分析显示随着基线柱镜度升高，相较于0.01%A组，HAL组AL增长量增加（β=-0.06，P=0.038）。 结论：基于群体数据的分析显示，HAL在控制AL增长方面的效果整体优于0.01%A；但随着基线散光增加，HAL的控制效果逐渐减弱，而0.01%A的控制效果受散光的影响较小。

Objective: To compare the one-year therapeutic efficacy of 0.01% atropine eye drops versus highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) in myopic children, and to identify factors associated with treatment response. Methods: This retrospective case series study included 99 children (99 eyes) treated with 0.01% atropine eye drops (0.01% A group) and 296 children (296 eyes) fitted with HAL (HAL group) at Eye Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University. The ages were 8.8 (7.7, 11.0) years in the 0.01% A group and 9.1 (8.0, 10.6) years in the HAL group, with male-to-female ratios of 55:44 and 147:149, respectively. The study period spanned from September 2021 to June 2024. The primary outcome was 12-month axial length (AL) progression. Secondary outcomes included changes in spherical equivalent (SE) and astigmatism. Analysis was performed exclusively using right eye data. Between-group comparisons were analyzed using the Mann-Whitney U tests, Cliff's Delta, and generalized linear models (GLMs). Interaction effects between baseline characteristics and interventions were assessed using multiple linear regression. Results: The one-year AL progression in the HAL group was 0.15 (0.05, 0.26) mm, significantly smaller than 0.28 (0.13, 0.39) mm in the 0.01% A group (Z=-4.88, P<0.001, Cliff's Delta=0.33). The change in SE was also smaller in the HAL group compared to the 0.01% A group (Z=2.42, P=0.016, Cliff's Delta=-0.16). HAL vs HAPD vs SVL— 一年期HAL最优

原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在对比三种镜片设计 —— 高度非球面微透镜（HALs）、水平不对称周边离焦（HAPD）镜片与标准单光镜片（SVLs）在延缓学龄儿童近视进展方面的一年期效果。 方法：本研究为前瞻性非随机研究，共纳入 57 名 8-17 岁儿童，根据其佩戴的镜片类型分为三组：HAL 组（n=16）、HAPD 组（n=21）和 SVL 组（n=20）。在基线、6 个月和 12 个月时对受试者进行全面眼科检查。 结局指标包括等效球镜度数（SER）、球镜度数（SR）、柱镜度数（CR）和眼轴长度（AL）。采用非参数检验对数据进行分析，显著性水平设定为 p<0.05。 结果：12 个月期间，所有组别的等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）均出现一定程度的进展。HAL 组的等效球镜度数（SER）中位变化值最小（-0.3 D），HAPD 组为 - 0.5 D，SVL 组为 - 0.4 D，但组间差异无统计学意义（p=0.111）。HAL 组的眼轴增长（0.1 mm，四分位距：0.0~0.2 mm）显著低于 HAPD 组和 SVL 组（两组均为 0.2 mm，p<0.0001）。所有组别的柱镜度数（CR）均保持稳定，未出现具有临床意义的变化。在所有指标中，HAPD 组均未表现出优于 SVL 组的优势。 结论：在本研究涉及的三种镜片中，12 个月期间，HAL 镜片在延缓屈光性近视和轴性近视进展方面效果最佳。该研究结果表明，HAL 镜片可作为儿童近视控制的可靠干预手段。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: The aim of this study was to compare the one-year efficacy of three spectacle lens designs, highly aspherical lenslets (HALs), horizontally asymmetric peripheral defocus (HAPD) lenses, and standard single vision lenses (SVLs) in slowing myopia progression in school-aged children. METHODS: In this prospective, non-randomized study, 57 children, aged 8-17 years, were grouped based on the type of lenses worn: HAL (n = 16), HAPD (n = 21), or SVL (n = 20). Comprehensive ophthalmologic examinations were performed at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months. Outcome measures included spherical equivalent refraction (SER), spherical refraction (SR), cylindrical refraction (CR), and axial length (AL). Data were analyzed using non-parametric tests with significance set at p < 0.05. RESULTS: All groups showed some progression in SER and AL over 12 months. The HAL group demonstrated the smallest median SER change (-0.3 D), compared to HAPD (-0.5 D) and SVL (-0.4 D), though group differences were not statistically significant (p = 0.111). Axial elongation was significantly lower in the HAL group (0.1 mm, IQR: 0.0-0.2 mm) compared to HAPD and SVL (both 0.2 mm, p < 0.0001). CR remained stable in all groups, with no clinically meaningful changes. The HAPD groups showed no advantages over SVL in any parameter. CONCLUSIONS: Among the three lens types studied, HAL lenses were the most effective in reducing both refractive and axial myopia progression over 12 months. These findings support their use as a reliable intervention in pediatric myopia control.

摘要 目的：比较不同光学矫正方法延缓高度近视儿童眼轴长度（AL）增长的临床效果。 方法：回顾性临床研究。简单随机抽样纳入2021年1月至2023年12月就诊于温州医科大学附属眼视光医院的高度近视儿童152例（152眼），年龄（12.4±1.5）岁，分为角膜塑形镜（OK镜）组45例、高非球眼镜（HAL）组52例、多焦软镜（DISC）组21例和单光镜（SP）组34例。比较戴镜1年前后AL变化及组间AL增长量差异。 结果：戴镜1年后4组AL较基线均有增长（均P<0.05）。OK镜组、HAL组、DISC组、SP组AL年增长量分别为（0.07±0.18）、（0.15±0.14）、（0.16±0.12）和（0.24±0.09）mm，组间差异有统计学意义（F=9.16，P<0.001）；其中OK镜组（P<0.001）、HAL组（P=0.006）和DISC组（P=0.041）的AL年增长量明显低于SP组；OK镜组AL年增长量明显低于HAL组（P=0.006）和DISC组（P=0.022）；HAL组与DISC组间差异无统计学意义（P=0.865）。 结论：高度近视儿童配戴OK镜、DISC和HAL均能有效减缓AL增长，其中OK镜减缓AL增长的临床效果最佳。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Objective: To compare the clinical effects of different optical correction methods in retarding axial length (AL) elongation in children with high myopia. Methods: In this retrospective clinical study, totally 152 children (152 eyes) with high myopia who met the criteria were recruited from January 2021 to December 2023 at the Eye Hospital, Wenzhou Medical University, the age of children was 12.4±1.5 years, with a male-to-female ratio of 75:77. All participants in this study were divided into four groups based on the correction methods: orthokeratology lens (OK, n=45) group, highly aspherical lenslets (HAL, n=52) group, defocus incorporated soft contact (DISC, n=21) group and single vision spectacles (SP, n=34) group. The changes in AL before and after one year of wearing corrective lenses in different groups were analyzed by paired t test. Additionally, one-way ANOVA was used to compare the differences in AL elongation among different groups. Results: After one year of wearing corrective lenses, the AL in all 4 groups increased compared to their baseline values, with statistically significant differences within each group (t=-15.60- -2.65, all P<0.05). The AL elongation in OK group, HAL group, DISC group, and SP group was 0.07±0.18 mm, 0.15±0.14 mm, 0.16±0.12 mm, and 0.24±0.09 mm, respectively. There was a statistically significant difference in the annual AL elongation among these groups (F=9.16, P<0.001). The annual AL elongation in the OK group (P<0.001), HAL group (P=0.006), and DISC group (P=0.041) was all statistically significantly lower than that in the SP group, and the annual AL elongation in the OK group also statistically lower than that in the HAL group (P=0.006) and DISC group (P=0.022). But there was no significant difference in AL elongation between HAL group and DISC group (P=0.865). Conclusions: For children with high myopia, wearing OK lens, DISC lenses, and HAL lenses could effectively slow down the progression of AL elongation. 原文摘要
摘要 目的：评估高非球面微透镜（HAL）对学龄儿童近视进展的延缓效果，并将其与角膜塑形镜进行比较。 方法：本回顾性研究纳入 475 例 6-15 岁近视患者，近视度数范围为 - 0.75D 至 - 5.75D。仅对每位受试者的右眼进行分析。在基线时和 6 个月后分别进行睫状肌麻痹验光和眼轴长度（AL）测量（角膜塑形镜组在 6 个月后仅进行眼轴长度测量）。 结果：6 个月后，在低度和中度近视患者中，HAL 镜片（0.00 [-0.25,0.00] D）相较于单光镜片（SV）（-0.50 [-0.75,-0.25] D），能显著延缓等效球镜度数（SER）的近视进展（P<0.001）。此外，与 SV 镜片（0.25±0.16 mm）相比，HAL 镜片（0.06±0.10 mm）和角膜塑形镜（0.04±0.13 mm）均能显著减少眼轴长度增长（P<0.001）。然而，HAL 镜片与角膜塑形镜在眼轴长度增长方面无统计学差异。在低度近视组中，HAL 镜片（0.05±0.12 mm）和角膜塑形镜（0.09±0.15 mm）相较于 SV 镜片（0.27±0.17 mm），均能显著延缓眼轴长度增长（P<0.001），且 HAL 镜片效果略优于角膜塑形镜（P=0.038）。在中度近视组中，HAL 镜片（0.07±0.09 mm）和角膜塑形镜（0±0.10 mm）相较于 SV 镜片（0.22±0.14 mm），均能显著延缓眼轴长度增长，且角膜塑形镜效果强于 HAL 镜片（P<0.001）。 结论：在低度和中度近视患者中，HAL 镜片在延缓近视进展方面的效果优于 SV 镜片。HAL 镜片和角膜塑形镜均能有效减少眼轴长度增长。具体而言，HAL 镜片在降低低度近视患者眼轴长度增长方面效果更显著，而角膜塑形镜在控制中度近视患者眼轴长度增长方面具有明显优势。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate the efficacy of Highly Aspherical Lenslets (HAL) in slowing myopia progression among schoolchildren and compare it to orthokeratology. METHODS: This retrospective study included 475 myopic patients aged 6 to 15 years, with myopia ranging from -0.75 to -5.75D Only the right eye of each subject was analyzed. Cycloplegic refraction and axial length(AL) measurements were performed at baseline and after 6 months (only AL measurements were performed in the orthokeratology group after 6 months). RESULTS: After 6 months, HAL lenses(0.00 [-0.25,0.00]D) significantly delayed spherical equivalent refraction (SER) myopia progression compared to single vision (SV) lenses(-0.50 [-0.75,-0.25]D) in both low and moderate myopia(P < 0.001). Additionally, both HAL (0.06 ± 0.10 mm) and orthokeratology(0.04 ± 0.13 mm) lenses significantly reduced AL elongation compared to SV lenses(0.25 ± 0.16 mm, (P < 0.001). However, there was no statistical difference between HAL and orthokeratology lenses in AL elongation(P = 0.157). In the low myopia group, HAL(0.05 ± 0.12 mm) and orthokeratology(0.09 ± 0.15 mm) lenses both significantly slowed AL elongation compared to SV lenses (0.27 ± 0.17 mm, P < 0.001), with HAL lenses showing a slight advantage over orthokeratology lenses(P = 0.038). In the moderate myopia group, both HAL(0.07 ± 0.09 mm) and orthokeratology(0 ± 0.10 mm) lenses significantly delayed AL elongation compared to SV lenses(0.22 ± 0.14 mm), with orthokeratology lenses having a stronger effect than HAL lenses(P < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: HAL lenses demonstrate superior efficacy to SV lenses in mitigating myopia progression in both low and moderate myopia. Both HAL and orthokeratology lenses are effective in reducing AL elongation. Specifically, HAL lenses exhibit greater effectiveness in decreasing AL elongation in cases of low myopia, whereas Ortho-K lenses show a pronounced advantage in managing AL elongation in moderate myopia.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-10
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：明确五种近视控制眼镜（MCG）在印度儿童中的疗效。 研究方法：本研究为一项为期 1 年随访的回顾性队列研究，纳入 216 名 4 至 17 岁儿童的 397 只眼；受试者近视度数介于 - 0.75 至 - 10.00 屈光度（D）之间，散光度数不超过 4.00 D，且基线近视进展度数≥0.50 D。研究分析了使用以下五种近视控制眼镜（MCG）的儿童数据：Ⅰ 型（defocus incorporated multiple segments）、Ⅱ 型（highly aspherical lenslet target）、Ⅲ 型（cylindrical annular refractive elements）、Ⅳ 型（peripheral defocus reducing lenses）、Ⅴ 型（pediatric progressive addition lenses）。研究分析了屈光不正球镜当量（SER）与眼轴长度（AL）的平均变化，对比了 SER 与 AL 进展至生理水平的平均变化，并按年龄、性别及近视度数进行了亚组分析。 研究结果：所有 MCG 联合使用时，6 个月与 12 个月时 SER 和 AL 的平均变化分别为 - 0.05±0.23 D、-0.26±0.43 D、0.07±0.11 mm 和 0.16±0.18 mm。Ⅰ、Ⅱ、Ⅲ 型之间未观察到统计学显著差异。所有 MCG 联合使用 6 个月与 12 个月时的眼轴控制疗效、屈光控制疗效分别为 42.34%、43.99%、90.41% 和 68.91%。男孩与女孩之间无显著差异；年龄较大组在 6 个月和 12 个月时的眼轴控制疗效显著更优（P < 0.01）；低度近视儿童在 12 个月时的屈光控制疗效显著更高（P < 0.01）。 研究结论：在印度儿童中，Ⅰ、Ⅱ、Ⅲ 型近视控制眼镜（MCG）控制近视进展的疗效相当，其中年龄较大儿童与低度近视儿童的效果更优。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To determine the efficacy of five types of myopia control glasses (MCG) among Indian children. METHODS: A retrospective cohort study with 1-year follow-up was done in 397 eyes of 216 children aged 4 to 17 years, with myopia between -0.75 and -10.00 diopters (D), astigmatism of 4.00 D or less, and baseline progression of 0.50 D or greater. Data from children prescribed type I (defocus incorporated multiple segments), type II (highly aspherical lenslet target), type III (cylindrical annular refractive elements), type IV (peripheral defocus reducing lenses), and type V (pediatric progressive addition lenses) MCG were analyzed. Mean change in spherical equivalence of refractive error (SER) and axial length (AL) and percentage efficacy in reducing SER and AL progression to physiological levels were compared. Subgroup analysis was done by age, gender, and amount of myopia. RESULTS: Mean change in SER and AL at 6 and 12 months with all MCG combined was -0.05 ± 0.23 D, -0.26 ± 0.43 D, 0.07 ± 0.11 mm, and 0.16 ± 0.18 mm, respectively. No statistically significant difference was noted between types I, II, and III. Axial and refractive efficacy at 6 and 12 months of all MCG combined was 42.34%, 43.99%, 90.41%, and 68.91%, respectively. There was no significant difference among boys and girls. The older group showed significantly better axial efficacy (P < .01) at 6 and 12 months. Refractive efficacy was significantly higher at 12 months (P < .01) among children with low myopia. CONCLUSIONS: Types I, II, and III MCG are equally efficacious in controlling myopia progression among Indian children, with better results among older children and those with low myopia.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-11
原文摘要
摘要 目的：比较两种近视控制眼镜镜片设计 —— 多焦点离焦镜片（DIMS）与高非球面微透镜（HAL）在减缓欧洲儿童及青少年近视进展中的效果。此前直接比较这两种镜片设计的研究仅局限于中国受试者，且随访时间仅为 1 年。欧洲儿童及青少年的近视患病率估计为 22.60%。 方法：对近视进展的受试者（6-17 岁）开展回顾性队列研究。受试者佩戴 DIMS 镜片（豪雅 MiyoSmart）或 HAL 镜片（依视路 Stellest）眼镜，佩戴时间至少 2 年。在基线、1 年和 2 年时分别测量眼轴长度（AL）和睫状肌麻痹自动验光（球镜等效屈光度，SER）。 结果：DIMS组1年平均视力变化为-0.34D（±0.46标准差），HAL组为-0.30D（±0.30）；2年变化值分别为-0.50D（±0.64标准差）和-0.63D（±0.56）。DIMS组1年平均屈光度增加值为0.19毫米（±0.56），HAL组为0.15毫米（±0.47）；2年增加值分别为0.29毫米（±0.63）和0.32毫米（±0.72）。以1年和2年视力等效性为0.25D和0.50D为界限，以及以眼轴长度等效性为0.20毫米和0.30毫米为界限时，DIMS和HAL镜片均达到等效性标准，仅1年眼轴长度数据中，DIMS镜片的95%置信区间上限0.21毫米略超0.20毫米阈值。在1年和2年随访中，DIMS与HAL镜片在平均SER值或AL值上的差异均无临床或统计学意义（p≥0.05，Mann-Whitney U检验）。采用线性混合模型分析，镜片类型与时间的交互作用未显著影响1年或2年随访时的SER或AL（p>0.05）。38.4%的DIMS儿童/青少年在2年内未出现SER进展，而HAL组该比例为21.9%（p=0.047）。 结论：在欧洲人群中，随访 2 年发现，DIMS 与 HAL 镜片在减缓近视进展和眼轴长度（AL）增长方面的效果基本相当。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: A performance comparison of two myopia control spectacle lens designs, defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) and highly aspherical lenslets (HAL), at slowing myopia progression in a European child/adolescent population. Previous research directly comparing these designs has been limited to Chinese participants and 1-year follow-up. The prevalence of myopia in European child/adolescent has been estimated at 22.60%. METHODS: Retrospective cohort study of individuals (6-17 years) with myopia progression. Participants wore DIMS (Hoya MiyoSmart) or HAL (Essilor Stellest) spectacles for a minimum of 2 years. Axial length (AL) and cycloplegic autorefraction (spherical equivalent refraction (SER)) were measured at baseline and 1 and 2 years. RESULTS: Mean 1-year SER changes for DIMS were -0.34D (±0.46 SD) and HAL -0.30D (±0.30); 2-year changes for DIMS were -0.50D (±0.64 SD) and HAL -0.63D (±0.56). Mean 1-year AL increases for DIMS were 0.19 mm (±0.56) and HAL 0.15 mm (±0.47); 2-year increases for DIMS were 0.29 mm (±0.63) and HAL 0.32 mm (±0.72). For equivalence margins of 0.25D and 0.50D for SER at 1 and 2 years, respectively, and similarly 0.20 mm and 0.30 mm margins for AL, DIMS and HAL lenses were equivalent apart from AL at 1 year where the 0.21 mm 95% CI upper limit just exceeded 0.20 mm. At both 1 and 2 years, none of the differences in mean SERs or ALs between DIMS and HAL were clinically or statistically significant (p≥0.05 Mann-Whitney U test). Using linear mixed model analysis, the interaction between lens type and time did not significantly affect SER or AL at 1- or 2-year follow-up (p≥0.05). 38.4% of children/adolescents with DIMS had no SER progression at 2 years, compared with 21.9% with HAL (p=0.047). CONCLUSION: In a European population, DIMS and HAL lenses are essentially equivalent in their ability to reduce myopia progression and AL elongation over a 2-year follow-up period.

参考文献6-2-12 HAL vs OK vs SVL 低度近视儿童近视控制-HALT更优 起始时间： 2022 年 1 月至 2023 年 6 月 研究中心&PI：天津医科大学眼科医院视光中心&林伟平、魏瑞华 试验设计简述：回顾性研究 试验组样本量：37 HAL VS 95 OK(APOK、SPOK、 EOK ）VS 34 SVL 结论：HALT在低度近视人群中近视控制效果略优于OK镜
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-12
原文摘要
摘要 目的：比较三种不同角膜塑形镜（OK 镜）与高非球面微透镜框架眼镜（HAL）对低度近视低龄儿童的近视控制效果，并比较三种不同设计 OK 镜的相对角膜屈光力（RCRP）分布特征。 方法：本回顾性研究纳入 166 名 8~11 岁低度近视儿童（近视度数 - 0.50~-3.00 D），分别采用普瞳非球面基弧角膜塑形镜（APOK）、普瞳球面基弧角膜塑形镜（SPOK）、欧几里得角膜塑形镜（EOK）、高非球面微透镜框架眼镜（HAL）或单光框架眼镜（SVL）进行矫正。在基线和 12 个月随访时测量眼轴长度（AL）；对佩戴 OK 镜的儿童测量角膜地形图，以确定角膜顶点相对角膜屈光力曲线至其 3/4 峰值的距离。 结果：12 个月后，APOK 组、SPOK 组、HAL 组、EOK 组和 SVL 组的眼轴增长量分别为 0.17±0.14 毫米、0.25±0.17 毫米、0.11±0.15 毫米、0.37±0.12 毫米和 0.45±0.16 毫米。APOK 组、SPOK 组和 HAL 组的眼轴增长速度显著慢于 EOK 组或 SVL 组均P<0.05；且 HAL 组的眼轴增长速度显著慢于 SPOK 组均P<0.05。HAL 组和 APOK 组中，分别有 59.5% 和 42.9% 的受试者眼轴增长量≤0.15 毫米。HAL 组与 APOK 组、SPOK 组与 APOK 组、EOK 组与 SVL 组之间的眼轴增长量无显著差异。SPOK 组和 APOK 组的 3/4X 值均低于 EOK 组。 结论：对于 8~11 岁低度近视儿童，佩戴 HAL 或 APOK 相较于佩戴 EOK 或 SVL，可实现相近且更慢的眼轴增长。APOK 和 SPOK 能使瞳孔范围内的相对角膜屈光力曲线分布更陡峭，其近视控制效果优于 EOK。 转化意义：建议将 HAL 和 APOK 作为 8~11 岁轻度近视儿童的有效近视控制方案。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To compare the effectiveness of three different orthokeratology (OK) lenses and highly aspherical-lenslet spectacle lenses (HAL) for myopia control in young children with low myopia, and to compare the relative corneal refractive power (RCRP) distributions among the three OK lenses with different designs. METHODS: This retrospective study involved 166 children aged eight to 11 years with myopia of -0.50 to -3.00 D treated with ProTong OK lenses with aspheric base curve (APOK), ProTong OK lenses with spherical base curve (SPOK), Euclid OK lenses (EOK), HAL, or single-vision spectacle lenses (SVL). Axial length (AL) was measured at baseline and the 12-month visit. Corneal topography was measured for OK wearers to determine the distance from the apex RCRP profile to its three-quarter-peak. RESULTS: The axial elongation for the APOK, SPOK, HAL, EOK, and SVL groups were 0.17 ± 0.14 mm, 0.25 ± 0.17 mm, 0.11 ± 0.15 mm, 0.37 ± 0.12 mm, and 0.45 ± 0.16 mm after 12 months, respectively. Axial elongation was significantly slower for the APOK, SPOK, and HAL groups than for the EOK or SVL groups (all P < 0.05); and it was significantly slower in HAL than in SPOK wearers (P < 0.05). 59.5% and 42.9% of HAL and APOK wearers experienced axial elongation of ≤0.15 mm, respectively. The HAL and APOK, SPOK and APOK, or EOK and SVL groups showed no significant differences in axial elongation. Both SPOK and APOK groups had lower 3/4X values than the EOK group. CONCLUSIONS: HAL and APOK wear, relative to EOK or SVL wear, by eight- to 11-year-old children with low myopia led to comparable yet slower axial elongation. APOK and SPOK led to a steeper distribution of the RCRP profile within the pupillary range and yielded better myopia control than EOK. TRANSLATIONAL RELEVANCE: HAL and APOK are recommended for effective myopia control in children aged eight to 11 years with mild myopia.

原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：评估网格维度多区域（GDM）眼镜片在近视控制中的有效性与安全性，并对比该镜片与高非球面微透镜（HAL）眼镜片的近视控制效果。 研究方法：2022 年 12 月至 2023 年 7 月，于温州医科大学眼视光医院杭州院区纳入 150 名 6~13 岁儿童，将其随机分为 GDM 组和 HAL 组。在基线期及后续每 6 个月对受试者进行睫状肌麻痹验光（球镜等效屈光度，SER）和眼轴长度（AL）测量，随访周期为 1 年。 研究结果：131 名受试者完成本研究并纳入最终分析。随访 6 个月时，GDM 组的球镜等效屈光度变化值为 0.06±0.37 D，眼轴长度变化值为 0.01±0.11 mm；HAL 组的球镜等效屈光度变化值为 - 0.06±0.31 D，眼轴长度变化值为 0.04±0.11 mm。GDM 组的球镜等效屈光度变化与 HAL 组相比，差异具有统计学意义（p=0.042），两组眼轴长度变化的差异则无统计学意义（p=0.266）。随访 1 年时，GDM 组的球镜等效屈光度变化值为 - 0.17±0.40 D，HAL 组为 - 0.19±0.36 D；GDM 组的眼轴长度变化值为 0.07±0.17 mm，HAL 组为 0.11±0.15 mm。此时两组的球镜等效屈光度和眼轴长度变化差异均无统计学意义（p 值分别为 0.980 和 0.131）。经广义估计方程校正后，两组的眼轴长度变化差异具有统计学意义（p=0.048）。在主观视觉质量方面，GDM 组与 HAL 组的总分差异无统计学意义（p=0.436）。本研究中所有组别均未出现不良事件。 研究结论：为期 1 年的研究表明，GDM 镜片和 HAL 镜片均能有效控制近视进展，且 GDM 镜片在抑制眼轴延长方面的效果略优于 HAL 镜片。试验注册：中国临床试验注册中心，注册号：ChiCTR2200066890
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate the effectiveness and safety of grid dimension multiregion (GDM) spectacle lenses in myopia control and compare the myopia control effects between GDM and highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) spectacle lenses. METHODS: A total of 150 children aged 6-13 years were enrolled at the Hangzhou Campus of Eye Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University between December 2022 and July 2023 and randomly assigned to the GDM and HAL groups. Cycloplegic autorefraction (spherical equivalent refraction [SER]) and axial length (AL) were measured at baseline and 6-month intervals until one year follow-up. RESULTS: 131 participants completed the study and were included in the final analysis. At the six-month follow-up, the changes in SER and AL were 0.06 ± 0.37 D and 0.01 ± 0.11 mm in the GDM group and -0.06 ± 0.31 D and 0.04 ± 0.11 mm in the HAL group, respectively. The GDM group showed a statistically significant difference in SER changes compared to the HAL group (p = 0.042). No statistically significant difference in AL was observed between the groups (p = 0.266). At the one-year follow-up, the changes in SER were -0.17 ± 0.40 D in the GDM group and -0.19 ± 0.36 D in the HAL group. The changes in AL were 0.07 ± 0.17 mm in the GDM group and 0.11 ± 0.15 mm in the HAL group. No statistically significant differences in SER or AL were observed between the GDM and HAL groups (p = 0.980 and p = 0.131, respectively). After adjustment using generalized estimating equations, a significant difference in AL change was observed between the GDM and HAL groups (p = 0.048). In terms of subjective visual quality, there was no statistical difference in the total scores between the GDM and HAL groups (p = 0.436). No adverse events were reported in any group. CONCLUSIONS: Both GDM and HAL lenses effectively controlled myopia progression over 1 year, with GDM showing slightly superior efficacy in limiting axial elongation. Trial Registration: Chinese Clinical Trial Registry: ChiCTR2200066890.

原文摘要
摘要 研究设计：中国真实世界回顾性研究，比较DIMS、HAL、DIMS+0.01%阿托品（DIMSA）和HAL+0.01%阿托品（HALA）。 结果：校正后年AL进展量分别为DIMS 0.23mm、HAL 0.15mm、DIMSA 0.20mm、HALA 0.12mm；HAL/HALA优于DIMS/DIMSA，HALA获得良好反应的概率最高。 结论：HAL/HALA在平均眼轴进展和个体良好反应分布上表现更优，提示HAL技术在头对头真实世界比较中具有一定优势。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: Myopia is a global public health issue, necessitating effective control strategies. Defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) and highly aspherical lenslet (HAL) spectacle lenses, as well as their combination with low-concentration atropine (0.01%), have been shown to control myopia effectively. However, direct comparisons among these regimens, DIMS, HAL, DIMSA (DIMS + atropine), and HALA (HAL + atropine), are lacking. In this real-world study, we compared their effectiveness in slowing myopia progression. METHODS: This single-center retrospective cohort study included 347 children (694 eyes) aged 6-14 years who received one of the four interventions for at least 1 year. The primary outcome was the annual change in axial length (AL). The secondary outcome was the annual change in spherical equivalent refraction (SER). The treatment response was categorized as good, fair, or poor. Linear mixed models and generalized estimating equations were used for analysis, adjusting for covariates. RESULTS: After adjustment, annual axial elongation differed significantly among the groups (P < 0.001), with marginal means of 0.23 mm (DIMS), 0.15 mm (HAL), 0.20 mm (DIMSA), and 0.12 mm (HALA). Post hoc comparisons revealed that both HAL and HALA were superior to DIMS (P < 0.001) and that HALA was superior to DIMSA (P = 0.022). Adding 0.01% atropine to either optical monotherapy did not provide a significant additional benefit in terms of mean AL or SER outcomes. Compared with DIMS, HALA significantly increased the odds of a good response for AL (OR = 4.34, P < 0.001) and SER (OR = 5.85, P < 0.001), whereas this effect was not observed with DIMSA. Older age independently predicted better response (AL: OR = 1.46/year; SER: OR = 1.26/year; both P < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: In this non-randomized real-world comparison, HAL monotherapy was associated with slower SER progression, compared with DIMS. Although adding atropine did not improve mean outcomes, HALA showed the highest likelihood of a good response, suggesting a clinically meaningful benefit in response distribution. Although HALA did not consistently outperform HAL monotherapy across analyses, its advantage in achieving favourable individual responses supports its consideration for children requiring maximal intervention. These findings require confirmation in prospective randomized trials.
