原文摘要
摘要 研究设计：欧洲3年真实世界回顾性研究，纳入288名5–12岁儿童，比较低浓度阿托品、DIMS/HAL、DIMS/HAL+0.01%阿托品和SVL。 结果：DIMS/HAL及DIMS/HAL+0.01%阿托品均较SVL减缓近视进展，效果类似0.01%阿托品；0.05%阿托品效果最明显。 结论：该研究提供了欧洲人群中DIMS/HAL与低浓度阿托品及联合治疗的长期真实世界比较证据。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: Myopia control is crucial for pediatric eye care professionals. Although various treatments exist, their comparative efficacy, particularly in European populations, remains unclear. In real-life conditions, this study aimed to compare different strategies to slow myopia progression. METHODS: This retrospective, nonrandomized study evaluated the efficacy of 0.01%, 0.025%, and 0.05% atropine, defocus incorporated multiple segments/highly aspherical lenslets (DIMS/HAL) spectacles, combined atropine and DIMS/HAL, and single vision spectacles in 288 European children (aged 5-12 years) with myopia progression (≥0.75 D in the past 12 months). Primary outcomes were changes in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length measured every 6 months for 3 years. RESULTS: The mean cumulative 3-year SER progressions were -0.75 ± 0.49, -0.92 ± 0.52, and -1.31 ± 0.75 D for the 0.05%, 0.025%, and 0.01% atropine groups, respectively, -1.31 ± 0.76 D for the DIMS/HAL group, and -1.11 ± 0.65 D for the 0.01% atropine + DIMS/HAL group, showing better myopia progression control compared to those of the control group (-2.14 ± 0.72 D). Atropine exhibited a dose-dependent effect, with 0.05% atropine achieving the greatest reduction in myopia progression and axial elongation. CONCLUSIONS: This study demonstrates the efficacy of low-dose atropine and DIMS/HAL spectacles in slowing myopia progression in European children. The 0.05% atropine exhibited the most pronounced myopia control effect.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-16
原文摘要
摘要 目的：比较采用多区正向光学离焦 (DIMS) 镜片与高非球微透镜 (HAL) 镜片对儿童近视真实世界的防控效果，并评估年龄、基线屈光度及眼轴 (AL) 对效果的修饰作用。 方法：本项回顾性队列研究纳入了 180 名连续配戴 DIMS 或 HAL 镜片≥12 个月的儿童 (年龄 6-14 岁)。根据基线等效球镜 (SER) 将参与者分为近视前期、低度近视和中度近视亚组。采用协方差分析 (ANCOVA) 评估 AL 和 SER 的年变化量，并通过纳入交互项检验效果修饰作用。 结果：校正后，与 DIMS 组相比，HAL 组的眼轴增长显著更慢 (校正后均差: 0.08 mm, 95% CI: 0.03 ~ 0.12, P < 0.001)，SER 进展也显著更慢 (−0.14 D, 95% CI: −0.25 ~ −0.03, P = 0.012)。在 AL 变化上观察到显著的治疗与年龄交互作用 (P = 0.024)。HAL 的优势在年龄较小的儿童 (≤10.5 岁；AL 差异: 0.13 mm, P < 0.001) 中更为明显，在年龄较大的儿童中则不显著。从治疗应答分类看，HAL 组中获得 AL “良好” 应答的比例更高 (64.4% vs. 41.1%, P = 0.004)，在近视前期亚组中尤为显著。仅在 HAL 组中观察到眼轴缩短现象 (占该组 8.9%)。 结论：在为期一年的真实世界研究中，HAL 镜片表现出优于 DIMS 镜片的近视控制效果。年龄是关键的效应修饰因素，年龄较小的儿童获益更大，这支持了基于年龄分层的临床决策。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To compare the real-world myopia control effectiveness of defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) versus highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) spectacle lenses in children, and assess effect modification by age, baseline refraction, and axial length (AL). METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included 180 children (aged 6 to 14) wearing DIMS or HAL lenses for ≥12 months. Participants were stratified by baseline spherical equivalent (SER) into pre-myopia, low myopia, and moderate myopia subgroups. Annual AL and SER changes were analyzed using analysis of covariance, with interaction terms tested for effect modification. RESULTS: After adjustment, the HAL group showed significantly slower annual axial elongation (adjusted mean difference = 0.08 mm; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.03 to 0.12; P < 0.001) and SER progression (-0.14 D; 95% CI, -0.25 to -0.03; P = 0.012) compared to DIMS. A significant treatment-by-age interaction was observed for AL change (P = 0.024). HAL's advantage was pronounced in younger children (≤10.5 years; AL difference = 0.13 mm; P < 0.001) but not significant in older children. Categorically, HAL yielded a higher proportion of "good" AL responders (64.4% vs. 41.1%; P = 0.004), most notably in pre-myopia. Axial shortening was observed exclusively in HAL wearers (8.9%). CONCLUSIONS: Over one year, HAL lenses demonstrated superior myopia control efficacy versus DIMS in a real-world setting. Age was a key effect modifier, with greater benefit in younger children, supporting age-stratified clinical decision-making. TRANSLATIONAL RELEVANCE: This study identifies patient age as a key biological modifier of the treatment response to different optical designs, bridging the mechanistic understanding of visual development with actionable, personalized clinical prescribing for childhood myopia control. 目的: (DIMS) (HAL) , 、 (AL) 。. 方法: 180 DIMS HAL ≥ 12 ( 6-14) 。 (SER) 、。 (ANCOVA) AL SER , 。. 结果: , DIMS , HAL (: 0.08 mm, 95% CI: 0.03 ∼ 0.12, P < 0.001), SER (-0.14 D, 95% CI: -0.25 ∼ -0.03, P = 0.012) 。 AL (P = 0.024) 。 HAL (≤10.5 ; AL : 0.13 mm, P < 0.001) , 。, HAL AL "" (64.4% vs. 41.1%, P = 0.004), 。 HAL (8.9%) 。. 结论: , HAL DIMS 。, , 。. 关键词: ; ; ;

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：在临床环境中比较三种近视控制框架眼镜［多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）、高非球面微透镜（HALT）和柱镜微透镜（CARE）］与单光镜片（SVL）在延缓儿童眼轴增长和近视屈光度进展方面的效果。 方法：单中心回顾性队列研究。纳入899名（1780眼）6~16岁、睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度（SE）在-0.50 D至-9.00 D之间的儿童，分为SVL组（446眼）、DIMS组（523眼）、HALT组（295眼）和CARE组（516眼）。利用线性混合效应模型分析年化眼轴长度（AL）和SE进展率，校正基线年龄、性别、父母近视及基线指标。 结果：平均随访时间为12.49±5.71个月。与SVL组（0.193 mm/年）相比，所有近视控制镜片均显著延缓AL增长：校正年AL进展量DIMS组为0.098 mm/年，CARE组为0.088 mm/年，HALT组为0.054 mm/年（与SVL相比均P<0.001）；HALT在延缓AL增长方面的效果显著优于DIMS（P<0.001）和CARE（P<0.001）。所有近视控制镜片亦显著降低近视SE进展（SVL组为-0.370 D/年，DIMS组为-0.107 D/年，CARE组为-0.106 D/年，HALT组为-0.073 D/年），但三种近视控制镜片之间的SE两两比较未达到统计学显著性差异（P>0.13）。 结论：HALT、DIMS和CARE均能有效延缓近视进展，其中HALT表现出最强的眼轴控制效果。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To compare the clincial setting effectiveness of three myopia control spectacle lenses, defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS), highly aspherical lenslet target (HALT), and cylindrical annular refractive elements (CARE), versus single-vision lenses (SVLs) in attenuating axial elongation and myopic refractive shift in children. Design: A single-center, retrospective cohort study. Participants: A total of 899 subjects (1780 eyes) aged 6—16 years with cycloplegic spherical equivalent (SE) between —0.50 D and —9.00 D. Subjects were divided into four groups based on prescribed eyewear: SVL (n = 446 eyes), DIMS (n = 523 eyes), HALT (n = 295 eyes), and CARE (n = 516 eyes). Methods: Data were extracted from electronic medical records. Longitudinal changes in axial length (AL) and SE refraction were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models to compare progression rates among the lens types, adjusting for baseline age, sex, parental myopia, and the baseline value of the respective outcome variable. Main Outcome Measures: Annualized rate of progression in AL (mm/year) and SE (D/year). Results: The mean age of our cohort was 12.18 ± 2.73 years, and the mean follow-up time was 12.49 ± 5.71 months. All myopia control lenses significantly slowed AL elongation compared to the SVL group (0.193 mm/year). The adjusted annual AL progression was 0.098 mm/year for DIMS, 0.088 mm/year for CARE, and 0.054 mm/year for HALT (P < 0.001 for all vs. SVL). Highly aspherical lenslet target lenses demonstrated significantly greater efficacy in slowing AL elongation compared to both DIMS (P < 0.001) and CARE (P value < 0.001). All myopia control lenses also significantly reduced myopic SE progression (—0.370 D/year for SVL) with rates of —0.107 D/year for DIMS, —0.106 D/ year for CARE, and —0.073 D/year for HALT. However, pairwise comparisons among the three myopia control lens types for SE progression did not reach statistical significance (P > 0.13). Conclusions: Highly aspherical lenslet target, DIMS, and CARE effectively slowed progression versus SVL, with HALT showing the greatest AL control. While the retrospective design warrants cautious interpretation, results support the use of all three lenses. Future prospective head-to-head studies are needed to clarify durability and optimal combination strategies.

原文摘要
摘要 目的 比较高度非球面微透镜片眼镜片（Highly Aspherical Lenslets, HAL）、扩散光学技术眼镜片（Diffusion Optics Technology, DOT）以及单光镜片（Single Vision Lenses, SVL）在儿童和青少年近视控制中的真实世界疗效。 方法 本研究纳入了2024年4月至2025年9月期间在南京儿童医院眼科门诊就诊的159名6至13岁受试者，其中HAL组、DOT组和SVL组各53例。受试者进一步按照年龄分为低龄亚组（6至<10岁）和高龄亚组（10至13岁）。研究采用单因素方差分析比较1年后等效球镜度数（SE）和眼轴长度（AL）的变化。 结果 与SVL组相比，HAL组和DOT组的SE进展和AL增长均显著减慢，差异均具有统计学意义（均P<0.001）；而HAL组与DOT组之间无统计学显著差异（SE：P=0.35；AL：P=0.22）。在两个年龄亚组中，HAL和DOT组的眼轴增长相近；在高龄亚组中，两组眼轴增长均显著慢于SVL组（均P<0.001）。在低龄亚组中，HAL组较SVL组也能显著减缓眼轴增长（P=0.003）；而DOT组与SVL组之间的差异在Bonferroni校正后未达到统计学显著性（P=0.02），但其每年0.11 mm的绝对差异仍可能具有临床意义。Pearson相关分析显示，在HAL组和DOT组中，仅年龄与眼轴增长显著相关，HAL组为 r=–0.35，P=0.024；DOT组为 r=–0.48，P=0.001。 结论 在这项真实世界队列研究中，HAL和DOT镜片均与较慢的近视进展相关，并且HAL与DOT之间的进展速度相似。然而，DOT镜片在较低龄儿童，即6至<10岁儿童中的疗效仍需要更大样本量的研究进一步验证。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To compare the real-world efficacy of Highly Aspherical Lenslets (HAL) spectacles, Diffusion Optics Technology (DOT) spectacles, and single vision lenses (SVL) for controlling myopia progression in children and adolescents. METHODS: A total of 159 participants aged 6 to 13 years were enrolled from the Ophthalmology Clinic of Nanjing Children's Hospital between April 2024 and September 2025, comprising 53 subjects each in the HAL, DOT, and SVL groups. Participants were further stratified into a younger subgroup (6 to < 10 years) and an older subgroup (10 to13 years). One-way analysis of variance was used to compare changes in spherical equivalent (SE) and axial length(AL) after one year. RESULTS: Both HAL and DOT groups were associated with significantly slower progression in SE and AL than the SVL group (all P < 0.001), with no statistically significant differences between the two treatment groups (P = 0.35 for SE; P = 0.22 for AL). In both age subgroups, axial elongation was similar between HAL and DOT (P = 0.52 and P = 0.15), and both were significantly slower than SVL in the older subgroup (both P < 0.001). In the younger subgroup, HAL also slowed axial elongation significantly compared with SVL (P = 0.003), whereas the difference between DOT and SVL did not reach statistical significance after Bonferroni correction (P = 0.02), although the observed absolute difference of 0.11 mm per year may still be clinically meaningful. Pearson correlation analysis showed that only age was significantly correlated with AL elongation in both the HAL (r= - 0.35, P = 0.024) and DOT groups (r= - 0.48, P = 0.001). CONCLUSION: In this real-world cohort, both HAL and DOT lenses were linked to slower myopia progression, with similar progression rates between HAL and DOT. However, the efficacy of DOT in younger children (aged 6 to < 10 years) requires further investigation with larger sample sizes.

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2026年👥 Rao Jing, Zhou Qizhi, He Yongchuan, Li Jianhua, Wang Zhiquan, Chen Xiao, Wang Qin, Kuang Yi, Tang Yuanyuan, Li Quanlan, Feng Shenghui, Yang Jiwen

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-19
原文摘要
摘要 目的 评估多焦点（multifocal，MF）眼镜与单光（single-vision，SV）眼镜相比，在控制中国近视前期儿童近视进展及延缓近视发生方面的有效性。近视前期定义为等效球镜度（spherical equivalent，SE）≤+0.75 D且>−0.50 D。 方法 开展一项多中心回顾性病例对照研究，并采用倾向评分匹配（propensity score matching，PSM）平衡两组基线特征。受试者接受等效球镜度和眼轴长度（axial length，AL）测量。主要结局包括6个月和12个月时SE及AL的变化，以及1年近视累积发生率。近视定义为SE≤−0.50 D。 结果 共纳入1501名受试者，平均年龄为8.60±2.26岁，平均SE为0.00±0.37 D。其中，MF组835名，SV组666名。随访12个月后，与SV组相比，MF眼镜可显著减缓SE向近视方向的进展，组间差异为−0.35±0.63 D（p<0.001）；同时显著减缓眼轴增长，组间差异为0.23±0.27 mm（p<0.001）。 MF组中快速近视进展儿童的比例显著低于SV组。其中，SE进展>0.50 D的比例分别为20.8%和45.1%（χ²=78.15，p<0.001）；AL增长>0.20 mm的比例分别为34.2%和73.5%（χ²=165.9，p<0.001）。 Kaplan–Meier分析显示，MF组1年近视累积发生率显著低于SV组，分别为42.6%和65.6%（log-rank p<0.001）。 结论 这项大样本、多中心研究表明，MF眼镜能够有效减缓近视前期儿童的SE进展和眼轴增长，并延缓近视发生。尽管与随机对照试验相比，回顾性研究设计存在其固有局限性，但本研究结果仍提供了较强的真实世界证据，支持MF眼镜作为一种有效的、非药物性的前置近视控制干预措施。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate the efficacy of multifocal (MF) spectacles, compared with single-vision (SV) spectacles, in controlling myopia progression and delaying myopia onset amongst Chinese children with pre-myopia (spherical equivalent [SE] ≤ +0.75 and >-0.50 D). METHODS: A multicentre retrospective case-control study was conducted, with baseline characteristics balanced using propensity score matching (PSM). The participants underwent spherical equivalent refraction (SE) and axial length (AL) measurements. Primary outcomes included SE and AL progression at 6 and 12 months, as well as the 1-year cumulative incidence of myopia (SE ≤ -0.50 D). RESULTS: A total of 1501 participants (mean age: 8.60 ± 2.26 years; mean SE: 0.00 ± 0.37 D) were included in the analysis, comprising 835 in the MF group and 666 in the SV group. After 12 months, MF spectacles slowed SE progression (difference: -0.35 ± 0.63 D; p < 0.001) and AL elongation (difference: 0.23 ± 0.27 mm; p < 0.001) significantly, compared with the SV group. The proportion of children with rapid myopia progression was significantly lower in the MF group (SE progression > 0.50 D: 20.8% vs. 45.1%, χ2 = 78.15, p < 0.001; AL elongation > 0.2 mm: 34.2% vs. 73.5%, χ2 = 165.9, p < 0.001). Kaplan-Meier analysis showed a significantly lower 1-year cumulative incidence of myopia in the MF group than in the SV group (42.6% vs. 65.6%; log-rank p < 0.001). CONCLUSION: This large-scale, multicentre study demonstrated that MF spectacles effectively slow SE progression and AL elongation and delay myopia onset in pre-myopic children. Despite the inherent limitations of retrospective designs relative to randomised controlled trials, the findings provide strong real-world evidence supporting the potential of MF spectacles as an effective, non-pharmacologic intervention for pre-emptive myopia control.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：比较OK与HAL在不同年龄和不同近视程度儿童中的12个月眼轴控制效果。 方法：温州医科大学附属眼视光医院真实世界回顾性研究，纳入2020年1月至2024年3月OK或HAL配戴儿童；PSM按年龄、SER、性别和基线AL进行1:1匹配。 样本量：PSM后OK组3122人，HAL组3122人。 结果：总体12个月AL增长OK组0.20mm、HAL组0.15mm，HAL整体更优。分层显示，HAL在8-9岁、10-11岁及低度近视儿童中更优；12-14岁和中度近视儿童两组无显著差异；高度近视儿童OK更优。 结论：OK与HAL的相对疗效存在年龄和屈光度依赖性，应根据儿童年龄和近视程度进行个性化选择。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: To compare the axial length (AL) elongation between orthokeratology (OK) and highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) in children with myopia. METHODS: This retrospective study included children with spherical equivalent refraction (SER) ranging from - 0.50 to - 9.00 D who were treated with OK lenses or HAL spectacles. Propensity score matching (PSM) was performed to balance baseline characteristics, including age, SER, sex, and baseline AL. The primary outcome was the 12-month AL elongation. Subgroup analyses were conducted according to age (8-9, 10-11, and 12-14 years) and refractive error categories (mild: - 0.50 to - 3.00 D; moderate: - 3.00 to - 5.00 D; high: - 5.00 to - 9.00 D). RESULTS: After PSM, 3,122 matched pairs (n = 6,244) with balanced baseline characteristics were included. Overall, OK group had greater AL elongation over 12 months than the HAL group (0.20 ± 0.18 mm vs. 0.15 ± 0.17 mm; P < 0.001). In age-stratified analyses, the OK group demonstrated greater AL elongation than the HAL group among younger children, including those aged 8-9 years (0.26 ± 0.18 mm vs. 0.19 ± 0.18 mm; P < 0.001) and 10-11 years (0.17 ± 0.17 mm vs. 0.12 ± 0.17 mm; P < 0.001). By contrast, no significant between-group difference was observed in children aged 12-14 years (P = 0.305). SER-stratified analyses revealed a refractive-error-dependent pattern. In children with mild myopia (- 0.50 to - 3.00 D), the OK group demonstrated greater AL elongation than the HAL group (P < 0.001). By contrast, among children with high myopia (- 5.00 to - 9.00 D), the OK group had lower AL elongation than the HAL group (P < 0.001), while no significant difference was observed for moderate myopia (P = 0.950). Subgroup analyses were performed using a propensity score-matched cohort. CONCLUSIONS: HAL were associated with less AL elongation in younger children and those with mild myopia, whereas OK lenses were associated with less AL elongation in children with high myopia. No significant differences between treatment modalities were observed in children with moderate myopia or in older children.

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：评估新型分区多点离焦光学技术（PMDOT）镜片在延缓近视进展方面与高非球面微透镜（HAL）镜片相比的1年疗效。 方法：这是一项正在进行的为期2年的非劣效性随机对照试验的1年中期分析，纳入194名8至13岁、等效球镜度（SER）为-0.75至-4.5 D的儿童，随机分配至PMDOT组（102例）或HAL组（92例）。整项试验的主要观察指标为2年时两组间SER变化的平均差异，非劣效界值为-0.3 D；次要观察指标包括眼轴长度（AL）、脉络膜厚度（ChT）等生物测量参数的变化，以及2年最佳矫正视力和主观视觉体验。本分析采用右眼数据进行符合方案集（PP）分析。 结果：1年后，基于PP分析，两组间SER和AL的平均变化量无统计学显著差异（PMDOT组对比HAL组：SER为-0.74±0.49 D对比-0.60±0.48 D，AL为0.26±0.20 mm对比0.19±0.19 mm）。12个月时两组间SER变化的组间差异为-0.09 D（双侧97%置信区间：-0.26至0.09）。除PP分析中的前房深度变化外，次要指标均未观察到显著的组间差异。 结论：PMDOT镜片在控制近视进展方面不劣于HAL镜片。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To evaluate the one-year efficacy of novel partition multipoint defocus optics technology (PMDOT) lenses in slowing myopia progression, compared to lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL). Methods: This is a 1-year interim analysis of an ongoing 2-year, non-inferiority randomized controlled trial, in which 194 children ages 8 to 13 years with spherical equivalent refraction (SER) of −0.75 to −4.5 diopters (D) were randomized to either the PMDOT or HAL group. The primary outcome of the full trial was the mean between-group difference in SER change at 2 years, and the non-inferiority margin was −0.3 D. Secondary outcomes included changes in axial length (AL), choroidal thickness (ChT), and other biometric parameters, as well as best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) at 2 years and subjective visual experience. Data from right eyes were used for the current analysis. Results: The study included 102 children in the PMDOT group and 92 in the HAL group. After 1 year, the mean ± SD changes in SER and AL were not statistically significantly different between the two groups (PMDOT vs. HAL SER −0.74 ± 0.49 D vs. −0.60 ± 0.48 D, AL 0.26 ± 0.20 mm vs. 0.19 ± 0.19 mm) based on per-protocol (PP) analysis. The between-group difference in SER change at 12 months was −0.09 D (two-sided 97% confidence interval [CI], −0.26 to 0.09). Except for the change in anterior chamber depth in the PP analysis, no significant between-group differences were observed for any secondary outcomes. Conclusions: PMDOT lenses were not inferior to HAL lenses in controlling myopia progression. Translational Relevance: This trial demonstrated the clinical potential of PMDOT lenses for myopia control in schoolchildren.

摘要 目的：采用双重稳健因果推断框架，比较四种近视控制框架眼镜干预措施在儿童近视控制中的真实世界效果。 方法：采用多疗法增强逆概率加权的回顾性队列研究。纳入2023年1月至2026年1月在成都中医药大学附属银海眼科医院就诊的2764名3~18岁近视儿童（右眼），分为高阶像差离焦组（HOAD，912例）、多区正向光学离焦组（DIMS，800例）、高非球面微透镜组（HAL，476例）、多样化分段离焦优化组（DSDO，238例）和单光镜片组（338例）。主要结局指标为1年眼轴长度和等效球镜度变化，次要指标为快速进展率。 结果：调整混杂因素后，所有四种近视控制设计的效果均显著优于单光矫正（P<0.05）。基于高阶像差离焦的设计表现出最佳疗效，眼轴长度变化为0.107 mm，等效球镜度变化为-0.146 D；该组中25.5%的儿童表现为眼轴快速增长（≥0.36 mm/年），8.3%表现为近视快速进展（≥-0.50 D/年）。在低度近视或眼轴长度不超过26 mm的儿童中，治疗效果具有统计学显著性（P<0.05），但在高度近视或病理性眼轴延长儿童中则无显著性。 结论：在真实世界临床实践中，四种近视控制镜片设计均较单光矫正表现出显著优势；应特别强调近视控制眼镜在近视早期的作用，当发展为高度近视或病理性眼轴延长时，单独使用框架眼镜的疗效减弱，可能需要结合多种近视管理策略。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: We aimed to compare the real-world effectiveness of four myopia-control spectacle lens interventions for childhood myopia control using a doubly robust causal inference framework. Design: This was a retrospective cohort study with multi-treatment augmented inverse probability weighting. Participants: A total of 2764 myopic children (right eyes) aged 3–18 years were included, screened from 13,071 electronic medical records at Ineye Hospital, Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, between January 2023 and January 2026. Methods: Participants were allocated to four myopia-control spectacle lens groups and one single-vision spectacle lens group: Higher-Order Aberration Defocus (n = 912), Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (n = 800), Highly Aspherical Lenslets (n = 476), Diversified Segmental Defocus Optimization (n = 238), and single-vision lenses (n = 338). A doubly robust estimator combining multinomial propensity-score weighting with outcome regression was applied to adjust for confounding. Outcome Measures: The primary outcomes were one-year changes in axial length and spherical equivalent. The secondary outcomes were the rates of rapid progression. Treatment-effect heterogeneity was explored across prespecified baseline age, refractive error, and axial length subgroups. Results: After adjustment, all four myopia-control designs significantly outperformed single-vision correction (p < 0.05). The design based on Higher-Order Aberration Defocus demonstrated the greatest efficacy, with an axial length change of 0.107 mm and a spherical equivalent change of −0.146 D. Within this group, 25.5% of children exhibited rapid axial elongation (≥0.36 mm/year) and 8.3% exhibited rapid myopic progression (≥−0.50 D/year). The treatment effect was statistically significant in children with low myopia or an axial length no greater than 26 mm (p < 0.05), but not in those with high myopia or pathological axial elongation. Conclusions: All four myopia-control spectacle lens designs demonstrated significant advantages over single-vision correction in real-world clinical practice. Particular emphasis should be placed on the role of myopia-control spectacles during the early stages of myopia. As myopia progresses to high myopia or pathological axial elongation, the efficacy of myopia-control spectacle lenses as a standalone intervention diminishes, and combined approaches incorporating multiple myopia management strategies may be warranted.

Spectacle Lenses With Highly Aspherical Lenslets for Slowing Myopia: A Randomized, Double-Blind, Cross-Over Clinical Trial

HAL控制近视的随机交叉临床试验及无反弹效应验证

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2022年👥 Sankaridurg Padmaja, Weng Rebecca, Tran Huy, Spiegel Daniel P, Drobe Björn, Ha Thao, Tran Yen H, Naduvilath Thomas

参考文献6-3-1 HAL控制近视的随机交叉临床试验及无反弹效应验证 起始时间：2019年5月31日 研究中心&PI：Haiyen Eye Care, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam & Padmaja Sankaridurg 试验设计简述：前瞻性、双盲、单中心、随机、交叉试验 样本量：119人 E：HSH组 (阶段2-佩戴SVL)进展量-0.3D；SHH组 (阶段1—佩戴SVL)-0.27D ， AL：HSH组 (阶段2-佩戴SVL)进展量0.17mm；SHH组 (阶段1—佩戴SVL)进展量0.13mm 结论：数据无显著差异，所以从HAL换到SVL未出现反弹
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-3 反弹效应 / 6-3-1
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：评估高度非球面微透镜（HAL）眼镜与传统单光（SV）眼镜对近视进展的影响。 研究设计：前瞻性、双盲、单中心、随机、交叉临床试验。 研究方法：共 119 名越南儿童（7-13 岁，球镜等效屈光度 [SE] 为 - 0.75~-4.75 屈光度）被随机分配佩戴 HAL 眼镜或 SV 眼镜，6 个月后（第 1 阶段）交叉更换为另一种镜片，再佩戴 6 个月（第 2 阶段）。第 2 阶段结束后，两组均继续佩戴 HAL 眼镜 6 个月。根据各阶段佩戴镜片的顺序，将组 1 命名为 HSH 组（HAL-SV-HAL），组 2 命名为 SHH 组（SV-HAL-HAL）。主要结局指标包括：各阶段内 HAL 与 SV 眼镜在 SE 及眼轴长度（AL）变化量（Δ）上的比较；HSH 组与 SHH 组在佩戴 SV 眼镜时 SE/AL 的比较，以判断 HSH 组从 HAL 眼镜更换为 SV 眼镜时是否出现近视反弹。 研究结果：第 1、2 阶段中，佩戴 HAL 眼镜的儿童近视进展速度均慢于佩戴 SV 眼镜者（球镜等效屈光度 [SE]：第 1 阶段为 - 0.21 屈光度 vs -0.27 屈光度，P=0.317；第 2 阶段为 - 0.05 屈光度 vs -0.32 屈光度，P<0.001；眼轴长度 [AL]：第 1 阶段为 0.07mm vs 0.14mm，P=0.004；第 2 阶段为 0.04mm vs 0.17mm，P<0.001）。HSH 组与 SHH 组在佩戴 SV 眼镜时的 SE/AL 无显著差异（SE：-0.33±0.27 屈光度 vs -0.27±0.42 屈光度，P=0.208；AL：0.17±0.13mm vs 0.13±0.15mm，P=0.092）。两种镜片的日均佩戴时长均约为 14 小时。 研究结论：本交叉试验中，组间及组内比较结果均表明 HAL 眼镜可延缓近视进展。儿童对镜片佩戴的依从性良好，数据未显示从 HAL 眼镜更换为 SV 眼镜时出现近视反弹。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate myopia progression with highly aspherical lenslet (HAL) spectacles vs conventional single vision (SV) spectacles. DESIGN: Prospective, double-blind, single-center, randomized, cross-over trial. METHOD: A total of 119 Vietnamese children (7-13 years of age, spherical equivalent refractive error [SE] = -0.75 to -4.75D) were randomized to wear either HAL or SV, and after 6 months (stage 1) crossed over to the other lens for another 6 months (stage 2). At the end of stage 2, both groups wore HAL for a further 6 months. In the order that lenses were worn at each stage, group 1 was designated HSH (HAL-SV-HAL) and group 2 SHH (SV-HAL-HAL). The main outcome measures were a comparison between HAL and SV for change (Δ) in SE and axial length (AL) during each stage; and a comparison of ΔSE/AL with SV between HSH and SHH groups to determine whether myopia rebounded when switched from HAL to SV (HSH group). RESULTS: Myopia progressed more slowly with HAL than with SV during stages 1 and 2 (SEΔ stage 1: -0.21 vs -0.27D, P = .317, stage 2: -0.05 vs -0.32D, P < .001; ALΔ stage 1: 0.07 vs 0.14 mm, P = .004; stage 2: 0.04 vs 0.17 mm, P < .001). ΔSE/AL with SV was not different between the HSH and SHH groups (ΔSE -0.33 ± 0.27D vs -0.27 ± 0.42D, P = .208; ΔAL 0.17 ± 0.13mm vs 0.13 ± 0.15 mm, P = .092). An average of 14 hours per day of lens wear was reported with both lenses. CONCLUSIONS: In this cross-over trial, intergroup and intragroup comparisons indicate that HAL slows myopia. Children were compliant with lens wear, and data were not suggestive of rebound when patients were switched from HAL to SV.

参考文献6-3-2 HAL vs SAL vs SVL-近视儿童与未近视儿童眼轴生长模式的比较研究 起始时间：2018年7月 研究中心&PI：温州医科大学附属眼视光医院 & 陈浩 试验设计简述：双盲、平行三组随机对照试验（HAL vs SAL vs SVL—三组各自存在慢速、正常、快速眼轴生长者） 试验组样本量：HAL 组 54 人；SAL 组 53 人 AL：【全体参与者：HAL进展量 0.34mm，控制量-0.35mm,控制率51% SAL进展量0.51mm，控制量-0.18mm,控制率26% 】；【全天佩戴者≥12h，HAL进展量0.28mm，控制量-0.41mm,控制率60% SAL‘进展量0.46mm，控制量-0.23mm,控制率33% 】
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-3 反弹效应 / 6-3-2
原文摘要
摘要 引言：旨在评估中国温州地区佩戴高度非球面微透镜（HAL）、轻度非球面微透镜（SAL）及单光镜片（SVL）框架眼镜的儿童，与非近视儿童的眼轴生长模式差异。 方法：该随机试验纳入 170 名 8-13 岁近视儿童，随机分配至 HAL 组、SAL 组或 SVL 组。采用逻辑函数模型，基于温州医科大学 - 依视路近视发生与进展队列研究（WEPrOM）中 700 名 7-9 岁非近视学龄儿童的数据，分析正常眼轴生长情况。眼轴生长速度分为慢速、正常、快速三类，分别定义为数值处于＜第 25 百分位、第 25-75 百分位、＞第 75 百分位范围。 结果：非近视儿童中，7-10 岁和 11-13 岁儿童的慢速眼轴生长（第 25 百分位）预测上限分别为 0.20-0.13 mm 和 0.08-0.01 mm（2 年后分别为 0.37-0.33 mm 和 0.29-0.14 mm）；正常眼轴生长（第 75 百分位）预测上限分别为 0.32-0.31 mm 和 0.28-0.10 mm（2 年后分别为 0.58-0.55 mm 和 0.50-0.24 mm）。2 年试验共纳入 157 名儿童，其中 96 名全天佩戴镜片（每天≥12 小时）。HAL 组、SAL 组和 SVL 组的 2 年眼轴长度平均变化值分别为 0.34 mm、0.51 mm 和 0.69 mm（全天佩戴者分别为 0.28 mm、0.46 mm 和 0.69 mm）。三组中，慢速眼轴生长的儿童占比分别为 35%、17% 和 2%（全天佩戴者分别为 44%、29% 和 3%）；正常眼轴生长的儿童占比分别为 35%、26% 和 12%（全天佩戴者分别为 44%、32% 和 9%）；快速眼轴生长的儿童占比分别为 30%、57% 和 86%（全天佩戴者分别为 12%、39% 和 88%），组间差异均有统计学意义（p＜0.001）。 结论：佩戴 HAL 镜片全天佩戴的儿童中，约 90%（佩戴 SVL 镜片全天佩戴的儿童约为 10%）在 1 年和 2 年后的眼轴生长模式，均与非近视儿童相似或更慢。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
INTRODUCTION: To evaluate eye growth of children wearing spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL), slightly aspherical lenslets (SAL) and single-vision lenses (SVL) compared to eye growth patterns in non-myopes in Wenzhou, China. METHODS: The randomised trial had 170 myopic children (aged 8-13 years) randomly assigned to the HAL, SAL or SVL group. Normal eye growth was examined using 700 non-myopic schoolchildren (aged 7-9 years) in the Wenzhou Medical University-Essilor Progression and Onset of Myopia (WEPrOM) cohort study using logistic function models. Slow, normal and fast eye growth was defined as range of values <25th, 25th-75th and >75th percentiles, respectively. RESULTS: The predicted upper limits of slow eye growth (25th percentile) among non-myopes aged 7-10 years and 11-13 years were 0.20-0.13 and 0.08-0.01 mm (after 2-year period; 0.37-0.33 and 0.29-0.14 mm), respectively, while the upper limits of normal eye growth (75th percentile) were 0.32-0.31 and 0.28-0.10 mm (after 2-year period; 0.58-0.55 and 0.50-0.24 mm), respectively. The 2-year trial had 157 children, 96 of whom wore their lenses full time (everyday ≥12 h/day). The mean 2-year axial length change for HAL, SAL and SVL was 0.34, 0.51 and 0.69 mm (0.28, 0.46 and 0.69 mm in full-time wear), respectively. Slow eye growth was found in 35%, 17% and 2% (44%, 29% and 3% in full-time wear); normal eye growth in 35%, 26% and 12% (44%, 32% and 9% in full-time wear) and fast eye growth in 30%, 57% and 86% (12%, 39% and 88% in full-time wear), respectively (p < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: The eye growth pattern in approximately 90% wearing HAL full time (compared with about 10% wearing SVL full time) was similar or slower than that of non-myopic children both after 1- and 2-year periods.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-4 效果预测 （包括脉络膜厚度） / 6-4-1
原文摘要
摘要 目的：高非球面微透镜眼镜（HAL）和低非球面微透镜眼镜（SAL）已显示出有效的近视控制效果，本研究旨在探讨其对近视儿童黄斑区脉络膜厚度（ChT）的影响。 方法：本研究为一项为期 2 年的双盲随机试验的探索性分析。纳入 170 名 8~13 岁近视儿童，其球镜度数为 - 0.75D~-4.75D，散光度数≤1.50D，屈光参差≤1.00D。受试者按 1:1:1 的比例随机分为三组，分别佩戴 HAL、SAL 或单光框架眼镜（SVL）。每 6 个月评估一次中心凹下、旁中心凹及周边中心凹的脉络膜厚度。 结果：154 名受试者完成所有检查。三组所有区域的脉络膜厚度均随时间发生显著变化（均 p<0.05）。SVL 组各区域脉络膜厚度持续下降，2 年后下降范围为 - 20.75（标准差 22.34）μm 至 - 12.18（标准差 22.57）μm。与 SVL 组相比，SAL 组脉络膜厚度下降幅度更小，下降范围为 - 16.49（标准差 21.27）μm 至 - 5.29（标准差 18.15）μm。HAL 组脉络膜厚度在第 1 年升高，第 2 年下降，2 年后变化范围为 - 0.30（标准差 27.54）μm 至 8.92（标准差 23.97）μm。周边中心凹脉络膜厚度下降幅度小于旁中心凹，且上方区域下降幅度最小。 结论：佩戴 SVL 的近视儿童在 2 年近视进展期间，黄斑区脉络膜厚度下降。佩戴非球面微透镜框架眼镜可减少或阻止脉络膜变薄，且 HAL 的效果更显著。 试验注册号：ChiCTR1800017683。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
OBJECTIVE: Spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) and slightly aspherical lenslets (SAL) showed effective myopia control. This study was to investigate their effects on macular choroidal thickness (ChT) in myopic children. METHODS: Exploratory analysis from a 2-year, double-masked, randomised trial. 170 children aged 8-13 years with myopia between -0.75D and -4.75D, astigmatism of 1.50D or less, and anisometropia of 1.00D or less were recruited. Participants were randomly assigned in a 1:1:1 ratio to receive HAL, SAL or single vision spectacle lenses (SVL). The subfoveal, parafoveal and perifoveal ChT were evaluated every 6 months. RESULTS: 154 participants completed all examinations. The ChT showed significant changes over time in all three groups in all regions (all p<0.05). The ChTs continuously decreased in the SVL group (ranging from -20.75 (SD 22.34) μm to -12.18 (22.57) μm after 2 years in different regions). Compared with the SVL group, ChT in the SAL group decreased less (ranging from -16.49 (21.27) μm to -5.29 (18.15) μm). In the HAL group, ChT increased in the first year and then decreased in the second year (ranging from -0.30 (27.54) μm to 8.92 (23.97) μm after two years). The perifoveal ChT decreased less than the parafoveal ChT, and the superior region decreased the least. CONCLUSIONS: The ChT of the macula decreased after 2 years of myopia progression with SVL. Wearing spectacle lenses with aspherical lenslets reduced or abolished the ChT thinning and HAL had a more pronounced effect. TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: ChiCTR1800017683.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：近期研究表明，高非球面微透镜（HAL）在延缓近视进展方面具有显著效果。此外，研究提示，脉络膜厚度增加或可作为评估近视控制治疗效果的生物标志物。因此，本研究探讨了高非球面微透镜（HAL）与全视野 + 3.00 屈光度（D）近视性离焦对黄斑中心凹下脉络膜厚度（SFCHR）的短期影响。 设计：前瞻性实验研究。 受试者：25 名受试者，年龄 20-30 岁（均数 24.56±2.467 岁），屈光不正范围为正视至 - 5.0 D（均数 - 2.255±1.514 D）。每位受试者以对侧非优势眼作为对照眼。 方法：受试者在两次独立实验中，分别于优势眼佩戴 HAL 镜片或 + 3 D 全视野近视性离焦镜片，观看 6 米处投影播放的影片，每次观看 90 分钟。对照眼仅佩戴单光隐形眼镜以获得最佳矫正远视力。分别在离焦前、离焦 60 分钟和 90 分钟时，对双眼的眼轴长度（AL）和黄斑中心凹下脉络膜厚度（SFCHR）进行三次测量。主要结局指标为 SFCHR 和 AL 随时间的变化情况。 结果：与基线相比，佩戴 HAL 镜片和 + 3 D 近视性离焦镜片后，离焦眼的 SFCHR 均显著增加（p<0.001）。其中，HAL 干预组的 SFCHR 增加量为 6.62±6.32 μm，+3 D 干预组为 7.36±8.83 μm。两组干预措施的效果差异无统计学意义（p=0.595）。在整个测量期间，+3.00 D 全视野离焦组中，离焦眼的 SFCHR 增加量较对照眼显著高 3.176±1.318 μm（p=0.020）。 结论：短期暴露于全视野近视性离焦可增加脉络膜厚度，这一效果与 HAL 镜片产生的周边近视性离焦效果相近，尽管前者效果似乎稍弱。 参考文献6-4-3：摘要 光学或药物治疗启动后，脉络膜厚度（CT）的早期变化可作为后续眼轴长度（AL）增长速率及近视进展的预测指标，同时也可作为个体治疗敏感性的生物标志物。 研究目的：本研究旨在探讨新验配高非球面微透镜（HAL）眼镜的儿童其近视进展动态与该光学矫正方式下脉络膜早期反应之间的关联。 材料与方法：本研究纳入 36 例儿童（共 72 眼），年龄 7-13 岁，平均年龄 10.41±1.14 岁，近视度数为 3.74±0.64 屈光度（D），均佩戴 HAL 眼镜片 12 个月。根据光学矫正首个月后的脉络膜反应，将受试者分为两组：第 1 组为 24 例儿童（48 眼），其脉络膜厚度增加≥5 微米（µm）；第 2 组为 12 例儿童（24 眼），其脉络膜厚度无变化或出现下降。随访一年后，对所有受试者的眼轴长度及屈光度数变化情况进行评估。 结果：随访一年后，第 1 组（脉络膜厚度增加组）的近视进展度数为 0.03±0.3 屈光度，眼轴增长量为 0.04±0.16 毫米；第 2 组的上述两项指标数值分别为 0.12±0.2 屈光度和 0.18±0.2 毫米，组间差异具有统计学意义（p<0.05）。 结论：在为期一年的随访中，脉络膜厚度的早期增加与屈光度数及眼轴长度的更高稳定性密切相关。脉络膜的早期反应可作为后续治疗效果的预测指标，同时也可作为选择近视控制方案的参考依据。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
Objectives: Recent studies have shown that highly aspheric lenslets (HAL) are effective in slowing myopia progression. Moreover, research indicates that an enhancement in choroidal thickness might serve as a biomarker for evaluating the efficacy of myopia control treatments. Therefore, this study examined the short-term effects of HAL and full-field +3.00 diopters (D) myopic defocus on sub-foveal choroidal thickness (SFCHR). Design: Prospective experimental study. Participants: Twenty-five participants aged 20-30 (mean 24.56 ± 2.467) years with a refraction error of emmetropia to -5.0 D (mean -2.255 ± 1.514 D). The contralateral non-dominant eye was used as control for each participant. Methods: The participants watched a movie projected at 6 m for 90 min on two separate occasions while wearing HAL or +3 D full-field myopic defocus lenses on their dominant eye. The control eye wore only a single-vision contact lens with the best-corrected distance vision. Three measurements of AL and SFCHR were captured before defocus, and after 60 and 90 min of defocus for both eyes. The main outcome measures were changes in SFCHR and AL over time. Results: Exposure to HAL and +3 D myopic defocus significantly increased SFCHR in the defocused eyes compared to the baseline (p < 0.001). The increase in SFCHR was 6.62 ± 6.32 µm with the HAL intervention and 7.36 ± 8.83 µm with the +3 D intervention. The difference between the two interventions was not statistically significant (p = 0.595). A significant mean difference of 3.176 ± 1.318 µm in SFCHR increase was observed with +3.00 D full-field defocus in the defocused eyes compared to the control eyes over the measurement period (p = 0.020). Conclusions: Short-term exposure to full-field myopic defocus increased choroidal thickness, which was comparable with that observed in peripheral myopic defocus with HAL, although the effect appears less pronounced.

参考文献6-4-3 高非球面微透镜眼镜治疗中脉络膜厚度早期变化的预测价值 样本量：36人 结果：第1组（24人，ΔCT≥5μm）：ΔSER=0.03D/年，ΔAL=0.04mm/年；第2组（12人，ΔCT≤0μm）：ΔSER=0.12D/年，ΔAL=0.18mm 结论：早期脉络膜反应可作为后续治疗效果的预测指标
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-4 效果预测 （包括脉络膜厚度） / 6-4-3
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
UNLABELLED: Early changes in choroidal thickness (CT) following the initiation of optical or pharmacological therapy may serve as a predictor of the subsequent rate of axial length (AL) increase and progression of myopia, as well as a biomarker of individual sensitivity to the treatment. PURPOSE: This study aimed to investigate the relationship between the dynamics of myopia progression in children wearing newly prescribed spectacles with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) and the early choroidal response to this optical correction. MATERIAL AND METHODS: The study included 36 children (72 eyes) aged 7-13 years (mean age 10.41±1.14 years) with myopia of 3.74±0.64 D who wore HAL spectacle lenses for 12 months. Based on the choroidal response after the first month of optical correction, patients were divided into two groups: group 1 included 24 children (48 eyes) with an increase in CT of ≥5 µm, and group 2 consisted of 12 children (24 eyes) in which CT either did not change or decreased. Changes in AL and refractive error were assessed after one year. RESULTS: In group 1 (CT increase), refractive progression was 0.03±0.3 D and axial elongation was 0.04±0.16 mm after one year; in group 2, these values were 0.12±0.2 D and 0.18±0.2 mm, respectively (p<0.05). CONCLUSION: Early increase in CT was associated with greater stability of refractive error and AL during one year of follow-up. The early response of the choroid may serve as a predictor of further treatment effectiveness and a criterion for selecting myopia control strategies.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-4 效果预测 （包括脉络膜厚度） / 6-4-4
原文摘要
摘要 研究背景：探讨佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜片（HAL）3 年的影响，以及从单光眼镜片（SVL）更换为高非球面微透镜眼镜片对儿童脉络膜厚度（ChT）的影响。 研究方法：选取 51 名已佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜片 2 年的受试者，继续佩戴该镜片 1 年（高非球面微透镜持续佩戴组）；另选取 50 名佩戴轻度非球面微透镜眼镜片（SAL）2 年、41 名佩戴单光眼镜片 2 年的受试者，均更换为高非球面微透镜眼镜片并佩戴 1 年（分别为轻非球面转高非球面组、单光转高非球面组）。同时纳入 48 名 10-15 岁新受试者，在研究第三年佩戴单光眼镜片（新单光组）。研究期间每 6 个月测量一次受试者的脉络膜厚度。 研究结果：研究第三年，四组受试者的脉络膜厚度变化存在显著差异（仅鼻侧外周区P=0.09，其余区域均P<0.05），新单光组的脉络膜厚度降幅显著大于其他三组。但三个佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜片的组别，在第三年的脉络膜厚度均无显著变化（均P>0.05）。对比高非球面微透镜持续佩戴组、轻非球面转高非球面组和单光转高非球面组 3 年的脉络膜厚度变化，发现更换为高非球面微透镜眼镜片前，三组间存在显著差异，而全部更换后，组间差异消失。 研究结论：与单光眼镜片组相比，所有佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜片的组别均能显著抑制脉络膜变薄。佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜片 3 年虽不再产生脉络膜增厚的效果，但相较于佩戴单光眼镜片，仍能有效抑制脉络膜变薄。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: To investigate the impact of wearing spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) for 3 years and the impact of switching from single-vision lenses (SVL) to HAL on choroidal thickness (ChT). METHODS: Fifty-one participants who had already worn HAL for 2 years continued wearing them for an additional year (HAL group). Further, 50 and 41 participants who had worn spectacle lenses with slightly aspherical lenslets (SAL) and SVL for 2 years, respectively, switched to wearing HAL for another year (SAL-HAL and SVL-HAL groups). Additionally, 48 new participants aged 10-15 years were enrolled to wear SVL at the third year (new-SVL group). ChT was measured every 6 months throughout the study. RESULTS: Significant differences were observed in the changes in ChT among the four groups at the third year (all P < 0.05 except for the outer nasal region: P = 0.09), with the new-SVL group showing larger reductions compared with the other three groups. However, none of the three HAL-wearing groups showed significant changes in ChT at the third year (all P > 0.05). When comparing the changes in ChT for 3 years among the HAL, SAL-HAL, and SVL-HAL groups, significant differences were found before switching to HAL, but these differences were abolished after all participants switched to HAL. CONCLUSIONS: Compared to those in the SVL group, choroid thinning was significantly inhibited in all the HAL groups. Wearing HAL for 3 years no longer had a choroidal thickening effect but could still inhibit choroidal thinning compared to wearing SVL. TRIAL REGISTRATION: The study was registered at the Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (ChiCTR1800017683), http://www.chictr.org.cn/showproj.aspx?proj=29789 .

参考文献6-4-5 阿托品vsOK镜vsRLRLvsHAL/SALvsSVL-对儿童脉络膜厚度影响-meta分析 结果：所有干预措施均能显著增加儿童的脉络膜厚度，其中重复低强度红光疗法的增厚效果最明显，低浓度阿托品的增厚幅度最小。【阿托品0.01%-0.05%/角膜塑形镜/重复低强度红光疗法/HAL/SAL/SVL】
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-4 效果预测 （包括脉络膜厚度） / 6-4-5
原文摘要
摘要 研究主题：本系统综述和荟萃分析对比单光镜片或安慰剂，评估近视控制干预措施是否会使近视儿童和青少年的脉络膜厚度（ChT）产生可测量的变化，主要研究目的为描述脉络膜厚度的调节规律。 临床意义：近视是全球最常见的眼部疾病，预计到 2050 年，全球 50% 的人口将受其影响。高度近视会增加近视性黄斑病变、视网膜脱离等并发症的发生风险。治疗效果的早期生物标志物至关重要，而脉络膜厚度对视觉和药物刺激具有快速的双向反应，因此成为极具潜力的候选标志物。 研究方法：本研究方案已在国际系统综述前瞻性注册库（PROSPERO，注册号：CRD420251144689）完成注册。研究遵循《系统综述和荟萃分析报告规范》（PRISMA）2020 版指南及《系统综述质量评估工具 2》（AMSTAR-2）标准，纳入所有评估儿童人群接受近视控制干预后脉络膜厚度变化的随机对照试验（RCT）。于 2025 年 8 月 5 日在 PubMed、Web of Science 和 Scopus 三大数据库完成文献检索。两名研究者采用 Cochrane 偏倚风险评估工具，独立完成文献筛选、数据提取及偏倚风险评估工作。本研究计算了合并均数差及 95% 置信区间（CI），并采用推荐意见的分级、制定与评估（GRADE）方法对证据质量进行评级。 研究结果：本研究共分析了 11 项随机对照试验，涉及 2190 只眼。重复低强度红光疗法带来的脉络膜增厚效果最显著（均数差 = 24.1μm，95% 置信区间：19.8-28.5，异质性指数 I²=77%）；阿托品虽能产生显著的增厚效果，但幅度温和（均数差 = 10.6μm，95% 置信区间：6.7-14.5，异质性指数 I²=97%），且研究间异质性高；角膜塑形术可使脉络膜厚度持续增加（均数差 = 13.3μm，95% 置信区间：9.5-17.1，异质性指数 I²=6%）；微透镜框架眼镜的增厚效果中等（均数差 = 13.2μm，95% 置信区间：5.7-20.7，异质性指数 I²=0%）。多数干预措施的证据质量被评为高级，阿托品的证据质量为中级。 研究结论：近视控制干预措施可使儿童脉络膜厚度在干预早期出现可测量的增加。本研究明确了脉络膜厚度的调节规律，但其临床应用价值仍有待证实。未来仍需开展更多研究，将脉络膜厚度与近视控制的疗效指标相结合分析。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
TOPIC: This systematic review and meta-analysis evaluated whether myopia control interventions produce measurable changes in choroidal thickness (ChT) in children and adolescents with myopia compared with single-vision lenses or placebo. The primary aim was to describe patterns of ChT modulation. CLINICAL RELEVANCE: Myopia is the most common ocular disorder worldwide and is projected to affect 50% of the global population by 2050. High myopia increases the risk of complications such as myopic maculopathy and retinal detachment. Early biomarkers of treatment efficacy are critical, and ChT has emerged as a promising candidate given its rapid and bidirectional response to visual and pharmacological stimuli. METHODS: The protocol was registered in the International Prospective Register of Systematic Reviews (PROSPERO; CRD420251144689). Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses (PRISMA) 2020 guidelines and A Measurement Tool to Assess Systematic Reviews 2 (AMSTAR-2) standards, randomized controlled trials (RCTs) were included if they assessed ChT changes after myopia control interventions in pediatric populations. Searches of PubMed, Web of Science, and Scopus were completed on August 5, 2025. Two reviewers independently screened, extracted, and assessed risk of bias using the Cochrane tool. Pooled mean differences with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were calculated, and certainty of evidence was rated with Grading of Recommendations, Assessment, Development and Evaluation. RESULTS: Eleven RCTs including 2190 eyes were analyzed. Repeated low-level red-light therapy induced the largest thickening (mean difference = 24.1 μm, 95% CI: 19.8-28.5; I2 = 77%). Atropine produced modest but significant effects (mean difference = 10.6 μm, 95% CI: 6.7-14.5) with high heterogeneity (I2 = 97%). Orthokeratology yielded consistent increases (mean difference = 13.3 μm, 95% CI: 9.5-17.1; I2 = 6%), while lenslet spectacles showed moderate effects (mean difference = 13.2 μm, 95% CI: 5.7-20.7; I2 = 0%). Evidence certainty was rated high for most interventions and moderate for atropine. CONCLUSIONS: Myopia control interventions produce early, measurable increases in ChT. These findings characterize patterns of choroidal modulation, while their clinical relevance remains uncertain. Further studies integrating ChT with efficacy measures are needed. FINANCIAL DISCLOSURES: Proprietary or commercial disclosure may be found in the Footnotes and Disclosures at the end of this article.

原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：本研究旨在评估高非球面小透镜（HAL）眼镜对低度远视儿童的作用，重点分析其对脉络膜厚度（ChT）和眼轴长度（AL）延长的影响。 研究方法：2022 年 8 月至 2023 年 9 月开展了一项单中心随机对照试验，研究对象为 6~9 岁球镜等效屈光度在 0.00~+2.00 屈光度（D）的儿童。研究对象被随机分为单光镜（SVL）组和高非球面小透镜（HAL）眼镜组。分别在基线、佩戴 1 个月和 12 个月时测量研究对象的眼轴长度和脉络膜厚度。结合眼镜平均周佩戴时长和 12 个月眼轴长度延长值，分析脉络膜厚度的变化情况。 研究结果：共 84 名儿童完成 12 个月随访并纳入分析，其中单光镜组 44 名，高非球面小透镜眼镜组 40 名。两组研究对象的平均脉络膜厚度较基线均无显著变化（均 P>0.05）。但高非球面小透镜眼镜组的眼镜周佩戴时长（38.6±18.5 小时）与中心凹下脉络膜厚度变化值（325.0±37.1 微米）呈正相关（R²=0.46，P<0.0001），且中心凹下脉络膜厚度变化值与眼轴延长值（0.19 毫米，四分位距 0.12~0.27 毫米）呈负相关（R²=0.13，P=0.004）。相反，单光镜组未观察到上述显著相关性。 研究结论：高非球面小透镜眼镜与单光镜在眼轴长度和脉络膜厚度的变化方面，未观察到显著差异。但在低度远视的中国儿童中，高非球面小透镜眼镜对眼轴长度延长和中心凹下脉络膜厚度存在影响，且该影响与眼镜佩戴时长呈剂量依赖性。转化意义：高非球面小透镜眼镜可通过调节低度远视儿童的脉络膜厚度，减缓其眼轴长度延长。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study aimed to evaluate the effects of spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HALs) in children with low hyperopia, focusing on their impact on choroidal thickness (ChT) and axial length (AL) elongation. METHODS: A single-center, randomized, controlled trial was conducted from August 2022 to September 2023, involving children aged 6 to 9 years with spherical equivalent ranging from +0.00 to +2.00 diopters (D). Participants were randomly assigned to either a single-vision lens (SVL) group or a HAL spectacle lens group. AL and ChT were measured at baseline, 1 month, and 12 months. ChT changes were analyzed with average weekly wearing time of spectacle lenses and 12-month AL elongation. RESULTS: A total of 84 children (44 in the SVL group and 40 in the HAL group) completed the 12-month follow-up visit and were included in the analysis. There was no significant change in mean ChT from baseline in either group (both P > 0.05). However, there was a positive correlation between weekly lens wearing time (38.6 ± 18.5 hours) and subfoveal ChT change (325.0 ± 37.1 µm) in the HAL group (R2 = 0.46, P < 0.0001), which was inversely correlated with axial elongation (0.19 mm; interquartile range, 0.12-0.27; R2 = 0.13; P = 0.004). In contrast, no significant correlations were observed in the SVL group. CONCLUSIONS: No significant differences were observed between HAL and single-vision spectacles in AL or ChT change. However, HAL spectacle lenses influenced AL elongation and subfoveal ChT with a dose-dependent effect related to lens wearing time in low hyperopic Chinese children. TRANSLATIONAL RELEVANCE: Spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets slow axial elongation by modulating choroidal thickness in low-hyperopic children.

Lens power and associated factors affect ocular response to highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) in myopic children

HAL对近视调控的生物学调制机制和阶段性调控规律

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2026年👥 Gao Min, Li Sixian, Wang Wenqian, Wu Bobo, Zhang Yan, Xiong Fen
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-4-7 HAL对近视调控的生物学调制机制和阶段性调控规律 研究中心：南昌大学附属眼科医院/熊芬 研究设计：回顾性队列研究 2组队列：非线性分析队列用于构建GAMMs模型（n=559），纵向随访队列（n=62，需完成12个月内最少随访2次） 样本量：50人 结果：利用广义相加混合模型（GAMMs），明确了晶状体补偿机制发生质变的三个关键临床阈值：眼轴（AL）= 24.0 mm，眼轴/角膜曲率半径比值（AL/CR）= 3.15，晶状体厚度（LT）= 3.3 mm。明确了 HAL 疗效的生物学调制机制：当儿童基线参数处于 AL > 24.0 mm 或 AL/CR ≥3.15时，其晶状体代偿能力已基本耗尽，在配戴 HAL 后仍表现出较快的近视进展 。 揭示 HAL 控近视的“阶段性规律”：发现 HAL 对等效球镜（SE）和晶状体屈光力（LP）的最强调节效应集中在配戴后的 3-6 个月区间（证实了阶段性衰减的存在） 。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-4 效果预测 （包括脉络膜厚度） / 6-4-7
原文摘要
摘要 目的：探究眼部生物测量参数与晶状体屈光力（LP）的关联，确定二者非线性变化的临界拐点，并评估上述指标对高非球微透镜（HAL）近视控制效果的调控作用。 方法：本回顾性研究包含两组研究人群：横断面队列（559 名轻、中度近视受试者）采用皮尔逊 / 斯皮尔曼相关分析、广义加性混合模型（GAMMs）分析参数间的关联及非线性关系；配戴高非球微透镜（HAL）随访 12 个月的纵向队列（62 名儿童）采用重复测量方差分析、协方差分析进行评估。依据年等效球镜（SE）变化量、眼轴（AL）增长速度划分近视进展快慢亚组，采用卡方检验、曼 - 惠特尼 U 检验开展亚组分析。 结果：广义加性混合模型（GAMMs）筛选出关键临界拐点：眼轴 24.0 mm、眼轴 / 角膜曲率半径比值 3.15、晶状体厚度 3.3 mm。在眼轴≤24 mm、眼轴 / 角膜曲率半径比值＜3.15 或晶状体厚度＞3.3 mm 的人群中，晶状体屈光力下降速度更快（P＜0.05）；配戴 HAL 且符合上述三项特征的儿童，晶状体屈光力降低更显著。近视进展缓慢组年晶状体屈光力降幅显著大于进展快速组（-0.28±0.44 D vs -0.03±0.42 D，P=0.02）。分阶段分析显示，HAL 对等效球镜、晶状体屈光力的调控作用在配戴 3～6 个月时达到峰值。 结论：本研究证实眼部生物测量参数（眼轴 24.0 mm、眼轴 / 角膜曲率半径比值 3.15、晶状体厚度 3.3 mm）与晶状体屈光力存在非线性关联；性别与晶状体屈光力显著相关，且眼轴 / 角膜曲率半径比值评估晶状体代偿能力优于单一眼轴指标。眼轴＞24 mm、眼轴 / 角膜曲率半径比值≥3.15 提示晶状体代偿功能耗竭、近视快速进展。高非球微透镜（HAL）可有效控制近视，基于上述临界拐点阈值能够实现临床风险分层，助力个性化干预，提升防控精准度与疗效。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To characterize associations between ocular biometrics and lens power (LP), identify nonlinear inflection points, and evaluate their role in modulating the myopia control efficacy of highly aspherical lenslets (HAL). METHODS: This retrospective study included two cohorts. The cross-sectional cohort (n = 559, mild-to-moderate myopia) was analyzed using Pearson/Spearman correlation and Generalized Additive Mixed Models (GAMMs) to explore associations and nonlinear relationships.The 12-month HAL follow-up cohort (n = 62 children) was evaluated using repeated-measures ANOVA and ANCOVA. Subgroup analyses stratified by myopia progression speed (based on annual spherical equivalent (SE) change and axial length (AL) growth) were performed using chi-square and Mann-Whitney U tests. RESULTS: GAMMs identified critical inflection points: AL = 24.0 mm, AL/CR = 3.15, and lens thickness (LT) = 3.3 mm. LP decreased more rapidly in subgroups with AL ≤ 24 mm, AL/CR < 3.15, or LT > 3.3 mm(P < 0.05). HAL wearers with AL ≤ 24 mm, AL/CR < 3.15, or LT > 3.3 mm showed faster LP reduction. The slow-progression group exhibited significantly greater annual LP reduction than the rapid-progression group (-0.28 ± 0.44 D vs. -0.03 ± 0.42 D, P = 0.02). Stage-specific analysis showed HAL's strongest regulatory effect on SE and LP occurred during the 3-6 month interval. CONCLUSIONS: We identified nonlinear relationships and critical inflection points between ocular biometrics (AL = 24.0 mm, AL/CR = 3.15, LT = 3.3 mm) and LP. Gender was significantly associated with LP, and AL/CR was superior to AL alone for evaluating lens compensation. AL > 24 mm and AL/CR ≥ 3.15 indicate exhausted lens compensation and rapid myopia progression. HAL provides effective myopia control, and these inflection-based thresholds enable clinical risk stratification and personalized intervention with improved precision and efficacy.

佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜儿童近视进展的预测-1年随访：1年后是否发生明显近视进展进行分析，并利用儿童开始配镜时的临床数据建立预测模型

📖 Optometry and vision science : official publication of the American Academy of Optometry📅 2026年👥 Wang Hui, Ge Yu-Ting, Xu Yue
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-4-8 佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜儿童近视进展的预测-1年随访：1年后是否发生明显近视进展进行分析，并利用儿童开始配镜时的临床数据建立预测模型 研究中心/PI：苏州大学第四附属医院眼科/徐悦 研究时间：2022年1月-2025年1月 研究设计：单中心、回顾性、观察性病例对照研究 随访时间：基线、6个月、12个月 样本量：211eyes 分组：根据近视进展速度：快速进展组（ΔSE≥0.50 D）和缓慢进展组（<0.50 D） 研究指标： 1. 等效球镜度数变化，即近视度数进展； 2. 眼轴等眼部生物测量参数变化； 3. 哪些基线因素能够预测1年内出现明显近视进展。 结果： 1. 基线年龄：年龄越小的儿童，后续出现较快近视进展的风险越高。 2. 基线眼轴：开始佩戴HAL镜片时眼轴越长，1年内出现明显近视进展的可能性越高。 将年龄和眼轴长度纳入预测工具(nomogram)，用于识别佩戴HAL后仍可能进展≥0.50 D的高风险儿童。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-4 效果预测 （包括脉络膜厚度） / 6-4-8
原文摘要
摘要 目的 本研究旨在评估中国儿童佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜后1年内等效球镜度数（spherical equivalent，SE）及眼部生物测量参数的变化，并建立预测模型，以识别发生显著近视进展（≥0.50 D）的高风险儿童。 方法 本研究为一项回顾性病例对照研究，纳入开始佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜并持续1年的儿童，并将其随机分为训练集和验证集。分别在基线、6个月和12个月收集等效球镜度数及眼部生物测量参数。研究建立了Logistic回归（logistic regression，LR）模型，并将其与6种机器学习模型进行比较。采用受试者工作特征曲线下面积、校准度和决策曲线分析（decision curve analysis，DCA）评估模型性能。 结果 在12个月随访期间，快速进展组和缓慢进展组在等效球镜度数及眼部生物测量参数方面呈现出不同的变化趋势。多因素分析显示，基线年龄和基线眼轴长度是仅有的两个显著预测因素。极端梯度提升模型具有最高的判别性能。Logistic回归模型表现出良好的判别能力、可接受的校准度，并且在决策曲线分析中，于较宽的阈值概率范围内显示出临床应用价值。研究进一步基于Logistic回归模型构建了列线图，以直观呈现个体发生显著近视进展的风险。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study aims to examine the 1-year changes in spherical equivalent (SE) refraction and ocular biometric parameters among Chinese children wearing highly aspherical lenslet spectacle and develop a predictive model for identifying children at risk of significant myopic progression (≥0.50 Diopter). METHODS: In this retrospective case-control study, children who started wearing highly aspherical lenslet spectacles for 1 year were enrolled and randomly divided into training and validation sets. Data on SE refraction and ocular biometric parameters were collected at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months. A logistic regression (LR) model was developed and compared with six machine learning models. Model performance was assessed by the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve, calibration, and decision curve analysis (DCA). RESULTS: Over 12 months, the rapid and slow progression groups displayed divergent trends in their SE refraction and ocular biometric parameters. Baseline age and axial length were the only significant predictors in the multivariate analysis. The extreme gradient boosting model achieved the highest discriminative performance. The LR model demonstrated good discrimination, acceptable calibration, and clinical utility across a broad range of threshold probabilities in DCA. A nomogram was developed from the LR model to visualize individual risk. CONCLUSIONS: This study developed practical predictive models to identify children at high risk of rapid myopia progression while wearing highly aspherical lenslet spectacles. These findings provide a clinically applicable, evidence-based tool for personalized myopia management, supporting early stratification and tailored intervention to improve myopia control outcomes in children. However, these results are population-specific and should be cautiously generalized to pediatric cohorts from other ethnic groups or regions.

HALT vs. DIMS vs. DOT vs. MyoCare对视网膜图像对比度影响的比较研究

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2026年👥 Lin Zhenghua, Christaras Dimitrios, Ginis Harilaos, Yang Zhikuan, Lan Weizhong, Artal Pablo
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-5-1： HALT vs. DIMS vs. DOT vs. MyoCare对视网膜图像对比度影响的比较研究 样本量：13名，男性8，平均年龄29.00±3.51岁，平均等效球镜度-1.77±1.77D，右眼 结论：在光线经过近视控制镜片的周边功能区时，视网膜图像对比度会降低，尤其在中心和近周边视野（10°）更明显。降低程度受镜片设计和个体眼部光学影响，其中HALT最明显，MyoCare 和DIMS较接近。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-5 机制探索 / 6-5-1
原文摘要
摘要 目的： 周边离焦和图像对比度调节是近视控制中的关键策略，但二者都会在一定程度上降低视网膜图像对比度。目前尚无体内研究直接比较这些影响。本研究旨在评估不同近视控制眼镜的对比度降低特征，以更好地理解其潜在作用机制。 方法： 研究使用双通道仪器，在模型眼和人眼中获取通过焦点图像，并比较佩戴四种近视控制眼镜时的结果，包括 DIMS、Stellest、扩散光学技术镜片（DOT）和 MyoCare。裸眼作为参考。共测试 13 名受试者，平均年龄为 29.0 ± 3.5 岁；测量位置包括中心凹，以及颞侧和上方视野 10°、20°偏心位置。镜片偏心 1.5 cm，以评估离轴效应。模型眼测试仅包括中心视野。视网膜图像对比度通过通过焦点图像中像素强度的变异系数计算。 结果： 在模型眼中，视网膜图像对比度从高到低依次为：裸眼、DIMS、DOT、MyoCare 和 Stellest。在体内实验中，由于 DOT 信号较弱，其结果被排除。非参数检验显示，不同镜片在中心凹以及颞侧/上方 10°视野处的视网膜图像对比度存在显著差异。事后分析显示，Stellest 产生的视网膜图像对比度降低最明显，而 MyoCare 和 DIMS 表现出相似程度的对比度损失。 结论： 所有近视控制镜片都会降低视网膜图像对比度，其中 Stellest 引起的降低最强，MyoCare 和 DIMS 的影响相近。镜片诱导的光学效应主要影响近周边视野的图像对比度，而在更大偏心位置，人眼自身的光学因素占主导作用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: Peripheral defocus and image contrast modulation are key strategies in myopia control, but both inherently reduce retinal image contrast. To date, no in vivo study has directly compared these effects. This study evaluated the contrast reduction profiles of different myopia control spectacles to better understand their underlying mechanisms. METHODS: Through-focus images (TFIs) were obtained with a double-pass instrument in a model eye and in human eyes wearing four spectacle designs: DIMS, Stellest, diffusion optics technology (DOT), and MyoCare. The naked eye served as a reference. Thirteen participants (mean age = 29.0 ± 3.5 years) were tested at the fovea and at 10° and 20° eccentricities in the temporal and superior fields. Lenses were decentered by 1.5 cm to assess off-axis effects. Model eye tests included only the central field. Retinal image contrast (RIC) was calculated as the coefficient of variation of pixel intensity in TFIs. RESULTS: In the model eye, RIC ranked from highest to lowest as follows: naked eye, DIMS, DOT, MyoCare, and Stellest. In vivo, DOT results were excluded due to a weak signal. A nonparametric test revealed significant differences in RIC among lenses at the fovea (P = 0.009) and at 10° in the temporal/superior fields (P = 0.05). Post hoc analysis showed that Stellest produced the greatest reduction in RIC, whereas MyoCare and DIMS demonstrated similar levels of contrast loss. CONCLUSIONS: All myopia control lenses reduced retinal image contrast, with Stellest inducing the strongest reduction. MyoCare and DIMS showed comparable effects. Lens-induced optics primarily influenced contrast in the near periphery, while ocular optics dominated at larger eccentricities.

光学分析：各类近视防控镜均降低视网膜像对比，Stellest降幅最强，MyoCare与DIMS相近。

Optical influence of myopia control spectacles at the retinal level: Effect of local light modulation

HALT vs DIMS vs DOT vs CARE——视网膜层面光学影响研究

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2025年👥 Kaymak Hakan, Mattern Ann-Isabel, Graff Birte, Devenijn Machteld, Seitz Berthold, Schwahn Hartmut

参考文献 6-5-2 HALT vs DIMS vs DOT vs CARE——视网膜层面光学影响研究 研究中心：Internationale Innovative Ophthalmochirurgie, Breyer Kaymak Klabe Augenchirurgie等；PI/通讯作者：Hakan Kaymak 试验设计简述：试点研究，自身对照 样本量：9人 中央清晰区视网膜敏感度：CARE:29.3 ± 2.8 dB；HALT:28.5 ± 2.4 dB；DIMS:29.1 ± 2.7 dB；DOT:28.8 ± 2.6 dB 周边治疗区视网膜敏感度：CARE:27.9 ± 2.4 dB；HALT:27.9 ± 2.2 dB；DIMS:28.0 ± 2.2 dB；DOT:27.3 ± 2.0 dB 结论：各类近视控制框架镜在中央清晰区未见视网膜敏感度下降，周边治疗区DOT视网膜敏感度出现显著下降，但仍然健康；DIMS 是唯一在局部光调制区内外显示显著敏感度差异的设计。

原文摘要
摘要 目的：探讨当前不同设计的近视控制框架镜所产生的光调制，对视网膜敏感度的影响。 方法：研究者使用 Macular Integrity Assessment（MAIA）微视野仪，对 9 名健康受试者在佩戴当前近视控制框架镜时的视网膜敏感度及扫描激光检眼镜（SLO）眼底图像进行测量。所测试的镜片包括：MyoCare、Stellest、MiYOSMART 和 DOT；相应度数的单光镜片以及 0.8 级 Bangerter 遮挡膜（BF）作为比较对照。 结果：通过 SLO 图像，可以在视网膜层面观察到不同近视控制镜片设计所形成的光调制区域。不同镜片设计的清晰区大小存在差异，其中 DOT 镜片的清晰区最小。在局部光调制区域内，Stellest 和 MyoCare 镜片并未降低视网膜敏感度，而 MiYOSMART 镜片则出现了视网膜敏感度下降，提示其局部光调制作用更为明显。DOT 镜片可导致整体视网膜敏感度显著下降，但这种下降程度仍小于 Bangerter 遮挡膜。在所有情况下，视网膜敏感度均明显高于健康视网膜的正常范围下限。 结论：本研究所测试的镜片均未造成具有临床意义的视网膜敏感度下降，且其结果均显著优于最低等级（即 0.8 级）的 Bangerter 遮挡膜。鉴于目前的近视控制框架镜在长期延缓近视进展方面尚未表现出一致且足够的治疗效果，不同镜片之间在空间光调制方面可能存在细微但关键的差异。对于外观上看似相似的镜片设计，不能想当然地认为其治疗效果等同；必须对这些细微差别进行充分评估，才能准确判断其长期疗效。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate the influence of light modulation conferred by current designs of myopia control spectacles on retinal sensitivity. METHODS: Retinal sensitivity and scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) fundus images were obtained from nine healthy subjects using a Macular Integrity Assessment microperimeter with current myopia control spectacle lenses: MyoCare, Stellest, MiYOSMART and DOT. Respectively powered single vision lenses and a 0.8-grade Bangerter occlusion foil (BF) served as comparative controls. RESULTS: Using the SLO image, one can visualise the areas of light modulation of the various myopia control lens designs at the level of the retina. Clear zone sizes differ between lens designs, with the DOT lens having the smallest area. Retinal sensitivity in areas of local light modulation was not reduced for the Stellest and MyoCare lenses, but declined with the MiYOSMART lens, suggesting a more prominent local light modulation. The DOT lenses produced a significant reduction in overall retinal sensitivity, although the reduction with the BF was greater. In all instances, retinal sensitivity remained well above the range considered normal for a healthy retina. CONCLUSIONS: None of the lenses tested produced a clinically relevant reduction in retinal sensitivity and all scored significantly better than the lowest (that is, 0.8) grade BF. Given that current myopia control spectacles do not show consistent treatment effects as required to slow progression effectively over extended periods, there appears to be a subtle, yet crucial difference in spatial light modulation among these myopia control spectacle lenses. Seemingly similar lens designs cannot be assumed to have equivalent treatment effects; a thorough assessment of these nuances is essential to ensure accurate claims regarding their long-term efficacy.

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2026年👥 Liu Yongji, Hu Xiaoyang, Chen Xiaoqin, Yang Xiaoyan, Liu Dongyu, He Tianrui, Li Lihua
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-5-3 DSDO vs DIMS vs HALT 在不同注视状态（正视与斜视）和瞳孔大小下，3种镜片对视网膜周边屈光度、高阶像差以及视网膜图像对比度的影响 研究中心：南开大学视光科学研究院/李丽华 研究类型：计算机光学仿真与建模研究 研究设计：在电脑软件（Zemax OpticStudio）中，将以下两者数字化并进行“虚拟组装” 镜片的三维数字模型：通过数学多项式输入微透镜的表面矢高（Sag），构建出精确的 SAL（球性微透镜）和 HAL（高非球面微透镜）镜片。 解剖学人眼数字模型：引入国际通用的 Navarro 宽视场眼模型（该模型在电脑中数字化了人眼角膜、前房、晶状体折射率梯度以及周边视网膜的几何形态）。 利用计算机进行虚拟光线追踪（Ray Tracing），通过计算数万条光线的折射轨迹，来定量的模拟出光线穿过镜片后在视网膜周边和中心的成像状态。 结论：1. HAL 具有更强且非线性递增的“近视离焦梯度”：在周边30°视场角下，HAL在周边视网膜前诱导出的近视离焦显着大于SAL 镜片。2. 眼球转动（斜视）时会触发高阶像差的“爆发式激增”。当模拟眼球向周边注视（从0°转向30°）时，穿过微透镜区的光线比例从 0% 飙升至 70% 以上。这导致在周边视网膜上，三阶彗差和球差激增了 3~5 倍。这种由微透镜引入的视网膜图像退化（模糊斑），为“像差信号参与阻断眼轴增长”的假说提供了物理依据。3.大瞳孔（近读/暗光）会不可避免地损害中心视网膜对比度。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-5 机制探索 / 6-5-3
原文摘要
摘要 目的：通过研究微透镜阵列框架眼镜对周边屈光和图像对比度的影响，探讨近视控制效果背后潜在的光学线索。 方法：在 Zemax OpticStudio 中重建了三款商业微透镜阵列框架眼镜——MiyoSmart（新乐学）、Stellest（星趣控）以及多区正向离焦镜片，并以传统单光（SV）镜片作为对照。在对镜片模型进行实验验证后，将重建的镜片与 Navarro 眼模型结合，以模拟实际的眼镜佩戴情况。在远距离和近距离视物（调节滞后量分别为 0.50 屈光度 [D] 和 1.00 D）的条件下评估了其光学性能。通过波前数据推导得出周边屈光成分（M 和 J0）。获取了点扩散函数（PSF）和调制传递函数（MTF），并随后计算了调制传递函数曲线下的面积。 结果：模拟和实验的点扩散函数表现出高度一致性，证实了所构建眼镜模型的可靠性。与单光镜片相比，微透镜阵列引入了 M 值的波动（在 ±0.25 D 以内），表现为相对于单光镜片基线的正负交替漂移。只有 Stellest 镜片在有限的离心率范围内表现出轻微的近视离焦，而其他设计未能诱导周边近视离焦。在水平子午线 12.5° 至 17.5° 离心率之间，微透镜阵列镜片在低空间频率（≤6 周期/度）下对比度有所降低，但在高空间频率（9–15 周期/度）下截止频率有所提高且对比度相对增强。在 0.50 D 调节滞后的近距离视物情况下，也观察到了类似的模式。 结论：微透镜阵列镜片的近视控制疗效可能无法完全用周边近视离焦假说来解释。相反，观察到的低空间频率对比度下降，结合能够保留高频信息的截止频率提升，可能会为减缓近视进展提供关键的光学线索。这些假设的机制仍需进一步的临床研究来证实。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate potential optical cues underlying myopia control effects by examining how lenslet-array spectacle lenses influence peripheral refraction and image contrast. METHODS: Three commercial lenslet-array spectacle lenses-MiyoSmart, Stellest, and diverse segmented defocus optics-were reconstructed in Zemax OpticStudio, together with a conventional single vision (SV) lens as a reference. The reconstructed lenses were coupled with the Navarro eye model to simulate spectacle wearing after experimental validation of the lens models. Optical performance was evaluated under both distance and near viewing conditions with accommodative lags of 0.50 diopters (D) and 1.00 D. Peripheral refraction components (M and J0) were derived from wavefront data. Point spread functions and modulation transfer functions were obtained, with the area under the modulation transfer function curve subsequently calculated. RESULTS: Simulated and experimental point spread functions showed strong agreement, confirming the reliability of the constructed spectacle models. Compared with the SV lens, the lenslet-array introduced M fluctuations (within ±0.25 D), manifesting as alternating positive and negative shifts relative to the SV baseline. Only the Stellest lens exhibited minimal myopic defocus over a limited eccentricity range, while the other designs failed to induce peripheral myopic defocus. In the horizontal meridian between 12.5° and 17.5° eccentricity, lenslet-array lenses exhibited reduced contrast at low spatial frequencies (≤6 cycles/degree) but increased cutoff frequencies and relatively enhanced contrast at higher frequencies (9-15 cycles/degree). Similar patterns were observed under near viewing with a 0.50 D accommodative lag. CONCLUSIONS: The myopia control efficacy of lenslet-array lenses may not be fully explained by the peripheral myopic defocus hypothesis. Instead, the observed reduction in low spatial frequency contrast, coupled with an elevated cutoff frequency that preserves high-frequency information, may provide the critical optical cues for slowing myopia progression. These hypothesized mechanisms warrant further clinical investigation.

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2026年👥 Ye Zhiqiang, Zhang Huayu, Luo Yifan, Fang Xiao, Chen Hao, Bao Jinhua
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-5-4 DOT vs HAL，DOT镜片通过“重塑对比度极性（增强OFF通路）”来抗近视；而HAL镜片则通过“光学离焦”来抗近视。 研究类型：基于大规模公开数据库的二次观察性研究 研究设计：首先构建53,620 张图像数据集，包括：自然环境（Natural, n=20,000）：选自 Places365 数据库中的森林、竹林、雨林和瀑布场景。城市环境（Urban, n=18,000）：选自 Mapillary Vistas 数据库的多样化城市街景。室内环境（Indoor, n=15,620）：选自 MIT Indoor Scenes 数据库，包含 67 个不同的室内子场景（如教室、卧室、托儿所等） 运用线性化与灰度转换、尺寸调整与抗锯齿和视场标准化来构建图像处理程序，以此标化不同图像并提高数据集的可比性。 使用智能手机荣耀（Magic5 Pro，27mm 等效焦距，f/1.6）在相同室内外场景下，加装与不加装HAL镜片/DOT镜片/0.4密度Bangerter 柔光膜进行实拍对比来验证环境统计学假设。 结论：1.环境类型的对比度极性显著差异。自然环境表现出强烈的“OFF 对比度主导性“，室内人造环境的 OFF 占比显著降低。 2.室内场景的OFF对比度极性存在场景差异。低OFF占比-近视风险高发地：托儿所/幼儿园，病房，浴室；高OFF占比：电影院，火车站。 3.光学干预镜片对对比度极性有重塑作用。DOT镜片在低空间频率（0.5 cpd）下具有显著增强室内环境负对比度（OFF比例）的效应，而HAL镜片对图像的对比度极性（ON/OFF比例）几乎没有明显的改变效应。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-5 机制探索 / 6-5-4
原文摘要
摘要 目的：户外暴露已被证实有助于预防近视；然而，仅靠低空间频率暴露并不能完全解释近视风险。本研究旨在探讨室内环境与自然环境之间的对比度极性差异。 方法：共有来自麻省理工学院室内场景（MIT Indoor Scenes）、Mapillary Vistas 和 Places365 数据库的 53,620 张图像被分类为自然、城市或室内环境（并进行了进一步细分）。在 0.5、2 和 6 cpd的空间频率下进行高斯差分（DoG）滤波后，通过计算正对比度（ON）和负对比度（OFF）像素的比例来量化局部对比度极性。此外，还评估了加装 0.4 密度 Bangerter 柔光膜、高度非球面微透镜（HAL）镜片以及扩散光学技术（DOT）镜片后的图像特征。 结果：自然环境表现出高水平的 OFF 比例（在 0.5 cpd 下为 0.555；2 cpd 下为 0.559；6 cpd 下为 0.555）。在所有频率下，室内环境的 OFF 主导地位均显著较低（0.5 cpd 下为 0.536；2 cpd 下为 0.533；6 cpd 下为 0.531；所有 p < 0.001）。在室内场景中，OFF 比例在 0.5 cpd 下以托儿所最低（0.493），在 2 cpd 下以病房最低（0.505），在 6 cpd 下以浴室最低（0.508）。降低对比度的光学干预手段增加了室内环境在 0.5 cpd 下的 OFF 比例，其增加幅度具有场景依赖性；然而，这种效应在较高的空间频率下会逐渐减弱。 结论：这些研究结果强调，人工建筑环境（特别是特定的室内子场景）比自然环境表现出更低的 OFF 比例。在室内增强低频负对比度可能会为近视预防和公共卫生计划提供指导。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: Outdoor exposure has been shown to help protect against myopia; however, low spatial frequency exposure alone cannot fully explain myopia risk. This study aimed to explore contrast polarity differences between indoor and natural environments. METHODS: A total of 53,620 images from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology Indoor Scenes, Mapillary Vistas and Places365 databases were categorised as natural, urban or indoor (with further subdivisions). Local contrast polarity was quantified by calculating the proportions of positive-contrast (ON) and negative-contrast (OFF) pixels after Difference-of-Gaussians filtering at 0.5, 2 and 6 cycles per degree (cpd). Additionally, image features with a 0.4 Bangerter foil, highly aspherical lenslets lens and diffusion optics technology (DOT) lens were also evaluated. RESULTS: Natural environments exhibited high OFF proportions (0.555 at 0.5 cpd; 0.559 at 2 cpd and 0.555 at 6 cpd). Indoor environments had lower OFF dominance (0.536 at 0.5 cpd; 0.533 at 2 cpd and 0.531 at 6 cpd) across all frequencies (all p < 0.001). Among indoor subscenes, the OFF proportion was lowest in the nursery at 0.5 cpd (0.493), in the hospital room at 2 cpd (0.505) and in the bathroom at 6 cpd (0.508). Contrast-reducing optical interventions increased indoor OFF proportions at 0.5 cpd with scene-dependent magnitudes; however, this effect diminished at higher spatial frequencies. CONCLUSION: These findings underscore that built environments, particularly specific indoor subscenes, exhibit lower OFF proportions than natural environments. Enhancing low-frequency negative contrast indoors may guide myopia prevention and public health initiatives.

原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：本研究旨在评估近视控制眼镜片中三种不同微透镜结构的短期视觉表现与光学质量。 材料与方法：本研究采用交叉设计。对 50 名近视儿童进行远视力（VA）测量，对 36 名近视儿童进行对比敏感度（CS）测量。每项测试均按随机顺序评估四种眼镜片：单光镜片（SVL）、带高度非球面微透镜同心环的镜片（HAL）、带轻度非球面微透镜同心环的镜片（SAL）以及带球面微透镜蜂窝结构的镜片（HC）。采用调制传递函数（MTF）及 MTF 面积（MTFa）评估光学质量。所有测试均在充分矫正屈光不正的情况下，对右眼进行单眼测试。 结果：HAL 与 SAL 的 MTFa 大于 HC。与 SVL 相比，含微透镜的镜片其视力（VA）显著下降（均 p<0.01）。其中，HC 导致的 VA 下降程度较 SAL（p=0.02）和 HAL（p=0.03）更显著；未发现微透镜非球面度对 VA 有影响（p>0.05）。微透镜引起的 VA 变化与等效球镜度数无相关性（均 p>0.05）；在 SAL（相关系数 r=0.36，p=0.01）和 HC（r=0.31，p=0.03）组中，VA 变化与年龄呈弱正相关，而 HAL 组无此相关性（p=0.30）。在所有光照条件下，HAL 和 HC 组的对数对比敏感度函数下面积（AULCSF）均下降（均 p<0.001）；在明视觉条件下，HAL 组的 AULCSF 高于 HC 组（1.17±0.10 vs. 1.10±0.13，p=0.0004）。微透镜的存在对 3 周 / 度（cpd）空间频率下的对比敏感度（CS）无影响（p=0.80）。在 6~18 cpd 空间频率下，与 SVL 相比，HAL 和 HC 显著降低 CS（均 p<0.05），而 SAL 无此效应（p>0.05）。在高空间频率（>12 cpd）下，SAL 和 HAL 对 CS 的降低程度均显著小于 HC（均 p<0.01）。 结论：通过近视控制眼镜片的微透镜结构视物时，短期视觉表现仅受到轻微影响。与带球面微透镜的蜂窝结构相比，带非球面微透镜的同心环结构对视力（VA）和对比敏感度（CS）的影响均显著更小。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
Purpose: This study aimed to evaluate short-term visual performance and optical quality of three different lenslet configurations on myopia control spectacle lenses. Materials and Methods: This study utilized a cross-over design. Distance visual acuity (VA) was measured in 50 myopic children; contrast sensitivity (CS) was measured in 36 myopic children. For each test, four spectacle lenses were evaluated in a random order: single-vision lens (SVL), lens with concentric rings of highly aspherical lenslets (HAL), lens with concentric rings of slightly aspherical lenslets (SAL), and lens with honeycomb configuration of spherical lenslets (HC). The modulation transfer function (MTF) and MTF area (MTFa) were used to determine optical quality. All tests were performed monocularly on the right eye with full correction. Results: HAL and SAL had larger MTFa than HC. VA in lenses with lenslets was significantly reduced compared to SVL (all p < 0.01). The reduction in VA was worse with HC than with SAL (p = 0.02) and HAL (p = 0.03); no effect of lenslet asphericity was found (p > 0.05). VA changes induced by lenslets showed no correlation with spherical equivalent refraction (all p > 0.05) and were weakly positively associated with age for SAL (r = 0.36, p = 0.01) and HC (r = 0.31, p = 0.03), but not for HAL (p = 0.30). The area under the log contrast sensitivity function (AULCSF) decreased with HAL and HC (all p < 0.001) in all illumination levels, and AULCSF with HAL was higher than that with HC in a photopic condition (1.17 ± 0.10 vs. 1.10 ± 0.13, p = 0.0004). The presence of lenslets did not affect CS at 3 cycles per degree (cpd) (p = 0.80). At 6 to 18 cpd, CS was significantly reduced by HAL and HC (all p < 0.05), but not SAL (p > 0.05) compared to SVL. At high spatial frequencies (>12 cpd) both SAL and HAL reduced CS significantly less than HC (all p < 0.01). Conclusion: Short-term visual performance was minimally impaired by looking through the lenslet structure of myopia control spectacle lenses. Concentric rings with aspherical lenslets had a significantly lower impact on both VA and CS than honeycomb configuration with spherical lenslets.

HAL vs SAL-对视觉功能的影响

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2021年👥 Gao Yi, Lim Ee Woon, Yang Adeline, Drobe Björn, Bullimore Mark A
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-2
原文摘要
摘要 目的：含多个小型周边光学元件的镜片已被研发用于儿童近视控制。通过以下两种方式量化其对视觉的影响具有重要意义：（1）通过镜片周边区域注视，即利用中心凹视力；（2）通过镜片中心区域注视并呈现周边目标。 方法：采用上述两种方式开展 5 项研究，评估两种新型镜片设计：高非球面微透镜镜片（HAL）和低非球面微透镜镜片（SAL），以单光镜片作为对照。每项研究均纳入视觉功能正常的成人受试者。前两项研究要求受试者通过镜片周边区域注视，采用Freiburg Vision Test测量高对比度及低对比度（10%）视力，采用句子生成器测量高对比度及低对比度文字的阅读速度。另外三项研究在受试者通过镜片中心区域注视的情况下评估周边视觉功能：采用每度 2 周波的drifting Gabor stimuli 测量周边对比敏感度，采用随机点刺激进一步评估周边运动知觉，最后采用已验证的、含三个复杂程度等级的有效视野测试（useful field of view test）测量注意力。 结果：HAL 镜片的周边区域显著降低低对比视力，但对高对比视力无显著影响；SAL 镜片对两种对比度视力均无显著影响。两种测试镜片均未影响高对比度文字的阅读速度，但 HAL 镜片显著影响低对比度文字的阅读表现。两种测试镜片均未影响周边运动知觉或有效视野。 结论：通过新型镜片的周边区域注视时，低对比视力及阅读速度略有下降，而高对比视力未受影响。新型镜片设计未对任何周边视觉功能测量指标产生影响。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: Spectacle lenses containing multiple small peripheral elements have been developed for myopia control in children. It is important that their effect on vision be quantified by (i) fixation through the peripheral portion, thereby using foveal vision and (ii) by fixation through the central portion and presentation of peripheral targets. METHODS: The above approaches were used in five studies to evaluate two novel spectacle lens designs: spectacle lenses with Highly Aspherical Lenslets (HAL) and Slightly Aspherical Lenslets (SAL). A single vision lens served as a control. Visually normal adults participated in each study. The first two studies had subjects fixate through the periphery of the lenses. High and low (10%) contrast visual acuity was measured with the Freiburg Vision Test and reading speed for high and low contrast words measured with a sentence generator. The other three studies assessed peripheral vision while subjects fixated through the central portion of the lens. Peripheral contrast sensitivity was measured using two cycles per degree drifting Gabor stimuli. Peripheral motion perception was further evaluated using random dot stimuli. Finally, attention was measured using an established test of useful field of view with three levels of complexity. RESULTS: The periphery of the HAL lens significantly reduced low contrast visual acuity, but not high contrast visual acuity, while the effect of the SAL lens was not significant for either. Neither test lens affected reading speed for high contrast words, but the HAL lens significantly affected performance for low contrast words. Neither test lens affected peripheral motion perception or useful field of view. CONCLUSIONS: Low contrast visual acuity and reading was slightly reduced while high contrast visual acuity was unaffected when fixating through the periphery of the novel lens designs. None of the peripheral measures of vision was affected by the novel lens designs.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-3
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：含周边微透镜的近视控制眼镜片因具有非侵入性且易于管理的特点，正逐渐得到广泛应用，目前进行的临床试验也显示出良好前景。本研究旨在评估眼睛斜向通过微透镜时，周边视力及周边注视状态下的中心视力（VA）表现。 研究方法：在 300 cm、10 lx光照条件下，测量 100% 高对比度视力。每项测试均以平衡顺序评估两种镜片设计：含高非球面微透镜（HALs）的眼镜片和标准单光镜片（SVL）。目标屏幕置于右眼鼻侧 21.6° 视角处。16 名成年人（年龄 27-52 岁；等效球镜度数（SER）-8.75 屈光度至 + 0.50 屈光度）佩戴自身常规视力矫正装置，以单眼方式完成所有测试。 研究结果：通过单光镜片（SVL）和高非球面微透镜（HAL）镜片进行周边注视时，中心视力均值（标准差）分别为 0.08（0.13）对数最小分辨角视力和 0.17（0.12）对数最小分辨角视力。与单光镜片相比，高非球面微透镜镜片使周边注视时的中心视力下降 0.10（0.08）对数最小分辨角视力（p=0.03）。未发现高非球面微透镜镜片的影响与年龄、等效球镜度数等其他因素存在显著相关性。两种镜片的周边视力无显著差异（单光镜片和高非球面微透镜镜片分别为 1.09（0.06）对数最小分辨角视力和 1.09（0.09）对数最小分辨角视力；p=0.86）。 研究结论：在高对比度、低光照条件下，与单光镜片（SVL）相比，高非球面微透镜（HAL）镜片使周边注视时的中心视力下降约 1 行。该镜片对中心视力的影响不受注视方向、年龄或等效球镜度数的影响。在此实验条件下，高非球面微透镜镜片对周边视力无影响。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: Myopia control spectacle lenses with peripheral lenslets are gaining popularity because they are non-invasive and easy to manage, and ongoing clinical trials have shown promising results. This study aimed to evaluate peripheral and central visual acuity (VA) with peripheral gaze in conditions where the eyes are turned to look obliquely through the lenslets. METHODS: High-contrast (100%) VA was measured at 300 cm and 10 lx. For each test, two lens designs were evaluated in counterbalanced order: a spectacle lens with highly aspherical lenslets (HALs) and a standard single-vision lens (SVL). The target screen was placed at a visual angle of 21.6° to the nasal side of the right eye. Sixteen adults (27-52 years of age; spherical equivalent refraction (SER), -8.75 D to +0.50 D) wearing their habitual visual correction performed all tests monocularly. RESULTS: Mean (SD) central VAs with peripheral gaze through the SVL and the HAL lens were 0.08 (0.13) and 0.17 (0.12) logMAR, respectively. The HAL lens reduced central VA with peripheral gaze by 0.10 (0.08) logMAR (p = 0.03). No significant correlation was observed between the impact of the HAL lens and other factors, such as age or SER. Peripheral VA was not significantly different through the two lenses (1.09 (0.06) logMAR and 1.09 (0.09) logMAR for the SVL and the HAL lens, respectively; p = 0.86). CONCLUSIONS: Under high-contrast and low-luminance conditions, the HAL lens reduced central VA with peripheral gaze by approximately one line compared with the SVL. The impact on central VA did not vary with gaze direction, age or SER. The HAL lens did not affect peripheral VA in this condition.

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-4 HAL vs SVL 对静态自动视野检查中视觉敏感度的影响 结论：与SVL相比，HAL未改变 30° 偏心度范围内整个视野中对静态视标的检测敏感度。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-4
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：带有微透镜阵列的眼镜镜片因其有效性高、对视觉功能影响小且具有无创性，在近视控制领域得到广泛应用。关于其对视觉功能的影响，目前仍存在一个待解答的问题：这些微透镜是否会影响视野敏感度？本研究旨在探讨佩戴高非球面微透镜（HAL）眼镜对视野敏感度的影响。 研究方法：本研究采用自动静态视野检查（Goldman perimeter target III）测量视野中的检测敏感度。视标为不同亮度水平的白色光点，尺寸为 0.43°，在 30° 偏心度范围内的 76 个位置随机出现。21 名成年受试者（年龄 23-61 岁，等效球镜度数（SER）为 - 8.75 D 至 + 0.88 D）参与了本研究。研究以高非球面微透镜（HAL）和单光镜片（SVL，作为对照条件）为两种测试镜片，按随机顺序测量受试者通过这两种镜片的视觉敏感度。 研究结果：在 76 个测试位置中，HAL 与 SVL 之间的平均敏感度差异介于 - 1.14 分贝（dB）至 1.28 dB 之间。仅在颞侧视野 30° 处的一个位置，差异具有统计学意义（p<0.00065），且通过 HAL 测量的敏感度在此位置提高了 1.1 dB。敏感度差异与年龄或等效球镜度数（SER）之间未发现显著相关性。这种差异在临床上不太可能具有相关性。 研究结论：与单光镜片（SVL）相比，高非球面微透镜（HAL）未改变 30° 偏心度范围内整个视野中对静态视标的检测敏感度。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: Spectacle lenses with arrays of lenslets have gained popularity in myopia control due to their high efficacy, low impact on visual performance, and non-invasiveness. One of the questions regarding their impact on visual performance that still remain is that: do the lenslets impact visual field sensitivity? The current study aims to investigate the impact of wearing spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) on the visual field sensitivity. METHODS: An automated static perimetry test (Goldman perimeter target III) was employed to measure the detection sensitivity in the visual field. Targets were white light dots of various luminance levels and size 0.43°, randomly appearing at 76 locations within 30° eccentricity. Twenty-one adult subjects (age 23-61, spherical equivalent refractive error (SER) -8.75 D to +0.88 D) participated in the study. Sensitivities through two lenses, HAL and a single vision lens (SVL) as the control condition, were measured in random order. RESULTS: The mean sensitivity differences between HAL and SVL across the 76 tested locations ranged between -1.14 decibels (dB) and 1.28 dB. Only one location at 30° in the temporal visual field reached statistical significance (p < 0.00065) whereby the sensitivity increased by 1.1 dB with HAL. No significant correlation was found between the difference in sensitivity and age or SER. Such a difference is unlikely to be clinically relevant. CONCLUSION: Compared to the SVL, the HAL did not change detection sensitivity to static targets in the whole visual field within 30° eccentricity.

摘要 目的：利用随机对照临床试验数据，探讨含高非球面微透镜（HAL）和低非球面微透镜（SAL）的近视控制框架眼镜对视觉功能和视觉质量的短期及长期影响。 方法：本研究为前瞻性、随机、对照、双盲研究；170 名 8-13 岁近视儿童被随机分为 HAL 组、SAL 组和单焦点框架眼镜（SVL）组。分别在佩戴镜片 10 分钟、6 个月和 12 个月后，测量明视和暗视条件下高（100%）、低（10%）对比度的远、近视力（VA），以及近距隐斜、立体视敏度、调节滞后、调节微波动（AMFs）和调节幅度（AA）。 结果：共 161 名受试者完成 12 个月全部随访并纳入分析。佩戴 10 分钟后，HAL 组和 SAL 组的暗视视力及低对比视力低于 SVL 组（HAL 组和 SAL 组不同视力指标分别下降 0.03-0.08 logMAR 和 0.01-0.04 logMAR，均 P<0.05）。12 个月时，HAL 组和 SAL 组视力显著改善，视力下降情况得以恢复，三组间视力无显著差异（均 P>0.05）。HAL 组和 SAL 组的调节微波动（AMFs）显著大于 SVL 组（基线期：HAL 组 vs.SAL 组 vs.SVL 组 = 0.21±0.08 D vs.0.16±0.05 D vs.0.15±0.06 D；12 个月时：0.19±0.07 D vs.0.17±0.05 D vs.0.13±0.07 D，均 P<0.05）。三组间调节滞后、调节幅度（AA）及隐斜均无显著差异（均 P>0.05）。基线期，HAL 组和 SAL 组的立体视敏度低于 SVL 组（70’ vs.60’ vs.50’，P=0.005），但 12 个月时三组间无显著差异（70’ vs.70’ vs.70’，P=0.11）。 结论：除调节微波动（AMF）大于 SVL 外，HAL 和 SAL 对调节功能和隐斜无显著影响。短期佩戴 HAL 和 SAL 会导致暗视视力和低对比视力下降，但佩戴 1 年后可恢复至与 SVL 相当的水平。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
OBJECTIVES: To investigate the short- and long-term effects of myopia control spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) and slightly aspherical lenslets (SAL) on visual function and visual quality using data obtained from a randomized controlled clinical trial. METHODS: This was a prospective, randomized, controlled, and double-blinded study; 170 myopic children aged 8-13 years were randomly assigned to the HAL, SAL, or single-vision spectacle lenses (SVL) groups. Distance and near visual acuity (VA) at high (100%) and low (10%) contrast in photopic and scotopic conditions, near phoria, stereoacuity, and accommodative lag, microfluctuations (AMFs), amplitude (AA) were measured after wearing lenses for 10 min, 6 months, and 12 months. RESULTS: In total, 161 subjects completed all follow-up in 12 months and were included in the analysis. After 10 min of wearing, the HAL and SAL groups had lower scotopic and low-contrast VA than the SVL group (decreased 0.03-0.08 logMAR and 0.01-0.04 logMAR in different VAs in the HAL and SAL groups, respectively, all P < 0.05). The reduction in VA was recovered at 12 months as the HAL and SAL groups exhibited significant VA improvements, and the VA was not different among the three groups (all P > 0.05). The HAL and SAL groups had significantly larger AMFs than the SVL group (HAL vs. SAL vs. SVL: 0.21 ± 0.08 D vs. 0.16 ± 0.05 D vs. 0.15 ± 0.06 D at baseline, 0.19 ± 0.07 D vs. 0.17 ± 0.05 D vs. 0.13 ± 0.07 D at 12 months, all P < 0.05). There were no significant differences in accommodative lag, AA, or phoria between the groups (all P > 0.05). The HAL and SAL groups had reduced stereoacuity compared to the SVL group at baseline (70' vs. 60' vs. 50', P = 0.005), but no difference was observed at 12 months (70' vs. 70' vs. 70', P = 0.11). CONCLUSIONS: HAL and SAL have no significant influence on accommodation and phoria except had larger AMF than SVL. Scotopic VA and low-contrast VA are reduced with short-term HAL and SAL use but recovered to be at same level with the SVL after 1 year of use. Trial registration Chinese Clinical Trial Registry: ChiCTR1800017683. Registered on 9 August 2018. http://www.chictr.org.cn/showproj.aspx?proj=29789.
