HAL vs SVL对间歇性外斜视近视儿童双眼视觉的影响

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2022年👥 Fengchao Zhou, Xue Li, Yingying Huang, Yuhao Li, Jiali Zhang, Hao Chen, Jinhua Bao
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-6 HAL vs SVL对间歇性外斜视近视儿童双眼视觉的影响 样本量：40人（20人IXT，20人正常视力，两组随机顺序佩戴HAL和SVL） 结论：IXT组—HAL与SVL在双眼视觉参数上无显著差异 ； 视力正常组—双眼视觉参数无显著差异 ；但IXT和视力正常组在AMF方面显著增加
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-6
原文摘要
摘要 目的：评估高非球面微透镜框架眼镜（HAL）对合并间歇性外斜视（IXT）近视儿童双眼视功能及调节功能的影响，并比较合并与未合并 IXT 的近视儿童佩戴 HAL 后双眼视功能及调节功能的变化差异。 方法：纳入 40 名 8~12 岁近视儿童，其中 20 名合并 IXT，20 名视力正常。受试者先适应 20 分钟，随后以随机顺序佩戴 HAL 或单光框架眼镜（SVL），分别测量其立体视功能、隐斜度、调节灵活度、融合聚散力、聚散灵活度、集合近点、调节幅度及调节反应（AR）。调节微波动（AMF）定义为 AR 的标准差。比较两组儿童佩戴 HAL 后双眼视功能及调节功能的变化情况。 结果：两组儿童佩戴 HAL 与 SVL 后的双眼视功能均无显著差异（均 P>0.05）。两组佩戴 HAL 后的 AMF 均大于佩戴 SVL 时（IXT 组：0.04 D，95% 置信区间（CI）：0.03~0.05 D，P<0.001；视力正常组：0.05 D，95% CI：0.03~0.07 D，P<0.001）；但其他调节参数无显著变化（均 P>0.05）。两组儿童佩戴 HAL 后各参数的变化量无显著差异（均 P>0.05）。 结论：短期内，除 AMF 外，HAL 对合并与未合并 IXT 的近视儿童的双眼视功能及调节功能无显著影响。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate the influence of spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) on binocular vision and accommodation in myopic children with intermittent exotropia (IXT) and compare the changes after wearing HAL in binocular vision and accommodation in myopic children with or without IXT. METHOD: Forty myopic subjects aged 8-12 years were recruited: 20 with IXT and 20 visually normal children. Stereoacuity, phoria, accommodative facility, fusional vergence, vergence facility, near point of convergence, amplitude of accommodation, and accommodative response (AR) were measured by wearing HAL or single vision spectacle lenses (SVL) in a random order after adapting for 20 minutes. Accommodative microfluctuation (AMF) was defined as the standard deviation of AR. Changes in binocular vision and accommodation after wearing HAL were compared between the two groups. RESULTS: No significant differences were found in binocular vision after wearing HAL versus SVL in either group (all P > 0.05). A greater AMF was found after wearing HAL than after wearing SVL in both groups (0.04 D, 95% confidence interval (CI), 0.03 to 0.05 D, P < 0.001 for the IXT group; 0.05 D, 95% CI, 0.03 to 0.07 D, P < 0.001 for the visually normal group); however, the other accommodation parameters did not change significantly (all P > 0.05). There were no differences in the changes after wearing HAL in any parameter between the two groups (all P > 0.05). CONCLUSION: HAL did not significantly change the binocular vision and accommodation for myopic children with or without IXT except for AMF in the short term.

Spectacles with highly aspherical lenslets for myopia control do not change visual sensitivity in automated static perimetry

高度非球面透镜对静态视野检测中的视觉敏感度影响

📖 Frontiers in neuroscience📅 2022年👥 Gao Yi, Spiegel Daniel P, Muzahid Izzah Al Ilma, Lim Ee Woon, Drobe Björn
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-7高度非球面透镜对静态视野检测中的视觉敏感度影响 样本量：21人(同一受试者在不同时间点分别佩戴SVL和HAL) 结论：高度非球面微透镜阵列镜片（HAL）在30°偏心度内不影响静态视野敏感度。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-7
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：微透镜阵列近视控制眼镜因矫治效果佳、对视觉功能影响小且无创的特点，在近视防控领域得到广泛应用。目前，关于该类镜片对视觉功能的影响仍存一个待解问题：微透镜是否会影响视野敏感度？本研究旨在探讨佩戴高非球面微透镜（HAL）眼镜对视野敏感度的影响。 研究方法：采用自动静态视野检查法（Goldman perimeter target III）检测视野的察觉敏感度，检测视标为不同亮度等级的白色光点，视角为 0.43°，在视野偏心度 30° 范围内的 76 个位点随机出现。21 名成年受试者参与本研究，年龄 23~61 岁，等效球镜屈光度数（SER）为 - 8.75 D 至 + 0.88 D。以高非球面微透镜眼镜为测试组，单光镜（SVL）为对照组，采用随机顺序检测受试者佩戴两种镜片后的视野敏感度。 研究结果：在 76 个检测位点中，受试者佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜与单光镜的平均敏感度差值在 - 1.14 分贝（dB）至 1.28 分贝之间。仅在颞侧视野 30° 的一个位点，敏感度差异具有统计学意义（p<0.00065），佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜后该位点的敏感度提升了 1.1 分贝。敏感度差值与受试者的年龄、等效球镜屈光度数均无显著相关性，且该差值不具备临床意义。 研究结论：与单光镜相比，高非球面微透镜眼镜未改变受试者在视野偏心度 30° 范围内对静态视标的察觉敏感度。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: Spectacle lenses with arrays of lenslets have gained popularity in myopia control due to their high efficacy, low impact on visual performance, and non-invasiveness. One of the questions regarding their impact on visual performance that still remain is that: do the lenslets impact visual field sensitivity? The current study aims to investigate the impact of wearing spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) on the visual field sensitivity. METHODS: An automated static perimetry test (Goldman perimeter target III) was employed to measure the detection sensitivity in the visual field. Targets were white light dots of various luminance levels and size 0.43°, randomly appearing at 76 locations within 30° eccentricity. Twenty-one adult subjects (age 23-61, spherical equivalent refractive error (SER) -8.75 D to +0.88 D) participated in the study. Sensitivities through two lenses, HAL and a single vision lens (SVL) as the control condition, were measured in random order. RESULTS: The mean sensitivity differences between HAL and SVL across the 76 tested locations ranged between -1.14 decibels (dB) and 1.28 dB. Only one location at 30° in the temporal visual field reached statistical significance (p < 0.00065) whereby the sensitivity increased by 1.1 dB with HAL. No significant correlation was found between the difference in sensitivity and age or SER. Such a difference is unlikely to be clinically relevant. CONCLUSION: Compared to the SVL, the HAL did not change detection sensitivity to static targets in the whole visual field within 30° eccentricity.

The Impactof Myopia Control Spectacle Lens Designs on Visual Function

HALT&DIMS&DOT 对视觉功能的影响

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2026年👥 Desiato Alfredo, Lam Hiu Yan, Anand Reena Rani, Chatha Inderjit, Logan Nicola S, Sheppard Amy L, Wolffsohn James S, Laughton Deborah, Davies Leon N
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-8HALT&DIMS&DOT 对视觉功能的影响 研究设计：前瞻性、双盲、四组随机交叉研究 样本量：20人 结论：DOT在高对比度视力和阅读速度上与SVL表现相当，而HAL和DIMS在所有测试条件下均显示出周边视力下降，尤其是在低对比度和低光照条件下，DIMS在近视力阈值和临界字体大小方面表现最差。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-8
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：分析调焦离焦型与调对比型近视控制眼镜片干预措施对视觉功能产生的即时影响。 研究方法：本研究为前瞻性、单次就诊、双盲、四组随机交叉试验，选取经隐形眼镜矫正的健康近视青年受试者（等效球镜度数均值为 - 4.25 至 - 0.50 屈光度），让其分别佩戴扩散光学技术镜片（DOT）、多段离焦设计镜片（DIMS）、高非球面微透镜镜片（HAL）以及标准单光平光试验镜片（SV）。通过镜片的中心区域（CZ）和 / 或周边区域（PZ），对受试者的中心凹进行远、近距高 / 低对比视力（VA）、对比敏感度、阅读能力、调节灵活度、视觉搜索任务表现及调节精度的检测。 研究结果：本研究共招募 20 名受试者（16 名女性），平均年龄为 22.4±2.72 岁，等效球镜度数均值为 - 2.21±1.10 屈光度。近视控制镜片与单光镜片通过周边区域检测的视力存在显著差异：高非球面微透镜镜片和多段离焦设计镜片在所有检测条件下的视力均更低（所有 p 值均 <0.05），而扩散光学技术镜片在高对比视标下的视力与单光镜片相当。所有镜片通过中心区域检测的对比敏感度均出现不同程度下降，其中高非球面微透镜镜片和多段离焦设计镜片通过周边区域检测的对比敏感度显著差于单光镜片和扩散光学技术镜片（p<0.01）。单光镜片、扩散光学技术镜片和高非球面微透镜镜片通过周边区域检测的近视力阈值、阅读速度及临界印刷字体大小均无显著差异（所有 p 值均> 0.05），而多段离焦设计镜片的近视力阈值和临界印刷字体大小表现更差（p<0.001）。各镜片在错误评分（p=0.53）、调节灵活度重新调焦周期（所有 p 值均 > 0.05）及视觉搜索时长（中心区域：p=0.68；周边区域：p=0.35）方面均无显著差异。所有镜片的调节反应无明显差别（所有 p 值均 > 0.05）；但单光镜片通过周边区域检测的远距调节变异性显著低于扩散光学技术镜片、高非球面微透镜镜片和多段离焦设计镜片（p<0.001）。 研究结论：三款近视控制镜片通过中心区域检测的视觉表现均与标准单光镜片相当。临床医师应关注不同镜片的视觉表现差异，尤其是通过镜片周边区域检测的视力、阅读速度及相关检测指标的区别。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To profile the immediate effect of defocus-modulating and contrast-modulating myopia control spectacle lens interventions on visual function. METHODS: Healthy myopic (mean spherical equivalent (MSE) -4.25 to -0.50 D) young adults, corrected with contact lenses, wore diffusion optics technology (DOT), defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS), highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) and standard single vision (SV) plano trial spectacle lenses, in a prospective, single-visit, double-blind, four-way randomised crossover study. Distance and near high- and low-contrast visual acuity (VA), contrast sensitivity, reading performance, accommodative facility, visual search task and accommodative accuracy were assessed foveally through the central zone (CZ) and/or peripheral zone (PZ) of the lenses. RESULTS: Twenty participants (16 female) were recruited, with a mean (±SD) age of 22.4 (±2.72) years and MSE -2.21 (±1.10) D. VAs through the PZ differed significantly between myopia control lenses and SV, with the HAL and DIMS exhibiting lower VA across all testing conditions (all p <0.05) and DOT demonstrating equivalence to SV with high contrast letters. Contrast sensitivity was similarly reduced for all lenses through the CZ, while HAL and DIMS performed worse than both SV and DOT through the PZ (p <0.01). Near acuity threshold, reading speed and critical print size through the PZ were comparable for SV, DOT and HAL (all p >0.05), whereas DIMS exhibited worse near acuity threshold and critical print size (p <0.001). No significant differences emerged for error score (p = 0.53), accommodative facility refocusing cycles (all p >0.05) or visual search duration (CZ: p = 0.68; PZ: p = 0.35). Accommodative response was similar across lenses (all p >0.05); however, SV had lower variability at distance through the PZ than DOT, HAL and DIMS (p <0.001). CONCLUSION: All three myopia control lenses exhibited visual performance comparable to standard SV lenses through the CZ. Clinicians should note differences in visual performance, especially VA and reading speed through the lens periphery and their relative testing.

Effect of the Long-Term Wearing of Spectacle Lenses with Highly Aspherical Lenslets on Visual Field Sensitivity in Children with Myopia

HAL vs SVL对近视儿童静态视野敏感度的长期及即时影响

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2026年👥 Cui Zaifeng, Zhang Huayu, Fang Xiao, Huang Yingying, Bao Jinhua, Li Xue
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-9 HAL vs SVL对近视儿童静态视野敏感度的长期及即时影响 研究设计：前瞻性病例-对照研究，比较长期佩戴 HAL 镜片 5 年与佩戴 SVL 镜片的近视儿童；同时采用随机顺序测试 HAL 和 SVL 镜片的即时影响。 样本量：80 人，HAL 组 40 人，SVL 组 40 人；有效分析样本量约为 25–33 人/条件。 结论：长期佩戴 HAL 镜片 5 年及即时佩戴 HAL 镜片均未显著影响近视儿童 30° 静态视野敏感度。组别效应无显著差异（p = 0.17），镜片效应无显著差异（p = 0.52），组别 × 镜片交互作用无显著差异（p = 0.81）。当使用 SVL 测试镜片时，HAL 组与 SVL 组平均敏感度差异为 0.7 ± 1.19 dB；使用 HAL 测试镜片时，两组平均差异为 0.7 ± 0.91 dB。总体提示 HAL 镜片在视野敏感度方面具有良好安全性。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-9
原文摘要
引言： 本研究旨在探讨短期和长期佩戴高非球微透镜框架镜片（HAL）对近视儿童视野敏感度的影响。 方法： 本前瞻性病例-对照研究纳入 80 名 13–18 岁近视儿童，其等效球镜屈光度范围为 -1.00 D 至 -7.25 D。其中 40 名儿童日常佩戴普通单光镜片（SVL），另外 40 名儿童已佩戴 HAL 镜片 5 年。采用自动静态视野计检测静态视野敏感度，使用 Goldman III 视标，在 60° 直径视野范围内检测 76 个白光刺激点。受试者先在不佩戴测试镜片的情况下进行练习，随后以随机顺序佩戴 HAL 测试镜片或 SVL 测试镜片进行测量。所有检测均测试右眼，左眼遮盖。 结果： 采用广义估计方程（GEE）进行统计分析，结果显示组别效应无统计学意义（p = 0.17），镜片效应无统计学意义（p = 0.52），组别与镜片之间的交互作用也无统计学意义（p = 0.81）。佩戴 SVL 测试镜片时，HAL 组与 SVL 组的平均敏感度差异为 0.7 ± 1.19 dB，范围为 -2.5 dB 至 4.8 dB。佩戴 HAL 测试镜片时，两组平均差异为 0.7 ± 0.91 dB，范围为 -0.6 dB 至 3.3 dB。视野检测可靠性指标，包括固视、假阳性和假阴性错误率，在不同条件下相似，差异均无统计学意义（均 p > 0.05）。 结论： 无论是短期还是长期佩戴 HAL 镜片，均未影响 13–18 岁近视儿童 30° 视野范围内的全视野静态视野敏感度，支持其用于近视控制的安全性。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
INTRODUCTION: This study investigated the effects of the short and long-term wearing of spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) on visual field sensitivity in children with myopia. METHODS: This prospective case‒control study included 80 children with myopia aged 13–18 years, whose spherical equivalent refractive error (SER) ranged from ﹣1.00 D to -7.25 D. Forty children wore single vision lenses (SVL) habitually, while the remaining 40 children had been wearing HAL lenses for five years. Static visual field sensitivity was assessed using automatic static perimetry (Goldman III target) involving 76 white light points within a 30° radius visual field. After a practice round without the test lenses, measurements were taken while the participants wore either test HAL lenses or SVL in a randomized order. All assessments were conducted on the right eye while the left eye was occluded. RESULTS: Statistical analysis using generalized estimating equations (GEEs) revealed no significant main effects of group (p = 0.17) or lens (p = 0.52), nor significant interaction effect between these factors (p = 0.81). When the test SVL were used, the difference in mean sensitivity between the HAL and SVL groups (HAL group minus SVL group) was 0.7 ± 1.19 dB (ranging from ﹣ 2.5 dB to 4.8 dB). When the test HAL lenses were used, a mean difference of 0.7 ± 0.91 dB (ranging from ﹣ 0.6 dB to 3.3 dB) was observed between the two groups. Visual field reliability parameters (fixation, false-positive, and false-negative error ratios) were similar between conditions (all p > 0.05). CONCLUSION: Neither short nor long-term wearing of spectacles with HAL affected full-field static visual field sensitivity within the 30° radius visual field in children with myopia aged 13 to 18 years, supporting their safety profile in controlling myopia.

使用基于平板电脑的分视平台评估佩戴单光镜片或高度非球面微透镜（HAL）框架眼镜儿童的双眼视功能

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2026年👥 Wu Zhuotong, Ye Yuhao, Ma Yong, Sun Bingqing, Zhou Xingtao, Zhao Jing
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-10 使用基于平板电脑的分视平台评估佩戴单光镜片或高度非球面微透镜（HAL）框架眼镜儿童的双眼视功能 起始时间：2025年3月 – 2025年8月 研究中心&PI：复旦大学附属眼耳鼻喉科医院 & 赵婧，周行涛 试验设计简述：横断面观察性研究 试验组样本量：共300名4至17岁的儿童；单光（SV）镜片组154人，HAL（Stellest/星趣控）组146人 该研究未主要评估使用平板电脑的双眼视功能。两组的中位等效球镜在基线时具有可比性（SV组-2.00 D，HAL组-1.94 D）。在调整后的观察分析中，探索性研究显示，在SE > -3.00 D的亚组中，HAL组相较于单光组具有更高几率的可测量动态立体视和粗略立体视（aOR分别为2.21和3.15），但在中高度近视亚组（SE ≤ -3.00 D）中未观察到显著关联。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-10
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate multi-distance binocular visual function in children using a tablet-based dichoptic platform and compare performance between single-vision and highly aspherical lenslet (HAL) spectacle lenses. METHODS: This cross-sectional study included 300 children aged 4 to 17 years wearing single-vision spectacle lenses (n = 154) or HAL spectacle lenses (n = 146). Outcomes included foveal simultaneous-perception non-composite responses, peripheral simultaneous-perception non-normal responses, and fine, dynamic, and gross stereopsis from 0.4 to 3.0 m. Generalized estimating equations clustered by participant evaluated lens type and testing distance, with adjustment for age, sex, myopia magnitude, interocular spherical-equivalent difference, and mean absolute cylinder. RESULTS: Fine stereopsis declined significantly as testing distance increased and was rarely measurable at 2.0 m. Compared with 0.4 m, the adjusted odds of measurable fine stereopsis were lower at 1.5 m (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] = 0.81; P = 0.003) and 2.0 m (aOR = 0.08; P < 0.001). In adjusted observational analyses, HAL lens wear was associated with higher odds of measurable dynamic (aOR = 1.68; P = 0.024) and gross stereopsis (aOR = 2.51; P = 0.006) than single-vision lens wear. Fine stereopsis remained comparable between the two groups (aOR = 0.99; P = 0.960). Foveal non-composite responses were uncommon at 0.4 m but highly prevalent at 3.0 m (>87%) regardless of lens type, while peripheral simultaneous perception remained mostly normal. CONCLUSIONS: Tablet-based binocular visual performance declined as the testing distance increased. In this cross-sectional observational analysis, children wearing HAL spectacle lenses showed higher adjusted odds of measurable dynamic and gross stereopsis than those wearing single-vision lenses, while fine stereopsis remained comparable. These findings provide preliminary clinical evidence regarding binocular visual performance with HAL lens wear and warrant confirmation in longitudinal studies across different myopia levels.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：评估 1 年内离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片在控制中国儿童近视进展方面的效果，以及其对儿童视觉相关生活质量的影响。 方法：本研究为随机双盲前瞻性对照临床试验，纳入 176 名 7-14 岁近视受试者，将其随机分为 DIMS 组和对照组（单光镜片，SV 组）。分别在基线期、3 个月、6 个月、9 个月和 12 个月随访时监测受试者的屈光不正情况和眼轴长度。采用屈光矫正对生活质量的影响（QIRC）问卷，在基线期和干预后 12 个月评估受试者的视觉相关生活质量。 结果：在初始队列中，共 151 名儿童顺利完成研究（DIMS 组 n=72；SV 组 n=79）。两组受试者的基线特征无显著差异。1 年后，DIMS 组的平均眼轴增长为 0.17（95% 置信区间 0.13-0.20）mm，平均近视进展为 - 0.27（95% 置信区间 - 0.36 至 - 0.18）屈光度（D）；SV 组的平均眼轴增长为 0.30（95% 置信区间 0.26-0.33）mm，平均近视进展为 - 0.55（95% 置信区间 - 0.64 至 - 0.47）屈光度（D）。两组在眼轴增长和近视进展方面的均值差异分别为 0.13 mm（95% 置信区间 0.08-0.18 mm，p<0.001）和 - 0.28 屈光度（D）（95% 置信区间 - 0.41 至 - 0.15 D，p<0.001）。DIMS 组与 SV 组的 QIRC 评分无显著差异（55.30（95% 置信区间 53.17-56.90） vs 54.20（95% 置信区间 51.99-56.41），p=0.854）。 结论：与单光（SV）镜片相比，儿童佩戴 DIMS 镜片可减缓近视进展，且不会对其整体生活质量产生负面影响。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
Purpose: To assess the efficacy of the Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lens for myopia control and its impact on vision-related quality of life in Chinese children over a 1-year period. Methods: This randomized double-blind prospective controlled clinical trial enrolled 176 myopic subjects aged between seven and 14 years who were randomly assigned into the DIMS group or the control single-vision (SV) group. Refractive error and axial length measurements at baseline, three-, six-, nine-, and 12-month follow-up visits were monitored. The Quality of Life Impact of Refractive Correction (QIRC) questionnaire was used to evaluate the vision-related quality of life at baseline and at 12 months postintervention. Results: Of the initial cohort, a total of 151 children successfully completed the study (DIMS n = 72; SV n = 79). Baseline characteristics were similar between both groups. Average axial elongation and myopia progression after 1 year were 0.17 (95% CI 0.13-0.20) mm and -0.27 (95% CI -0.36 to -0.18) D in the DIMS group and 0.30 (95% CI 0.26-0.33) mm and -0.55 (95% CI -0.64 to -0.47) D in the SV group. The mean differences in axial elongation and myopia progression were 0.13 mm (95% CI 0.08-0.18 mm, p < 0.001) and -0.28 D (95% CI -0.41 to -0.15 D, p < 0.001) between the two groups. No significant difference in the QIRC score was found between the DIMS and SV groups (55.30 (95% CI 53.17-56.90) versus 54.20 (95% CI 51.99-56.41), p=0.854)). Conclusion: The use of DIMS lenses in children was found to slow down myopia progression compared to SV lenses, without negatively affecting their overall quality of life. Trial Registration: Clinical Trial Registry identifier: ChiCTR2000037443.

摘要 目的：比较使用0.01%阿托品滴眼液（0.01%A）和高非球面微透镜设计的镜片（HAL）治疗近视儿童1年内的疗效差异，并分析影响疗效的因素。 方法：采用回顾性系列病例研究，纳入2021年9月至2024年6月期间在温州医科大学附属眼视光医院接受0.01%A治疗的近视儿童99例（99眼，年龄8.8岁，男女比例55:44）作为0.01%A组，验配HAL的儿童296例（296眼，年龄9.1岁，男女比例147:149）作为HAL组，均纳入右眼数据分析。主要观察指标为随访12个月的AL增长量，次要观察指标为SE和散光度数变化量。 结果：HAL组随访12个月AL增长量为0.15（0.05，0.26）mm，显著小于0.01%A组的0.28（0.13，0.39）mm（Z=-4.88，P<0.001，Cliff's Delta=0.33）；SE变化量亦小于0.01%A组（Z=2.42，P=0.016，Cliff's Delta=-0.16）；但角膜散光变化量大于0.01%A组（Z=-2.48，P=0.013，Cliff's Delta=0.17）。广义线性模型校正基线特征及样本量差异后亦显示HAL组随访12个月的AL增长量和SE变化量均小于0.01%A组（Wald χ2=40.19，P<0.001；Wald χ2=7.19，P=0.007），而角膜散光变化量大于0.01%A组（Wald χ2=4.71，P=0.030）。多元线性回归显示基线年龄越大两组AL增长均越慢（P均<0.001）；基线柱镜度越高，HAL组AL增长量增加（β=-0.06，95%CI：-0.094~-0.019，P=0.003）；交互分析显示随着基线柱镜度升高，相较于0.01%A组，HAL组的AL增长量增加（β=-0.06，95%CI：-0.12~0.00，P=0.038）。 结论：基于群体数据的分析显示HAL在控制AL增长方面的效果整体优于0.01%A；然而随着基线散光增加，HAL的控制效果逐渐减弱，而0.01%A的控制效果受散光的影响较小。

Methods: This retrospective case series study included 99 children (99 eyes) treated with 0.01% atropine eye drops (0.01% A group) and 296 children (296 eyes) fitted with HAL (HAL group) at Eye Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University. The ages were 8.8 (7.7, 11.0) years in the 0.01% A group and 9.1 (8.0, 10.6) years in the HAL group, with male-to-female ratios of 55:44 and 147:149, respectively. The study period spanned from September 2021 to June 2024. The primary outcome was 12-month axial length (AL) progression. Secondary outcomes included changes in spherical equivalent (SE) and astigmatism. Analysis was performed exclusively using right eye data. Between-group comparisons were analyzed using the Mann-Whitney U tests, Cliff's Delta, and generalized linear models (GLMs). Interaction effects between baseline characteristics and interventions were assessed using multiple linear regression. The change in SE was also smaller in the HAL group compared to the 0.01% A group (Z=2.42, P=0.016, Cliff's Delta=-0.16). One-Year Comparative Evaluation of Highly Aspherical Lenslets and Horizontally Asymmetric Peripheral Defocus Lenses for Myopia Control in School-Aged Children

HAL vs HAPD（罗敦司得） vs SVL —有效性&散光影响

📖 Life (Basel, Switzerland)📅 2025年👥 Orešković Ivana, Malenica Ravlić Maja, Knežević Lana, Doko Mandić Blanka, Marić Goran, Vukojević Ante, Zorić Geber Mia, Vatavuk Zoran, Sabol Ivan, Škunca Herman Jelena

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-2
原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在对比三种镜片设计 —— 高度非球面微透镜（HALs）、水平不对称周边离焦（HAPD）镜片与标准单光镜片（SVLs）在延缓学龄儿童近视进展方面的一年期效果。 方法：本研究为前瞻性非随机研究，共纳入 57 名 8-17 岁儿童，根据其佩戴的镜片类型分为三组：HAL 组（n=16）、HAPD 组（n=21）和 SVL 组（n=20）。在基线、6 个月和 12 个月时对受试者进行全面眼科检查。 结局指标包括等效球镜度数（SER）、球镜度数（SR）、柱镜度数（CR）和眼轴长度（AL）。采用非参数检验对数据进行分析，显著性水平设定为 p<0.05。 结果：12 个月期间，所有组别的等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）均出现一定程度的进展。HAL 组的等效球镜度数（SER）中位变化值最小（-0.3 D），HAPD 组为 - 0.5 D，SVL 组为 - 0.4 D，但组间差异无统计学意义（p=0.111）。HAL 组的眼轴增长（0.1 mm，四分位距：0.0~0.2 mm）显著低于 HAPD 组和 SVL 组（两组均为 0.2 mm，p<0.0001）。所有组别的柱镜度数（CR）均保持稳定，未出现具有临床意义的变化。在所有指标中，HAPD 组均未表现出优于 SVL 组的优势。 结论：在本研究涉及的三种镜片中，12 个月期间，HAL 镜片在延缓屈光性近视和轴性近视进展方面效果最佳。该研究结果表明，HAL 镜片可作为儿童近视控制的可靠干预手段。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: The aim of this study was to compare the one-year efficacy of three spectacle lens designs, highly aspherical lenslets (HALs), horizontally asymmetric peripheral defocus (HAPD) lenses, and standard single vision lenses (SVLs) in slowing myopia progression in school-aged children. METHODS: In this prospective, non-randomized study, 57 children, aged 8-17 years, were grouped based on the type of lenses worn: HAL (n = 16), HAPD (n = 21), or SVL (n = 20). Comprehensive ophthalmologic examinations were performed at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months. Outcome measures included spherical equivalent refraction (SER), spherical refraction (SR), cylindrical refraction (CR), and axial length (AL). Data were analyzed using non-parametric tests with significance set at p < 0.05. RESULTS: All groups showed some progression in SER and AL over 12 months. The HAL group demonstrated the smallest median SER change (-0.3 D), compared to HAPD (-0.5 D) and SVL (-0.4 D), though group differences were not statistically significant (p = 0.111). Axial elongation was significantly lower in the HAL group (0.1 mm, IQR: 0.0-0.2 mm) compared to HAPD and SVL (both 0.2 mm, p < 0.0001). CR remained stable in all groups, with no clinically meaningful changes. The HAPD groups showed no advantages over SVL in any parameter. CONCLUSIONS: Among the three lens types studied, HAL lenses were the most effective in reducing both refractive and axial myopia progression over 12 months. These findings support their use as a reliable intervention in pediatric myopia control.

摘要 目的：探讨配戴高非球面微透镜镜片（HAL）的近视儿童柱镜度数及角膜散光的变化，并与配戴单光眼镜（SVL）的近视儿童进行比较。 方法：将8至13岁、近视度数在-0.75 D至-4.75 D之间的儿童随机分配配戴HAL或SVL两年。每6个月进行一次睫状肌麻痹电脑验光（包括SER和柱镜度数）、眼轴长度（AL）及角膜曲率半径测量，并比较两组间的2年变化量。 结果：HAL组52名儿童（103眼）和SVL组49名儿童（98眼）完成了所有检查并纳入分析。与SVL组相比，HAL组的近视进展（SER：-0.69 D，95% CI [-0.81, -0.57] 对比 -1.38 D，95% CI [-1.50, -1.26]，p < 0.001）和AL变化量（0.34 mm，95% CI [0.29, 0.39] 对比 0.67 mm，95% CI [0.62, 0.72]，p < 0.001）均显著减缓。配戴2年后，SVL组与HAL组在柱镜度数变化（-0.46 D，95% CI [-0.54, -0.38] 对比 -0.51 D，95% CI [-0.61, -0.41]，p=0.43）或角膜散光变化（-0.29 D，95% CI [-0.38, -0.20] 对比 -0.39 D，95% CI [-0.49, -0.27]，p=0.14）方面均无显著差异。 结论：与配戴单光眼镜相比，配戴HAL两年对儿童的柱镜度数和角膜散光无显著影响。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose : To explore the changes in cylinder power and corneal astigmatism in myopic children wearing spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) and to compare these findings with those observed in myopic children wearing single-vision spectacle lenses (SVL). Methods : Children aged 8 to 13 years with myopia between -0.75 D and -4.75 D were randomly assigned to wear HAL or SVL for two years. Cycloplegic autorefraction, including spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and cylinder power, axial length (AL), and corneal curvature radius were obtained every 6 months. The two-year changes were compared between groups. Results : A total of 103 eyes in 52 children from the HAL group and 98 eyes in 49 children from the SVL group completed all examinations and were included in the analysis. The HAL group exhibited significantly slower myopia progression (SER, -0.69D, 95% CI [-0.81, -0.57] vs. -1.38D, 95% CI [-1.50, -1.26], p < 0.001), and change in AL (0.34mm, 95% CI [0.29, 0.39] vs. 0.67mm, 95% CI [0.62, 0.72], p < 0.001) compared to the SVL group. No significant difference was observed between the SVL and HAL groups in terms of changes in cylinder power (-0.46D, 95%CI [-0.54, -0.38] vs. -0.51D, 95%CI [-0.61, -0.41], p=0.43) or corneal astigmatism (-0.29D, 95%CI [-0.38, -0.20] vs. -0.39D, 95%CI [-0.49, -0.27], p=0.14) after two years. Conclusions : Wearing HAL for two years had no significant impact on cylinder power and corneal astigmatism compared to SVL.

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：探讨近视儿童配戴周边离焦眼镜镜片（PDSL）对柱镜屈光度（CYL）的影响。 方法：纳入1057名近视儿童，分为三组：HAL组（高非球面微透镜镜片）、MPV组（基于周边视力调控的镜片）及对照组（无近视控制干预）。分析配戴PDSL对等效球镜屈光度、CYL和角膜散光（CA）变化的影响，并探讨球镜屈光度（SPH）变化与CYL之间的中介效应。 结果：与对照组（0.05 ± 0.33 D）相比，HAL组（-0.15 ± 0.33 D，P < 0.001）和MPV组（-0.09 ± 0.27 D，P = 0.019）的年CYL进展更快。HAL组中有更多儿童的年CYL进展≥0.50 D（HAL组：23.6%，对照组：16.2%，P = 0.012）。PDSL各组内年CYL与CA进展趋势一致（HAL组：P = 0.677，MPV组：P = 0.683）。HAL组CYL进展的总效应主要源于配戴HAL的直接诱导以及通过SPH控制效应的间接诱导。 结论：应用PDSL可能导致近视儿童散光增加，这主要归因于角膜散光的变化。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: This study aims to explore the impact of wearing peripheral defocus spectacle lenses (PDSL) on cylindrical refractive error (CYL) in myopic children. Methods: This study included 1057 myopic children and divided the participants into three groups: the HAL group (spectacle lens with highly aspherical lenslets), the MPV group (spectacle lens based on manipulating peripheral vision), and a control group (without myopia control interventions). The study analyzed the effect of wearing PDSL on changes in spherical equivalent refraction, CYL, and corneal astigmatism (CA). The mediating effect between changes in spherical refractive errors (SPH) and CYL was also investigated. Results: Compared to the control group (0.05 ± 0.33 D), the annual CYL progression was faster in the HAL group (−0.15 ± 0.33 D, P < 0.001) and the MPV group (−0.09 ± 0.27 D, P = 0.019). More children in the HAL group had an annual CYL progression ≥0.50 D (HAL: 23.6%, Control: 16.2%, P = 0.012). The annual CYL and CA progression were consistent within the PDSL groups (HAL: P = 0.677, MPV: P = 0.683). The total effect of CYL progression in the HAL group was primarily due to direct induction from wearing HAL and indirect induction through the SPH control effect. Conclusions: The application of PDSL could cause increase in astigmatism in myopic children, which could mainly be contributed to cornea astigmatism change. Translational Relevance: PDSL may passively affect the anterior ocular biomechanics during myopia control, leading to an increase in astigmatism.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：探讨佩戴高非球面微透镜（HAL）眼镜的近视且眼轴长度（AL）快速变化儿童的眼部生物学特征。 方法：收集 156 例（252 眼）7~13 岁、佩戴 HAL 治疗且眼轴长度快速变化的近视儿童资料。根据 6 个月内眼轴长度变化，将受试者分为眼轴缩短组和眼轴增长组。采用配对 t 检验比较 HAL 治疗前基线水平与眼轴长度快速变化后的眼部生物学参数，采用 Pearson 相关分析探讨眼部参数与眼轴长度变化的相关性。 结果：佩戴 HAL 后，近视且眼轴长度快速变化儿童的眼部生物学参数发生显著改变。眼轴缩短组前房深度（ACD）、玻璃体腔深度（VCD）降低，晶状体厚度（CLT）增加，角膜平坦子午线曲率（FK）降低，角膜陡峭子午线曲率（SK）增加（均 P<0.001）；眼轴增长组 ACD、VCD 增加，SK 增大，但 CLT、FK 无显著变化。眼轴长度变化与基线散光度数呈负相关（r=-0.171，P=0.007）。 结论：佩戴 HAL 的儿童在眼轴缩短过程中，可观察到 ACD、VCD 降低，CLT 增厚，FK 变平，SK 变陡；基线散光度数较低与眼轴缩短相关。眼轴缩短可能提示 HAL 在近视控制中的潜在疗效，同时为优化个性化近视管理方案提供依据。需进一步开展纵向研究，验证眼轴快速变化是否可预测治疗疗效的持续性。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
AIM: To investigate the ocular biological characteristics of children with myopia and rapid axial length (AL) changes prescribed spectacles with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL). METHODS: Data were collected from 156 children (252 eyes) with myopia and HAL treatment who were aged 7-13 and had rapid AL changes. The participants were divided into groups with AL reduction and elongation according to the changes in AL within 6mo. Paired t-tests were used to compare the ocular biological parameters at baseline and after rapid changes post-HAL treatment. Pearson's correlation analysis was used to determine the association between the ocular parameters and AL changes. RESULTS: The ocular biological parameters significantly changed in the children with myopia and rapid AL changes after HAL treatment. In the group with AL reduction, the anterior chamber depth (ACD) and vitreous chamber depth (VCD) decreased. The crystalline lens thickness (CLT) increased, corneal flat keratometry (FK) decreased, and steep keratometry (SK) increased (all P<0.001). The eyes in the group with AL elongation had increased ACD and VCD and steepened SK, but the CLT or FK findings were not different. AL change was negatively associated with baseline astigmatism (r=-0.171; P=0.007). CONCLUSION: In the eyes with HAL treatment, decreased ACD and VCD, thickened CLT, flattened FK, and steepened SK are observed during AL reduction. Lower baseline astigmatism is associated with AL reduction. The AL reduction may suggest the potential efficacy of HAL intervention in myopia control, while providing evidence for optimizing personalized myopia management strategies. Further longitudinal studies are warranted to validate whether rapid AL changes predict sustained treatment efficacy.

摘要 目的：探求青少年儿童配戴多区正向离焦镜片（DIMS）与高非球面微透镜镜片（HAL）两种不同设计的多点近视离焦镜片后散光度数的变化情况。 方法：选取2020年9月至2021年3月于北京爱尔英智眼科医院视光中心就诊的7~12岁儿童，分为配戴DIMS者54名、配戴HAL者60名、配戴单光镜片（SVL）者48名三组。观察配戴三种不同设计镜片后6个月与12个月无其他干预情况下眼总散光和角膜散光的变化。 结果：配戴6个月后，DIMS组眼总散光增长0.14±0.38 D，角膜散光增长0.09±0.24 D；HAL组眼总散光增长0.06±0.08 D，角膜散光增长0.15±0.32 D；SVL组眼总散光增长0.24±0.14 D，角膜散光增长0.10±0.30 D。单光组眼总散光增长显著高于DIMS组和HAL组（P<0.01）；三组间角膜散光增长无统计学差异（P>0.05）。配戴12个月后，DIMS组眼总散光增长0.24±0.17 D，角膜散光增长0.15±0.25 D；HAL组眼总散光增长0.16±0.17 D，角膜散光增长0.15±0.36 D；单光组眼总散光增长0.48±0.25 D，角膜散光增长0.20±0.35 D。SVL组眼总散光增长显著高于DIMS组和HAL组（P<0.01）；三组间角膜散光增长无统计学差异（P>0.05）。 结论：青少年儿童配戴多区正向离焦和高非球面微透镜设计的近视离焦镜片后眼总散光度数变化均较单光镜片小，对角膜散光的变化没有明显影响，为青少年儿童近视防控方案个性化选择提供了临床依据。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Objective To explore the changes in astigmatism in children and adolescents after wearing two different designs of multi-focal myopia defocus lenses : Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) and Highly Aspherical Lenslets (HAL). Methods Children aged 7~12 years who visited the Optometry Center of Beijing Aier Yingzhi Eye Hospital from September 2020 to March 2021 were selected and divided into three groups : 54 children wearing DIMS, 60 children wearing HAL, and 48 children wearing single-vision lenses (SVL). The changes in total ocular astigmatism and corneal astigmatism were observed in children and adolescents after wearing the three differently designed lenses for 6 months and 12 months without other interventions. Results After 6 months of wear DIMS group : total astigmatism increased by 0.14±0.38D, corneal astigmatism increased by 0.09±0.24D. HAL group : total astigmatism increased by 0.06±0.08D, corneal astigmatism increased by 0.15±0.32D. SVL group : total astigmatism increased by 0.24±0.14D, corneal astigmatism increased by 0.10±0.30D. The increase in total astigmatism in the SVL group was significantly higher than in both the DIMS and HAL groups, and this difference was statistically significant (P<0.01). No statistically significant difference was observed in corneal astigmatism changes among the three groups (P>0.05). After 12 months of wear DIMS group : total astigmatism increased by 0.24±0.17D, corneal astigmatism increased by 0.15±0.25D. HAL group : total astigmatism increased by 0.16±0.17D, corneal astigmatism increased by 0.15±0.36D. SVL group : total astigmatism increased by 0.48±0.25D, corneal astigmatism increased by 0.20±0.35D. The increase in total astigmatism in the SVL group was significantly higher than in both the DIMS and HAL groups, and this difference was statistically significant (P<0.01).

原文摘要
摘要 目的：探讨瞳孔面积是否会影响周边离焦眼镜片在控制近视儿童眼轴伸长和屈光度数进展中的效果。 方法：本回顾性分析纳入 310 名 7-14 岁近视儿童，每位参与者至少佩戴三种近视控制镜片中的一种达 12 个月：A 类为多区正向离焦（DIMS）镜片；B 类为高非球面微透镜；C 类为个性化自由曲面光学设计镜片。根据瞳孔面积（高于或低于均值）对参与者进行分组，分别在基线、6 个月和 12 个月时测量眼轴长度和球镜等效屈光度数，并采用线性混合效应模型评估瞳孔面积与镜片类型的交互作用对眼轴伸长的影响。 结果：在瞳孔较大的儿童中，与 A 类和 C 类镜片相比，12 个月时 B 类镜片与更少的眼轴伸长和屈光度数进展相关（P<0.001）；相反，在瞳孔较小的儿童中，未观察到不同镜片类型之间存在显著差异。交互项（β=-0.086，P=0.002）表明，B 类镜片的效果可能受瞳孔面积影响。 结论：瞳孔面积可能会影响周边离焦眼镜片的近视控制效果。瞳孔较大的儿童从高非球面微透镜中获得的益处更显著，提示在临床决策中应考虑瞳孔面积这一因素。 转化相关性：瞳孔面积可能影响周边离焦镜片的临床表现，为儿童个性化近视管理提供支持。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate whether pupil area influences the effectiveness of peripheral defocus spectacle lenses in controlling axial elongation and refractive error progression among myopic children. METHODS: This retrospective analysis included 310 myopic children ages 7 to 14 years. Each participant wore one of three myopia control lens types for at least 12 months: type A, defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lenses; type B, highly aspherical lenslets; or type C, personalized freeform optical design. Participants were grouped by pupil area (above or below the mean). Axial length and spherical equivalent refractive error were measured at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months. A linear mixed-effects model was used to evaluate the effect of the interaction between pupil area and lens type on axial elongation. RESULTS: Among children with larger pupils, lens type B was associated with less axial elongation and refractive error progression at 12 months compared with types A and C (P < 0.001). In contrast, no significant differences among lens types were observed in children with smaller pupils. An interaction term (β = -0.086, P = 0.002) indicated that the efficacy of lens type B may be influenced by pupil area. CONCLUSIONS: Pupil area may influence the efficacy of peripheral defocus spectacle lenses for myopia control. Children with larger pupils demonstrated greater benefit from highly aspherical lenslets, suggesting that pupil area should be considered in clinical decision-making. TRANSLATIONAL RELEVANCE: Pupil area may influence the clinical performance of peripheral defocus lenses, supporting personalized myopia management in children.

非球面微透镜眼镜片对近视儿童周边眼轴长度和周边屈光状态变化的影响—2年随机临床试验

参考文献6-8-8 非球面微透镜眼镜片对近视儿童周边眼轴长度和周边屈光状态变化的影响—2年随机临床试验 样本量：HAL组54 人；SAL组53人；新SVL组49人 结果：HAL组和SAL组均能减缓中央眼轴延长，但对周边眼轴延长影响较小；SVL组视网膜变陡、周边远视性离焦增加，而HAL组视网膜变平、周边远视性离焦减少。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-8
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：探讨近视儿童佩戴高非球面度微透镜（HAL）和低非球面度微透镜（SAL）眼镜片 2 年后，其周边眼轴长度（PEL）和周边屈光状态（PR）的变化情况。 研究方法：本研究纳入 170 名 8~13 岁近视儿童，其球镜等效屈光度为 - 0.75~-4.75 屈光度（D）。将受试者随机分为三组，分别佩戴高非球面度微透镜眼镜片、低非球面度微透镜眼镜片和单光眼镜片（SVL）。在 2 年的研究期内，每 6 个月测量一次受试者视网膜中心 0°、鼻侧 15°、鼻侧 30°、颞侧 15° 和颞侧 30° 位置的周边眼轴长度和周边屈光状态，并通过周边屈光值减去中心屈光值计算相对周边屈光状态（RPR）。 研究结果：所有受试者的周边眼轴长度均随时间显著增加（均P<0.001），其中单光眼镜片组的眼轴延长量最大，高非球面度微透镜眼镜片组最小。单光眼镜片组和低非球面度微透镜眼镜片组的中心眼轴长度延长速度快于周边；而高非球面度微透镜眼镜片组中，视网膜鼻侧 30° 位置的周边眼轴长度延长速度快于其他位置，中心眼轴长度延长速度慢于周边。所有受试者的周边屈光状态随时间向近视方向发展（均P<0.001），单光眼镜片组的近视化程度最高，高非球面度微透镜眼镜片组最低。单光眼镜片组和低非球面度微透镜眼镜片组的相对周边屈光状态向远视方向偏移，而高非球面度微透镜眼镜片组的相对周边屈光状态远视偏移程度降低（均P<0.001）。 研究结论：在 2 年的近视进展期内，单光眼镜片组受试者的视网膜曲率变陡，周边远视性离焦程度加重；低非球面度微透镜眼镜片组的上述变化程度有所缓解；而高非球面度微透镜眼镜片组受试者的视网膜曲率变平，周边远视性离焦程度降低。 转化意义：高、低非球面度微透镜眼镜片对周边眼轴长度的延长几乎无抑制作用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate changes in peripheral eye length (PEL) and peripheral refraction (PR) in myopic children after wearing spectacle lenses with highly or slightly aspherical lenslets (HAL or SAL) for 2 years. METHODS: We recruited 170 children aged 8 to 13 years with myopia between -0.75 diopters (D) and -4.75 D. Participants were randomized to wear HAL, SAL, or single vision spectacle lenses (SVL). PEL and PR were measured at 0° central and 15° and 30° in the nasal and temporal retina every 6 months for 2 years. The relative PR (RPR) was calculated by subtracting central from peripheral values. RESULTS: PELs significantly increased with time (all P < 0.001), with the greatest elongation in the SVL group and the least in the HAL group. In the SVL and SAL groups, axial length elongated faster than the periphery. Whereas in the HAL group, N30 elongated faster than other PELs, axial length elongated less than the periphery. With time, the PR became more negative (all P < 0.001), with the most negative changes in the SVL group and the least negative changes in the HAL group. RPR became more hyperopic in the SVL and SAL groups, but less hyperopic in the HAL group (all P < 0.001). CONCLUSIONS: Over the 2-year myopia progression, steeper retina and greater peripheral hyperopic defocus were found in the SVL group. In the SAL group, changes were attenuated. In the HAL group, the retina flattened and peripheral defocus became less hyperopic. TRANSLATIONAL RELEVANCE: HAL and SAL lenses had little impact on PEL elongation.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-9
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：已有研究证实，高非球面微透镜眼镜片（HAL）能有效延缓近视进展和眼轴长度（AL）增长。本研究探讨持续佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜片，或从单光眼镜片（SVL）、轻度非球面微透镜眼镜片（SAL）换用该镜片的儿童，其周边眼轴长度（PEL）和周边屈光状态（PR）受该镜片的影响。 研究方法：52 名已佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜片 2 年的受试者继续佩戴该镜片（高非球面微透镜组）；第 3 年，51 名原佩戴轻度非球面微透镜眼镜片 2 年、48 名原佩戴单光眼镜片 2 年的受试者均换用高非球面微透镜眼镜片，分别设为轻非球面换高非球面组、单光换高非球面组。第 3 年新增一组 56 名 10-15 岁受试者佩戴单光眼镜片，设为新单光组。在视网膜鼻侧 30° 至颞侧 30°、上方 30° 至下方 10° 范围内，每间隔 10° 测量一次受试者的周边眼轴长度和周边屈光状态。 研究结果：各组间眼轴长度及颞侧周边眼轴长度的变化量存在显著差异（均 P≤0.001）。三个高非球面微透镜相关组别均较新单光组的眼轴增长更缓慢。黄斑旁颞侧（P=0.002）和上方（P=0.001）区域的周边屈光状态变化量在各组间存在差异，新单光组的近视进展程度高于其他三组。新单光组的眼轴长度增长幅度大于周边眼轴长度（均 P<0.02），而三个高非球面微透镜相关组别的眼轴长度与周边眼轴长度变化量无显著差异（均 P>0.05）。 研究结论：与佩戴单光眼镜片相比，换用或持续佩戴高非球面微透镜眼镜片能延缓中心及颞侧眼轴长度的增长，且佩戴该镜片会对视网膜的曲度和对称性产生影响。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: Spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) have been shown to slow myopia progression and axial length (AL) elongation effectively. The effects of HAL on peripheral eye length (PEL) and peripheral refraction (PR) were investigated in children who continued wearing HAL or switched from single-vision spectacle lenses (SVL) or spectacle lenses with slightly aspherical lenslets (SAL) to HAL. METHODS: Fifty-two participants who had worn HAL for 2 years continued their use (HAL group), while 51 and 48 participants who had originally worn SAL or SVL for 2 years switched to HAL (SAL-HAL and SVL-HAL groups, respectively) in Year 3. A new SVL group of 56 participants, 10-15 years of age, was enrolled in Year 3 (new-SVL group). PEL and PR were measured every 10° from 30° nasal to 30° temporal and from 30° superior to 10° inferior retina. RESULTS: There were significant differences in the changes in AL and PEL on the temporal side among the groups (all p ≤ 0.001). All three HAL groups exhibited less elongation than the new-SVL group. PR changes in the parafoveal temporal (p = 0.002) and superior (p = 0.001) regions differed among the groups; the new-SVL group progressed more than the other three groups. The AL in the new-SVL group exhibited greater elongation than the PEL (all p < 0.02). However, there were no significant differences between the AL and PEL changes in the three HAL groups (all p > 0.05). CONCLUSIONS: Compared with wearing SVL, switching to or continuing to wear HAL could slow central and temporal elongation of eye length. Wearing HAL could impact retinal steepness and symmetry.

参考文献6-8-10 HAL vs DIMS vs Aura 3（DSDO） vs Aura 6（DSDO）对视网膜活动的短期影响 样本量：19人【随机交叉试验，每位参与者先后佩戴四种不同的近视控制镜片，每种镜片佩戴15天，之间设有1周的洗脱期。】 结论：Aura 3、Aura 6、DIMS、HALT，均能诱导视网膜电生理活动的短期变化，其中以HALT和Aura 6镜片在周边视网膜区域引发的改变较一致，表明光学离焦可调节视网膜活动，这一机制可能参与眼部生长的调控。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-10
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：探究四款近视控制眼镜片诱导的离焦效应是否会引发视网膜的功能性改变。 研究方法：选取 19 名 18-28 岁的青年近视成年人，让其佩戴四款通过不同微透镜阵列模式诱导周边近视性离焦的镜片，包括两款分段式离焦光学镜片（Aura 3、Aura 6）、多段式离焦镜片（DIMS）以及高非球面微透镜靶向镜片（HALT）。分别在基线状态、佩戴 30 分钟后和佩戴 15 天后，采用明视 3.0 全视野视网膜电图、图形视网膜电图和全域闪光多焦视网膜电图对受试者的视网膜功能进行检测。 研究结果：佩戴 15 天后，Aura 6 镜片组受试者的全视野视网膜电图 a 波振幅显著升高（P=0.02），而 Aura 3 镜片组的 b 波振幅明显上升（P=0.01）。所有镜片均能在短期内使图形视网膜电图的波幅升高（N35-P50、P50-N95 波，P<0.01），其中分段式离焦光学镜片在佩戴 15 天后仍能维持较高的视网膜电反应。在全域闪光多焦视网膜电图检测中，HALT 镜片能使视网膜中周边区和周边区（14.8°-30.0°）产生最强且最持久的波幅升高，且在 30° 偏心区的潜时缩短（P=0.03）。Aura 6 镜片组的波幅呈渐进式升高，但部分为一过性变化；Aura 3 镜片组在 14.8°-23.0° 偏心区出现延迟性的波幅增强。多段式离焦镜片在 7.6°-14.8° 和 23°-30° 偏心区早期即出现波幅变化，但该变化在佩戴 15 天后有所减弱。 研究结论：不同近视控制眼镜片因光学设计和离焦特征的差异，会引发独特的视网膜电生理反应。其中 HALT 和 Aura 6 镜片的微透镜分布范围更广，能使视网膜周边区和内层的功能产生最稳定的改变。该研究结果证实，光学离焦可调节视网膜的活动，这一机制可能参与眼部生长的调控。 转化意义：不同设计的近视控制眼镜片基于其光学离焦特征，会诱导视网膜产生不同的功能性改变。深入理解这些视网膜反应，有助于优化镜片设计方案，提升近视控制的效果。 6-8-11摘要 目的：基于眼部生物测量参数，构建用于个性化推荐周边离焦框架眼镜设计的预测模型。 方法：本回顾性队列研究纳入了在北京大学人民医院眼科中心配戴周边离焦框架眼镜的2824名近视儿童。研究对象根据镜片设计分为五组：DSDO、DOT、DIMS、HALT 和 HORI，并按性别、年龄及基线眼部生物测量参数进行匹配。数据集随机分为训练集（80%）和验证集（20%），用于模型评估。研究分别针对每种镜片设计，基于眼部生物测量参数建立多元线性回归预测模型。最后，开发了一个 R 语言函数，用于临床个性化推荐。 结果：在匹配基线参数后，五种周边离焦框架眼镜在控制眼轴增长方面未观察到统计学显著差异（P = 0.28）。训练集中的决定系数（R²）为0.89至0.96，验证集为0.88至0.97；训练集中的均方根误差（RMSE）为0.05 mm至0.07 mm，验证集为0.04 mm至0.07 mm。校准图显示预测值与观察值之间具有良好一致性。 结论：尽管五种镜片设计在平均疗效上未显示显著差异，本研究成功建立了基于眼部生物测量参数的预测模型，可用于指导周边离焦框架眼镜的个性化验配。 通俗摘要：离焦眼镜已被证实可以减缓近视进展，但目前尚无基于个体情况选择离焦镜片类型的方法。本研究提出了一种基于眼部生物测量数据的个性化离焦镜片选择模型，可为临床近视管理决策提供参考。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate whether defocus induced by four myopia control spectacle lenses translate into retinal functional changes. METHODS: Nineteen young myopic adults (18-28 years) wore four lens that induce peripheral myopic defocus through different lenslet patterns: two segmented defocus optics (Aura 3 and Aura 6), defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS), and highly aspherical lenslet target (HALT). Retinal function was assessed at baseline, after 30 minutes, and after 15 days using photopic 3.0 full-field electroretinography (ERG), pattern ERG, and global-flash multifocal ERG. RESULTS: The Aura 6 showed increased ff ERG a-wave amplitude at 15 days (P = 0.02), whereas the Aura 3 showed increased b-wave amplitude (P = 0.01). All lenses induced short-term pattern ERG amplitude increases (N35-P50, P50-N95; P < 0.01), with diverse segmented defocus optics maintaining higher responses at 15 days. On global flash multifocal ERG, HALT induced the strongest and most sustained amplitude increases in midperipheral and peripheral regions (14.8°-30.0°) with reduced implicit times at 30° (P = 0.03). The Aura 6 showed progressive but partially transient amplitude increases, and the Aura 3 elicited delayed enhancements at 14.8° to 23.0°. Defocus incorporated multiple segments showed early changes at 7.6° to 14.8° and 23° to 30°, which diminished by 15 days. CONCLUSIONS: Myopia control spectacle lenses produce distinct retinal electrophysiological responses related to their optical design and defocus profile. The HALT and Aura 6, with more widely distributed lenslet patterns, induced the most consistent changes in peripheral and inner retinal function. These findings support that optical defocus can modulate retinal activity, potentially contributing to mechanisms regulating eye growth. TRANSLATIONAL RELEVANCE: Different myopia control spectacle lens designs induce distinct functional changes in retinal activity, according their optical defocus profiles. Understanding these retinal responses may help to optimize lens strategies to improve myopia control efficacy.

摘要 目的：基于眼部生物测量参数，构建用于个性化推荐周边离焦框架眼镜设计的预测模型。 方法：本回顾性队列研究纳入了在北京大学人民医院眼科中心配戴周边离焦框架眼镜的2824名近视儿童。研究对象根据镜片设计分为五组：DSDO、DOT、DIMS、HALT 和 HORI，并按性别、年龄及基线眼部生物测量参数进行匹配。数据集随机分为训练集（80%）和验证集（20%），用于模型评估。研究分别针对每种镜片设计，基于眼部生物测量参数建立多元线性回归预测模型。最后，开发了一个 R 语言函数，用于临床个性化推荐。 结果：在匹配基线参数后，五种周边离焦框架眼镜在控制眼轴增长方面未观察到统计学显著差异（P = 0.28）。训练集中的决定系数（R²）为0.89至0.96，验证集为0.88至0.97；训练集中的均方根误差（RMSE）为0.05 mm至0.07 mm，验证集为0.04 mm至0.07 mm。校准图显示预测值与观察值之间具有良好一致性。 结论：尽管五种镜片设计在平均疗效上未显示显著差异，本研究成功建立了基于眼部生物测量参数的预测模型，可用于指导周边离焦框架眼镜的个性化验配。 通俗摘要：离焦眼镜已被证实可以减缓近视进展，但目前尚无基于个体情况选择离焦镜片类型的方法。本研究提出了一种基于眼部生物测量数据的个性化离焦镜片选择模型，可为临床近视管理决策提供参考。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To construct a predictive model for personalized recommendation of peripheral defocus spectacle designs based on ocular biometric parameters. METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included 2824 myopic children who wore peripheral defocus spectacles at the Ophthalmology Center of Peking University People's Hospital. Participants were divided into five groups according to the spectacle designs (Diversified Segmental Defocus Optimization [DSDO], Diffusion Optics Technology [DOT], Defocus Induced Multiple Segment [DIMS], Highly Aspherical Lenslets [HALT], Hexagon Optimized Reticular Integration [HORI]) and matched for gender, age, and baseline biometric parameters. The dataset was randomly split into training (80%) and validation (20%) sets for model evaluation. Separate multiple linear regression prediction models based on ocular biometric parameters were constructed for each designs. Finally, an R language function was developed for clinical personalized recommendation. RESULTS: After matching baseline parameters, no statistically significant difference was observed in axial elongation control efficacy among the five peripheral defocus spectacles designs (P = 0.28). The coefficient of determination (R2) ranged from 0.89 to 0.96 in the training set and from 0.88 to 0.97 in the validation set; the root mean square error (RMSE) ranged from 0.05 mm to 0.07 mm in the training set and from 0.04 mm to 0.07 mm in the validation set. Calibration plots showed good agreement between predicted and observed values. CONCLUSION: Although no significant differences in average efficacy were observed among the five designs, this study successfully established predictive models based on ocular biometric parameters to guide personalized fitting of peripheral defocus spectacles.

Effect of Three Types of Specially-Designed Myopia Control Spectacle Lenses on Astigmatism: A Two-Year Result

HALT、DIMS、Myovision三种近视控制框架镜片是否会影响儿童散光变化

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2026年👥 Wen Ke, Yang Bi, Liu Longqian, Cho Pauline
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-8-12：HALT、DIMS、Myovision三种近视控制框架镜片是否会影响儿童散光变化 起始时间：2018 年 3 月至 2021 年 7 月 研究中心：四川大学华西医院Bi Yang（杨必） 试验简述：顾性收集 6–12 岁近视儿童佩戴三种近视控制框架镜片后的临床资料，比较 MyoVision、DIMS、Stellest 镜片佩戴前和佩戴 2 年后的散光变化。主要分析总散光及散光矢量成分 J0、J45。 结论：三种近视控制框架镜片佩戴 2 年后，儿童散光均有轻度增加，但增加幅度 <0.50 D，不具有临床意义；散光变化与镜片类型无关，更可能与近视进展本身相关。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控 / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-12
原文摘要
目的： 本研究旨在探讨临床实践中，特殊设计的近视控制框架镜片是否会对散光产生影响。 方法： 研究收集了四川大学华西医院 74 名患者的病历资料，患者年龄为 6–12 岁，分别佩戴 MyoVision 镜片 23 人、DIMS 镜片 22 人和 Stellest 镜片 29 人。收集内容包括基线年龄、性别，以及基线和 2 年随访时的框架镜处方。散光通过睫状肌麻痹后的客观验光和主观验光确定，并进一步分解为功率矢量成分 J0 和 J45。 结果： 佩戴镜片 2 年后，MyoVision、DIMS 和 Stellest 组的总散光分别增加了 -0.41 ± 0.29 D、-0.42 ± 0.34 D 和 -0.41 ± 0.31 D，差异均具有统计学意义。三组 J0 矢量分别增加 0.19 ± 0.15 D、0.19 ± 0.18 D 和 0.20 ± 0.16 D，差异也均具有统计学意义。J45 矢量在 MyoVision 和 Stellest 组中无显著变化，但在 DIMS 组中显著下降，不过其变化幅度为 -0.07 ± 0.14 D，不具有临床意义。三组之间在总散光、J0 和 J45 的变化方面无显著差异。多元线性回归分析显示，散光变化仅与等效球镜度数变化相关。 结论： 特殊设计的近视控制框架镜片佩戴 2 年后，儿童屈光性散光有轻度增加，但增加幅度小于 0.50 D，不具有临床意义。散光增加与镜片类型无关，而更可能与近视进展有关。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study sought to determine whether specially-designed myopia control spectacle lenses had any effect on astigmatism in clinical practice. METHODS: Medical records of 74 patients (age: 6 to 12 years old) involving the use of MyoVision (n = 23), DIMS (n = 22) and Stellest lenses (n = 29) were collected from the West China Hospital. Data collection included baseline age, sex and spectacle lens prescription at baseline and at the 2-year follow-up. Astigmatism, determined by cycloplegic objective and subjective refraction, was divided into its power vector components, J0 and J45. RESULTS: After 2 years of lens wear, for the MyoVision, DIMS and Stellest groups, the total astigmatism increased by -0.41 ± 0.29 D, -0.42 ± 0.34 D and -0.41 ± 0.31 D, respectively (all p < 0.001). The J0 vector increased by 0.19 ± 0.15 D, 0.19 ± 0.18 D and 0.20 ± 0.16 D, respectively (all p < 0.001). The J45 vector did not change significantly for MyoVision and Stellest (p = 0.12, 0.21), but did decrease significantly with DIMS (p = 0.02) although the magnitude (-0.07 ± 0.14 D) was not clinically significant. The changes in total astigmatism, J0 and J45 were comparable between the three groups (p = 0.99, 0.97 and 0.32, respectively). Multivariate linear regression analyses showed that the change in astigmatism was correlated only with the change of SER (standard β = 0.31, p = 0.006). CONCLUSION: The use of specially-designed myopia control spectacle lenses over 2 years resulted in a slight, but clinically insignificant (<0.50 D) increase in refractive astigmatism. The increase was not associated with lens type, but rather with the increase in myopia.

摘要 目的：评估Essilor Stellest在美国FDA授权后，美国公众对儿童近视控制框架镜片的线上搜索兴趣变化。 方法：观察性pre-post时间序列分析，收集2025年1月5日至10月26日美国Google Trends周度RSV；比较授权前37周与授权后6周，并以儿童眼镜通用检索词进行季节性校正，MiSight作为同期参照。 结果：Stellest相关composite RSV由9.39升至18.6（+98%，p=0.024）；校正后ratio由0.353升至0.694（+96.3%，p=0.016）；MiSight检索量同期稳定。 结论：FDA授权后公众对儿童近视控制框架镜片的搜索兴趣明显增加，但该指标不能直接代表临床认知、采纳或处方行为。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To quantify changes in US public interest in pediatric myopia-control spectacle lenses surrounding the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) authorization of Essilor Stellest (Essilor, Charenton-le-Pont, France) (September 25, 2025). METHODS: Weekly U.S. Google Trends relative search volume (RSV) data were collected for 2025 for parent-facing and brand-specific pediatric myopia-control spectacle lens search terms, with MiSight-related searches analyzed as a contemporaneous comparator. Search terms were selected a priori to capture both direct interest in the Stellest product and broader public interest in pediatric myopia-control spectacle lenses. A composite interest index was constructed by averaging RSV values for the following terms: "stellest", "stellest lenses", "essilor", "essilor stellest", "myopia control glasses", "pediatric myopia glasses", and "HALT lens". To account for general seasonality in children's eyewear searches, a baseline index was generated using the mean RSV of "kids glasses", "children's glasses", and "eyeglasses for kids", and a normalized interest ratio (composite ÷ baseline) was calculated. Pre- and post-authorization differences were compared using two-sided p-values. RESULTS: From 2025-01-05 to 2025-10-26 (37 pre- and six post-weeks), mean composite interest rose from 9.39 pre to 18.6 post (absolute +9.21, +98%; p = 0.024). The mean ratio to baseline increased from 0.353 to 0.694 (absolute +0.34, +96.3%; p = 0.016). MiSight-related searches remained stable over the same period, supporting a modality-specific response to Stellest authorization. CONCLUSIONS: Public search interest in pediatric myopia-control spectacle lenses increased markedly following FDA authorization of Essilor Stellest, with normalization suggesting growth beyond seasonal effects. These findings demonstrate increased online search activity surrounding pediatric myopia-control spectacles after authorization, which may help clinicians anticipate heightened patient and parent inquiries, although search interest does not directly reflect awareness, clinical adoption, or prescribing behavior.

Effect of increased power and asphericity of lenslets on myopia control efficacy: 6-month interim results of a contralateral crossover clinical trial

👥 Rajkumar Nallour Raveendran, Wee Sing Ong, Ee Woon Lim, Si Ying Lim, Hua Ren Chua, Bjorn Drobe
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-1-1 —研究摘要 试验设计简述：单中心、前瞻性、随机化、双盲、双眼对照、交叉设计 试验组样本量：25人，HALT MAX半年→HALT半年 vs HALT半年→HALT MAX半年 AL：进展量0.043mm，控制量-0.062mm,控制率59%
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控2.0 / 1年临床试验 / 2-1-1
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：评估通过同时提高微透镜的光度和非球面度，能否进一步提高高非球面微透镜镜片（H.A.L.T.）的近视控制效果。 方法：在一项单中心、前瞻性、随机、双盲、对侧眼交叉、优效性临床试验中，纳入50名新加坡儿童（年龄8.6±1.2岁，近视-0.50至-4.75 D，散光≤2.00 D，屈光参差≤1.00 D）。儿童被随机分为两组（每组25人），一组右眼配戴H.A.L.T. MAX（增加微透镜平均光度和非球面度）、左眼配戴H.A.L.T.，另一组佩戴相反组合；6个月后两组佩戴组合进行交叉。主要结局指标为眼轴长度（AL）变化，本报告为6个月中期结果。 结果：基线时配戴H.A.L.T.与H.A.L.T. MAX眼的平均AL分别为23.97±0.84 mm与23.99±0.84 mm（p=0.89），等效球镜度分别为-1.90±0.97 D与-1.90±0.98 D（p=0.92）。6个月内无受试者脱落，平均每天配戴时间为13.7±2.2小时。与H.A.L.T.相比，H.A.L.T. MAX显著减缓了平均AL变化（0.043±0.016 mm 对比 0.105±0.016 mm，p<0.001），即6个月时H.A.L.T. MAX的眼轴增长比H.A.L.T.减缓了59%。 结论：在减缓儿童眼轴增长方面，采用H.A.L.T. MAX技术的镜片比H.A.L.T.镜片更有效，表明提高微透镜的光度和非球面度可提升近视控制疗效。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose Spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets demonstrated to be effective in slowing myopia progression and axial elongation. The objective of this study was to evaluate whether the myopia control efficacy of those lenses could be further improved by a combined increase of power and asphericity of lenslets. Methods Fifty Singaporean children [8.6 ± 1.2 years], myopia between -0.50 and -4.75 D, astigmatism ≤2.00 D and anisometropia ≤1.00 D were enrolled in a monocentric, prospective, randomized, double-masked, contralateral, crossover, superiority clinical trial. Two different myopia control spectacle lenses were used in this study: spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets target (H.A.L.T.) technology and spectacle lenses with maximized H.A.L.T. (H.A.L.T. MAX) technology (increased average power and asphericity of lenslets). The recruited children were randomized into two groups of 25 each. One group was assigned to wear H.A.L.T. MAX on right eye and H.A.L.T. on left eye and the other group was assigned to wear the reverse combination. After six months, the combinations were crossed over between the two groups for the next six months. The primary outcome was the change in axial length (AL) measured using a Lenstar LS 900 (Haag-Streit). Results were analyzed based on lens groups and the 6-month interim results are reported here. Results At the baseline, mean±SE AL of eyes wearing H.A.L.T. was 23.97±0.84 mm and H.A.L.T. MAX was 23.99±0.84 mm (p=0.89) and spherical equivalent of eyes wearing H.A.L.T. was -1.90 ± 0.97D and H.A.L.T. MAX was -1.90 ± 0.98D (p=0.92). After 6-months, no children discontinued from the study. Average wearing time of study spectacles was 13.7±2.2 hours. H.A.L.T. MAX significantly slowed mean (±SE) changes in AL (0.043±0.016) compared to H.A.L.T. (0.105±0.016 mm, p<0.001), i.e., after 6 months, axial elongation was 59% slower with H.A.L.T. MAX than with H.A.L.T. Conclusions Spectacles lenses with H.A.L.T. MAX technology were more efficacious than spectacle lenses with H.A.L.T. technology in slowing axial elongation in children, which suggested that increased power and asphericity of lenslets result in increased myopia control efficacy.

MAX）技术的镜片（该镜片提高了小透镜的平均屈光力与非球面度）。入选儿童被随机分为两组，每组 25 人。一组被分配为右眼佩戴 H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片、左眼佩戴 H.A.L.T. 镜片，另一组则佩戴相反组合的镜片。6 个月后，两组儿童佩戴的镜片组合进行交叉互换，进入下一个 6 个月的观察期。主要结局指标为眼轴长度（AL）的变化，采用 Lenstar LS 900 眼轴测量仪（Haag-Streit 公司）进行测量。按镜片类型分组对结果进行分析，本文报告的是 6 个月中期结果。 结果：基线时，佩戴 H.A.L.T. 镜片眼的眼轴长度（AL）平均值 ± 标准误（SE）为 23.97±0.84 mm，佩戴 H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片眼的眼轴长度平均值 ± 标准误为 23.99±0.84 mm（p=0.89）佩戴 H.A.L.T. 镜片眼的等效球镜度数为 - 1.90±0.97 D，佩戴 H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片眼的等效球镜度数为 - 1.90±0.98 D（p=0.92）。6 个月观察期结束后，无儿童退出研究。研究镜片的平均佩戴时间为 13.7±2.2 小时。与 H.A.L.T. 镜片相比（眼轴长度变化：0.105±0.016 mm），H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片显著延缓了眼轴长度的平均（± 标准误）变化（0.043±0.016 mm，p<0.001），即 6 个月后，H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片组的眼轴增长速度比 H.A.L.T. 镜片组慢 59%。 结论：在延缓儿童眼轴增长方面，含 H.A.L.T. MAX 技术的框架眼镜比含 H.A.L.T. 技术的框架眼镜更有效，这表明提高小透镜的屈光力与非球面度可提升近视控制效果。

Effect of Increased Power and Asphericity of Highly Aspherical Lenslets on Myopia Control Efficacy: A Contralateral Crossover Study

HALT MAX vs HAL-crossover—1年结果 HALT MAX 更优

📖 Translational vision science & technology📅 2025年👥 Nallour Raveendran Rajkumar, Ong Wee Sing, Wong Yee Ling, Zhan Stella Jinran, Lee Chun Fan, Lim Si Ying, Drobe Björn
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-1-2：HALT MAX vs HAL-crossover—1年结果 HALT MAX 更优 起始时间：2023年11月 研究中心&PI：Essilor R&D Centre Singapore & Björn Drobe 试验设计简述：RCT，双盲、双眼交叉、优效性临床试验 试验组样本量：50人 阶段一 SE：HAL进展量：−0.20D ；HALT MAX进展量：-0.11D控制量：0.09D；控制率：45%（无显著差异）; AL：HAL进展量：0.105mm ； HALT MAX进展量：0.043mm，控制量：-0.062mm；控制率：59% 阶段二 HAL→HALT MAX: - 0.10D, 0.077mm HALT MAX→HAL: -0.22D, 0.123mm
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控2.0 / 1年临床试验 / 2-1-2
原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在评估通过联合增加微透镜的度数和非球面度，采用高非球面微透镜靶向（H.A.L.T.）技术的眼镜片是否能进一步提升近视控制效果。 方法：纳入 50 名 6 至 10 岁的新加坡近视儿童，开展一项随机、双眼交叉的临床试验。测试两种不同的近视控制眼镜片：采用 H.A.L.T. 技术的镜片和采用强化型 H.A.L.T.（H.A.L.T. MAX）技术的镜片。一组（25 人）被分配为右眼佩戴 H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片、左眼佩戴 H.A.L.T. 镜片，另一组（25 人）佩戴相反组合，为期 6 个月。接下来的 6 个月交换镜片组合。主要结局指标为眼轴长度（AL）的变化。 结果：基线时，佩戴 H.A.L.T. 镜片和 H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片的眼睛，其平均眼轴长度（± 标准差）分别为 23.97±0.84 毫米和 23.99±0.84 毫米。第一个 6 个月后，佩戴 H.A.L.T. 镜片和 H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片的眼睛，其平均眼轴增长（± 标准误）分别为 0.105±0.016 毫米和 0.043±0.016 毫米（P<0.001）。交叉后，相应的平均眼轴长度变化分别为 0.123±0.014 毫米和 0.077±0.013 毫米（P<0.001）。两个阶段中，两种镜片的眼轴长度变化差异均与佩戴 H.A.L.T. 镜片时更快的眼轴增长相关。 结论：采用 H.A.L.T. MAX 技术的眼镜片比采用 H.A.L.T. 技术的眼镜片更能有效减缓眼轴增长，且可能对眼轴增长较快的儿童尤为有益。 转化意义：微透镜的光学特性与眼轴增长之间的关系，为研发更有效的近视控制镜片提供了新方向。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: The study aims to evaluate whether the myopia control efficacy of spectacle lenses with Highly Aspherical Lenslet Target (H.A.L.T.) technology could be further improved by a combined increase of power and asphericity of lenslets. METHODS: Fifty Singaporean myopic children aged 6 to 10 years were enrolled in a randomized, contralateral, crossover clinical trial. Two different myopia control spectacle lenses were tested: lenses with H.A.L.T. technology and lenses with maximized H.A.L.T. (H.A.L.T. MAX) technology. One group (N = 25) was assigned to wear H.A.L.T. MAX on the right eye and H.A.L.T. on the left eye, and the other group (N = 25) to wear the opposite combination for 6 months. The combinations were switched for the next 6 months. The primary outcome was the change in axial length (AL). RESULTS: At baseline, mean (±SD) AL of eyes wearing H.A.L.T. and H.A.L.T. MAX lenses was 23.97 ± 0.84 and 23.99 ± 0.84 mm. After the first 6 months, mean (±SEM) axial elongation in eyes wearing H.A.L.T. and H.A.L.T. MAX lenses was 0.105 ± 0.016 and 0.043 ± 0.016 mm (P < 0.001), respectively. After the crossover, the corresponding mean AL change was 0.123 ± 0.014 and 0.077 ± 0.013 mm (P < 0.001). The differences in AL change between the two lenses were correlated with faster axial elongation with H.A.L.T. lenses in both phases. CONCLUSIONS: Spectacle lenses with H.A.L.T. MAX technology slowed axial elongation more effectively than spectacle lenses with H.A.L.T. technology and might be particularly beneficial for children with faster axial elongation. TRANSLATIONAL RELEVANCE: The relationship between the optical characteristics of lenslets and axial elongation offers a new avenue for developing more effective myopia control lenses.

Effect of increased power and asphericity of lenslets in myopia control spectacle lenses on short-term visual performance

HALTMAX vs HALT-高/低对比度视力

👥 Bjorn Drobe, Soheil M. Doustkouhi, Ee Woon Lim, Si Ying Lim, Rajkumar Nallour Raveendran
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-1 HALTMAX vs HALT-高/低对比度视力 结论：与 HALT镜片相比，HALT MAX镜片中微透镜的度数增加与非球面度提高，对高对比度及低对比度视力均无显著影响。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星趣控2.0 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-1
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：评估H.A.L.T.镜片与提高微透镜光度及非球面度的H.A.L.T. MAX镜片对高对比度和低对比度视力的影响。 方法：纳入最佳矫正视力（BCVA）≤0.1 logMAR的成年受试者（21至39岁）。采用弗莱堡视力测试（FrACT）评估3米处的高对比度（100%）和低对比度（10%）远视力（N=20），以及40厘米处的低对比度（10%）近视力（N=10）。将近视控制镜片安装在试镜架上叠加于标准矫正镜片上，用不透明胶带遮盖中央清晰区以确保受试者仅通过微透镜区域（第4至第6环之间）注视；以标准单光平光镜片（SVL）作为对照。所有测量均仅在右眼进行（遮盖左眼），每项测试和镜片重复两次，镜片评估顺序随机，采用配对t检验分析视力结果。 结果：在对SVL进行标准化后，两种近视控制镜片在高对比度远视力（H.A.L.T.为0.11±0.01 logMAR，H.A.L.T. MAX为0.12±0.02 logMAR，p=0.79）、低对比度远视力（H.A.L.T.为0.12±0.02 logMAR，H.A.L.T. MAX为0.14±0.03 logMAR，p=0.49）及低对比度近视力（H.A.L.T.为0.14±0.01 logMAR，H.A.L.T. MAX为0.16±0.02 logMAR，p=0.35）方面均无显著差异。 结论：与H.A.L.T.镜片相比，H.A.L.T. MAX镜片增加微透镜光度和非球面度对高对比度和低对比度视力均无显著影响。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose Spectacles with highly aspherical lenslets target (H.A.L.T.) technology demonstrated to be effective in slowing down myopia progression and axial elongation. Recently, we developed maximized H.A.L.T. [H.A.L.T. MAX] technology with increased power and asphericity of lenslets. The objective of this study was to evaluate the impact of H.A.L.T and H.A.L.T. MAX lenses on high and low contrast visual acuity. Methods Adult observers [age: 21 to 39 years] with BCVA ≤0.1 logMAR were enrolled in the study. Freiburg Visual Acuity Test (FrACT) was used to assess high contrast (100%) and low contrast (10%) distance visual acuity (VA) at 3m [N=20], and low contrast (10%) near VA at 40cm [N=10]. Myopia control lenses were mounted on a trial frame over the standard correction, ensuring participants viewed through the lenslets zone (between the 4th & 6th ring). To ensure viewing only through the lenslets zone, central clear zone was patched using an opaque tape. Standard single vision plano lenses (SVL) served as control and similar arrangements were made for SVL. All the measures were performed only on the right eye (left eye patched) and two trials per test and lens were done. The order of the lenses assessed was randomized. A paired t-test was used to analyze the results of VA. Results After normalizing to SVL, there was no significant difference between the two myopia control lenses in high contrast distance VA (H.A.L.T.= 0.11±0.01 logMAR; H.A.L.T. MAX=0.12±0.02 logMAR, p=0.79), low contrast distance VA (H.A.L.T.=0.12±0.02 logMAR; H.A.L.T. MAX=0.14±0.03 logMAR, p=0.49), and low contrast near VA (H.A.L.T.= 0.14±0.01 logMAR; H.A.L.T. MAX=0.16±0.02 logMAR, p=0.35). Conclusions Increased power and asphericity of lenslets in H.A.L.T. MAX lenses had no significant effect on high and low contrast visual acuity, compared with H.A.L.T. lenses.

MAX，即 H.A.L.T. 增强版）技术，该技术中微透镜的度数与非球面度均有所提高。本研究旨在评估 H.A.L.T. 镜片与 H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片对高对比度及低对比度视力的影响。 方法：本研究纳入年龄为 21-39 岁、最佳矫正视力（BCVA）≤0.1 对数最小分辨角（logMAR）的成年受试者。采用弗莱堡视力测试（FrACT）评估以下指标：3 米处高对比度（100%）远视力（VA）与低对比度（10%）远视力（VA）[样本量 N=20]，以及 40 厘米处低对比度（10%）近视力（VA）[样本量 N=10]。将近视控制镜片装配在试戴架上，置于标准矫正镜片前方，确保受试者通过微透镜区域（第 4 环至第 6 环之间）视物。为确保仅通过微透镜区域视物，用不透明胶带遮盖镜片的中央清晰区。以标准单光平光镜片（SVL）作为对照，且对 SVL 镜片采用相同的设置。所有测量仅对右眼进行（左眼遮盖），每种镜片的每项测试均进行 2 次。镜片的评估顺序采用随机化设计，采用配对 t 检验分析视力测试结果。 结果：以 SVL 镜片为基准进行标准化后，两种近视控制镜片在以下指标上均无显著差异：高对比度远视力 [H.A.L.T. 镜片 = 0.11±0.01 对数最小分辨角（logMAR）；H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片 = 0.12±0.02 对数最小分辨角（logMAR），概率值 p=0.79]、低对比度远视力 [H.A.L.T. 镜片 = 0.12±0.02 对数最小分辨角（logMAR）；H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片 = 0.14±0.03 对数最小分辨角（logMAR），概率值 p=0.49]，以及低对比度近视力 [H.A.L.T. 镜片 = 0.14±0.01 对数最小分辨角（logMAR）；H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片 = 0.16±0.02 对数最小分辨角（logMAR），概率值 p=0.35]。 结论：与 H.A.L.T. 镜片相比，H.A.L.T. MAX 镜片中微透镜的度数增加与非球面度提高，对高对比度及低对比度视力均无显著影响。

Control of myopia using diffusion optics spectacle lenses: 12-month results of a randomised controlled, efficacy and safety study (CYPRESS)

CYPRESS

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2023年👥 Rappon Joe, Chung Carol, Young Graeme, Hunt Christopher, Neitz Jay, Neitz Maureen, Chalberg Thomas
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-1-1 CYPRESS 起始时间：2018年7月 研究中心&PI：14 sites in North America & Joe Rappon 试验设计简述：多中心、随机、对照、双盲临床试验 试验组样本量：Test1- DOT 0.2（扩散点间距0.365 mm）组88人；Test2（扩散点间距0.240 mm）组75人 SE：Test1进展量-0.14D，控制量0.4D，控制率74% ；Test2进展量-0.22D，控制量0.32D，控制率59% AL：Test1进展量0.15mm，控制量-0.15mm,控制率50% ；Test2进展量0.20mm，控制量-0.1mm,控制率33%
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 控优点/柯学优 / 1年临床试验 / 2-1-1
原文摘要
摘要 背景 ：L/M锥细胞视蛋白基因阵列的突变会导致感知到的视网膜对比度异常升高，并引发近视。环境因素也可能导致视觉对比度升高，进而诱发近视。漫射光学技术（DOT）镜片旨在降低视网膜的对比度信号传导，从而减缓近视进展。 方法 ：“采用周边漫射镜片控制近视的有效性与安全性研究”（CYPRESS，临床试验注册号：NCT03623074）是一项为期 36 个月的多中心、随机对照、双盲试验，旨在评估两种试验性眼镜镜片与对照镜片在 6-10 岁近视儿童中的效果，计划在 12 个月时进行中期分析。主要终点指标为眼轴长度（AL）和球镜当量屈光度（SER）较基线的变化值。 结果 ：共为 256 名儿童（女性占 58%；筛查时平均年龄为 8.1 岁）配发了眼镜。所有组别的基线平均值如下：眼轴长度（AL）为 24.02 mm（标准差 ±0.77 mm）；采用主观验光测得的球镜当量屈光度（SER）为 - 2.01 D（标准差 ±0.9 D）；采用睫状肌麻痹自动验光测得的 SER 为 - 1.94 D（标准差 ±1.0 D）。12 个月时，试验组 1 与对照组相比，SER 进展的平均差异为 - 0.40 D（p<0.0001），意味着近视进展减缓 74%；试验组 2 与对照组相比，SER 进展的平均差异为 - 0.32 D（p<0.0001），意味着近视进展减缓 59%。眼轴长度（AL）进展方面，试验组 1 与对照组的差异为 0.15 mm（p<0.0001），试验组 2 与对照组的差异为 0.10 mm（p=0.0018）。 结论 ：这项正在进行的试验的 12 个月结果表明，漫射光学技术（DOT）眼镜在减缓近视进展方面具有安全性和有效性。 2-1-2 CATHAY - 全文
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: Mutations in the L/M cone opsin gene array cause abnormally high perceived retinal contrast and the development of myopia. Environmental factors may also lead to high visual contrast and cause myopia. Diffusion optics technology (DOT) lenses are designed to reduce contrast signalling in the retina and slow myopia progression. METHODS: The Control of Myopia Using Peripheral Diffusion Lenses Efficacy and Safety Study (CYPRESS, NCT03623074) is a 36-month, multicentre, randomised, controlled, double-masked trial evaluating two investigational spectacle lenses versus control lenses in myopic children aged 6-10, with a planned interim analysis at 12 months. The primary endpoints are change from baseline in axial length (AL) and spherical equivalent refraction (SER). RESULTS: 256 children (58% female; mean age at screening, 8.1 years) were dispensed spectacles. Across all groups, baseline averages were AL 24.02 mm (SD±0.77 mm), SER -2.01 D (SD±0.9 D) using manifest refraction, and SER -1.94 D (SD±1.0 D) using cycloplegic autorefraction. At 12 months, mean difference in SER progression for test 1 versus control was -0.40 D (p<0.0001), representing a 74% reduction and -0.32 D for Test 2 (p<0.0001), representing a 59% reduction. The difference in AL progression for test 1 versus control was 0.15 mm (p<0.0001) and test 2 versus control was 0.10 mm (p=0.0018). CONCLUSION: 12-month results from this ongoing trial demonstrate the safety and effectiveness of DOT spectacles for reducing myopic progression.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 控优点/柯学优 / H/1年临床试验；H/1年临床试验 / 2-1-2
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：在中国近视儿童人群中评估对比度调控镜片（DOT镜片）的安全性和有效性。 方法：该研究（NCT05562622）是一项在中国5家医院开展的为期24个月的随机对照临床试验，比较DOT镜片与标准单光对照镜片在6至13岁近视儿童中的疗效，计划在12个月时进行中期分析。主要终点为眼轴长度（AL）和睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度（cSER）较基线的变化。 结果：共纳入195名受试者，按2:1比例配发研究镜片，12个月前有9例非镜片相关的脱落（DOT组2例，对照组7例）。186名儿童完成了12个月随访（男占48%，筛选时平均年龄9.6岁；DOT组128名，对照组58名）。基线平均（±SD）AL为24.45±0.80 mm，cSER为-2.27±0.85 D。12个月时，DOT组较基线的平均变化（±SE）无统计学意义，AL为0.09±0.10 mm（95%CI: -0.10~0.29，p=0.34），cSER为-0.17±0.11 D（95%CI: -0.38~0.05，p=0.13）；而对照组变化显著，AL为0.35±0.16 mm（95%CI: -0.66~-0.04，p=0.03），cSER为-0.64±0.16 D（95%CI: -0.96~-0.32，p=0.0001）。12个月时DOT组对比对照组的AL进展差异显著（相差0.26 mm，p<0.0001），延缓了74%；cSER进展差异亦显著（相差-0.48 D，p<0.0001），延缓了75%。 结论：该进行中试验的12个月结果证实了DOT对比度调控镜片减缓中国儿童近视进展的安全性和有效性，证实了DOT镜片能显著延缓不同人群儿童的近视进展。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose : Diffusion Optics Technology (DOT) lenses are designed to slow myopia progression by reducing contrast signaling in the retina. A recent 4-year multicenter clinical trial demonstrated DOT lenses are safe and effective at slowing the progression of myopia in North American children. The purpose of this research was to evaluate the safety and efficacy of DOT spectacle lenses in a Chinese population, where the prevalence and severity of myopia is even greater. Methods : The study (NCT05562622) is a 24-month, randomized and controlled clinical trial across 5 Chinese hospital sites, evaluating DOT spectacle lenses versus control standard single vision spectacle lenses in myopic children aged 6–13, with a planned interim analysis at 12 months (M). The primary endpoints are change from baseline in axial length (AL) and cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (cSER). Results : A total of 195 participants were enrolled, ranging from 30 to 51 at each of the 5 sites. There were 9 non lens related discontinuations prior to 12M (2 DOT, 7 control). Participants were dispensed study lenses in a 2:1 ratio. 186 children completed the 12M visit (48% male; mean age at screening 9.6 years;128 DOT, 58 Control). Baseline average (±SD) AL and cSER were 24.45 mm (0.80) and −2.27 D (0.85), respectively. For DOT wearers, the mean changes ± SE at 12M from baseline in AL and cSER were not significant, with AL being 0.09 ± 0.10 mm (95%CI: -0.10 to 0.29, p=0.34) and cSER being -0.17 ± 0.11D (95%CI: -0.38 to 0.05, p=0.13). For the control group, the mean changes at 12M from baseline were significant; AL 0.35 ± 0.16 mm (95%CI: -0.66 to -0.04, p=0.03) and cSER -0.64 ± 0.16D (95%CI: -0.96 to -0.32, p=0.0001). The difference in AL progression for DOT versus control at 12M was significant (0.26 mm, p<0.0001), representing a 74% reduction compared to control. The difference in cSER progression for DOT versus control was also significant (−0.48D, p<0.0001), representing a 75% reduction. Conclusions : 12M results from this ongoing trial demonstrate the safety and effectiveness of DOT contrast modulating spectacles for reducing myopic progression in Chinese children. These findings support the year one results from North American research and demonstrate DOT lenses can significantly slow myopia in children from diverse populations.

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-1-3 DOTvsSVL-退轴效果-CATHAY研究的部分内容-摘要 设计：124 DOT vs 62 SVL，配戴6个月 结论：对照组有5%的儿童出现眼轴缩短（平均-0.04 mm），而DOT™镜片组有49%的儿童出现眼轴缩短（平均-0.11 mm）。两组在眼轴变化方向上的差异具有统计学显著性，并且眼轴长度变化与屈光度变化之间存在显著相关性。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 控优点/柯学优 / 1年临床试验 / 2-1-3
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：探讨配戴对比度调控镜片（DOT™）后儿童出现眼轴长度缩短的发生率，并研究其与其他变量的相互影响。 方法：在一项5个研究中心开展的为期2年的随机对照临床试验中（NCT05562622），纳入186名6至13岁、近视度数为-0.75 D至-5.00 D的中国儿童，按2:1比例分配佩戴DOT™镜片或标准单光对照镜片。在基线和佩戴6个月后测量眼轴长度（AL）和睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度（cSER），并根据6个月时AL变化将受试者细分为AL缩短组（变化量<0 mm）与AL增长组（变化量>0 mm），分析AL变化与cSER变化、基线AL、基线cSER、年龄、性别及既往配镜史的关系。 结果：佩戴6个月后，对照组中有5%的儿童出现AL缩短（n=3，平均AL变化±SD：-0.04±0.02 mm），而DOT™镜片组中有49%出现AL缩短（n=63，平均AL变化：-0.11±0.09 mm）。对照组95%出现AL增长（n=55，平均AL变化：0.20±0.12 mm），DOT™组51%出现AL增长（n=65，平均AL变化：0.13±0.11 mm）。镜片分组与AL变化存在显著关联（Fisher精确检验，p<0.001）。AL变化与cSER变化显著相关（R2=0.584，p<0.001）；AL变化与其他调查变量之间未观察到显著相关性。 结论：近半数DOT™镜片组儿童在佩戴6个月后出现眼轴缩短，观察到的AL缩短幅度提示可能存在多种眼部结构的重塑。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: Multiple clinical trials have observed a small proportion of children undergo an initial reduction in axial length with defocus-based myopia control treatment, which has primarily been attributed to choroidal thickening. The purpose of this research was to explore the incidence of axial length reduction with contrast modulation spectacle lenses (Diffusion Optics Technology™, DOT™), and to investigate interaction with other variables. Methods: One hundred and eighty-six Chinese children aged 6 to 13 years with myopia from -0.75 D to -5.00 D were enrolled in a 2-year randomised controlled clinical trial across 5 sites (NCT05562622). The children were allocated to wear either DOT™ spectacle lenses or standard single vision Control lenses in a 2:1 ratio. Axial Length (AL) and cycloplegic Spherical Equivalent Refraction (cSER) were measured at baseline and after 6 months of wear. The DOT™ and Control groups were subdivided into two groups based on AL progression after 6-months of study lens wear: AL reduction (<0 mm change) or AL elongation (>0 mm change). The relationships between change in AL and change in cSER, baseline AL, baseline cSER, age, gender and previous lens wear were explored. Results: After 6 months of wear, AL reduction was observed in 5% of the Control group (n=3, mean AL change ± SD: -0.04 ± 0.02 mm) and 49% of the DOT™ lens group (n=63, mean AL change: -0.11 ± 0.09 mm). AL elongation was observed in 95% of the Control group (n=55, mean AL change: 0.20 ± 0.12 mm) and 51% of the DOT™ lens group (n=65, mean AL change: 0.13 ± 0.11 mm). There was a significant association between lens group and AL change (Fisher’s exact test, p<0.001). Change in AL significantly correlated with change in cSER (R2=0.584, p<0.001). No significant relationships were observed between change in AL and the other variables investigated. Conclusion: Almost half of the DOT™ lens group experienced a reduction in AL after 6 months of wear. The magnitude of the observed AL reduction implicates remodeling of multiple ocular structures. IMC 2024 poster.pdf 来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：摘要 目的：多项临床试验观察到，在基于离焦的近视控制治疗中，有一小部分儿童会出现眼轴长度的初始缩短，这一现象主要归因于脉络膜增厚。本研究旨在探讨儿童佩戴对比度调节镜片（扩散光学技术™，DOT™）后眼轴长度缩短的发生率，并研究该情况与其他变量的相互关系。 方法：在 5 个研究中心开展的一项为期 2 年的随机对照临床试验（NCT05562622）中，纳入了 186 名 6-13 岁、近视度数为 - 0.75 屈光度至 - 5.00 屈光度的中国儿童。儿童按 2:1 的比例被分配至两组，分别佩戴 DOT™镜片或标准单光对照镜片。在基线时（试验开始前）和佩戴镜片 6 个月后，分别测量儿童的眼轴长度（AL）和睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度数（cSER）。根据佩戴研究镜片 6 个月后的眼轴长度变化情况，将 DOT™组和对照组进一步细分为两个亚组：眼轴长度缩短组（变化值 <0 毫米）和眼轴长度增长组（变化值> 0 毫米）。研究探讨了眼轴长度变化与以下因素之间的关系：睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度数变化、基线眼轴长度、基线睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度数、年龄、性别及既往镜片佩戴情况。 结果：佩戴镜片 6 个月后，对照组中 5% 的儿童（n=3，眼轴长度平均变化 ± 标准差：-0.04±0.02 毫米）和 DOT™镜片组中 49% 的儿童（n=63，眼轴长度平均变化：-0.11±0.09 毫米）观察到眼轴长度缩短。对照组中 95% 的儿童（n=55，眼轴长度平均变化：0.20±0.12 毫米）和 DOT™镜片组中 51% 的儿童（n=65，眼轴长度平均变化：0.13±0.11 毫米）观察到眼轴长度增长。镜片组与眼轴长度变化之间存在显著关联（Fisher 精确检验，p<0.001）。眼轴长度变化与睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度数变化呈显著相关（R²=0.584，p<0.001）。未观察到眼轴长度变化与其他所研究变量之间存在显著关联。 结论：佩戴 6 个月后，DOT™镜片组中近一半儿童的眼轴长度出现缩短。观察到的眼轴长度缩短幅度表明存在多种眼部结构的重塑。要确定初始眼轴长度变化是否可预测某一治疗方案对个体儿童的近视控制效果，还需进一步的纵向随访研究。

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-2-1 CYPRESS 全时佩戴者亚组2年疗效 起始时间：2018年7月 研究中心&PI：14 sites in North America & Joe Rappon 试验设计简述：多中心、双盲、随机、对照临床试验 试验组样本量：Test 1: 61人；Test 2: 45人 SE：Test 1进展量-0.36D，控制量0.52D，控制率59% ；Test 2进展量-0.48D，控制量0.4D，控制率45% AL：Test 1进展量0.33mm，控制量-0.20mm,控制率38% ； Test 2进展量0.34mm，控制量-0.19mm,控制率36%
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 控优点/柯学优 / 2年临床试验 / 2-2-1
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：评估新型视网膜对比度调节眼镜镜片（DOT镜片）全天佩戴者在2年内延缓儿童近视进展的有效性。 方法：CYPRESS试验（NCT03623074）是一项在北美14个临床中心开展的多中心、双盲、随机对照研究，纳入256名6-10岁近视儿童，随机分配佩戴两款微降低对比度的新型试验镜片（Test 1、Test 2）或单光对照镜片，评估3年内延缓近视进展的能力。“全天佩戴者”定义为家长报告在近距离用眼时不摘下眼镜的儿童。在基线和年度随访（截至24个月）测量眼轴长度（AL）和睫状肌麻痹自动验光等效球镜度（SER）。 结果：约三分之二受试者符合“全天佩戴者”标准（Test 1组61人，Test 2组45人，对照组66人）。随访24个月后，Test 1、Test 2和对照组较基线的平均（±SD）AL变化分别为0.33±0.23 mm、0.34±0.39 mm和0.53±0.33 mm；平均SER变化分别为-0.36±0.54 D、-0.48±0.85 D和-0.88±0.77 D。Test 1组与对照组相比，AL变化差异（-0.21 mm）和SER变化差异（0.52 D）均具有统计学显著性（p<0.0001）。 结论：DOT镜片旨在通过降低视网膜对比度来延缓近视进展。使用24个月后，全天佩戴DOT镜片的受试者近视进展显著少于对照组受试者。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose : New therapies are urgently needed to slow or stop myopia progression in children, and therefore reduce the risk of long-term, sight-threatening complications from myopia. The discovery that polymorphisms at the myopia genetic locus, MYP1, are associated with splicing-defective cone opsin genes (OPN1LW and OPN1MW) led to the hypothesis that contrast signaling in the retina plays an important role in myopia development and progression. This hypothesis predicted that reducing the contrast of images on the retina could slow myopia progression. Novel spectacle lenses (DOT lenses) were developed to evaluate this hypothesis, and a multi-center, double-masked, randomized, controlled clinical trial was initiated. Methods : CYPRESS (NCT03623074) evaluated two investigational spectacle lenses (Test 1, Test 2) designed to slightly reduce contrast compared to control spectacle lenses for the ability to reduce myopia progression in children 6-10 years of age over a period of 3 years. Two hundred and fifty-six (256) eligible myopic subjects were randomized and dispensed spectacles at 14 clinical sites in North America. Subjects were asked to wear the study spectacles constantly, except for activities in which standard spectacle wear would be inappropriate, such as contact sports and swimming. “Full time wearers” were defined as those subjects whose parents reported that they did not remove the study spectacles for near vision activities. Axial length (AL) and cycloplegic autorefraction (SER) were measured at baseline and annual follow-up visits, now through 24-months. Results : Approximately two-thirds of study subjects (61, 45, and 66 in Test 1, Test 2, and Control, respectively) met criteria for “full-time wearers”. After 24-months, the mean (± SD) change from baseline in AL was 0.33 ± 0.23, 0.34 ± 0.39, and 0.53 ± 0.33 mm for Test 1, Test 2, and Control respectively. The mean change from baseline in SER after 24-months of usage was -0.36 ± 0.54, -0.48 ± 0.85, and -0.88 ± 0.77 D for Test 1, Test 2, and Control, respectively. The difference in means (Test 1 minus Control) for change from baseline of AL (-0.21 mm) and SER (0.52 D) were statistically significant (p<0.0001). Conclusions : DOT spectacle lenses were designed to reduce retinal contrast to slow the progression of myopia. After 24-months of usage, subjects who wore DOT lenses full-time had less myopia progression than control subjects.

来源=桌面《框架眼镜SP》/03 尼康控优点or柯达柯学优 DOT/2-2-1 CYPRESS 2年 TWO-YEAR EFFECTIVENESS OF A NOVEL MYOPIA MANAGEMENT SPECTACLE LENS WITH FULL-TIME WEARERS _ IOVS _ ARVO Journals.pdf 来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：摘要 目的：目前迫切需要新的疗法来延缓或阻止儿童近视进展，进而降低近视相关的长期、致盲性并发症风险。研究发现，近视基因位点 MYP1 的多态性与剪接缺陷型视锥细胞视蛋白基因（OPN1LW 和 OPN1MW）相关，这一发现引出假说：视网膜对比度信号传导在近视的发生与进展中发挥重要作用。该假说推测，降低视网膜上图像的对比度可延缓近视进展。为验证这一假说，研究人员研发了新型镜片（DOT 镜片），并启动了一项多中心、双盲、随机、对照临床试验。 方法：CYPRESS 试验（试验编号 NCT03623074）对两种试验用镜片（试验组 1、试验组 2）的效果进行评估。与对照组镜片相比，这两种试验用镜片设计目的为轻度降低对比度，评估其在 3 年内对 6-10 岁儿童近视进展的控制效果。在北美 14 个临床研究中心，256 名符合条件的近视受试者被随机分组并发放试验镜片。受试者需持续佩戴试验镜片，但在不适合佩戴普通眼镜的活动（如接触性运动、游泳）中除外。“全天佩戴者” 定义为其家长报告称，受试者在进行近距离视物活动时也不摘下试验镜片的人群。在基线时及年度随访中（目前已随访至 24 个月），对受试者的AL和SER进行了测量。 结果：约三分之二的受试者（试验组 1、试验组 2、对照组分别有 61 人、45 人、66 人）符合 “全天佩戴者” 标准。24 个月后，试验组 1、试验组 2、对照组的眼轴长度（AL）较基线的平均变化量（± 标准差）分别为 0.33±0.23 mm、0.34±0.39 mm、0.53±0.33 mm。使用 24 个月后，试验组 1、试验组 2、对照组的球镜当量（SER）较基线的平均变化量分别为 - 0.36±0.54 D（屈光度）、-0.48±0.85 D、-0.88±0.77 D。试验组 1 与对照组相比，AL较基线变化量的平均值差异（-0.21 mm）和SER较基线变化量的平均值差异（0.52 D）均具有统计学意义（p<0.0001）。 结论：DOT 镜片的设计目的是通过降低视网膜对比度来延缓近视进展。使用 24 个月后，全天佩戴 DOT 镜片的受试者比对照组受试者的近视进展程度更轻。

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：进一步评估对比度调节镜片（Diffusion Optics Technology™，DOT）在中国儿童人群中的近视控制有效性。 方法：该研究（NCT05562622）是一项在中国5家医院开展的为期24个月、随机（2:1比例）、盲法、对照临床试验，在6-13岁近视儿童中评估DOT镜片对比标准单光对照镜片的效果，并在18个月时进行预设中期分析。主要终点为眼轴长度（AL）较基线的变化，次要终点为睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度（cSER）。采用重复测量线性混合效应模型评估治疗效果随时间的变化。 结果：改良意向性治疗（mITT）人群包含186名受试者（男48%，平均年龄9.6岁；DOT组128人，对照组58人）。基线平均（±SD）AL为24.45±0.80 mm，cSER为-2.27±0.85 D。共171名儿童完成18个月随访（DOT组123人，对照组48人）。18个月时，DOT组较基线的最小二乘（LS）平均变化±SE中，AL为0.17±0.03 mm（95% CI: 0.12~0.22，p<0.0001），cSER为-0.20±0.05 D（95% CI: -0.30~-0.09，p=0.0004）；对照组AL为0.51±0.04 mm（95% CI: 0.44~0.58，p<0.0001），cSER为-0.89±0.08 D（95% CI: -1.06~-0.73，p<0.0001）。DOT组较对照组AL增长减少0.34 mm（95% CI: 0.25~0.42，p<0.0001），cSER进展减少0.70 D（95% CI: 0.50~0.89，p<0.0001）。DOT组有57%的儿童在18个月时无临床意义的进展（即≤0.25 D），而对照组仅为15%。 结论：中期分析结果表明，DOT镜片能有效延缓中国儿童至18个月时的眼轴增长和近视进展，支持了通过调节视网膜对比度可延缓不同人群儿童近视进展的假说。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
PURPOSE Contrast modulation spectacle lenses (Diffusion Optics Technology™; DOT) are designed to slow myopia progression by reducing contrast signaling in the retina. A 4-year multicenter clinical trial demonstrated DOT lenses are safe and effective at slowing the progression of myopia in North American children. The purpose of this study was to further evaluate the myopia control efficacy of DOT spectacle lenses in a Chinese population. METHODS The study (NCT05562622) is a 24-month, randomized (2:1 ratio), masked and controlled clinical trial across 5 Chinese hospitals, evaluating DOT spectacle lenses versus standard single vision control spectacle lenses in myopic children aged 6–13, with a planned interim analysis at 18 months (M). The primary endpoint is change from baseline in axial length (AL) and a secondary endpoint is cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (cSER). A linear mixed-effects model for repeated measures was fitted to the data to evaluate the treatment effect over time. RESULTS The modified intent-to-treat (mITT) group consist of 186 participants; 48% male; mean age 9.6 years;128 DOT, 58 Control. Baseline average (±SD) for AL and cSER were 24.45 mm (0.80) and −2.27 D (0.85), respectively. 171 children completed the 18M visit (123 DOT; 48 Control). For DOT wearers, the least square (LS) means changes ± SE at 18M from baseline in AL was 0.17 ± 0.03 mm (95%CI: 0.12 to 0.22, p<0.0001) and cSER was -0.20 ± 0.05 D (95%CI: -0.30 to -0.09, p=0.0004). For the control group, AL was 0.51 ± 0.04 mm (95%CI: 0.44 to 0.58, p<0.0001) and cSER was -0.89 ± 0.08 D (95%CI: -1.06 to -0.73, p<0.0001). Based on type 3 tests of fixed effects, estimates of the differences in AL elongation and cSER progression for DOT wearers was 0.34 mm (95%CI 0.25 to 0.42, p<0.0001) and 0.70 D (95% CI 0.50 to 0.89, p<0.0001) less than the control group, respectively. More than half (57%) of children wearing DOT lenses did not have clinically meaningful progression (ie 0.25 D) at 18M, compared to 15% with control. CONCLUSIONS Results from this ongoing trial demonstrate DOT spectacle lenses are effective at slowing axial elongation and myopia progression through to 18M in Chinese children. These results support the hypothesis that modulating retinal contrast can slow myopia progression in children from diverse populations.
