摘要 目的：评估近视管理眼镜镜片在成人中通过镜片中心和周边对两种距离下的高对比度与低对比度中心凹视力（VA）的即刻影响。 方法：在一项前瞻性、单次随访、双盲、四向随机交叉研究中，纳入20名18至30岁近视成人（女性16名，MSE为-4.25 D至-0.50 D，配戴球性软性角膜接触镜达到功能性正视），依次佩戴具有扩散光学技术（DOT）、多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）、高非球面微透镜（HAL）的镜片及单光（SV）平光镜片。分别通过镜片中心及周边（偏离光学中心10 mm）测量中心凹VA。受试者完成8项单眼任务：在远距（4 m）和近距（40 cm）下，通过镜片中心和周边测量高对比度（96%）和低对比度（10%）logMAR中心凹VA。 结果：中心远距高对比度（p=0.06）和低对比度（p=0.74）视力在所有镜片间均相似；与SV相比，中心近距DIMS的高对比度VA下降0.06±0.02 logMAR，HAL的低对比度VA下降0.05±0.01 logMAR（均p<0.05）。周边远距高对比度VA方面，DIMS镜片劣于SV（p<0.001）、DOT（p<0.001）和HAL（p<0.05）；与SV相比，DIMS高对比度VA在远距下降0.16±0.02 logMAR、近距下降0.13±0.01 logMAR；HAL的高对比度VA也较SV下降（远距：0.08±0.019 logMAR，p<0.01；近距：0.05±0.017 logMAR，p<0.05）；DOT镜片通过周边治疗区对远距（p=0.85）或近距（p=0.09）高对比度VA均无显著影响。低对比度测量方面，与SV对照相比，所有镜片均导致远距VA下降[DOT降低0.09 logMAR，HAL降低0.12 logMAR，DIMS降低0.17 logMAR]及近距VA下降[DOT降低0.11 logMAR，HAL降低0.10 logMAR，DIMS降低0.14 logMAR]（均p<0.001）。 结论：尽管三种近视管理镜片在中央区相对于SV对照均表现较好，但佩戴者的中心凹VA在周边治疗区受到不同程度的影响。具体而言，DOT镜片在治疗区提供了更优越的视力表现，与SV镜片相当。临床医生应注意这些周边视力差异并充分考虑视觉需求。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose : To profile the immediate effect of spectacle-based myopia management interventions on high- and low-contrast foveal visual acuity (VA) through lens centre and periphery at two distances in adults. Methods : Twenty myopic (MSE -4.25D to -0.50D) adults (16F); aged 18-30 years, rendered functionally emmetropic with spherical soft contact lenses wore, sequentially, lenses with Diffusion Optics Technology (DOT), Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS), Highly Aspherical Lenslets (HAL) and single vision (SV) plano spectacle lenses in a prospective, single-visit, double-blind, four-way randomised crossover study. Measures of foveal VA were taken through the lens centre and periphery (decentred 10mm from the optical centre). All participants completed eight monocular tasks: high- (96%) and low-contrast (10%) logMAR foveal VA at distance (4 m) and near (40 cm) through the lens centre and periphery. Results : Central- distance VA was similar across all lenses for high- (p=0.06) and low-contrast (p=0.74) letters, whilst central near DIMS lens high-contrast VA reduced by 0.06±0.02 logMAR and HAL low-contrast VA by 0.05±0.01 logMAR compared with SV (both p<0.05). Peripheral - distance high-contrast VA was worse with the DIMS lens than SV (p<0.001), DOT (p<0.001) and HAL lenses (p<0.05). DIMS lens high-contrast VA reduced by 0.16±0.02 logMAR (distance) and 0.13±0.01 logMAR (near) compared with SV. HAL also reduced high-contrast VA versus SV (distance: 0.08±0.019 logMAR, p<0.01; near: 0.05±0.017 logMAR, p<0.05). DOT lenses had no significant impact on distance (p=0.85) or near (p=0.09) high-contrast VA through the peripheral treatment zone. For low-contrast measures, all lenses reduced distance VA [by 0.09 (DOT), 0.12 (HAL) and 0.17 (DIMS) logMAR] and near VA [by 0.11 (DOT), 0.10 (HAL) and 0.14 (DIMS) logMAR] with reference to the SV control (all p<0.001). Conclusions : Whilst all three myopia management lenses performed relatively well centrally against a SV comparator, the results suggest wearers’ foveal VA is differentially affected through peripheral treatment zones. Specifically, the results indicate DOT lenses provide superior visual acuity in the treatment zone, equivalent to SV lenses. Clinicians should be aware of these differences in peripheral VA between myopia management lenses, and carefully consider visual requirements when discussing treatment options with patients and carers.

来源=桌面《框架眼镜SP》/03 尼康控优点or柯达柯学优 DOT/6-6-2 功能区视力 Treatment zone visual acuity with myopia control spectacle lenses _ IOVS _ ARVO Journals.pdf 来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：摘要 目的：探究基于镜片的近视管理干预措施在两种距离下，通过镜片中心和周边区域对成人高对比度及低对比敏感度中心凹视力（VA）的即时影响。 方法：本研究为前瞻性、单访视、双盲、四组随机交叉研究。20 名近视成人（等效球镜度数 - 4.25D 至 - 0.50D，其中 16 名为女性），年龄 18-30 岁，通过佩戴球面软镜实现功能性正视后，依次佩戴扩散光学技术（DOT）镜片、多段离焦整合（DIMS）镜片、高非球面微透镜（HAL）镜片及单光（SV）平光镜片。分别通过镜片中心和周边区域（距光学中心偏心 10mm 处）测量中心凹视力。所有受试者完成 8 项单眼测试任务：通过镜片中心和周边区域，在远距（4 米）和近距（40 厘米）下测量高对比度（96%）及低对比度（10%）logMAR 中心凹视力。 结果：在高对比度（p=0.06）和低对比度（p=0.74）视标下，所有镜片的中心远距视力无显著差异；而与 SV 镜片相比，DIMS 镜片的中心近距高对比度视力下降 0.06±0.02 logMAR，HAL 镜片的中心近距低对比度视力下降 0.05±0.01 logMAR（均 p<0.05）DIMS 镜片的周边远距高对比度视力较 SV 镜片（p<0.001）、DOT 镜片（p<0.001）和 HAL 镜片（p<0.05）均更差。与 SV 镜片相比，DIMS 镜片的高对比度视力下降幅度为：远距 0.16±0.02 logMAR，近距 0.13±0.01 logMAR。与 SV 镜片相比，HAL 镜片的高对比度视力也有所下降（远距：0.08±0.019 logMAR，p<0.01；近距：0.05±0.017 logMAR，p<0.05）。通过周边功能区测量时，DOT 镜片对远距（p=0.85）或近距（p=0.09）高对比度视力无显著影响。在低对比度测量中，相较于 SV 对照镜片，所有镜片的远距视力均下降 [DOT：0.09 logMAR，HAL：0.12 logMAR，DIMS：0.17 logMAR]，近距视力也均下降 [DOT：0.11 logMAR，HAL：0.10 logMAR，DIMS：0.14 logMAR]（均 p<0.001）。 结论：尽管三种近视管理镜片与 SV 镜片相比，在中心区域表现均相对良好，但结果表明，佩戴者通过周边功能区获得的中心凹视力会受到不同程度的影响。具体而言，结果显示 DOT 镜片在功能区提供的视力更优，与 SV 镜片相当。临床医生应了解不同近视管理镜片在周边视力方面的这些差异，并在与患者及照护者讨论治疗方案时，审慎考虑其视觉需求。

Visual impact of diffusion optic technology lenses for myopia control

DOTvsSV-视力、阅读速度、对比敏感度、立体视与眩光

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2024年👥 Wolffsohn James S, Hill Jennifer S, Hunt Chris, Young Graeme
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-3 DOTvsSV-视力、阅读速度、对比敏感度、立体视与眩光 样本量： Diffusion Optics Technology™ 0.2 DOT组27人 结果：DOT在有效控制近视进展的同时，在视觉锐度、对比敏感度、立体视、阅读功能等方面，其视觉功能和质量与佩戴SVL无显著差异，虽然DOT镜片的平均光晕半径0.56°，但与SVL差异仅0.06°远小于预先设定的临床非劣效界值（0.4°）。所以研究者认为这个差异在临床上微不足道，不影响日常使用。 对照组选择：SVL（24人）
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 控优点/柯学优 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-3
原文摘要
摘要 目的：评估用于近视控制的 0.2 型扩散光学技术（Diffusion Optics Technology™）DOT 镜片（SightGlass Vision 公司生产）在第一眼位下的视觉影响。DOT 镜片含有光散射元件，光线穿过镜片时会被散射，进而降低视网膜图像对比度。 方法：在北美 6 个研究中心，51 名儿童（年龄 12.2±1.3 岁，范围 10-14 岁；51% 为女性）被随机分配佩戴 DOT 镜片（n=27）或单光镜片（n=24）。在佩戴至少 3 年后，于第一眼位评估受试者的双眼高低对比度远视力、近视力、阅读速度、对比敏感度、立体视敏度和眩光情况。该研究在所有指标上的检验效能均为 95%，足以检测出组间的显著差异。 结果：DOT 镜片佩戴组与单光镜片佩戴组的双眼平均远视力情况如下：高对比度远视力（-0.09±0.02 vs. -0.08±0.02 logMAR，p=0.81）、低对比度远视力（0.05±0.02 vs. 0.07±0.02 logMAR，p=0.52）、存在眩光源时的近视力（-0.06±0.03 vs. -0.09±0.03 logMAR，p=0.32），两组间均无显著差异。在 16 个空间频率中，有 11 个空间频率下，佩戴 DOT 镜片与单光镜片的儿童对比敏感度相似（p>0.05）。DOT 镜片组（33.2±12.5 角秒）与单光镜片组（38.1±14.2 角秒）的平均立体视敏度相似（p=0.30）。两组的功能性阅读速度指标无显著差异，阅读时客观测量的头部倾斜角度也无显著差异（p>0.05）。DOT 镜片组的平均光晕半径为 0.56°±0.17°，单光镜片组为 0.50°±0.12°（p=0.02），但这一具有统计学意义的差异小于 0.4° 的非劣效性界值。 结论：扩散光学技术镜片能提供与标准单光镜片临床等效的视觉体验。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To assess the visual impact of Diffusion Optics Technology™ 0.2 DOT lenses (SightGlass Vision Inc.) designed for myopia control on primary gaze. DOT spectacle lenses contain light scattering elements that scatter light as it passes through the lens which, in turn, reduces retinal image contrast. METHODS: Fifty-one children (12.2 ± 1.3, range 10-14 years; 51% females) were randomly assigned to wear DOT spectacle (n = 27) or single vision lenses (n = 24) across six investigational sites in North America. Binocular high- and low-contrast distant visual acuities, near visual acuity, reading speed, contrast sensitivity, stereoacuity and glare were assessed in primary gaze after at least 3 years of wear, with the study 95% powered in all metrics to detect significant differences between the groups. RESULTS: Mean binocular distance high-contrast (-0.09 ± 0.02 vs. -0.08 ± 0.02 logMAR, p = 0.81), low-contrast (0.05 ± 0.02 vs. 0.07 ± 0.02 logMAR, p = 0.52) and near visual acuity with glare sources (-0.06 ± 0.03 vs. -0.09 ± 0.03 logMAR, p = 0.32) were similar for DOT and single vision lens wearers, respectively. Contrast sensitivity was similar between children wearing DOT or single vision lenses across 11 of the 16 spatial frequencies (p > 0.05). Mean stereopsis was similar (p = 0.30) with the DOT lenses (33.2 ± 12.5″) and single vision lenses (38.1 ± 14.2″). Functional reading speed metrics were similar in both study groups, as was the objectively measured head tilt during reading (p > 0.05). The mean halo radius was 0.56° ± 0.17° with the DOT lenses compared with 0.50° ± 0.12° with single vision lenses (p = 0.02), but the statistically significant difference was smaller than the non-inferiority bound of 0.4°. CONCLUSION: Diffusion optics technology lenses provide a clinically equivalent visual experience to a standard single vision lens.

Contrast sensitivity function differentiates between myopia control spectacle lens designs with glare and luminance manipulations

DOT&DIMS&HALvsSV-眩光与低照度下对比敏感度

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-4 DOT&DIMS&HALvsSV-眩光与低照度下对比敏感度 样本量：20人（依次佩戴DOT™、DIMS、HAL、SV） 结果：眩光和弱光条件都会显著降低所有镜片的对比敏感度，尤其是在镜片的周边治疗区域。在弱光条件下，通过镜片中央区域观看时，单光镜片提供了最佳的视觉质量。弱光条件下通过镜片周边区域观看时，DOT镜片的视觉质量与单光镜片相似，并且明显优于HAL和DIMS镜片。在眩光条件下，各种镜片之间的视觉质量没有显著差异。

摘要 目的：评估眩光和对比敏感度功能测试的亮度水平在区分不同近视控制眼镜镜片设计中的作用。 方法：在这项前瞻性、单次随访、双盲、四向随机交叉研究中，纳入20名18至30岁近视成人（女性16名，MSE为-4.25 D至-0.50 D，配戴球性软性角膜接触镜达到功能性正视），依次佩戴具有扩散光学技术（DOT™）、多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）、高非球面微透镜（HAL）的镜片及标准单光（SV）平光镜片。在明视条件下、平板两侧附带条形灯（±12.3°角，115,000 cd/m²）产生眩光条件下以及中间视（mesopic）条件下，通过镜片中心和/或周边（偏离光学中心10 mm）使用平板格式Aston对比敏感度测试在40 cm处单眼评估对比敏感度功能。 结果：增加眩光源（F=6.273，p=0.022）或将亮度从明视降低至中间视（F=103.264，p<0.001）均降低了对比敏感度。所有测试镜片在眩光和中间视亮度降低时，通过周边治疗区观察的对比敏感度均低于中央透明区（F=54.092，p<0.001；二者均p<0.001）。在眩光条件下各镜片间无显著差异（F=3.088，p=0.055）；但在降至中间视水平时存在差异（F=6.095，p=0.005）：在中央透明区，标准单光镜片表现优于三种近视控制镜片设计（p<0.001）；而在周边治疗区，DOT™镜片的表现与标准单光镜片相似（p=0.537），且优于HAL和DIMS镜片（p<0.01）。 结论：增加眩光和降低亮度至中间视水平使得对比敏感度功能能够区分单光镜片以及不同近视控制眼镜镜片。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To assess the effect of glare and the luminance level of a contrast sensitivity function assessment test to differentiate between myopia control spectacle lens designs. Methods: Twenty myopic (MSE -4.25D to -0.50D) adults (16F); aged 18-30 years, rendered functionally emmetropic with spherical soft contact lenses wore, sequentially, lenses with Diffusion Optics Technology (DOT™), Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS), Highly Aspherical Lenslets (HAL) and standard single vision plano spectacle lenses in a prospective, single-visit, double-blind, four-way randomised crossover study. Contrast sensitivity function was assessed monocularly at 40cm with the tablet format Aston Contrast Sensitivity test in photopic condition, with strip lights attached either side of the tablet (115,000 cd/m2 at an angle of ±12.3°) and under mesopic conditions, assessed viewing through the lens centre and/or periphery (lens decentred 10mm from the optical centre). Results: The addition of a glare source (F=6.273, p=0.022), or decreasing the luminance from photopic to mesopic (F=103.264, p<0.001) reduced contrast sensitivity. Contrast sensitivity was lower when viewing through the peripheral treatment zone compared to the central clear zone (F=54.092, p<0.001), both with glare and a reduction to mesopic luminance (both p<0.001) with all the lenses tested. There was no difference between the lenses worn with glare (F=3.088, p=0.055), but there was with a reduction to mesopic lighting levels (F=6.095, p=0.005); for the central clear zone, the standard single vision lens performed better than the three myopia control lens designs (p<0.001), but for the peripheral treatment zone, the DOT™ lenses performed similarly to the standard single vision lenses (p=0.537), and better compared to the HAL and DIMS lenses (p<0.01). Conclusion: The addition of glare and reducing the luminance to mesopic levels allowed the contrast sensitivity function to differentiate between single vision and within myopia control spectacle lenses.

IMC 2024 poster..pdf 来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：摘要 目的：评估眩光及对比敏感度函数评估测试的亮度水平对区分不同近视控制框架镜片设计的作用。 方法：在一项前瞻性、单次访视、双盲、四组随机交叉研究中，20 名近视成人（等效球镜度数为 - 4.25D 至 - 0.50D，其中 16 名为女性），年龄 18-30 岁，通过球面软镜矫正至功能性正视后，依次佩戴扩散光学技术镜片（DOT™）、离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS）、高非球面微透镜（HAL）及标准单光平光框架镜片。采用平板式阿斯顿对比敏感度测试，在 40cm 处单眼评估对比敏感度函数：明视条件下，平板电脑两侧加装条形灯（在 ±12.3° 角度下亮度为 115,000 cd/m²）；中间视觉条件下，分别通过镜片中央和 / 或周边区域（镜片从光学中心偏移 10mm）进行评估。 结果：添加眩光源（F=6.273，p=0.022）或将亮度从明视水平降至中间视觉水平（F=103.264，p<0.001），均会降低对比敏感度。在所有测试镜片中，无论有无眩光及是否降低至中间视觉亮度（均 p<0.001），通过周边治疗区域视物时的对比敏感度均低于通过中央清晰区域时（F=54.092，p<0.001）。有眩光时，所佩戴的不同镜片之间无差异（F=3.088，p=0.055）；但当亮度降至中间视觉水平时，不同镜片间存在差异（F=6.095，p=0.005）；在中央清晰区域，标准单光镜片的表现优于三种近视控制镜片（p<0.001）；而在周边治疗区域，DOT™镜片的表现与标准单光镜片相当（p=0.537），且优于 HAL 镜片和 DIMS 镜片（p<0.01）。 结论：添加眩光及将亮度降低至中间视觉水平，使得对比敏感度函数能够区分单光镜片与不同类型的近视控制框架镜片。

The impact of myopia control spectacle lens designs on visual function

HALT&DIMS&DOT 对视觉功能的影响

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2026年👥 Desiato Alfredo, Lam Hiu Yan, Anand Reena Rani, Chatha Inderjit, Logan Nicola S, Sheppard Amy L, Wolffsohn James S, Laughton Deborah, Davies Leon N
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-5 HALT&DIMS&DOT 对视觉功能的影响 研究设计：前瞻性、单次就诊、双盲、四组随机交叉研究 样本量：20人 结论：DOT在高对比度视力和阅读速度上与SVL表现相当，而HAL和DIMS在所有测试条件下均显示出周边视力下降，尤其是在低对比度和低光照条件下，DIMS在近视力阈值和临界字体大小方面表现最差。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 控优点/柯学优 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-5
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：分析调焦离焦型与调对比型近视控制眼镜片干预措施对视觉功能产生的即时影响。 研究方法：本研究为前瞻性、单次就诊、双盲、四组随机交叉试验，选取经隐形眼镜矫正的健康近视青年受试者（等效球镜度数均值为 - 4.25 至 - 0.50 屈光度），让其分别佩戴扩散光学技术镜片（DOT）、多段离焦设计镜片（DIMS）、高非球面微透镜镜片（HAL）以及标准单光平光试验镜片（SV）。通过镜片的中心区域（CZ）和 / 或周边区域（PZ），对受试者的中心凹进行远、近距高 / 低对比视力（VA）、对比敏感度、阅读能力、调节灵活度、视觉搜索任务表现及调节精度的检测。 研究结果：本研究共招募 20 名受试者（16 名女性），平均年龄为 22.4±2.72 岁，等效球镜度数均值为 - 2.21±1.10 屈光度。近视控制镜片与单光镜片通过周边区域检测的视力存在显著差异：高非球面微透镜镜片和多段离焦设计镜片在所有检测条件下的视力均更低（所有 p 值均 <0.05），而扩散光学技术镜片在高对比视标下的视力与单光镜片相当。所有镜片通过中心区域检测的对比敏感度均出现不同程度下降，其中高非球面微透镜镜片和多段离焦设计镜片通过周边区域检测的对比敏感度显著差于单光镜片和扩散光学技术镜片（p<0.01）。单光镜片、扩散光学技术镜片和高非球面微透镜镜片通过周边区域检测的近视力阈值、阅读速度及临界印刷字体大小均无显著差异（所有 p 值均> 0.05），而多段离焦设计镜片的近视力阈值和临界印刷字体大小表现更差（p<0.001）。各镜片在错误评分（p=0.53）、调节灵活度重新调焦周期（所有 p 值均 > 0.05）及视觉搜索时长（中心区域：p=0.68；周边区域：p=0.35）方面均无显著差异。所有镜片的调节反应无明显差别（所有 p 值均 > 0.05）；但单光镜片通过周边区域检测的远距调节变异性显著低于扩散光学技术镜片、高非球面微透镜镜片和多段离焦设计镜片（p<0.001）。 研究结论：三款近视控制镜片通过中心区域检测的视觉表现均与标准单光镜片相当。临床医师应关注不同镜片的视觉表现差异，尤其是通过镜片周边区域检测的视力、阅读速度及相关检测指标的区别。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To profile the immediate effect of defocus-modulating and contrast-modulating myopia control spectacle lens interventions on visual function. METHODS: Healthy myopic (mean spherical equivalent (MSE) -4.25 to -0.50 D) young adults, corrected with contact lenses, wore diffusion optics technology (DOT), defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS), highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) and standard single vision (SV) plano trial spectacle lenses, in a prospective, single-visit, double-blind, four-way randomised crossover study. Distance and near high- and low-contrast visual acuity (VA), contrast sensitivity, reading performance, accommodative facility, visual search task and accommodative accuracy were assessed foveally through the central zone (CZ) and/or peripheral zone (PZ) of the lenses. RESULTS: Twenty participants (16 female) were recruited, with a mean (±SD) age of 22.4 (±2.72) years and MSE -2.21 (±1.10) D. VAs through the PZ differed significantly between myopia control lenses and SV, with the HAL and DIMS exhibiting lower VA across all testing conditions (all p <0.05) and DOT demonstrating equivalence to SV with high contrast letters. Contrast sensitivity was similarly reduced for all lenses through the CZ, while HAL and DIMS performed worse than both SV and DOT through the PZ (p <0.01). Near acuity threshold, reading speed and critical print size through the PZ were comparable for SV, DOT and HAL (all p >0.05), whereas DIMS exhibited worse near acuity threshold and critical print size (p <0.001). No significant differences emerged for error score (p = 0.53), accommodative facility refocusing cycles (all p >0.05) or visual search duration (CZ: p = 0.68; PZ: p = 0.35). Accommodative response was similar across lenses (all p >0.05); however, SV had lower variability at distance through the PZ than DOT, HAL and DIMS (p <0.001). CONCLUSION: All three myopia control lenses exhibited visual performance comparable to standard SV lenses through the CZ. Clinicians should note differences in visual performance, especially VA and reading speed through the lens periphery and their relative testing.

Oculomotor Profiles in Children Wearing Different Myopia Control Lenses: A Real-World Eye Tracking Study

离焦镜片vsDOTvsOK镜-眼动研究

📖 Eye📅 2026年👥 Wu Shuo, Fu Hao, Li Wenjin, Li Hao, Wang Zehong, Wang Kai
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-6 离焦镜片vsDOTvsOK镜-眼动研究 起始时间：未报告；伦理批准日期为2026年4月21日。 研究中心&通讯作者：北京大学人民医院眼科 & 王凯。 研究设计：单中心真实世界观察性研究，纳入已佩戴相应镜片约1年的儿童。 样本量：共134人；OK组46人、离焦框架镜片（Defocus）组49人、光扩散技术（DOT）组39人。原文未明确Defocus组。 SE：有1年SE数据者为Defocus组34人、DOT组29人，分别进展−0.27±0.43 D、−0.34±0.36 D，差异无统计学意义（P=0.312）。 AL：作为探索性次要结局，三组1年眼轴增长无显著差异，未报告各组具体增长值。 眼动参数：眼球微动频率发、峰值速度、潜伏期、fixation disparity, 共轭性在组间显著差异。三组部分眼动参数存在差异，但不能据此判断近视控制效果优劣。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 控优点/柯学优 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-6
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
To compare oculomotor profiles among children wearing orthokeratology, defocus spectacle, and diffusion optics technology lenses in a routine pediatric myopia management setting. This real-world observational study included children who had worn one of the three lens types for approximately one year and had available eye tracking data. Lens type was selected during routine clinical care rather than assigned by the investigators. Oculomotor parameters were compared among lens groups using Kruskal-Wallis tests with false discovery rate correction. One-year spherical equivalent change was examined only in the defocus spectacle and diffusion optics technology groups. Adjusted and exploratory analyses included age, sex, baseline spherical equivalent, baseline axial length, axial elongation, and parental education categories. A total of 134 children were analyzed, including 46 in the orthokeratology group, 49 in the defocus spectacle group, and 39 in the diffusion optics technology group. Significant group differences were observed for microsaccade frequency (FDR adjusted p = 0.00099), peak velocity (FDR adjusted p = 0.00099), latency (FDR adjusted p = 0.00395), fixation disparity (FDR adjusted p = 0.00395), and conjugacy (FDR adjusted p = 0.0274). Saccade frequency and saccade amplitude did not differ significantly. One-year spherical equivalent change did not differ significantly between the defocus spectacle group and the diffusion optics technology group (-0.27 ± 0.43 D vs. -0.34 ± 0.36 D, p = 0.312). No statistically significant correlation was observed between spherical equivalent change and microsaccade frequency in the two spectacle lens groups (Spearman r = -0.231, p = 0.069). Parental education categories showed no consistent association with oculomotor parameters after correction for multiple comparisons. Children wearing different myopia control lenses showed selective differences in oculomotor profiles. Refractive change in the two spectacle lens groups was similar, and the observed oculomotor differences should not be interpreted as direct indicators of myopia control efficacy. Eye tracking may provide complementary information about visual behavior and lens adaptation, but prospective studies with age-balanced designs and longitudinal refractive and axial length outcomes are needed.

Impact of contrast modulation spectacle lenses on astigmatism

DOT对近视儿童散光进展的影响[摘要]

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-8-1：DOT对近视儿童散光进展的影响[摘要] 样本量：173北美儿童（from CYPRESS）；182中国儿童（仅分析右眼）(from CATHAY) 结论：佩戴12个月的DOT在北美（减缓0.41D）和中国儿童（减缓0.48D）中均显著减缓了近视进展，且没有证据表明佩戴DOT镜片会导致近视儿童的散光增加。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 控优点/柯学优 / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-1
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：探讨对比度调节眼镜镜片（不含周边离焦）对近视儿童散光进展的影响。 方法：选取评估扩散光学技术（DOT）镜片的两项多中心随机对照临床试验的12个月屈光数据进行分析。第一项为招募6至10岁北美儿童的4年期临床试验（NCT03623074）；第二项为招募6至13岁中国儿童的2年期临床试验（NCT05562622）。评估右眼数据，确定基线和12个月时散光（>0.25 DC）儿童的数量，以及散光儿童在佩戴DOT镜片和标准单光对照镜片12个月后的散光变化幅度。 结果：共纳入173名北美儿童和182名中国儿童的数据。佩戴12个月后，与对照组相比，DOT镜片显著延缓了北美儿童（0.41 D；74%；p<0.0001）和中国儿童（0.48 D；75%；p<0.0001）的睫状肌麻痹等效球镜屈光进展。佩戴12个月后，北美研究中散光儿童比例由87%变为92%，中国研究中由91%变为88%，各组间均无显著差异（p>0.05）。与对照组相比，北美儿童（0.02±0.42 DC vs -0.02±0.32 DC；p=0.485）和中国儿童（0.15±0.39 DC vs 0.18±0.43 DC；p=0.679）中DOT组的平均散光变化差异相似。 结论：佩戴12个月后，DOT镜片显著延缓了北美和中国儿童的近视进展。没有证据表明佩戴DOT镜片会导致近视儿童散光增加。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose Recent research has suggested that peripheral defocus spectacle lens wear may cause an increase in astigmatism in myopic children. The purpose of this research was to explore the impact of contrast modulation spectacle lenses (that do not incorporate peripheral defocus) on astigmatism progression in myopic children. Methods Twelve-month refractive data from two multicenter randomized controlled clinical trials evaluating Diffusion Optics Technology (DOT) spectacle lenses were selected for analysis. The first was a 4-year clinical trial (NCT03623074) that recruited North American children aged 6 to 10 years. The second was a 2-year clinical trial (NCT05562622) that recruited Chinese children aged 6 to 13 years. Right eye data was evaluated to determine the number of children with astigmatism (>0.25 DC) at baseline and at 12-months, and the magnitude of change in astigmatic children after 12-months of wear of DOT and standard single vision control spectacle lenses. Results Data from 173 North American and 182 Chinese children were included in this analysis. After 12-months of wear, DOT spectacle lenses significantly slowed cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction in North American (0.41 D; 74%; p<0.0001) and Chinese children (0.48 D; 75%; p<0.0001), compared to control. The proportion of children with astigmatism changed from 87% to 92% in the North American study and from 91% to 88% in the Chinese study after 12-months of wear, with no difference between study arms (p>0.05). Compared to the control groups, the mean differences in astigmatism were similar to the DOT groups in North American (0.02 ± 0.42 DC vs -0.02 ± 0.32 DC; p=0.485) and Chinese (0.15 ± 0.39 DC vs 0.18 ± 0.43 DC; p=0.679) children. Conclusion After 12-months of wear, DOT spectacle lenses significantly slowed myopia progression in North American and Chinese children. There was no evidence to suggest that wearing DOT lenses leads to an increase in astigmatism in myopic children.

Optical Evaluation of Contrast Modulating Diffusion Optics Myopia Control Spectacle Lenses

DOT的不同材质效果[摘要]

👥 Ryan Webster, Joshua Richards, Dawn Meyer, Pete Kollbaum
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-8-2：DOT的不同材质效果[摘要] 样本选择：中国生产聚碳酸酯材质polycarbonate的DOT和SVL，用于中国的临床研究；英国生产Trivex 材质的DOT和SVL，用于北美的临床研究 结论：DOT 镜片中央区域的调制传递函数(MTF)与对照组相近；治疗区域在低空间频率下调制程度降至 0.60-0.65，随后逐步下降，65 周 / 度时与对照组水平接近；不同材料、不同制造地点生产的镜片，调制传递函数(MTF)表现一致。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 控优点/柯学优 / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-2
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：评估镜片材质和生产工厂对扩散光学技术（DOT）近视控制镜片相对对比度传递的影响。 方法：评估标准单光对照镜片与DOT镜片，包含聚碳酸酯（PC）和Trivex两种材质（均带有减反射膜）。中国生产并在中国临床研究中使用的为PC材质DOT和对照镜片；英国生产并在北美临床研究中使用的为Trivex材质DOT和对照镜片。使用高动态范围（HDR）12位单色探测器对点扩散函数（PSF）进行数字采样，激光光源波长λ=636.8 nm，输出功率0.01 mW，测量6 mm直径圆形光孔。在0度和20度偏心度下采样中心光学区和周边治疗区的PSF，并通过PSF的傅里叶变换计算调制传递函数（MTF）。 结果：通过DOT镜片中心区域测量时，所有镜片的MTF均与对照镜片相似，在低空间频率下接近系统极限调制，在65 cpd的高空间频率下逐渐降低至约0.45；通过DOT镜片治疗区域测量时，所有DOT镜片在低空间频率下的调制均降低至约0.60~0.65，并在65 cpd下逐渐降低至与对照镜片相似的水平。不同材质及不同生产地点的镜片具有相似的MTF。 结论：应用于不同材质并在不同生产工厂制造的DOT镜片技术对对比度的降低程度相似，因此预期对近视进展的控制效果相似。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
BACKGROUND: Diffusion Optics Technology™ (DOT) spectacle lenses from SightGlass Vision (SGV) have been shown to slow myopia progression in children. These lenses contain a central aperture encircled by a treatment zone of light-scattering micro-diffusers to adjust contrast. As with any spectacle lenses, DOT lenses can be made of various materials and by several contract manufacturing facilities. This study evaluated the impact of lens material and manufacturing facility on the relative contrast transferred by DOT lens technology. METHODS: The lenses evaluated were standard single vision Control and DOT lenses, of two materials: polycarbonate and Trivex, both with AR coating. Polycarbonate DOT and Control lenses were manufactured and used in clinical studies in China. Trivex DOT and Control lenses were manufactured in the UK and used in clinical studies in North America. Point-spread functions (PSFs) were digitally sampled by a high dynamic range (HDR), 12-bit (3864x2176 pixels) IDS U3-38J0XCP-M-GL monochrome detector with 1.45-micron pixel pitch. The laser light source was a single mode optical fiber (λ=636.8nm) with the output power set to 0.01 mW (Thorlabs LP635-SF8). The single pass system captured PSFs for 6mm diameter circular apertures. Alignment and focus of the system were achieved with a shear-plate interferometer. To capture the contrast modulating properties of both the central optic, and peripheral treatment optic, the PSF for each spectacle lens was sampled with 0- and 20-degrees lens eccentricity. The HDR system captured multiple images of the same source at different exposure levels (32 μs to 1.9 s). Images were linearly combined, processed, and image quality metrics were calculated using custom MATLAB software, Indiana Wavefront Analyzer (IWA). Modulation transfer functions (MTFs) were calculated by Fourier transform of the PSF. RESULTS: Through the central sections of the DOT lenses, all lenses demonstrated MTF’s similar to the Control lenses. Specifically, all lenses showed near system-limited modulation at low spatial frequencies (SFs) with gradual decreases in modulation to around 0.45 at the higher SF of 65 cpd. When measuring through the treatment sections of the DOT lenses, all DOT lenses showed decreases in modulation to around 0.60-0.65 at low SFs with further gradual decreases in modulation to levels similar to those seen in the Control at 65 cpd. Lenses made of different materials and at different manufacturing locations had similar MTFs. CONCLUSIONS: DOT lens technology applied to lenses of differing materials and by differing manufacturing facilities reduce contrast similarly, and accordingly may be expected to control myopia progression similarly.

来源=桌面《框架眼镜SP》/03 尼康控优点or柯达柯学优 DOT/6-8-2 MCA-ABS-AAO-25-001Indiana.pdf 来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：摘要 背景：视镜视觉公司（SGV）的扩散光学技术（DOT）眼镜已被证实可减缓儿童近视进展。该镜片设有中心孔径，周围环绕着由光散射微扩散器构成的治疗区，用于调节对比度。与所有眼镜一样，DOT 镜片可采用多种材料制造，并由多家合同生产工厂生产。本研究旨在评估镜片材料和生产工厂对 DOT 镜片技术传递相对对比度的影响。 方法：本研究评估的镜片包括标准单光对照镜片和 DOT 镜片，采用两种材料：聚碳酸酯和 Trivex，均带有抗反射（AR）涂层。聚碳酸酯材质的 DOT 镜片和对照镜片在中国生产并用于中国的临床试验；Trivex 材质的 DOT 镜片和对照镜片在英国生产并用于北美的临床试验。点扩散函数（PSFs）通过高动态范围（HDR）、12 位（3864×2176 像素）IDS U3-38J0XCP-M-GL 型单色探测器进行数字采样，该探测器的像素间距为 1.45 微米。激光光源为单模光纤（波长 λ=636.8 纳米），输出功率设置为 0.01 毫瓦（Thorlabs LP635-SF8 型号）。单通系统用于采集直径 6 毫米圆形孔径的点扩散函数（PSFs）。系统的对准和对焦通过剪切板干涉仪实现。为捕捉中心光学区和周边治疗区的对比度调节特性，对每副眼镜镜片分别在 0 度和 20 度镜片偏心率下采样点扩散函数（PSF）。HDR 系统在不同曝光水平（32 微秒至 1.9 秒）下拍摄同一光源的多张图像，图像经线性组合和处理后，使用定制的 MATLAB 软件 —— 印第安纳波前分析仪（IWA）计算图像质量指标。调制传递函数（MTFs）通过对点扩散函数（PSF）进行傅里叶变换得到。 结果：通过 DOT 镜片的中心区域时，所有镜片的调制传递函数（MTFs）与对照镜片相似。具体而言，所有镜片在低空间频率（SFs）下均表现出接近系统极限的调制水平，随着空间频率升高，调制程度逐渐下降，在 65 周 / 度（cpd）的高空间频率下降至约 0.45。通过 DOT 镜片的治疗区域测量时，所有 DOT 镜片在低空间频率下的调制程度降至约 0.60-0.65，随后继续逐渐下降，在 65 周 / 度（cpd）时达到与对照镜片相近的水平。不同材料、不同生产地点制造的镜片具有相似的调制传递函数（MTFs）。 结论：将 DOT 镜片技术应用于不同材料、由不同生产工厂制造的镜片时，其对比度降低效果相似，因此有望实现相近的近视控制效果。

Evaluation of Lag of Accommodation with Full-Field Diffusion Optics Technology™ (DOT) Contrast Management Spectacle Lenses in Emmetropic Children

全视野DOT镜片vsSVL-对调节滞后(LOA, lag of accomodation)的影响

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2024年👥 Jabeen Asiya, Luensmann Doerte, Woods Jill, Hill Jennifer S, Jones Lyndon
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-8-3 全视野DOT镜片vsSVL-对调节滞后(LOA, lag of accomodation)的影响 设计：纳入正视眼，随机先配戴平光全视野DOT（无中央透明区）/ SVL，适应5min后使用开放视野自动验光的办法测量调节滞后的量。 样本量：30人 全视野LOA：右眼平均调节滞后为 0.57D；优势眼平均调节滞后为0.60D SVL: 右眼平均调节滞后为 0.62D；优势眼平均调节滞后为 0.68D 结论：佩戴全视野对比度管理眼镜（DOT镜片） 与佩戴标准单光眼镜相比，调节滞后（LOA）没有显著差异。同时本文未发现调节滞后在不同性别或不同年龄组之间存在显著差异。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 控优点/柯学优 / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-3
原文摘要
摘要 目的：评估旨在通过调节视网膜对比度以控制近视进展的全视野扩散光学技术™（DOT）眼镜镜片，在正视儿童短期佩戴后对其调节滞后（LOA）产生的影响。 患者与方法：本研究为单访视、前瞻性、随机、受试者设盲研究，研究对象为无近视控制治疗史的正视者（各子午线屈光不正度数均在 ±1.00D 及以内）。研究测量了受试者的裸眼 logMAR 视力，并采用瞄准法确定其主导眼。受试者按随机顺序佩戴平光全视野对比度管理（DOT）眼镜（无清晰中心孔径）或对照眼镜（标准单光眼镜镜片）。在进行 6 米和 40 厘米处的开放式视野自动验光测量前，每位受试者均有 5 分钟时间适应相应镜片。每只眼进行 10 次测量，分别对右眼和优势眼的数据进行评估。 结果：共 30 名受试者（20 名女性，10 名男性）完成了研究，其平均年龄为 10.4±2.8 岁（范围 7-17 岁）。佩戴对比度管理眼镜时，右眼平均调节滞后为 0.57±0.39D；佩戴对照眼镜时，右眼平均调节滞后为 0.62±0.34D，两者无显著差异（Wilcoxon 检验，p=0.37）。对于优势眼，佩戴对比度管理眼镜和对照眼镜时的调节滞后值分别为 0.60±0.40D 和 0.68±0.33D（p=0.14）。此外，无论佩戴对比度管理眼镜还是对照眼镜，在右眼或优势眼中，男性与女性之间、不同年龄组（7-11 岁 vs 12-17 岁）之间的平均调节滞后均未观察到显著差异（所有 p>0.05）。 结论：与标准单光眼镜镜片相比，全视野对比度管理眼镜镜片对调节滞后无显著影响，这表明在本研究测试的短期佩戴镜片期间，其对调节反应无差异性影响。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate the impact on the lag of accommodation (LOA) in emmetropic children after short-term wear of full-field Diffusion Optics TechnologyTM (DOT) spectacle lenses, designed to modulate retinal contrast to control myopia progression. PATIENTS AND METHODS: This was a single-visit, prospective, randomized, subject-masked study of emmetropes (ametropes ±1.00D or less in each meridian) with no history of myopia control treatment. Unaided logMAR visual acuity was measured, and ocular dominance was determined using the sighting method. In a randomized order, participants wore plano full-field contrast management (DOT) spectacles (no clear central aperture) or control spectacles (standard single vision spectacle lenses). Each participant was given 5 minutes for adaptation to the respective lenses before open field autorefraction measurements were taken at 6 meters and 40 cm. Ten measurements were taken for each eye. Data were evaluated from the right eye and the dominant eye separately. RESULTS: A total of 30 participants (20 females and 10 males) with a mean age of 10.4 ± 2.8 (7 to 17) years completed the study. There was no significant difference in right eye mean LOA with contrast management spectacles 0.57 ± 0.39D versus control spectacles 0.62 ± 0.34D; Wilcoxon test, p = 0.37. For dominant eyes, LOA values were 0.60 ± 0.40D and 0.68 ± 0.33D with contrast management spectacles and control spectacles, respectively (p = 0.14). Additionally, no significant difference was observed in mean LOA between males and females or between age groups (7-11 years vs 12-17 years) for either right or dominant eyes with contrast management or control spectacles (all p > 0.05). CONCLUSION: Full-field contrast management spectacle lenses had no significant effect on LOA compared to standard single vision spectacle lenses, indicating no differential impact on accommodative response over the short period of lens wear tested.

A Predictive Model for Personalized Fitting of Peripheral Defocus Spectacles Based on Ocular Biometric Parameters

HALT、DOT、DIMS、DSDO、HORI-基于眼部生物学参数对近视进展进行预测的模型构建

📖 Clinical optometry📅 2026年👥 Zhou Peng, Li Yingli, Chen Sitong, Wang Kai, Li Yan
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-8-4：HALT、DOT、DIMS、DSDO、HORI-基于眼部生物学参数对近视进展进行预测的模型构建 起始时间：回顾性研究，2026年1月之前 研究中心/PI：北京大学人民医院眼科中心，李岩 试验设计简述：回顾性队列研究，使用DOT、DIMS、HALT等5种镜片进行个性化配适的评估。分5组，匹配性别、年龄、基线眼部生物参数。 试验样本量：2824名儿童，样本量分为训练集80%，验证集20% 结论：基于眼部参数比如眼轴长度、角膜曲率等生物参数，能个性化推荐最适合的外周散焦眼睛设计。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 控优点/柯学优 / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-4
原文摘要
摘要 目的：基于眼部生物测量参数，构建用于个性化推荐周边离焦框架眼镜设计的预测模型。 方法：本回顾性队列研究纳入了在北京大学人民医院眼科中心配戴周边离焦框架眼镜的2824名近视儿童。研究对象根据镜片设计分为五组：DSDO、DOT、DIMS、HALT 和 HORI，并按性别、年龄及基线眼部生物测量参数进行匹配。数据集随机分为训练集（80%）和验证集（20%），用于模型评估。研究分别针对每种镜片设计，基于眼部生物测量参数建立多元线性回归预测模型。最后，开发了一个 R 语言函数，用于临床个性化推荐。 结果：在匹配基线参数后，五种周边离焦框架眼镜在控制眼轴增长方面未观察到统计学显著差异（P = 0.28）。训练集中的决定系数（R²）为0.89至0.96，验证集为0.88至0.97；训练集中的均方根误差（RMSE）为0.05 mm至0.07 mm，验证集为0.04 mm至0.07 mm。校准图显示预测值与观察值之间具有良好一致性。 结论：尽管五种镜片设计在平均疗效上未显示显著差异，本研究成功建立了基于眼部生物测量参数的预测模型，可用于指导周边离焦框架眼镜的个性化验配。 通俗摘要：离焦眼镜已被证实可以减缓近视进展，但目前尚无基于个体情况选择离焦镜片类型的方法。本研究提出了一种基于眼部生物测量数据的个性化离焦镜片选择模型，可为临床近视管理决策提供参考。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To construct a predictive model for personalized recommendation of peripheral defocus spectacle designs based on ocular biometric parameters. METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included 2824 myopic children who wore peripheral defocus spectacles at the Ophthalmology Center of Peking University People's Hospital. Participants were divided into five groups according to the spectacle designs (Diversified Segmental Defocus Optimization [DSDO], Diffusion Optics Technology [DOT], Defocus Induced Multiple Segment [DIMS], Highly Aspherical Lenslets [HALT], Hexagon Optimized Reticular Integration [HORI]) and matched for gender, age, and baseline biometric parameters. The dataset was randomly split into training (80%) and validation (20%) sets for model evaluation. Separate multiple linear regression prediction models based on ocular biometric parameters were constructed for each designs. Finally, an R language function was developed for clinical personalized recommendation. RESULTS: After matching baseline parameters, no statistically significant difference was observed in axial elongation control efficacy among the five peripheral defocus spectacles designs (P = 0.28). The coefficient of determination (R2) ranged from 0.89 to 0.96 in the training set and from 0.88 to 0.97 in the validation set; the root mean square error (RMSE) ranged from 0.05 mm to 0.07 mm in the training set and from 0.04 mm to 0.07 mm in the validation set. Calibration plots showed good agreement between predicted and observed values. CONCLUSION: Although no significant differences in average efficacy were observed among the five designs, this study successfully established predictive models based on ocular biometric parameters to guide personalized fitting of peripheral defocus spectacles.

Impact of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments Spectacles Versus Single Vision Spectacles on Myopia Control and Astigmatic Changes in Adolescents

📖 Eye📅 2026年👥 Hu Shan, Zheng Yuxi, Guo Dongyu, Lin Honghao, Deng Jun
内容摘要（Excel 原始记录）
摘要 目的： 评估离焦多区镜片（Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments, DIMS）与普通单光镜片（Single Vision Spectacles, SVS）在近视青少年中的近视控制效果及其对散光变化的影响。 方法： 本回顾性研究纳入了 2022 年 1 月至 2023 年 3 月期间在本诊所就诊的 153 名 7–14 岁近视儿童，随访时间为 1 年。其中 DIMS 组 86 人，SVS 组 67 人。使用 OA-2000 测量眼轴长度（Axial Length, AL）和角膜散光（Corneal Astigmatism, CA）。通过睫状肌麻痹验光获得球镜度数（Spherical, S）、柱镜度数/散光度数（Cylinder, C）和等效球镜（Spherical Equivalent, SE）。采用 Thibos 矢量分析法计算总散光（Total Astigmatism, TA）及角膜散光的 J0/J45 分量。使用配对 t 检验分析治疗前后的变化，并采用 Mann-Whitney U 检验、独立样本 t 检验和一般线性模型进行组间比较。 结果： 配戴 1 年后，DIMS 组在等效球镜进展和眼轴增长方面均明显少于 SVS 组：ΔSE 分别为 -0.39 ± 0.39 D 和 -0.72 ± 0.47 D；ΔAL 分别为 0.23 ± 0.15 mm 和 0.37 ± 0.22 mm，差异具有统计学意义（p < 0.01）。两组在总散光和角膜散光方面未观察到显著差异：ΔTA 分别为 -0.22 ± 0.07 D 和 -0.16 ± 0.06 D；ΔCA 分别为 -0.16 ± 0.06 D 和 -0.12 ± 0.01 D，差异无统计学意义（p > 0.01）。然而，与 SVS 组相比，DIMS 组在 1 年后总散光和角膜散光的斜轴分量增加更明显（p < 0.05；见表 1、图 1 和图 2）。 结论： DIMS 镜片可通过减少等效球镜变化和抑制眼轴增长，有效减缓青少年近视进展。与普通单光镜片相比，DIMS 配戴可减少水平/垂直方向的散光分量，但长期使用可能增加斜轴方向的总散光和角膜散光。这些发现提示，在 DIMS 干预过程中，应重视对散光方向性变化的监测，尤其是对于基线散光较高或存在斜轴散光的儿童。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate the effects of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacles versus Single Vision Spectacles (SVS) on myopia control and astigmatic changes in adolescents with myopia. METHODS: This retrospective study included 153 myopic children aged 7-14 years who attended our clinic between January 2022 and March 2023 (86 in the DIMS group and 67 in the SVS group), with a follow-up duration of one year. Axial Length (AL) and Corneal Astigmatism (CA) were measured using the OA-2000. Cycloplegic refraction was used to obtain Spherical (S), Cylinder Angle (C), and Spherical Equivalent (SE). Total astigmatism (TA) and corneal astigmatism J0/J45 components were calculated using Thibos' vector analysis. Pre- and post-treatment changes were analyzed using paired t-tests, while between-group comparisons were assessed using the Mann-Whitney U test, independent-samples t-test, and general linear model. RESULTS: After one year of wear, the DIMS group exhibited significantly less myopic progression than the SVS group in both Spherical Equivalent and axial elongation, ΔSE: -0.39 ± 0.39 D vs. -0.72 ± 0.47 D; ΔAL: 0.23 ± 0.15 mm vs. 0.37 ± 0.22 mm; p < 0.01. No significant differences were observed in total astigmatism or corneal astigmatism between groups, ΔTA: -0.22 ± 0.07 D vs. -0.16 ± 0.06 D; ΔCA: -0.16 ± 0.06 D vs. -0.12 ± 0.01 D; p > 0.01. However, the DIMS group showed significantly greater increases in oblique components of total and corneal astigmatism compared with the SVS group after one year (p < 0.05; Table 1, Figure 1 and Figure 2). CONCLUSIONS: DIMS lenses effectively slow myopic progression in adolescents by reducing Spherical Equivalent shift and suppressing axial elongation. Compared with SVS lenses, DIMS wear reduces horizontal/vertical astigmatic components but may increase oblique total and corneal astigmatism over long-term use. These findings highlight the importance of monitoring directional astigmatic changes during DIMS intervention, particularly in children with high baseline or oblique astigmatism.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：明确 “离焦整合多段（DIMS）” 眼镜片是否能减缓儿童近视进展。 方法：对 183 名 8-13 岁中国儿童开展为期 2 年的双盲随机对照试验，这些儿童的近视度数为 - 1.00 至 - 5.00 屈光度（D），散光度数≤1.50 屈光度（D）。儿童被随机分为两组，分别佩戴 DIMS 眼镜片（n=93）或单光（SV）眼镜片（n=90）。DIMS 眼镜片整合了多个光学段，具有 + 3.50 屈光度的近视性离焦功能。每 6 个月测量一次屈光不正（睫状肌麻痹自动验光）和眼轴长度。 结果：160 名儿童完成了研究，其中 DIMS 组 79 人，SV 组 81 人。2 年内，DIMS 组儿童的平均（标准误）近视进展为 - 0.41±0.06 D，SV 组为 - 0.85±0.08 D。DIMS 组和 SV 组的平均（标准误）眼轴增长分别为 0.21±0.02 毫米和 0.55±0.02 毫米。与 SV 组相比，DIMS 组儿童的近视进展速度慢 52%（平均差值 - 0.44±0.09 D，95% 置信区间 - 0.73 至 - 0.37，p<0.0001）。同样，DIMS 组儿童的眼轴增长量比 SV 组少 62%（平均差值 0.34±0.04 毫米，95% 置信区间 0.22 至 0.37，p<0.0001）。佩戴 DIMS 眼镜片的儿童中，21.5% 在 2 年内无近视进展，而佩戴 SV 眼镜片的儿童中这一比例仅为 7.4%。 结论：近视儿童每日佩戴 DIMS 眼镜片可显著延缓近视进展和眼轴增长。研究结果表明，在获得清晰视觉的同时持续保持近视性离焦，能够减缓近视进展。 试验注册号 NCT02206217
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
AIM: To determine if 'Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments' (DIMS) spectacle lenses slow childhood myopia progression. METHODS: A 2-year double-masked randomised controlled trial was carried out in 183 Chinese children aged 8-13 years, with myopia between -1.00 and -5.00 D and astigmatism ≤1.50 D. Children were randomly assigned to wear DIMS (n=93) or single vision (SV) spectacle lenses (n=90). DIMS lens incorporated multiple segments with myopic defocus of +3.50 D. Refractive error (cycloplegic autorefraction) and axial length were measured at 6month intervals. RESULTS: 160 children completed the study, n=79 in the DIMS group and n=81 in the SV group. Average (SE) myopic progressions over 2 years were -0.41±0.06 D in the DIMS group and -0.85±0.08 D in the SV group. Mean (SE) axial elongation was 0.21±0.02 mm and 0.55±0.02 mm in the DIMS and SV groups, respectively. Myopia progressed 52% more slowly for children in the DIMS group compared with those in the SV group (mean difference -0.44±0.09 D, 95% CI -0.73 to -0.37, p<0.0001). Likewise, children in the DIMS group had less axial elongation by 62% than those in the SV group (mean difference 0.34±0.04 mm, 95% CI 0.22 to 0.37, p<0.0001). 21.5% children who wore DIMS lenses had no myopia progression over 2 years, but only 7.4% for those who wore SV lenses. CONCLUSIONS: Daily wear of the DIMS lens significantly retarded myopia progression and axial elongation in myopic children. Our results demonstrated simultaneous clear vision with constant myopic defocus can slow myopia progression. TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT02206217.

Myopia control effect of defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lens in Chinese children: results of a 3-year follow-up study

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2022年👥 Lam Carly Sy, Tang Wing Chun, Lee Paul H, Zhang Han Yu, Qi Hua, Hasegawa Keigo, To Chi Ho
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-3 起始时间：2014年8月 研究中心&PI：香港理工大学视光学院&Carly SY Lam 试验设计简述：双盲、随机、对照试验、DIMS vs SVL 试验组样本量：原DIMS组65人，SVL转DIMS组55人 SE：原DIMS组进展量-0.52D，控制量0.18D ；SVL转DIMS组进展量-0.04D，控制量0.30D ； AL：原DIMS组进展量0.31mm，控制量-0.08mm ；SVL转DIMS组进展量0.08mm，控制量-0.12mm

原文摘要
摘要 目的：在一项为期 2 年的近视控制试验后，通过 1 年的观察，明确持续佩戴离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片的儿童与从单光（SV）镜片转为佩戴 DIMS 镜片的儿童的近视进展情况。 方法：共 128 名儿童参与本研究。其中，此前佩戴 DIMS 镜片的儿童继续佩戴 DIMS 镜片（DIMS 组），此前佩戴 SV 镜片的儿童转为佩戴 DIMS 镜片（对照组转 DIMS 组）。每 6 个月测量一次睫状肌麻痹下等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）。选取在 24 月龄时与 DIMS 组年龄匹配的历史对照组，用于比较第 3 年的指标变化。 结果：3 年期间，DIMS 组（n=65）的 SER 变化为 - 0.52±0.69 屈光度，AL 变化为 0.31±0.26 毫米；经重复测量方差分析，这些变化随时间推移无统计学意义（p>0.05）。对照组转 DIMS 组（n=55）第 3 年的 SER 变化（-0.04±0.38 屈光度）和 AL 变化（0.08±0.12 毫米）均小于第 1 年（均数差值 = 0.45±0.30 屈光度、0.21±0.11 毫米，p<0.001）和第 2 年（0.34±0.30 屈光度、0.12±0.10 毫米，p<0.001）。同期内，两组的 SER 和 AL 变化均显著小于历史对照组（DIMS 组 vs 历史对照组：SER 均数差值 =-0.18±0.42 屈光度，p=0.012；AL 均数差值 = 0.08±0.15 毫米，p=0.001；对照组转 DIMS 组 vs 历史对照组：校正后 SER 均数差值 =-0.30±0.42 屈光度，p<0.001；校正后 AL 均数差值 = 0.12±0.16 毫米，p<0.001）。 结论：此前 2 年佩戴 DIMS 框架眼镜的儿童，其近视控制效果在第 3 年仍持续存在；从 SV 镜片转为佩戴 DIMS 镜片的儿童，也表现出近视控制效果。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
AIMS: To determine myopia progression in children who continued to wear the defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lenses or switched from single vision (SV) to DIMS lenses for a 1-year period following a 2-year myopia control trial. METHODS: 128 children participated in this study. The children who had worn DIMS lenses continued to wear DIMS lenses (DIMS group), and children who had worn SV lenses switched to wear DIMS lenses (Control-to-DIMS group). Cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) were measured at 6-month interval. Historical controls were age matched to the DIMS group at 24 months and used for comparing the third-year changes. RESULTS: Over 3 years, SER and AL changes in the DIMS group (n=65) were -0.52±0.69D and 0.31±0.26 mm; these changes were not statistically significant over time (repeated measures analysis of variance, p>0.05).SER (-0.04±0. 38D) and AL (0.08±0.12 mm) changes in the Control-to-DIMS group (n=55) in the third year were less compared with the first (mean difference=0.45 ± 0.30D, 0.21±0.11 mm, p<0.001) and second (0.34±0.30D, 0.12±0.10 mm, p<0.001) years.Changes in SER and AL in both groups over that period were significantly less than in the historical control group (DIMS vs historical control: mean difference=-0.18±0.42D, p=0.012; 0.08±0.15 mm, p=0.001; Control-to-DIMS versus historical control: adjusted mean differences=-0.30±0.42D, p<0.001; 0.12±0.16 mm, p<0.001). CONCLUSIONS: Myopia control effect was sustained in the third year in children who had used the DIMS spectacles in the previous 2 years and was also shown in the children switching from SV to DIMS lenses.

Long-term myopia control effect and safety in children wearing DIMS spectacle lenses for 6 years

📖 Scientific Reports📅 2023年👥 Lam Carly Siu Yin, Tang Wing Chun, Zhang Han Yu, Lee Paul H, Tse Dennis Yan Yin, Qi Hua, Vlasak Natalia, To Chi Ho
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6年临床试验 / 2-6
原文摘要
摘要：本研究旨在评估儿童佩戴离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片的近视长期控制效果及安全性。对完成 2 年随机对照试验（RCT）的参与者进行了为期 6 年的随访，期间测量其睫状肌麻痹验光结果及眼轴长度。1 组（n=36）连续 6 年佩戴 DIMS 镜片；2 组（n=14）前 3.5 年佩戴 DIMS 镜片，之后更换为单光（SV）镜片；3 组（n=22）前 2 年佩戴 SV 镜片，之后更换为 DIMS 镜片；4 组（n=18）前 2 年佩戴 SV 镜片，随后更换为 DIMS 镜片并佩戴 1.5 年，之后再次换回 SV 镜片。1 组在前 3 年与后 3 年的近视进展（−0.52±0.66D vs. −0.40±0.72D）及眼轴增长（0.32±0.26mm vs. 0.28±0.28mm）方面均无统计学差异（均 p>0.05）。在最后 2.5 年中，DIMS 镜片组（1 组和 3 组）的近视进展及眼轴增长均少于单光镜片组（2 组和 4 组）。停止治疗后未发现近视反弹迹象。所有组别的佩戴后视功能均在正常范围内。结果表明，在 6 年研究期间，DIMS 镜片可实现持续的近视控制效果，且无不良反应。 试验注册：clinicaltrials.gov；注册号：NCT02206217
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
This study evaluated the long-term myopia control effect and safety in children wearing Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses. Participants who completed the 2-year RCT were followed for a total of 6 years; their cycloplegic refractions and axial length were measured. Group 1 (n = 36) wore DIMS spectacles for 6 years; Group 2 (n = 14) wore DIMS lens for the first 3.5 years and SV spectacles afterwards; Group 3 (n = 22) wore SV spectacles in the first 2 years and switched to DIMS; Group 4 (n = 18) wore SV spectacles in the first 2 years, switched to DIMS for 1.5 years and then SV spectacles again. Group 1 showed no significant differences in myopia progression (- 0.52 ± 0.66 vs. - 0.40 ± 0.72D) and axial elongation (0.32 ± 0.26 vs. 0.28 ± 0.28 mm, both p > 0.05) between the first and the later 3 years. In the last 2.5 years, DIMS lens groups (Groups 1 and 3) had less myopia progression and axial elongation than the single vision groups (Groups 2 and 4). There was no evidence of rebound after stopping the treatment. Post-wear visual functions in all groups were within norms. The results supported that DIMS lenses provided sustained myopia control without adverse effects over the 6-year study period.Trial registration: clinicaltrials.gov; NCT02206217.

Long-­term axial elongation in myopic children wearing DIMS spectacle lenses: an 8-­to-­10-­year observational study

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2026年👥 Leung Tsz Wing, Zhang Han Yu, Chan Kin Ho, Lee Paul H, Liu Kenneth Ka King, Kwok Yee Mui, To Ka Mei, Vlasak Natalia, Lam Carly Siu-Yin
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-8 研究中心&PI：香港理工大学视光学院&Carly SY Lam 研究类型：长期、纵向的回顾性观察研究 观察总样本量：60人（即所有完成最初2年、随后3年和6年的所有21次随访研究的儿童，且继续随访最少2年） group1（原DIMS 组，n=27） group2（DIMS → SVL，n=7） group3（SV → DIMS，n=14） group4（SV → DIMS→SV，n=12） 平均年龄：19.97±1.64岁 观察时间：9.4±0.3年 观察统计方法：建立内部模型预测（LMM模型）及外部常模对比（Benchmarked） 结论： 利用LMM模型预测： 假设持续配戴 DIMS，眼轴总共只增长 0.44±0.11mm；假设持续配戴SV，眼轴总增长将达到 1.27±0.11mm。DIMS 累积减少了 65% 的眼轴增长，防控效果极其显著。 假设持续配戴 DIMS，度数进展仅为–0.57±0.32 D；假设持续配戴SV，度数进展为–2.17±0.37 D。二者虽无统计学差异，但95%CI不重叠。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 8年临床试验 / 2-8
原文摘要
摘要： 背景/目的：评估离焦整合多段(DIMS)眼镜镜片在过渡到青春期晚期的原始随机临床试验队列的长期观察性随访(8年)中的长期有效性。 方法：从最初的DIMS试验(基线年龄：8-13岁)中选取60名青年(平均年龄：19.97±1.64岁)进行观察性试验后研究，平均随访时间为(9.4±0.3)年。使用线性混合效应模型(LMM)分析了等值球镜屈光度(SER)和眼轴长度(AL)的纵向变化，以比较 佩戴DIMS 镜片和SV镜片的变化率。LMM的预测以未经治疗的亚洲儿童的外部荟萃分析为基准。 结果：LMM预测，DIMS镜片对AL增长有显著的治疗作用(p=0.003)，与佩戴SV镜片相比，累积减少了65%(0.44±0.11 mm vs1.27±0.11 mm)。相反，DIMS镜片对延缓SER进展没有统计学上的显著影响(p=0.83)，尽管预测了一个很大的有临床意义的累积差异(DIMS：-0.57±0.32 D vs SV：-2.17±0.37 D)。LMM预测，连续佩戴DIMS镜片对AL增长的控制率比外部未处理的标准低76%。 结论：佩戴DIMS眼镜镜片可持续减缓青春期后期的AL增长，与单纯佩戴SV和外部标准相比有显著的好处。然而，这种显著的生物效应在LMM中并没有转化为统计上显著的屈光不正效应，这可能是因为长期的自动屈光测量固有的低信噪比，以及缺乏同期的、未经治疗的单视力对照组。在长期研究中，进一步的研究应该解决显著的AL控制和非显著的SER结果之间的矛盾。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND/AIM: To evaluate the long-term effectiveness of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses in a long-term observational follow-up (>8 years) of an original randomised clinical trial cohort transitioning into late adolescence. METHODS: This observational post-trial study included 60 young adults (mean age: 19.97±1.64 years) from the original DIMS trial (baseline age: 8-13 years) followed for an average of 9.4±0.3 years. Longitudinal changes in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) were analysed using linear mixed-effects models (LMM) to compare rates of change during DIMS versus single vision (SV) wear periods. LMM predictions were benchmarked against an external meta-analysis for untreated Asian children. RESULTS: The LMM revealed a significant treatment effect for DIMS on axial elongation (p=0.003), with a predicted 65% cumulative reduction versus modelled SV wear (0.44±0.11 mm vs 1.27±0.11 mm). Conversely, the LMM found no statistically significant effect on SER progression (p=0.83), despite predicting a large, clinically meaningful cumulative difference (DIMS: -0.57±0.32 D vs SV: -2.17±0.37 D). The LMM-predicted elongation for continuous DIMS wear was 76% lower than the external untreated norm. CONCLUSIONS: DIMS spectacle lens provides sustained slowing of axial elongation through late adolescence, yielding substantial benefits compared with modelled SV wear and external norms. However, this significant biological effect did not translate to a statistically significant refractive error effect in the LMM, possibly due to the low signal-to-noise ratio inherent to long-term autorefraction measurements and the lack of a contemporaneous, untreated single-vision control group. Further research should address this paradox between significant AL control and non-significant SER outcomes in long-term studies.

来源=桌面《框架眼镜SP》/04 豪雅新乐学DIMS/3-1 RWS 3639例-the efficacy of DIMS lenses in slowing myopia progression - a retrospective RWS.pdf 说明：摘录文件仅为文前作者、单位及基金声明等信息，未见摘要正文（Abstract）。 来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：目的：近期一项随机对照试验（RCT）显示，多焦点离焦（DIMS）框架眼镜可显著延缓近视进展。本研究旨在评估该镜片在临床实践中的疗效。设计：回顾性研究。研究对象：收集中国爱尔眼科医院集团旗下 9 家分院使用 DIMS 镜片和单光（SV）框架眼镜的患者病历资料。 方法：采用主观验光获得的右眼配镜球面等效屈光力（SE）评估近视进展情况。采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）法，对 DIMS 组和 SV 组的基线混杂因素进行匹配。根据两组近视进展差异计算疗效。 主要结果指标：球面等效屈光力（SE）的变化量。 结果：共纳入 3639 例使用 DIMS 镜片的受试者和 6838 例使用 SV 眼镜的受试者。受试者年龄为 6-16 岁，平均（标准差）为 11.02±2.53 岁；基线球面等效屈光力（SE）为 0.00~-10.00 D，平均为 - 2.78±1.74 D。倾向得分匹配（PSM）后，获得 2240 对 1 年随访数据和 735 对 2 年随访数据。在 1 年随访亚组（DIMS 组：-0.50±0.43 D，SV 组：-0.77±0.58 D，P<0.001）和 2 年随访亚组（DIMS 组：-0.88±0.43 D，SV 组：-1.23±0.58 D，P<0.001）中，DIMS 组的近视进展速度均显著慢于 SV 组。1 年随访亚组中，DIMS 组和 SV 组近视进展不超过 0.25 D 的比例分别为 40% 和 19%（P<0.001），而近视进展超过 1.00 D 的比例分别为 9% 和 22%（P<0.001）。2 年随访亚组中，DIMS 组和 SV 组近视进展不超过 0.50 D 的比例分别为 33% 和 20%（P<0.001），而近视进展超过 1.50 D 的比例分别为 12% 和 29%（P<0.001）。 结论：尽管本研究中 DIMS 镜片的疗效低于此前随机对照试验（RCT）报道的结果，但这项数据来源多样的大规模研究仍证实，在临床实践中 DIMS 框架眼镜具有延缓近视进展的疗效。 3-2 目的：本回顾性分析旨在评估德国真实临床环境下 “离焦整合多段式”（DIMS）镜片对近视的治疗效果。 材料与方法：分析 166 只接受 DIMS 治疗的眼睛在基线期和 12 个月随访时的眼轴长度（AL）及客观验光数据。年度眼轴长度增长率处于生理增长率范围内即视为治疗成功；近视进展量≤-0.5 屈光度 / 年（D/yr）也判定为治疗成功。研究分析了基于基线眼轴长度和年龄划分的亚组与总人群在治疗成功率上的差异。 结果：就所有受测眼睛而言，眼轴长度增长达标（治疗成功）的比例为 46%，近视进展达标（治疗成功）的比例为 65%。基线眼轴长度中等的男性眼睛治疗成功率更高（分别为 73%，p<0.01；89%，p<0.01）；而基线眼轴长度偏高的眼睛治疗成功率更低（分别为 25%，p<0.01；51%，无统计学意义）。女性眼睛呈现相同趋势，但差异无统计学意义（基线眼轴长度中等：49%、68%；基线眼轴长度偏高：40%、62%）。年龄较小儿童的治疗成功率较低（男性：11%，p<0.01；38%，p<0.05；女性：25%，p<0.01；42%，p<0.01）；年龄较大儿童的治疗成功率较高（男性：60%，p<0.05；78%，p<0.05；女性：53%，无统计学意义；77%，p<0.05）。 结论：基线眼轴长度中等的眼睛及年龄较大儿童的眼睛，在接受 12 个月 DIMS 治疗后可达到治疗成功标准。基线眼轴长度偏高的眼睛及年龄较小儿童的眼睛治疗成功率较低，因此应考虑联合治疗方案。未来研究中，应分别评估男性和女性的治疗效果。 3-3 目的：比较中国儿童佩戴角膜塑形镜（Ortho-k）或近视控制眼镜（MCS）一年后的近视控制效果。 方法：收集 212 例患者的相关数据，这些患者基线近视度数为 - 5.00~-0.75 屈光度（D），散光度数≤1.50 D，且至少接受过一年角膜塑形镜（欧几里得 Euclid，OK1；角膜塑形治疗镜 CRT，OK2）或近视控制眼镜（思利巴 Stellest，MCS1；离焦内置多段设计镜片 DIMS，MCS2）的近视控制治疗。根据等效球镜度数（SER）变化（针对眼镜组）和眼轴长度（AL）变化（针对所有组），比较四组的近视控制效果。所收集的数据仅来自右眼，包括首次就诊（基线）和一年随访时的最佳矫正视力（BCVA）、等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AL），并对这些数据进行分析。 结果：基线检查时，四组患者在性别、散光度数和最佳矫正视力（BCVA）方面无显著差异（P>0.05），但在基线年龄、近视度数和眼轴长度（AL）方面存在显著差异（P<0.05）。治疗一年后，四组患者的眼轴增长值（AE）无显著差异（P=0.49）。经基线年龄和球镜度数校正后，OK1、OK2、MCS1、MCS2 四组的眼轴增长值（AE）分别为 0.19±0.15 mm、0.18±0.14 mm、0.19±0.19 mm、0.20±0.18 mm。仅年龄是与眼轴增长值（AE）和等效球镜度数（SER）增加相关的显著因素（P<0.05）：所有组中眼轴增长值（AE）与年龄呈负相关，而眼镜组中等效球镜度数（SER）增加与基线年龄呈正相关。 结论：在中国真实临床环境中，两种品牌的角膜塑形镜和两种近视控制眼镜对轻中度近视儿童的近视控制效果相似。一年的平均眼轴增长值（AE）在 0.18~0.20 mm 之间，与此前关于角膜塑形镜近视控制效果的报道相当。

官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
OBJECTIVES: This retrospective analysis evaluates the treatment success of "Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments" (DIMS) spectacle lenses in a real-life clinical setting in Germany. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Axial length (AL) and objective refraction of 166 eyes treated with DIMS at baseline and 12-month follow-up were analyzed. Annual AL growth rate within the range of physiological growth rate was considered a successful treatment. Myopia progression of ≥ -0.5 D/yr accounted as treatment success. Differences in percentages of treatment success of subgroups depending on baseline AL and age against treatment success of the total population were investigated. RESULTS: Considering all eyes, treatment success regarding AL growth and myopia progression was achieved in 46% and 65%, respectively. Male eyes with moderate AL showed treatment success in a higher proportion (73%, p < 0.01; 89%, p < 0.01); eyes with high AL showed treatment success in a lower proportion (25%, p < 0.01; 51%, n.s.). Female eyes showed the same trend but without statistical significance (moderate AL: 49%; 68%; high AL: 40%; 62%). Younger children showed treatment success in a lower proportion (male: 11%, p < 0.01; 38%, p < 0.05; female: 25%, p < 0.01; 42%, p < 0.01). Older children showed treatment success in a higher proportion (male: 60%, p < 0.05; 78% p < 0.05; female: 53%, n.s.; 77% p < 0.05). CONCLUSIONS: Eyes with moderate baseline AL and of older children showed treatment success after 12 months of DIMS treatment. Eyes with a high baseline AL and of younger children showed treatment success in a smaller proportion, therefore combination treatment should be considered. In future studies, males and females should be assessed separately.

目的：比较中国儿童佩戴角膜塑形镜（Ortho-k）或近视控制眼镜（MCS）一年后的近视控制效果。 方法：收集 212 例患者的相关数据，这些患者基线近视度数为 - 5.00~-0.75 屈光度（D），散光度数≤1.50 D，且至少接受过一年角膜塑形镜（欧几里得 Euclid，OK1；角膜塑形治疗镜 CRT，OK2）或近视控制眼镜（思利巴 Stellest，MCS1；离焦内置多段设计镜片 DIMS，MCS2）的近视控制治疗。根据等效球镜度数（SER）变化（针对眼镜组）和眼轴长度（AL）变化（针对所有组），比较四组的近视控制效果。所收集的数据仅来自右眼，包括首次就诊（基线）和一年随访时的最佳矫正视力（BCVA）、等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AL），并对这些数据进行分析。 结果：基线检查时，四组患者在性别、散光度数和最佳矫正视力（BCVA）方面无显著差异（P>0.05），但在基线年龄、近视度数和眼轴长度（AL）方面存在显著差异（P<0.05）。治疗一年后，四组患者的眼轴增长值（AE）无显著差异（P=0.49）。经基线年龄和球镜度数校正后，OK1、OK2、MCS1、MCS2 四组的眼轴增长值（AE）分别为 0.19±0.15 mm、0.18±0.14 mm、0.19±0.19 mm、0.20±0.18 mm。仅年龄是与眼轴增长值（AE）和等效球镜度数（SER）增加相关的显著因素（P<0.05）：所有组中眼轴增长值（AE）与年龄呈负相关，而眼镜组中等效球镜度数（SER）增加与基线年龄呈正相关。 结论：在中国真实临床环境中，两种品牌的角膜塑形镜和两种近视控制眼镜对轻中度近视儿童的近视控制效果相似。一年的平均眼轴增长值（AE）在 0.18~0.20 mm 之间，与此前关于角膜塑形镜近视控制效果的报道相当。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
OBJECTIVE: To compare the effectiveness of myopia control in Chinese children, who had been wearing either orthokeratology (ortho-k) lenses or myopia control spectacles (MCS) for one year. METHODS: Relevant data were retrieved from 212 patients, with baseline myopia of -5.00 to -0.75 D, astigmatism ≤ 1.50 D, who had been undergoing myopia control treatment with either ortho-k (Euclid (OK1) or CRT (OK2)) or MCS (Stellest (MCS1) or DIMS (MCS2)) for at least one year. Myopia control effectiveness among the four groups was compared based on the change in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) (for the spectacle groups) and axial length (AL) (for all groups). Data retrieved, from the right eye only, included best corrected visual acuity (BCVA), SER, and AL at both the initial clinic visit (baseline) and the one-year visit was analysed. RESULTS: Although no significant differences in gender, cylindrical power, or BCVA were observed at the baseline visit (P > 0.05), there were significant differences in baseline age, myopia, and AL among the four groups (P < 0.05). No significant difference in axial elongation (AE) was found among the four groups after one year of treatment (P = 0.49). AE, adjusted for baseline age and spherical power, were 0.19 ± 0.15, 0.18 ± 0.14, 0.19 ± 0.19, 0.20 ± 0.18 mm for OK1, OK2, MCS1, MCS2, respectively. Only age was a significantly factor associated with AE and SER increase (P < 0.05), with negative associations between AE and age in all groups and positive association between SER increase and baseline age in the spectacle groups observed. CONCLUSION: Both brands of ortho-k lenses and MCS had similar myopia control effectiveness for mild to moderate myopic children treated in a real-world setting in China. Average AE in one year ranged from 0.18 to 0.20 mm, comparable to previous reports on myopia control using ortho-k.

原文摘要
摘要：背景：本研究旨在评估离焦整合多段式（DIMS）镜片按年龄分组延缓儿童近视进展的效果。方法：本研究为非随机、研究者设盲的回顾性对照观察研究，研究对象为 6-16 岁欧洲渐进性近视患儿，且无眼部病变。我们回顾性分析了分配使用 DIMS 镜片（豪雅® 米优智能®）或单光镜片（对照组）的受试者病历。在基线时以及随访 12 个月、24 个月和 36 个月时，测量睫状肌麻痹状态下的球镜度数等效值（SE）和眼轴长度（AL）。按年龄将结果分为四组：佩戴 DIMS 镜片且年龄大于 10 岁或小于 10 岁的患者（A 组：20 例，平均年龄 13.6±2.2 岁；C 组：20 例，平均年龄 9.0±1.2 岁）以及年龄匹配的对照组（B 组：18 例，平均年龄 13.2±2.5 岁；D 组：22 例，平均年龄 8.5±0.9 岁）。结果：随访 36 个月时，与 B 组和 D 组相比，A 组和 C 组的 SE 增加量和 AL 增加量分别显著降低（p<0.05）。线性回归分析显示，在 A 组和 C 组中，患者年龄与近视进展（以 SE 衡量）存在显著相关性（p<0.05）；而以 AL 衡量时，仅 A 组存在显著相关性（p<0.05）。B 组和 D 组未显示出任何显著相关性（p>0.05）。结论：DIMS 镜片似乎能延缓儿童近视进展，但其效果在 10 岁以上儿童中最为显著。此外，我们的研究结果表明，眼轴长度（AL）可能是评估近视进展更可靠的指标。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
Background: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the effectiveness of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMSs) in slowing myopia progression in pediatric patients as a function of age. Methods: This was a non-randomized experimenter-masked retrospective controlled observational study of European individuals aged 6-16 years with progressive myopia but no ocular pathology. We retrospectively reviewed the charts of the participants allocated to receive DIMS spectacles (Hoya® MiyoSmart®) or single-vision spectacle lenses (control group). Cycloplegic spherical equivalent (SE) and axial length (AL) were measured at baseline and at 12-, 24-, and 36-month follow-ups. The results were stratified by age into four groups: patients wearing DIMS spectacles older or younger than 10 years of age (group A, 20 patients mean age 13.6 ± 2.2, and group C, 20 patients mean age 9.0 ± 1.2) and age-matched control groups (group B, 18 patients mean age 13.2 ± 2.5, and group D, 22 patients mean age 8.5 ± 0.9). Results: At 36 months, SE and AL increase were significantly reduced in groups A and C, respectively, compared to groups B and D (p < 0.05). Linear regression analysis showed a significant correlation (p < 0.05) between patient age and myopia progression for SE in groups A and C, but only in group A for AL. Groups B and D did not show any significant correlation (p > 0.05). Conclusions: DIMS spectacles seem to slow myopia progression in pediatric patients; however, their effectiveness shows the greatest results in children older than 10 years of age. Moreover, our findings suggest that AL may be the more reliable parameter for evaluating myopia progression.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / RWS / 3-5
原文摘要
摘要：意义：这些数据表明，多焦段离焦（DIMS）镜片在使用的第一年能减缓儿童近视的进展。 目的：本研究旨在调查多焦段离焦近视控制眼镜片对 6 至 15 岁中国近视儿童的疗效。 方法：这是一项对 1 年纵向数据的回顾性研究。2018 年 2 月至 2021 年 1 月期间，从中山大学中山眼科中心的患者中选取了 180 名中国近视儿童。一组为 90 名 6 至 15 岁的儿童，等效球镜度数为 - 0.50 至 - 7.75 D（-3.82 ± 1.57 D），并佩戴多焦段离焦镜片。另一组为 90 名佩戴单光眼镜片的儿童，与多焦段离焦组在年龄、性别、屈光度数和上一年近视进展情况方面相匹配。回顾性测量了两组儿童一年的近视进展情况。采用非配对 t 检验比较多焦段离焦组和对照组的近视进展情况。采用皮尔逊相关分析探讨近视进展与年龄、基线屈光度数之间的关系。 结果：佩戴多焦段离焦镜片 1 年后，多焦段离焦组的近视进展明显更低（-0.51 ± 0.50 与 -0.85 ± 0.51 D，P < 0.001）。两组中近视进展均与年龄呈正相关。10 至 15 岁儿童的多焦段离焦组与对照组之间的差异比 6 至 9 岁儿童更为显著。 结论：本研究证实，多焦段离焦镜片在使用的第一年能减缓近视进展。其疗效似乎随年龄增长而增强。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
SIGNIFICANCE: These data demonstrate that defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) lens reduces myopia progression in children during the first year of use. PURPOSE: This study aimed to investigate the efficacy of DIMS myopia control spectacle lens in Chinese myopic children aged 6 to 15 years. METHODS: This is a retrospective study of 1-year longitudinal data. A total of 180 Chinese myopic children were selected from patients at Zhongshan Ophthalmic Center, Sun Yat-sen University, from February 2018 to January 2021. One group consisted of 90 children aged 6 to 15 years, with spherical equivalent refraction -0.50 to -7.75 D (-3.82 ± 1.57 D) and fitted with the DIMS lens. The other group consisted of 90 children fitted with single-vision spectacle lenses and matched with the DIMS group for age, sex, refraction, and progression of myopia in the previous year. One-year myopia progression was measured retrospectively in two groups. Unpaired t test was used to compare the myopia progression between the DIMS group and the control group. Pearson correlation was used to explore the relationship between myopia progression, age, and baseline refraction. RESULTS: After 1 year of DIMS lens wear, myopia progression was significantly lower in the DIMS group (-0.51 ± 0.50 vs. -0.85 ± 0.51 D, P < .001). Myopia progression was positively correlated with age in both groups. The difference between the DIMS and control groups was more pronounced for children aged 10 to 15 years than for children aged 6 to 9 years. CONCLUSIONS: This study confirms that the DIMS lens reduces myopia progression during the first year of use. Efficacy seems to increase with age.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / RWS / 3-6
原文摘要
目的：本研究旨在评估在广泛年龄范围（6-26 岁）的欧洲进行性近视人群中，离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片相较于对照组（CTRL）的矫正有效性。 方法：本研究为前瞻性、非随机观察性研究，共纳入 78 例进行性近视患者，近视度数为 - 0.25~-8.5 屈光度（D），散光度数为 - 0.25~-2.25 屈光度（D）。患者自主选择佩戴 DIMS 镜片（n=54）或单光镜片（SV，n=24）。基线测量指标包括球镜度数等效值（SER）和眼轴长度（AL），并定期对这些指标进行评估。 结果：在 15 岁以下受试者中，与第 2 组（对照组，SER 为 - 0.73±0.57 D，AL 为 0.30±0.20 mm）相比，第 1 组（DIMS 组）的近视进展（以 SER 衡量）更缓慢（SER 为 - 0.25±0.35 D），眼轴伸长量也更少（0.09±0.16 mm），两组差异均具有统计学意义（p<0.05）。在 15 岁以上受试者中，第 3 组（DIMS 组）近视进展极轻微（SER 为 - 0.24±0.29 D），眼轴伸长量可忽略不计（0.00±0.07 mm）；而第 4 组（对照组）眼轴伸长更明显（SER 为 - 0.20±0.53 D，AL 为 0.01±0.06 mm）。 结论：与单光镜片相比，DIMS 镜片对 15 岁以下受试者眼轴长度（AL）的改善效果高出 68.7%，对球镜度数等效值（SER）的改善效果高出 65.6%。在 15 岁以下年龄组中，DIMS 镜片对近视进展的减缓作用具有统计学意义，且其对该年龄组 SER 的影响也观察到统计学上的显著差异。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
AIM: The objective of this study was to evaluate the efficacy of DIMS (Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments) in comparison to control group (CTRL) in a wide age group of European progressive myopes (6-26 years). METHODS: In this prospective, non-randomised observational study, 78 myopes with progression myopia to -0.25 to -8.5 D and astigmatism to -0.25 to -2.25 D chose DIMS (n=54) or single vision lenses (SV) (n=24). Baseline measurements included spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AL), evaluated at regular intervals. RESULTS: In participants younger than 15 years of age, slower progression of myopia (SER) (SER -0.25±0.35 D) and reduced axial elongation (0.09 ± 0.16 mm) was observed in Group 1 (DIMS) compared to Group 2 (CTRL) (SER -0.73 ± 0.57 D, AL 0.30 ± 0.20 mm), both significantly at p-value <0.05. In participants over 15 years of age, Group 3 (DIMS) exhibited minimal myopia progression (SER -0.24 ± 0.29D) and negligible axial elongation (0.00 ± 0.07 mm), Group 4 (CTRL) demonstrated more pronounced axial elongation (SER -0.20 ± 0.53D, AL 0.01 ± 0.06 mm). CONCLUSION: It can be stated that the DIMS variant is 68.7% more effective in the category of subjects younger than 15 years of age in the effect on AL and 65.6% more effective in the effect on SER compared to the SV lenses. This deceleration in myopia progression is statistically significant in the under 15 age group. A statistically significant difference in the effect on SER in this age group was observed for DIMS.

参考文献3-7 79例DIMS vs 81例SVL-DIMS使近视进展回归生理性进展 起始时间：2014年 研究中心&PI：香港理工大学视光学院 & Carly S.Y. Lam 试验设计简述：RCT临床试验数据的二次分析 试验组样本量：DIMS组79只眼 65%（男性 61%、女性 70%）眼轴长度增长率处于生理性增长范围内
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / RWS / 3-7
原文摘要
摘要 背景 / 目的：已知与单光（SV）镜片相比，离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片可抑制近视儿童的眼轴长度（AL）增长。但目前尚不清楚眼轴长度增长是否能被充分抑制，以达到生理性眼轴长度增长的治疗目标。 方法：基于 Lam 等人 2014–2017 年已收集的数据，采用年龄匹配近视控制系统，重新评估佩戴 DIMS 镜片和 SV 镜片儿童的眼轴长度增长情况。以彩色编码方式，将每只眼睛治疗 1 年后的个体眼轴长度增长与同期对应年龄进行绘图分析。根据年龄和基线眼轴长度，将两个治疗组进一步细分。 结果：总体而言，佩戴 DIMS 镜片的眼睛中，65%（男性 61%、女性 70%）的眼轴长度增长率处于生理性增长范围内；而佩戴 SV 镜片的眼睛中，仅 16%（男性 16%、女性 16%）处于该范围。佩戴 DIMS 镜片眼睛的眼轴长度增长中位数也处于生理性增长范围内。在各亚组中，就该治疗目标而言，佩戴 DIMS 镜片的眼睛效果仍优于佩戴 SV 镜片的眼睛。在佩戴 SV 镜片的儿童中，年龄较大的儿童和基线眼轴长度较高的儿童，达到生理性眼轴长度增长率的可能性最低。 结论：DIMS 镜片可使近视儿童的眼轴长度增长率降至生理性眼轴长度增长水平，这表明其能 100% 减少近视相关的过度眼轴长度增长，且不受年龄和基线眼轴长度的影响。未接受治疗时，年龄较大的儿童和眼轴长度较高的儿童存在眼轴长度增长加快的风险。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND/AIMS: Defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses are known to be able to inhibit axial length (AL) growth in myopic children compared with single vision (SV) spectacle lenses. However, it is not known whether AL growth is sufficiently inhibited to achieve the treatment goal of physiological AL growth. METHODS: Of the data already collected in 2014-2017 by Lam et al, the AL growth with DIMS and SV spectacle lenses was re-evaluated according to the age-matched myopia control system. The individual AL growth after the first year of treatment of each eye was plotted against the corresponding age of the same time point in a colour-coded scheme. The two treatment groups were further subdivided based on their age and their baseline AL. RESULTS: Overall, 65% (61% of male, 70% of female) of eyes with DIMS spectacle lenses and 16% (16% of male, 16% of female) of eyes with SV spectacle lenses are within range of physiological AL growth rate. Median AL growth rate of eyes with DIMS spectacle lenses is also within the range of physiological growth. In the subgroups, eyes with DIMS spectacle lenses were also superior to the ones with SV spectacle lenses regarding this treatment goal. Of the children with SV spectacle lenses, older children and children with eyes with high baseline AL were least likely to achieve physiological AL growth rate. CONCLUSIONS: DIMS spectacle lenses can bring the AL growth rate of myopic children to the level of physiological AL growth rate, indicating 100% reduction of excessive myopic AL growth, independent of age and baseline AL. Older children and children with eyes with high AL have the risk to have increased AL growth without treatment.

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2025年👥 Akagun Nilay, Altiparmak Ugur Emrah
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献3-8 54例DIMS vs 43例SVL 起始时间：2023年5月 研究中心&PI：Department of Ophthalmology, Acıbadem Hospital Ankara, Ankara, Turkey & Nilay Akagun 试验设计简述：回顾性观察性研究 试验组样本量：DIMS组54人 SE：进展量-0.28D，控制量0.46D，控制率62% AL：进展量0.14mm，控制量-0.15mm,控制率52%
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / RWS / 3-8
原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究评估 12 个月内，离焦整合多段式（DIMS）框架眼镜在土耳其儿童人群中控制近视进展和眼轴增长的有效性。 方法：本回顾性观察性研究纳入 97 名儿童（194 只眼），年龄 6~16 岁，分别处方 DIMS 眼镜（54 例）或单光框架眼镜（SVSLs，43 例）。在基线时和 12 个月后测量睫状肌麻痹球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）。采用广义估计方程（GEE）评估治疗有效性，并按年龄组、性别和基线眼轴长度进行亚组分析。 结果：12 个月后，与 SVSL 组（-0.74 屈光度，标准差 0.75）相比，DIMS 组近视进展显著更少（-0.28 屈光度，标准差 0.42），表明 SER 进展减少 62%（P<0.001）。DIMS 组眼轴增长（0.14 毫米，标准差 0.31）也显著低于 SVSL 组（0.29 毫米，标准差 0.31），对应减少 52%（P<0.001）。亚组分析显示，在两组中，年龄较小和基线眼轴长度较高均与 SER 进展更显著、眼轴增长更显著持续相关。在 DIMS 组中，基线眼轴长度较高预示结局较差，但年龄和性别并非显著预测因素。 结论：与 SVSLs 相比，DIMS 框架眼镜可有效减少儿童近视进展和眼轴增长。该类眼镜为近视控制提供了一种安全、无创的方法，对年龄较小或基线眼轴长度较高的患者尤其有益。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study evaluated the effectiveness of defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses in controlling myopia progression and axial elongation in a Turkish paediatric population over a 12-month period. METHODS: This retrospective observational study included 97 children (194 eyes), aged 6-16 years, who were prescribed either DIMS lenses (n = 54) or single vision spectacle lenses (SVSLs, n = 43). Cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) were measured at baseline and after 12 months. Treatment effectiveness was assessed using generalised estimating equations (GEE) and subgroup analyses were conducted based on age group, gender and baseline AL. RESULTS: After 12 months, the DIMS group exhibited significantly less myopia progression (-0.28 D [0.42]) compared with the SVSL group (-0.74 D [0.75]), indicating a 62% reduction in SER progression (p < 0.001). Axial elongation was also significantly lower in the DIMS group (0.14 mm [0.31]) than in the SVSL group (0.29 mm [0.31]), corresponding to a 52% reduction (p < 0.001). Subgroup analyses revealed that younger age and high baseline AL were consistently associated with greater SER progression and AL elongation across both groups. In the DIMS group, high baseline AL predicted poorer outcomes, but age and gender were not significant predictors. CONCLUSIONS: DIMS spectacle lenses effectively reduced myopia progression and axial elongation in children compared with SVSLs. These lenses offer a safe and non-invasive method for myopia control, being especially beneficial for younger patients or those with higher baseline axial length.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在探讨离焦整合多段式（DIMS）镜片在临床人群中对近视进展和眼轴增长的影响。 方法：本研究为回顾性研究，采用 2018 年 7 月至 2019 年 8 月期间在香港理工大学视光诊所分别处方 DIMS 镜片和单光（SV）镜片的 489 例和 156 例 3-17 岁患者的临床数据。研究纳入曾接受过近视控制干预的患者，测量其等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）的变化，并将其标准化为年变化量；同时分析基线年龄与 AL 年变化量之间的相关性。 结果：佩戴 DIMS 镜片后，SER 总变化量为 - 0.94±0.79 屈光度（D），AL 总变化量为 0.55±0.40 毫米（mm），平均佩戴时长为 31.98±9.97 个月。DIMS 镜片佩戴者的 SER 和 AL 标准化年变化量显著小于 SV 镜片佩戴者（DIMS 组：SER 变化量 - 0.38±0.32D，AL 变化量 0.22±0.16mm；SV 组：SER 变化量 - 0.45±0.41D，AL 变化量 0.29±0.20mm，p<0.05）。有近视控制史的患者在佩戴 DIMS 镜片后，近视进展程度更显著。基线年龄与 AL 年变化量之间存在显著负相关（相关系数 r=-0.61，p<0.001），提示发病年龄越小的儿童，近视进展越快。少数患者（2.7%）在佩戴 DIMS 镜片超过 2 年后，出现具有临床意义的眼轴缩短（AL 总变化量：-0.13±0.07mm）。 结论：本研究表明，DIMS 镜片可延缓眼轴增长，且随着佩戴时长增加，该效果仍能维持。然而，有过近视控制史的患者在佩戴 DIMS 镜片后，近视进展更为明显。研究还发现，少数患者佩戴 DIMS 镜片后存在眼轴缩短的可能性。这些结果强调了坚持干预对于实现最佳治疗效果的重要性。未来需进一步研究以明确上述效应的潜在机制，并优化光学干预手段在近视控制中的应用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study aimed to examine the effect of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) lenses on myopia progression and axial elongation in a clinical population. METHODS: A retrospective study was conducted using clinical data from 489 and 156 patients aged 3 to 17 years old who were prescribed DIMS and single vision (SV) lenses, respectively at the Optometry Clinic of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University between July 2018 and August 2019. The study included patients with previous myopia control interventions. The changes in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) were measured and normalized to annual changes. The correlation between age at baseline and annual change in AL was also examined. RESULTS: The total change in SER and AL after DIMS were -0.94 ± 0.79D and 0.55 ± 0.40 mm, respectively with an average wearing period of 31.98 ± 9.97 months. The normalized annual changes in SER and AL in DIMS wearers were significantly smaller than those in SV wearers (DIMS; SER change vs. AL changes; -0.38 ± 0.32D vs. 0.22 ± 0.16 mm. SV; -0.45 ± 0.41D vs. 0.29 ± 0.20 mm, p < 0.05). Patients with a history of myopia control had greater myopia progression after wearing DIMS lenses. There was a significant negative correlation between age at baseline and annual change in AL (correlation coefficient, r = -0.61, p < 0.001), suggesting that myopia progression was faster in children with a younger age of onset. A small proportion of patients (2.7%) experienced a clinically significant axial shortening (total change in AL:-0.13 ± 0.07 mm) after wearing DIMS lenses more than 2 years. CONCLUSION: The study demonstrated that DIMS lenses could retard axial elongation, with the effect sustained with increased duration of lens wear. However, patients with previous myopia control experienced greater myopia progression after wearing DIMS lenses. The study also highlighted the potential for axial length shortening in a small proportion of patients after the DIMS lens wear. These findings underscore the importance of adherence to intervention in achieving optimal treatment efficacy. Further research is needed to understand the mechanisms underlying these effects and to optimize the use of optical interventions in myopia control.

原文摘要
摘要 重要性：研究发现，在新型冠状病毒肺炎（COVID-19）疫情期间，儿童近视进展加剧。在此期间控制近视的快速进展具有重要意义。 目的：分析 COVID-19 相关封锁措施与儿童近视进展的关联，并比较离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS）与单光镜片（SVL）在减缓近视进展方面的治疗效果。 设计、研究地点与研究对象：本队列研究对 2019 年起在同一机构开展的两项独立纵向研究进行了探索性预设比较。收集并分析了香港地区 7-13 岁学龄儿童的数据。数据分析于 2021 年 6 月至 7 月进行。 暴露因素：研究 1 中的儿童佩戴 DIMS 镜片 18 个月，研究 2 中的儿童佩戴 SVL 镜片 24 个月。 主要结果指标：测量指标包括睫状肌麻痹下等效球镜度数和眼轴长度。研究 1 和研究 2 均在封锁措施实施前启动，并在整个封锁期间持续进行。两项研究均划分出 COVID-19 相关封锁措施较少的时期和较多的时期。由于 COVID-19 封锁导致随访时间偏离计划，研究将近视进展标准化为 12 个月变化量，进而比较 DIMS 组与 SVL 组的差异，同时也比较了封锁时间短和封锁时间长时期的差异。 结果：DIMS 组共 115 名参与者（女生 58 名，占 50.4%；平均年龄 [标准差] 为 10.3 [1.5] 岁），其基线平均等效球镜度数 [标准差] 为 - 4.02 [1.46] 屈光度（D）。SVL 组共 56 名参与者（女生 29 名，占 51.8%；平均年龄 [标准差] 为 10.8 [1.5] 岁），其基线平均等效球镜度数 [标准差] 为 - 2.99 [1.06] D。控制协变量后，与 SVL 治疗相比，DIMS 治疗与眼轴伸长量减少 34%（0.19 mm [95% 置信区间，0.16~0.22 mm] vs 0.30 mm [95% 置信区间，0.25~0.35 mm]，P<0.001）以及 12 个月后近视进展减少 46%（-0.31 D [95% 置信区间，-0.39~-0.23 D] vs -0.57 D [95% 置信区间，-0.69~-0.45 D]，P=0.001）显著相关。在 DIMS 组和 SVL 组中，与封锁时间较短相比，封锁时间较长均与等效球镜度数显著增加（-0.54 D [95% 置信区间，-0.64~-0.44 D] vs -0.34 D [95% 置信区间，-0.44~-0.25 D]，P=0.01）和眼轴长度显著增加（0.29 mm [95% 置信区间，0.25~0.32 mm] vs 0.20 mm [95% 置信区间，0.16~0.24 mm]，P=0.001）相关。未观察到治疗类型与封锁时间之间存在显著交互作用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
IMPORTANCE: Myopia progression has been found to be worsening during the COVID-19 pandemic. It is important to control the rapid myopia progression in this period. OBJECTIVE: To analyze the association of COVID-19-related lockdown measures with myopia progression in schoolchildren and to compare the performance of defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lens with that of single vision lens (SVL) treatment in reducing myopia progression. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cohort study involved an exploratory, prespecified, comparison of 2 independent longitudinal studies performed at the same institute beginning in 2019. Data from Hong Kong schoolchildren (aged 7-13 years) were gathered and analyzed. Data analysis was performed from June to July 2021. EXPOSURE: Schoolchildren in study 1 wore a DIMS lens for 18 months, and those in study 2 wore a SVL for 24 months. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction and axial length were measured. Studies 1 and 2 started before the start of lockdown measures and continued throughout the lockdown. In both studies, periods of fewer and more COVID-19-related lockdown measures were identified. Because COVID-19 lockdown caused deviations from the visit schedule, myopia progression was normalized to 12-month change, which were compared between DIMS and SVL groups, also during the periods with less and more lockdown time. RESULTS: There were 115 participants (58 girls [50.4%]; mean [SD] age, 10.3 [1.5] years) in the DIMS group; their mean (SD) baseline refraction was -4.02 (1.46) D. There were 56 participants (29 girls [51.8%]; mean [SD] age, 10.8 [1.5] years) in the SVL group; their mean (SD) baseline refraction was -2.99 (1.06) D. After controlling for the covariates, DIMS treatment was significantly associated with 34% less axial elongation (0.19 mm [95% CI, 0.16 to 0.22 mm] vs 0.30 mm [95% CI, 0.25 to 0.35 mm]; P < .001) and 46% less myopic progression after 12 months (-0.31 D [95% CI, -0.39 to -0.23 D] vs -0.57 D [95% CI, -0.69 to -0.45 D]; P = .001) compared with SVL treatment. In both the DIMS and SVL groups, more lockdown time was associated with significantly more spherical equivalent refraction (-0.54 D [95% CI, -0.64 to 0.44 D] vs -0.34 D [95% CI, -0.44 to -0.25 D]; P = .01) and axial length (0.29 mm [95% CI, 0.25 to 0.32 mm] vs 0.20 mm [95% CI, 0.16 to 0.24 mm]; P = .001) compared with less lockdown time. No significant interaction between treatment type and lockdown time was observed. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this exploratory analysis, myopia progressed more rapidly in schoolchildren during the period when there were more COVID-19-related lockdown measures. However, optical treatment with DIMS was significantly associated with slower myopia progression compared with SVL treatment during the lockdown period.

原文摘要
摘要 引言：近视是一个日益严重的公共卫生问题，长期存在视力损害风险。尽管离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片已在中国儿童中证实有效，但针对西方人群的证据仍较为有限。本多中心干预研究旨在评估 DIMS 镜片在减缓英国儿童近视进展方面的有效性，以及其在该人群中的视觉可接受性和耐受性。 方法：纳入 5-15 岁、睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度数（SER）为 - 0.50~-8.50D、屈光参差≤1.50D 且散光≤2.50D 的儿童。所有受试者均处方 DIMS 镜片。在基线时及随后 24 个月内每 6 个月测量一次 SER（睫状肌麻痹自动验光）和眼轴长度（AL，使用 IOLMaster 测量）。将测得的眼轴增长情况与已发表的荟萃分析中年龄和种族匹配的未治疗近视儿童的预期眼轴增长情况进行比较。同时评估视觉功能（远 / 近视力、立体视、调节滞后和眼位）及视觉症状（通过受试者问卷收集）。 结果：共 108 名受试者完成了为期 2 年的研究（基线年龄 10.2±2.2 岁）。模型校正后的均值（标准误）显示，12 个月时 SER 变化为 - 0.35±0.04D、AL 变化为 0.17±0.01mm；24 个月时 SER 变化为 - 0.57±0.05D、AL 变化为 0.30±0.03mm。与未治疗近视儿童的预期进展相比，佩戴 DIMS 镜片的儿童在 24 个月内眼轴增长减少 0.27±0.20mm（均值 ± 标准差），其中 91% 的儿童眼轴增长速度慢于未治疗近视儿童的平均水平。DIMS 镜片与单光镜片在视觉功能指标上具有可比性。57% 的受试者在佩戴第一周内未报告视觉症状，且在佩戴 DIMS 镜片 12 个月和 24 个月后，受试者平均 “从未” 或 “极少” 出现视觉症状。 结论：本研究提供了可靠且新颖的证据，表明 DIMS 镜片能有效减缓英国儿童的眼轴增长。在整个佩戴期间，视觉症状极少且视觉功能得以保留，这支持了该镜片在不同人群近视管理中的临床可行性和实际应用价值。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
INTRODUCTION: Myopia is a growing public health concern with long-term risks for visual impairment. While Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses have proven efficacy in Chinese children, evidence from Western populations remains limited. This multi-site interventional study evaluates the effectiveness of DIMS lenses in slowing myopia progression and their visual acceptability and tolerability among UK children. METHODS: Children aged 5-15 years with cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) of -0.50 to -8.50 D, anisometropia ≤1.50 D and astigmatism ≤2.50 D were recruited. All participants were prescribed DIMS spectacle lenses. SER (cycloplegic autorefraction) and axial length (AL, IOLMaster) were measured at baseline and at 6-monthly intervals for 24 months. Measured axial elongation was compared to expected eye growth in age- and ethnicity-matched untreated myopes from published meta-analyses. Visual function (distance/near visual acuity, stereoacuity, accommodative lag and ocular posture) and visual symptoms (participant questionnaire) were also assessed. RESULTS: A total of 108 participants completed the study to 2 years (baseline age 10.2 ± 2.2 years). Model-adjusted mean (SE) changes in SER and AL change were -0.35 ± 0.04 D and 0.17 ± 0.01 mm at 12 months and -0.57 ± 0.05 D and 0.30 ± 0.03 mm at 24 months. Compared to expected untreated myopic progression, children wearing DIMS spectacle lenses showed 0.27 ± 0.20 mm (mean ± SD) less axial elongation over 24 months, with 91% exhibiting slower than average untreated myopic eye growth. Measures of visual function were comparable through DIMS and single-vision spectacle lenses. Fifty-seven percent of participants reported no visual symptoms within the first week, and on average, visual symptoms were 'never' or 'seldom' experienced by participants after 12 and 24 months of DIMS wear. CONCLUSIONS: This study provides robust and novel evidence demonstrating that DIMS spectacle lenses provide meaningful slowing of axial elongation among UK children. Minimal visual symptoms and preserved visual function throughout lens wear support their clinical viability and real-world applicability for myopia management in diverse populations.

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / RWS / 3-12
原文摘要
摘要 背景 / 目的：本研究旨在评估多焦离焦（DIMS）眼镜片在土耳其儿童队列中控制近视进展的一年期真实世界有效性，并利用年龄特异性生理生长曲线识别治疗反应的预测因素。 方法：本项单中心回顾性研究纳入 54 例（108 只眼）6-16 岁近视患儿，均全天佩戴多焦离焦（DIMS）眼镜片 12 个月。主要结局指标为球镜当量屈光度数（SER）达标情况和基于眼轴长度（AL）的治疗反应。治疗达标定义为每年球镜当量屈光度数（SER）进展≤0.50 屈光度，且眼轴长度（AL）增长在年龄特异性生理范围内。按年龄、性别和基线眼轴长度（AL）分组进行亚组分析。 结果：12 个月后，平均眼轴长度（AL）增长为 0.14 ± 0.31 mm，平均球镜当量屈光度数（SER）变化为 -0.28 ± 0.42 屈光度。85.2% 的眼睛达到球镜当量屈光度数（SER）达标标准。基于眼轴长度（AL）的治疗反应中，61.1% 的眼睛表现为良好反应，16.7% 为低 - 中度反应，22.2% 无反应。基线眼轴长度（AL）中度组的眼睛较基线眼轴长度（AL）高度组的眼睛，眼轴增长显著更少（p=0.001）。10 岁及以上儿童表现出更优的基于眼轴长度（AL）的治疗反应（p=0.016）。基线眼轴长度（AL）分组是眼轴长度（AL）治疗反应的显著预测因素，而基线眼轴长度（AL）分组和性别均能预测球镜当量屈光度数（SER）达标情况。性别与球镜当量屈光度数（SER）结局相关，但与基于眼轴长度（AL）的治疗反应无关。 结论：在该土耳其儿童真实世界队列中，多焦离焦（DIMS）眼镜片能有效减缓近视进展和眼轴增长。基线眼轴长度（AL）和性别是治疗结局的显著预测因素。纳入年龄特异性生理生长曲线为解读治疗达标情况提供了个体化框架。需开展更大样本量、更长随访时间的前瞻性研究以验证上述结果。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND/OBJECTIVES: This study aimed to evaluate the one-year real-world effectiveness of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses in controlling myopia progression in a Turkish pediatric cohort and to identify predictors of treatment response using age-specific physiological growth curves. METHODS: This retrospective single-center study included 54 patients (108 eyes) aged 6-16 years with myopia who wore DIMS spectacle lenses full time for 12 months. The primary outcomes were spherical equivalent refraction (SER) success and axial length (AL)-based treatment response. Treatment success was defined as an SER progression of ≤0.50 dioptres per year and AL elongation within age-specific physiological limits. Subgroup analyses were performed according to age, gender, and the baseline AL group. RESULTS: After 12 months, the mean AL elongation was 0.14 ± 0.31 mm, and the mean SER change was -0.28 ± 0.42 D. SER-based success was achieved in 85.2% of eyes. For AL-based response, 61.1% of eyes showed a good response, 16.7% showed a low-moderate response, and 22.2% had no response. Eyes with moderate baseline AL exhibited significantly less axial elongation than those with high baseline AL (p = 0.001). Children aged ≥ 10 years demonstrated better AL-based responses (p = 0.016). The baseline AL group significantly predicted the AL treatment response, while both the baseline AL group and gender predicted SER success. Gender was associated with SER outcomes but not with AL-based response. CONCLUSIONS: DIMS spectacle lenses effectively reduced myopia progression and axial elongation in this real-world Turkish pediatric cohort. Baseline AL and gender were significant predictors of treatment outcomes. Incorporating age-specific physiological growth curves provided an individualized framework for interpreting treatment success. Further prospective studies with larger samples and longer follow-up are warranted to confirm these findings.

HALTvsDIMSvsCAREvsSVL-回顾性研究-HALT控制效果最佳
