摘要 目的：比较三种近视控制框架眼镜——多区正向光学离焦镜片（DIMS）、高非球面微透镜（HALT）和柱镜环形屈光微结构镜片（CARE）与单光镜片（SVL）在临床环境中延缓儿童眼轴增长和近视屈光度进展的效果。 方法：单中心回顾性队列研究。纳入899名（1780眼）6~16岁、睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度（SE）在-0.50 D至-9.00 D的受试者，分为SVL组（446眼）、DIMS组（523眼）、HALT组（295眼）和CARE组（516眼）。从电子病历提取数据，采用线性混合效应模型比较各镜片类型的眼轴（AL）和SE年化进展率，校正基线年龄、性别、父母近视及基线指标。 结果：队列平均年龄为12.18±2.73岁，平均随访12.49±5.71个月。与SVL组（0.193 mm/年）相比，所有近视控制镜片均显著延缓AL增长（校正后AL年增长量：DIMS组0.098 mm/年、CARE组0.088 mm/年、HALT组0.054 mm/年；对比SVL均P<0.001）；HALT在延缓AL增长方面的效果显著优于DIMS（P<0.001）和CARE（P<0.001）。所有近视控制镜片也显著减缓近视SE进展（SVL组为-0.370 D/年，DIMS组为-0.107 D/年，CARE组为-0.106 D/年，HALT组为-0.073 D/年），但三种近视控制镜片之间两两比较SE进展差异无统计学意义（P>0.13）。 结论：HALT、DIMS和CARE镜片均能有效延缓近视进展，其中HALT对眼轴增长的控制效果最佳。尽管回顾性设计需谨慎解读，但结果支持使用这三款镜片。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To compare the clincial setting effectiveness of three myopia control spectacle lenses, defocus incor-porated multiple segments (DIMS), highly aspherical lenslet target (HALT), and cylindrical annular refractive elements (CARE), versus single-vision lenses (SVLs) in attenuating axial elongation and myopic refractive shift in children. Design: A single-center, retrospective cohort study. Participants: A total of 899 subjects (1780 eyes) aged 6—16 years with cycloplegic spherical equivalent (SE) between —0.50 D and —9.00 D. Subjects were divided into four groups based on prescribed eyewear: SVL (n = 446 eyes), DIMS (n = 523 eyes), HALT (n = 295 eyes), and CARE (n = 516 eyes). Methods: Data were extracted from electronic medical records. Longitudinal changes in axial length (AL) and SE refraction were analyzed using linear mixed-effects models to compare progression rates among the lens types, adjusting for baseline age, sex, parental myopia, and the baseline value of the respective outcome variable. Main Outcome Measures: Annualized rate of progression in AL (mm/year) and SE (D/year). Results: The mean age of our cohort was 12.18 ± 2.73 years, and the mean follow-up time was 12.49 ± 5.71 months. All myopia control lenses significantly slowed AL elongation compared to the SVL group (0.193 mm/year). The adjusted annual AL progression was 0.098 mm/year for DIMS, 0.088 mm/year for CARE, and 0.054 mm/year for HALT (P < 0.001 for all vs. SVL). Highly aspherical lenslet target lenses demonstrated significantly greater efficacy in slowing AL elongation compared to both DIMS (P < 0.001) and CARE (P value < 0.001). All myopia control lenses also significantly reduced myopic SE progression (—0.370 D/year for SVL) with rates of —0.107 D/year for DIMS, —0.106 D/year for CARE, and —0.073 D/year for HALT. However, pairwise comparisons among the three myopia control lens types for SE progression did not reach statistical significance (P > 0.13). Conclusions: Highly aspherical lenslet target, DIMS, and CARE effectively slowed progression versus SVL, with HALT showing the greatest AL control. While the retrospective design warrants cautious interpretation, results support the use of all three lenses. Future prospective head-to-head studies are needed to clarify durability and optimal combination strategies.

来源=桌面《框架眼镜SP》/04 豪雅新乐学DIMS/3-13 HALTvsDIMSvsCAREvsSVL- Comparative Effectiveness of Myopia-control Spectacle Lenses Clincial setting Performance from a Retrospective Cohort Study.pdf 来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：摘要 目的： 比较三种近视控制框架眼镜镜片——离焦整合多区镜片（DIMS）、高度非球面微透镜目标镜片（HALT）和柱状环形屈光元件镜片（CARE）——与普通单光镜（SVL）相比，在儿童中减缓眼轴增长和近视屈光度加深方面的真实临床有效性。 研究设计：单中心、回顾性队列研究。 研究对象： 共纳入 899 名受试者，1780 只眼，年龄为 6–16 岁，睫状肌麻痹后球镜等效值（SE）范围为 -0.50 D 至 -9.00 D。根据所处方的眼镜类型分为四组：SVL 组 446 只眼，DIMS 组 523 只眼，HALT 组 295 只眼，CARE 组 516 只眼。 方法： 研究数据来自电子病历。研究者使用线性混合效应模型分析眼轴长度（AL）和球镜等效值（SE）随时间的变化，并比较不同镜片类型之间的进展速度。模型校正了基线年龄、性别、父母近视情况，以及相应结局指标的基线值。 主要结局指标： AL 的年进展率，单位为 mm/年；SE 的年进展率，单位为 D/年。 结果： 研究人群平均年龄为 12.18 ± 2.73 岁，平均随访时间为 12.49 ± 5.71 个月。与 SVL 组相比，所有近视控制镜片均显著减缓眼轴增长。SVL 组的眼轴年进展为 0.193 mm/年；校正后的年眼轴进展分别为：DIMS 0.098 mm/年，CARE 0.088 mm/年，HALT 0.054 mm/年，三组与 SVL 比较均有统计学意义（均 P < 0.001）。HALT 在减缓眼轴增长方面显著优于 DIMS 和 CARE。 所有近视控制镜片也显著降低了 SE 近视进展。SVL 组 SE 进展为 -0.370 D/年；DIMS 为 -0.107 D/年，CARE 为 -0.106 D/年，HALT 为 -0.073 D/年。不过，三种近视控制镜片之间在 SE 进展方面的两两比较未达到统计学显著性（P > 0.13）。 结论： HALT、DIMS 和 CARE 均能较 SVL 有效减缓儿童近视进展，其中 HALT 对眼轴增长的控制效果最强。由于本研究为回顾性设计，结果解读需要谨慎；但研究结果支持三种镜片均可用于近视控制。未来仍需要前瞻性、头对头研究，以进一步明确疗效持久性及最佳联合治疗策略。

摘要 目的：评估多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）眼镜与单光眼镜（SVS）对青少年近视控制及散光变化的影响。 方法：回顾性研究纳入2022年1月至2023年3月就诊的153名7~14岁近视儿童（DIMS组86例，SVS组67例），随访1年。使用OA-2000测量眼轴长度（AL）和角膜散光（CA），睫状肌麻痹验光获取球镜度、柱镜轴向和等效球镜度（SE）。采用Thibos矢量分析法计算总散光（TA）及角膜散光的J0/J45成分。 结果：配戴1年后，DIMS组在SE进展和眼轴增长方面均显著低于SVS组（ΔSE：-0.39±0.39 D vs. -0.72±0.47 D；ΔAL：0.23±0.15 mm vs. 0.37±0.22 mm；P<0.01）。两组在总散光或角膜散光变化上无显著差异（ΔTA：-0.22±0.07 D vs. -0.16±0.06 D；ΔCA：-0.16±0.06 D vs. -0.12±0.01 D；P>0.01）。但1年后DIMS组总散光和角膜散光的斜向成分增幅显著大于SVS组（P<0.05）。 结论：DIMS镜片通过减少SE漂移和抑制眼轴增长，能有效延缓青少年近视进展。与SVS相比，长期配戴DIMS减少了水平/垂直散光成分，但可能增加斜向总散光和角膜散光，提示在干预期间需监测方向性散光变化，特别是基线散光较高或有斜向散光的儿童。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To evaluate the effects of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacles versus Single Vision Spectacles (SVS) on myopia control and astigmatic changes in adolescents with myopia. Methods: This retrospective study included 153 myopic children aged 7–14 years who attended our clinic between January 2022 and March 2023 (86 in the DIMS group and 67 in the SVS group), with a follow-up duration of one year. Axial Length (AL) and Corneal Astigmatism (CA) were measured using the OA-2000. Cycloplegic refraction was used to obtain Spherical (S), Cylinder Angle (C), and Spherical Equivalent (SE). Total astigmatism (TA) and corneal astigmatism J0/J45 components were calculated using Thibos’ vector analysis. Pre- and post-treatment changes were analyzed using paired t-tests, while between-group comparisons were assessed using the Mann-Whitney U test, independent-samples t-test, and general linear model. Results: After one year of wear, the DIMS group exhibited significantly less myopic progression than the SVS group in both Spherical Equivalent and axial elongation, ΔSE: −0.39 ± 0.39 D vs. −0.72 ± 0.47 D; ΔAL: 0.23 ± 0.15 mm vs. 0.37 ± 0.22 mm; p < 0.01. No significant differences were observed in total astigmatism or corneal astigmatism between groups, ΔTA: −0.22 ± 0.07 D vs. −0.16 ± 0.06 D; ΔCA: −0.16 ± 0.06 D vs. −0.12 ± 0.01 D; p > 0.01. However, the DIMS group showed significantly greater increases in oblique components of total and corneal astigmatism compared with the SVS group after one year (p < 0.05; Table 1, Figure 1 and Figure 2). Conclusions: DIMS lenses effectively slow myopic progression in adolescents by reducing Spherical Equivalent shift and suppressing axial elongation. Compared with SVS lenses, DIMS wear reduces horizontal/vertical astigmatic components but may increase oblique total and corneal astigmatism over long-term use. These findings highlight the importance of monitoring directional astigmatic changes during DIMS intervention, particularly in children with high baseline or oblique astigmatism.

摘要 目的：比较多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）框架眼镜与单光（SV）镜片在儿童近视控制中的治疗效果。 方法：纳入201名7~17岁儿童（平均年龄10.92±2.11岁），其中DIMS组104例，SV组97例。眼科检查包括最佳矫正视力（BCVA）、睫状肌麻痹验光（SER）、眼球运动评估、遮盖试验、远近棱镜遮盖去遮盖试验、裂隙灯评估、眼底检查和眼部生物测量。 结果：在12个月随访期内，右眼平均SER进展在DIMS组为-0.29±0.3 D，SV组为-0.58±0.45 D；配戴DIMS的儿童近视进展显著较慢（P<0.001）。多元线性回归模型显示，性别和基线眼轴长度（AL）对SER变化无显著影响（分别为P=0.057和P=0.17），而治疗镜片类型、确诊年龄、来源地及基线SER对SER变化有显著影响（P<0.001）。 结论：DIMS镜片是白种人群近视管理的有效治疗手段。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Background: Myopia is a refractive error reaching alarmingly high levels worldwide and is associated with severe complications such as: maculopathy, retinal detachment, open-angle glaucoma, and posterior subcapsular cataract. The study compared two treatment strategies: defocus-incorporated multi-segment (DIMS) spectacle lenses and single-vision (SV) lenses. Methods: 201 children (mean age 10.92 ± 2.11 years, range, 7–17 years) were included in the study (104 patients, DIMS group; 97 patients, SV group). The ophthalmological examination included best corrected visual acuity (BCVA), cycloplegic refractive measurement (SER), eye movement evaluation, cover test, prism cover-uncover tests for near and distance, slit-lamp evaluation, fundus examination and ocular biometry. Results: The mean SER progression in the right eye over the 12-month follow-up was −0.29 ± 0.3 D in the DIMS group and −0.58 ± 0.45 in the SV group. Children wearing DIMS exhibited significantly less myopia progression (p < 0.001). The multiple linear regression model showed no significant effect of sex or baseline axial length (AL) on SER change (p = 0.057 and 0.17, respectively), whereas treatment lens, age at diagnosis, provenance and baseline SER had a significant effect on SER change (p < 0.001). Conclusions: DIMS lenses are an effective treatment in myopia management in the Caucasian population.

Efficacy of defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lenses and low-dose atropine on retarding myopic shift among premyopic preschoolers: Protocol for a prospective, multicenter, randomized controlled trial

DIMSvsATPvsusual care-近视预防-方案

📖 PloS one📅 2024年👥 Yang Hsin-Yu, Tsai Der-Chong, Yang Yu-Chieh, Wang Chiao-Yu, Lee Chia-Wei, Huang Pei-Wei
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献4-1-1 DIMSvsATPvsusual care-近视预防-方案 起始时间：计划于2024年9月至12月招募受试者 研究中心&PI：National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University and Yuanshan Branch of Taipei Veterans General Hospital & Der-Chong Tsai 试验设计简述：前瞻性、多中心、RCT-3组（DIMS vs 0.01% 阿托品滴眼液 vs 常规护理） 试验组样本量：DIMS组78人
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 4-1 近视预防 / 4-1-1
原文摘要
摘要： 背景：近视已成为全球范围内日益严重的问题。早发性近视会显著增加成年后患高度近视的风险。尽管增加户外活动时间对预防近视的益处已得到证实，但针对近视前期儿童预防早发性近视的最佳策略仍需进一步研究。 方法：本随机对照试验旨在评估光学干预（多焦点离焦镜片 [DIMS 眼镜]）与药物干预（0.01% 阿托品滴眼液）在近视前期学龄前儿童近视预防中的疗效。研究将纳入 234 名 5-6 岁无症状近视前期儿童，这些儿童均已在台湾宜兰县全县幼儿园眼科保健项目（宜兰县近视预防与视力改善项目）中接受过睫状肌麻痹自动验光检查。符合条件的受试者将随机分配至 DIMS 眼镜组（n=78）、0.01% 阿托品组（n=78）或常规护理组（n=78）。DIMS 组学龄前儿童在入学前需在家佩戴该眼镜，入学后则需全天佩戴；阿托品组受试者在整个研究期间需每晚使用 0.01% 阿托品滴眼液；所有受试者均被鼓励每天进行 2 小时户外活动。在 18 个月的研究期间，每 3 个月测量一次受试者的睫状肌麻痹下等效球镜度数（SE）、眼轴长度及黄斑中心凹下脉络膜厚度，每 9 个月由家长填写一次近视危险因素相关问卷。 主要结果指标：平均睫状肌麻痹下等效球镜度数（SE）的变化。 次要结果指标：新发近视累积发生率、等效球镜度数（SE）快速近视性漂移的累积发生率以及平均眼轴长度的变化。 其他预设结果指标：近视发病时间、黄斑中心凹下脉络膜厚度变化以及近距离工作 / 户外活动时长。 试验注册：本研究已在 www.clinicaltrials.gov 网站注册，注册号为 NCT06200194。 结论：本试验将为近视预防策略提供参考，并为制定针对近视前期学龄前儿童的早期识别与干预相关眼科保健新政策提供依据。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: Myopia has been a rising problem globally. Early-onset myopia significantly increases the risk of high myopia later in life. Despite the proven benefits of increased outdoor time, optimal strategies for preventing early-onset myopia in premyopic children need further investigation. METHODS: This randomized controlled trial aims to evaluate the efficacy of optical (Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments [DIMS] spectacle lenses) and pharmacological (0.01% atropine eye drops) interventions in preventing myopia among premyopic preschoolers. We will recruit 234 premyopic, asymptomatic 5-to-6-year-old children who will have received cycloplegic autorefraction examination in a countywide kindergarten eye care program in Yilan County, Taiwan. Eligible participants will be randomly assigned to DIMS spectacles (n = 78), 0.01% atropine (n = 78), or usual care (n = 78). In the DIMS group, preschoolers will be instructed to wear spectacles at home before entering elementary school but to wear them all the time after school entry. In the atropine group, subjects will be given 0.01% atropine eyedrops nightly throughout the study period. All participants will be encouraged to spend time outdoors for 2 hours every day. During the 18-month study period, cycloplegic spherical equivalent (SE) refraction, axial length, and subfoveal choroidal thickness will be measured every three months, and parents-administered questionnaires regarding risk factors for myopia will be performed every nine months. PRIMARY OUTCOME: The change in mean cycloplegic SE. SECONDARY OUTCOMES: The cumulative percentage of incident myopia, the cumulative percentage of a fast myopic shift of SE, and the changes in mean axial length. OTHER PRE-SPECIFIED OUTCOMES: The time to myopia onset, alteration in subfoveal choroidal thickness, and levels of near work/outdoor activities. TRIAL REGISTRATION: This study is registered at www.clinicaltrials.gov as NCT06200194. CONCLUSION: This trial will provide insights into myopia prevention strategies and inform new eye care policies for early identification and intervention in premyopic preschoolers.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 4-1 近视预防 / 4-1-2
原文摘要
摘要： 目的：回顾性分析多区正向离焦镜片（DIMS）+ 雾视 + 0.01% 阿托品治疗儿童近视前期及早期近视的疗效。 方法：对接受联合治疗的 192 只眼，分析基线时及随访 12 个月后的眼轴长度（AL）和屈光状态。治疗成功定义为眼轴长度年增长率处于生理生长范围内，且近视进展≤-0.50 屈光度（D）/ 年。按基线眼轴长度和年龄分组进行亚组分析，比较亚组与总人群的治疗成功率。 结果：总体而言，眼轴控制成功率和近视控制成功率分别为 87% 和 93%。与联合治疗前相比，治疗后男女儿童的眼轴长度均增加（男孩：P<0.001；女孩：P<0.001）。等效球镜度数（SE）的变化与眼轴长度变化趋势一致，男女儿童治疗后等效球镜度数均升高，其中女孩的差异具有统计学意义（男孩：P=0.059；女孩：P=0.001）。按基线眼轴长度和年龄划分的亚组中，男女儿童的治疗成功率与总人群相比，差异均无统计学意义。 结论：DIMS + 雾视 + 0.01% 阿托品治疗方案对不同性别、不同基线眼轴长度、不同年龄的儿童近视前期及早期近视均具有显著的控制效果。建议儿童一旦出现近视倾向，应及时干预。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To retrospectively analyze the efficacy of multi-zone positive optical defocus lenses (DIMS) + fog vision + 0.01% atropine for the treatment of children with preclinical and early stages of myopia. METHODS: The axial length (AL) and refraction were analyzed at baseline and after 12 months of follow-up in 192 eyes treated with combined therapy. The success of treatment was defined as an annual AL growth rate within the physiological growth range and myopia progression of -0.50 diopters (D)/year or greater. Subgroup analysis was performed to investigate the percentage of treatment success in the overall population compared to the subgroups based on baseline AL and age. RESULTS: Overall, the success rates were 87% and 93% for AL control and myopia control, respectively. Compared to before combined therapy, there was an increase in AL after treatment (boys: P < .001; girls: P < .001). The change in spherical equivalent (SE) was consistent with the change in AL, with both boys and girls showing an increase in SE after treatment, with a statistically significant difference in girls (boys: P = .059; girls: P = .001). There was no statistically significant difference in the percentage of treatment success in either boys or girls based on baseline AL and age subgroups compared to the overall population. CONCLUSIONS: The treatment regimen of DIMS + fog vision + 0.01% atropine demonstrated significant control effects on myopia in preclinical and early stages of myopia in children across different genders, baseline ALs, and ages. Timely intervention is recommended once a tendency toward myopia is observed in children.

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：评估多焦点（MF）眼镜与单光（SV）眼镜相比，在中国近视前期儿童（等效球镜度[SE] ≤+0.75 D且>-0.50 D）中控制近视进展及延缓近视发病的效果。 方法：开展多中心回顾性病例对照研究，采用倾向评分匹配（PSM）平衡基线特征。受试者接受等效球镜度（SE）和眼轴长度（AL）测量。主要终点包括6个月和12个月时的SE和AL进展量，以及1年近视累计发病率（SE ≤-0.50 D）。 结果：共纳入1501名受试者（平均年龄8.60±2.26岁，平均SE为0.00±0.37 D），其中MF组835例，SV组666例。12个月后，与SV组相比，MF眼镜显著减缓SE进展（差异：-0.35±0.63 D；P<0.001）和AL增长（差异：0.23±0.27 mm；P<0.001）。MF组快速近视进展的儿童比例显著更低（SE进展>0.50 D比例：20.8% vs. 45.1%，χ²=78.15，P<0.001；AL增长>0.2 mm比例：34.2% vs. 73.5%，χ²=165.9，P<0.001）。Kaplan-Meier分析显示MF组1年近视累计发病率显著低于SV组（42.6% vs. 65.6%；log-rank P<0.001）。 结论：这项大规模多中心研究表明，MF眼镜能有效延缓近视前期儿童的SE进展和AL增长，并延迟近视发病，为MF眼镜作为预防性近视控制的有效非药物干预手段提供了有力的真实世界证据。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
PURPOSE: To evaluate the efficacy of multifocal (MF) spectacles, compared with single-vision (SV) spectacles, in controlling myopia progression and delaying myopia onset amongst Chinese children with pre-myopia (spherical equivalent [SE] ≤+0.75 and >–0.50 D). METHODS: A multicentre retrospective case-control study was conducted, with baseline characteristics balanced using propensity score matching (PSM). The participants underwent spherical equivalent refraction (SE) and axial length (AL) measurements. Primary outcomes included SE and AL progression at 6 and 12 months, as well as the 1-year cumulative incidence of myopia (SE ≤–0.50 D). RESULTS: A total of 1501 participants (mean age: 8.60 ± 2.26 years; mean SE: 0.00 ± 0.37 D) were included in the analysis, comprising 835 in the MF group and 666 in the SV group. After 12 months, MF spectacles slowed SE progression (difference: –0.35 ± 0.63 D; p < 0.001) and AL elongation (difference: 0.23 ± 0.27 mm; p < 0.001) significantly, compared with the SV group. The proportion of children with rapid myopia progression was significantly lower in the MF group (SE progression > 0.50 D: 20.8% vs. 45.1%, χ2 = 78.15, p < 0.001; AL elongation > 0.2 mm: 34.2% vs. 73.5%, χ2 = 165.9, p < 0.001). Kaplan–Meier analysis showed a significantly lower 1-year cumulative incidence of myopia in the MF group than in the SV group (42.6% vs. 65.6%; log-rank p < 0.001). CONCLUSION: This large-scale, multicentre study demonstrated that MF spectacles effectively slow SE progression and AL elongation and delay myopia onset in pre-myopic children. Despite the inherent limitations of retrospective designs relative to randomised controlled trials, the findings provide strong real-world evidence supporting the potential of MF spectacles as an effective, non-pharmacologic intervention for pre-emptive myopia control.

HAL vs. DIMS——近视前期儿童中，HAL组眼轴增长及近视发生率更低，SE变化无显著差异

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：比较多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）与非球面微透镜（HAL）镜片对近视前期儿童眼轴增长、屈光度进展及近视发生率的控制效果。 方法：回顾性研究纳入2021年3月至2025年5月在深圳希玛林顺潮眼科医院佩戴DIMS或HAL镜片至少12个月的60例（60眼）6~14岁近视前期儿童，分为DIMS组（30例）和HAL组（30例），比较两组基线资料、眼轴年变化量、屈光度年变化量及终点近视发生率。 结果：两组基线年龄、性别、眼轴及等效球镜度差异无统计学意义（P>0.05）。随访后，HAL组眼轴年增长量（0.13±0.19 mm/年）低于DIMS组（0.24±0.14 mm/年，P=0.012）；多元回归分析显示在控制混杂因素后，镜片类型仍是眼轴变化的独立预测因子（B=-0.111，P=0.016）。HAL组近视发生率（43.3%）低于DIMS组（70.0%，P=0.037）。HAL组有4例（13.3%）出现眼轴缩短，3例（10.0%）出现屈光回退，DIMS组无此现象；两组屈光度年变化量差异P=0.128。结论：在近视前期儿童中，HAL镜片较DIMS镜片能更有效延缓眼轴增长、降低近视发生率，部分患儿可出现眼轴缩短和屈光回退，提示HAL镜片或为近视前期儿童更具前景的光学干预选择。

Objective: To evaluate and compare the effectiveness of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) lenses and Highly Aspherical Lenslets (HAL) lenses in controlling axial growth, refractive error progression, and the onset of myopia in pre-myopic children. Methods: This retrospective study included 60 pre-myopic children (60 eyes), aged between 6 and 14 years, who wore either DIMS or HAL lenses for a minimum of 12 months from March 2021 to May 2025. Results: There were no notable differences in baseline age, gender, axial length, or spherical equivalent refraction between the two groups (all P > 0.05). 摘要 目的：确定佩戴高非球面微透镜（HAL）和多区正向离焦（DIMS）眼镜儿童近视进展的预测因素。 方法：这项为期3年的纵向回顾性真实世界研究纳入了法国近视队列（2020年至2025年间处方近视控制眼镜MCS）中4-14岁且处于进展期（每年≤-0.5 D）的儿童。在治疗开始后12±3、24±3和36±3个月评估等效球镜度（SER，D/年）近视进展。采用经年龄校正的潜在类别增长模型识别对MCS反应较差者；随后采用逻辑回归分析确定与MCS治疗下持续进展相关的因素（包括治疗组别、更换率、基线年龄、等效球镜度、J0和J45、性别及初始进展速度）。 结果：共纳入723名儿童（平均年龄8.9±2.4岁），DIMS组与HAL组之间基线无差异。潜在类别增长模型确定了三种不同的进展模式：稳定型、中度近视进展型和进展型近视，斜率分别为-0.05、-0.31和-0.58 D/年。初始进展较快强烈预测了进展型近视类别，而治疗类型对类别分配无影响。治疗下的进展风险在统计学上独立于年龄、性别和基线近视度数。 结论：佩戴DIMS或HAL的近视儿童表现出三种不同的进展轨迹，其中一小部分儿童仍以具有临床意义的速度持续进展；本研究局限性在于仅检验了两种近视控制手段且缺乏环境因素数据。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Objective To identify predictive factors of myopia progression in children wearing highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) and defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) spectacles. Methods and analysis The 3-year longitudinal, retrospective real-world study included progressive children (≤ –0.5 dioptre (D)/year), aged 4–14 years collected from the French Myopia Cohort, between 2020 and 2025 who were prescribed myopia control spectacles (MCS). Myopia progression (spherical equivalent, D/year) was assessed at 12±3, 24±3 and 36±3 months after treatment initiation. A latent class growth model, adjusted for age, identified potential poor responders to MCS. Model performance was evaluated using Akaike information criterion, entropy and posterior class-membership probabilities. Logistic regression was then used to determine factors associated with persistent progression under MCS, including treatment group, renewal rate, baseline age, spherical equivalent, J0 and J45, sex and initial progression. Results A total of 723 children (mean age 8.9 ± 2.4 years) were included, with no baseline differences between the DIMS and the HAL groups. Latent class growth modelling identified three distinct progression profiles: stable, moderate myopia progression and progressive myopia, with slopes of −0.05, −0.31 and −0.58 D/year, respectively. Fast initial progression strongly predicted progressive myopia class, while neither treatment type influenced class allocation. Progression risk under treatment was statistically independent of age, sex and baseline myopia. Conclusions Our study is limited as it examines only two types of myopia control treatments and lacks data on environmental factors. Myopic children treated with DIMS or HAL showed three distinct progression trajectories, with a small group of progressors continuing to progress at a clinically meaningful rate.

原文摘要
摘要： 背景与目的：本研究旨在探讨阿托品（ATR）联合离焦整合多段式（DIMS）眼镜镜片与 ATR 单药治疗相比，在儿童高度近视控制中的效果。 患者与方法：本研究为回顾性队列研究，纳入接受 ATR 单药治疗（n=35 只眼）或 ATR 联合 DIMS 镜片治疗（n=32 只眼）的患者。主要结局指标为等效球镜度数（SER）进展和眼轴长度（AXL）增长，随访时间为 1 年。采用独立样本 t 检验和广义线性模型进行统计学比较。 结果：1 年后，ATR 组的等效球镜度数进展（–0.38±0.14 屈光度）显著大于 DIMS-ATR 组（–0.15±0.09 屈光度）（p<0.001）。同期，ATR 组的眼轴长度增长（0.13±0.07 mm）也显著高于 DIMS-ATR 组（0.06±0.04 mm）（p<0.001）。亚组分析显示，ATR 组中，初诊年龄小、基线等效球镜度数高及初诊眼轴长度长均与等效球镜度数进展更显著、眼轴长度增长更多相关（均 p<0.05）。此外，DIMS-ATR 组中，初诊等效球镜度数高与等效球镜度数进展更显著独立相关，初诊眼轴长度长与眼轴长度增长更多独立相关（均 p<0.05）。 结论：在高度近视儿童中，ATR 联合 DIMS 眼镜镜片在延缓近视进展方面比 ATR 单药治疗更有效。该联合治疗方案或可作为高危儿童近视管理的更优策略。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND/AIM: This study investigated the efficiency of combined atropine (ATR) and defocus incorporated multiple segments' (DIMS) spectacle lens versus ATR monotherapy in controlling high myopia in children. PATIENTS AND METHODS: A retrospective cohort study was performed, enrolling patients treated with either ATR monotherapy (n=35 eyes) or a combination of ATR and DIMS lenses (n=32 eyes). The primary outcomes were the spherical equivalent refraction (SER) progression and axial length (AXL) elongation, and were measured over a one year follow up period. Statistical comparisons were made using independent t-tests and generalized linear models. RESULTS: After one year, the ATR group showed significantly greater SER progression (-0.38±0.14D) compared to the DIMS-ATR group (-0.15±0.09D) (p<0.001). After the same period of time, AXL elongation was also significantly higher in the ATR group (0.13±0.07 mm) compared to the DIMS-ATR group (0.06±0.04 mm) (p<0.001). Subgroup analysis indicated that a young initial age, high baseline SER, and longer initial AXL were associated with greater SER progression and AXL elongation in the ATR group (all p<0.05). In addition, in the DIMS-ATR group, higher initial SER and AXL were independently associated with SER progression and AXL elongation, respectively (both p<0.05). CONCLUSION: The combined ATR plus DIMS spectacle lenses was more effective in slowing myopia progression than ATR monotherapy in children with high myopia. This combined approach may be a preferable strategy for managing high-risk pediatric myopia.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 4-4 高度近视 / 4-4-2
原文摘要
摘要 目的：旨在评估多焦点软性接触镜（MFSCLs）与离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS）在限制高度近视儿童近视进展中的疗效。 方法：本回顾性研究纳入 249 名高度近视儿童（年龄 8-16 岁），其非散瞳球镜度数（SE）为−6.00 至−10.00 D，散光 <2.00 D。受试者分为三组：DIMS 镜片治疗组（N=81）、多焦点软性接触镜（DISC，N=60）治疗组及单光眼镜（SVLs，N=108）对照组。根据基线至 1 年的球镜度数变化评估近视进展情况，分为慢速进展（<-0.25 D）、中度进展（−0.25 至−0.75 D）和快速进展（>−0.75 D）三类。采用多元线性回归分析评估近视进展与相关特征的关联性。 结果：基线时，三组受试者的年龄、球镜度数（SE）及性别分布均无显著差异。1 年后，DIMS 组（−0.47±0.39 D，33.8%）和 MFSCLs 组（−0.39±0.47 D，45.1%）的近视进展幅度显著小于 SVL 对照组（−0.71±0.54 D；P<0.001）。慢速进展者比例分别为：SVLs 组 28.40%、DIMS 组 39.81%、MFSCLs 组 51.67%。年龄与 DIMS 组（β=0.108，P<0.001）和 SVLs 组（β=0.120，P<0.001）的近视进展相关，但与 MFSCLs 组无关（P=0.776）。12 岁以下儿童更适合佩戴 MFSCLs，而 12 岁以上高度近视儿童佩戴 DIMS 与 MFSCLs 的疗效相当。 结论：多焦点软性接触镜（MFSCLs）与离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS）均能有效延缓高度近视儿童的近视进展。12 岁以下儿童佩戴 MFSCLs 的近视控制效果更优，12 岁以上儿童佩戴 MFSCLs 仍为优质选择，且与 DIMS 疗效相当。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate the efficacy of multifocal soft contact lenses (MFSCLs) and defocus incorporated multiple segments lenses (DIMS) to limit myopic progression in children with high myopia. METHODS: This retrospective study included 249 children (aged 8-16 years) with high myopia (non-cycloplegic spherical equivalent [SE] -6.00 to -10.00 D, astigmatism < 2.00 D). Selected participants were those treated with DIMS (N=81), MFSCLs (DISC, N=60), or single-vision spectacles (SVLs, N=108, control group). Myopic progression was assessed based on the 1-year SE change from baseline, categorized as slow (<-0.25 D), moderate (-0.25 to -0.75 D), or rapid (> -0.75 D). The multiple linear regression evaluated the association between myopic progression and characters. RESULTS: No significant differences in age, SE, or sex were found among the groups at baseline. At one year, the magnitude of myopic progression was significantly smaller in the DIMS (-0.47 ± 0.39 D, 33.8 %) groups and MFSCLs (-0.39 ± 0.47 D, 45.1 %) compared to the SVL group (-0.71 ± 0.54 D; P < 0.001). The proportion of slow progressors was 28.40 % (SVLs), 39.81 % (DIMS), and 51.67 % (MFSCLs). Age was associated with the myopic progression in the DIMS (β=0.108, P < 0.001) and SVLs (β=0.120, P < 0.001) group, but not in the MFSCLs (P=0.776) group. MFSCLs were preferred for children under 12 years, while DIMS and MFSCLs showed comparable efficacy for those over 12 with high myopia. CONCLUSIONS: Both MFSCLs and DIMS have demonstrated efficacy in delaying myopic progression in children with high myopia. The MFSCLs will give children better control up to the age of 12; after that, they remain a good option.

摘要 目的：比较角膜塑形镜（OK镜）与多区正向离焦（DIMS）镜片对双眼近视性屈光参差儿童眼轴（AL）增长的影响。 方法：这项回顾性研究纳入双眼近视性屈光参差儿童，分为OK镜组和DIMS镜片组。近视度数较深眼设为MM眼，对侧近视度数较浅眼设为LM眼。根据MM眼的近视程度进一步细分为-0.50至-3.00 D亚组和-3.25至-6.00 D亚组。采用t检验分析组间眼轴增长变化及双眼眼轴差值，采用Pearson线性相关分析评估眼轴变化与基线数据的关系。 结果：共纳入202名8-14岁儿童，分为OK镜组（平均年龄10.97±1.91岁，男46例，女50例）和DIMS组（平均年龄11.05±2.06岁，男58例，女48例）。1年后，OK-MM眼的眼轴变化（0.14±0.18 mm）显著慢于OK-LM眼（0.20±0.19 mm）和DIMS-MM眼（0.19±0.18 mm；P<0.001，P=0.037）。OK-LM眼与DIMS-LM眼、DIMS-MM眼与DIMS-LM眼的眼轴变化差异无统计学意义（P=0.337，0.381）。在-0.50至-3.00 D亚组中，DIMS-LM眼的眼轴控制效果优于OK-LM眼，OK-MM眼与DIMS-MM眼的眼轴变化差异无统计学意义。在-3.25至-6.00 D亚组中，结果与总体人群相似。4个亚组的眼轴变化均与年龄呈负相关（P<0.05）。 结论：OK镜可减轻双眼屈光参差；DIMS镜片对屈光参差儿童的双眼近视控制效果相近。近视度数较高时OK镜较DIMS镜片更有效，而当MM眼等效球镜度低于-3.00 D时，DIMS镜片延缓眼轴增长的效果优于OK镜。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
AIM: To compare the effect of orthokeratology (OK) and defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) lenses on axial length (AL) elongation in bilateral myopic anisometropic children. METHODS: This retrospective study enrolled bilateral myopic anisometropic children categorized into two groups: OK lenses and DIMS lenses. The eyes with more myopia (MM) were divided into MM eyes and the fellow eyes with less myopia (LM) into LM eyes. According to the myopia degree in MM eyes, the subjects were further assigned to -0.50 to -3.00 D subgroup and -3.25 to -6.00 D subgroup. The t-test was used to analyze the changes in AL elongation between groups and AL differences in both eyes, and the relationship between AL changes and baseline data was evaluated by Pearson linear correlation analysis. RESULTS: Totally 202 children (8-14y) were divided into OK group with mean age 10.97±1.91y (46 males and 50 females) and DIMS group with mean age 11.05±2.06y (58 males and 48 females). After 1y, the changes of AL in OK-MM eyes (0.14±0.18 mm) were significantly slower than that in OK-LM eyes (0.20±0.19 mm) and DIMS-MM eyes (0.19±0.18; P<0.001, P=0.037). The OK-LM eyes and DIMS-LM eyes, DIMS-MM eyes and DIMS-LM eyes showed no statistically significant difference in AL changes (P=0.337, 0.381). In the -0.50 to -3.00 D subgroups, DIMS-LM eyes had better effect of AL control than OK-LM eyes, the changes of AL in OK-MM eyes and DIMS-MM eyes were no statistically significant. In the -3.25 to -6.00 D subgroups, the results were similar in total group. The change of AL in four subgroups was negatively correlated with age (P<0.05). CONCLUSION: OK lens can reduce binocular anisometropia; DIMS lens has similar effect on the control of binocular myopia in children with myopic anisometropia. The OK lenses are more effective than DIMS lenses with higher degrees of myopia, while DIMS lens retard AL elongation more effectively than OK lens when the spherical equivalent refraction of MM eyes is lower than -3.00 D. KEYWORDS: orthokeratology lens; defocus incorporated multiple segments; myopic anisometropia; axial length

原文摘要
摘要： 目的：探讨集合功能障碍对佩戴多焦点离焦（DIMS）镜片儿童近视进展的影响。 患者与方法：本研究回顾性纳入因延缓近视进展而处方 DIMS 镜片的儿童。根据远距和近距隐斜情况判断基线集合功能障碍类型。在配镜前以及配镜后 6 个月、1 年随访时，分别进行眼轴长度（AL）测量和睫状肌麻痹主观验光。计算并比较不同集合功能障碍亚型儿童配镜后 6 个月、1 年相对于基线的 AL 和等效球镜度数（SE）变化。 结果：共纳入 292 名近视儿童。配镜后 6 个月和 1 年，儿童均出现显著的 AL 增长和 SE 近视进展（所有比较均 P<0.05）。多元回归分析显示，配镜后 6 个月（P<0.001）和 1 年（P<0.001）的 AL 增长与年龄呈负相关，6 个月的 SE 近视进展与年龄相关（P=0.002）。6 个月时，集合过度儿童的 AL 增长显著大于正常近视儿童（P=0.011）以及集合不足（P=0.008）、发散过度（P=0.007）、发散不足（P=0.024）和基本内隐斜（P=0.048）儿童。 结论：本研究表明，集合功能障碍会影响佩戴 DIMS 镜片近视儿童的近视进展，且在不同类型的集合功能障碍中，集合过度儿童的近视进展最为显著。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate the impact of vergence dysfunction on myopia progression in children with Defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses. PATIENTS AND METHODS: We retrospectively enrolled children prescribed DIMS spectacle lenses to slow myopic progression. Baseline vergence dysfunction was determined according to phoria at distance and near. Axial length (AL) measurement and cycloplegic subjective refraction were performed before fitting the lenses and at six-month and one-year follow-ups. The six-month and one-year AL and spherical equivalent (SE) change from baseline were calculated and compared in subgroups stratified with the type of vergence dysfunction. RESULTS: Two hundred and ninety-two myopic children were included. Significant AL elongation and SE progression were observed at six months and one year (P < 0.05 for all comparisons). Multiple regression demonstrated that AL elongation at six months (P < 0.001) and one year (P < 0.001) was negatively correlated with age, and SE progression at six months was associated with age (P = 0.002). The AL elongation at six months in children with convergence excess was significantly greater than in normal myopic subjects (P = 0.011) and subjects with convergence insufficiency (P = 0.008), divergence excess (P = 0.007), divergence insufficiency (P = 0.024) and basic esophoria (P = 0.048) at six months. CONCLUSION: The present research demonstrated that vergence dysfunction influences myopia progression for myopic children with DIMS, and the children with convergence excess suffer from the greatest myopia progression among different types of vergence dysfunction.

原文摘要
摘要： 目的：评估近视控制眼镜（DIMS）与 0.01% 阿托品及 DIMS 联合阿托品相比，在减缓欧洲儿童近视进展方面的疗效。 方法：本研究为非随机、研究者设盲的前瞻性对照观察性研究，研究对象为 6~18 岁近视进展期且无眼部病变的人群。根据患者 / 家长的选择，将受试者分配至以下组别：0.01% 阿托品滴眼液组、DIMS（豪雅 ® 迈儿视 ®）眼镜组、阿托品 + DIMS 联合组或单光眼镜组（对照组）。关键结局指标包括睫状肌麻痹自动验光球镜等效屈光度（SER）和眼轴长度（AL），分别在基线、3 个月、6 个月和 12 个月时进行测量。 结果：共纳入 146 名受试者（平均年龄 10.3 岁 ±3.2 岁），其中 53 人使用阿托品，30 人使用 DIMS 眼镜，31 人使用阿托品 + DIMS，32 人使用单光对照眼镜。广义线性混合模型分析显示：在控制年龄和基线 SER 的情况下，各时间点所有治疗组的近视进展均显著低于对照组（p<0.016）；在控制基线年龄和 AL 的情况下，6 个月和 12 个月时所有治疗组的眼轴进展均显著低于对照组（p<0.005）。仅针对 SER 指标，12 个月时的两两比较显示，阿托品 + DIMS 联合组的近视进展显著低于单纯 DIMS 组和单纯阿托品组（p<0.001）。 结论：在欧洲人群中，DIMS 和阿托品均能有效减缓近视进展期儿童的近视进展和眼轴伸长，且二者联合使用时对近视进展的减缓效果最佳。 5-1-2摘要： 近视是全球青少年视力损伤的主要原因之一，有时会增加失明风险并降低生活质量。以往研究已证实离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS）和局部应用阿托品（ATP）在近视控制方面的治疗效果，但目前尚无研究对这两种干预手段的联合应用效果进行评估。本回顾性研究旨在探究 DIMS 镜片联合 0.01% 阿托品，相较于单独使用 DIMS 镜片或单光（SV）镜片，是否能更有效地延缓近视进展。研究纳入 107 名近视儿童，分别接受 DIMS 联合 0.01% 阿托品治疗（DIMS+ATP 组）、DIMS 单独治疗（DIMS 组）或作为对照组接受单光镜片治疗（SV 组）。研究对比了三组患儿在眼轴长度和近视进展方面的治疗效果。经过 1 年随访，DIMS+ATP 组的眼轴长度变化和近视进展程度均小于 DIMS 组和 SV 组（P<0.05）。因此，DIMS 联合 0.01% 阿托品治疗可能是儿童近视治疗的更优选择。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate the efficacy of a myopia control spectacle lens (DIMS) at slowing the progression of myopia in a population of European children in comparison with 0.01% atropine and combined DIMS and atropine. METHODS: The study was a non-randomised experimenter-masked prospective controlled observational study of individuals aged 6-18 years with progressing myopia but no ocular pathology. Participants were allocated, according to patient/parent choice, to receive 0.01% atropine eyedrops, DIMS (Hoya® MiyoSmart®) spectacles, combined atropine+DIMS or single vision spectacle lenses (control group). The key outcome variables, cycloplegic autorefraction spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AL), were measured at baseline and after three, six, and 12 months. RESULTS: Of the 146 participants (mean age 10.3y ±3.2), 53 received atropine, 30 DIMS spectacles, 31 atropine+DIMS, and 32 single vision control spectacles. Generalized linear mixed model analysis revealed for SER, whilst controlling for age and SER at baseline, at each stage all treatment groups had significantly reduced progression compared with the control group (p<0.016). For AL, whilst controlling for baseline age and AL, at 6 and 12 months all treatment groups had significantly less progression than the control group (p<0.005). For SER only, in pairwise comparisons at 12 months the atropine+DIMS group had significantly reduced progression compared with the DIMS only and Atropine only groups (p<0.001). CONCLUSION: In a European population, DIMS and atropine are effective at reducing myopia progression and axial elongation in progressing myopia and are most successful at reducing myopia progression when used in combination.

原文摘要
摘要： 近视是全球青少年视力损伤的主要原因之一，有时会增加失明风险并降低生活质量。以往研究已证实离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS）和局部应用阿托品（ATP）在近视控制方面的治疗效果，但目前尚无研究对这两种干预手段的联合应用效果进行评估。本回顾性研究旨在探究 DIMS 镜片联合 0.01% 阿托品，相较于单独使用 DIMS 镜片或单光（SV）镜片，是否能更有效地延缓近视进展。研究纳入 107 名近视儿童，分别接受 DIMS 联合 0.01% 阿托品治疗（DIMS+ATP 组）、DIMS 单独治疗（DIMS 组）或作为对照组接受单光镜片治疗（SV 组）。研究对比了三组患儿在眼轴长度和近视进展方面的治疗效果。经过 1 年随访，DIMS+ATP 组的眼轴长度变化和近视进展程度均小于 DIMS 组和 SV 组（P<0.05）。因此，DIMS 联合 0.01% 阿托品治疗可能是儿童近视治疗的更优选择。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
Myopia is a leading cause of visual impairment in young people worldwide. It sometimes increases the risk of blindness and reduces life quality. Previous reports have revealed the treatment effects of defocus-incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) and topical atropine (ATP) on myopia control. However, no study has evaluated these two interventions together. In this retrospective study, we aimed to determine whether the combination of DIMS lenses and 0.01% ATP can slow the progression of myopia compared with DIMS lenses or single vision (SV) lenses alone. We included 107 children with myopia who were treated with DIMS and 0.01% ATP combination (DIMS + ATP group), DIMS monotherapy (DIMS group), or a control group (SV group). We compared treatment effects among three groups in axial length and myopia progression. After a 1-year follow-up, the DIMS + ATP group showed a smaller change in axial length and myopia progression than the DIMS and SV groups (P < 0.05). Hence, combination treatment with DIMS and 0.01% ATP might be a better choice for children with myopia.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在评估角膜塑形术（Ortho-K）、离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS 镜片）、角膜塑形术联合阿托品（Ortho-K / 阿托品）以及 DIMS 镜片联合阿托品（DIMS / 阿托品）对儿童近视控制的效果。 研究方法：本研究为回顾性研究，纳入 167 名 6-14 岁近视儿童，其球镜等效屈光度（SER）为 - 0.75 至 - 4.00 屈光度（D），分别接受角膜塑形术（OK 组，41 例）、角膜塑形术联合阿托品（OKA 组，41 例）、DIMS 镜片（DIMS 组，41 例）或 DIMS 镜片联合阿托品（DIMSA 组，42 例）治疗。分别在基线期、3 个月、6 个月、9 个月和 12 个月时测量眼轴长度（AL），分析不同时间点及组间的眼轴增长情况。 研究结果：治疗 12 个月后，OK 组、OKA 组、DIMS 组、DIMSA 组的眼轴长度（AL）变化分别为 0.20±0.12 mm、0.12±0.14 mm、0.22±0.14 mm、0.15±0.15 mm。OK 组与 DIMS 组的 AL 变化无显著差异；与 OK 组、DIMS 组单一治疗相比，OKA 组、DIMSA 组能显著减缓眼轴增长。按年龄分层后，在 6-10 岁亚组中，OKA 组与 DIMS 组的 AL 变化存在显著差异（p=0.013），其他组间无差异；而在 10-14 岁亚组中，OKA 组与 DIMS 组的差异无统计学意义（p>0.05），OK 组与 OKA 组、OK 组与 DIMSA 组、DIMS 组与 DIMSA 组的 AL 变化差异均具有统计学意义（均 p<0.05）。 研究结论：在初始近视度数较低的儿童中，角膜塑形术（OK）与 DIMS 镜片的近视进展减缓效果相当。阿托品可显著提升角膜塑形术和 DIMS 镜片的近视控制效果，且这种附加效果在年龄较大的儿童中更显著。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: The aim of this study was to evaluate the efficacy of Orthokeratology (Ortho-K), defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) lens, combined Ortho-K/atropine, and combined DIMS/atropine for myopia control in children. METHODS: A retrospective study included 167 myopic children aged 6-14 years with a spherical equivalent refraction (SER) of -0.75 to -4.00 diopter treated with Ortho-K (OK, n = 41), combined Ortho-K/atropine (OKA, n = 43), DIMS (n = 41), or combined DIMS/atropine (DIMSA, n = 42). Axial length (AL) was measured at baseline and at 3, 6, 9 and 12 months. Axial elongation over time and between groups were analysed. RESULTS: After 12 months, the AL change was 0.20 ± 0.12 mm, 0.12 ± 0.14 mm, 0.22 ± 0.14 mm, and 0.15 ± 0.15 mm in the OK, OKA, DIMS, and DIMSA, respectively. There was no significant difference in AL change between OK and DIMS. OKA and DIMSA significantly slowed axial elongation compared to OK and DIMS monotherapy. After stratification by age, in the subgroup aged 6-10 years, there was significant difference in AL change between OKA and DIMS (p = 0.013), and no difference between other groups, while in the subgroup aged 10-14 years, the difference between OKA and DIMS became insignificant (p = 0.237), and the difference between OK and OKA, OK and DIMSA, DIMS and DIMSA became significant. CONCLUSIONS: Ortho-K and DIMS lenses show similar reductions in myopia progression among children with low initial myopia. Atropine can significantly improve the efficacy of myopia control of both Ortho-K and DIMS lenses, and this add-on effect is better in older children.

原文摘要
摘要 目的： 评估并比较 0.025% 阿托品联合离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片与 0.025% 阿托品联合单光（SV）镜片在延缓儿童近视进展方面的疗效。 方法：本研究为随机对照试验，纳入 4~16 岁近视儿童，其近视度数为 - 1.00D 至 - 6.00D，散光度数≤2.00D。儿童被随机分为两组：0.025% 阿托品联合 SV 镜片治疗组（A 组）和 0.025% 阿托品联合 DIMS 镜片治疗组（B 组）。在基线、6 个月和 12 个月时测量睫状肌麻痹状态下的等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度。 结果：102 例患者完成 12 个月随访：A 组 49 例，平均年龄 9.50±2.78 岁；B 组 53 例，平均年龄 9.90±2.47 岁。12 个月时，A 组眼轴长度（AL）平均变化量 ± 标准差为 0.18±0.16 mm，B 组为 0.07±0.16 mm（均值差：0.11，95% 置信区间：0.05~0.17；p≤0.001）。12 个月时，A 组和 B 组的等效球镜度数（SER）平均进展量 ± 标准差分别为 - 0.19±0.42D 和 - 0.09±0.35D（p=0.13）。B 组 39.6% 的儿童在 12 个月内无眼轴伸长，而 A 组该比例为 12.2%（p=0.002）。 结论：0.025% 阿托品联合 DIMS 镜片的治疗方案在控制眼轴伸长方面，比 0.025% 阿托品联合 SV 镜片更有效。尽管差异无统计学意义，但 B 组的 SER 进展量低于 A 组。这些结果表明两种治疗方案可能存在协同作用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
AIM: To evaluate and compare the efficacy of combination treatment using 0.025% atropine and Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses to 0.025% atropine and single vision (SV) spectacle lenses in slowing myopia progression in children with myopia. METHODS: Randomised controlled trial conducted on children aged 4-16 years with myopia between -1.00D and -6.00D and astigmatism ≤2.00D. Children were randomly allocated into two groups: 0.025% atropine and SV spectacle lenses treatment group (group A), and 0.025% atropine and DIMS spectacle lenses treatment group (group B). Cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length were measured at baseline, 6 and 12 months. RESULTS: 102 patients completed the 12-month follow-up: n=49 in group A, mean age 9.50±2.78 years and n=53 in group B, mean age 9.90±2.47 years. At 12 months, the mean AL±SD change was 0.18±0.16 mm in group A and 0.07±0.16 mm in group B (mean difference: 0.11, 95% CI: 0.05 to 0.17; p≤0.001). Mean SER±SD progression at 12 months was -0.19±0.42D and -0.09±0.35D in groups A and B, respectively (p=0.13). 39.6% of children in group B had no axial elongation over 12 months compared with 12.2% of the children in group A (p=0.002). CONCLUSIONS: Combination treatment with 0.025% atropine and DIMS spectacle lenses is more effective in controlling axial elongation than 0.025% atropine with SV lenses. Although not significant, SER differences between groups were lower in group B. These findings support a potential additive effect of the two treatments.

原文摘要
摘要 本研究旨在评估离焦整合多段式（DIMS）镜片联合不同浓度阿托品（ATR）的近视控制效果。研究采用回顾性队列设计，根据阿托品浓度将使用 DIMS 镜片的受试者分为三组：纯 DIMS 组（55 例）、DIMS 联合低浓度阿托品组（0.01%，55 例）、DIMS 联合高浓度阿托品组（0.125%，50 例）。三种近视控制方案均持续应用 1 年。主要结局指标为等效球镜度数（SER）变化和眼轴长度（AXL）变化。采用单因素方差分析比较三组结局指标的差异，采用多元线性回归分析年龄、性别、基线等效球镜度数（基线 SER）和基线眼轴长度（基线 AXL）对三组近视进展的影响。纯 DIMS 组、DIMS 联合低浓度阿托品组、DIMS 联合高浓度阿托品组的睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度数（睫状肌麻痹 SER）进展分别为 - 0.30±0.25 屈光度（D）、-0.17±0.49 屈光度（D）、-0.16±0.14 屈光度（D）。其中，纯 DIMS 组的睫状肌麻痹 SER 进展显著更高（P=0.003）。三组的眼轴长度（AXL）增长分别为：纯 DIMS 组 0.13±0.08 毫米（mm）、DIMS 联合低浓度阿托品组 0.06±0.20 毫米（mm）、DIMS 联合高浓度阿托品组 0.06±0.14 毫米（mm）；纯 DIMS 组的眼轴长度增长显著更高（P=0.011）。在所有组中，年龄较小均与睫状肌麻痹 SER 进展更显著呈正相关（均 P<0.05）；在纯 DIMS 组和 DIMS 联合低浓度阿托品组中，年龄较小还与眼轴长度增长更显著相关（均 P<0.05）。对于使用 DIMS 镜片的受试者，低浓度与高浓度阿托品的近视控制效果无显著差异；但 DIMS 镜片联合阿托品的近视控制效果，显著优于单纯使用 DIMS 镜片。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
We aim to evaluate the myopia control effect of defocus incorporated multiple segments' (DIMS) spectacle lens in combination with different concentrations of atropine (ATR). A retrospective cohort study was conducted and DIMS users were categorized according to ATR concentration: 55 DIMS alone, 55 DIMS-Low ATR (0.01%) and 50 DIMS-High ATR (0.125%) groups. All three myopia control methods were applied for one year. Primary outcomes measures were changes in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AXL). One-way ANOVA was utilized to compare the outcome differences among the three groups, and multiple linear regression was utilized to analyze the effects of age, sex, baseline SER and baseline AXL on myopia progression among the three groups. The cycloplegic SER progression was-0.30 ± 0.25 D, -0.17 ± 0.49 D and - 0.16 ± 0.14 D in DIMS, DIMS-Low ATR and DIMS-High ATR groups respectively. The DIMS group showed a significant higher cycloplegia SER progression (P = 0.003). The AXL elongation was 0.13 ± 0.08 mm, 0.06 ± 0.20 mm and 0.06 ± 0.14 mm in DIMS, DIMS-Low ATR and DIMS-High ATR groups respectively and AXL elongation was significantly higher in DIMS group (P = 0.011). The young age demonstrated positive correlation to the higher cycloplegia SER progression in all groups (all P < 0.05). The young age is also correlated to higher AXL elongation in the DIMS and DIMS-Low ATR groups (both P < 0.05). The myopia control effects of low- and high-concentration ATRs in DIMS users show no significant difference, while the addition of atropine in combination with DIMS spectacles had a greater effect on myopia control than DIMS spectacles alone.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：探讨 0.01% 阿托品（AT）联合不同光学矫正方式控制中国儿童近视的有效性与安全性。 方法：本回顾性研究分析了 2022 年 1 月至 2023 年 5 月期间的 341 名中国儿童，年龄 6-11 岁，近视度数为−0.50 D 至−3.0 D。将近视进展较快的儿童分为三组，分别接受三种光学矫正方式联合 0.01% 阿托品治疗：单光眼镜联合阿托品组（SV + AT）75 例、离焦整合多段式眼镜联合阿托品组（DIMS + AT）162 例、角膜塑形镜联合阿托品组（OK + AT）104 例。分别在治疗 6 个月和 1 年时，观察等效球镜度数（SER）、眼轴长度（AL）、眼压（IOP）及调节幅度（AMP）的变化。 结果：校正基线变量后，治疗 6 个月时：SV + AT 组的校正后眼轴长度（AL）增长值显著大于 DIMS + AT 组（差值 = 0.13 mm，95% 置信区间：0.07-0.20，P<0.05）和 OK + AT 组（差值 = 0.09 mm，95% 置信区间：0.01-0.17，P<0.05）；SV + AT 组的校正后等效球镜度数（SER）进展也显著大于 DIMS + AT 组（差值 =-0.20 D，95% 置信区间：-0.29 至 - 0.11，P<0.05）。治疗 12 个月时：SV + AT 组的校正后眼轴长度增长值最大，与 DIMS + AT 组相比差异有统计学意义（差值 = 0.24 mm，95% 置信区间：0.19-0.29，P<0.05），与 OK + AT 组相比差异也有统计学意义（差值 = 0.19 mm，95% 置信区间：0.13-0.25，P<0.05）；同理，SV + AT 组的校正后等效球镜度数进展显著大于 DIMS + AT 组（差值 =-0.36 D，95% 置信区间：-0.48 至 - 0.24，P<0.05）。 结论：本研究表明，0.01% 阿托品联合离焦整合多段式眼镜（DIMS）或角膜塑形镜，可能是控制近视进展较快儿童低度近视的有效方案。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate the efficacy and safety of 0.01% atropine (AT) in combination with different optical treatments for controlling myopia in Chinese children. METHODS: This retrospective study analyzed 341 Chinese children aged 6-11 years with myopia between -0.50 D and -3.0 D between January 2022 and May 2023. The fast-progressing, myopic children received three optical treatments combined with 0.01 % atropine: 75 children with single-vision spectacles and atropine (SV + AT), 162 children with defocus-incorporated multi-segment spectacles and atropine (DIMS + AT), or 104 children with orthokeratology and atropine (OK + AT). The changes in spherical equivalent refraction (SER), axial length (AL), intraocular pressure (IOP), and amplitude of accommodation (AMP) were observed at 6-month and 1-year intervals. RESULTS: After controlling for baseline variables, at 6 months, the increase in adjusted AL was significantly greater in the SV + AT group than in the DIMS + AT group (difference = 0.13 mm, 95 % CI: 0.07-0.20, P < 0.05) and in the OK + AT group (difference = 0.09 mm, 95 % CI: 0.09-0.17, P < 0.05). A more significant progression in adjusted SER was also observed in the SV + AT group than in the DIMS group (difference = -0.20D, 95 % CI: -0.29 to -0.11, P < 0.05). At 12 months, the greatest increase in adjusted AL was observed in the SV + AT group, with a statistically significant difference of 0.24 mm (95 % CI: 0.19-0.29, P < 0.05) compared with the DIMS group and a difference of 0.19 mm (95 % CI: 0.13-0.25, P < 0.05) compared with the OK + ST group. Similarly, a more significant progression in adjusted SER was observed in the SV + AT group than in the DIMS group (difference = -0.36 D, 95 % CI: -0.48 to -0.24, P < 0.05). CONCLUSIONS: This study suggested that 0.01% atropine combined with DIMS or orthokeratology may be viable for controlling low myopia in fast-progressing, myopic children.

原文摘要
摘要 背景：近视以眼球轴向过度延长为特征，不仅增加患致盲性眼病的风险，更给医疗体系带来沉重经济负担。尽管近视控制干预措施在延缓近视进展方面显示出成效，但其效果因人而异且无法完全阻止近视发展。本研究旨在探讨每日两次使用0.01%阿托品联合光学离焦疗法对学龄儿童近视控制的联合疗效。 方法与设计：这是一项前瞻性、平行组、单盲、随机、活性对照试验（ClinicalTrials.gov标识符：NCT06358755）。招募对象为7至12岁、既往未接受过近视控制干预的近视学龄儿童。基线测量后，受试者将随机分配至两组（每组n=56）。两组均接受0.01%阿托品治疗18个月（每日早晚各滴眼一次）。阿托品联合光学离焦（ATD）治疗组将配戴多段离焦（DIMS）镜片，纯阿托品（AT）组则配戴单光镜片。研究期间每6个月监测一次散瞳验光屈光度及眼轴长度变化。主要终点指标为研究期间散瞳验光屈光度及眼轴长度相对于基线的变化量。 讨论：本随机对照研究的结果将验证低浓度阿托品联合近视离焦在近视控制中的协同作用。研究结果还将探讨每日两次使用 0.01% 阿托品滴眼液在近视控制中的潜在益处及其潜在副作用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: Myopia, characterized by excessive axial elongation of the eyeball, increases risks of having sight-threatening diseases and impose a financial burden to healthcare system. Although myopic control interventions showed their effectiveness in slowing progression, the efficacy varies between individuals and does not completely halt progression. The study aims to investigate the efficacy of combining 0.01% atropine administered twice daily with optical defocus for myopia control in schoolchildren. METHODS AND DESIGN: This is a prospective, parallel-group, single-blinded, randomized, active-control trial (ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT06358755). Myopic schoolchildren with no previous myopic control interventions aged between 7 to 12 years will be recruited. They will be randomly allocated into two groups (n = 56 per group) after baseline measurement. Both groups will receive 0.01% atropine twice per day for 18 months (one drop in the morning and the other drop at night before bedtime). Defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses will be prescribed in atropine plus optical defocus (ATD) treatment group while single vision spectacle lenses will be given in atropine only (AT) group. Cycloplegic refraction and axial lengths will be monitored every 6 months over 18-month study period. The primary outcomes are changes in cycloplegic refraction and axial lengths relative to the baseline over the study period. DISCUSSION: The result will examine the combination effect of low dose atropine and myopic defocus on myopia control in a randomized controlled study. The findings will also explore the potential benefits of applying 0.01% atropine twice per day on myopic control and its potential side effects.

原文摘要
摘要 背景 / 目的：本研究探讨阿托品（ATR）联合多焦点离焦（DIMS）框架眼镜与阿托品单药治疗相比，在儿童高度近视控制中的效果。 患者与方法：本研究为回顾性队列研究，纳入接受阿托品单药治疗（n=35 眼）或阿托品联合多焦点离焦（DIMS）框架眼镜治疗（n=32 眼）的患者。主要结局指标为等效球镜度数（SER）进展量和眼轴长度（AXL）增长量，随访时间为 1 年，并采用独立样本 t 检验和广义线性模型进行统计学比较。 结果：1 年后，阿托品组的等效球镜度数（SER）进展量（–0.38±0.14 屈光度）显著大于 DIMS - 阿托品组（–0.15±0.09 屈光度）（p<0.001）。同期，阿托品组的眼轴长度（AXL）增长量（0.13±0.07 毫米）也显著高于 DIMS - 阿托品组（0.06±0.04 毫米）（p<0.001）。亚组分析显示，在阿托品组中，初始年龄较小、基线等效球镜度数（SER）较高、初始眼轴长度（AXL）较长均与更显著的 SER 进展和 AXL 增长相关（均 p<0.05）。此外，在 DIMS - 阿托品组中，初始 SER 较高与 SER 进展独立相关，初始 AXL 较长与 AXL 增长独立相关（均 p<0.05）。 结论：在高度近视儿童中，阿托品（ATR）联合多焦点离焦（DIMS）框架眼镜在延缓近视进展方面比阿托品单药治疗更有效。这种联合治疗方案可能是管理高危儿童近视的优选策略。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND/AIM: This study investigated the efficiency of combined atropine (ATR) and defocus incorporated multiple segments' (DIMS) spectacle lens versus ATR monotherapy in controlling high myopia in children. PATIENTS AND METHODS: A retrospective cohort study was performed, enrolling patients treated with either ATR monotherapy (n=35 eyes) or a combination of ATR and DIMS lenses (n=32 eyes). The primary outcomes were the spherical equivalent refraction (SER) progression and axial length (AXL) elongation, and were measured over a one year follow up period. Statistical comparisons were made using independent t-tests and generalized linear models. RESULTS: After one year, the ATR group showed significantly greater SER progression (-0.38±0.14D) compared to the DIMS-ATR group (-0.15±0.09D) (p<0.001). After the same period of time, AXL elongation was also significantly higher in the ATR group (0.13±0.07 mm) compared to the DIMS-ATR group (0.06±0.04 mm) (p<0.001). Subgroup analysis indicated that a young initial age, high baseline SER, and longer initial AXL were associated with greater SER progression and AXL elongation in the ATR group (all p<0.05). In addition, in the DIMS-ATR group, higher initial SER and AXL were independently associated with SER progression and AXL elongation, respectively (both p<0.05). CONCLUSION: The combined ATR plus DIMS spectacle lenses was more effective in slowing myopia progression than ATR monotherapy in children with high myopia. This combined approach may be a preferable strategy for managing high-risk pediatric myopia.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：回顾性分析多区正向离焦镜片（DIMS）联合雾视法（+0.50D）与 0.01% 阿托品治疗儿童近视前期及早期近视的疗效。 方法：对接受联合治疗的 192 只眼，分析其基线时及随访 12 个月后的眼轴长度（AL）和屈光状态。治疗成功的定义为：年眼轴长度（AL）增长率处于生理生长范围内，且近视进展≥-0.50 屈光度（D）/ 年。按基线眼轴长度（AL）和年龄分组进行亚组分析，比较总人群与各亚组的治疗成功率。 结果：总体而言，眼轴长度（AL）控制成功率和近视控制成功率分别为 87% 和 93%。与联合治疗前相比，治疗后男、女儿童的眼轴长度（AL）均显著增加（男孩：P<0.001；女孩：P<0.001）。等效球镜度数（SE）的变化与眼轴长度（AL）的变化趋势一致，男、女儿童治疗后等效球镜度数（SE）均有所增加，其中女孩的差异具有统计学意义（男孩：P=0.059；女孩：P=0.001）。按基线眼轴长度（AL）和年龄分组后，无论男孩还是女孩，各亚组的治疗成功率与总人群相比，差异均无统计学意义。 结论：多区正向离焦镜片（DIMS）联合雾视法与 0.01% 阿托品的治疗方案，对不同性别、不同基线眼轴长度（AL）及不同年龄的儿童近视前期及早期近视均具有显著的控制效果。建议在儿童出现近视倾向时及时进行干预。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To retrospectively analyze the efficacy of multi-zone positive optical defocus lenses (DIMS) + fog vision + 0.01% atropine for the treatment of children with preclinical and early stages of myopia. METHODS: The axial length (AL) and refraction were analyzed at baseline and after 12 months of follow-up in 192 eyes treated with combined therapy. The success of treatment was defined as an annual AL growth rate within the physiological growth range and myopia progression of -0.50 diopters (D)/year or greater. Subgroup analysis was performed to investigate the percentage of treatment success in the overall population compared to the subgroups based on baseline AL and age. RESULTS: Overall, the success rates were 87% and 93% for AL control and myopia control, respectively. Compared to before combined therapy, there was an increase in AL after treatment (boys: P < .001; girls: P < .001). The change in spherical equivalent (SE) was consistent with the change in AL, with both boys and girls showing an increase in SE after treatment, with a statistically significant difference in girls (boys: P = .059; girls: P = .001). There was no statistically significant difference in the percentage of treatment success in either boys or girls based on baseline AL and age subgroups compared to the overall population. CONCLUSIONS: The treatment regimen of DIMS + fog vision + 0.01% atropine demonstrated significant control effects on myopia in preclinical and early stages of myopia in children across different genders, baseline ALs, and ages. Timely intervention is recommended once a tendency toward myopia is observed in children.

Myopic Control Using Defocus-Incorporated Multiple Segments Spectacle Lenses Plus Low-Concentration Atropine in Patients With Fast Myopia Progression: A Retrospective Cohort Study

DIMS+0.01%ATP vs SVL+0.125%ATP

📖 Cureus📅 2025年👥 Lee Chia-Yi, Yang Shun-Fa, Huang Ching-Yao, Chang Chao Kai, Huang Jing-Yang, Chang Yu-Ling

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 5-1 联合阿托品 / 5-1-10
原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在评估离焦整合多段式镜片（DIMS 镜片）联合 0.01% 阿托品（ATR）与 0.125% 阿托品（ATR）对快速进展性近视患者的近视控制效果。 方法：本研究为回顾性队列研究，纳入 1 年内近视进展超过 - 1.00 屈光度（D）的患者。根据患者接受的治疗方案将其分组，其中 ATR 组（阿托品组）纳入 53 只眼，DIMS 组（离焦整合多段式镜片组）纳入 46 只眼。主要结局指标为等效球镜度数（SER）进展量和眼轴长度（AXL）增长值。采用独立样本 t 检验和广义线性模型进行统计分析。 结果：1 年随访后，ATR 组的 SER 进展量（0.31±0.11 D）显著大于 DIMS 组（0.10±0.07 D）（p<0.001）；末次随访时，ATR 组的 AXL 增长值（0.12±0.06 mm）显著大于 DIMS 组（0.03±0.02 mm）（p<0.001）。此外，基线近视度数为轻度或中度的患者中，ATR 组的 SER 进展量和 AXL 增长值均显著大于 DIMS 组（均 p<0.001）。ATR 组中，发病年龄较小与 SER 进展量更大、AXL 增长值更大相关（均 p<0.05）；而 DIMS 组中，无任何治疗前指标与 SER 进展量增加或 AXL 增长值增加相关（均 p>0.05）。 结论：在快速进展性近视人群中，离焦整合多段式镜片（DIMS 镜片）联合 0.01% 阿托品的治疗方案在等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AXL）控制方面，疗效优于 0.125% 阿托品的治疗方案。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
Purpose The aim of this study is to evaluate the myopic control effect between defocus-incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses plus 0.01% atropine (ATR), and 0.125% ATR, for patients with fast myopia progression. Methods A retrospective cohort study was conducted, and patients who had experienced myopic progression of more than -1.00 diopter (D) within a one-year period were enrolled. Then, the patients were divided according to the management they received. A total of 53 and 46 eyes were assigned to the ATR and DIMS groups, respectively. The primary outcomes were the progression of spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AXL). The independent t-test and generalized linear model were used for statistical analysis. Results After the one-year follow-up period, the progression of SER was significantly greater in the ATR group (0.31 ± 0.11 D) than in the DIMS group (0.10 ± 0.07 D) (p < 0.001). On the other hand, the elongation of AXL was significantly larger in the ATR group (0.12 ± 0.06 mm) than in the DIMS group (0.03 ± 0.02 mm) (p < 0.001) at the final visit. In addition, the ATR group with low- or moderate-baseline myopia revealed more significant SER and AXL progression than the DIMS group (all p < 0.001). A young age at onset was correlated with greater SER and AXL progression in the ATR group (both p < 0.05). Still, no pre-treatment parameter was associated with increased SER or AXL progression in the DIMS group (all p > 0.05). Conclusions DIMS spectacle lenses plus 0.01% ATR management showed greater efficacy for SER and AXL control than 0.125% ATR management in the fast myopia progression population.

摘要 目的：探讨并比较佩戴多区正向离焦（DIMS）镜片联合0.01%阿托品（DIMSA）与角膜塑形镜（OK镜）的近视儿童眼轴长度（AL）的季节性变化。 方法：这项回顾性研究共纳入428名受试者（平均年龄9.70±1.94岁），分为DIMSA组（203例）和OK镜组（225例）。根据两次随访之间6个月的中点将数据归类为“夏季”或“冬季”。收集基线及1年随访数据，仅提取右眼数据进行分析。分析眼轴随时间的增长情况及组间差异。 结果：1年时，DIMSA组的平均眼轴变化为0.18±0.19 mm，OK镜组为0.19±0.15 mm，两组间差异无统计学意义（P>0.05）。两组冬季的眼轴变化均显著高于夏季（P<0.01）。在DIMSA组7-8岁儿童、OK镜组7-12岁儿童以及初始AL<26 mm的受试者中，均观察到了类似的季节性规律。 结论：DIMSA与OK镜在一年中不同时段延缓近视进展的效果相似。眼轴增长在夏季放缓，且这种现象随着年龄增长和眼轴变长而减弱消失。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To investigate and compare seasonal variations in axial length (AL) in myopic children with defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses combined with 0.01% atropine (DIMSA) and orthokeratology (OK) lenses. Methods: The present retrospective study involved 428 subjects, mean age 9.70 ± 1.94 years, categorized into two groups: DIMSA (203 cases), and OK lenses (225 cases). Data were classified as “summer” or “winter” based on the midpoint of the 6 months between visits. Initial clinical visit (baseline) and one-year follow-up data were collected, and only data from the right eye was retrieved for analysis. Axial elongation over time and between groups was analyzed. Results: The mean change in AL at 1 year was 0.18 ± 0.19 mm in the DIMSA group and 0.19 ± 0.15 mm in the OK group, with no significance between the two groups (p>0.05). In both groups, the change of AL in winter was significantly higher than that in summer (P<0.01). A similar seasonal pattern was found among children 7–8 years of age in the DIMSA group and 7–12 years of age in the OK group, as well as for those with an initial AL < 26 mm. Conclusion: DIMSA and OK lenses show similar reductions in myopia progression at different times of the year. Axial elongation decreased in summer, and this phenomenon disappears with increasing age and AL. Keywords: axial length, myopia progression, defocus incorporated multiple segment spectacle lenses, orthokeratology, seasonal variations

摘要 目的：在真实世界中直接比较多区正向离焦（DIMS）、高非球面微透镜（HAL）及其分别联合低浓度阿托品（0.01%）共四种干预方案（DIMS、HAL、DIMSA、HALA）延缓近视进展的有效性。 方法：这项单中心回顾性队列研究纳入347名（694眼）接受上述四种方案之一至少1年的6-14岁儿童。主要结局指标为年眼轴长度（AL）变化，次要结局指标为年等效球镜度（SER）变化。治疗反应分为良好、一般或较差。采用线性混合模型和广义估计方程调整协变量后进行分析。 结果：调整协变量后，各组年眼轴增长差异有统计学意义（P<0.001），边际均值分别为DIMS组0.23 mm、HAL组0.15 mm、DIMSA组0.20 mm、HALA组0.12 mm。事后比较显示，HAL和HALA均优于DIMS（P<0.001），且HALA优于DIMSA（P=0.022）。在任一光学单药中添加0.01%阿托品均未在平均AL或SER结局上带来显著额外获益。与DIMS相比，HALA显著增加了AL（OR=4.34，P<0.001）和SER（OR=5.85，P<0.001）取得良好反应的几率，而DIMSA未观察到该效应。年龄较大独立预测更好的反应（AL：OR=1.46/年；SER：OR=1.26/年；均P<0.001）。 结论：在此非随机真实世界比较中，与DIMS相比，HAL单药治疗与更慢的SER进展相关。尽管添加阿托品未改善平均结局指标，但HALA获得良好反应的几率最高，提示其在反应分布上具有临床获益；HALA在实现良好个体反应方面的优势支持其用于需要最大程度干预的儿童。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Background Myopia is a global public health issue, necessitating effective control strategies. Defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) and highly aspherical lenslet (HAL) spectacle lenses, as well as their combination with low-concentration atropine (0.01%), have been shown to control myopia effectively. However, direct comparisons among these regimens, DIMS, HAL, DIMSA (DIMS + atropine), and HALA (HAL + atropine), are lacking. In this real-world study, we compared their effectiveness in slowing myopia progression. Methods This single-center retrospective cohort study included 347 children (694 eyes) aged 6–14 years who received one of the four interventions for at least 1 year. The primary outcome was the annual change in axial length (AL). The secondary outcome was the annual change in spherical equivalent refraction (SER). The treatment response was categorized as good, fair, or poor. Linear mixed models and generalized estimating equations were used for analysis, adjusting for covariates. Results After adjustment, annual axial elongation differed significantly among the groups (P < 0.001), with marginal means of 0.23 mm (DIMS), 0.15 mm (HAL), 0.20 mm (DIMSA), and 0.12 mm (HALA). Post hoc comparisons revealed that both HAL and HALA were superior to DIMS (P < 0.001) and that HALA was superior to DIMSA (P = 0.022). Adding 0.01% atropine to either optical monotherapy did not provide a significant additional benefit in terms of mean AL or SER outcomes. Compared with DIMS, HALA significantly increased the odds of a good response for AL (OR = 4.34, P < 0.001) and SER (OR = 5.85, P < 0.001), whereas this effect was not observed with DIMSA. Older age independently predicted better response (AL: OR = 1.46/year; SER: OR = 1.26/year; both P < 0.001). Conclusions In this non-randomized real-world comparison, HAL monotherapy was associated with slower SER progression, compared with DIMS. Although adding atropine did not improve mean outcomes, HALA showed the highest likelihood of a good response, suggesting a clinically meaningful benefit in response distribution. Although HALA did not consistently outperform HAL monotherapy across analyses, its advantage in achieving favourable individual responses supports its consideration for children requiring maximal intervention. These findings require confirmation in prospective randomized trials.

摘要 目的：比较多区正向离焦（DIMS）镜片、阿托品单药治疗及其联合疗法在儿童近视管理中的有效性。 方法：遵循PRISMA指南开展系统评价。检索多个电子数据库以纳入相关对照研究。主要结局指标为至少随访6个月时患者末次随访的等效球镜度（SER，D）和眼轴长度（AL，mm）变化；次要结局指标包括不良反应、视力变化及治疗依从性。 结果：共纳入8项研究、1460名受试者。3项研究比较了DIMS镜片与阿托品单药治疗，除1项研究报告阿托品延缓SER进展更显著外，其余研究无统计学显著差异；但有2项研究报告DIMS镜片延缓AL增长显著优于阿托品，1项无显著差异。4项研究比较了联合疗法与DIMS单药治疗，其中3项报告联合治疗显著延缓SER进展；在AL方面，所有研究均倾向于联合疗法，其中3项显示统计学显著差异。3项研究比较了联合疗法与阿托品单药治疗，均显示减缓了SER和AL进展，其中各有2项研究显示差异具有统计学意义。 结论：DIMS镜片和阿托品单药治疗均可有效控制近视，且DIMS镜片因不良反应较少而更具优势；联合治疗的效果显著优于任一单一疗法。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
To compare the effectiveness of defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lenses, atropine monotherapies, and their combination for myopia management in children. A systematic review was conducted following the guidelines of the PreferredReportingItemsforSystematicReviewsandMeta-Analyses(PRISMA).Multipleelectronicdatabasesweresearched to identify relevant, comparative studies. The primary outcome was the change in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) in diopters and axial length (AL) in millimeters at the latest patient follow-up, with a minimum follow-up period of 6 months. Thesecondaryoutcomesincludedadverseeffects,changesinvisualacuityandcompliancerelatedtotheinterventions.Atotal of1460participantsfromeightstudieswereincluded.ThreestudiescomparedDIMSlensesandatropinemonotherapy;there wasnostatisticallysignificantdifferenceinSERreductionexceptwithonestudythatreportedsignificantreductionwithatro- pine. However, two studies reported a significant decrease in AL with DIMS lenses, while one did not. Four studies compared the combination therapy versus DIMS monotherapy; three reported a significant reduction in SER with the combination. Regarding AL, all studies favored combination therapy, with three showing statistically significant results. Three studies com- pared combination therapy with atropine monotherapy; all demonstrated reductions in SER and AL, with two studies show- ing statistical significance for each. The evidence suggests that both DIMS lenses and atropine monotherapy are effective in managing myopia, with DIMS lenses being preferred due to fewer adverse effects. However, combining these therapies offers greater effectiveness than either therapy alone. Keywords Myopia, children, myopia control, atropine, defocus, DIMS

摘要 目的：评估在佩戴多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）镜片后近视仍持续进展的儿童中，每晚联合加用0.025%阿托品的疗效，并探讨动态瞳孔测量是否有助于识别此类进展。 方法：采用混合方法设计。纵向队列纳入20名DIMS无应答儿童（定义为年等效球镜度数进展≥0.5 D或年眼轴增长≥0.2 mm），接受辅助性阿托品治疗并随访12个月；另一独立的横断面队列对60名接受DIMS治疗的儿童（根据前一年进展分为快速进展者和慢速进展者）进行动态瞳孔测量。 结果：联合治疗显著降低了近视进展，平均年眼轴增长从0.39±0.18 mm/年降至0.20±0.18 mm/年，平均年屈光度进展从-0.82±0.67 D/年改善至-0.28±0.45 D/年。20%的患者观察到暂时性眼轴缩短，25%的患者仍无应答（主要见于母亲高度近视者）。动态瞳孔测量显示，与慢速进展者相比，快速进展者的瞳孔收缩更慢且收缩持续时间延长，而散瞳参数和静态瞳孔大小无差异。 结论：加用低浓度阿托品可有效减缓大多数DIMS无应答儿童的近视进展；改变的瞳孔收缩动力学可能反映了潜在的生理机制。

This study evaluated the efficacy of adding nightly 0.025% atropine to Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle treatment in children with ongoing myopia progression and explored whether dynamic pupillometry could help identify such progression. In a mixed-method design, a longitudinal arm included 20 DIMS non-responders, defined by annual progression of ≥ 0.5 D spherical equivalent refraction or ≥ 0.2 mm axial elongation, who received adjunctive atropine and were followed for 12 months. In a separate cross-sectional arm, dynamic pupillometry was performed in 60 DIMS-treated children classified as fast or slow progressors based on prior-year progression. Combination therapy significantly reduced myopia progression, with mean axial elongation decreasing from 0.39 ± 0.18 to 0.20 ± 0.18 mm/year and mean refractive progression improving from − 0.82 ± 0.67 to − 0.28 ± 0.45 D/year. Transient axial shortening was observed in 20% of patients, while 25% remained unresponsive, predominantly those with high maternal myopia. Dynamic pupillometry revealed that fast progressors exhibited slower and prolonged pupil constriction compared with slow progressors, whereas dilation parameters and static pupil size did not differ. 摘要 目的：评估对于初始佩戴多区正向离焦（DIMS）镜片反应不足、眼轴快速增长的儿童，联合使用0.05%阿托品是否能提供额外的近视控制效果。 方法：这项回顾性配对队列研究纳入54名在佩戴DIMS镜片初期近视快速进展的儿童。按年龄、性别、眼轴长度和等效球镜度（SER），将接受联合0.05%阿托品治疗的27名儿童与继续接受DIMS单药治疗的27名儿童进行配对。先设立约6个月的干预前观察期以识别眼轴快速增长儿童，随后进行约12个月的干预观察期比较组间进展情况。统计学分析采用t检验、卡方检验、协方差分析及多变量线性回归。 结果：两组基线特征具有可比性。在干预前阶段，单药组与联合组的时间标化年眼轴增长率相似（0.47±0.03 vs. 0.54±0.03 mm/年，P=0.170），而联合组的SER进展显著快于单药组（-0.98±0.10 vs. -0.61±0.11 D/年，P=0.016）。干预阶段校正干预前进展率后，联合组的校正年眼轴增长率显著低于单药组（0.12±0.04 vs. 0.31±0.04 mm/年，P=0.001），SER进展亦显著慢于单药组（-0.19±0.08 vs. -0.55±0.08 D/年，P=0.001）。 结论：对于DIMS镜片治疗期间近视快速进展的儿童，联合使用0.05%阿托品比继续DIMS单药治疗具有更低的眼轴增长率和更慢的SER进展。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
ABSTRACT Introduction: Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) lenses slow myopia progression, but some children continue to experience rapid axial elongation despite treatment. This study evaluated whether adjunctive 0.05% atropine was associated with additional myopia control in children with an insufficient response to DIMS monotherapy. Methods: This retrospective matched cohort study included 54 children with rapid myopia progression during initial DIMS lens wear. We matched 27 children receiving adjunctive 0.05% atropine with 27 children who continued DIMS monotherapy by age, sex, axial length, and spherical equivalent refraction (SER). A pre-intervention observation period of approximately 6 months was used to identify children with rapid axial elongation during initial DIMS monotherapy, followed by an approximately 12-month intervention period to compare progression outcomes between groups. Statistical analyses included t tests, chi-square tests, analysis of covariance, and multivariable linear regression. Results: Baseline characteristics were comparable between groups. During the pre-intervention phase, the time-normalized axial elongation rate was similar between the monotherapy and combination groups (0.47 ± 0.03 vs. 0.54 ± 0.03 mm/year, P = 0.170), whereas the combination group showed greater myopic SER progression than the monotherapy group (− 0.98 ± 0.10 vs. − 0.61 ± 0.11 D/year, P = 0.016). During the intervention phase, after adjustment for the corresponding pre-intervention progression rate, the adjusted axial elongation rate was lower in the combination group than in the monotherapy group (0.12 ± 0.04 vs. 0.31 ± 0.04 mm/year, P = 0.001), as was SER progression (− 0.19 ± 0.08 vs. − 0.55 ± 0.08 D/year, P = 0.001). Conclusions: In children with rapid myopia progression during DIMS lens treatment, adjunctive 0.05% atropine was associated with a lower axial elongation rate and slower SER progression than continued DIMS monotherapy. These findings support further prospective evaluation of this treatment strategy. Keywords: Myopia; Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS); Atropine; Combination therapy; Rapid myopia progression

摘要 目的：探讨对于较高浓度阿托品控制效果不佳的儿童，联合加用多区正向离焦（DIMS）眼镜进行近视控制的疗效。 方法：这项前瞻性队列研究纳入此前使用≥0.125%阿托品至少1年、随后接受DIMS联合阿托品治疗超过6个月的6-14岁儿童。采用配对t检验比较单药期与联合期的年眼轴长度（AL）变化；采用广义估计方程分析相关结局变量。 结果：最终分析纳入29名患者共57只眼（平均年龄9.8岁），基线平均AL为24.6 mm。阿托品单药期平均随访27.9个月，联合治疗期平均随访18.2个月。联合治疗期的年眼轴增长显著少于阿托品单药期（0.19±0.18 mm/年 vs. 0.29±0.20 mm/年，P=0.004）。在联合校正年龄、瞳孔大小、阿托品浓度及DIMS依从性后，年AL变化和球镜度数变化均与年龄呈负相关（分别P=0.003和P=0.035）。 结论：阿托品联合DIMS眼镜对于单独阿托品治疗反应不佳的儿童近视控制有效。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose To explore the efficacy of myopia control by adding defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacles in children who are refractory to higher-dose atropine control. Methods This prospective cohort study included children aged 6–14 who had previously used ≥0.125% atropine for at least one year and were later treated with DIMS plus atropine for over six months. Annual axial length (AL) changes during monotherapy and combination therapy were compared using paired t-tests. Generalized estimating equations were used to analyze correlations with outcome variables. Results In total, 57 eyes from 29 patients (mean age 9.8 years) were included in our final analysis. The mean AL value at the baseline was 24.6 mm. The mean follow-up duration was 27.9 months in the atropine-alone period and 18.2 months in the combination therapy period. Annual AL changes in the combination therapy period were significantly less than in the atropine-alone period (0.19 ± 0.18 mm/year vs. 0.29 ± 0.20 mm/year, P = 0.004). After adjusting for age, pupil size, and atropine concentration and compliance for DIMS together, both annual AL change and spherical power changes were associated with age negatively (P = 0.003 and P = 0.035, respectively). Conclusions Combination therapy of atropine and DIMS was effective in myopia control in children with poor response to atropine treatment alone. Further large-scale and long-term studies are needed to confirm these observations. Keywords Atropine · Axial length · Defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacles · Combination therapy · Refractory myopia

摘要 目的：比较每日两次0.01%阿托品分别联合角膜塑形镜（OKA组）或多区正向离焦镜片（DIMSA组）控制眼轴长度（AL）增长的1年疗效，并利用弹性网络惩罚回归识别关键预测因素。 方法：这项回顾性队列研究纳入220名近视儿童（220眼），分为DIMSA组（n=120）和OKA组（n=100），评估12个月内的眼轴长度变化（ΔAL）。采用多变量线性回归和亚组分析评估独立关联，并采用倾向评分法和E值敏感性分析处理治疗选择偏倚与未测混杂因素。采用5折交叉验证的弹性网络回归模型处理多重共线性并筛选ΔAL的潜在预测指标。 结果：OKA组的眼轴增长显著慢于DIMSA组（0.157±0.154 mm vs. 0.313±0.221 mm，P<0.001）。多变量回归显示，与OKA方案相比，DIMSA方案与更大的眼轴增长相关（β=0.144，P<0.001）。在所有倾向评分模型中该关联均保持稳健，高E值（>5.0）表明其对未测混杂因素具有强抵抗力。亚组分析和交互作用检验显示在不同年龄和近视严重程度分层中，OKA与较少眼轴增长的关联均保持一致。弹性网络回归确定较短的基线AL和较小的年龄是进展更快的首要预测因素；此外，OKA组呈现出主要与年龄和基线AL相关的简约模式，而DIMSA组则表现出与更广泛基线协变量相关的“多驱动因素”模式。 结论：在联合每日两次0.01%阿托品时，角膜塑形镜控制眼轴增长的效果显著优于DIMS镜片；较短的基线眼轴和较小的年龄是近视快速进展的主要预测因素。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Background The increasing prevalence of childhood myopia necessitates effective intervention strategies. This study compared the 1-year efficacy of twice-daily 0.01% atropine combined with either Orthokeratology (OKA) or Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMSA) lenses in controlling axial length (AL) elongation, and utilized Elastic Net penalized regression to identify key predictive factors. Methods This retrospective cohort study included 220 myopic children (220 eyes), divided into the DIMSA group (n=120) and the OKA group (n=100). Axial length changes (ΔAL) over 12 months were evaluated. Multivariable linear regression and subgroup analyses were conducted to evaluate the independent associations. Additionally, propensity score methods and E-value sensitivity analyses were employed to address potential treatment-selection bias and unmeasured confounding. An Elastic Net regression model with 5-fold cross-validation was employed to handle multi-collinearity and perform feature selection for potential predictors of ΔAL. Results The OKA group demonstrated significantly slower AL elongation than the DIMSA group (0.157 ± 0.154 mm vs. 0.313 ± 0.221 mm, P < 0.001). Multivariable regression indicated that the DIMSA regimen was associated with greater AL elongation compared with the OKA regimen (β= 0.144, P < 0.001). This association remained robust across all propensity score models, with high E-values (> 5.0) indicating strong resistance to unmeasured confounding. Subgroup analyses and interaction tests revealed a consistent association of OKA with less axial elongation across different age and myopia severity strata. Elastic Net regression identified shorter baseline AL and younger age as the primary predictors of faster progression. Notably, the Elastic Net models revealed distinct predictive architectures: the OKA group exhibited a parsimonious pattern primarily associated with age and baseline AL, whereas the DIMSA group displayed a "multi-driver" pattern associated with broader baseline covariates.

原文摘要
摘要 背景：全球近视患病率呈上升趋势。联合治疗在近视控制方面的效果优于单一治疗。已有研究表明，RLRL与DIMS可显著延缓近视进展，但目前尚不清楚这两种疗法联合使用是否优于单一疗法。本研究旨在阐述一项临床试验的方案，该试验旨在评估 RLRL 联合 DIMS 与单纯 DIMS 治疗在中国学龄儿童近视进展中的疗效与安全性。 方法：本研究为一项为期 12 个月的随机、平行对照、单中心临床试验。研究将在本院招募 66 名受试者，按 1:1 比例分组，纳入标准为：年龄 8-12 岁，双眼睫状肌麻痹下等效球镜度数（SE）为 - 0.50 D 至 - 6.00 D。干预组受试者在家长 / 监护人监督下，于周一至周五在家使用 RLRL 治疗设备，每日 2 次，每次 3 分钟，两次治疗间隔至少 4 小时；白天佩戴 DIMS 眼镜矫正近视。对照组受试者不接受 RLRL 治疗，仅白天佩戴 DIMS 眼镜矫正近视。两组受试者均需每 6 个月到院复诊。主要结局指标为 12 个月时眼轴长度的变化；次要结局指标包括 12 个月时睫状肌麻痹下屈光状态变化、OCT检查结果、mfERG结果、色觉变化及受试者自我报告的不良事件。 讨论：本研究将详细报告 RLRL 联合 DIMS 与单纯 DIMS 治疗学龄儿童近视的疗效及安全性结局。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: Myopia is increasing in prevalence worldwide. Combination therapy showed a better effect on myopia control than monotherapy. Repeated low-level red light therapy (RLRL) therapy and defocus-incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) spectacle lenses have been reported to retard myopia progression significantly. However, whether these two therapies are better than one is still unknown. The present study aims to report the study protocol of a trial designed to evaluate the efficacy and safety of combination therapy of RLRL and DIMS versus DIMS alone for reducing the progression of myopia among Chinese school-aged children. METHODS: This study is a 12-month, randomized, parallel-controlled, single-center clinical trial. We will recruit children aged 8-12 years with spherical equivalence (SE) between - 0.50 D and - 6.00 D under cycloplegia in both eyes. We will recruit 66 participants with an allocation ratio of 1:1 from our hospital. Participants in the intervention group will be treated with an RLRL therapy device twice a day from Monday to Friday at home, 3 min per session, with a minimum interval of 4 h, under the supervision of their parents/guardians. They will wear DIMS spectacles for myopia correction during the day. Participants in the control group will not receive the RLRL therapy and will only wear DIMS spectacles to correct myopia. Participants from both groups will attend the hospital every 6 months. The primary outcome is the change in axial length at 12 months. Secondary outcomes include changes in refraction under cycloplegia, optical coherence tomography (OCT), multifocal electroretinogram (mfERG), color vision, and participants' self-reporting of adverse events at 12 months. DISCUSSION: This study will report the efficacy and safety outcome of the combination therapy of RLRL and DIMS versus DIMS for school-aged children with myopia in detail. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ChiCTR2300075398. Registered 4 September 2023. https://www.chictr.org.cn/bin/project/edit?pid=200751 .

DIMS+RLRL vs DIMS vs RLRL

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 5-2 联合红光 / 5-2-2
原文摘要
摘要 DIMS镜片与RLRL疗法均用于延缓近视进展，但目前尚不清楚这两种干预措施是否存在协同作用。本研究纳入 190 名学龄期近视儿童（共 380 只眼），通过近 1 年的随访，观察其轴向长度（AL）变化。在 380 只眼中，170 只眼佩戴 DIMS 镜片，80 只眼接受 RLRL 疗法，130 只眼采用两种干预联合方案进行近视控制。每次随访时，通过减去基线测量值计算轴向长度变化，并将其标准化为以毫米（mm）为单位的年均变化值。以轴向长度变化为主要结局指标，采用广义线性混合模型进行分析，在调整年龄、性别、基线轴向长度和随访时长后，比较三种干预措施的近视控制效果大小。受试者平均年龄为 9.84±2.63 岁，平均轴向长度为 24.49±1.20 mm，平均球镜等效屈光度（SER）为 - 2.90±2.08 屈光度（D），平均随访时间为 301±91 天。研究结束时，联合疗法组的调整后年均轴向长度变化为 - 0.13 mm，RLRL 单独治疗组为 - 0.04 mm，DIMS 镜片单独佩戴组为 0.16 mm（p<0.0001）。DIMS 与 RLRL 联合疗法在控制近视进展方面的效果显著优于 RLRL 单独疗法（p=0.0009）或 DIMS 单独疗法（p<0.0001）。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
Defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) lenses and repeated low-level red-light (RLRL) are used to retard myopia progression. However, it is currently unknown if there is a synergistic effect of the two interventions. In the current study, 190 school-aged children with myopia (380 eyes) were studied for the change in axial length (AL) over nearly one year of follow-up. Of 380 eyes, 170 eyes wore DIMS lenses, 80 eyes had RLRL therapy, and 130 eyes had both interventions (DIMS_RLRL) for myopia control. AL changes were calculated at each follow-up visit by subtracting the baseline measurements and normalized to yearly changes in mm. AL changes as a primary outcome were analyzed in a generalized linear mixed model to compare effect sizes of myopia control among three interventions while adjusting for age, sex, baseline axial length, and follow-up length. Participants had a mean age of 9.84 ± 2.63 years old, mean AL of 24.49 ± 1.20 mm, mean SER of -2.90 ± 2.08 diopters, and mean follow-up time of 301 ± 91 days. By the end of the study, the adjusted mean yearly axial change with combination therapy was - 0.13 mm, -0.04 mm for the eyes with RLRL alone, and 0.16 mm for the eyes with DIMS lenses alone (p < 0.0001). Combination therapy of DIMS and RLRL has significantly greater effect size in controlling myopia progression than either RLRL alone (p = 0.0009) or DIMS alone (p < 0.0001).

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：评价重复低强度红光（RLRL）联合光学干预（角膜塑形镜 OK 或多区正向光学离焦 DIMS 框架眼镜）控制儿童近视的疗效与安全性。 方法：系统检索 PubMed、EMBASE、Cochrane Library、Web of Science、中国知网（CNKI）和万方数据库（检索截止至 2025 年 7 月 14 日），纳入比较 RLRL 联合 OK 或 DIMS 与单项光学治疗的随机对照和队列研究。主要结局指标为眼轴长度（AL）、等效球镜度（SER）和黄斑中心凹下脉络膜厚度（SFChT），使用 ROB2 和 ROBINS-I 评估偏倚风险。 结果：共纳入 8 项研究。与单纯光学治疗相比，联合治疗可显著减少眼轴延长、减缓 SER 进展并更显著增加 SFChT；眼部结构改变最早在 1 个月时即可观察到，并持续至 12 个月；短期眼表不良事件发生率未见显著差异，但研究存在异质性且数据呈区域集中特征。 结论：辅助 RLRL 治疗可能通过脉络膜调节增强光学近视控制效果，尤其在延缓眼轴增长和增加脉络膜厚度方面；上述结果应视为早期生物学信号而非长期优效性的确切证据，仍需更大规模、随访时间更长的多中心随机对照试验以确认其持久性、安全性和剂量反应特征。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Background: Repeated low-level red-light (RLRL) therapy, a photobiomodulation approach for myopia control, has shown potential in modulating choroidal and axial structures. Recent studies have combined RLRL with optical interventions such as orthokeratology (OK) and defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) spectacles. However, the efficacy and safety of these combinations remain unclear. This study synthesized current evidence on RLRL combined with optical interventions for pediatric myopia control. Methods: A systematic search of PubMed, EMBASE, Cochrane Library, Web of Science, CNKI and Wanfang Data was conducted up to July 14, 2025. Randomized and cohort studies comparing RLRL combined with OK or DIMS versus monotherapy were included. Primary outcomes were axial length (AL), spherical equivalent refraction (SER), and subfoveal choroidal thickness (SFChT). Fixed- or random-effects models were used based on heterogeneity. Risk of bias was assessed with ROB2 and ROBINS-I. Results: Eight studies were included. Compared with optical monotherapy, combination therapy was associated with reduced axial elongation, slower SER progression, and greater increases in SFChT. Structural changes were observed as early as 1 month and persisted through 12 months. No significant differences were detected in short-term ocular surface adverse events. However, heterogeneity and regional concentration of data were noted. Conclusions: Adjunctive RLRL therapy may enhance optical myopia control effects, particularly in reducing axial elongation and increasing choroidal thickness, possibly through choroidal modulation. These findings should be viewed as early biological signals, not definitive evidence of long-term superiority. Larger multicenter randomized trials with extended follow-up are needed to confirm durability, safety, and dose–response characteristics.
