摘要 目的：探讨重复低强度红光（RLRL）联合多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）眼镜控制儿童近视进展的疗效与安全性。 方法：回顾性队列研究，分析 100 例佩戴 DIMS 眼镜后近视仍持续进展的儿童病历，根据治疗史分为单纯 DIMS 对照组（n=50）和 RLRL+DIMS 联合治疗组（n=50）。在基线及 1、3、6、9、12 个月时评估眼轴长度（AL）、等效球镜度（SER）、裸眼视力（UCVA）、黄斑中心凹视网膜厚度（CRT）、黄斑中心凹下脉络膜厚度（SFChT）、角膜曲率（CC）、眼底自发荧光及不良事件。 结果：入组 100 例儿童中 92 例完成 12 个月随访，两组基线特征具有可比性（均 P>0.05）。12 个月时，联合组眼轴延长量显著小于对照组（平均变化：0.060±0.237 mm 对比 0.386±0.183 mm，P<0.001），且联合组中 37.8% 的儿童出现眼轴缩短；联合组 SER 进展亦显著慢于对照组（变化：+0.038±0.435 D 对比 -0.720±0.295 D，P<0.001）；联合组 SFChT 显著增加（+13.2±27.4 μm），而对照组变薄（-3.3±12.4 μm，P<0.001）；CRT 及 CC 无显著变化；9 名儿童出现一过性眩光，1 名因出现持续 8 分钟后像而退出；未发现异常眼底自发荧光。 结论：在 12 个月观察期内，RLRL 联合 DIMS 眼镜可有效增加近视儿童脉络膜厚度、延缓眼轴延长并减缓 SER 进展，短期安全性良好；仍需更长期研究以确认其持续有效性与安全性。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Objective: To investigate the efficacy and safety of repeated low-intensity red light (RLRL) therapy combined with defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacles for controlling myopia progression in children. Methods: In this retrospective cohort study, medical records of 100 children with persistent myopia progression despite DIMS spectacle wear were reviewed. Patients were divided into two groups based on their treatment history: a DIMS-only control group (n=50) and an RLRL+DIMS combination group (n=50). Axial length (AL), spherical equivalent refraction (SER), uncorrected visual acuity (UCVA), central retinal thickness (CRT), subfoveal choroidal thickness (SFChT), corneal curvature (CC), fundus autofluorescence, adverse events were assessed at baseline and 1, 3, 6, 9 and 12 months. Results: Of the 100 enrolled children, 92 completed the 12-month follow-up. Baseline characteristics were comparable between groups (all P>0.05). At 12 months, the combination group showed significantly less axial elongation than the control group (mean change: 0.060±0.237 mm vs. 0.386±0.183 mm, P<0.001), with 37.8% of children showing axial shortening. SER progression was also significantly slower in the combination group (change: +0.038±0.435 D vs. -0.720±0.295 D; P<0.001). SFChT increased significantly in the combination group (+13.2±27.4 μm) but decreased in controls (-3.3±12.4 μm, P<0.001). No significant changes in CRT or CC were observed. Transient glare occurred in nine children; one child withdrew due to an 8-minute afterimage. No abnormal fundus autofluorescence was detected. Conclusion: RLRL combined with DIMS spectacles effectively increased choroidal thickness, delayed axial elongation, and slowed SER progression in myopic children over 12 months, with a favorable short-term safety profile. Longer-term studies are warranted to confirm sustained efficacy and safety.

原文摘要
摘要 本研究旨在评估不同近视矫正方式在青少年近视防控中的临床应用效果。共纳入 145 例 8~15 岁近视青少年，根据治疗方式将其双眼分为 4 组：纯佩戴DIMS框架镜组（A 组）、纯佩戴OK镜组（B 组）、DIMS +anisodamine 组（C 组）、OK +anisodamine 组（D 组）。 主要结果指标包括眼轴长度和屈光不正（以等效球镜度数 SER 表示），分别在基线时和随访 12 个月时进行测量，比较各组的临床效果。结果显示，各组近视进展存在显著差异，其中 D 组的眼轴伸长量最小。OK镜片在控制近视进展方面优于DIMS眼镜，且联合anisodamine可进一步增强矫正效果。本研究为青少年近视控制干预措施提供了重要的临床依据。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
This study aimed to evaluate the clinical application of different myopia correction methods in the prevention and control of myopia in adolescents. A total of 145 myopic adolescents aged 8 to 15 years were included, and their eyes were divided into four groups based on the treatment modality: wearing Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses alone (Group A), orthokeratology (OK) lenses alone (Group B), DIMS spectacle lenses combined with racemic anisodamine eye drops (Group C), and OK lenses combined with racemic anisodamine eye drops (Group D). The primary outcomes, including axial length and refractive error (expressed as spherical equivalent refraction, SER), were measured at baseline and at the 12-month follow-up. The clinical effects of each group were compared. The results showed significant differences in myopia progression across the groups, with Group D showing the least axial elongation. OK lenses were more effective than DIMS spectacle lenses in controlling myopia progression, and the combination of racemic anisodamine eye drops further enhanced the correction effect. This study provides important clinical evidence for myopia control interventions in adolescents.

原文摘要
摘要 引言：近视及其并发症可导致不可逆性视力损害，甚至失明，已成为 21 世纪全球范围内的公共卫生问题。尽管目前已有延缓近视进展的治疗方法，但其平均疗效中等。无论是在受控动物模型中，还是儿童在自然阳光下暴露于强光，均已显示出对近视发生的保护作用。本研究假设，通过模拟阳光的家用设备实施的强光疗法（BLT），可延缓学龄儿童的近视进展。 方法与分析：本研究拟开展一项为期 2 年的双盲随机对照试验，旨在探讨强光疗法（BLT）及其联合近视控制治疗对学龄儿童的有效性。1 期试验将纳入 7-12 岁中国学龄儿童，并将其随机分配至三个试验组中的一组。受试者需每日在强光疗法（10000 lux白色发光二极管（LED）灯）或安慰剂光疗（500 lux色 LED 灯）下完成至少 45 分钟的近距离作业。对照组受试者将佩戴单光镜片并接受安慰剂光疗；单一治疗组受试者将佩戴单光镜片并接受强光疗法；联合治疗组受试者将佩戴离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS 镜片）并接受强光疗法。主要结局指标和次要结局指标分别为 2 年内睫状肌麻痹客观验光结果和眼轴长度的变化。 治疗剂量并非通过可穿戴光强计测量，而是通过附着在强光疗法灯下方的监测传感器间接测量。剂量监测的差异可能会影响观察到的治疗效果。 伦理与成果传播:本研究已获得香港理工大学机构审查委员会（批件号：HSEARS 20180829002–05）以及香港大学 / 医院管理局香港西联网机构审查委员会（批件号：UW 20–362）的批准。研究结果将在学术会议上公布，并发表于经同行评审的核心期刊。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
INTRODUCTION: Myopia and its complications can lead to irreversible visual impairment and even blindness, making this a worldwide public health concern for the 21st century. While treatments to slow myopia progression exist, their average efficacy is moderate. Bright light exposure, either in controlled animal models or naturally under sunlight for children, has demonstrated a protective effect against myopia development. This study hypothesises that bright light therapy (BLT), delivered via a home-based device mimicking sunlight, could slow myopia progression in schoolchildren. METHODS AND ANALYSIS: We propose a 2-year, double-masked, randomised controlled trial to investigate the effectiveness of BLT and its combination with myopia control treatment in schoolchildren. Chinese schoolchildren aged 7-12 years will be recruited and randomly assigned to one of three arms in phase 1. Subjects will be instructed to perform a minimum of 45 mins of near tasks daily under either BLT (10 000 lux white Light Emitting Diode (LED) light) or placebo light therapy (500 lux white LED light). The control subjects will receive single-vision spectacles and placebo light therapy; the single treatment subjects will receive single-vision spectacles and BLT; and the combination treatment subjects will receive defocus-incorporated multiple segments spectacles and BLT. The primary and secondary outcome measures are changes in cycloplegic objective refraction and axial length over a 2-year period.Treatment dosage is indirectly measured using a monitoring sensor attached beneath the BLT lamp rather than a wearable light metre. Variations in dosage monitoring may influence the observed treatment efficacy. ETHICS AND DISSEMINATION: The study has been approved by the Institutional Review Boards of The Hong Kong Polytechnic University (HSEARS 20180829002-05) and The University of Hong Kong/Hospital Authority Hong Kong West Cluster (UW 20-362). The study results will be disseminated in scientific conferences and peer-reviewed indexed journals. TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT04923841.

参考文献5-3-3｜DIMS联合远像屏——90分钟后部分区域脉络膜增厚，尚未评估长期近视控制效果 研究时间：2023年1—6月 研究中心：天津市眼科医院视光中心 主要作者：郭星艺（第一作者）；陈晓琴&李丽华 试验设计：前瞻性、随机、对照、交叉先导试验 研究人群：8–13岁，SE为−0.50至−6.00 D，共40人 分组：DIMS＋远像屏、DIMS＋平板、SVL＋远像屏、SVL＋平板，初始各10人 观察时间：每阶段观看90分钟，间隔3–7天后交换屏幕类型，镜片类型保持不变 结果 - 脉络膜厚度（主要指标）：DIMS＋远像屏较SVL＋平板组，在下方内环区域（I3）的增厚量多 11.23 μm（P＝0.009）。 - DIMS＋平板：较SVL＋平板组，中心区脉络膜增厚量多 9.54 μm（P＝0.005），下方、鼻侧及颞侧内环区域也有显著差异。 - SE短期变化：平板组由−2.14 D变为−2.26 D，近视性偏移约 0.12 D（P＝0.036）；远像屏组变化无统计学意义。 - AL进展量、长期控制量及控制率：未报告。

摘要 目的：明确使用远像屏（DIS）设备和多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）镜片的光学干预对儿童脉络膜厚度（ChT）变化的影响。 方法：前瞻性随机对照交叉试验。招募 40 名 8-13 岁、等效球镜度（SER）在 -0.50 至 -6.00 D 的儿童，随机分为 4 组（分别佩戴 DIMS 或单光镜片 SVL，并使用 DIS 或平板电脑 TC 观看视频）。第一阶段观看视频 90 分钟，经 3-7 天恢复期后，TC 组与 DIS 组交叉进行第二阶段 90 分钟视频观看。采用开放视野电脑验光仪测量 SER，全量程扫频源 OCT（SS-OCT）测量各区域 ChT。 结果：观看 90 分钟视频后，TC 组 SER 显著负向增加（-2.14±1.15 D 对比 -2.26±1.16 D，P=0.036），而 DIS 组无显著变化。佩戴 SVL 受试者中，DIS 组在 I3（P=0.036）和 T3（P=0.032）区域的 ChT 增加显著大于 TC 组。使用 TC 的受试者中，DIMS 组在中心区 C（9.54±3.19 μm，P=0.005）、I3（6.44±3.04 μm，P=0.043）、N3（9.10±3.17 μm，P=0.007）和 T3（8.00±3.17 μm，P=0.017）的 ChT 增厚均显著大于 SVL 组。DIMS 联合 DIS 组在 I3 区域的 ChT 增厚（11.23±4.07 μm，P=0.009）显著优于 SVL 联合 TC 组。 结论：短期远距离用眼模式和近视离焦可能对近视儿童的脉络膜变化产生有益效应。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: This study aimed to characterize the changes in choroidal thickness (ChT) in response to optical approaches using the distant-image screen (DIS) device and defocus-incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lenses. Design: This is a prospective, randomized, controlled, crossover trial. Participants: A total of 40 children (8–13 years of age) with spherical equivalent refraction (SER) ranging from −0.50 to −6.00 diopters (D) were recruited and randomized into 4 groups: children who watched videos using either a DIS or a tablet computer (TC) and those wearing DIMS or single-vision lenses (SVL). Methods: In their assigned groups, children watched videos for 90 min in stage I, followed by a 3–7-day recovery period. After this recovery period, the children in the TC group were crossed over to the DIS group, and those in the DIS group were crossed over to the TC group for an additional 90 min in stage II. The SER was measured before and after watching videos using an open-field autorefractor. The ChT in the central (1 × 1 mm), superior, inferior, nasal, and temporal regions in 1–3 mm (S3, I3, N3, and T3) and 3–6 mm (S6, I6, N6, and T6) were measured before and after watching videos using full-range swept-source optical coherence tomography (SS-OCT). Main outcome measures: The main outcome measure was the changes in regional ChT. Results: After 90 min of video watching, the SER in the TC group significantly increased after viewing 90-min videos (−2.14 ± 1.15 D vs.-2.26 ± 1.16 D, p = 0.036), whereas no significant difference was observed in the DIS group. Among the participants wearing SVL, the ChT changes in the DIS group were significantly higher than those in the TC group at I3 (p = 0.036) and T3 (p = 0.032), and the changes in other regions were not significantly different between the two groups. For participants using TC, the DIMS group showed greater ChT thickening at C (9.54 ± 3.19 μm, p = 0.005), I3 (6.44 ± 3.04 μm, p = 0.043), N3 (9.10 ± 3.17 μm, p = 0.007), and T3 (8.00 ± 3.17 μm, p = 0.017) than the SVL group. The combination of DIMS and DIS exhibited greater ChT thickening at I3 (11.23 ± 4.07 μm, p = 0.009) compared to the SVL and TC groups. Conclusion: Short-term long-distance working mode and myopic defocus may exert beneficial effects on choroidal variation in myopic children.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在探讨控制近视进展干预措施的有效性。在这项系统综述中，主要结果指标为治疗组与对照组在近视进展（D）和眼轴长度（AL）增长（mm）方面的均值差（MD）。 结果：以下干预措施被证实有效（p<0.001）：高非球面镜片（HAL，0.80 D，95%置信区间0.77–0.83；-0.35毫米，95%置信区间-0.36至-0.34），MiSight隐形眼镜（0.66 D， 95% CI, 0.63–0.69; −0.28毫米, 95% CI −0.29至−0.27), 低剂量阿托品0.05%（0.54 D, 95% CI, 0.38–0.70; −0.21毫米, 95% CI-0.28至−0.14), Biofinity +2.50 D (0.45 D, 95% CI, 0.29, 0.61; −0.24毫米, 95% CI −0.33 至 −0.15)，带散光的多段式镜片[DIMS]（0.44 D，95% CI，0.42–0.46； −0.34毫米，95%置信区间−0.35至−0.33）及角膜塑形镜（−0.24毫米，95%置信区间−0.33至−0.15）。 结论：在两项研究中，0.01% 低浓度阿托品在减缓眼轴长度（AL）进展方面无效。0.05% 低浓度阿托品的治疗效果良好。框架眼镜（HAL 和 DIMS）与隐形眼镜（MiSight 和 Biofinity）在减缓近视进展方面的治疗获益可能与阿托品相当。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study aims to investigate the effectiveness of interventions to control myopia progression. In this systematic review, the primary outcomes were mean differences (MD) between treatment and control groups in myopia progression (D) and axial length (AL) elongation (mm). RESULTS: The following interventions were found to be effective (p < 0.001): highly aspherical lenslets (HAL, 0.80 D, 95% CI, 0.77-0.83; -0.35 mm, 95% CI -0.36 to -0.34), MiSight contact lenses (0.66 D, 95% CI, 0.63-0.69; -0.28 mm, 95% CI -0.29 to -0.27), low dose atropine 0.05% (0.54 D, 95% CI, 0.38-0.70; -0.21 mm, 95% CI-0.28 to -0.14), Biofinity +2.50 D (0.45 D, 95% CI, 0.29, 0.61; -0.24 mm, 95% CI -0.33 to -0.15), defocus incorporated multiple segments [DIMS] (0.44 D, 95% CI, 0.42-0.46; -0.34 mm, 95% CI -0.35 to -0.33) and ortho-k lenses (-0.24 mm, 95% CI -0.33 to -01.5). CONCLUSION: Low-dose atropine 0.01% was not effective in reducing AL progression in two studies. Treatment efficacy with low-dose atropine of 0.05% showed good efficacy. Spectacles (HAL and DIMS) and contact lenses (MiSight and Biofinity) may confer a comparable treatment benefit compared to atropine, to slow myopia progression.

框架眼镜控制近视效果的Meta分析：基于随机对照试验的证据

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2025年👥 D'Andrea Luca, Rinaldi Michele, Piscopo Raffaele, Iorio Fabiana, La Padula Simone, Maqsood Sundas, Elalfy Mohamed, Melenzane Antonietta, Confalonieri Filippo, Ozkan Ozlem, Utine Canan Asli, Costagliola Ciro

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-1 meta / 6-1-2
原文摘要
摘要 目的：通过综合随机对照试验（RCTs）数据，明确先进框架眼镜技术在延缓儿童和青少年近视进展中对等效球镜度数（SER）变化和眼轴长度（AL）增长的影响。 方法：开展系统综述与荟萃分析，检索截至 2025 年 2 月 27 日所有对比近视控制镜片干预组与标准单光镜片（SVLs）对照组的随机对照试验（RCTs）。将符合纳入标准的研究数据提取至专门设计的数据收集表中，且不改变原始数据。计算连续型结局指标的均数和标准差（SD），并导入 RevMan 软件进行分析。 结果：本荟萃分析共纳入 23 项随机对照试验（RCTs），涉及 13,315 名受试者。与单光镜片（SVLs）相比，近视控制镜片可显著减少眼轴长度（AL）增长（-0.15mm；95% 置信区间 - 0.20 至 - 0.09；p<0.00001）和等效球镜度数（SER）进展（-0.31 屈光度；95% 置信区间 - 0.42 至 - 0.20；p<0.00001）。高非球面微透镜（HAL）可显著减少眼轴长度增长（-0.28mm；95% 置信区间 - 0.37 至 - 0.19）和等效球镜度数进展（-0.52 屈光度；95% 置信区间 - 0.84 至 - 0.20）。离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS）也可显著减少等效球镜度数进展（-0.45 屈光度；95% 置信区间 - 0.65 至 - 0.26），但仅有 1 项符合纳入标准的随机对照试验报告了眼轴长度（AL）数据。其他类型镜片的效果则较温和或存在差异。 结论：本荟萃分析仅基于随机对照试验（RCTs），为近视控制用框架眼镜设计提供了最新且详细的对比评估。研究结果支持将专用镜片作为一种有效的无创策略，以降低高度近视相关风险，并为临床实践中优化镜片选择提供指导。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To determine the effects of advanced spectacle lens technologies on changes in spherical equivalent of refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) elongation in slowing down the progression of myopia in children and adolescents, by synthesising data from randomised controlled trials (RCTs). METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted to identify all RCTs up to 27 February 2025 that compared intervention groups with myopia control lenses and control groups with standard single vision lenses (SVLs). Data from eligible studies were extracted into specially-designed data collection forms without changing the original values. Means and SD for continuous outcomes were determined and imported into RevMan. RESULTS: This meta-analysis included 23 RCTs with a total of 13.315 subjects. Compared with SVLs, myopia control lenses significantly reduced AL (-0.15 mm; 95% CI -0.20 to -0.09; p<0.00001) and SER progression (-0.31 D; 95% CI -0.42 to -0.20; p<0.00001). Highly Aspherical Lenslet lenses significantly reduced AL (-0.28 mm; 95% CI -0.37 to -0.19) and SER progression (-0.52 D; 95% CI -0.84 to -0.20). Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments lenses also significantly reduced SER (-0.45 D; 95% CI -0.65 to -0.26), although only one eligible RCT reported AL data. Other lens types had modest or variable effects. CONCLUSIONS: This meta-analysis provides an up-to-date and detailed comparative evaluation of spectacle lens designs for myopia control, based exclusively on RCTs. These findings support the use of specialty lenses as an effective, non-invasive strategy to reduce the risks associated with high-myopia and guide optimal lens selection in clinical practice. PROSPERO REGISTRATION NUMBER: CRD420251009898.

Efficacy of interventions for myopia control in children: A systematic review with network meta-analyses

儿童近视控制干预措施疗效—meta

📖 Acta ophthalmologica📅 2025年👥 Schmidt Diana Chabané, Hvid-Hansen Anders, Jacobsen Nina, Jakobsen Trine Møldrup, Larsen Per Michael, Lindblad Kjersti Kristin, Møller Flemming, Slyngborg Annette, Subhi Yousif, Kessel Line
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-1-3 儿童近视控制干预措施疗效—meta 样本量： 12154人 设计品类：阿托品，角膜塑形镜，框架眼镜，软性接触镜，联合治疗，其他干预措施
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-1 meta / 6-1-3
原文摘要
摘要 本研究旨在明确各类干预措施延缓儿童近视进展的有效性。于 2023 年 12 月 2 日检索以下文献数据库：PubMed、Embase、Cochrane 中心数据库、Web of Science 核心合集、BIOSIS Previews、Current Contents Connect、数据引用索引（Data Citation Index）、Derwent Innovations Index、KCI - 韩国期刊数据库、预印本引用索引（Preprint Citation Index）、ProQuest™学位论文引用索引及 SciELO 引用索引。研究遵循 PRISMA 声明（系统综述与 meta 分析优先报告条目）及《Cochrane 手册》推荐规范。为得出具有临床应用价值的结果，对每一项独特的干预措施均进行单独分析。主要结局指标为眼轴长度进展；次要结局指标包括新发角膜浸润、畏光、干预相关过敏反应发生情况、近距及远距视力，以及退出指定干预 / 对照组的情况。 本研究共纳入 74 项随机对照试验（RCT），涉及 12154 名 6-18 岁受试者。通过网络 meta 分析，比较了 45 种干预措施与安慰剂或单光眼镜在干预 1 年后的眼轴长度差异。以加权均数差（WMD）及 95% 置信区间（95% CI）表示，最有效的干预措施依次为：低强度红光（−0.33 mm，95% CI：−0.40~−0.25）、治疗区直径为 5mm 的角膜塑形镜（OK 镜）（−0.32 mm，95% CI：−0.41~−0.24）、非球面基弧 OK 镜（−0.29 mm，95% CI：−0.37~−0.22）、1.0% 阿托品（−0.28 mm，95% CI：−0.30~−0.26）、0.01% 阿托品联合 OK 镜（−0.24 mm，95% CI：−0.37~−0.11）、高非球面微透镜眼镜（−0.23 mm，95% CI：−0.26~−0.19）、高压缩系数 OK 镜（−0.23 mm，95% CI：−0.28~−0.17）、0.05% 阿托品（−0.21 mm，95% CI：−0.30~−0.13）及多焦点离焦框架镜（−0.21 mm，95% CI：−0.27~−0.15）。 阿托品干预组报告有畏光及近距视力下降情况，且 1.0% 阿托品组的治疗依从性较低。未发现任何干预措施与角膜浸润或过敏反应存在显著关联。超 70% 的研究在亚洲人群中开展。 本系统综述与网络 meta 分析证实，多种干预措施（包括 OK 镜、阿托品、高非球面微透镜眼镜及多焦点离焦框架镜）可有效延缓儿童眼轴伸长；低强度红光疗法同样能减缓眼轴长度进展，但需进一步研究评估其潜在副作用。未来研究应纳入多样化人群并采用标准化方法，以提高研究结果的适用性与可比性。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
To determine the effectiveness of various interventions in reducing myopia progression in children. Literature databases were searched on December 2, 2023: PubMed, Embase, the Cochrane Central, Web of Science Core Collection, BIOSIS Previews, Current Contents Connect, Data Citation Index, Derwent Innovations Index, KCI-Korean Journal Database, Preprint Citation Index, ProQuest™ Dissertations and Theses Citation Index and SciELO Citation Index. PRISMA guidelines and the Cochrane Handbook recommendations were followed. All unique interventions were analyzed individually in order to generate clinically applicable results. The main outcome was axial length progression. Secondary outcomes were incident corneal infiltrates, photophobia, development of an allergic response towards the intervention, visual acuity at near and distance and drop-out from allocated intervention/control. We identified 74 RCTs involving 12 154 participants aged 6-18 years. Network meta-analysis compared axial length after 1 year between 45 interventions and placebo or single-vision spectacles. The most effective interventions reported in weighted mean difference and 95% confidence interval were low-level red-light (-0.33 mm (-0.40, -0.25)), ortho-K with 5 mm treatment zone (-0.32 mm (-0.41, -0.24)), ortho-K with aspheric base curve (-0.29 mm (-0.37, -0.22)), atropine 1.0% (-0.28 mm (-0.30, -0.26)), combined atropine 0.01% and ortho-K (-0.24 mm (-0.37, -0.11)), spectacles with highly aspherical lenslets (-0.23 mm (-0.26, -0.19)), ortho-K with increased compression factor (-0.23 mm (-0.28, -0.17), atropine 0.05% (-0.21 mm (-0.30, -0.13)) and defocus incorporated multiple segments spectacles (-0.21 mm (-0.27, -0.15)). Photophobia and reduced near-visual acuity were reported for atropine, and lower adherence to treatment was found for atropine at 1.0%. There was no significant association between any interventions and corneal infiltrates or allergic reactions. Over 70% of the studies were conducted in Asian populations. This systematic review and network meta-analysis highlights the efficacy of various interventions, including orthokeratology lenses, atropine, highly aspherical lenslets and defocus incorporated multiple segments spectacles in slowing axial elongation in children. Low-level red-light therapy also slowed axial length progression, but further research is needed to assess the potential side effects. Future studies should include diverse populations and standardized methodologies to enhance the applicability and comparability of results.

Which is better for myopia control in children: orthokeratology or DIMS spectacle lenses? A meta-analysis

DIMS vs OK-meta

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2026年👥 Song Desheng, Chen Xiaoxue, Hong Fan, Zhou Qing, Yao Jiaqi
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-1-4 DIMS vs OK-meta 研究中心：南京医科大学儿童医院眼科 样本量：1480 只眼（OK 812 只；DIMS668 只） 结论：角膜塑形镜（Ortho-K）在控制眼轴（AL）方面的效果优于 DIMS，且这一优势在东亚人群、大样本研究（>150 例）以及 10 岁以下儿童中尤为明显。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-1 meta / 6-1-4
原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在系统评价多点离焦（DIMS）眼镜片与角膜塑形术（Ortho-K）在近视控制中的效果。 方法：检索 PubMed、Medline、Embase、Ovid、中国知网（CNKI）、中国生物医学文献数据库（CBM）和 Cochrane 图书馆截至 2025 年 8 月的相关临床研究，涉及多点离焦（DIMS）眼镜片与角膜塑形术（Ortho-K）。由两名研究者独立进行文献筛选、数据提取和偏倚风险评估后，采用 RevMan 5.3 软件进行统计分析。 结果：本研究共纳入 9 项研究，所有研究均提供了 1 年时的眼轴长度（AL）变化数据，3 项研究报告了等效球镜度数（SER）变化数据。合并结果显示，角膜塑形术（Ortho-K）组的眼轴长度年增长值低于多点离焦（DIMS）眼镜片组（平均差（MD）=-0.07，95% 置信区间（CI）（-0.11，-0.03），P<0.001）；两组的等效球镜度数变化无统计学差异（MD=0.05，95% CI（-0.11，0.22），P=0.52）。亚组分析表明，种族、样本量和年龄会影响角膜塑形术（Ortho-K）与多点离焦（DIMS）眼镜片的疗效对比结果（均 P<0.05）。 结论：与多点离焦（DIMS）眼镜片相比，角膜塑形术（Ortho-K）在控制眼轴增长方面疗效更优。但在选择这两种近视控制干预措施时，应考虑种族和年龄因素。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
OBJECTIVE: This study aims to systematically evaluate the effectiveness of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses compared with orthokeratology (Ortho-K) in controlling myopia. METHODS: Clinical studies related to DIMS and Ortho-K were searched for using PubMed, Medline, Embase, Ovid, CNKI, CBM, and Cochrane Library data up to August 2025. Following independent literature screening, data extraction, and risk of bias assessment by two researchers, analysis was conducted using RevMan 5.3 software. RESULTS: A total of nine studies were included in this analysis, all of which provided axial length (AL) changes at 1 year, while three studies reported spherical equivalent refraction (SER) changes. Pooled results indicated that the yearly increase of AL in the Ortho-K group was lower than that in the DIMS group (MD=-0.07, 95%CI (-0.11, -0.03), P < 0.001), with no statistically significant difference in SER changes between the two groups (MD = 0.05, 95%CI (-0.11, 0.22), P = 0.52). Subgroup analysis indicated that the comparative outcomes between Ortho-K and DIMS were influenced by ethnicity, sample size, and age (all P < 0.05). CONCLUSION: Ortho-K demonstrates superior efficacy in controlling axial elongation compared to DIMS. However, ethnic and age factors should be considered when selecting between these two myopia control interventions.
补充中文要点 (AI解析参考)
比较结论：OK在控制眼轴延长上优于DIMS，但需考虑种族与年龄因素。

内容摘要（根据本地文件整理）
摘要 目的：通过汇总随机对照试验（RCT）数据，明确先进框架眼镜技术对儿童和青少年等效球镜度（SER）改变及眼轴长度（AL）延长的控制作用。 方法：进行系统评价与 Meta 分析，检索截至 2025 年 2 月 27 日对比近视控制镜片干预组与标准单光眼镜（SVL）对照组的所有 RCT。提取各符合标准研究的连续性结局指标均值与标准差，并导入 RevMan 软件进行分析。 结果：Meta 分析共纳入 23 项 RCT，涉及 13,315 名受试者。与 SVL 相比，近视控制镜片显著减缓了 AL 延长（-0.15 mm；95% CI -0.20 至 -0.09；P<0.00001）和 SER 进展（-0.31 D；95% CI -0.42 至 -0.20；P<0.00001）。高非球面微透镜（HAL）镜片显著减少 AL 延长（-0.28 mm；95% CI -0.37 至 -0.19）和 SER 进展（-0.52 D；95% CI -0.84 至 -0.20）；多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）镜片亦显著减少 SER 进展（-0.45 D；95% CI -0.65 至 -0.26），但仅有 1 项入选 RCT 报告了 AL 数据；其余镜片类型效果较温和或存在差异。 结论：本 Meta 分析仅基于 RCT 提供了近视控制镜片设计的最新且详细的对比评估，支持将特殊设计镜片作为减少高度近视风险的有效非侵入性策略，并指导临床实践中的最佳镜片选择。

Purpose To determine the effects of advanced spectacle lens technologies on changes in spherical equivalent of refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) elongation in slowing down the progression of myopia in children and adolescents, by synthesising data from randomised controlled trials (RCTs). Methods A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted to identify all RCTs up to 27 February 2025 that compared intervention groups with myopia control lenses and control groups with standard single vision lenses (SVLs). Data from eligible studies were extracted into specially-designed data collection forms without changing the original values. Means and SD for continuous outcomes were determined and imported into RevMan. Results This meta-analysis included 23 RCTs with a total of 13.315 subjects. Compared with SVLs, myopia control lenses significantly reduced AL (−0.15 mm; 95% CI −0.20 to −0.09; p<0.00001) and SER progression (−0.31 D; 95% CI −0.42 to −0.20; p<0.00001). Highly Aspherical Lenslet lenses significantly reduced AL (−0.28 mm; 95% CI −0.37 to −0.19) and SER progression (−0.52 D; 95% CI −0.84 to −0.20). Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments lenses also significantly reduced SER (−0.45 D; 95% CI −0.65 to −0.26), although only one eligible RCT reported AL data. Other lens types had modest or variable effects. Conclusions This meta-analysis provides an up-to-date and detailed comparative evaluation of spectacle lens designs for myopia control, based exclusively on RCTs. These findings support the use of specialty lenses as an effective, non-invasive strategy to reduce the risks associated with high-myopia and guide optimal lens selection in clinical practice.

Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) Spectacle Lenses Versus Single-Vision Lenses for Pediatric Myopia: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis

DIMS vs SVL -meta analysis

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2026年👥 Al-Shammari Yousef Mesaed, Alkandari Saud Abdullah, Al-Shammari Reem Mesaed, Al-Mahdi Al-Kurdi Mohammed, Aljassar Faisal
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献 6-1-5 DIMS vs SVL -meta analysis 样本量：1224 结论：1年的随访中，DIMS相比SVL减缓SER进展0.37D，减缓AL进展-0.16mm
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-1 meta / 6-1-5
原文摘要
摘要 摘要主题： 本系统综述与 Meta 分析旨在评估离焦型多区段（Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments, DIMS）眼镜片与单光眼镜片相比，在 12 个月内延缓儿童近视进展的效果。 临床意义： DIMS 眼镜片通过引入同时性近视离焦来减少儿童眼轴增长。尽管随机对照试验已证明其有效性，但针对其疗效的比较性证据仍然有限。评估 12 个月的结局对于指导循证近视管理和未来研究具有临床意义。 方法： 本研究依据 PRISMA 指南开展系统综述与 Meta 分析。检索了 PubMed、Scopus、Embase 和 Web of Science 数据库，截至 2025 年 11 月，纳入比较儿童佩戴 DIMS 眼镜与单光眼镜的研究。由两名研究者独立完成文献筛选、数据提取和质量评价。采用随机效应模型合并等效球镜屈光度（SER）进展和眼轴增长的加权均数差（MD）。采用 I² 评估异质性，并通过逐一排除法（leave-one-out）进行敏感性分析，以评估删除单个研究对结果的影响。纳入标准为：研究对象为近视儿童，且比较 DIMS 镜片与单光镜片。 结果： 共纳入 6 项研究，涉及 1224 名儿童，其中 80.1% 来自中国。纳入研究开展于亚洲和欧洲，受试儿童平均年龄约 10 岁。与单光眼镜相比，DIMS 镜片在前 12 个月内可显著减缓近视进展，表现为等效球镜恶化更少（MD = 0.37 D；P < 0.0001），眼轴增长更少（MD = -0.16 mm；P < 0.0001）。异质性为中度至高度，但敏感性分析证实所有合并结果均较为稳定。 结论： DIMS 镜片在儿童近视控制的第一年内能够持续减缓近视进展，减少眼轴增长，并改善屈光结局。这些结果表明，DIMS 镜片在前 12 个月内具有明确获益；然而，其疗效在第一年之后能否持续仍不确定，而且第一年后疗效变化速度很可能减弱。上述结论仅适用于 DIMS 镜片，不应推广至其他类型的离焦眼镜设计。另由于大多数研究对象来自中国，其结果的普遍适用性可能受到一定影响。 6-1-6摘要 本研究旨在比较儿童近视控制中不同光学干预措施〔眼镜、软性角膜接触镜（SCL）和角膜塑形镜（OK）〕的治疗效果，探讨治疗期间疗效是否具有一致性，并评估基线等效球镜度数（SER）、眼轴长度（AL）和年龄对治疗效果的影响。研究通过检索 EMBASE、PubMed 和 Google Scholar 数据库，纳入 2000 年 1 月至 2022 年 4 月期间发表的文献，共筛选出 220 篇文章，这些研究报告了干预组与对照组之间 SER 和 AL 变化差异所体现的治疗效果。最终共有 35 篇文章纳入分析。研究计算了治疗效应量（ES）：对于 SER，效应量越大且为正，表示疗效越好；对于 AL，效应量越小且为负，表示疗效越好。结果显示，在 SER 方面，外围加光设计眼镜和软性角膜接触镜的效应量分别为 0.66 和 0.53，均为较大的治疗效应，且两类干预之间差异无统计学意义（p=0.69）。在 AL 方面，外围加光设计眼镜、软性角膜接触镜和 OK 镜的效应量分别为 -0.37、-0.55 和 -0.93，均表现出较大疗效，其中 OK 镜的效果显著优于外围加光设计眼镜（p≤0.001）。在治疗时间维度上，所有干预在治疗前 12 个月内 的效应均较大，而在 24–36 个月 时疗效有所下降。基线 SER 仅对外围加光设计眼镜的治疗效果有影响。总体而言，光学干预对控制儿童近视进展是有效的，但其治疗效果主要在前 12 个月最为显著，随后会随时间减弱。 6-1-7摘要 6-1摘要：研究背景 近视患病率不断上升，已成为全球公共卫生问题，不仅表现为未矫正屈光不正发生率增加，更重要的是，近视相关眼部并发症会提高视力损害风险。儿童期是近视进展最快的阶段，因此需要在这一时期采取干预措施以减缓近视进展。本研究是该动态系统综述的更新版本。 研究目的 采用网络Meta分析，评估儿童近视控制干预措施在减缓近视进展方面的相对有效性和安全性；对不同干预措施进行疗效排序；并通过简要经济学评论总结相关经济学评价结果。检索方法 研究者检索了 CENTRAL、MEDLINE、Embase 以及 3个临床试验注册平台，最新检索时间为 2024年2月19日。 纳入标准 纳入对象为 18岁及以下儿童近视控制相关随机对照试验（RCT），干预类型包括光学干预、药物干预、光疗以及行为干预。 结局指标 关键结局包括：干预组与对照组在 1年及以上随访中的等效球镜屈光度（SER，单位D）变化差异，以及眼轴长度（AL，单位mm）变化差异；同时关注停药后的屈光和眼轴反跳变化。 偏倚风险评估 研究采用 Cochrane RoB 2 工具对 SER 和 AL 结局的偏倚风险进行评估。 资料合成方法 研究遵循 Cochrane 标准方法，采用 GRADE 方法评价 1年和2年 SER 与 AL 变化证据的确定性，并使用 SUCRA（累积排序曲线下面积）对各干预措施进行疗效排序。 纳入研究 本次更新共纳入 104项研究（其中 40项为新增研究），共随机分配 17,509名 4–18岁儿童。多数研究来自中国及其他亚洲国家（66.3%）和北美（14.4%）。84项研究（80.8%）将近视控制干预与非活性对照进行比较。研究随访时间为 12–48个月。 结果综合 由于网络Meta分析中的大多数证据网络连接较差，除特别说明外，估计结果主要基于直接的两两比较。 在1年随访时，对照组 SER 中位变化为 −0.65 D。与对照相比，下列干预可能减缓 SER 进展：重复低强度红光（RLRL，MD 0.80 D，95%CI 0.71–0.89）、高浓度阿托品（≥0.5%，MD 0.90 D，95%CI 0.62–1.18）、中浓度阿托品（0.1%至<0.5%，MD 0.55 D，95%CI 0.17–0.93）、低浓度阿托品（<0.1%，MD 0.25 D，95%CI 0.16–0.35）、周边离焦/周边加光框架镜（PPSL，MD 0.45 D，95%CI 0.16–0.74）、多焦点软性接触镜（MFSCL，MD 0.27 D，95%CI 0.18–0.35）以及多焦点框架镜（MFSL，MD 0.14 D，95%CI 0.08–0.21）。 在1年随访时，对照组 AL 中位变化为 0.33 mm。与对照相比，下列干预可能减缓眼轴延长：RLRL（MD −0.33 mm，95%CI −0.37至−0.29）、高浓度阿托品（MD −0.33 mm，95%CI −0.35至−0.30）、中浓度阿托品（MD −0.24 mm，95%CI −0.34至−0.15）、低浓度阿托品（MD −0.10 mm，95%CI −0.13至−0.07）、角膜塑形镜（Ortho-K，MD −0.18 mm，95%CI −0.21至−0.14）、周边离焦/周边加光框架镜（MD −0.13 mm，95%CI −0.21至−0.05）、多焦点软性接触镜（MD −0.11 mm，95%CI −0.13至−0.09）以及多焦点框架镜（MD −0.06 mm，95%CI −0.09至−0.04）。此外，角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品较单用角膜塑形镜可能进一步减少眼轴延长（MD −0.12 mm，95%CI −0.15至−0.09）。 在2年随访时，SER 和 AL 的干预排序与 1年结果大体相似，但目前数据仍不足以判断累积效应。SER 排名较高的干预为高浓度阿托品、中浓度阿托品和周边离焦/周边加光框架镜；AL 排名较高的干预为角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品、高浓度阿托品和中浓度阿托品。关于停药后是否出现超出年龄预期进展速度的反跳，证据有限。不良事件和治疗依从性报告不一致。仅有两项研究报告生活质量，结果显示干预组与对照组差异很小或无差异。对于不同近视控制策略的相对成本或成本效益，目前尚无法得出明确结论。 作者结论 大多数研究将药物和光学治疗与非活性对照进行比较。这些干预可能减缓屈光变化并减少眼轴延长，但结果常存在异质性。关于 2年以上随访的数据较少，因此这些干预措施是否具有持续效果仍存在不确定性。未来需要开展更长期、质量更高的研究，比较单一或联合近视控制干预，并改进不良反应的监测与报告。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
TOPIC: This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the 12-month effectiveness of defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses compared with single-vision (SV) lenses in slowing myopia progression in children. CLINICAL RELEVANCE: DIMS spectacle lenses incorporate simultaneous myopic defocus to reduce axial elongation in children. Although randomized trials have demonstrated efficacy, comparative evidence remains limited. Evaluation of 12-month outcomes is clinically relevant to inform evidence-based myopia management and future research. METHODS: A systematic review and meta-analysis were conducted following PRISMA guidelines. PubMed, Scopus, Embase, and Web of Science were searched to November 2025 for studies comparing DIMS vs SV lenses in children. Two reviewers independently screened studies, extracted data, and assessed quality. Random-effects models generated pooled mean differences (MD) for spherical equivalent refractive (SER) progression and axial elongation. We used I2 to assess heterogeneity. Sensitivity analysis was conducted using the leave-one-out method to assess the effect of removing each study. Studies were included if they enrolled children with myopia and compared DIMS lenses with SV lenses. RESULTS: Six studies involving 1224 children were included, and 80.1% of them were from China. The included studies were conducted in Asia and Europe and included pediatric participants with a mean aged around 10 years. Compared with SV lenses, DIMS lenses significantly slowed myopia progression over the first 12 months, showing less SER deterioration (MD = 0.37 D; P < .0001) and reduced axial elongation (MD = -0.16 mm; P < .0001). Heterogeneity ranged from moderate to high, but sensitivity analyses confirmed the stability of all pooled estimates. CONCLUSION: DIMS lenses provide consistent slowing of myopia progression, reduce axial growth, and improve refractive outcomes during the first year in children. These findings demonstrate a benefit during the first 12 months; however, the durability of this effect beyond the first year remains uncertain, and the rate of change after year one is likely less. These findings apply specifically to DIMS lenses and should not be generalized to other defocus spectacle lens designs. Most children were from China, which may affect the generalization of these results.

排名较高的干预为高浓度阿托品、中浓度阿托品和周边离焦/周边加光框架镜；AL 排名较高的干预为角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品、高浓度阿托品和中浓度阿托品。关于停药后是否出现超出年龄预期进展速度的反跳，证据有限。不良事件和治疗依从性报告不一致。仅有两项研究报告生活质量，结果显示干预组与对照组差异很小或无差异。对于不同近视控制策略的相对成本或成本效益，目前尚无法得出明确结论。 作者结论 大多数研究将药物和光学治疗与非活性对照进行比较。这些干预可能减缓屈光变化并减少眼轴延长，但结果常存在异质性。关于 2年以上随访的数据较少，因此这些干预措施是否具有持续效果仍存在不确定性。未来需要开展更长期、质量更高的研究，比较单一或联合近视控制干预，并改进不良反应的监测与报告。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
To compare the treatment efficacy of childhood myopia control optical interventions [spectacles, soft contact lenses (SCLs) and orthokeratology (OK) lenses], explore the consistency of treatment efficacies during the treatment period and evaluate the impact of baseline spherical equivalent refraction (SER), axial length (AL) and age on the treatment effect. A literature search of EMBASE, PubMed and Google Scholar databases identified 220 articles published between January 2000 and April 2022, which reported the treatment efficacy by differences in the SER and AL change between intervention and control groups. Thirty-five articles were included in the analysis. Treatment effect sizes (ESs) were calculated, where more positive and negative directions indicated greater treatment efficacy for SER and AL respectively. For SER, the ESs with peripheral add design spectacles (0.66) and SCLs (0.53) were large but not significantly different between treatment types (p = 0.69). For AL, ESs with peripheral add design spectacles (-0.37), SCLs (-0.55) and OK lenses (-0.93) were large, but OK lenses had a significantly greater effect than peripheral add design spectacles (p ≤ 0.001). ESs were large during the first 12 months of treatment for all interventions [peripheral add design SCLs and OK (F ≥ 5.39, p ≤ 0.01), peripheral add design spectacles (F = 0.47, p = 0.63)] but reduced towards the end of 24-36 months of treatment. Baseline SER had an impact on the treatment effect with peripheral add design spectacles only. Optical interventions are efficacious in controlling childhood myopia progression. However, treatment effects were largest only during the first 12 months of treatment and reduced over time.

原文摘要
摘要 6-1摘要：研究背景 近视患病率不断上升，已成为全球公共卫生问题，不仅表现为未矫正屈光不正发生率增加，更重要的是，近视相关眼部并发症会提高视力损害风险。儿童期是近视进展最快的阶段，因此需要在这一时期采取干预措施以减缓近视进展。本研究是该动态系统综述的更新版本。 研究目的 采用网络Meta分析，评估儿童近视控制干预措施在减缓近视进展方面的相对有效性和安全性；对不同干预措施进行疗效排序；并通过简要经济学评论总结相关经济学评价结果。检索方法 研究者检索了 CENTRAL、MEDLINE、Embase 以及 3个临床试验注册平台，最新检索时间为 2024年2月19日。 纳入标准 纳入对象为 18岁及以下儿童近视控制相关随机对照试验（RCT），干预类型包括光学干预、药物干预、光疗以及行为干预。 结局指标 关键结局包括：干预组与对照组在 1年及以上随访中的等效球镜屈光度（SER，单位D）变化差异，以及眼轴长度（AL，单位mm）变化差异；同时关注停药后的屈光和眼轴反跳变化。 偏倚风险评估 研究采用 Cochrane RoB 2 工具对 SER 和 AL 结局的偏倚风险进行评估。 资料合成方法 研究遵循 Cochrane 标准方法，采用 GRADE 方法评价 1年和2年 SER 与 AL 变化证据的确定性，并使用 SUCRA（累积排序曲线下面积）对各干预措施进行疗效排序。 纳入研究 本次更新共纳入 104项研究（其中 40项为新增研究），共随机分配 17,509名 4–18岁儿童。多数研究来自中国及其他亚洲国家（66.3%）和北美（14.4%）。84项研究（80.8%）将近视控制干预与非活性对照进行比较。研究随访时间为 12–48个月。 结果综合 由于网络Meta分析中的大多数证据网络连接较差，除特别说明外，估计结果主要基于直接的两两比较。 在1年随访时，对照组 SER 中位变化为 −0.65 D。与对照相比，下列干预可能减缓 SER 进展：重复低强度红光（RLRL，MD 0.80 D，95%CI 0.71–0.89）、高浓度阿托品（≥0.5%，MD 0.90 D，95%CI 0.62–1.18）、中浓度阿托品（0.1%至<0.5%，MD 0.55 D，95%CI 0.17–0.93）、低浓度阿托品（<0.1%，MD 0.25 D，95%CI 0.16–0.35）、周边离焦/周边加光框架镜（PPSL，MD 0.45 D，95%CI 0.16–0.74）、多焦点软性接触镜（MFSCL，MD 0.27 D，95%CI 0.18–0.35）以及多焦点框架镜（MFSL，MD 0.14 D，95%CI 0.08–0.21）。 在1年随访时，对照组 AL 中位变化为 0.33 mm。与对照相比，下列干预可能减缓眼轴延长：RLRL（MD −0.33 mm，95%CI −0.37至−0.29）、高浓度阿托品（MD −0.33 mm，95%CI −0.35至−0.30）、中浓度阿托品（MD −0.24 mm，95%CI −0.34至−0.15）、低浓度阿托品（MD −0.10 mm，95%CI −0.13至−0.07）、角膜塑形镜（Ortho-K，MD −0.18 mm，95%CI −0.21至−0.14）、周边离焦/周边加光框架镜（MD −0.13 mm，95%CI −0.21至−0.05）、多焦点软性接触镜（MD −0.11 mm，95%CI −0.13至−0.09）以及多焦点框架镜（MD −0.06 mm，95%CI −0.09至−0.04）。此外，角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品较单用角膜塑形镜可能进一步减少眼轴延长（MD −0.12 mm，95%CI −0.15至−0.09）。 在2年随访时，SER 和 AL 的干预排序与 1年结果大体相似，但目前数据仍不足以判断累积效应。SER 排名较高的干预为高浓度阿托品、中浓度阿托品和周边离焦/周边加光框架镜；AL 排名较高的干预为角膜塑形镜联合低浓度阿托品、高浓度阿托品和中浓度阿托品。关于停药后是否出现超出年龄预期进展速度的反跳，证据有限。不良事件和治疗依从性报告不一致。仅有两项研究报告生活质量，结果显示干预组与对照组差异很小或无差异。对于不同近视控制策略的相对成本或成本效益，目前尚无法得出明确结论。 作者结论 大多数研究将药物和光学治疗与非活性对照进行比较。这些干预可能减缓屈光变化并减少眼轴延长，但结果常存在异质性。关于 2年以上随访的数据较少，因此这些干预措施是否具有持续效果仍存在不确定性。未来需要开展更长期、质量更高的研究，比较单一或联合近视控制干预，并改进不良反应的监测与报告。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
RATIONALE: The increasing prevalence of myopia is a growing global public health problem, in terms of rates of uncorrected refractive error and significantly, an increased risk of visual impairment due to myopia-related ocular morbidity. Interventions to slow its progression are needed in childhood, when myopia progression is most rapid. This is a review update, conducted as part of a living systematic review. OBJECTIVES: To assess the comparative efficacy and safety of interventions for slowing myopia progression in children using network meta-analysis (NMA). To generate a relative ranking of interventions according to their efficacy. To produce a brief economic commentary, summarising economic evaluations. SEARCH METHODS: We searched CENTRAL, MEDLINE, Embase, and three trial registers. The latest search date was 19 February 2024. ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: We included randomised controlled trials (RCTs) of optical, pharmacological, light therapy and behavioural interventions for slowing myopia progression in children, up to 18 years old. OUTCOMES: Critical outcomes were progression of myopia (mean difference (MD) in the change in spherical equivalent refraction (SER, dioptres (D)), and axial length (AL, mm) in the intervention and control groups at one year or longer), and difference in the change in SER and AL following cessation of treatment (rebound). RISK OF BIAS: We assessed the risk of bias (RoB) for SER and AL using the Cochrane RoB 2 tool. SYNTHESIS METHODS: We followed standard Cochrane methods. We rated the certainty of evidence using the GRADE approach for change in SER and AL at one and two years. We used the surface under the cumulative ranking curve (SUCRA) to rank the interventions for all available outcomes. INCLUDED STUDIES: We included 104 studies (40 new for this update) that randomised 17,509 children, aged 4 years to 18 years. Most studies were conducted in China or other Asian countries (66.3%), and North America (14.4%). Eighty-four studies (80.8%) compared myopia control interventions against inactive controls. Study durations ranged from 12 months to 48 months. SYNTHESIS OF RESULTS: Since most of the networks in the NMA were poorly connected, our estimates are based on direct (pairwise) comparisons, unless stated otherwise. The median change in SER for controls was -0.65 D (55 studies, 4888 participants; one-year follow-up). These interventions may reduce SER progression compared to controls: repeated low intensity red light (RLRL: MD 0.80 D, 95% confidence interval (CI) 0.71 to 0.89; SUCRA = 93.8%; very low-certainty evidence); high-dose atropine (HDA (≥ 0.5%): MD 0.90 D, 95% CI 0.62 to 1.18; SUCRA = 93.3%; moderate-certainty evidence); medium-dose atropine (MDA (0.1% to < 0.5%): MD 0.55 D, 95% CI 0.17 to 0.93; NMA estimate SUCRA = 75.5%; low-certainty evidence); low dose atropine (LDA (< 0.1%): MD 0.25 D, 95% CI 0.16 to 0.35; SUCRA = 53.2%; very low-certainty evidence); peripheral plus spectacle lenses (PPSL: MD 0.45 D, 95% CI 0.16 to 0.74; SUCRA = 50.2%; very low-certainty evidence); multifocal soft contact lenses (MFSCL: MD 0.27 D, 95% CI 0.18 to 0.35; SUCRA = 49.9%; very low-certainty evidence); and multifocal spectacle lenses (MFSL: MD 0.14 D, 95% CI 0.08 to 0.21; SUCRA = 30.8%; low-certainty evidence). The median change in AL for controls was 0.33 mm (58 studies, 9085 participants; one-year follow-up). These interventions may reduce axial elongation compared to controls: RLRL (MD -0.33 mm, 95% CI -0.37 to -0.29; SUCRA = 98.6%; very low-certainty evidence); HDA (MD -0.33 mm, 95% CI -0.35 to -0.30; SUCRA = 88.4%; moderate-certainty evidence); MDA (MD -0.24 mm, 95% CI -0.34 to -0.15; NMA estimate SUCRA = 75.8%; low-certainty evidence); LDA (MD -0.10 mm, 95% CI -0.13 to -0.07; SUCRA = 36.1%; very low-certainty evidence); orthokeratology (ortho-K: MD -0.18 mm, 95% CI -0.21 to -0.14; SUCRA = 79%; moderate-certainty evidence); PPSL (MD -0.13 mm, 95% CI -0.21 to -0.05; SUCRA = 52.6%; very low-certainty evidence); MFSCL (MD -0.11 mm, 95% CI -0.13 to -0.09; SUCRA = 45.6%; low-certainty evidence); and MFSL (MD -0.06 mm, 95% CI -0.09 to -0.04; SUCRA = 26.3%; low-certainty evidence). Ortho-K plus LDA probably reduces axial elongation more than ortho-K monotherapy (MD -0.12 mm, 95% CI -0.15 to -0.09; SUCRA = 81.8%; moderate-certainty evidence). At two-year follow-up, change in SER was reported in 34 studies (3556 participants). The median change in SER for controls was -1.01 D. The ranking of interventions to reduce SER progression was close to that observed at one year; there were insufficient data to draw conclusions on cumulative effects. The highest-ranking interventions were: HAD (SUCRA = 97%); MDA (NMA estimate SUCRA = 69.8%); and PPSL (SUCRA = 69.1%). At two-year follow-up, change in AL was reported in 33 studies (3334 participants). The median change in AL for controls was 0.56 mm. The ranking of interventions to reduce axial elongation was similar to that observed at one year; there were insufficient data to draw conclusions on cumulative effects. The highest-ranking interventions were: ortho-K plus LDA (SUCRA = 94.2%); HAD (SUCRA = 96.8%); and MDA (NMA estimate SUCRA = 88.4%). There was limited evidence on whether cessation of myopia control therapy increases progression beyond the expected rate of progression with age. Adverse events and treatment adherence were not consistently reported. Two studies reported quality of life, showing little to no difference between intervention and control groups. We were unable to draw firm conclusions regarding the relative costs or efficiency of different myopia control strategies in children. AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: Most studies compared pharmacological and optical treatments to slow the progression of myopia with an inactive comparator. These interventions may slow refractive change and reduce axial elongation, although results were often heterogeneous. Less evidence is available for two years and beyond; uncertainty remains about the sustained effect of these interventions. Longer term and better quality studies comparing myopia control interventions alone or in combination are needed, with improved methods for monitoring and reporting adverse effects. FUNDING: Cochrane Eyes and Vision US Project is supported by grant UG1EY020522, National Eye Institute, National Institutes of Health. REGISTRATION: The previous version of this living systematic review is available at doi: 10.1002/14651858.CD014758.pub2.

Myopia control strategies: A systematic review and meta-meta-analysis

meta-meta-analysis-阿托品vsOK镜vs软镜vsRLRLvs多焦点框架镜

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2024年👥 Zaabaar Ebenezer, Asiamah Randy, Kyei Samuel, Ankamah Samuel
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-1-8：meta-meta-analysis-阿托品vsOK镜vs软镜vsRLRLvs多焦点框架镜 起始时间：截至 2024年2月，按1年随访 研究内容：儿童近视控制，比较光学干预（框架镜-包含HALT，软性角膜接触镜，角膜塑形镜）、不同浓度阿托品、低强度红光的有效性 样本量：38篇综述，97,359 名个体 SE：高（≥0.5%）/中/低（0.05%；0.025%；0.01%）阿托品= 0.67 D/0.48D/0.33D；RLRL=0.55D；周边离焦软镜=0.30D；周边离焦框架=0.77D；多焦点框架=0.21D；户外活动=0.17D；OK镜+低浓度阿托品=0.24D； AL：高（≥0.5%）/中/低（0.05%；0.025%；0.01%）阿托品=-0.24mm /-0.23mm/-0.14mm；RLRL=-0.25mm；周边离焦软镜=-0.35mm；周边离焦框架=-0.43mm；户外活动=-0.04mm；OK镜+低浓度阿托品=-0.30mm；OK镜=-0.47mm
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-1 meta / 6-1-8
原文摘要
6-1-6摘要： 目的： 总结已发表 Meta 分析中各种近视控制干预措施的合并疗效估计。 方法： 研究者检索了 PubMed、Scopus 和 Web of Science 数据库，自建库起至 2024 年 2 月，纳入报告各种近视控制策略治疗效果的系统综述和 Meta 分析。采用 16 项的 AMSTAR 2 工具评估纳入 Meta 分析的方法学质量。若某种干预使**等效球镜（SER）每年变化达到 ≥0.50 D，或使眼轴长度（AL）**每年变化达到 ≤−0.18 mm，则定义为具有临床意义的疗效。 结果： 共纳入 38 项研究。SER 和 AL 的总体变化均值差（MD，95% CI）分别为： 高浓度（≥0.5%）阿托品：0.67 D（0.58–0.77） 和 −0.24 mm（−0.36 至 −0.11）； 中浓度（>0.05% 至 <0.5%）阿托品：0.48 D（0.34–0.62） 和 −0.23 mm（−0.27 至 −0.19）； 低浓度（0.01%、0.025%、0.05%）阿托品：0.33 D（0.23–0.43） 和 −0.14 mm（−0.19 至 −0.09）； 角膜塑形镜：−0.47 mm（−0.66 至 −0.28）； 周边加光软性接触镜：0.30 D（0.18–0.42） 和 −0.35 mm（−0.62 至 −0.08）； 周边加光框架眼镜：0.77 D（0.40–1.14） 和 −0.43 mm（−0.78 至 −0.08）； 多焦点框架眼镜：0.21 D（0.11–0.31）； 重复低强度红光治疗：0.55 D（0.46–0.65） 和 −0.25 mm（−0.29 至 −0.20）； 户外活动：0.17 D（0.16–0.18） 和 −0.04 mm（−0.06 至 −0.01）。 结论： 在减缓眼轴延长方面，高浓度和中浓度阿托品、角膜塑形镜、周边加光框架眼镜以及重复低强度红光显示出具有临床意义的效果；在减缓屈光度进展方面，高浓度和中浓度阿托品、周边加光框架眼镜以及重复低强度红光显示出具有临床意义的效果。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To summarise pooled estimates of the efficacies of various myopia control interventions, as drawn from published meta-analyses. METHOD: PubMed, SCOPUS and Web of Science were searched from inception to February 2024 for systematic reviews and meta-analyses reporting treatment effects of various myopia control strategies. The qualities of the included meta-analyses were assessed using the 16-item A MeaSurement Tool to Assess systematic Reviews (AMSTAR) 2. An intervention was defined as having a clinically significant effect if it resulted in a change in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) of ≥0.50 D/year or axial length (AL) change of ≤-0.18 mm/year. RESULTS: A total of 38 studies were identified. The overall respective changes in SER and AL, mean difference (95% CI) were high-concentration (≥0.5%) atropine 0.67 D (0.58-0.77) and -0.24 mm (-0.36 to -0.11); moderate-concentration (>0.05% to <0.5%) atropine 0.48 D (0.34-0.62) and -0.23 mm (-0.27 to -0.19); low-concentration (0.01%, 0.025%, 0.05%) atropine 0.33 D (0.23-0.43) and -0.14 mm (-0.19 to -0.09); orthokeratology -0.47 mm (-0.66 to -0.28); peripheral plus soft contact lenses 0.30 D (0.18-0.42) and -0.35 mm (-0.62 to -0.08); peripheral plus spectacles 0.77 D (0.40-1.14) and -0.43 mm (-0.78 to -0.08); multifocal spectacles 0.21 D (0.11-0.31); repeated low-level red light therapy 0.55 D (0.46-0.65) and -0.25 mm (-0.29 to -0.20); outdoor time 0.17 D (0.16-0.18) and -0.04 mm (-0.06 to -0.01). CONCLUSION: High and moderate concentrations of atropine, orthokeratology, peripheral plus spectacles and repeated low-level red light demonstrated clinically significant effects on slowing AL elongation, while high and moderate concentrations of atropine, peripheral plus spectacles and repeated low-level red light demonstrated clinically significant effects on slowing SER progression.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-1
原文摘要
摘要 目的：比较两种近视控制眼镜镜片设计 —— 多焦点离焦镜片（DIMS）与高非球面微透镜（HAL）在减缓欧洲儿童及青少年近视进展中的效果。此前直接比较这两种镜片设计的研究仅局限于中国受试者，且随访时间仅为 1 年。欧洲儿童及青少年的近视患病率估计为 22.60%。 方法：对近视进展的受试者（6-17 岁）开展回顾性队列研究。受试者佩戴 DIMS 镜片（豪雅 MiyoSmart）或 HAL 镜片（依视路 Stellest）眼镜，佩戴时间至少 2 年。在基线、1 年和 2 年时分别测量眼轴长度（AL）和睫状肌麻痹自动验光（球镜等效屈光度，SER）。 结果：DIMS组1年平均视力变化为-0.34D（±0.46标准差），HAL组为-0.30D（±0.30）；2年变化值分别为-0.50D（±0.64标准差）和-0.63D（±0.56）。DIMS组1年平均屈光度增加值为0.19毫米（±0.56），HAL组为0.15毫米（±0.47）；2年增加值分别为0.29毫米（±0.63）和0.32毫米（±0.72）。以1年和2年视力等效性为0.25D和0.50D为界限，以及以眼轴长度等效性为0.20毫米和0.30毫米为界限时，DIMS和HAL镜片均达到等效性标准，仅1年眼轴长度数据中，DIMS镜片的95%置信区间上限0.21毫米略超0.20毫米阈值。在1年和2年随访中，DIMS与HAL镜片在平均SER值或AL值上的差异均无临床或统计学意义（p≥0.05，Mann-Whitney U检验）。采用线性混合模型分析，镜片类型与时间的交互作用未显著影响1年或2年随访时的SER或AL（p>0.05）。38.4%的DIMS儿童/青少年在2年内未出现SER进展，而HAL组该比例为21.9%（p=0.047）。 结论：在欧洲人群中，随访 2 年发现，DIMS 与 HAL 镜片在减缓近视进展和眼轴长度（AL）增长方面的效果基本相当。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: A performance comparison of two myopia control spectacle lens designs, defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) and highly aspherical lenslets (HAL), at slowing myopia progression in a European child/adolescent population. Previous research directly comparing these designs has been limited to Chinese participants and 1-year follow-up. The prevalence of myopia in European child/adolescent has been estimated at 22.60%. METHODS: Retrospective cohort study of individuals (6-17 years) with myopia progression. Participants wore DIMS (Hoya MiyoSmart) or HAL (Essilor Stellest) spectacles for a minimum of 2 years. Axial length (AL) and cycloplegic autorefraction (spherical equivalent refraction (SER)) were measured at baseline and 1 and 2 years. RESULTS: Mean 1-year SER changes for DIMS were -0.34D (±0.46 SD) and HAL -0.30D (±0.30); 2-year changes for DIMS were -0.50D (±0.64 SD) and HAL -0.63D (±0.56). Mean 1-year AL increases for DIMS were 0.19 mm (±0.56) and HAL 0.15 mm (±0.47); 2-year increases for DIMS were 0.29 mm (±0.63) and HAL 0.32 mm (±0.72). For equivalence margins of 0.25D and 0.50D for SER at 1 and 2 years, respectively, and similarly 0.20 mm and 0.30 mm margins for AL, DIMS and HAL lenses were equivalent apart from AL at 1 year where the 0.21 mm 95% CI upper limit just exceeded 0.20 mm. At both 1 and 2 years, none of the differences in mean SERs or ALs between DIMS and HAL were clinically or statistically significant (p≥0.05 Mann-Whitney U test). Using linear mixed model analysis, the interaction between lens type and time did not significantly affect SER or AL at 1- or 2-year follow-up (p≥0.05). 38.4% of children/adolescents with DIMS had no SER progression at 2 years, compared with 21.9% with HAL (p=0.047). CONCLUSION: In a European population, DIMS and HAL lenses are essentially equivalent in their ability to reduce myopia progression and AL elongation over a 2-year follow-up period.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在评估角膜塑形术（Ortho-K）、离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS 镜片）、角膜塑形术联合阿托品（Ortho-K +ATP）以及 DIMS 镜片联合阿托品（DIMS +ATP）对儿童近视的控制效果。 方法：本回顾性研究纳入 167 例 6~14 岁近视儿童，其球镜等效屈光度（SER）为 - 0.75~-4.00 屈光度（D），分别接受角膜塑形术（OK 组，41 例）、角膜塑形术联合阿托品（OK+ATP组，43 例）、DIMS 镜片（DIMS 组，41 例）或 DIMS 镜片联合阿托品（DIMS+ATP 组，42 例）治疗。分别在基线、3 个月、6 个月、9 个月和 12 个月时测量眼轴长度（AL），分析不同时间点及组间的眼轴伸长情况。 结果：12 个月后，OK 组、OK+ATP 组、DIMS 组和 DIMS+ATP组的眼轴长度（AL）变化分别为 0.20±0.12 mm、0.12±0.14 mm、0.22±0.14 mm 和 0.15±0.15 mm。OK 组与 DIMS 组的 AL 变化无显著差异；与 OK 组和 DIMS 组单药治疗相比，OK+ATP 组和 DIMS+ATP组能显著减缓眼轴伸长。按年龄分层后，在 6~10 岁亚组中，OK+ATP 组与 DIMS 组的 AL 变化存在显著差异（p=0.013），其他组间无差异；而在 10~14 岁亚组中，OK+ATP 组与 DIMS 组的差异变得不显著（p>0.05），但 OK 组与 OK+ATP 组、OK 组与 DIMSA 组、DIMS 组与 DIMSA 组的差异均具有统计学意义。 结论：在初始近视度数较低的儿童中，角膜塑形术（Ortho-K）和 DIMS 镜片在延缓近视进展方面效果相近。阿托品可显著提升角膜塑形术和 DIMS 镜片的近视控制效果，且这种附加效应在年龄较大的儿童中更显著。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: The aim of this study was to evaluate the efficacy of Orthokeratology (Ortho-K), defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) lens, combined Ortho-K/atropine, and combined DIMS/atropine for myopia control in children. METHODS: A retrospective study included 167 myopic children aged 6-14 years with a spherical equivalent refraction (SER) of -0.75 to -4.00 diopter treated with Ortho-K (OK, n = 41), combined Ortho-K/atropine (OKA, n = 43), DIMS (n = 41), or combined DIMS/atropine (DIMSA, n = 42). Axial length (AL) was measured at baseline and at 3, 6, 9 and 12 months. Axial elongation over time and between groups were analysed. RESULTS: After 12 months, the AL change was 0.20 ± 0.12 mm, 0.12 ± 0.14 mm, 0.22 ± 0.14 mm, and 0.15 ± 0.15 mm in the OK, OKA, DIMS, and DIMSA, respectively. There was no significant difference in AL change between OK and DIMS. OKA and DIMSA significantly slowed axial elongation compared to OK and DIMS monotherapy. After stratification by age, in the subgroup aged 6-10 years, there was significant difference in AL change between OKA and DIMS (p = 0.013), and no difference between other groups, while in the subgroup aged 10-14 years, the difference between OKA and DIMS became insignificant (p = 0.237), and the difference between OK and OKA, OK and DIMSA, DIMS and DIMSA became significant. CONCLUSIONS: Ortho-K and DIMS lenses show similar reductions in myopia progression among children with low initial myopia. Atropine can significantly improve the efficacy of myopia control of both Ortho-K and DIMS lenses, and this add-on effect is better in older children.

原文摘要
摘要 比较高非球面微透镜（HAL）与离焦整合多段式（DIMS）框架眼镜片在 1 年内对近视进展的控制效果。本回顾性队列研究纳入了中国广州爱尔眼科医院中处方配戴 HAL 或 DIMS 框架眼镜片儿童的数据。为解决部分儿童随访时间不足 1 年或超过 1 年的差异问题，本研究计算了标准化的 1 年等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）较基线的变化值。采用多变量线性回归模型比较两组间上述变化值的均值差异。模型中纳入了年龄、性别、基线 SER/AL 以及干预方式（即配戴的镜片类型）等变量。共纳入 257 名符合纳入标准的儿童进行分析（HAL 组 193 名，DIMS 组 64 名）。控制基线变量后，HAL 和 DIMS 框架眼镜片使用者标准化的 1 年 SER 变化校正均值（标准误，SE）分别为 - 0.34（0.04）屈光度（D）和 - 0.63（0.07）屈光度（D）。与 DIMS 镜片相比，HAL 框架眼镜片在 1 年内可减少 0.29 屈光度（D）的近视进展（95% 置信区间 [CI]：0.13~0.44 D）。相应地，配戴 HAL 镜片和 DIMS 镜片的儿童，其眼轴长度（AL）校正均值（SE）分别增加了 0.17（0.02）mm 和 0.28（0.04）mm。HAL 镜片使用者的眼轴增长比 DIMS 镜片使用者少 0.11 mm（95% 置信区间 [CI]：-0.20~-0.02 mm）。基线年龄与眼轴增长存在显著相关性。配戴 HAL 设计框架眼镜片的中国儿童，其近视进展程度和眼轴增长幅度均小于配戴 DIMS 设计框架眼镜片的儿童。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
To compare spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) versus defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) on myopia progression control in 1 year. This retrospective cohort study involved data from children prescribed HAL or DIMS spectacle lenses in Guangzhou Aier Eye Hospital, China. To address the discrepancy that some children followed up at less than or more than 1 year, the standardized 1-year spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) changes from baseline were calculated. The mean differences in the changes between the two groups were compared with linear multivariate regression models. Age, sex, baseline SER/AL, and treatment were included in the models. A total of 257 children who qualified for the inclusion criteria were included for the analyses (193 in the HAL group and 64 in the DIMS group). After controlling baseline variates, the adjusted mean (standard error, SE) of the standardized 1-year changes in SER for HAL and DIMS spectacle lens users were - 0.34 (0.04) D and - 0.63 (0.07) D, respectively. HAL spectacle lenses reduced myopia progression by 0.29 D (95% confidence interval [CI] 0.13 to 0.44 D) at 1 year compared to DIMS lenses. Accordingly, the adjusted mean (SE) ALs increased by 0.17 (0.02) and 0.28 (0.04) mm for children wearing HAL lenses and DIMS lenses, respectively. HAL users had 0.11 mm less AL elongation (95% CI - 0.20 to - 0.02 mm) than DIMS users. Age at baseline was significantly associated with AL elongation. Chinese children wearing spectacle lenses designed with HAL had less myopia progression and axial elongation than those wearing spectacle lenses designed with DIMS.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：比较中国儿童佩戴角膜塑形镜（ortho-k，OK 镜）或近视控制眼镜（MCS）1 年后的近视控制效果。 方法：收集 212 例患者的相关数据，患者基线近视度数为 - 5.00~-0.75 D，散光度数≤1.50 D，且至少接受 1 年近视控制治疗（OK 镜组：Euclid 镜片（OK1）、CRT 镜片（OK2）；MCS 组：Stellest 镜片（MCS1）、DIMS 镜片（MCS2））。根据等效球镜度数（SER）变化（仅眼镜组）和眼轴长度（AL）变化（所有组），比较四组的近视控制效果。仅提取右眼数据进行分析，包括首次就诊（基线）和 1 年随访时的最佳矫正视力（BCVA）、SER 及 AL。 结果：尽管基线检查时四组受试者在性别、柱镜度数或最佳矫正视力方面未观察到显著差异（P>0.05），但在基线年龄、近视度数和眼轴长度方面存在显著差异（P<0.05）。治疗 1 年后，四组的眼轴增长量（AE）无显著差异（P=0.49）。经基线年龄和球镜度数校正后，OK1、OK2、MCS1、MCS2 组的眼轴增长量分别为 0.19±0.15 mm、0.18±0.14 mm、0.19±0.19 mm、0.20±0.18 mm。仅年龄是与眼轴增长量和 SER 增加相关的显著因素（P<0.05）：所有组中眼轴增长量与年龄呈负相关，眼镜组中 SER 增加量与基线年龄呈正相关。 结论：在中国真实临床环境中，两种品牌的 OK 镜和两种品牌的近视控制眼镜对轻中度近视儿童的近视控制效果相似。1 年平均眼轴增长量为 0.18~0.20 mm，与既往 OK 镜近视控制研究的报道结果相当。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
OBJECTIVE: To compare the effectiveness of myopia control in Chinese children, who had been wearing either orthokeratology (ortho-k) lenses or myopia control spectacles (MCS) for one year. METHODS: Relevant data were retrieved from 212 patients, with baseline myopia of -5.00 to -0.75 D, astigmatism ≤ 1.50 D, who had been undergoing myopia control treatment with either ortho-k (Euclid (OK1) or CRT (OK2)) or MCS (Stellest (MCS1) or DIMS (MCS2)) for at least one year. Myopia control effectiveness among the four groups was compared based on the change in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) (for the spectacle groups) and axial length (AL) (for all groups). Data retrieved, from the right eye only, included best corrected visual acuity (BCVA), SER, and AL at both the initial clinic visit (baseline) and the one-year visit was analysed. RESULTS: Although no significant differences in gender, cylindrical power, or BCVA were observed at the baseline visit (P > 0.05), there were significant differences in baseline age, myopia, and AL among the four groups (P < 0.05). No significant difference in axial elongation (AE) was found among the four groups after one year of treatment (P = 0.49). AE, adjusted for baseline age and spherical power, were 0.19 ± 0.15, 0.18 ± 0.14, 0.19 ± 0.19, 0.20 ± 0.18 mm for OK1, OK2, MCS1, MCS2, respectively. Only age was a significantly factor associated with AE and SER increase (P < 0.05), with negative associations between AE and age in all groups and positive association between SER increase and baseline age in the spectacle groups observed. CONCLUSION: Both brands of ortho-k lenses and MCS had similar myopia control effectiveness for mild to moderate myopic children treated in a real-world setting in China. Average AE in one year ranged from 0.18 to 0.20 mm, comparable to previous reports on myopia control using ortho-k.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：比较 0.01% 阿托品与离焦整合多段（DIMS）眼镜片在预防欧洲儿童近视进展中的效果。 方法：本研究为回顾性研究，纳入欧洲近视儿童患者的数据。2021 年 11 月至 2022 年 3 月期间，因葡萄牙当时尚未供应 DIMS 镜片，故仅开具 0.01% 阿托品；2022 年 3 月至 2022 年 10 月期间，因患者家长的偏好，故仅开具 DIMS 眼镜片。近视进展的评价指标为治疗前与治疗 6 个月后眼轴长度（AL）和等效球镜度数（SE）的变化值。采用重复测量的一般线性模型（GLM）比较两组的 AL 和 SE 变化情况。 结果：本研究共纳入 50 例患者的 98 只眼，其中阿托品组 47 只眼，DIMS 组 51 只眼。两组患者的初始眼轴长度（AL）、初始等效球镜度数（SE）、性别及年龄均无统计学差异。6 个月时，阿托品组的平均眼轴长度（AL）增长为 0.057mm（标准差 = 0.118），DIMS 组为 0.002mm（标准差 = 0.077）；阿托品组的等效球镜度数（SE）进展为 - 0.098D（标准差 = 0.232），DIMS 组为 - 0.039D（标准差 = 0.105）。DIMS 镜片组的 AL 增长显著更低（p=0.038，partial Eta² = 0.045）。两组的等效球镜度数（SE）进展无差异（p=0.302，partial Eta² = 0.011）。 结论：短期随访结果显示，在延缓近视进展方面，对比 0.01% 阿托品滴眼液与 DIMS 眼镜片，DIMS 眼镜片在抑制眼轴长度（AL）增长方面更具优势；两组在等效球镜度数（SE）方面无差异。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To compare 0.01% atropine with DIMS spectacle lenses in the prevention of myopia progression in European children. METHODS: This was a retrospective study including data from pediatric European patients with myopia. From November 2021 to March 2022, only 0.01% atropine was prescribed because DIMS lenses were still not available in Portugal. From March to October 2022, only DIMS spectacle lenses were prescribed due to patients' parents' preference. Myopia progression endpoints were axial length (AL) and spherical equivalent (SE) differences between before and 6 months after treatment. AL and SE evolution were compared using a general linear model with repeated measures. RESULTS: The study included 98 eyes from 50 patients: 47 in the atropine group and 51 in the DIMS group. There were no statistically significant differences between groups in terms of initial AL, initial SE, sex or age. The mean AL elongation at 6 months was 0.057 mm in the atropine group (SD = 0.118) and 0.002 mm (SD = 0.077) in the DIMS group. SE progression was - 0.098 (SD = 0.232) D in the atropine group and - 0.039 (SD = 0.105) D in the DIMS group. AL elongation was significantly lower in the DIMS lens group (p = 0.038, partial Eta2 = 0.045). There was no difference in SE progression between groups (p = 0.302, partial Eta2 = 0.011). CONCLUSION: Comparison between 0.01% atropine eyedrops and DIMS spectacle lenses for slowing the progression of myopia favored DIMS lenses in terms of AL elongation in a short-term follow-up. There was no difference in terms of SE between groups.

DIMS vs Apollo PALs -3yRCT方案

参考文献6-2-6 DIMS vs Apollo PALs -3yRCT方案 试验组样本量：DIMS组300人 对照组选择：Apollo Progressive Addition Lenses (PALs) 镜片
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-6
原文摘要
摘要 背景：近视患病率呈上升趋势，目前已被公认为全球重大公共卫生问题，在中国尤为突出。近视发生后，需采取适当临床干预措施延缓其进展。现有多项研究表明，近视离焦（MD）可抑制眼球生长及近视进展。然而，目前尚无临床试验在同一观察组中比较不同近视离焦（MD）眼镜片的效果，在中国大陆尤其如此。本研究旨在比较两种不同近视离焦（MD）眼镜片的近视控制效果：离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片与 Apollo 渐进多焦点镜片（PALs）。 方法：本试验为一项为期 3 年的前瞻性、随机、多中心临床试验，研究对象为佩戴 DIMS 镜片与 PALs 的学龄儿童。计划纳入 600 名 6~12 岁中国小学生，每组各 300 名受试者。纳入标准为：近视度数 - 1.00~-5.00 屈光度，散光度数≤1.50 屈光度。随访时间点为 1 个月（m）、3 个月、6 个月、12 个月、18 个月、24 个月、30 个月及 36 个月。主要结局指标为两组受试者从基线到最后一次随访的睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度数差异；次要结局指标为眼轴长度；探索性结局指标包括眼部生物测量指标、周边屈光状态、双眼视功能、调节功能、依从性及佩戴体验相关问卷结果。 讨论：本研究将是中国首个针对近视小学生佩戴 DIMS 镜片与 PALs 的随机对照试验。研究结果将明确不同近视离焦（MD）机制是否能延缓近视进展及眼轴增长，以及延缓程度。此外，通过对比还可获取 DIMS 镜片与 PALs 的临床有效性和安全性信息，包括佩戴体验及视功能相关信息。 试验注册：中国临床试验注册中心（ChiCTR），注册号 ChiCTR1900025645。注册日期：2019 年 9 月 3 日。网址：http://www.chictr.org.cn/showproj.aspx?proj=42927.
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: Myopia is increasing in prevalence and is currently recognized as a significant public health issue worldwide, particularly in China. Once myopia develops, appropriate clinical interventions need to be prescribed to slow its progression. Currently, several publications indicate that myopic defocus (MD) retards eye growth and myopia progression. However, no clinical trials have compared the outcomes of different MD spectacle lenses in the same observational group, especially in mainland China. The aim of the present study is to compare the myopia control efficiency of two different MD spectacle lenses: defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lenses and Apollo progressive addition lenses (PALs). METHODS: The trial is designed as a 3-year, prospective, randomized, multicenter clinical trial of schoolchildren treated with DIMS lenses and PALs. A total of 600 Chinese primary school children aged 6-12 years will be recruited, and each group is intended to include 300 subjects. The inclusion criteria are myopia between - 1.00 and - 5.00 diopters and astigmatism ≤ 1.50 diopters. The follow-up time points will be 1 month (m), 3 m, 6 m, 12 m, 18 m, 24 m, 30 m, and 36 m. The primary outcome will be determined by the difference between the two groups in cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction between baseline and the last follow-up visit. The secondary outcome is the axial length, and the exploratory outcomes include ocular biometric measures, peripheral refraction, binocular vision, accommodation, compliance, and the results of questionnaires related to wearing experiences. DISCUSSION: The present study will be the first randomized controlled trial in myopic primary school children treated with DIMS lenses and PALs in China. The results will indicate whether and how much different MD mechanisms retard myopia progression and axial elongation. In addition, the comparison will provide information on the clinical efficacy and safety of DIMS lenses and PALs, including information related to wearing experiences and visual function. TRIAL REGISTRATION: Chinese Clinical Trial Registry (ChiCTR), ChiCTR1900025645. Registered on 3 September 2019. http://www.chictr.org.cn/showproj.aspx?proj=42927.

Real—world outcomes on myopia management efficacy of diverse segmented defocus optics (DSDO) and defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses in Chinese children: An initial 12—month prospective clinical study

DIMS vs DSDO

📖 Journal of optometry📅 2025年👥 Fan Yuzhuo, Chu Huihui, Peng Zisu, Zhou Jingwei, Ma Jiahui, Lu Yuchang, Zhao Chenxu, Wang Yanyan, Deng Qiulin, Yu Jifeng, Li Yan, Wang Kai, Zhao Mingwei

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-7
原文摘要
摘要 目的：探讨多段离焦光学（DSDO）与多区离焦（DIMS）框架眼镜在真实世界临床人群中，对中国近视及近视前期儿童的 12 个月干预效果。 方法：纳入约 364 例处方为 DSDO 或 DIMS 框架眼镜的受试者，测量 12 个月内眼轴长度（AL）和睫状肌麻痹球镜当量屈光力（SER）的变化。受试者进一步按年龄分为亚组（6-9 岁；10-14 岁），按 SER 分为亚组（+0.75D ≤ SER < -0.50D；-0.50D ≤ SER < -2.00D；-2.00D ≤ SER < -4.00D；SER ≤ -4.0D）。同时记录对比敏感度及视觉体验，并将近视进展速率与历史单光框架眼镜（SVS）数据对比，以评估该干预方案的效果。 结果：共分析 317 例受试者。12 个月时，DSDO 组与 DIMS 组的眼轴长度变化分别为 0.16±0.16 mm 和 0.21±0.22 mm（P=0.0202）。在 + 0.75D ≤ SER < -0.50D 和 SER ≤ -2.0D 亚组中，DSDO 框架眼镜的控制效果更优。DSDO 组和 DIMS 组中，眼轴长度增长不超过 0.20 mm 的受试者比例分别为 65.00% 和 55.41%。与历史单光框架眼镜（SVS）相比，DSDO 组的近视控制效果为 47%-69%，DIMS 组为 33%-62%。 结论：DSDO 与 DIMS 框架眼镜均能延缓眼轴长度增长。与 DIMS 相比，DSDO 的近视控制效果更稳定，尤其在 SER ≤ -2.0D 亚组和年龄较大的受试者中表现更优。与历史单光框架眼镜（SVS）数据相比，DSDO 对近视前期儿童显示出初步的近视预防潜力。然而，本研究中近视前期受试者样本量小且无对照组，是主要局限性。需进一步研究以明确 DSDO 在近视前期儿童中的作用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSES: To investigate the 12-month effectiveness of Diverse Segmented Defocus Optics (DSDO) and Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses in a real-world clinical population in myopic and pre-myopic Chinese children. METHODS: About 364 subjects prescribed DSDO or DIMS were enrolled. Axial length (AL) and cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) changes over 12 months were measured. The subjects were further divided into age sub-group (6-9; 10-14) and SER sub-group (+0.75D≤SER<-0.50D; -0.50D≤SER<-2.00D; -2.00D≤SER<-4.00D; SER≤-4.0D). Contrast sensitivity and visual experience were also reported. The rate of myopia progression was compared with historical single-vision spectacles (SVS) lenses data to evaluate the effectiveness of the regime. RESULTS: 317 subjects were analyzed. At 12-month, AL changes in the DSDO and DIMS group were 0.16±0.16 mm and 0.21±0.22 mm, respectively (P = 0.0202). DSDO spectacle lenses had better control effect in +0.75D≤SER<-0.50D and SER≤-2.0D sub-groups. The proportion of participants had no greater than 0.20 mm AL elongation was 65.00% and 55.41% of in DSDO and DIMS group separately. Myopia control effect in DSDO group was 47%-69% and 33%-62% in DIMS group compared to historical SVS lenses. CONCLUSIONS: Both DSDO and DIMS spectacle lenses retarded AL elongation. DSDO showed more stable myopia control effect comparing to DIMS, especially in groups of SER≤-2.0D sub-groups and older patients. DSDO showed initial potential myopia prevention effect in pre-myopic children compared with historical SVS lenses data. However, the small sample and no control group in pre-myopes of this study are key limitations. Further research is needed to confirm and understand DSDO's role for pre-myopic children.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在评估并比较双焦点隐形眼镜（DFCL）与融入散光的多段式（DIMS）眼镜镜片在控制低散光患者近视进展方面的有效性。 研究方法：本研究为回顾性队列研究，纳入使用双焦点隐形眼镜（DFCL）或离焦多段设计（DIMS）框架眼镜、散光度数＜-1.25 屈光度（D）的近视患者。研究共纳入 DFCL 组 95 眼、DIMS 组 88 眼，研究人群的球镜等效屈光度（SER）范围为 - 0.50 D 至 - 6.00 D。主要结局指标为 1 年内 SER 的进展情况（近视度数加深）和眼轴长度（AXL）的伸长情况。采用广义线性混合模型计算调整后比值比（aOR）及相关 95% 置信区间（CI），调整因素包括年龄、性别、初始眼轴长度（AXL）和初始球镜等效屈光度（SER）。 结果：DFCL 组的平均 SER 进展（近视度数加深）为 - 0.28±0.15 D，DIMS 组为 - 0.25±0.12 D（p=0.139）。DFCL 使用者的平均眼轴长度（AXL）伸长为 0.12±0.07 mm，DIMS 使用者为 0.10±0.05 mm（p=0.029）。经混杂因素调整后的趋势分析显示，两组间 SER 进展（aOR：0.988；95% CI：0.945~1.033；p=0.513）或 AXL 伸长（aOR：0.982；95% CI：0.945~1.018；p=0.307）均无显著差异。亚组分析显示，在不同基线特征人群中，DIMS 使用者与 DFCL 使用者的 SER 进展或 AXL 伸长均无显著差异（所有 p>0.05）。 结论：使用离焦多段设计（DIMS）框架眼镜对球镜等效屈光度（SER）和眼轴长度（AXL）的控制效果与双焦点隐形眼镜（DFCL）相当。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study aimed to evaluate and compare the effectiveness of dual-focus contact lenses (DFCL) and defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) spectacle lenses in controlling myopia progression in patients with low astigmatism. METHODS: A retrospective cohort study was conducted involving myopic patients with astigmatism of less than -1.25 diopters (D) who used either DFCL or DIMS spectacle lenses. The study included 95 eyes in the DFCL group and 88 eyes in the DIMS group, and the spherical equivalent refraction (SER) of the study population ranged from -0.50 D to -6.00 D. The primary outcomes were the progression of SER and the elongation of axial length (AXL) over 1 year. A generalized linear mixed model was used to calculate adjusted odds ratios (aORs) and the associated 95% confidence intervals (CIs), adjusting for age, sex, initial AXL, and initial SER. RESULTS: The mean SER progression was -0.28 ± 0.15 D in the DFCL group and -0.25 ± 0.12 D in the DIMS group (p = 0.139). The mean AXL elongation was 0.12 ± 0.07 mm for DFCL users and 0.10 ± 0.05 mm for DIMS users (p = 0.029). Trend analysis revealed no significant differences in SER progression (aOR: 0.988; 95% CI: 0.945-1.033; p = 0.513) or AXL elongation (aOR: 0.982; 95% CI: 0.945-1.018; p = 0.307) between the groups after adjusting for confounders. Subgroup analyses indicated no significant differences in SER progression or AXL elongation between DIMS and DFCL users across different baseline characteristics (all p > 0.05). CONCLUSION: The use of DIMS spectacle lenses showed SER and AXL control similar to that of DFCL.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：比较角膜塑形镜（OK 镜）与离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS 镜片）对儿童近视控制的效果。 方法：本前瞻性研究纳入 540 名受试者（7~14 岁），分为三组：DIMS 镜片组（180 例）、OK 镜组（180 例）和单光眼镜组（SVS 组，180 例）。经过 1 年随访，分析各组受试者的眼轴长度（AL）变化及组间差异。受试者进一步分为低近视亚组（LM 组，等效球镜度数 SE：−1.50 D ≤ SE ≤ −0.50 D）、中度近视亚组（MM 组，SE：−3.00 D ≤ SE < −1.50 D）和高度近视亚组（HM 组，SE：−5.00 D ≤ SE < −3.00 D）。采用单因素方差分析（one-way ANOVA）和多元线性回归分析比较各组眼轴长度增长情况及影响因素。 结果：共 496 名（92%）受试者完成研究。OK 镜组、DIMS 镜片组和 SVS 组的平均眼轴长度变化分别为 0.20±0.18mm、0.30±0.22mm 和 0.38±0.19mm（P<0.001）。在 LM 亚组中，OK 镜组与 DIMS 镜片组的眼轴长度变化无显著差异，但两组的眼轴增长速度均慢于 SVS 组（P=0.001）。在 MM 亚组和 HM 亚组中，与 DIMS 镜片组和 SVS 组相比，OK 镜组的眼轴长度增长最短（P<0.001）。多元回归分析显示，眼轴长度变化与年龄（β=−0.038，P=0.005）、初始眼轴长度（β=−0.010，P=0.011）、初始等效球镜度数（β=0.028，P=0.007）以及干预方式（使用 OK 镜：β=−0.172，P=0.020；使用 DIMS 镜片：β=−0.089，P=0.020）相关。 结论：在 1 年治疗期内，与 SVS 相比，OK 镜和 DIMS 镜片均能显著延缓眼轴长度增长。此外，对于近视度数较高的患者，OK 镜在眼轴长度控制方面的效果优于 DIMS 镜片。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To compare the efficiency of orthokeratology (OK) and defocus-incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) lenses in myopia control in children. METHODS: This prospective study involved 540 subjects (7-14 years) categorized into three groups: DIMS lenses (180 cases), OK lenses (180 cases), or single-vision spectacles (SVS) (180 cases). After a one-year follow-up, changes in axial length (AL) and differences among the groups were analyzed. The subjects were further divided into a low myopia degree subgroup (LM, -1.50 D ≤ SE ≤ -0.50 D), a moderate myopia degree subgroup (MM, -3.00 D ≤ SE ＜ -1.50 D), and a high myopia degree subgroup (HM, -5.00 D ≤ SE ＜ -3.00 D). A one-way ANOVA and multiple linear regression analysis were used to compare AL elongation and the factors influencing the different groups. RESULTS: A total of 496 (92 %) subjects completed the study. The mean AL change in the OK lenses, DIMS lenses, and SVS were 0.20±0.18 mm, 0.30±0.22 mm, and 0.38±0.19 mm, respectively (P < 0.001). In the LM subgroup, the OK and DIMS groups showed similar AL changes, but both exhibited slower changes than the SVS group (P = 0.001). In the MM and HM subgroups, the OK lens performed the shortest AL elongation compared with the DIMS lenses and SVS (P < 0.001). Multiple regression analysis showed that the AL change was associated with age (β = -0.038 and P = 0.005), initial AL (β = -0.010 and P = 0.011), initial SE (β = 0.028 and P = 0.007), and interventions using OK lenses (β = -0.172 and P = 0.020) and DIMS lenses (β = -0.089 and P = 0.020). CONCLUSION: Over a one-year treatment period, OK and DIMS lenses can significantly retard AL elongation compared with SVS. In addition, the OK lenses were more effective than the DIMS lenses in controlling AL in patients with higher degrees of myopia.

原文摘要
摘要 本研究旨在评估不同近视矫正方法在青少年近视防控中的临床应用效果。研究共纳入 145 名 8-15 岁近视青少年，根据治疗方式将其双眼分为 4 组：纯佩戴离焦整合多段式（DIMS）框架眼镜组（A 组）、纯佩戴角膜塑形镜（OK 镜）组（B 组）、DIMS+anisodamine 组（C 组）、OK+anisodamine 组（D 组）。以眼轴长度和屈光不正（以等效球镜度数 SER 表示）为主要观察指标，分别在基线时和 12 个月随访时进行测量，并比较各组的临床效果。结果显示，各组近视进展存在显著差异，其中 D 组的眼轴增长幅度最小；在控制近视进展方面，OK 镜的效果优于 DIMS 框架眼镜，而联合使用anisodamine 可进一步提升矫正效果。本研究为青少年近视防控干预措施提供了重要的临床依据。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
This study aimed to evaluate the clinical application of different myopia correction methods in the prevention and control of myopia in adolescents. A total of 145 myopic adolescents aged 8 to 15 years were included, and their eyes were divided into four groups based on the treatment modality: wearing Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses alone (Group A), orthokeratology (OK) lenses alone (Group B), DIMS spectacle lenses combined with racemic anisodamine eye drops (Group C), and OK lenses combined with racemic anisodamine eye drops (Group D). The primary outcomes, including axial length and refractive error (expressed as spherical equivalent refraction, SER), were measured at baseline and at the 12-month follow-up. The clinical effects of each group were compared. The results showed significant differences in myopia progression across the groups, with Group D showing the least axial elongation. OK lenses were more effective than DIMS spectacle lenses in controlling myopia progression, and the combination of racemic anisodamine eye drops further enhanced the correction effect. This study provides important clinical evidence for myopia control interventions in adolescents.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：在真实世界研究中评估镜片控制近视的有效性。 方法：本研究为法国近视队列的一项纵向、回顾性、对比性观察性真实世界研究。2020 年至 2023 年期间，从 1500 名验光师处收集了光学矫正处方记录、性别及年龄信息。研究队列纳入 4-15 岁近视儿童，分为三组：两组为佩戴单光镜片（SVL）的对照组，一组为佩戴近视控制镜片（MCS）的干预组；MCS 组儿童佩戴的镜片为离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS，n=1786）或高非球面微透镜（HAL，n=585）。第一组 SVL 对照组与 MCS 组在年龄、性别和初始屈光不正方面进行匹配（首次匹配）；第二组 SVL 对照组则在上述相同指标基础上，额外结合随访前 6 个月的近视进展情况进行匹配（二次匹配）。计算 SVL 对照组与 MCS 组之间的近视进展差异，并比较 DIMS 与 HAL 镜片在近视控制效果上的差异。 结果：三组各纳入 2542 名儿童，基线时平均年龄为 9.5 岁，平均等效球镜度数（SE）为 - 2.3D。与 SVL 对照组相比，首次匹配后 MCS 组的平均近视进展减缓幅度为 + 0.59D（95% 置信区间（CI）为 + 0.57 至 + 0.62D，P<0.001）；二次匹配后，该减缓幅度为 + 0.30D（95% CI 为 + 0.28 至 + 0.32D，P<0.001）。与佩戴 DIMS 镜片的儿童相比，佩戴 HAL 镜片的儿童近视进展略慢（进展差异 =+0.14D，95% CI 为 + 0.10 至 + 0.18，P<0.001）。 结论：尽管本研究存在一些局限性（包括回顾性设计、缺乏生活方式和环境因素数据，且采用等效球镜度数而非眼轴长度作为评估指标），但研究表明，在真实世界场景中，DIMS 和 HAL 镜片均能有效减缓近视进展。尽管 HAL 组的近视进展速度在统计学上显著更低，但该差异无临床意义。本研究还证实，DIMS 和 HAL 镜片对 4-6 岁低龄儿童的近视进展同样具有减缓作用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
AIMS: To evaluate the efficacy of myopia control by spectacle lenses in a real-world study. METHODS: This is a longitudinal, retrospective, comparative, observational, real-world study of the French Myopia Cohort. Records of prescriptions for optical correction, gender and age were collected from 1500 opticians between 2020 and 2023. The study cohort consisted of myopic children aged 4 to 15 years who were assigned to three groups: two control groups wearing single vision lenses (SVL) and one intervention group wearing myopia control spectacles (MCS); either defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS, n=1786) or highly aspheric lenses (HAL, n=585). The first SVL group was matched to the MCS group for age, sex and initial refractive error (first matching), and the second SVL group was matched for the same criteria and myopia progression during the first 6 months of follow-up (second matching).The difference in myopia progression was calculated between SVL groups and the MCS group. DIMS and HAL were also compared for myopia progression. RESULTS: A total of 2542 children (mean age of 9.5 years and mean spherical equivalent of -2.3 D at baseline) were included in each of the three groups. The mean progression rates for MCS were by +0.59 D (95% CI +0.57 to +0.62D; p<0.001) after the first matching and by +0.30 D (95% CI +0.28 to +0.32D; p<0.001) after the second matching, in comparison to the SVL groups. Children wearing HAL spectacles showed slightly less myopia progression (difference in progression = +0.14 D, 95% CI = +0.10 to +0.18, p<0.001) compared with the DIMS group. CONCLUSIONS: Although there are some limitations, including its retrospective design, the lack of lifestyle and environmental data and the use of SE rather than axial length, this study showed that in a real-world setting, both DIMS and HAL spectacles demonstrated efficacy in reducing myopia progression. While a statistically significant lower myopia progression rate was observed in the HAL group, this difference was not clinically meaningful. This study also showed that DIMS and HAL reduce myopia progression among younger children aged 4 to 6 years.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-12
原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在评估并比较不同基于周边离焦的眼镜设计 —— DIMS、HAL及CARE在控制近视进展中的疗效。 方法：本研究为前瞻性、干预性、双盲随机临床试验。年龄 5-15 岁、近视度数为 - 1~-8 屈光度（D）且经证实近视进展速率≥0.5 屈光度 / 年的儿童，按 1:1:1 的比例随机分配，全程佩戴 DIMS、HAL 或 CARE 眼镜。在基线时和 1 年后分别进行睫状肌麻痹验光和眼轴长度测量。主要结局指标为近视进展速率的变化。所有分析均基于意向性治疗原则进行。 结果：共纳入 120 名受试者（DIMS、HAL、CARE 组各 40 名），平均年龄为 10.1±3.3 岁（57% 为男性）。1 年随访时，DIMS 组、HAL 组、CARE 组的近视进展速率分别降低了 0.38±0.13 屈光度 / 年（56.7%）、0.36±0.12 屈光度 / 年（58.1%）和 0.31±0.15 屈光度 / 年（47%）；各组眼轴长度变化分别为 0.2±0.11 mm、0.19±0.12 mm 和 0.23±0.14 mm。组间比较显示，HAL 组与 CARE 组在等效球镜度数变化上存在显著差异（p=0.04），DIMS 组与 CARE 组在近视进展速率上存在显著差异（p=0.04）；而 HALT 组与 DIMS 组在所有指标上均无显著差异。 结论：包含周边离焦设计的眼镜（DIMS、HALT、CARE）均能显著降低近视进展速率，且未观察到不良反应。在 1 年随访时，三种设计中 DIMS 和 HAL的疗效相当，且显著优于 CARE 眼镜。但仍需进一步的长期研究验证上述结果。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study aimed to evaluate and compare the efficacy of different peripheral defocus-based spectacle designs [Defocus Induced Multiple Segment (DIMS), Highly Aspherical Lenslets (HALT) and Cylindrical Annular Refractive Elements (CARE)] in controlling myopia progression. METHODS: This was a prospective, interventional, double-blinded, randomised clinical trial. Children aged 5 to 15 years, with myopia ranging from -1 D to -8 D and documented myopia progression of ≥0.5 D/year, were randomly assigned (1:1:1) to wear either DIMS, HALT or CARE spectacles full-time. Cycloplegic refraction and axial length measurements were taken at baseline and after 1 year. The primary outcome was the change in the rate of myopia progression. All analyses were performed based on the intention-to-treat principle. RESULTS: A total of 120 participants (40 in each group: DIMS, HALT and CARE) with a mean age of 10.1 ± 3.3 years (57% male) were enrolled. At the 1-year follow-up, the rate of myopia progression reduced by 0.38 ± 0.13 D/year (56.7%), 0.36 ± 0.12 D/year (58.1%) and 0.31 ± 0.15 D/year (47%) for the DIMS, HALT and CARE groups, respectively. The respective change in axial length was 0.2 ± 0.11 mm, 0.19 ± 0.12 mm and 0.23 ± 0.14 mm. Inter-group comparisons showed a significant difference in spherical equivalent refractive error changes between HALT and CARE (p = 0.04) and in the rate of myopia progression between DIMS and CARE (p = 0.04). No significant differences were found between HALT and DIMS for any parameter. CONCLUSIONS: Spectacle lenses incorporating peripheral defocus (DIMS, HALT and CARE) were all effective in reducing the rate of myopia progression significantly, with no adverse effects being observed. Among the three designs, DIMS and HALT exhibited comparable and significantly better efficacy than CARE spectacles at 1 year follow-up. However, further long-term studies are required to validate these findings.

原文摘要
摘要 本研究旨在评估离焦整合多段（DIMS，Miyosmart）镜片对低浓度阿托品（LCA，0.01%）滴眼液无应答儿童近视进展的影响。共纳入 10 例对 0.01% LCA 滴眼液无应答的儿童，建议其佩戴 DIMS 镜片以遏制近视进展，并对这些儿童进行了 1 年的随访。10 例儿童中有 8 例近视进展速度减缓：佩戴 DIMS 镜片前，这 8 例儿童的近视进展度数为−0.68 屈光度 ±0.3 屈光度（球镜），佩戴 DIMS 镜片后，近视进展度数降至−0.24 屈光度 ±0.2 屈光度；其余 2 例儿童在 1 年内仍有−0.57 屈光度 ±0.4 屈光度（球镜）的近视进展。在这些 LCA 无应答儿童中，佩戴 DIMS 镜片后，眼轴长度增长从 0.28 毫米 ±0.3 毫米降至 0.16 毫米 ±0.2 毫米。研究表明，即使对于 0.01% LCA 滴眼液无应答的儿童，DIMS 镜片在减缓近视进展方面仍初步显示出潜力。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
To assess the effect of defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) (Miyosmart) lenses on myopic progression in children not responding to low-concentration atropine (LCA) (0.01%) eye drops. A total of 10 children not responding to LCA (0.01%) eye drops were advised to start using the DIMS lens to halt the progression of myopia. The children were followed for a period of 1 year. Eight out of 10 children showed a reduction in the progression of myopia. Pre DIMS, the progression was -0.68 D ± 0.3 D sph, which reduced to -0.24 ± 0.2 diopter progression post DIMS lens in the eight children. The remaining two children still progressed by -0.57 ± 0.4 D sph over a year. The axial length growth reduced from 0.28 ± 0.3 mm to 0.16 ± 0.2 mm after using the DIMS lens in these non-responders. The DIMS lens shows initial promise in reducing the progression of myopia even in children not responding to LCA 0.01% eye drops.
