原文摘要
摘要 背景与目的： 近视病例在全球范围内显著增加，尤其在年轻人群中。本研究旨在评估多焦段离焦（DIMS）镜片联合阿托品（DIMSA）与角膜塑形术（ortho-k）镜片在控制近视进展方面的效果。 方法： 本项非随机对照临床研究纳入了 2022 年 1 月至 2023 年 2 月期间在南京市儿童医院接受治疗的 180 名近视儿童的 180 只眼。根据患者及其监护人的意愿，参与者被分为 DIMSA 组和角膜塑形术组，每组各 90 例（90 只眼）。两组共计 161 名患者符合纳入与排除标准，其中 DIMSA 组 88 名，角膜塑形术组 73 名。对右眼参数进行分析，并比较两组患者一年随访后眼轴长度（AL）的变化、眼轴负增长率及眼轴延长率。 结果： 除年龄外，DIMSA 组与角膜塑形术组在基线特征上无显著差异。经一年治疗后，两组在眼轴延长量（AE）方面未发现统计学上的显著差异。在校正基线年龄后，DIMSA 组和角膜塑形术组的眼轴延长量分别为 0.14±0.18 mm 和 0.20±0.18 mm（P = 0.025）。基线年龄是影响 DIMSA 和角膜塑形术镜片眼轴控制效果的唯一因素，两组中眼轴延长量与年龄均呈负相关，且 DIMSA 组中球镜等效度数（SER）的增加与基线年龄呈正相关。与角膜塑形术镜片组相比，DIMSA 组在一年后呈现出更高的眼轴负增长和眼轴缓慢增长（≤0.15 mm）率（分别为 P = 0.008 和 P = 0.004）。 结论： 在我国真实世界场景下，对于轻中度近视儿童，DIMSA 在近视控制效果上略优于角膜塑形术镜片。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Myopia cases have markedly increased worldwide, particularly in younger individuals. This study evaluatestheeffectofdefocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lens combined with atropine (DIMSA) in the control of myopia progression versus orthokeratology (ortho-k) lenses. METHODS: In this non-randomized controlled clinical study, 180 eyes in 180 myopic children treated at the Nanjing Children's Hospital between January 2022 and February 2023 were included. According to the preferences of patients and their guardians, the participants were divided into the DIMSA and ortho-k groups, with 90 cases (90 eyes) each. Totally 161 patients in both groups met the inclusion and exclusion criteria, including 88 and 73 in the DIMSA and ortho-k groups, respectively. Right eye parameters were analyzed. Both groups were compared in terms of change in axial length (AL), AL negative growth rate and AL elongation rate after a one-year visit. RESULTS: No significant differences were found in baseline features other than age between the DIMSA and ortho-k groups. After a one-year treatment, no statistically significant difference was found in axial elongation (AE) between the two groups. After adjustment for baseline age, axial elongations in the DIMSA and ortho-k groups were 0.14 ± 0.18 mm and 0.20 ± 0.18 mm (P = 0.025), respectively. Baseline age was the only factor impacting the axial control efficacy of DIMSA and ortho-k lenses, with a negative association between AE and age in both groups and a positive association between spherical equivalent refraction (SER) increase and baseline age in the DIMSA group. The DIMSA group exhibited higher AL negative growth and AL slow growth (≤0.15 mm) rates after one year compared with the ortho-k lens group (P = 0.008 and P = 0.004, respectively). CONCLUSIONS: DIMSA demonstrated marginally superior myopia control efficacy compared to ortho-k lenses in children with mild to moderate myopia in a real-world setting in China.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在比较角膜塑形镜（OK 镜）与多焦点离焦框架镜（DIMS 镜）在近视控制效果上的差异。 方法：本研究为回顾性队列研究，纳入接受 OK 镜、DIMS 镜或单光框架镜治疗的患者。其中，OK 镜组纳入 27 例患者（54 眼），DIMS 镜组纳入 19 例患者（38 眼），对照组（单光框架镜组）纳入 21 例患者（42 眼）。主要结局指标为各组患者的等效球镜度数（SER）变化和眼轴长度（AXL）变化。采用重复测量协方差分析（repeated-measure ANCOVA）比较 OK 镜组与 DIMS 镜组的 SER 进展情况和 AXL 增长情况。 结果：与 DIMS 镜组和对照组相比，OK 镜组的 SER 进展差异具有统计学意义（P=0.001），但临床无显著差异；OK 镜组与 DIMS 镜组的总 AXL 增长情况相近，且均低于对照组（P=0.005）。重复测量协方差分析显示，研究期间 OK 镜组与 DIMS 镜组的 SER 进展差异具有统计学意义（P=0.028），但临床无显著差异；两组的 AXL 增长情况无统计学差异（P=0.607）。在中度散光亚组分析中，DIMS 镜亚组的 AXL 控制效果优于 OK 镜亚组（P=0.016）。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
Purpose: The purpose of this study was to compare the differences in myopic control effects between orthokeratology (OK) contact lenses and defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses. Methods: A retrospective cohort study was conducted that included patients who had received OK lens, DIMS spectacle lens or single-vision spectacle treatments. A total of 54 eyes from 27 individuals, 38 eyes from 19 individuals and 42 eyes from 21 individuals were enrolled into the OK lens, DIMS and control groups, respectively. The primary outcomes were the changes in the spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AXL) among the groups. A repeated-measure ANCOVA was adopted to calculate the SER progression and AXL elongation of the OK lens group compared with the DIMS group. Results: The difference in the SER progression was clinically non-significant in the OK lens group compared with the DIMS and control groups (P = 0.001). The total AXL elongation results were similar between the OK lens and DIMS groups, but these were lower than in the control group (P = 0.005). The repeated-measure ANCOVA revealed that the SER progression difference during the study interval was clinically non-significant in the OK lens group when compared with the DIMS group (P = 0.028). The AXL elongation results between the OK lens and DIMS populations did not illustrate a significant difference (P = 0.607). In a subgroup analysis of moderate astigmatism, better AXL control was observed in the DIMS subgroup compared with the OK lens subgroup (P = 0.016). Conclusions: The OK lens demonstrated a clinically non-significant effect on the SER and AXL controls compared with the DIMS spectacle lens.

原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：近视是一种常见的影响视力的屈光不正。本研究旨在评估两种实际应用中的近视控制方法：角膜塑形镜（OK 镜）和离焦整合多段（DIMS）框架镜片。 研究方法：本项回顾性观察性多中心研究以法国近视人群为研究对象，受试者分别采用 DIMS 框架镜片或 OK 镜进行近视控制。研究记录了受试者的基线眼轴长度（AL）、等效球镜度数（SER），以及 6 个月和 12 个月时的相关数据，并将眼轴长度变化作为近视控制效果的主要评价指标。 研究结果：角膜塑形镜组纳入 111 例患者，框架镜片组纳入 88 例患者。框架镜片组的基线平均眼轴长度为 24.46 mm，角膜塑形镜组的基线平均眼轴长度为 25.05 mm。两组在 6 个月和 12 个月时的眼轴长度增长无显著差异。6 个月时，DIMS 组的等效球镜度数变化显著低于角膜塑形镜组；然而，这一差异在 12 个月时未持续存在。12 个月时，角膜塑形镜组的平均眼轴长度增长为 0.12 mm（n=162），DIMS 组为 0.16 mm（n=70）。 研究结论：本研究为法国儿童近视控制技术提供了新的实际应用数据。在一年的观察期内，两种技术的近视控制效果相近。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
Purpose Myopia is a common refractive error affecting vision. This study aims to evaluate two real-world methods for myopia control: orthokeratology (ortho-k) and defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS) spectacles lenses. Methods This retrospective observational multicenter study was conducted on a French population with myopia, treated with either DIMS spectacle lenses or ortho-k for myopia control. Baseline axial length (AL) and spherical equivalent refraction (SER) were recorded, along with data at six and 12 months. AL change was used as the primary criterion for myopia control. Results We included 111 patients in the ortho-k group and 88 in the spectacle lenses group. The mean baseline AL was 24.46 mm in the spectacle lenses group and 25.05 mm in the ortho-k group. No significant difference in AL elongation was observed between the two groups at the six- and 12-month time points. At six months, SER change in the DIMS group was significantly lower than in the ortho-k group; however, this difference was not maintained at 12 months. The mean AL elongation at 12 months was 0.12 mm (n=162) in the ortho-K group vs. 0.16 mm in the DIMS group (n=70). Conclusion The study provides new real-world data on myopia control techniques in French children. Both techniques appear to yield similar results over a one-year period.

原文摘要
摘要 背景 / 目的：全球儿童近视发生率的上升凸显了有效控制策略的必要性。本研究比较了多焦离焦（DIMS）眼镜镜片与 0.01% 阿托品滴眼液在延缓欧洲儿童近视进展中的效果。本报告总结了一项正在进行的 2 年临床试验的 1 年随访结果。 方法：共纳入 110 名 6-16 岁无明显眼部病变的波兰儿童，将其随机分为两组。A 组佩戴单光眼镜并每晚使用 0.01% 阿托品滴眼液；B 组佩戴 DIMS 眼镜镜片并每晚使用placebo drops。主要结局指标为每 6 个月测量一次的睫状肌麻痹下等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度变化。 结果：12 个月后，A 组的平均眼轴增长为 0.19±0.03 mm，B 组为 0.11±0.02 mm。在 6-11 岁儿童中，A 组的眼轴增长（0.30±0.05 mm）大于 B 组（0.15±0.02 mm）。12-16 岁儿童中，A 组的眼轴增长为 0.10±0.02 mm，B 组为 0.07±0.02 mm。平均等效球镜度数（SER）进展方面，A 组为 0.37±0.06 D，B 组为 0.23±0.05 D。在低年龄组（6-11 岁），A 组的 SER 进展（0.60±0.1 D）高于 B 组（0.25±0.05 D）。在高年龄组（12-16 岁），两组的 SER 变化相近（0.19±0.05 D vs 0.21±0.08 D）。 结论：在本研究队列中，DIMS 眼镜镜片在控制近视进展方面的疗效优于 0.01% 阿托品，尤其是在 6-11 岁儿童中。这些结果表明，DIMS 镜片是高加索人群儿童近视控制的有效干预手段。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND/AIMS: The global increase in childhood myopia underscores the need for effective control strategies. This study compares the effectiveness of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses versus 0.01% atropine eye drops in slowing myopia progression in European children. This report summarises 1-year outcomes from an ongoing 2-year clinical trial. METHODS: A total of 110 Polish children aged 6-16 years, without significant ocular pathology, were randomly assigned to two groups. Group A received single-vision spectacles plus nightly 0.01% atropine drops; group B received DIMS spectacle lenses plus nightly placebo drops. Primary outcomes were changes in cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length, measured every 6 months. RESULTS: After 12 months, mean axial elongation was 0.19±0.03 mm in group A and 0.11±0.02 mm in group B. Among 6-11-year olds, group A showed greater elongation (0.30±0.05 mm) than group B (0.15±0.02 mm). For 12-16-year olds, axial elongation was 0.10±0.02 mm in group A and 0.07±0.02 mm in group B. Mean SER progression was 0.37±0.06 D in group A and 0.23±0.05 D in group B. In the younger group (6-11 years), SER progression was higher in group A (0.60±0.1 D) than group B (0.25±0.05 D). Among older children (12-16 years), SER changes were similar between groups (0.19±0.05 D vs 0.21±0.08 D). CONCLUSION: DIMS spectacle lenses demonstrated superior efficacy to the 0.01% atropine in controlling myopia progression in this cohort, particularly among children aged 6-11 years. These findings support DIMS lenses as an effective intervention for myopia control in Caucasian populations.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：旨在评估多焦点软性接触镜（MFSCLs）与离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS）在限制高度近视儿童近视进展中的疗效。 方法：本回顾性研究纳入 249 名高度近视儿童（年龄 8-16 岁），其非散瞳球镜度数（SE）为−6.00 至−10.00 D，散光 <2.00 D。受试者分为三组：DIMS 镜片治疗组（N=81）、多焦点软性接触镜（DISC，N=60）治疗组及单光眼镜（SVLs，N=108）对照组。根据基线至 1 年的球镜度数变化评估近视进展情况，分为慢速进展（<-0.25 D）、中度进展（−0.25 至−0.75 D）和快速进展（>−0.75 D）三类。采用多元线性回归分析评估近视进展与相关特征的关联性。 结果：基线时，三组受试者的年龄、球镜度数（SE）及性别分布均无显著差异。1 年后，DIMS 组（−0.47±0.39 D，33.8%）和 MFSCLs 组（−0.39±0.47 D，45.1%）的近视进展幅度显著小于 SVL 对照组（−0.71±0.54 D；P<0.001）。慢速进展者比例分别为：SVLs 组 28.40%、DIMS 组 39.81%、MFSCLs 组 51.67%。年龄与 DIMS 组（β=0.108，P<0.001）和 SVLs 组（β=0.120，P<0.001）的近视进展相关，但与 MFSCLs 组无关（P=0.776）。12 岁以下儿童更适合佩戴 MFSCLs，而 12 岁以上高度近视儿童佩戴 DIMS 与 MFSCLs 的疗效相当。 结论：多焦点软性接触镜（MFSCLs）与离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS）均能有效延缓高度近视儿童的近视进展。12 岁以下儿童佩戴 MFSCLs 的近视控制效果更优，12 岁以上儿童佩戴 MFSCLs 仍为优质选择，且与 DIMS 疗效相当。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate the efficacy of multifocal soft contact lenses (MFSCLs) and defocus incorporated multiple segments lenses (DIMS) to limit myopic progression in children with high myopia. METHODS: This retrospective study included 249 children (aged 8-16 years) with high myopia (non-cycloplegic spherical equivalent [SE] -6.00 to -10.00 D, astigmatism < 2.00 D). Selected participants were those treated with DIMS (N=81), MFSCLs (DISC, N=60), or single-vision spectacles (SVLs, N=108, control group). Myopic progression was assessed based on the 1-year SE change from baseline, categorized as slow (<-0.25 D), moderate (-0.25 to -0.75 D), or rapid (> -0.75 D). The multiple linear regression evaluated the association between myopic progression and characters. RESULTS: No significant differences in age, SE, or sex were found among the groups at baseline. At one year, the magnitude of myopic progression was significantly smaller in the DIMS (-0.47 ± 0.39 D, 33.8 %) groups and MFSCLs (-0.39 ± 0.47 D, 45.1 %) compared to the SVL group (-0.71 ± 0.54 D; P < 0.001). The proportion of slow progressors was 28.40 % (SVLs), 39.81 % (DIMS), and 51.67 % (MFSCLs). Age was associated with the myopic progression in the DIMS (β=0.108, P < 0.001) and SVLs (β=0.120, P < 0.001) group, but not in the MFSCLs (P=0.776) group. MFSCLs were preferred for children under 12 years, while DIMS and MFSCLs showed comparable efficacy for those over 12 with high myopia. CONCLUSIONS: Both MFSCLs and DIMS have demonstrated efficacy in delaying myopic progression in children with high myopia. The MFSCLs will give children better control up to the age of 12; after that, they remain a good option.

HAL VS DIMS vs CARE vs PDRE vs PAL 印度儿童研究

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2025年👥 Batra Sneha, Bandyopadhyay Supratik, Roy Swarup K, Saha Shyamal, Chakraborty Aroni, Datta Chandrani, Banerjee Joyashree, Sanyal Anupam

参考文献6-2-19 HAL VS DIMS vs CARE vs PDRE vs PAL 印度儿童研究 type I :DIMS;type II:HALT;type III: CARE;type IV:PDRE(周边离焦，类似蔡司的成长乐) ;type V:PAL 试验设计简述：回顾性队列研究 试验组样本量：216名印度儿童，397只眼 SE：所有MCG合并进展量-0.26D，疗效68.91% AL：所有MCG合并进展量0.16mm,疗效43.99% HAL和DIMS和CARE的近视控制效果无显著差异
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-19
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：明确五种近视控制眼镜（MCG）在印度儿童中的疗效。 研究方法：本研究为一项为期 1 年随访的回顾性队列研究，纳入 216 名 4 至 17 岁儿童的 397 只眼；受试者近视度数介于 - 0.75 至 - 10.00 屈光度（D）之间，散光度数不超过 4.00 D，且基线近视进展度数≥0.50 D。研究分析了使用以下五种近视控制眼镜（MCG）的儿童数据：Ⅰ 型（defocus incorporated multiple segments）、Ⅱ 型（highly aspherical lenslet target）、Ⅲ 型（cylindrical annular refractive elements）、Ⅳ 型（peripheral defocus reducing lenses）、Ⅴ 型（pediatric progressive addition lenses）。研究分析了屈光不正球镜当量（SER）与眼轴长度（AL）的平均变化，对比了 SER 与 AL 进展至生理水平的平均变化，并按年龄、性别及近视度数进行了亚组分析。 研究结果：所有 MCG 联合使用时，6 个月与 12 个月时 SER 和 AL 的平均变化分别为 - 0.05±0.23 D、-0.26±0.43 D、0.07±0.11 mm 和 0.16±0.18 mm。Ⅰ、Ⅱ、Ⅲ 型之间未观察到统计学显著差异。所有 MCG 联合使用 6 个月与 12 个月时的眼轴控制疗效、屈光控制疗效分别为 42.34%、43.99%、90.41% 和 68.91%。男孩与女孩之间无显著差异；年龄较大组在 6 个月和 12 个月时的眼轴控制疗效显著更优（P < 0.01）；低度近视儿童在 12 个月时的屈光控制疗效显著更高（P < 0.01）。 研究结论：在印度儿童中，Ⅰ、Ⅱ、Ⅲ 型近视控制眼镜（MCG）控制近视进展的疗效相当，其中年龄较大儿童与低度近视儿童的效果更优。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To determine the efficacy of five types of myopia control glasses (MCG) among Indian children. METHODS: A retrospective cohort study with 1-year follow-up was done in 397 eyes of 216 children aged 4 to 17 years, with myopia between -0.75 and -10.00 diopters (D), astigmatism of 4.00 D or less, and baseline progression of 0.50 D or greater. Data from children prescribed type I (defocus incorporated multiple segments), type II (highly aspherical lenslet target), type III (cylindrical annular refractive elements), type IV (peripheral defocus reducing lenses), and type V (pediatric progressive addition lenses) MCG were analyzed. Mean change in spherical equivalence of refractive error (SER) and axial length (AL) and percentage efficacy in reducing SER and AL progression to physiological levels were compared. Subgroup analysis was done by age, gender, and amount of myopia. RESULTS: Mean change in SER and AL at 6 and 12 months with all MCG combined was -0.05 ± 0.23 D, -0.26 ± 0.43 D, 0.07 ± 0.11 mm, and 0.16 ± 0.18 mm, respectively. No statistically significant difference was noted between types I, II, and III. Axial and refractive efficacy at 6 and 12 months of all MCG combined was 42.34%, 43.99%, 90.41%, and 68.91%, respectively. There was no significant difference among boys and girls. The older group showed significantly better axial efficacy (P < .01) at 6 and 12 months. Refractive efficacy was significantly higher at 12 months (P < .01) among children with low myopia. CONCLUSIONS: Types I, II, and III MCG are equally efficacious in controlling myopia progression among Indian children, with better results among older children and those with low myopia.

HAL vs DIMS - HAL更优

📖 Scientific Reports📅 2023年👥 Guo Hui, Li Xianfang, Zhang Xiaoxiao, Wang Haizhao, Li Jianhua

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-20
原文摘要
摘要 比较高非球面微透镜（HAL）与离焦整合多段式（DIMS）框架眼镜在 1 年内对近视进展的控制效果。本回顾性队列研究纳入了中国广州爱尔眼科医院中处方 HAL 、DIMS 框架眼镜儿童的数据。为解决部分儿童随访时间不足 1 年或超过 1 年这一差异，本研究计算了标准化的 1 年球镜当量屈光度（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）较基线的变化值。采用多变量线性回归模型比较两组间变化值的均值差异，模型中纳入了年龄、性别、基线 SER/AL 及治疗方式等变量。共纳入 257 名符合纳入标准的儿童进行分析（HAL 组 193 名，DIMS 组 64 名）。控制基线变量后，HAL 和 DIMS 框架眼镜使用者标准化的 1 年 SER 变化校正均值（标准误，SE）分别为 - 0.34（0.04）D 和 - 0.63（0.07）D。与 DIMS 眼镜相比，HAL 眼镜在 1 年内可减少 0.29 D 的近视进展（95% 置信区间 [CI]：0.13~0.44 D）。相应地，佩戴 HAL 眼镜和 DIMS 眼镜的儿童，其 AL 校正均值（SE）分别增加 0.17（0.02）mm 和 0.28（0.04）mm。与 DIMS 使用者相比，HAL 使用者的 AL 增长少 0.11 mm（95% CI：-0.20~-0.02 mm）。基线年龄与 AL 增长显著相关。佩戴 HAL 设计框架眼镜的中国儿童，其近视进展和眼轴增长程度均低于佩戴 DIMS 设计框架眼镜的儿童。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
To compare spectacle lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) versus defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) on myopia progression control in 1 year. This retrospective cohort study involved data from children prescribed HAL or DIMS spectacle lenses in Guangzhou Aier Eye Hospital, China. To address the discrepancy that some children followed up at less than or more than 1 year, the standardized 1-year spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) changes from baseline were calculated. The mean differences in the changes between the two groups were compared with linear multivariate regression models. Age, sex, baseline SER/AL, and treatment were included in the models. A total of 257 children who qualified for the inclusion criteria were included for the analyses (193 in the HAL group and 64 in the DIMS group). After controlling baseline variates, the adjusted mean (standard error, SE) of the standardized 1-year changes in SER for HAL and DIMS spectacle lens users were - 0.34 (0.04) D and - 0.63 (0.07) D, respectively. HAL spectacle lenses reduced myopia progression by 0.29 D (95% confidence interval [CI] 0.13 to 0.44 D) at 1 year compared to DIMS lenses. Accordingly, the adjusted mean (SE) ALs increased by 0.17 (0.02) and 0.28 (0.04) mm for children wearing HAL lenses and DIMS lenses, respectively. HAL users had 0.11 mm less AL elongation (95% CI - 0.20 to - 0.02 mm) than DIMS users. Age at baseline was significantly associated with AL elongation. Chinese children wearing spectacle lenses designed with HAL had less myopia progression and axial elongation than those wearing spectacle lenses designed with DIMS.

摘要 目的：比较两种不同设计的多点微透镜近视离焦眼镜［多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）与高非球面微透镜（HAL）］对儿童近视控制的临床效果。 方法：收集 2020 年 9 月 5 日至 2021 年 8 月 3 日在北京爱尔英智眼科医院配镜建档的 287 例儿童资料，其中观察组 190 例佩戴多点微透镜近视离焦眼镜（DIMS 组 88 例，HAL 组 102 例），对照组 97 例佩戴单焦点镜片（SVL）。提取右眼数据，比较配戴前及配戴后 6、12 个月的等效球镜度（SER）和眼轴长度变化。 结果：配戴 12 个月后，DIMS 组、HAL 组与 SVL 组屈光度变化分别为（-0.44±0.37）D、（-0.36±0.49）D（原文排印作 0.36±0.49 D）和（-0.91±0.60）D，DIMS 组与 HAL 组的屈光度增长均显著小于 SVL 组（P<0.05），HAL 组与 DIMS 组比较差异无统计学意义（P=0.29）。三组 12 个月的眼轴变化分别为（0.25±0.17）mm、（0.16±0.12）mm 和（0.47±0.31）mm，DIMS 组与 HAL 组眼轴增长均显著小于 SVL 组（P<0.05），且 HAL 组眼轴增长显著小于 DIMS 组（P<0.05）。 结论：DIMS 镜片与 HAL 设计镜片均能有效延缓儿童近视进展；在屈光度变化上两者差异无统计学意义，但在眼轴变化上 HAL 设计控制效果优于 DIMS 设计。

摘要 目的：比较佩戴角膜塑形镜（OK 镜）和特殊设计框架眼镜对低龄近视儿童眼轴控制的效果。 方法：回顾性队列研究。纳入 2021 年 9 月至 2023 年 5 月在成都爱迪眼科医院配镜的低龄中低度近视儿童 129 例（248 眼），分为 OK 镜组（60 例，115 眼）和特殊设计框架眼镜组（69 例，133 眼，包含三种设计亚组）。在小瞳下测量基线及戴镜 12 个月后的眼轴长度（AL），采用独立样本 t 检验和单因素方差分析比较组间差异。 结果：戴镜 12 个月，OK 镜组与框架镜组眼轴增长量分别为（0.27±0.17）mm 和（0.26±0.20）mm，差异无统计学意义（t=-0.26，P=0.798）。高非球面微透镜眼镜（HAL）、多焦点正向光学离焦眼镜（DIMS）和周边视力控制技术眼镜（蔡司成长乐加强版 ZMAA）三种框架眼镜的眼轴增长量分别为（0.17±0.19）mm、（0.29±0.22）mm 和（0.35±0.16）mm，总体差异有统计学意义（F=13.77，P<0.001）；HAL 控制效果优于 ZMAA（P<0.001）和 DIMS（P=0.007），DIMS 与 ZMAA 之间年增加量差异无统计学意义（P=0.212）。 结论：对于低龄近视儿童，佩戴 OK 镜与特殊设计框架眼镜对眼轴的控制效果相当。

Methods This was a retrospective cohort study. One hundred and twenty-nine low-age myopic children (248 eyes) who were fitted with lenses at Chengdu Aidi Eye Hospital from Sep. 2021 to May 2023 were included. Participants were divided into two groups based on the methods of correction: an OK lenses group (60 cases,115 eyes) and a special spectacle lenses group (69 cases,133 eyes )(including three design subgroups). All children underwent biometric measurements under small pupil conditions to assess axial length (AL) baseline and the 12-months follow-up AL. Independent sample t-tests and one-way ANOVA were utilized to compare the changes in AL between the OK lens group and the spectacle lens group, as well as among different spectacle lens subgroups. Results At 12 months after wearing, AL growth was (0. 27±0. 17) mm in the OK lens group and (0. 26±0. 20)mm in the spectacle group, with no statistically significant difference (t = -0. 26, P= 0. 798). AL growth was (0. 17±0. 19), (0. 29±0. 22), and (0. 35±0. 16)mm, resulted from the three different designs of frame glasses: highly aspheric multifocal ( HAL), defocus incorporated multiple segments ( DIMS), and peripheral vision control technology ( ZEISS Myovision ACE Asiana ZMMA), respectively, with statistically significant differences (F= 13. 77, P<0. 001). The control effect of HAL was superior to that of ZMAA and DIMS (P<0. 001, P = 0. 007), while there was no statistically significant difference in the annual increase of AL between DIMS and ZMAA (P= 0. 212). 摘要 目的：评估 MyopiaX 这款智能手机应用的安全性、耐受性及效应信号。该应用通过选择性向视神经头递送蓝光，以控制儿童和青少年的近视进展。 设计：多中心、随机、活性对照、检查者单盲的概念验证临床试验（NCT04967287）。研究对象：基线时年龄为 6-12 岁、睫状肌麻痹球镜当量屈光度数（SER）在 -0.75 至 -5.00 屈光度（D）之间的合格近视儿童。2021 年 11 月至 2023 年 9 月期间对儿童进行筛查和入组。 方法：儿童以 2:1 的比例随机分配至 MyopiaX 组或活性对照组。受试者需在试验前 6 个月每日使用 MyopiaX 两次，每次 10 分钟；在试验后 6 个月，除使用 MyopiaX 外，还需佩戴多点离焦（DIMS）近视控制眼镜。活性对照组在整个 12 个月的试验期间均佩戴 DIMS 眼镜。 主要结局指标：主要结局为 6 个月时眼轴长度（AL）变化和 SER 变化。对所有开始治疗的受试者进行临床安全性检查，并分析与设备相关的不良事件（AEs）的发生率和严重程度。 结果：在 124 名随机分配的受试者中，101 名按照 12 个月活性对照研究设计入组（MyopiaX 组：n=66；DIMS 组：n=35）。6 个月后，MyopiaX 组（n=50）和 DIMS 组（n=34）的平均眼轴长度较基线变化分别为 0.14 ± 0.11 mm 和 0.08 ± 0.09 mm。MyopiaX 组 6 个月时 SER 变化为 -0.18 ± 0.39 D，DIMS 组为 -0.16 ± 0.41 D。在 73 名使用 MyopiaX 的受试者中（包括在原始研究设计下随机分配的受试者，即引入活性对照前入组者），16 名受试者（22%）发生了 23 起相关不良事件，包括短暂的眼部不适和头痛，所有不良事件均无需治疗即可缓解。 结论：在未接受过近视治疗的儿童中，MyopiaX 为期 12 个月的使用具有安全性和良好耐受性。这项探索性研究首次提供了 MyopiaX 选择性蓝光刺激对近视进展和眼球生长影响的临床数据。这种新方法可能为进行性近视的临床管理提供一种补充治疗方案。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate the safety, tolerability, and signals of effect of MyopiaX, a smartphone app that selectively delivers blue light to the optic nerve head to control myopia progression in children and adolescents. DESIGN: Multicenter, randomized, active-controlled, examiner-masked proof-of-concept clinical trial (ClinicalTrials.gov identifier NCT04967287). PARTICIPANTS: Eligible children aged 6 to 12 years, with myopia of cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) between -0.75 and -5.00 diopters (D) at baseline. Children were screened and enrolled between November 2021 and September 2023. METHODS: Children were randomly assigned in a 2:1 ratio to MyopiaX or active control. Participants were instructed to use MyopiaX for 10 minutes twice daily for the first 6 months and, during the second 6 months of the trial, also wear defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) myopia control spectacles. The active control group wore DIMS spectacles for the entire 12-month trial. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: The primary outcome was change in axial length (AL) and change in SER at month 6. Clinical safety examinations and the frequency and severity of device-related adverse events (AEs) were analyzed for all participants who began treatment. RESULTS: Of the 124 randomized participants, 101 were enrolled under the 12-month active-control study design (MyopiaX: n = 66, DIMS: n = 35). After 6 months, the mean AL change from baseline in the MyopiaX (n = 50) and DIMS (n = 34) groups, respectively, was 0.14 ± 0.11 mm and 0.08 ± 0.09 mm. The 6-month change in SER was -0.18 ± 0.39 D in the MyopiaX group and -0.16 ± 0.41 D in DIMS participants. Among the 73 participants who used MyopiaX, including those randomized under the original study design (prior to introduction of an active control), there were 23 related AEs among the 16 participants (22%), including transient ocular discomfort and headache, all of which resolved without any need for treatment. CONCLUSIONS: MyopiaX was safe and well tolerated over 12 months in treatment-naive children with myopia. This exploratory study provides the first clinical data on the impact of MyopiaX's selective blue light stimulation on myopia progression and ocular growth. This novel approach may offer a complementary therapeutic solution for the clinical management of progressive myopia. FINANCIAL DISCLOSURES: Proprietary or commercial disclosure may be found in the Footnotes and Disclosures at the end of this article.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-24
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：本研究对比了多段离焦植入镜片（DIMS）、Myopi-X 渐进多焦镜片与单光镜片（SV）在真实世界中延缓儿童近视进展的 12 个月效果。 材料与方法：本项回顾性观察研究纳入 385 只佩戴上述三种镜片之一的眼目，记录研究对象的基线年龄、等效球镜度数（SER）及眼轴长度（AL）。采用克鲁斯卡尔 - 沃利斯检验结合邦费罗尼校正的两两比较法，分析等效球镜度数和眼轴长度 12 个月的变化情况；运用广义估计方程（GEE）评估治疗组、年龄组、性别及基线眼轴长度分组对等效球镜度数和眼轴长度变化的影响。 研究结果：研究对象包括 118 只佩戴 Myopi-X 镜片的眼目（32.4%）、107 只佩戴单光镜片的眼目（29.4%）和 139 只佩戴 DIMS 镜片的眼目（38.2%）。各组研究对象的基线人口学特征和眼部指标（包括年龄、性别、等效球镜度数、眼轴长度、年龄分组及基线眼轴长度分组）均具有可比性（所有 P 值均 > 0.05）。12 个月后，Myopi-X 组的平均等效球镜度数进展为 - 0.35±0.34 屈光度（D），单光镜片组为 - 0.46±0.37 屈光度，DIMS 组为 - 0.24±0.33 屈光度（P<0.001）；三组的平均眼轴长度增长量分别为 0.21±0.12 毫米、0.24±0.17 毫米和 0.17±0.16 毫米（P=0.004）。广义估计方程分析结果显示，治疗方案对等效球镜度数和眼轴长度的变化均存在显著影响（两项指标的 P 值均 < 0.001）。DIMS 组的近视进展程度最低，其次为 Myopi-X 组，单光镜片组的近视进展程度最高。基线眼轴长度分组是眼轴长度增长的唯一显著预测因素（β=0.210，95% 置信区间：0.189-0.231，P<0.001），基线眼轴长度较长的眼目，其眼轴增长幅度更大；年龄组和性别对等效球镜度数及眼轴长度的变化结果均无显著影响。 研究结论：12 个月的观察期内，DIMS 眼镜片在延缓屈光度数进展和眼轴长度增长方面，效果优于 Myopi-X 镜片和单光镜片。基线眼轴长度是眼轴增长的关键决定因素，这一结果提示在儿童近视管理中应实施个体化风险评估。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
OBJECTIVES: This study compared the 12-month real-world effectiveness of defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses, Myopi-X progressive addition lenses, and single-vision (SV) lenses in slowing myopia progression in children. MATERIALS AND METHODS: This retrospective observational study included 385 eyes using one of the three spectacle types. Baseline age, spherical equivalent refraction (SER), and axial length (AL) were recorded. Twelve-month changes in SER and AL were analyzed using the Kruskal-Wallis test with Bonferroni-adjusted pairwise comparisons. Generalized estimating equations (GEE) were used to assess the effects of treatment group, age group, sex, and baseline AL group on SER and AL changes. RESULTS: The study population consisted of 118 Myopi-X eyes (32.4%), 107 SV eyes (29.4%), and 139 DIMS eyes (38.2%). Baseline demographic and ocular characteristics (including age, sex, SER, AL, age group, and baseline AL group) were comparable among the groups (all p>0.05). After 12 months, mean SER progression was -0.35±0.34 diopters (D) in the Myopi-X group, -0.46±0.37 D in the SV group, and -0.24±0.33 D in the DIMS group (p<0.001). Mean AL elongation was 0.21±0.12 mm, 0.24±0.17 mm, and 0.17±0.16 mm, respectively (p=0.004). GEE analyses demonstrated a significant treatment effect for both SER and AL change (p<0.001 for both). The least progression occurred in the DIMS group, followed by Myopi-X, while the SV group showed the highest progression. Baseline AL group was the only significant predictor of AL elongation (β=0.210, 95% confidence interval: 0.189-0.231, p<0.001), with greater elongation in eyes with high baseline AL. Age group and sex did not significantly influence SER or AL outcomes. CONCLUSION: DIMS spectacle lenses were more effective than Myopi-X and SV lenses in reducing both refractive progression and axial elongation over 12 months. Baseline AL was a key determinant of axial growth, supporting the use of individualized risk assessment in pediatric myopia management.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：探讨当前不同设计的近视控制框架镜所产生的光调制，对视网膜敏感度的影响。 方法：研究者使用 Macular Integrity Assessment（MAIA）微视野仪，对 9 名健康受试者在佩戴当前近视控制框架镜时的视网膜敏感度及扫描激光检眼镜（SLO）眼底图像进行测量。所测试的镜片包括：MyoCare、Stellest、MiYOSMART 和 DOT；相应度数的单光镜片以及 0.8 级 Bangerter 遮挡膜（BF）作为比较对照。 结果：通过 SLO 图像，可以在视网膜层面观察到不同近视控制镜片设计所形成的光调制区域。不同镜片设计的清晰区大小存在差异，其中 DOT 镜片的清晰区最小。在局部光调制区域内，Stellest 和 MyoCare 镜片并未降低视网膜敏感度，而 MiYOSMART 镜片则出现了视网膜敏感度下降，提示其局部光调制作用更为明显。DOT 镜片可导致整体视网膜敏感度显著下降，但这种下降程度仍小于 Bangerter 遮挡膜。在所有情况下，视网膜敏感度均明显高于健康视网膜的正常范围下限。 结论：本研究所测试的镜片均未造成具有临床意义的视网膜敏感度下降，且其结果均显著优于最低等级（即 0.8 级）的 Bangerter 遮挡膜。鉴于目前的近视控制框架镜在长期延缓近视进展方面尚未表现出一致且足够的治疗效果，不同镜片之间在空间光调制方面可能存在细微但关键的差异。对于外观上看似相似的镜片设计，不能想当然地认为其治疗效果等同；必须对这些细微差别进行充分评估，才能准确判断其长期疗效。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate the influence of light modulation conferred by current designs of myopia control spectacles on retinal sensitivity. METHODS: Retinal sensitivity and scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) fundus images were obtained from nine healthy subjects using a Macular Integrity Assessment microperimeter with current myopia control spectacle lenses: MyoCare, Stellest, MiYOSMART and DOT. Respectively powered single vision lenses and a 0.8-grade Bangerter occlusion foil (BF) served as comparative controls. RESULTS: Using the SLO image, one can visualise the areas of light modulation of the various myopia control lens designs at the level of the retina. Clear zone sizes differ between lens designs, with the DOT lens having the smallest area. Retinal sensitivity in areas of local light modulation was not reduced for the Stellest and MyoCare lenses, but declined with the MiYOSMART lens, suggesting a more prominent local light modulation. The DOT lenses produced a significant reduction in overall retinal sensitivity, although the reduction with the BF was greater. In all instances, retinal sensitivity remained well above the range considered normal for a healthy retina. CONCLUSIONS: None of the lenses tested produced a clinically relevant reduction in retinal sensitivity and all scored significantly better than the lowest (that is, 0.8) grade BF. Given that current myopia control spectacles do not show consistent treatment effects as required to slow progression effectively over extended periods, there appears to be a subtle, yet crucial difference in spatial light modulation among these myopia control spectacle lenses. Seemingly similar lens designs cannot be assumed to have equivalent treatment effects; a thorough assessment of these nuances is essential to ensure accurate claims regarding their long-term efficacy.

摘要 目的：在真实世界条件下，比较延缓欧洲儿童近视进展的不同策略的有效性。 方法：本项回顾性、非随机研究评估了0.01%、0.025%和0.05%阿托品、多区正向离焦/高非球面微透镜（DIMS/HAL）眼镜、阿托品联合DIMS/HAL以及单光眼镜在288名近视进展（过去12个月内≥0.75 D）的欧洲儿童（5–12岁）中的疗效。主要结局指标为3年内每6个月测量一次的等效球镜度（SER）和眼轴长度变化。 结果：0.05%、0.025%和0.01%阿托品组的平均3年累计SER进展分别为-0.75±0.49 D、-0.92±0.52 D和-1.31±0.75 D；DIMS/HAL组为-1.31±0.76 D；0.01%阿托品+DIMS/HAL组为-1.11±0.65 D，与对照组（-2.14±0.72 D）相比均显示出更好的近视控制效果。阿托品表现出剂量依赖效应，其中0.05%阿托品在延缓近视进展和眼轴增长方面效果最为显著。 结论：该研究证实了低浓度阿托品和DIMS/HAL眼镜在延缓欧洲儿童近视进展中的有效性，其中0.05%阿托品的近视控制效果最为显著。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: Myopia control is crucial for pediatric eye care professionals. Although various treatments exist, their comparative efficacy, particularly in European populations, remains unclear. In real‐life conditions, this study aimed to compare different strategies to slow myopia progression. Methods: This retrospective, nonrandomized study evaluated the efficacy of 0.01%, 0.025%, and 0.05% atropine, defocus incorporated multiple segments/highly aspherical lenslets (DIMS/HAL) spectacles, combined atropine and DIMS/HAL, and single vision spectacles in 288 European children (aged 5–12 years) with myopia progression (≥0.75 D in the past 12 months). Primary outcomes were changes in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length measured every 6 months for 3 years. Results: The mean cumulative 3‐year SER progressions were −0.75 ± 0.49, −0.92 ± 0.52, and −1.31 ± 0.75 D for the 0.05%, 0.025%, and 0.01% atropine groups, respectively, −1.31 ± 0.76 D for the DIMS/HAL group, and −1.11 ± 0.65 D for the 0.01% atropine + DIMS/HAL group, showing better myopia progression control compared to those of the control group (−2.14 ± 0.72 D). Atropine exhibited a dose‐dependent effect, with 0.05% atropine achieving the greatest reduction in myopia progression and axial elongation. Conclusions: This study demonstrates the efficacy of low‐dose atropine and DIMS/HAL spectacles in slowing myopia progression in European children. The 0.05% atropine exhibited the most pronounced myopia control effect.

摘要 目的：比较多区正向离焦（DIMS）与高非球面微透镜（HAL）眼镜镜片在儿童中的真实世界近视控制效果，并评估年龄、基线屈光度和眼轴长度（AL）对疗效的修饰作用。 方法：本回顾性队列研究纳入180名配戴DIMS或HAL镜片≥12个月的儿童（6至14岁）。按基线等效球镜度（SER）将受试者分层为近视前期、低度近视和中度近视亚组。采用协方差分析评估年AL和SER变化，并检验交互项以评估效应修饰。 结果：调整后，HAL组年眼轴延长显著慢于DIMS组（调整后平均差=0.08 mm；95% CI: 0.03至0.12；P < 0.001），年SER进展亦显著更慢（-0.14 D；95% CI: -0.25至-0.03；P = 0.012）。观察到治疗与年龄对AL变化存在显著交互作用（P = 0.024）。HAL的优势在低龄儿童（≤10.5岁；AL差异=0.13 mm；P < 0.001）中尤为显著，但在较大年龄儿童中不显著。分类分析显示，HAL组的AL“良好应答者”比例更高（64.4% vs. 41.1%；P = 0.004），尤其在近视前期中最为突出；眼轴缩短仅在HAL配戴者中观察到（8.9%）。 结论：在为期1年的真实世界研究中，HAL镜片的近视控制效果优于DIMS镜片。年龄是关键的效应修饰因素，低龄儿童获益更大，支持分年龄层的临床决策。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To compare the real-world myopia control effectiveness of defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) versus highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) spectacle lenses in children, and assess effect modification by age, baseline refraction, and axial length (AL). Methods: This retrospective cohort study included 180 children (aged 6 to 14) wearing DIMS or HAL lenses for ≥12 months. Participants were stratified by baseline spherical equivalent (SER) into pre-myopia, low myopia, and moderate myopia subgroups. Annual AL and SER changes were analyzed using analysis of covariance, with interaction terms tested for effect modification. Results: After adjustment, the HAL group showed significantly slower annual axial elongation (adjusted mean difference = 0.08 mm; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.03 to 0.12; P < 0.001) and SER progression (−0.14 D; 95% CI, −0.25 to −0.03; P = 0.012) compared to DIMS. A significant treatment-by-age interaction was observed for AL change (P = 0.024). HAL’s advantage was pronounced in younger children (≤10.5 years; AL difference = 0.13 mm; P < 0.001) but not significant in older children. Categorically, HAL yielded a higher proportion of “good” AL responders (64.4% vs. 41.1%; P = 0.004), most notably in pre-myopia. Axial shortening was observed exclusively in HAL wearers (8.9%). Conclusions: Over one year, HAL lenses demonstrated superior myopia control efficacy versus DIMS in a real-world setting. Age was a key effect modifier, with greater benefit in younger children, supporting age-stratified clinical decision-making. Translational Relevance: This study identifies patient age as a key biological modifier of the treatment response to different optical designs, bridging the mechanistic understanding of visual development with actionable, personalized clinical prescribing for childhood myopia control.

参考文献6-2-29 DIMS vs DF软性角膜接触镜（MiSight, 库博光学） vs MF软性角膜接触镜 vs OK 研究中心：Glasgow Caledonian University，Myopia Management Clinic & Mhairi Day 研究类型：英国单中心、回顾性、真实世界队列研究。 分组：DIMS组28人、DF组16人、MF组11人、OK组9人 结果：只有约 33%的眼睛被判定为近视控制成功：平均眼轴增长速度减缓0.11 mm/年，而干预前眼轴增长越快，是干预后获得更大眼轴减缓幅度的主要预测因素。

摘要 目的：探索评估光学近视控制干预措施成功率的方法，并将其回顾性应用于临床人群。 方法：在英国一家近视门诊就诊的儿童患者中开展回顾性队列研究，患者使用多区正向离焦（DIMS）眼镜镜片、双焦点（DF）、多焦点（MF）或角膜塑形镜（OrthoK）隐形眼镜。通过多种方法定义干预成功（进展率达到阈值）：(1) 等效球镜屈光度（SER）变化；(2) 眼轴长度（AL）变化（基于个体、基于人群及基于百分位数）；(3) 干预期间的AL增长速率。采用线性回归分析确定对AL增长速率降低有显著影响的因素。 结果：共分析了64名儿童的128只眼（DIMS: 56，DF: 32，MF: 22，OrthoK: 18）。在各项评估方法中，33%的眼睛干预成功，32%达到了相应临床试验的平均AL延缓速率，基于个体的年龄调整后AL进展延缓量平均值（SD）为0.11（0.21）mm/年（95% CI: -0.31至0.53 mm/年）。仅在基于个体的AL变化方法中回归模型具有统计学意义，在该模型中，干预前更快的AL增长速率是AL更大幅度延缓的唯一显著预测因素。 结论：在英国临床人群中，监测干预前的AL进展速率有助于预测和衡量疗效。治疗反应存在较大变异性，且总体成功率为33%，有助于对光学近视管理干预措施的风险与获益开展平衡的讨论。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To explore methods of evaluating success of optical myopia control interventions, and to apply these methods retrospectively to a clinical population. Methods: A retrospective cohort study was conducted on pediatric patients attending a United Kingdom myopia clinic and used defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses, dual‐focus (DF), multifocal (MF) or orthokeratology (OrthoK) contact lenses. An intervention was deemed as successful if the progression rate met a threshold value using a variety of methods: (1) spherical equivalent refraction (SER) change; (2) axial length (AL) change (individual‐based, population‐based, and percentile‐based); and (3) AL rate during intervention. Linear regression analyses were conducted to deter- mine which factor(s) had a significant effect on the reduction in AL rate. Results: One hundred twenty‐eight eyes of 64 children were analyzed (DIMs: 56, DF: 32, MF: 22, OrthoK: 18). Across the methods to assess success, 33% of eyes had a successful outcome and 32% obtained the mean AL reduction rate from equivalent clinical trials, with a mean (SD) individual‐based age‐adjusted reduction in AL progression of 0.11 (0.21) mm/year, 95% CI: −0.31 to 0.53 mm/ year. Regression models were significant for the individual‐based AL change method only, and for this regression, a faster AL rate preintervention was the only significant predictor of a larger AL reduction. Conclusions: Monitoring the rate of AL progression prior to intervention has advantages such as predicting and measuring success in this UK clinical pop- ulation. The large variability in treatment response and the 33% overall success rate should help inform balanced discussions about the risks/benefits of optical myopia management interventions.

参考文献6-2-31 DIMS vs OK非劣效RCT-DIMS不劣于OK 起始时间：2021年11月注册，丹麦单中心临床试验 试验设计简述：RCT-非劣效研究，6-12岁近视儿童，DIMS vs OK，随访18个月；非劣效界值为AL差异0.13mm 试验组样本量：DIMS组45人；OK组45人 AL：DIMS-OK的校正后差异为-0.05mm（95%CI -0.13至0.04），满足非劣效标准但未证明优效；整体眼长差异-0.04mm（95%CI -0.12至0.04）。OK组发生1例不良事件。

摘要 目的：确定多区正向离焦（DIMS）眼镜镜片在延缓儿童近视进展方面是否非劣于角膜塑形镜（OKL）。 方法：在南丹麦大学医院开展平行分组、非劣效性随机临床试验，比较DIMS眼镜镜片与OKL在6–12岁近视儿童中的疗效。主要结局指标为治疗18个月后的眼轴长度增长（校正OKL组中央角膜厚度变化）。非劣效性标准为两组治疗差异估计值（DIMS - OKL）的95%置信区间（95% CI）上限≤0.13 mm；若非劣效则进一步检验优效性（95% CI上限<0）。关键次要结局指标为治疗18个月后的全眼长度增长。 结果：90名受试者被随机分配至DIMS镜片组（n=45）和OKL组（n=45），主要结局采用意向性分析。在调整了基线年龄、基线睫状肌麻痹等效球镜屈光度、基线眼轴长度及近视父母人数的混合模型中，两组眼轴延长的组间差异（DIMS - OKL）为-0.05 mm（95% CI: -0.13至0.04），低于非劣效性界值且高于0。两组全眼长度延长的组间差异为-0.04 mm（95% CI: -0.12至0.04）。OKL组观察到1起不良事件。 结论：在近视儿童治疗18个月后，DIMS镜片在延缓眼轴延长方面非劣于OKL，但未优于OKL。DIMS镜片与OKL在全眼长度增长上无统计学显著差异。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Background To determine whether the Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lens is non-inferior to Orthokeratology lenses (OKL) in slowing the progression of myopia in children. Methods A parallel-group, non-inferiority randomised clinical trial at the University Hospital of Southern Denmark compared the myopia control treatment efficacy of DIMS spectacle lenses with OKL in myopic children aged 6–12 years. Our primary outcome was axial length growth after 18 months of therapy, adjusted for change in central corneal thickness in the OKL group. The participants were allocated to the treatments using centralised computer-generated randomisation. The interpreters were blinded. Non-inferiority was concluded if the upper bound of the 95% confidence interval (95% CI) for the estimated treatment difference (DIMS – OKL) after 18 months was equal to or below 0.13 mm. In case of non-inferiority, superiority was tested in the same population. Superiority was declared if the upper 95%Cl bound was below zero. Our key secondary outcome was overall eye length growth after 18 months of therapy and was assessed for superiority. Results 90 participants were randomised to DIMS spectacle lenses (n = 45) and OKL (n = 45). For the primary outcome, 45 participants were analysed in both the DIMS spectacle lens and OKL groups using an intention-to-treat approach. A per-protocol approach was used for sensitivity analysis. The between-group difference (DIMS – OKL) in axial elongation was −0.05 mm (95% CI −0.13; 0.04) in a mixed model adjusted for covariates: age at baseline, baseline cycloplegic spherical equivalent refractive error, baseline axial length, and number of myopic parents, which is below the non-inferiority margin and above zero. The between-group difference (DIMS – OKL) in overall eye length elongation was −0.04 mm (95% CI −0.12; 0.04). One adverse event was observed in the OKL group. Conclusions The DIMS spectacle lens was noninferior to OKL for slowing axial elongation after 18 months of therapy in myopic children. The DIMS spectacle lens was not superior to OKL. There was no statistically significant difference in overall eye length growth between the DIMS spectacle lens and OKL after 18 months of therapy in myopic children.

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-2-32 DIMSvs0.01%ATP-DIMS更优 起始时间：2023年2月；招募时间为2023年2月至11月。 研究机构&通讯作者：波兰西里西亚医科大学等机构 试验设计简述：2年随机对照试验，比较DIMS镜片+安慰剂滴眼液与单光眼镜+0.01%阿托品。 试验组样本量：110名6–16岁儿童，两组各55人；完成2年随访96人，其中阿托品组44人、DIMS组52人。 SE：24个月时，DIMS组进展−0.47±0.47 D，阿托品组−0.70±0.58 D；6–11岁儿童分别为−0.59±0.48 D、−1.05±0.64 D。 AL：24个月时，DIMS组增长0.22±0.22 mm，阿托品组0.32±0.29 mm；6–11岁儿童分别为0.30±0.23 mm、0.48±0.31 mm。 结论：DIMS组近视进展较少，组间差异在6–11岁儿童中显著，在12–16岁儿童中无统计学意义。阿托品组依从性较低，可能影响疗效比较。

摘要 目的：评估多区正向离焦（DIMS）眼镜镜片与0.01%阿托品滴眼液在延缓欧洲儿童2年近视进展中的效果。 方法：共110名无明显眼部病变的波兰和乌克兰儿童（6–16岁）随机分配至单光眼镜联合每晚0.01%阿托品组（A组）或DIMS镜片联合每晚安慰剂组（B组）。主要结局指标为每6个月评估一次的睫状肌麻痹等效球镜屈光度（SER）和眼轴长度变化。 结果：在24个月时，B组平均眼轴增长（0.22±0.22 mm）低于A组（0.32±0.29 mm），该差异在6–11岁儿童中尤为显著（0.30±0.23 mm vs 0.48±0.31 mm）。SER进展呈现类似趋势：B组为0.47±0.47 D，A组为0.70±0.58 D，在低龄儿童中差异最大（0.59±0.48 D vs 1.05±0.64 D）；在较大年龄儿童中组间差异较小。 结论：在本研究中，DIMS镜片在延缓近视进展方面比0.01%阿托品显示出更好的效果，尤其是在6–11岁儿童中。解释结果时应考虑不同干预措施之间的依从性差异。DIMS镜片可作为欧洲人群近视控制的有效选择。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: The global increase in childhood myopia underscores the need for effective control strategies. This study evaluated the effectiveness of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses versus 0.01% atropine eye drops in slowing myopia progression in European children over two years. Methods: A total of 110 Polish and Ukrainian children aged 6−16 years without significant ocular pathology were randomised to single-vision spectacles plus nightly 0.01% atropine (group A) or DIMS lenses plus nightly placebo (group B). Primary outcomes were changes in cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length, assessed at 6-month intervals. Results: At 24 months, mean axial elongation was lower in group B (0.22 ± 0.22 mm) than in group A (0.32 ± 0.29 mm), particularly among children aged 6−11 years (0.30 ± 0.23 mm vs 0.48 ± 0.31 mm). Similar patterns were observed for SER progression: 0.47 ± 0.47 D in group B versus 0.70 ± 0.58 D in group A, with the greatest difference in younger children (0.59 ± 0.48 D vs 1.05 ± 0.64 D). Differences in older children were smaller. Conclusions: In this study, DIMS lenses were associated with greater efficacy than 0.01% atropine in reducing myopia progression, particularly in children aged 6−11 years. Differences in adherence between the interventions should be considered when interpreting these findings. DIMS lenses may represent an effective option for myopia control in European populations.

DIMSvsPALvsSVL-西班牙儿童近视进展、双眼视及视觉表现的比较纵向评估-DIMS略优

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-2-33 DIMSvsPALvsSVL-西班牙儿童近视进展、双眼视及视觉表现的比较纵向评估-DIMS略优 起始时间：2023年9月；研究开展时间为2023年9月至2025年6月。 试验设计简述：18个月前瞻性、非随机比较观察性研究，以单光镜组为对照。 试验组样本量：入组45名9–14岁儿童，SV组16人、DIMS组16人、PALs组13人；18个月SE及AL数据共34人，分别为11人、13人、10人。 SE：18个月时，SV组、PALs组和DIMS组分别进展−0.59 D、−0.51 D和−0.30 D；DIMS组较SV组的SE进展幅度减少约49%。 AL：18个月时，SV组、PALs组和DIMS组分别增长0.32 mm、0.27 mm和0.23 mm，组间差异无统计学意义。（注：摘要中SV组为0.24 mm，此处采用正文及Table 3的0.32 mm。） 结论：DIMS组SE进展较少，但眼轴增长的组间差异不显著；结果需结合非随机设计、样本量较小及非睫状肌麻痹验光等局限解释。

摘要 目的：评估不同光学矫正方式对西班牙儿童近视进展、双眼视功能及视觉质量的影响。 方法：这项为期18个月的前瞻性、非随机对照观察性研究纳入45名9–14岁近视受试者，分别配戴单光镜片（SV）、低下加光渐进多焦点镜片（PALs）或多区正向离焦镜片（DIMS）。在基线及第6、12、18个月评估等效球镜度（SE）、眼轴长度（AL）、调节功能（调节幅度、正负相对调节、调节灵敏度及调节反应）、双眼视功能（隐斜视、融像性聚散及立体视）、对比敏感度（CS）、视觉干扰指数（VDI）及主观视觉质量。 结果：18个月后，SV组、PALs组和DIMS组的SE进展分别为-0.59 D、-0.51 D和-0.30 D，DIMS组较SV组进展延缓了49%；三组AL分别增加0.24 mm、0.27 mm和0.23 mm，组间差异无统计学意义。各组调节与双眼视功能、视力、CS及VDI保持稳定，DIMS组远距离立体视有所改善。 结论：在该队列中，与SV镜片相比，配戴DIMS镜片与近视进展减缓相关，且对调节功能、双眼视功能、视力或主观视觉质量未产生具有临床意义的差异。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
An 18-month prospective, non-randomized comparative observational study evaluated the effects of different optical corrections on myopia progression, binocular vision, and visual performance in Spanish children. Forty-five myopic participants aged 9–14 years were allocated to single-vision lenses (SV), low-addition progressive addition lenses (PALs), or defocus-incorporated multiple segments lenses (DIMS). Assessments included spherical equivalent (SE) and axial length (AL), comprehensive accommodative function evaluated by measuring amplitude of accommodation, positive and negative relative accommodation, accommodative facility, and accommodative response, and binocular function evaluated by measuring phorias, fusional vergences, and stereopsis. In addition, contrast sensitivity (CS), visual disturbance index (VDI), and subjective visual quality were assessed at baseline and at 6, 12, and 18 months. After 18 months, SE progression was −0.59 D for SV, −0.51 D for PALs, and −0.30 D for DIMS, corresponding to a 49% reduction with DIMS compared to SV. AL increased by 0.24, 0.27, and 0.23 millimeters, respectively, although inter-group differences were not significant for AL. Accommodative and binocular functions, visual acuity, CS, and VDI remained stable, while distance stereopsis improved in the DIMS group. These findings suggest an association between DIMS lens wear and reduced myopia progression compared with SV lenses in this cohort, without clinically relevant differences in accommodative or binocular function, visual acuity, or subjective visual quality.

HOADvsDIMSvsHALTvsDSDOvsSVL-the comparative effectiveness of 4 myopia-control spectacle lenses - a real-world APIW cohort study

参考文献6-2-34 HOAD vs DIMS vs HALT vs DSDO vs SVL - RWS 起始时间：2023年1月 – 2026年1月 研究中心&PI：成都中医药大学附属银海眼科医院 & 段俊国 试验设计：回顾性AIPW队列研究 样本量：共2764人；HOAD 912人、DIMS 800人、HAL 476人、DSDO 238人、SV（单光） 338人 SE：1年变化量分别为 HOAD -0.146 D，HAL -0.253 D，DIMS -0.276 D，DSDO -0.316 D，SV -0.514 D。4款控制镜片均显著优于SV。快速进展率（≤-0.75 D/年）分别为 HOAD 8.3%，HAL 13.2%，DIMS 15.2%，DSDO 17.9%，SV 36.6%。 AL：1年增长量分别为 HOAD 0.107 mm，HAL 0.149 mm，DIMS 0.175 mm，DSDO 0.205 mm，SV 0.258 mm。4款控制镜片均显著减缓眼轴增长。快速增长率（≥0.2 mm/年）分别为 HOAD 25.5%，HAL 30.7%，DIMS 38.1%，DSDO 45.1%，SV 58.1%。

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：利用双重稳健因果推断框架，比较四款近视控制眼镜镜片干预措施在儿童近视控制中的真实世界效果。 方法：本回顾性队列研究基于多处理增强逆概率加权方法，纳入2023年1月至2026年1月间成都中医药大学银海眼科医院的2764名3–18岁近视儿童（右眼）。受试者分为高阶像差离焦组（n=912）、多区正向离焦组（n=800）、高非球面微透镜组（n=476）、多样化分段离焦优化组（n=238）以及单光镜片组（n=338）。主要结局指标为1年眼轴长度和等效球镜度变化，次要结局指标为快速进展率。 结果：调整后，四款近视控制设计均显著优于单光矫正（p < 0.05）。基于高阶像差离焦的设计效果最显著，眼轴长度变化为0.107 mm，等效球镜度变化为-0.146 D；该组中25.5%的儿童出现眼轴快速增长（≥0.36 mm/年），8.3%出现近视快速进展（≥-0.50 D/年）。该治疗效果在低度近视或眼轴长度≤26 mm的儿童中具有统计学显著性（p < 0.05），但在高度近视或病理性眼轴延长儿童中不显著。 结论：在真实世界临床实践中，四款近视控制眼镜镜片设计均表现出显著优于单光矫正的优势。应特别重视近视控制眼镜在近视早期的作用；随着近视进展为高度近视或病理性眼轴延长，单独使用近视控制镜片的效果减弱，可能需要结合多种近视管理策略进行联合干预。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: We aimed to compare the real-world effectiveness of four myopia-control spectacle lens interventions for childhood myopia control using a doubly robust causal inference framework. Design: This was a retrospective cohort study with multi-treatment augmented inverse probability weighting. Participants: A total of 2764 myopic children (right eyes) aged 3–18 years were included, screened from 13,071 electronic medical records at Ineye Hospital, Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, between January 2023 and January 2026. Methods: Participants were allocated to four myopia-control spectacle lens groups and one single-vision spectacle lens group: Higher-Order Aberration Defocus (n = 912), Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (n = 800), Highly Aspherical Lenslets (n = 476), Diversified Segmental Defocus Optimization (n = 238), and single-vision lenses (n = 338). A doubly robust estimator combining multinomial propensity-score weighting with outcome regression was applied to adjust for confounding. Outcome Measures: The primary outcomes were one-year changes in axial length and spherical equivalent. The secondary outcomes were the rates of rapid progression. Treatment-effect heterogeneity was explored across prespecified baseline age, refractive error, and axial length subgroups. Results: After adjustment, all four myopia-control designs significantly outperformed single-vision correction (p < 0.05). The design based on Higher-Order Aberration Defocus demonstrated the greatest efficacy, with an axial length change of 0.107 mm and a spherical equivalent change of −0.146 D. Within this group, 25.5% of children exhibited rapid axial elongation (≥0.36 mm/year) and 8.3% exhibited rapid myopic progression (≥−0.50 D/year). The treatment effect was statistically significant in children with low myopia or an axial length no greater than 26 mm (p < 0.05), but not in those with high myopia or pathological axial elongation. Conclusions: All four myopia-control spectacle lens designs demonstrated significant advantages over single-vision correction in real-world clinical practice. Particular emphasis should be placed on the role of myopia-control spectacles during the early stages of myopia. As myopia progresses to high myopia or pathological axial elongation, the efficacy of myopia-control spectacle lenses as a standalone intervention diminishes, and combined approaches incorporating multiple myopia management strategies may be warranted.

Assessing the rebound phenomenon in different myopia control treatments: A systematic review

原文摘要
摘要 目的：探讨不同近视控制治疗停止后的反弹效应。 方法：本研究按照 PRISMA 声明开展系统综述，于 2023 年 6 月 15 日至 6 月 30 日在 PubMed 和 Web of Science 两个数据库中检索文献，纳入包含全文的随机对照研究（RCTs）及针对 RCTs 的事后分析研究（需报告近视控制治疗反弹效应的新发现）。采用 Cochrane 偏倚风险评估工具对所选研究的质量进行分析。 结果：本系统综述共纳入 11 项研究。综合所有近视控制治疗的反弹效应数据，在 10.2±7.4 个月的洗脱期后，眼轴长度（AL）和等效球镜度数（SER）的平均反弹效应分别为 0.10±0.07 mm [−0.02~0.22] 和−0.27±0.2 D [−0.71~−0.03]。此外，与阿托品和低水平光疗法相比，采用高非球面微透镜或离焦整合多段技术的眼镜、软性多焦点接触镜及角膜塑形术的反弹效应更低，其 AL 和 SER 的平均反弹效应分别为 0.04±0.04 mm [0~0.08] 和−0.13±0.07 D [−0.05~−0.2]。 结论：不同的近视控制治疗在停止后均会产生反弹效应。具体而言，光学类治疗的反弹效应似乎低于药物治疗或光疗法。但仍需更多研究验证上述结果。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To review the rebound effect after cessation of different myopia control treatments. METHODS: A systematic review that included full-length randomised controlled studies (RCTs), as well as post-hoc analyses of RCTs reporting new findings on myopia control treatments rebound effect in two databases, PubMed and Web of Science, was performed according to the PRISMA statement. The search period was between 15 June 2023 and 30 June 2023. The Cochrane risk of bias tool was used to analyse the quality of the selected studies. RESULTS: A total of 11 studies were included in this systematic review. Unifying the rebound effects of all myopia control treatments, the mean rebound effect for axial length (AL) and spherical equivalent refraction (SER) were 0.10 ± 0.07 mm [-0.02 to 0.22] and -0.27 ± 0.2 D [-0.71 to -0.03] after 10.2 ± 7.4 months of washout, respectively. In addition, spectacles with highly aspherical lenslets or defocus incorporated multiple segments technology, soft multifocal contact lenses and orthokeratology showed lower rebound effects compared with atropine and low-level light therapy, with a mean rebound effect for AL and SER of 0.04 ± 0.04 mm [0 to 0.08] and -0.13 ± 0.07 D [-0.05 to -0.2], respectively. CONCLUSIONS: It appears that the different treatments for myopia control produce a rebound effect after their cessation. Specifically, optical treatments seem to produce less rebound effect than pharmacological or light therapies. However, more studies are required to confirm these results.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-4 效果预测 （包括脉络膜厚度） / 6-4-1
原文摘要
摘要 背景：多焦点离焦（DIMS）框架眼镜等近视控制干预措施已用于学龄儿童，以降低近视患病率及其并发症发生率。本研究旨在探讨两年期间 DIMS 框架眼镜对黄斑中心凹下脉络膜厚度（SfChT）的影响，因为脉络膜对近视控制的反应是探究其在预测近视进展方面潜在作用的关键因素。 方法：本研究为既往随机临床试验的二次分析。研究纳入 8~13 岁近视学龄儿童，开展为期两年的研究，探究 DIMS 框架眼镜对近视进展的影响。治疗组（n=78）佩戴 DIMS 框架眼镜，对照组（n=80）佩戴单光（SV）框架眼镜。采用频域光学相干断层扫描（SD-OCT）及基于卷积神经网络的定制自动分割算法，在佩戴眼镜后 1 周、1 个月、3 个月、6 个月、12 个月、18 个月和 24 个月时监测 SfChT。 结果：与佩戴 SV 框架眼镜的儿童相比，佩戴 DIMS 框架眼镜 1 周后，儿童的 SfChT 显著增加（一周时相对于基线的校正平均变化 ± 标准误；DIMS 组 vs. SV 组，6.75±1.52 µm vs. -3.17±1.48 µm；一般线性模型分析，P<0.0001）。佩戴 DIMS 眼镜 12 个月后，儿童脉络膜厚度增加至 13.64±2.62 µm，而 SV 组儿童脉络膜厚度减少（-9.46±2.55 µm）。在两年研究期间，DIMS 组和 SV 组的脉络膜变化均与眼轴伸长呈显著负相关。控制年龄和性别因素后，3 个月时的脉络膜变化可显著预测 12 个月时的眼轴长度（AL）变化。 结论：本研究表明，佩戴含近视离焦设计的框架眼镜 1 周后，脉络膜显著增厚，且这种增厚效应在两年研究期间持续存在。结果提示，3 个月时的脉络膜变化可能有助于预测 1 年后的眼轴长度变化。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: Myopia control interventions, such as defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses, have been adopted in school-aged children to reduce the prevalence of myopia and its complications. This study aimed to investigate the effect of DIMS spectacle lenses on subfoveal choroidal thickness (SfChT) over a period of two years, as the choroidal response to myopic control is a crucial factor in exploring its potential effect on predicting myopia progression. METHODS: This study involved a secondary analysis of our previous randomized clinical trial. Myopic school-aged children aged 8-13 years were recruited in a two-year study investigating the effect of DIMS spectacle lenses on myopia progression. The treated group received DIMS spectacle lenses (n = 78), while the control group was treated with a pair of single vision (SV) spectacle lenses (n = 80). SfChT was monitored at 1 week, 1, 3, 6, 12, 18 and 24 months post lens wear using spectral-domain optical coherence tomography and a custom made auto-segmentation algorithm utilizing convolutional neural networks. RESULTS: SfChT increased significantly after one week of DIMS spectacle lens wear compared to those wearing SV spectacle lenses (adjusted mean change relative to baseline ± SEM at one week; DIMS vs. SV, 6.75 ± 1.52 µm vs. - 3.17 ± 1.48 µm; P < 0.0001, general linear model). The thickness of choroid increased to 13.64 ± 2.62 µm after 12 months of DIMS lens wear while the choroid thinned in SV group (- 9.46 ± 2.55 µm). Choroidal changes demonstrated a significant negative association with axial elongation over two years in both the DIMS and SV groups. Choroidal change at three months significantly predicted the changes in AL at 12 months after controlling the effect of age and gender. CONCLUSIONS: Our study demonstrated a significant choroidal thickening in response to myopic defocus incorporated in a spectacle lens after one week of lens wear, sustained over the two-year study period. The results suggested that choroidal changes at three months may help predict changes in axial length after one year. Trial registration ClinicalTrials.gov. Myopia control with the multi-segment lens. NCT02206217. Registered 29 July 2014, https://clinicaltrials.gov/ct2/show/study/NCT02206217.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-4 效果预测 （包括脉络膜厚度） / 6-4-2
原文摘要
摘要 目的：评估近视控制眼镜片（离焦整合多段 / DIMS）在中欧不同儿科人群中延缓近视进展的效果，并探究基线参数对治疗结局的影响。 方法与分析：本回顾性观察性研究纳入 62 例 4-17 岁（均值 ± 标准差：10.21±2.70 岁）进展性近视患儿，无眼部病变，等效球镜度数（SER）范围为 - 0.88 至 - 8.25 屈光度（D）（-3.73±1.56 D），散光度数最高达 - 3.25 屈光度（柱镜）。所有参与者均处方 DIMS（豪雅 MiyoSmart）眼镜。主要结局指标包括：所有参与者均测量的睫状肌麻痹状态下等效球镜度数（SER），以及部分患儿测量的眼轴长度（AL），上述指标均在基线、6 个月和 12 个月时记录。生活质量评估在基线、2 周、3 个月、6 个月、9 个月和 12 个月时进行。此外，还记录了适用情况下父母的近视屈光度。 结果：在 12 个月时，患儿近视进展（均值 ± 标准误：-0.40±0.05 D）与此前欧洲 DIMS 研究结果一致，但 50% 的患儿未出现近视进展。多变量协方差分析模型显示，基线散光和低龄对 SER 和 AL 的治疗结局均产生不利影响，而母亲重度近视会导致 SER 进展更显著。相反，在 LIFE 儿童研究中佩戴单光眼镜的可比近视患儿群体中，仅低龄与 AL 增长相关，散光则无此关联。患儿对治疗的满意度稳定，副作用极少，且在一年内逐渐减轻。 结论：在欧洲人群中，散光、低龄和母亲重度近视是 DIMS 治疗后结局不佳的危险因素。需进一步研究阐明散光对近视离焦治疗的影响。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
OBJECTIVE: To assess the efficacy of myopia control spectacle lenses (defocus incorporated multiple segments/DIMS) in slowing myopia progression among a diverse Central European paediatric population and investigate the contribution of baseline parameters on treatment outcomes. METHODS AND ANALYSIS: This retrospective observational study included 62 individuals aged 4-17 years (mean±SD: 10.21±2.70) with progressing myopia but without ocular pathology with a range of -0.88 to -8.25 D spherical equivalent refraction (SER) (-3.73±1.56), coupled with astigmatism up to -3.25 D cylindrical. All participants were prescribed DIMS (Hoya MiyoSmart) spectacles. Key outcome variables were cycloplegic SER, measured for all participants and axial length (AL), assessed in a subset of patients, recorded at baseline, 6 months and 12 months. Quality of life assessments were conducted at baseline, at 2 weeks, and 3, 6, 9 and 12 months. Additionally, parental myopic dioptre was recorded when applicable. RESULTS: At the 12-month mark, myopia progression in patients (mean±SE: -0.40±0.05) mirrored findings from prior European DIMS studies, but with 50% of patients showing no progression. A multivariate analysis of covariance model revealed that baseline astigmatism and younger age adversely affected therapy outcomes in both SER and AL, while severe maternal myopia led to greater SER progression. In contrast, only young age but not astigmatism was associated with AL increase in a comparable group of children with myopia, part of the LIFE Child Study, wearing single-vision spectacles. Patients reported consistent satisfaction with treatment, with minimal side effects, which diminished over the year. CONCLUSION: In the European population, astigmatism, young age and severe maternal myopia are risk factors for suboptimal outcomes following DIMS therapy. Further research is necessary to elucidate the impact of astigmatism on myopic defocus therapy.

原文摘要
摘要 本研究旨在探讨基线周边相对屈光度（RPR）是否会影响中国近视儿童佩戴离焦整合多段（DIMS）框架眼镜的近视控制效果。在一项为期 2 年的随机对照试验中，每 6 个月测量一次受试者视网膜鼻侧 10°、20°、30°（分别记为 10 N、20 N、30 N）和颞侧 10°、20°、30°（分别记为 10 T、20 T、30 T）的周边屈光度，并分析基线周边屈光度与近视进展及眼轴长度变化的关系。研究共纳入 DIMS 组 79 名儿童和单光（SV）组 81 名儿童。调整共变量后，DIMS 组中，基线周边相对屈光度等效球镜度（SE）越偏向近视，近视进展越显著（10 N：相关系数 r=0.36，p=0.001；20 N：r=0.35，p=0.001），眼轴伸长量也越大（10 N：r=-0.34，p=0.001；20 N：r=-0.29，p=0.006）。SV 组中，经邦费罗尼校正（p>0.008）后，基线周边相对屈光度仅与近视进展相关（10 N：r=0.37，p=0.001；20 N：r=0.36，p=0.001；30 N：r=0.35，p=0.002），与眼轴伸长量无相关性。两组中，视网膜颞侧周边屈光度与近视进展及眼轴伸长量均无统计学意义上的关联。DIMS 组中，基线周边相对屈光度为近视型的儿童，其近视进展量（平均差异约 - 0.40 D）和眼轴伸长量（平均差异 0.15 mm）均显著大于基线周边相对屈光度为远视型的儿童；而 SV 组中无此差异。综上，对于佩戴单光眼镜的儿童，基线周边相对屈光度分布可能不影响未来的近视进展或眼轴伸长。 然而，DIMS镜片能延缓近视进展，且对于基线视网膜前部距离（RPR）为远视的儿童，其近视控制效果优于RPR为近视的儿童。或许这部分解释了为何近视儿童的近视控制效果存在差异。为个体定制近视散光度数可优化近视控制效果，有必要开展进一步研究以确定最佳配镜方案，同时需考虑周边视网膜形态特征。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
The aim of this study is to investigate if baseline relative peripheral refraction (RPR) influences the myopia control effects in Chinese myopic children wearing Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) lenses. Peripheral refraction at 10°, 20°, and 30° nasal (10 N, 20 N, 30 N) and temporal (10 T, 20 T, 30 T) retina were measured at six-month intervals for children who participated in a 2-year randomized controlled trial. The relationship between the baseline peripheral refractions and myopia progression and axial length changes were analysed. A total of 79 children and 81 children in the DIMS and single vision (SV) group were investigated, respectively. In the DIMS group, more baseline myopic RPR spherical equivalent (SE) was associated with more myopic progression (10 N: r = 0.36, p = 0.001; 20 N: r = 0.35, p = 0.001) and greater axial elongation (10 N: r = −0.34, p = 0.001; 20 N: r = −0.29, p = 0.006) after adjusting for co-factors. In the SV group, baseline RPR had association with only myopia progression (10 N: r = 0.37, p = 0.001; 20 N: r = 0.36, p = 0.001; 30 N: r = 0.35, p = 0.002) but not with axial elongation after Bonferroni correction (p > 0.008). No statistically significant relationship was found between temporal retina and myopia progression or axial elongation in both groups. Children with baseline myopic RPR had statistically significant more myopia progression (mean difference around −0.40 D) and more axial elongation (mean difference 0.15 mm) when compared with the children having baseline hyperopic RPR in the DIMS group but not in the SV group. In conclusion, the baseline RPR profile may not influence future myopia progression or axial elongation for the SV lens wearers. However, DIMS lenses slowed down myopia progression and was better in myopia control for the children with baseline hyperopic RPR than the children with myopic RPR. This may partially explain why myopia control effects vary among myopic children. Customised myopic defocus for individuals may optimise myopia control effects, and further research to determine the optimal dosage, with consideration of peripheral retinal profile, is warranted.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-4 效果预测 （包括脉络膜厚度） / 6-4-4
原文摘要
摘要 目的：旨在探究离焦区域与离焦量、昼夜节律及调节功能对近视离焦诱导的视网膜和脉络膜变化的影响。 设计：使用了四种测试镜片：单光软性隐形眼镜（SVCL）、下视野附加+3.50屈光度（D）的双焦眼镜片（BSL）、多焦点离焦框架镜（DIMS），以及附加+2.00 D的双焦点隐形眼镜（DFCL）。 受试者：纳入 21 名 18-30 岁成年人，近视度数为 1.00-6.00 D。 方法：每位受试者在 4 个不同日期随机佩戴四种镜片进行测试。在上午 10 点和下午 5 点两个时间点，受试者分别佩戴四种测试镜片进行 20 分钟的远距视物（4 米）和近距视物（20 厘米）后，接受光学相干断层扫描（OCT）和 OCT 血管造影检查。 主要结果指标：评估指标包括视网膜厚度（RT）、脉络膜厚度（ChT）及血管密度。 结果：视网膜厚度（RT）、视网膜及脉络膜血管密度的变化在不同镜片组间或不同时间点间均无显著差异（均 P>0.05）。在上午和下午的近距视物后，以及上午的远距视物后，不同镜片组间的脉络膜厚度变化存在显著差异（均 P<0.05）。与单光软镜（SVCL）相比，双焦框架镜（BSL）、多焦点离焦框架镜（DIMS）和双焦软镜（DFCL）均能显著降低脉络膜厚度（ChT）的减少量（均 P<0.05），且双焦框架镜（BSL）的减少量最小。所有镜片均无法完全抑制近距视物后的脉络膜变薄。 结论：近视离焦在上午对脉络膜变薄的抑制效果更显著，且在视网膜上方区域提供充足离焦时效果更佳。本研究中镜片的离焦量（+3.50 D）不足以完全抑制 5 D 调节状态下的脉络膜变薄。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To explore the effect of defocus region and amount, diurnal rhythm, and accommodation on myopic defocus-induced changes in the retina and choroid. DESIGN: Four test lenses were used: single-vision soft contact lens (SVCL), bifocal spectacle lens (BSL) with +3.50 diopters (D) addition in the inferior visual field, defocus incorporated multiple segments lens (DIMS), and dual-focus contact lens (DFCL) with +2.00 D addition. PARTICIPANTS: Twenty-one adults aged between 18 and 30 years, myopia between -1.00 D and -6.00 D, were included. METHODS: Four lenses were used in random order at 4 separate days for each participant. Participants underwent OCT and OCT angiography examinations after distance-viewing (4 m) and near-viewing (20 cm) for 20 minutes with 4 test lenses at both 10 am and 5 pm. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Retinal and choroidal thicknesses (RT and ChT) and vessel density were assessed. RESULTS: The changes in RT, retinal and choroidal vessel density were not significantly different between lenses or times (all P > 0.05). Choroidal thickness changes differed between lenses after near-viewing in both the morning and evening and after distance-viewing in the morning (all P < 0.05). Compared with SVCL, BSL, DIMS, and DFCL achieved lower ChT reductions (all P < 0.05), and BSL showed least reduction. No lenses completely inhibited ChT thinning after near-viewing. CONCLUSIONS: Myopic defocus inhibited choroid thinning more effectively in the morning, and provided sufficient defocus in the superior retina was more effective. The amount of lens defocus in this study (+3.50 D) was insufficient to inhibit choroidal thinning with 5 D accommodation completely. FINANCIAL DISCLOSURES: Proprietary or commercial disclosure may be found in the Footnotes and Disclosures at the end of this article.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-4 效果预测 （包括脉络膜厚度） / 6-4-5
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：探讨影响佩戴离焦整合多段（DIMS）框架眼镜儿童眼轴长度（AL）增长的脉络膜及眼部生物学参数。 研究方法：本队列研究纳入 106 例 7~14 岁近视儿童，随访 1 年。根据 1 年内眼轴长度（AL）的增长情况，将受试者分为两组：眼轴快速增长组（增长 > 0.2 mm）和眼轴缓慢增长组（增长≤0.2 mm）。在基线、随访 6 个月及 12 个月时，分别进行睫状肌麻痹自动验光并测量眼轴长度（AL）；同时测量基线时的脉络膜毛细血管FVs面积及脉络膜厚度（ChT）。 研究结果：单变量线性回归分析显示，眼轴增长与FVs面积（标准化 β=0.198，P<0.05）及年龄（标准化 β=-0.201，P<0.05）显著相关。多变量线性回归分析显示，FVs面积、年龄及平均角膜曲率（平均 K 值）与眼轴增长相关。多变量 logistic 回归分析显示，近视度数更高、FVs面积更大是眼轴快速增长的危险因素，而年龄较大、瞳孔直径较大及角膜曲率较大则具有保护作用。在眼轴增长预测中，单独使用FVs面积的曲线下面积（AUC）为 0.672（95% 置信区间：0.569~0.775，P<0.01）；联合使用FVs面积与其他眼部参数的曲线下面积（AUC）为 0.788（95% 置信区间：0.697~0.878，P<0.001）。 研究结论：基线时更大的脉络膜毛细血管FVs面积或有助于预测近视患者的眼轴增长。在未来的近视队列研究中，应考虑FVs面积与眼轴增长之间的关联。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate choroidal and ocular biological variables that influence axial length (AL) elongation in children wearing defocused incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses. METHODS: This cohort study included 106 myopic children aged 7-14 years with a 1-year follow-up. Participants were divided into two groups according to the increase in AL in one year: rapid (>0.2 mm) and slow (≤0.2 mm) axial elongation groups. Cycloplegic autorefraction and AL were measured at baseline and after 6 and 12 months. The area of choriocapillaris flow voids (FVs) and choroidal thickness (ChT) at baseline were measured. RESULTS: Univariate linear regression analysis showed that AL elongation were significantly associated with the FVs area (standardised β = 0.198, P < 0.05) and age (standardised β = -0.201, P < 0.05). Multiple linear regression showed that the FVs area, age, and average K reading were associated with AL elongation. Multiple logistic regression analyses showed that greater degrees of myopia and larger FVs areas were risk factors for rapid axial elongation, while older age, large pupil diameter and steeper cornea were protective factors. In estimating axial elongation, the FVs area alone demonstrated an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.672 (95% CI, 0.569-0.775, P < 0.01), and that of FVs area and other ocular variables was 0.788 (95% CI, 0.697-0.878, P < 0.001). CONCLUSION: Larger choriocapillaris FVs area at baseline may help to predict axial elongation in myopic eyes. The association between FVs area and axial elongation should be taken into consideration in further myopic cohort studies.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-4 效果预测 （包括脉络膜厚度） / 6-4-6
原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在比较多种近视控制方法（包括阿托品、角膜塑形镜（OK 镜）、离焦软镜（MiSight®，简称 MS 镜）及多焦点离焦框架镜（Hoya Miyosmart®，简称 HY 镜））对近视儿童脉络膜厚度的影响。 方法：本单中心回顾性研究于 2023 年 12 月至 2024 年 9 月在中国台湾台中中国医药大学附设医院开展。根据治疗方式将患者分为四组：阿托品组、OK 镜组、MS 镜组及 HY 镜组。治疗 6 个月后，采用增强深度成像光学相干断层扫描（EDI-OCT）在 7 个特定位置测量脉络膜厚度。采用单因素方差分析（one-way ANOVA）和事后检验进行统计分析，显著性水平设定为 P<0.05。 结果：研究共纳入 51 名 5-15 岁儿童（102 只眼）。参与者分为四组：阿托品组（n=34）、OK 镜组（n=44）、MS 镜组（n=16）及多焦点离焦框架镜（DIMS 镜，即 HY 镜）组（n=8）。在大多数测量点，OK 镜组和 DIMS 镜组的脉络膜厚度均显著大于阿托品组。OK 镜组的脉络膜厚度始终大于 MS 镜组，而 MS 镜组与阿托品组相比无显著差异。HY 镜组的效果与 OK 镜组相似，表明两者在增加脉络膜厚度方面的疗效相当。 结论：接受角膜塑形镜和多焦点离焦框架镜治疗的儿童，其脉络膜厚度大于使用离焦软镜和阿托品的儿童，这表明不同近视控制干预措施的作用机制存在差异。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study aimed to compare the effects of various myopia control methods, including atropine, orthokeratology (OK) lenses, defocus soft contact lenses (MiSight®, MS), and defocus incorporated multiple segment spectacle lenses (Hyoa Miyosmart®, HY), on choroidal thickness in children with myopia. METHODS: This single-center, retrospective study was conducted at China Medical University Hospital in Taichung, Taiwan, from December 2023 to September 2024. Patients were divided into four groups based on treatment modality: atropine, OK lenses, MS lenses, and HY lenses. Choroidal thickness was measured after six months of treatment using enhanced depth imaging OCT at seven specific locations. Statistical analysis was performed using one-way ANOVA and post-hoc tests, with significance set at P < 0.05. RESULTS: A total of 51 children (102 eyes) aged 5-15 years were included in the study. Participants were divided into four groups: atropine (n = 34), OK lenses (n = 44), MS lenses (n = 16), and Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments spectacle lens (DIMS), HY lenses (n = 8). Both OK lenses and DIMS lenses demonstrated significantly greater choroidal thickness compared to atropine across most measurement points. OK lenses consistently exhibited thicker choroids than MS lenses, while MS lenses showed no significant difference compared to atropine. HY lenses exhibited similar effects to OK lenses, indicating comparable efficacy in enhancing choroidal thickness. CONCLUSION: Children treated with orthokeratology and defocus-incorporated spectacle lenses exhibited greater choroidal thickness compared to those using defocus soft contact lenses and atropine, highlighting the variability in mechanisms among different myopia control interventions.

参考文献6-4-7 DIMS 8+年长期随访-基线RPR影响长期反应 起始时间：源自2014年开始的DIMS RCT及后续3年、6年、8+年随访 研究中心&PI：香港理工大学视光学院 & Carly S.Y. Lam / Han Yu Zhang / Tsz Wing Leung 试验设计简述：长期观察性随访，完成6年随访者继续邀请回访；按长期镜片佩戴模式和基线相对周边屈光（RPR）分层，并与历史SV对照比较AL变化 样本量：60人完成8+年随访；38人为基线远视性RPR，22人为近视性RPR 结论：基线近视性RPR儿童在DIMS长期治疗中获益较弱；排除近视性RPR后，DIMS较SV减少AL增长0.13mm；在远视性RPR持续DIMS佩戴者中，相比历史对照8+年AL减少0.57mm，控制效果约56%。基线RPR可用于个性化处方和识别需联合/替代治疗的人群。

摘要 目的：评估多区正向离焦（DIMS）眼镜镜片在儿童中超过8年的长期有效性，并明确影响治疗反应的因素，特别是基线相对周边屈光度（RPR）。 方法：回顾性分析一项为期8年的DIMS镜片近视控制有效性研究的数据。根据镜片佩戴类型（DIMS与单光镜片SV）对受试者进行分析，并按基线RPR进行分类。通过将8年DIMS亚组与历史对照组进行比较来计算有效性，分析包括和排除了近视性RPR受试者。 结果：完成既往6年随访的受试者中，有60名参加了8年以上的随访调查：基线时分别有38名和22名表现为远视性RPR和近视性RPR。在整个研究期间持续佩戴DIMS镜片者（n=14）中，近视性RPR亚组（n=4）在6至8年以上期间的眼轴增长显著大于远视性RPR亚组（n=10）（平均差值：0.17±0.06 mm，p=0.009）。排除近视性RPR受试者后，与SV佩戴者相比，DIMS佩戴者的眼轴增长显著减少（平均差值：0.13±0.05 mm，p=0.009），但近视进展差异无统计学意义（p=0.12）。在整个8年以上的周期中，远视性RPR的DIMS佩戴者（n=10）与历史对照组（n=62）相比实现了56%的近视控制效果，眼轴增长显著减少0.57 mm（p<0.0001）。 结论：本研究代表了迄今为止DIMS眼镜镜片用于近视控制的最长试验后随访调查。基线RPR改变了对DIMS镜片的长期反应：基线为近视性RPR的儿童有效性降低，可能需要替代或辅助方案；而远视性RPR儿童的治疗效果维持超过8年，从儿童期延续至青年早期。因此，基线RPR评估可为个性化近视控制处方提供参考。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
PURPOSE: This observational follow-up evaluated the long-term efficacy of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses in children over 8 years and identified factors that influence the treatment response, particularly baseline relative peripheral refraction (RPR). METHODS: Data from an 8-year study of DIMS lens myopia control effectiveness was reviewed retrospectively. Participants were analysed by types of lens wear (DIMS vs. single vision (SV)) and categorised by baseline RPR. Effectiveness was calculated by comparing the 8-year DIMS subgroup against historical controls, with analyses including and excluding participants with myopic RPR. RESULTS: Sixty participants who completed the previous 6-year follow up, attended the 8+ year investigation: 38 and 22 exhibited hyperopic and myopic RPR at baseline, respectively. Among continuous DIMS lens wear (n = 14) for the whole period, the myopic RPR subgroup (n = 4) showed statistically significantly greater axial elongation than the hyperopic RPR subgroup (n = 10) between 6 to 8+ years (mean difference: 0.17 ± 0.06 mm, p = 0.009). Excluding myopic RPR participants, DIMS wearers exhibited a statistically significant reduction in axial elongation compared with SV wearers (mean difference: 0.13 ± 0.05 mm, p = 0.009), though myopia progression did not differ significantly (p = 0.12). Over the full 8+ year period, DIMS wearers with hyperopic RPR (n = 10) achieved a 56% myopia control effectiveness compared with the historical control group (n = 62), with a statistically significant reduction in axial elongation of 0.57 mm (p < 0.0001). CONCLUSIONS: This study represents the longest post-trial follow-up investigation of DIMS spectacle lenses for myopia control to date. Baseline RPR modified the long-term response to DIMS spectacle lenses: children with myopic RPR showed reduced efficacy and may require alternative or adjunctive strategies, whereas in those with hyperopic RPR, treatment effect was maintained for more than 8 years, extending beyond childhood into young adulthood. Therefore, baseline RPR assessment may inform personalised myopia control prescribing.

DIMS- systemic metabolic and skeletal muscle-related profiles associated with annual axial elongation across optical myopia-control strategies in adolescents - a retrospective cohort study

青少年光学近视控制中代谢及骨骼肌特征与眼轴增长的关联

📖 Ophthalmol Ther📅 2026年👥 X. Wang, W. Wang, F. Han, T. Li, W. Kang, X. Yang, J. Wang, L. Yang
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-4-8 青少年光学近视控制中代谢及骨骼肌特征与眼轴增长的关联 资料时间：2023年1月至2024年12月。 研究中心&通讯作者：沧州市中心医院 & 王雪（Xue Wang）。 研究设计：单中心回顾性队列研究。 样本量：3270名7–18岁儿童青少年；SV组795人、DIMS组1017人、OK组1458人；调整分析纳入2267人。 SE：未报告各组SE控制效果。 AL：年增长中位数分别为SV 0.396、DIMS 0.289、OK 0.240 mm/year（P<0.001）；调整后DIMS、OK较SV分别少增长0.089、0.143 mm/year（均P<0.001）。 其他结果：较高BMI z评分、胰岛素抵抗及GLP-1RA使用记录与较快眼轴增长相关，但不能推断药物导致眼轴增长。骨骼肌指数无独立关联，握力呈非线性关联。

摘要 目的：探讨全身代谢及骨骼肌相关特征与青少年近视控制治疗期间年眼轴增长的关联，将记录的胰高血糖素样肽-1受体激动剂（GLP-1RA）状态作为临床标志物而非独立药物暴露进行评估。 方法：本回顾性研究纳入3270名接受单光眼镜、多区正向离焦（DIMS）镜片或角膜塑形镜治疗的7-18岁青少年。主要结局为年眼轴增长；复合治疗失败为探索性结局。采用多变量回归、样条模型、治疗分层分析以及稳定逆概率治疗加权（IPTW）进行分析。主要校正分析纳入2267例完整病例。修订后的探索性肌肉脆弱性评分排除了GLP-1RA状态和使用时间。 结果：在3270名受试者中，484人有GLP-1RA使用记录，且表现出更高的肥胖及胰岛素抵抗负担，以及较差的肌肉和活动状况。在综合模型中，BMI z评分（每单位β = 0.020 mm/年；95% CI 0.014–0.026）和HOMA-IR（每单位β = 0.007 mm/年；95% CI 0.004–0.009）与更大的年眼轴增长相关。骨骼肌指数无独立相关性，而握力呈非线性关联（非线性P = 0.002）。记录的GLP-1RA状态与每年多增加0.040 mm的眼轴增长相关（95% CI 0.031–0.049），且在不同近视控制方案间无异质性（交互作用P = 0.646）。经IPTW及综合校正后，该效应值减弱至0.032 mm/年（95% CI 0.021–0.043），17个协变量中有4个存在残余不平衡。在综合模型（OR 1.23；95% CI 0.93–1.63）和IPTW后（OR 1.17；95% CI 0.80–1.70），与探索性复合治疗失败的关联在统计学上均不明确。 结论：代谢脆弱性与年眼轴增长略有增加相关，但所观察到差异的临床意义仍不确定。记录的GLP-1RA状态识别了代谢高风险亚组，但未确立药物效应。肌肉相关发现并不一致，且存在残余混杂。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Introduction: Axial elongation varies among adolescents receiving myopia-control treatment, but the contribution of systemic metabolic and skeletal muscle-related characteristics remains uncertain. We examined these associations, treating recorded glucagon-like peptide 1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA) status as a clinical marker rather than an independent drug exposure. Methods: This retrospective study included 3270 adolescents aged 7–18 years receiving single-vision spectacles, defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lenses, or orthokeratology. The primary outcome was annual axial elongation; composite treatment failure was exploratory. Multivariable regression, spline models, treatment-stratified analyses, and stabilized inverse probability of treatment weighting (IPTW) were performed. Primary adjusted analyses included 2267 complete cases. The revised exploratory muscle-vulnerability score excluded GLP-1RA status and duration. Results: Among 3270 participants, 484 had recorded GLP-1RA use and showed greater obesity and insulin-resistance burden and less favorable muscle and activity profiles. In the comprehensive model, BMI z-score (β = 0.020 mm/year per unit; 95% CI 0.014–0.026) and HOMA-IR (β = 0.007 mm/year per unit; 95% CI 0.004–0.009) were associated with greater annual axial elongation. Skeletal muscle index was not independently associated, whereas handgrip strength showed a nonlinear association (P for nonlinearity = 0.002). Recorded GLP-1RA status was associated with 0.040 mm/year greater elongation (95% CI 0.031–0.049), without heterogeneity across myopia-control strategies (P for interaction = 0.646). After IPTW and comprehensive adjustment, the estimate attenuated to 0.032 mm/year (95% CI 0.021–0.043), with residual imbalance in four of 17 covariates. Associations with exploratory composite treatment failure were statistically uncertain in the comprehensive model (OR 1.23; 95% CI 0.93–1.63) and after IPTW (OR 1.17; 95% CI 0.80–1.70). Conclusions: Metabolic vulnerability was associated with modestly greater annual axial elongation, although the clinical importance of the observed difference remains uncertain. Recorded GLP-1RA status identified a metabolically higher-risk subgroup but did not establish a drug effect. Muscle-related findings were not uniform, and residual confounding remained.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：分析离焦光学眼镜和散射光学眼镜产生的视网膜阴影的光学相干断层扫描（OCT）图像。 方法：为一只眼睛依次适配豪雅离焦整合多段（DIMS）眼镜片、两种不同版本的 + 3.50 D 周边附加度数眼镜片（DEFOCUS）以及低对比度点阵镜片（散射光学多段镜片，DOMS）；每款镜片的顶点距离均为 12 mm。同时，采用红外 OCT 获取中央注视状态下黄斑区的视网膜图像。通过光学生物测量仪测定角膜屈光力和眼内距离。 结果：DIMS和DOMS镜片的视网膜图像显示周边区域存在明显的视网膜阴影模式，而中央10–11°区域保持清晰。DEFOCUS镜片则产生了周边暗化区域。通过OCT软件卡尺测量视网膜影像尺寸，并除以镜片实际尺寸，得出放大倍率为-0.57倍。该结果与OCT入射光束成像于距眼球前部约31毫米处的位置相符。 研究结论：通过设备特异性校正，视网膜 OCT 图像可帮助可视化近视控制眼镜所诱导的离焦或对比度降低所影响的区域。这对改进近视治疗方法具有潜在价值。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To analyse ocular coherence tomography (OCT) images of the retinal shadows caused by defocus and diffusion optics spectacles. METHODS: One eye was fitted successively with the Hoya Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lens, two variations of the +3.50 D peripheral add spectacle (DEFOCUS) and the low-contrast dot lens (Diffusion Optics Multiple Segments, DOMS); each at a vertex distance of 12 mm. Simultaneously, a retinal image of the macular region with central fixation was obtained using infrared OCT. The corneal power and intraocular distances were determined using an optical biometer. RESULTS: The retinal images for the DIMS and DOMS lenses showed patterns of obvious retinal shadows in the periphery, while the central 10-11° remained clear. The DEFOCUS lens produced a darkened peripheral area. Dividing the size of the retinal pattern, measured with the calliper of the OCT software, by the actual size on the spectacle lens gave a magnification of -0.57 times. This is consistent with the incoming OCT beam being imaged to a position approximately 31 mm beyond the front of the eye. [Correction added on 26 October 2023 after first online publication: The preceding paragraph was corrected.] CONCLUSION: With device-specific correction, retinal OCT images can help visualise the regions affected by the defocus or lowered contrast induced by myopia control spectacles. This is of potential value for improving myopia therapies.

Myopia control and modulation transfer functions for multisegment spectacle lenses

离焦or对比度？-MTF检测

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2025年👥 Charman W Neil, Atchison David A
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-5-2 离焦or对比度？-MTF检测 实验设计：建模研究 结论：注视点 20°-50° 范围内的物体需通过载体镜片的小透镜覆盖区域观测，该区域会产生低通空间频率滤波效应。此时视觉分辨率局限于每度几个周数，因此任何（眼球）生长控制机制都必须依赖低空间频率信息。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-5 机制探索 / 6-5-2
原文摘要
摘要 引言：多段式（MS）框架镜片的中心区域透明，可实现远视力矫正，且前表面周边区域分布着一系列小型正屈光力小透镜，已被证实能有效延缓儿童近视进展。关于其作用机制是源于离焦效应，还是源于小透镜带来的图像对比度变化，目前仍存在争议。本研究通过建模分析不同条件下多段式镜片 - 眼球组合光学系统的调制传递函数（MTF）表现，探讨上述第二种可能性。 方法：使用光学设计软件 Ansys Zemax OpticsStudio，分别测定单光镜片、豪雅（Hoya）MiyoSmart 多段式镜片与 4 屈光度近视眼球模型组合后的远视力调制传递函数（MTF）。实验条件包括：镜片与眼球同轴时观测轴向及周边物体，以及眼球偏离镜片光轴旋转、通过镜片小透镜覆盖区域观测物体。同时估算了各条件下的视觉分辨率。 结果：与通过单光镜片观测相比，通过小透镜阵列观测物体时，调制传递效率显著降低，且空间频率越高，降低越明显。在视场角约为 32.5° 的周边观测中，成像质量较差。通过多段式镜片透明中心区域进行轴向观测时，中心凹成像质量优于眼球旋转约 30° 时的成像质量。 结论：佩戴多段式镜片时，通过镜片透明中心区域注视物体可获得最佳视觉分辨率。在此情况下，注视点 20°-50° 范围内的物体需通过载体镜片的小透镜覆盖区域观测，该区域会产生低通空间频率滤波效应。此时视觉分辨率局限于每度几个周数，因此任何（眼球）生长控制机制都必须依赖低空间频率信息。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
INTRODUCTION: Multisegment (MS) spectacle lenses, providing a distance correction with a clear central area and by having an array of small, positively powered lenslets in the periphery of the front surface, have proved effective in slowing childhood myopia progression. Debate continues as to whether their mechanism of action is due to through-focus effects or to the image contrast changes due to the inclusion of the lenslets. This study explores the second possibility by modelling the performance of a combined MS lens-eye optical system in terms of its modulation transfer function (MTF) under various conditions. METHODS: The optical design program Ansys Zemax OpticsStudio was used to determine distance MTFs for the combination of either a single-vision or a Hoya MiyoSmart MS lens with a 4 D myopic eye model. Conditions included axial and peripheral objects with co-axial lens and eye, and rotating the eye away from the lens axis to observe objects through the lenslet-covered region of the lens. Visual resolution under each condition was estimated. RESULTS: Observing objects through the lenslet array lowered modulation transfer in comparison with that given by the single-vision lens, especially as spatial frequency increased. In peripheral observation at a field angle of approximately 32.5 degrees, imagery was poor. Foveal image quality was better with axial viewing through the clear MS lens centre than when the eye was rotated by approximately 30 degrees. CONCLUSIONS: Optimal visual resolution during MS lens wear is achieved when fixating through the clear, central area of the lens. Under these circumstances, objects at 20-50 degrees from fixation are seen through the lenslet-covered region of the carrier which produces a low-pass spatial frequency filtering effect. Here, visual resolution is limited to a few cycles per degree so that any growth control mechanism must rely on low spatial frequency information.
