原文摘要
摘要 引言：多段式（MS）眼镜旨在通过改变落在周边视网膜上的成像来延缓近视进展。已发表的有关这类镜片的部分光学研究假设光线垂直入射镜片表面，但落在周边视网膜上的成像通常与斜射光束相关。本研究针对使用斜射光束时，豪雅（Hoya）MiyoSmart 多段式眼镜镜片所形成的点物典型成像进行建模分析。 方法：采用 Ansys Zemax OpticStudio 光学设计软件，对多段式（MS）镜片单独使用时，以及与适用于 4 屈光度近视患者的调节眼模型组合使用时的各项成像特性进行了评估。研究的配置包括：物点聚散度为 0 屈光度和 - 4 屈光度，且物点要么位于镜片光轴上，要么处于约 30° 的视场角位置。同时，还考虑了眼睛光轴相对于镜片光轴旋转对中央凹视觉的影响。通过点列图和快速傅里叶变换点扩散函数对於点物成像进行描述。 结果：由于镜片和眼睛的轴外像差增加，随着光束斜射程度的加大，成像的对称性和整体光学质量会下降。近距物点的成像受调节水平的影响显著：当调节作用使载体镜片的焦点靠近视网膜（而非微透镜的焦点靠近视网膜）时，视网膜成像质量达到最佳。 结论：要理解多段式镜片为何能延缓近视进展，需考虑在整个视野范围内，离焦视网膜成像质量随光束斜射程度的变化方式，以及眼睛调节可能产生的影响。 6-5-4摘要 目的： 周边离焦和图像对比度调节是近视控制中的关键策略，但二者都会在一定程度上降低视网膜图像对比度。目前尚无体内研究直接比较这些影响。本研究旨在评估不同近视控制眼镜的对比度降低特征，以更好地理解其潜在作用机制。 方法： 研究使用双通道仪器，在模型眼和人眼中获取通过焦点图像，并比较佩戴四种近视控制眼镜时的结果，包括 DIMS、Stellest、扩散光学技术镜片（DOT）和 MyoCare。裸眼作为参考。共测试 13 名受试者，平均年龄为 29.0 ± 3.5 岁；测量位置包括中心凹，以及颞侧和上方视野 10°、20°偏心位置。镜片偏心 1.5 cm，以评估离轴效应。模型眼测试仅包括中心视野。视网膜图像对比度通过通过焦点图像中像素强度的变异系数计算。 结果： 在模型眼中，视网膜图像对比度从高到低依次为：裸眼、DIMS、DOT、MyoCare 和 Stellest。在体内实验中，由于 DOT 信号较弱，其结果被排除。非参数检验显示，不同镜片在中心凹以及颞侧/上方 10°视野处的视网膜图像对比度存在显著差异。事后分析显示，Stellest 产生的视网膜图像对比度降低最明显，而 MyoCare 和 DIMS 表现出相似程度的对比度损失。 结论： 所有近视控制镜片都会降低视网膜图像对比度，其中 Stellest 引起的降低最强，MyoCare 和 DIMS 的影响相近。镜片诱导的光学效应主要影响近周边视野的图像对比度，而在更大偏心位置，人眼自身的光学因素占主导作用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
INTRODUCTION: Multisegment (MS) spectacles are intended to slow myopia progression by modifying images falling on the peripheral retina. Some published optical treatments of these lenses assume normal incidence of light at the surfaces, but images falling on the peripheral retina are usually associated with oblique ray pencils. Here, we model representative images of point objects produced by the Hoya MiyoSmart MS spectacle lens when oblique ray pencils are used. METHODS: Various imaging aspects of the MS lens alone and in combination with a suitable accommodating eye model for a 4D myope were evaluated using the Optical Design program Ansys Zemax OpticStudio. Configurations studied included object points at vergences of zero and -4 D, with the objects being either on the lens axis or at a field angle of about 30°. The effect on foveal vision of rotating the axis of the eye with respect to that of the lens was also considered. Images of point objects were described in terms of spot diagrams and fast Fourier transform point-spread functions. RESULTS: Symmetry and overall optical quality of images decreased with the obliquity of the ray pencils, due to the increased off-axis aberrations of the lens and the eye. Images of near object points were strongly affected by the level of accommodation: optimal retinal image quality occurred when accommodation brought the carrier lens focus close to the retina, rather than that of the lenslets. CONCLUSIONS: Attempts to understand why MS lenses slow myopia progression need to consider the way in which through-focus retinal image quality changes with obliquity of the ray pencils across the visual field and the possible effects of ocular accommodation.

Impact of Myopia Control Spectacles on Retinal Image Contrast

HALT vs. DIMS vs. DOT vs. MyoCare对视网膜图像对比度影响的比较研究

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2026年👥 Lin Zhenghua, Christaras Dimitrios, Ginis Harilaos, Yang Zhikuan, Lan Weizhong, Artal Pablo
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-5-4 HALT vs. DIMS vs. DOT vs. MyoCare对视网膜图像对比度影响的比较研究 样本量：13名，男性8，平均年龄29.00±3.51岁，平均等效球镜度-1.77±1.77D，右眼 结论：在光线经过近视控制镜片的周边功能区时，视网膜图像对比度会降低，尤其在中心和近周边视野（10°）更明显。降低程度受镜片设计和个体眼部光学影响，其中HALT最明显，MyoCare 和DIMS较接近。

原文摘要
摘要 目的： 周边离焦和图像对比度调节是近视控制中的关键策略，但二者都会在一定程度上降低视网膜图像对比度。目前尚无体内研究直接比较这些影响。本研究旨在评估不同近视控制眼镜的对比度降低特征，以更好地理解其潜在作用机制。 方法： 研究使用双通道仪器，在模型眼和人眼中获取通过焦点图像，并比较佩戴四种近视控制眼镜时的结果，包括 DIMS、Stellest、扩散光学技术镜片（DOT）和 MyoCare。裸眼作为参考。共测试 13 名受试者，平均年龄为 29.0 ± 3.5 岁；测量位置包括中心凹，以及颞侧和上方视野 10°、20°偏心位置。镜片偏心 1.5 cm，以评估离轴效应。模型眼测试仅包括中心视野。视网膜图像对比度通过通过焦点图像中像素强度的变异系数计算。 结果： 在模型眼中，视网膜图像对比度从高到低依次为：裸眼、DIMS、DOT、MyoCare 和 Stellest。在体内实验中，由于 DOT 信号较弱，其结果被排除。非参数检验显示，不同镜片在中心凹以及颞侧/上方 10°视野处的视网膜图像对比度存在显著差异。事后分析显示，Stellest 产生的视网膜图像对比度降低最明显，而 MyoCare 和 DIMS 表现出相似程度的对比度损失。 结论： 所有近视控制镜片都会降低视网膜图像对比度，其中 Stellest 引起的降低最强，MyoCare 和 DIMS 的影响相近。镜片诱导的光学效应主要影响近周边视野的图像对比度，而在更大偏心位置，人眼自身的光学因素占主导作用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: Peripheral defocus and image contrast modulation are key strategies in myopia control, but both inherently reduce retinal image contrast. To date, no in vivo study has directly compared these effects. This study evaluated the contrast reduction profiles of different myopia control spectacles to better understand their underlying mechanisms. METHODS: Through-focus images (TFIs) were obtained with a double-pass instrument in a model eye and in human eyes wearing four spectacle designs: DIMS, Stellest, diffusion optics technology (DOT), and MyoCare. The naked eye served as a reference. Thirteen participants (mean age = 29.0 ± 3.5 years) were tested at the fovea and at 10° and 20° eccentricities in the temporal and superior fields. Lenses were decentered by 1.5 cm to assess off-axis effects. Model eye tests included only the central field. Retinal image contrast (RIC) was calculated as the coefficient of variation of pixel intensity in TFIs. RESULTS: In the model eye, RIC ranked from highest to lowest as follows: naked eye, DIMS, DOT, MyoCare, and Stellest. In vivo, DOT results were excluded due to a weak signal. A nonparametric test revealed significant differences in RIC among lenses at the fovea (P = 0.009) and at 10° in the temporal/superior fields (P = 0.05). Post hoc analysis showed that Stellest produced the greatest reduction in RIC, whereas MyoCare and DIMS demonstrated similar levels of contrast loss. CONCLUSIONS: All myopia control lenses reduced retinal image contrast, with Stellest inducing the strongest reduction. MyoCare and DIMS showed comparable effects. Lens-induced optics primarily influenced contrast in the near periphery, while ocular optics dominated at larger eccentricities.

光学分析：各类近视防控镜均降低视网膜像对比，Stellest降幅最强，MyoCare与DIMS相近。

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：探究当前设计的近视控制眼镜镜片所产生的光调制对视网膜敏感度的影响。 方法：使用黄斑完整性评估微视野计评估9名健康受试者佩戴当前近视控制眼镜镜片（MyoCare、Stellest、MiYOSMART和DOT）时的视网膜敏感度，并获取扫描激光眼底照相（SLO）图像。以相应度数的单光镜片和0.8级Bangerter压贴遮盖膜（BF）作为对比对照。 结果：通过SLO图像可在视网膜水平可视化各款近视控制镜片设计的光调制区域。各镜片设计的中心清晰区大小各异，其中DOT镜片面积最小。Stellest和MyoCare镜片在局部光调制区域的视网膜敏感度未见降低，但MiYOSMART镜片出现下降，提示其局部光调制更显著。DOT镜片导致全视网膜敏感度显著降低，但降低程度小于BF。在所有情况下，视网膜敏感度均远高于健康视网膜的正常范围。 结论：所测试的镜片均未造成具有临床意义的视网膜敏感度降低，且均显著优于最低（0.8）等级的BF。鉴于当前近视控制眼镜在长期有效延缓近视进展方面未表现出一致的治疗效果，这些镜片在空间光调制上似乎存在微妙而关键的差异。看似相似的镜片设计不能假定具有等同的治疗效果，彻底评估这些细微差异对于确保其长期疗效声明的准确性至关重要。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To investigate the influence of light modulation conferred by current designs of myopia control spectacles on retinal sensitivity. Methods: Retinal sensitivity and scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) fundus images were obtained from nine healthy subjects using a Macular Integrity Assessment microperimeter with current myopia control spectacle lenses: MyoCare, Stellest, MiYOSMART and DOT. Respectively powered single vision lenses and a 0.8-grade Bangerter occlusion foil (BF) served as comparative controls. Results: Using the SLO image, one can visualise the areas of light modulation of the various myopia control lens designs at the level of the retina. Clear zone sizes differ between lens designs, with the DOT lens having the smallest area. Retinal sensitivity in areas of local light modulation was not reduced for the Stellest and MyoCare lenses, but declined with the MiYOSMART lens, suggesting a more prominent local light modulation. The DOT lenses produced a significant reduction in overall retinal sensitivity, although the reduction with the BF was greater. In all instances, retinal sensitivity remained well above the range considered normal for a healthy retina. Conclusions: None of the lenses tested produced a clinically relevant reduction in retinal sensitivity and all scored significantly better than the lowest (that is, 0.8) grade BF. Given that current myopia control spectacles do not show consistent treatment effects as required to slow progression effectively over extended periods, there appears to be a subtle, yet crucial difference in spatial light modulation among these myopia control spectacle lenses. Seemingly similar lens designs cannot be assumed to have equivalent treatment effects; a thorough assessment of these nuances is essential to ensure accurate claims regarding their long-term efficacy.

DSDO vs DIMS vs HALT 在不同注视状态（正视与斜视）和瞳孔大小下，3种镜片对视网膜周边屈光度、高阶像差以及视网膜图像对比度的影响

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-5-7 DSDO vs DIMS vs HALT 在不同注视状态（正视与斜视）和瞳孔大小下，3种镜片对视网膜周边屈光度、高阶像差以及视网膜图像对比度的影响 研究中心：南开大学视光科学研究院/李丽华 研究类型：计算机光学仿真与建模研究 研究设计：在电脑软件（Zemax OpticStudio）中，将以下两者数字化并进行“虚拟组装” 镜片的三维数字模型：通过数学多项式输入微透镜的表面矢高（Sag），构建出精确的 SAL（球性微透镜）和 HAL（高非球面微透镜）镜片。 解剖学人眼数字模型：引入国际通用的 Navarro 宽视场眼模型（该模型在电脑中数字化了人眼角膜、前房、晶状体折射率梯度以及周边视网膜的几何形态）。 利用计算机进行虚拟光线追踪（Ray Tracing），通过计算数万条光线的折射轨迹，来定量的模拟出光线穿过镜片后在视网膜周边和中心的成像状态。 结论：1. HAL 具有更强且非线性递增的“近视离焦梯度”：在周边30°视场角下，HAL在周边视网膜前诱导出的近视离焦显着大于SAL 镜片。2. 眼球转动（斜视）时会触发高阶像差的“爆发式激增”。当模拟眼球向周边注视（从0°转向30°）时，穿过微透镜区的光线比例从 0% 飙升至 70% 以上。这导致在周边视网膜上，三阶彗差和球差激增了 3~5 倍。这种由微透镜引入的视网膜图像退化（模糊斑），为“像差信号参与阻断眼轴增长”的假说提供了物理依据。3.大瞳孔（近读/暗光）会不可避免地损害中心视网膜对比度。

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：通过研究微透镜阵列眼镜镜片对周边屈光度和图像对比度的影响，探讨近视控制效应背后的潜在光学线索。 方法：在Zemax OpticStudio中重建了三款商用微透镜阵列眼镜镜片（MiyoSmart、Stellest和不同多区离焦光学设计），并以常规单光（SV）镜片为参考。镜片模型经实验验证后与Navarro眼模型耦合，以模拟配戴眼镜的情况。在远视距以及伴有0.50屈光度（D）和1.00 D调节滞后的近视距条件下评估光学性能。从波前数据中导出周边屈光成分（M和J0）。获取点扩散函数和调制传递函数（MTF），并计算MTF曲线下面积。 结果：模拟与实验的点扩散函数表现出高度一致性，证实了所构建眼镜模型的可靠性。与SV镜片相比，微透镜阵列引起了M值的波动（在±0.25 D以内），表现为相对于SV基线的正负交替偏移。仅Stellest镜片在有限的离心度范围内表现出微弱的近视性离焦，而其他设计均未能诱导周边近视性离焦。在水平经线12.5°至17.5°离心度范围内，微透镜阵列镜片在低空间频率（≤6 cycles/degree）下对比度降低，但截止频率提高，且在较高频率（9–15 cycles/degree）下对比度相对增强。在伴有0.50 D调节滞后的近视距下观察到了相似规律。 结论：微透镜阵列镜片的近视控制效果可能无法完全由周边近视离焦假说解释。相反，观察到的低空间频率对比度下降，结合保留高频信息的截止频率提升，可能提供了延缓近视进展的关键光学线索。这些假设机制有待进一步临床研究检验。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
PURPOSE. To investigate potential optical cues underlying myopia control effects by examining how lenslet-array spectacle lenses influence peripheral refraction and image contrast. METHODS. Three commercial lenslet-array spectacle lenses—MiyoSmart, Stellest, and diverse segmented defocus optics—were reconstructed in Zemax OpticStudio, together with a conventional single vision (SV) lens as a reference. The reconstructed lenses were coupled with the Navarro eye model to simulate spectacle wearing after experimental validation of the lens models. Optical performance was evaluated under both distance and near viewing conditions with accommodative lags of 0.50 diopters (D) and 1.00 D. Peripheral refraction components (M and J0) were derived from wavefront data. Point spread functions and modulation transfer functions were obtained, with the area under the modulation transfer function curve subsequently calculated. RESULTS. Simulated and experimental point spread functions showed strong agreement, confirming the reliability of the constructed spectacle models. Compared with the SV lens, the lenslet-array introduced M fluctuations (within ±0.25 D), manifesting as alternating positive and negative shifts relative to the SV baseline. Only the Stellest lens exhibited minimal myopic defocus over a limited eccentricity range, while the other designs failed to induce peripheral myopic defocus. In the horizontal meridian between 12.5° and 17.5° eccentricity, lenslet-array lenses exhibited reduced contrast at low spatial frequencies (≤6 cycles/degree) but increased cutoff frequencies and relatively enhanced contrast at higher frequencies (9–15 cycles/degree). Similar patterns were observed under near viewing with a 0.50 D accommodative lag. CONCLUSIONS. The myopia control efficacy of lenslet-array lenses may not be fully explained by the peripheral myopic defocus hypothesis. Instead, the observed reduction in low spatial frequency contrast, coupled with an elevated cutoff frequency that preserves high-frequency information, may provide the critical optical cues for slowing myopia progression. These hypothesized mechanisms warrant further clinical investigation.

原文摘要
摘要 背景：本研究旨在评估离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片与阿托品联合治疗时的交通安全性。 患者与方法：招募 12 名年轻成人（年龄：24-45 岁，平均 30.1±5.7 岁），分别在单独使用 DIMS 镜片矫正以及 DIMS 镜片与 0.01% 阿托品联合治疗的情况下，评估其矫正远视力（CDVA）、对比敏感度（CS，采用 FrACT 测试）及眩光敏感度（采用 Mesotest 测试）。 结果：通过 DIMS 镜片中心区域视物时，阿托品不会导致远视力下降；而在眩光与阿托品的共同作用下，矫正远视力（CDVA）会下降 0.10 对数最小分辨角视力（logMAR）。强制通过 DIMS 区域视物时，在无眩光条件下，阿托品会导致远视力下降 0.09 logMAR；而在有眩光条件下，阿托品不会导致视力进一步下降。阿托品对佩戴 DIMS 镜片时的对比视觉无影响。在眩光敏感度方面，DIMS 镜片未表现出任何与视觉及交通安全相关的视觉损伤。额外使用阿托品对眩光敏感度无影响。 结论：无论是单独使用，还是在 0.01% 阿托品的急性作用下，DIMS 镜片用于道路通行均安全，且不会对交通安全造成相关损害。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: The aim of this study was to evaluate traffic safety of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses in combination therapy with atropine. PATIENTS AND METHODS: 12 young adults (age: 24 - 45; 30,1 ± 5,7 years) were recruited to evaluate corrected distance visual acuity (CDVA), contrast sensitivity (CS; FrACT), glare sensitivity (Mesotest) under the influence of DIMS spectacle correction alone and combination therapy with 0,01% atropine. RESULTS: When looking through the central area of the DIMS lens, far vision does not decrease due to the influence of atropine; influence of glare and atropine leads to a reduction of CDVA by 0.10 logMAR. When forced to look through the DIMS area, far vision is reduced by 0.09 logMAR due to the influence of atropine in the absence of glare; in the presence of glare, no further loss of visual acuity can be observed under the influence of atropine. Contrast vision with DIMS glasses is not altered by the effects of atropine. Concerning glare sensitivity, DIMS lenses did not show any visual impairment that would be relevant to vision and road safety. Additional atropinization does not affect glare sensitivity. CONCLUSION: DIMS spectacle lenses are safe for participation in road traffic and do not relevantly impair traffic safety, neither alone nor under the acute influence of 0,01% atropine.

实验室光学检测-PSF&MTF&OTF

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2023年👥 Gantes-Nuñez Javier, Jaskulski Matt, López-Gil Norberto, Kollbaum Pete S
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-2 实验室光学检测-PSF&MTF&OTF 试验组：DIMS，HALT，每种镜片各一个 结论：DIMS镜片六边形区域内的微透镜平均光焦度为 + 3.95±0.10 D；Stellest 镜片 1-5 环的微透镜平均光焦度为 + 6.00±0.15 D，且光焦度以每环 0.42 D 的幅度降低，至第 11 环（最后一环）时降至 3.50 D。Stellest 微透镜的初级球差最大可达 - 0.015 微米。PSF与视网膜模拟图像同时显示基础光学和晶状体的贡献。两种镜片都会导致图像对比度下降，尤其是在低空间频率（1–10 c/deg）下，其MTF的下降程度相当于0.25D的散焦，而在高空间频率下，对比度虽有所保留，但仍处于较低水平。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-2
原文摘要
摘要 目的：通过计算与实验方法，对两款创新性近视控制镜片（豪雅 MiYOSMART 与依视路 Stellest，二者设计中均融入微透镜结构）的近视性离焦量、对比度调制特性及其他光学参数进行量化分析。本文验证了以下假设：尽管该类透镜采用非共轴光学设计，但当光线通过微透镜分布区域成像时，基底面透镜的碎片化特性仍会导致成像质量下降。 方法：使用 Optocraft 波前像差仪，在 1.0 mm 和 6.0 mm 孔径下，分别对 MiYOSMART 镜片的六边形区域和 Stellest 镜片的环形区域测量波前斜率，通过计算波前聚散度与波前曲率来评估镜片屈光力。基于物理（波动）光学和几何光线光学原理计算点扩散函数（PSF），并与采用 4f 光学系统的实验测量结果进行对比。通过由 PSF 推导得到的光学传递函数（OTF），计算模拟视网膜图像与调制传递函数（MTF）。 结果：MiYOSMART 镜片六边形区域内的微透镜平均屈光力为 + 3.95±0.10 D；Stellest 镜片第 1-5 环微透镜的平均屈光力为 + 6.00±0.15 D，且屈光力以每环 0.42 D 的幅度递减，至第 11 环（最后一环）时降至 3.50 D。Stellest 微透镜的初级球差最大可达- 0.015 μm。点扩散函数（PSF）与视网膜模拟图像同时显示基础光学和晶状体的贡献。调制传递函数（MTF）结果表明：在低空间频率（1–10 c/deg）下，镜片对比度下降程度相当于 0.25 D 离焦造成的影响；而在高空间频率下，对比度虽有所保留，但整体水平仍显著降低。 结论：两款近视控制镜片所采用的新型非共轴设计具有一个标志性特征 —— 微透镜区域内弧矢屈光力存在差异，而曲率屈光力保持一致。微透镜阵列结构本身对成像特性具有重要影响。对于两款镜片而言，基底面透镜的碎片化所产生的模糊均会对成像质量造成影响；且在宽空间频率范围内调制传递函数（MTF）的降低，是导致图像对比度下降的主要原因。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To quantify the amount of myopic defocus, contrast modulation and other optical characteristics of two novel spectacle lenses (MiYOSMART by Hoya and Stellest by Essilor) with the inclusion of lenslets in their designs were investigated computationally and experimentally. This paper examined the hypothesis that despite the non-coaxial nature of the optics, image degradation will exist due to the fragmented nature of the base optic when imaging through the lens regions populated by lenslets. METHODS: Optical power was evaluated by computing wavefront vergence and curvature from wavefront slope measured with the Optocraft aberrometer within 1.0 and 6.0 mm apertures across MiYOSMART hexagons and Stellest rings. Point-spread functions (PSFs) were computed using physical (wave) optics and geometrical ray optics principles, and compared with experimental measurements using a 4f optical system. Simulated retinal images and modulation transfer functions (MTFs) were computed from PSF-derived optical transfer functions (OTFs). RESULTS: Mean lenslet power in MiYOSMART was +3.95 ± 0.10 D through the hexagons and +6.00 ± 0.15 D in Stellest in rings 1-5 and decreased by 0.42 D/ring reaching 3.50 D in the final one. Stellest lenslets included up to -0.015 microns of primary spherical aberration. PSFs and retinal images revealed simultaneous contributions of the base optic and lenslets. MTFs showed a decrease in contrast at low (1-10 c/deg) spatial frequencies (SFs) comparable to 0.25 D of defocus, and retention of diminished levels of contrast at higher SFs. CONCLUSIONS: Varying sagittal power and consistent curvature power across the lenslets is an identifying signature of the novel non-coaxial lens design included in both spectacle lenses. Lenslet array structure itself plays a significant role in determining image characteristics. For both lenses, the blur created by the fragmented base optic contributes to the image quality. The reduced MTFs over a wide range of spatial frequencies result in lowered image contrast.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究对比了不同设计的近视矫正方案的视觉表现与短期耐受性，包括具有治疗意义的双焦点隐形眼镜（CL）以及采用 “离焦整合多段（DIMS）” 技术的框架眼镜。 方法与分析：近视志愿者受试者(n=8；在短期佩戴单视力镜片（SV）、DIMS镜片（DIMS）、单焦点软CL和近中心多焦点软CL （MCL）后，分别在三个不同的凝视位置（- 22°鼻、+22°颞和0°中央）评估使用Landolt C的视力（VA）和使用对比度C的对比灵敏度（CS）；这三个注视位置分别对应通过 DIMS 镜片的 DIMS 区域和透明区域视物。此外，在光亮和中等光度条件下，有无眩光的情况下，使用正弦光栅（1.5、3、6、12 和 18 周/度）评估对比敏感度（CS）。 结果：中央注视（0°）时，单光框架眼镜（SV）、DIMS 框架眼镜（DIMS）、单焦点软镜（CL）及中心近视型多焦点软镜（MCL）的平均视力（VA，采用 Landolt C 视标）分别为 - 0.12~-0.10、-0.05 和 0.10 logMAR。与中央注视时的视力值相比，鼻侧注视（-22°）时，上述四种矫正方案的视力差值分别为 0.12、0.33、0.05 和 0.01 logMAR；颞侧注视（+22°）时，视力差值分别为 0.05、0.26、0 和 - 0.08 logMAR。中央注视时，单光框架眼镜（SV）、DIMS 框架眼镜（DIMS）、单焦点软镜（CL）及中心近视型多焦点软镜（MCL）的平均对比敏感度（CS，采用对比 C 视标）分别为 1.74、1.73、1.69 和 1.61 logCS。与中央注视时的对比敏感度值相比，鼻侧注视时，上述四种矫正方案的对比敏感度差值分别为 - 0.02~-0.13、-0.01 和 - 0.01 logCS；颞侧注视时，对比敏感度差值分别为 - 0.02~-0.16、-0.01 和 + 0.06 logCS。 结论：与单光框架眼镜（SV）相比，中心近视型多焦点软镜（MCL）会导致视力（VA）和对比敏感度（CS）普遍下降；而 DIMS 框架眼镜在正视注视（0° 注视）时，其视力和对比敏感度与单光框架眼镜无差异。仅在鼻侧和颞侧注视时，DIMS 框架眼镜的视力和对比敏感度会下降至与中心近视型多焦点软镜（MCL）相近的水平。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
OBJECTIVE: Visual performance and short-term tolerability of different designs of myopia correcting options, including therapeutically relevant bifocal contact lenses (CL) and spectacle lenses with 'defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS)' technology were compared. METHODS AND ANALYSIS: In myopic volunteering subjects (n=8; spherical equivalent range: -1 to -7 D) visual acuity (VA) using Landolt C and contrast sensitivity (CS) using contrast C were assessed at three different gaze positions (-22° nasal, +22° temporal and 0° central), corresponding to a gaze through the DIMS area or the clear area of the DIMS lens design, respectively, after short-term wear of each of single vision spectacle lenses (SV), DIMS spectacle lenses (DIMS), monofocal soft CL and centre-near multifocal soft CL (MCL). Also, CS was assessed under photopic and mesopic light conditions with and without glare using sinusoidal gratings at 1.5, 3, 6, 12 and 18 cpd. RESULTS: Mean VA (Landolt C) was -0.12 to -0.10, -0.05 and 0.10 logMAR (SV, DIMS, CL, MCL) at central gaze (0°). At nasal gaze (-22°), VA differed by 0.12, 0.33, 0.05 and 0.01, and at temporal gaze (+22°) by 0.05, 0.26, 0 and -0.08 compared with central gaze values. Mean CS (Contrast C) was 1.74, 1.73, 1.69 and 1.61 logCS (SV, DIMS, CL, MCL) at central gaze at nasal gaze, CS differed by -0.02 to -0.13, -0.01 and -0.01, and at temporal gaze by -0.02 to -0.16, -0.01 and +0.06 compared with central gaze values. CONCLUSION: When compared with SV, MCL leads to a general decrease in VA and CS, while DIMS did not differ from SV at straight gaze (0° gaze). With DIMS, VA and CS are decreased to a similar level as with the MCL, but only at nasal and temporal gaze.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-4
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：本研究旨在评估佩戴离焦整合多段（DIMS）眼镜片与佩戴传统单光（SV）眼镜片时，受试者在视野表现上的差异。 研究方法：纳入 21 名 9-14 岁儿童，其等效球镜度数（SER）介于 - 1.13D 至 - 4.75D 之间。在室内光照条件（500 lux ±10%）下，分别使用 DIMS 镜片和 SV 镜片测量受试者的中周部近视力（NVA）。采用蔡司 Humphrey Visual Field HFA 750i 自动静态视野仪，结合 SITA Fast 30-2 程序，评估受试者的视野敏感度。测试过程中，将研究用镜片（平光 DIMS 镜片或 SV 镜片）装入试戴镜片前的镜片托架中，每个儿童均按其矫正处方进行配镜。 研究结果：3 名儿童因固视丢失（>20%）或假阳性率过高（>15%）未能完成可靠的视觉测试，18 名儿童成功完成测试。佩戴 DIMS 镜片和 SV 镜片时，受试者的平均视野敏感度分别为 29.2±3.7 dB和 29.3±3.5 dB。在 76 个测试位点中，DIMS 镜片与 SV 镜片的平均敏感度差异介于 - 2.4±3.9 dB 至 1.6±3.9 dB 之间。在中央 30° 范围内的 76 个位点中，DIMS 镜片与 SV 镜片在敏感度上未观察到统计学显著差异 （采用Wilcoxon符号秩检验并进行Bonferroni多重比较校正，p > 0.00065）。与SV镜片相比，DIMS镜片（n=18）在所有四个象限（上、颞、下、鼻）的中周NVA均出现0.05对数最小分辨角（logMAR）的降低（p<0.05）。然而，未发现中周视力与特定位置视敏度存在统计学显著相关性。 研究结论：尽管佩戴 DIMS 镜片会导致中周部近视力（NVA）略有下降，但与佩戴 SV 镜片相比，佩戴 DIMS 镜片并未改变儿童在 30° 视野范围内对静态刺激的视觉感知敏感度。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study evaluates differences in the visual field performance when wearing the Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lens compared to wearing a conventional single vision (SV) spectacle lens. METHODS: Twenty-one children aged 9-14 years with spherical equivalent refraction (SER) between -1.13D to -4.75D were recruited. Mid-peripheral near visual acuity (NVA) under room lighting condition (500 lux ±10%) was measured using DIMS and SV lenses, respectively. Automated static perimetry (Zeiss, Humphrey Visual Field HFA 750i) with SITA Fast 30-2 protocol was used to investigate the visual field sensitivity. During the test, the study lens (Plano DIMS or SV lens) were inserted into the lens holder in front of the trial lenses with each child's compensated prescription. RESULTS: Three children were not able to complete the reliable visual tests due to fixation losses (>20%) or high false positive rate (>15%) while 18 children successfully completed the test. The mean visual field sensitivity was 29.2 ± 3.7 decibels (dB) and 29.3 ± 3.5 dB when wearing DIMS and SV lens, respectively. The mean sensitivity differences between DIMS and SV lens among 76 locations ranged from -2.4 ± 3.9 dB to 1.6 ± 3.9 dB. No statistically significant difference in sensitivity was observed across 76 locations within the central 30o between DIMS and SV lens (Wilcoxon signed rank test with bonferroni correction for multiple comparisons, p > 0.00065). Compared to SV lens, 0.05 logarithm of minimal angle of resolution (logMAR) reduction in mid-peripheral NVA in all 4 quadrants (Superior, Temporal, Inferior and nasal, p < 0.05) was noted with the DIMS lens (N = 18). However, no statistically significant correlation was found between the mid-peripheral NVA and visual sensitivity at the specific locations. CONCLUSION: Although the mid-peripheral NVA was slightly reduced using DIMS lens, wearing DIMS lens did not change the children's visual sensitivity to detect the static stimulus within 30o visual field when compared to wearing SV lens.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在明确马来西亚籍近视儿童长期佩戴离焦整合多段（DIMS）框架眼镜 24 个月后，其双眼视觉（BV）和调节功能的变化情况。 方法：纳入 23 名 7-12 岁马来西亚籍近视儿童，开展前瞻性自身对照研究。为所有儿童处方离焦整合多段（DIMS）框架眼镜，并分别在基线、12 个月和 24 个月时进行数据分析。评估指标包括立体视功能、集合近点（NPC）、隐斜视、正 / 负融合聚散力（PFV/NFV）、调节幅度（AA）、调节滞后、正 / 负相对调节（PRA/NRA）及调节性集合与调节比（AC/A 比）；同时对视力（VA）、睫状肌麻痹验光（球镜度数，SER）和眼轴长度（AL）均进行监测。采用重复测量方差分析（ANOVA，组内分析）或弗里德曼检验对数据进行分析，并应用邦费罗尼校正。p<0.05 被认为具有统计学意义。 结果：佩戴 DIMS 眼镜 24 个月后，受试者多项指标出现具有统计学意义的变化，其中位数变化如下：NPC 后移 2 cm（p<0.001）、AA 降低 1.67 屈光度（D，p=0.002）、远距 PFV 破裂点增加 8 Δ（p=0.026）、远距 PFV 恢复点增加 6Δ（p=0.033）、远距 NFV 破裂点无变化（p=0.043）、立体视功能改善 10 "（p<0.001）、调节滞后降低 0.25D（p=0.002）、AC/A 比增加 1Δ/ D（p<0.001）。此外，受试者远距与近距视力均显著改善（p<0.001），且 SER 与 AL 均有所增加。 结论：佩戴 DIMS 框架眼镜 24 个月可在延缓近视进展的同时，引起儿童双眼视觉与调节功能的改变。建议对佩戴 DIMS 眼镜的儿童定期监测 NPC，以维持其最佳双眼视觉功能与视觉舒适度。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study aimed to determine the changes in binocular vision (BV) and accommodation in Malay myopic children following long-term wear of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses for 24 months. METHODS: Twenty-three Malay myopic children aged 7-12 years were enrolled in this prospective, self-controlled study. DIMS spectacle lenses were prescribed, and analyses were conducted at baseline, 12, and 24 months. Assessments included stereopsis, near point of convergence (NPC), phoria, positive/negative fusional vergence (PFV/NFV), amplitude of accommodation (AA), accommodative lag, positive/negative relative accommodation (PRA/NRA), and accommodative convergence to accommodation (AC/A) ratio. Visual acuity (VA), cycloplegic refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) were monitored. Data were analyzed using repeated-measures analysis of variance (ANOVA) within-subject or the Friedman test, with Bonferroni correction applied. p < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. RESULTS: Statistically significant changes were observed after 24 months, including median changes in NPC (receded by 2 cm, p < 0.001), AA (reduced by 1.67D, p = 0.002), distance PFV break (increased by 8Δ, p = 0.026) and recovery (increased by 6Δ, p = 0.033), distance NFV break (no change, p = 0.043), stereopsis (improved by 10″, p < 0.001), accommodative lag (reduced by 0.25D, p = 0.002), and AC/A ratio (increased by 1Δ/D, p < 0.001). Additionally, distance and near VA improved (p < 0.001), while SER and AL increased (p < 0.001). CONCLUSION: Wearing DIMS spectacle lenses for 24 months resulted in changes in BV and accommodation while slowing myopia progression. Regular NPC monitoring is recommended to maintain optimal BV function and visual comfort in children wearing DIMS lenses.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在评估佩戴含离焦整合多段（DIMS）技术的近视控制镜片后，受试者的视觉参数与皮层活动变化。 方法：纳入 20-30 岁的近视成人受试者。受试者需分别佩戴单光镜片（SVL）和 MiYOSMART（MS）镜片，在每种镜片的两周适应期结束后，按平衡顺序完成两项测试：（1）视觉参数检查；（2）皮层反应测量。测试的视觉参数包括：高对比度视力（HCVA）、低对比度视力（LCVA）、对比敏感度、隐斜视、集合近点（NPC）、立体视、调节灵活度及调节反应。皮层反应通过视觉诱发电位（VEPs）评估，该电位由置于顶枕叶区域的 10 个电极记录获得。 结果：与 SVL 相比，MS 镜片的 HCVA 略优（分别为 - 0.25 logMAR 和 - 0.21 logMAR，p=0.02），且调节反应更大（MS 为 1.68 屈光度，SVL 为 1.53 屈光度，p<0.001）。未观察到 LCVA、隐斜视、NPC、立体视或对比敏感度存在显著差异。两种镜片在 VEPs 早晚期成分（C1、N1、P1、P2）的潜伏期和振幅上均无显著差异。 结论：本研究发现，经过两周适应期后，SVL 与 MS 镜片在视觉参数或视觉皮层反应方面均无临床显著差异。上述结果证实，用于近视控制的 DIMS 镜片不存在不良视觉影响。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: This study evaluated visual parameters and cortical activity after wearing myopia control spectacle lenses with defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS). METHODS: Myopic adults between 20 and 30 years of age were enrolled. The study consisted of (1) examination of visual parameters and (2) measurement of cortical responses, while wearing single vision lenses (SVL) and MiYOSMART (MS) lenses in counterbalanced order after a two-week adaptation period. Visual parameters tested were: high-contrast visual acuity (HCVA) and low-contrast visual acuity (LCVA), contrast sensitivity, heterophoria, near point of convergence (NPC), stereopsis, accommodative facility and the accommodative response. Cortical responses were assessed by visual evoked potentials (VEPs), recorded from 10 electrodes placed over the parieto-occipital area. RESULTS: MiYOSMART lenses produced slightly better HCVA than SVL (-0.25 vs. -0.21 logMAR, p = 0.02) and a larger accommodative response (MS 1.68 D; SVL 1.53 D, p < 0.001). No significant differences in LCVA, heterophoria, NPC, stereopsis or contrast sensitivity were observed. The latencies and amplitudes of the early and late components of the VEPs (C1, N1, P1, P2) did not differ significantly between lenses. CONCLUSIONS: This study found no clinically significant differences in visual parameters or visual cortex responses between SVL and MS lenses after 2 weeks of adaptation. These results confirm the absence of adverse visual effects from DIMS lenses for myopia control.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：研究一种近期被报道具有显著抗近视效果的新型框架镜片设计的适应性与接受度。 设计：前瞻性交叉研究 方法：招募 20 名儿童，使其同时佩戴离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS 镜片）和单光镜片（SV 镜片），两种镜片的初始佩戴顺序随机分配。对于每种镜片，分别在佩戴 30 分钟和 1 周后，于 500 lux（标准光照）和 50 lux（弱光照）环境下，测量高对比度和低对比度的中心远视力、高对比度的中周边近视力。在佩戴 1 周时，采用自主设计的问卷评估视觉不适情况。所有定量数据采用配对 t 检验分析，定性数据采用卡方检验或威尔科克森符号秩检验分析。 结果：在所有测试条件下，与 SV 镜片相比，DIMS 镜片对中心视力无影响（所有 P>0.05）。然而，佩戴 DIMS 镜片时，在 500 lux光照下，四个象限中有两个象限的中周边近视力下降约 0.06 LogMAR 单位（P<0.05）；在 50 勒克斯光照下，四个象限中有三个象限的中周边近视力下降（P<0.05）。佩戴 1 周后，上述视力下降情况未得到改善。主要视觉不适症状为中周边视物模糊，且该症状每天仅出现 1-2 次。在了解 DIMS 镜片的平均抗近视效果后，90% 的儿童受试者更倾向于选择 DIMS 镜片。 结论：与单光镜片相比，DIMS 镜片对中周边视力有轻微影响；除此之外，中国儿童样本对 DIMS 镜片的耐受性和接受度良好。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: We investigated the adaptability and acceptance of a novel spectacle lens design that was recently reported to achieve a significant antimyopia effect. DESIGN: A prospective, cross-over study. METHODS: Twenty children were recruited to wear both Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) and single vision (SV) lens, with a random assignment of which type of lens was experienced first. For each type of lens, high and low contrast central distant visual acuity (VA) and high contrast mid-peripheral near VA were measured at both 500 lux and 50 lux ambient illuminance after 30 minutes' and a week's wearing of the lens. A self-developed questionnaire was applied to evaluate the visual discomfort at the 1-week visit. All quantitative data were analyzed by paired t test, while qualitative data were analyzed with the χ2 or Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. RESULTS: Central VA was not affected by DIMS lens compared with SV lens in all circumstances (all P > .05). However, the mid-peripheral near VA was found to reduce by approximately 0.06 logarithm of minimal angle of resolution unit in 2 of 4 quadrants (500 lux; P < .05) and in 3 quadrants (50 lux; P < .05) for DIMS lenses. No improvement was detected in the 1-week visit. Mid-peripheral blurred vision was the main visual complaint, which was noticed only once or twice a day. Being aware of the average antimyopic efficacy, 90% of children subjects preferred DIMS lenses. CONCLUSION: Mid-peripheral vision through DIMS lenses was slightly affected compared with SV lenses. Otherwise, DIMS lenses received good tolerance and acceptance by Chinese children.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-8
原文摘要
摘要 背景：比较普通球柱面眼镜与离焦整合多段（DIMS）眼镜在 2 年内对近视青少年眼位及双眼视功能的影响。 方法：将 120 名 12-18 岁近视青少年随机分配为两组，分别佩戴普通球柱面单光眼镜（SV 组，n=60）DIMS 眼镜（DIMS 组，n=60），为期 2 年。 结果：2 年后，DIMS 组在远距（1.5±2.2 PD vs. 3.4±3.1 PD，p=0.001）和近距（3.7±4.1 PD vs. 6.8±5.4 PD，p<0.001）眼位外隐斜偏移量显著小于 SV 组；在立体视敏度 [为便于统计分析对数值进行了 log10 转换，此处为便于临床解读，以角秒为单位呈现]（32±12 vs. 48±20 arcsec，p<0.001）、集合近点（7.2±2.3 cm vs. 9.5±3.6 cm，p=0.001）及融合聚散范围（正融合聚散：24±8 PD vs. 18±7 PD，p=0.002；负融合聚散：14±5 PD vs. 11±4 PD，p=0.01）方面，DIMS 组的保留效果也显著优于 SV 组。2 年内，DIMS 组的平均近视进展速度显著慢于 SV 组（-0.72±0.32 D vs. -1.25±0.45 D，p<0.001），眼轴增长更短（0.41±0.18 mm vs. 0.65±0.25 mm，p<0.001）。此外，DIMS 组中出现眼位（外隐斜≥10 PD）、立体视敏度（损失≥0.3 log arcsec loss）及集合功能（集合近点后移≥4 cm）临床显著变化的参与者比例，均显著低于 SV 组（均 p<0.05）。 结论：在近视青少年中，使用 DIMS 眼镜进行光学矫正可减少眼位及双眼视功能的变化，且以球镜当量屈光度（SER）衡量，可使近视进展减缓 42%。这些结果表明，DIMS 眼镜可能对青少年的屈光进展及部分双眼视功能变化均具有控制作用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: To compare the effects of ordinary spherocylindrical spectacle lenses versus defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses on ocular alignment and binocular visual functions in teenagers with myopia over a 2-year period. METHODS: 120 myopic teenagers aged 12–18 years were randomly allocated to wear either ordinary spherocylindrical single vision spectacle lenses (SV group, n = 60) or DIMS spectacle lenses (DIMS group, n = 60) for 2 years. RESULTS: After 2 years, the DIMS group exhibited significantly smaller exophoric shifts in ocular alignment compared to the SV group at distance (1.5 ± 2.2 vs. 3.4 ± 3.1 PD, p = 0.001) and near (3.7 ± 4.1 vs. 6.8 ± 5.4 PD, p < 0.001). The DIMS group also demonstrated better preserved stereoacuity [values log10-transformed for statistical analysis but presented here in arcsec for clinical interpretability] (32 ± 12 vs. 48 ± 20 arcsec, p < 0.001), near point of convergence (7.2 ± 2.3 vs. 9.5 ± 3.6 cm, p = 0.001), and fusional vergence ranges (positive: 24 ± 8 vs. 18 ± 7 PD, p = 0.002; negative: 14 ± 5 vs. 11 ± 4 PD, p = 0.01) than the SV group at 2 years. The mean myopia progression over 2 years was significantly slower in the DIMS group than the SV group (-0.72 ± 0.32 vs. -1.25 ± 0.45 D, p < 0.001), with less axial elongation (0.41 ± 0.18 vs. 0.65 ± 0.25 mm, p < 0.001). The proportions of participants with clinically significant changes in ocular alignment (≥ 10 PD exophoria), stereoacuity (≥ 0.3 log arcsec loss), and convergence (≥ 4 cm recession in near point of convergence) were significantly lower in the DIMS group compared to the SV group (all p < 0.05). CONCLUSIONS: In myopic teenagers, DIMS spectacle lenses used for optical correction were associated with smaller changes in ocular alignment and binocular visual functions, and slowed myopia progression by 42% in terms of spherical equivalent refraction (SER). These results suggest that DIMS lenses may be effective in controlling both refractive progression and certain binocular function changes in adolescents.

原文摘要
摘要 引言：近视是一个日益严重的公共卫生问题，长期存在视力损害风险。尽管离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片已在中国儿童中证实有效，但针对西方人群的证据仍较为有限。本多中心干预研究旨在评估 DIMS 镜片在减缓英国儿童近视进展方面的有效性，以及其在该人群中的视觉可接受性和耐受性。 方法：纳入 5-15 岁、睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度数（SER）为 - 0.50~-8.50D、屈光参差≤1.50D 且散光≤2.50D 的儿童。所有受试者均处方 DIMS 镜片。在基线时及随后 24 个月内每 6 个月测量一次 SER（睫状肌麻痹自动验光）和眼轴长度（AL，使用 IOLMaster 测量）。将测得的眼轴增长情况与已发表的荟萃分析中年龄和种族匹配的未治疗近视儿童的预期眼轴增长情况进行比较。同时评估视觉功能（远 / 近视力、立体视、调节滞后和眼位）及视觉症状（通过受试者问卷收集）。 结果：共 108 名受试者完成了为期 2 年的研究（基线年龄 10.2±2.2 岁）。模型校正后的均值（标准误）显示，12 个月时 SER 变化为 - 0.35±0.04D、AL 变化为 0.17±0.01mm；24 个月时 SER 变化为 - 0.57±0.05D、AL 变化为 0.30±0.03mm。与未治疗近视儿童的预期进展相比，佩戴 DIMS 镜片的儿童在 24 个月内眼轴增长减少 0.27±0.20mm（均值 ± 标准差），其中 91% 的儿童眼轴增长速度慢于未治疗近视儿童的平均水平。DIMS 镜片与单光镜片在视觉功能指标上具有可比性。57% 的受试者在佩戴第一周内未报告视觉症状，且在佩戴 DIMS 镜片 12 个月和 24 个月后，受试者平均 “从未” 或 “极少” 出现视觉症状。 结论：本研究提供了可靠且新颖的证据，表明 DIMS 镜片能有效减缓英国儿童的眼轴增长。在整个佩戴期间，视觉症状极少且视觉功能得以保留，这支持了该镜片在不同人群近视管理中的临床可行性和实际应用价值。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
INTRODUCTION: Myopia is a growing public health concern with long-term risks for visual impairment. While Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses have proven efficacy in Chinese children, evidence from Western populations remains limited. This multi-site interventional study evaluates the effectiveness of DIMS lenses in slowing myopia progression and their visual acceptability and tolerability among UK children. METHODS: Children aged 5-15 years with cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) of -0.50 to -8.50 D, anisometropia ≤1.50 D and astigmatism ≤2.50 D were recruited. All participants were prescribed DIMS spectacle lenses. SER (cycloplegic autorefraction) and axial length (AL, IOLMaster) were measured at baseline and at 6-monthly intervals for 24 months. Measured axial elongation was compared to expected eye growth in age- and ethnicity-matched untreated myopes from published meta-analyses. Visual function (distance/near visual acuity, stereoacuity, accommodative lag and ocular posture) and visual symptoms (participant questionnaire) were also assessed. RESULTS: A total of 108 participants completed the study to 2 years (baseline age 10.2 ± 2.2 years). Model-adjusted mean (SE) changes in SER and AL change were -0.35 ± 0.04 D and 0.17 ± 0.01 mm at 12 months and -0.57 ± 0.05 D and 0.30 ± 0.03 mm at 24 months. Compared to expected untreated myopic progression, children wearing DIMS spectacle lenses showed 0.27 ± 0.20 mm (mean ± SD) less axial elongation over 24 months, with 91% exhibiting slower than average untreated myopic eye growth. Measures of visual function were comparable through DIMS and single-vision spectacle lenses. Fifty-seven percent of participants reported no visual symptoms within the first week, and on average, visual symptoms were 'never' or 'seldom' experienced by participants after 12 and 24 months of DIMS wear. CONCLUSIONS: This study provides robust and novel evidence demonstrating that DIMS spectacle lenses provide meaningful slowing of axial elongation among UK children. Minimal visual symptoms and preserved visual function throughout lens wear support their clinical viability and real-world applicability for myopia management in diverse populations.

Driving Performance Under Peripheral Defocus Induced by Ophthalmic Lenses for MyopiaControl

近视控制眼镜引起的周边离焦下的驾驶性能

📅 2025年
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-10 近视控制眼镜引起的周边离焦下的驾驶性能 试验设计简述：自身前后对照设计（对照组：不佩戴MCSL；试验组：佩戴MCSL条件） 试验组样本量：31人 结论：DIMS显著降低40°偏心度周边视力，但不会对模拟驾驶性能产生不良影响，在驾驶安全上具有适用性。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-10
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：评估近视控制眼镜镜片（MCSL）诱导的周边离焦是否会影响驾驶表现，进而构成驾驶安全风险。 方法：纳入20名经验丰富的年轻成年驾驶员（18-25岁）。评估并比较了基线和配戴MCSL两种条件下40度离心率处的周边视力（VA）和周边对比敏感度（CS）。基线条件下还评估了中央动态视力和中央相干点运动（CDM）检测。受试者在模拟器中完成驾驶路线，同时在基线和配戴MCSL两种条件下执行高视觉要求的次要任务，以获取综合驾驶表现评分（ODPS）。 结果：MCSL显著降低了40度处的周边VA（Z = −1.990，P = 0.047），但对周边CS无统计学显著影响（Z = −0.870，P = 0.384）。同样，ODPS未受MCSL影响（Z = −0.465，P = 0.642）。动态VA与ODPS呈显著相关，尤其是在执行高视觉要求的次要任务时（rho = 0.325，P = 0.010）。CDM检测在常规路线中（rho = 0.737，P = 0.003）以及与次要高视觉要求驾驶任务交互时（rho = 0.356，P = 0.004），均与ODPS显示出显著相关性。 结论：尽管MCSL对周边视觉功能产生负面影响，但ODPS未出现显著改变。未来需进一步研究其对现实世界驾驶表现的长期影响。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: The purpose of this study was to assess whether peripheral defocus induced by myopia control spectacle lenses (MCSL) could affect driving performance, thereby posing a risk to driving safety. Methods: Twenty young adult participants (aged 18–25 years), all experienced drivers, were included in the study. Peripheral visual acuity (VA) and peripheral contrast sensitivity (CS) at 40 degrees eccentricity were assessed and compared for 2 conditions: baseline and wearing MCSL. Central dynamic VA and central coherent dot motion (CDM) detection were also assessed in the baseline condition. To study driving performance, participants completed a driving route in a simulator while performing visually demanding secondary tasks in both conditions (baseline and MCSL). The overall driving performance score (ODPS) was obtained. Results: MCSL significantly reduced peripheral VA at 40 degrees (Z = −1.990, P = 0.047) but had no statistically significant effect on peripheral CS (Z = −0.870, P = 0.384). Similarly, ODPS was not affected by MCSL (Z = −0.465, P = 0.642). Significant correlations were found between dynamic VA and ODPS, particularly during visually demanding secondary tasks (rho = 0.325, P = 0.010). CDM detection also showed significant correlations with ODPS both for the general route (rho = 0.737, P = 0.003), and when interacting with secondary visually demanding driving tasks (rho = 0.356, P = 0.004). Conclusions: Although MCSL negatively affected peripheral visual function, ODPS did not show significant changes. Further studies are needed to investigate their long-term effects on real-world driving performance. Translational Relevance: These findings suggest that MCSL may be a safe option for myopia control in terms of driving safety.

Impact of defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses for myopia control on quality of life of the children: a qualitative study

DIMS对生活质量的影响

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2024年👥 Fatimah Mobashir, Agarkar Sumita, Narayanan Anuradha
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-11 DIMS对生活质量的影响 样本量：29次深度访谈（15儿童，14父母） 结论：DIMS镜片使用初期可逆的副作用（如眼疲劳、头痛、光晕）在2天至1个月内缓解，但周边模糊为普遍且持续的感知。在近视控制方案中，多数儿童及其家长相比阿托品和隐形眼镜（CL），更偏好将 DIMS 作为近视控制方案。家长反馈同时指出，该镜片存在耐用性与易刮花的矛盾，并面临价格、可及性与维护便利性等方面的挑战。（相较于SV，DIMS不能变色）
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-11
原文摘要
摘要 目的：评估离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片对佩戴该镜片儿童生活质量的影响。 方法：依据预设访谈提纲，分别对采用 DIMS 作为近视控制方案且佩戴时长至少 1 个月的儿童及其家长进行深度访谈。对访谈录音进行转录后，采用混合方法（即同时运用归纳式和演绎式编码法）对关键数据点进行编码，以确定研究主题。将生成的编码进一步整合、分类，并最终根据相关性归入世界卫生组织生活质量简表（WHOQOL-BREF）框架的四个领域下的子领域，这四个领域分别为社会关系、生理健康、心理健康和环境健康。 结果：共开展 29 次访谈，其中儿童访谈 15 次（平均年龄：12.47±2.13 岁），家长访谈 14 次。经主题分析，共生成 63 个编码，其中分别有 2 个、16 个、17 个和 28 个编码对应社会关系、环境健康、心理健康和生理健康领域。多数家长未观察到孩子的视觉行为发生变化，但儿童在适应期确实出现了周边视物模糊、眼疲劳、头痛、光晕等症状。家长提出的担忧包括镜片价格高昂、易刮花以及采购困难等。 结论：受访者对社会关系、生理健康和心理健康领域的大部分方面表示满意。但环境健康领域的部分方面（如镜片质量、可及性及费用问题）仍需改进。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
OBJECTIVE: To assess the impact of DIMS (defocus incorporated multiple segments) spectacle lenses on the quality of life of children using it. METHODS: Separate in-depth interviews were conducted with children using DIMS as a myopia control strategy for at least 1 month and their parents based on prepared guides. The recorded audio of the interviews was transcribed, and the significant data points were coded using a hybrid approach, that is, both the inductive and deductive coding methods were used to identify themes. The generated codes were further grouped, categorised and finally fitted as per relevance into the subdomains of the four domains of the WHO Quality of Life-Brief framework, namely the domains of social relationships, physical, psychological and environmental health. RESULTS: A total of 29 interviews were conducted, 15 with children (mean age: 12.47±2.13 years) and 14 with parents. Thematic analysis was done and a total of 63 codes were generated with 2, 16, 17 and 28 codes aligning to the domains of social relationships, environmental, psychological and physical health, respectively. Most parents did not notice any change in their child's visual behaviour, yet children did experience symptoms such as peripheral blurred vision, eyestrain, headache, haloes and more during the adaptation period. High-cost, scratch-prone nature and difficulty in procurement were a few concerns raised by parents. CONCLUSIONS: Participants were satisfied with most of the facets of social relationships, physical and psychological health domains. However, a few facets such as quality, accessibility and finance of the environmental health domain need improvement.

Comparison of Myopic Progression and Quality of Life Wearing Either DIMS Lenses or Single-Vision Myopia Correcting Spectacles

DIMSvsSVL对生活质量的影响

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2025年👥 Li Xiaoying; Ma Wei; Song Yutong; Yap Maurice; Liu Longqian
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-12 DIMSvsSVL对生活质量的影响 样本量：DIMS组85人 结果：DIMS组近视进展：‑0.27 D，眼轴增长：0.17 mm；DIMS 组比 SVL 组近视进展减缓 51%，眼轴增长减缓 43%，差异具有统计学意义。DIMS 组与 SV 组的 QIRC 评分无显著差异。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-12
原文摘要
摘要 目的：评估 1 年内离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片在控制中国儿童近视进展方面的效果，以及其对儿童视觉相关生活质量的影响。 方法：本研究为随机双盲前瞻性对照临床试验，纳入 176 名 7-14 岁近视受试者，将其随机分为 DIMS 组和对照组（单光镜片，SV 组）。分别在基线期、3 个月、6 个月、9 个月和 12 个月随访时监测受试者的屈光不正情况和眼轴长度。采用屈光矫正对生活质量的影响（QIRC）问卷，在基线期和干预后 12 个月评估受试者的视觉相关生活质量。 结果：在初始队列中，共 151 名儿童顺利完成研究（DIMS 组 n=72；SV 组 n=79）。两组受试者的基线特征无显著差异。1 年后，DIMS 组的平均眼轴增长为 0.17（95% 置信区间 0.13-0.20）mm，平均近视进展为 - 0.27（95% 置信区间 - 0.36 至 - 0.18）屈光度（D）；SV 组的平均眼轴增长为 0.30（95% 置信区间 0.26-0.33）mm，平均近视进展为 - 0.55（95% 置信区间 - 0.64 至 - 0.47）屈光度（D）。两组在眼轴增长和近视进展方面的均值差异分别为 0.13 mm（95% 置信区间 0.08-0.18 mm，p<0.001）和 - 0.28 屈光度（D）（95% 置信区间 - 0.41 至 - 0.15 D，p<0.001）。DIMS 组与 SV 组的 QIRC 评分无显著差异（55.30（95% 置信区间 53.17-56.90） vs 54.20（95% 置信区间 51.99-56.41），p=0.854）。 结论：与单光（SV）镜片相比，儿童佩戴 DIMS 镜片可减缓近视进展，且不会对其整体生活质量产生负面影响。 6-6-13摘要 目的： 评估调节离焦和调节对比度的近视控制眼镜镜片对视觉功能的即时影响。 方法： 本研究纳入健康近视年轻成人，平均等效球镜范围为 -4.25 至 -0.50 D。受试者先佩戴隐形眼镜进行屈光矫正，再分别佩戴四种平光试验镜片：扩散光学技术镜片（DOT）、离焦整合多区镜片（DIMS）、高度非球面微透镜镜片（HAL）以及标准单光镜片（SV）。研究采用前瞻性、单次访问、双盲、四方式随机交叉设计。研究评估了远近距离高、低对比度视力、对比敏感度、阅读表现、调节灵活度、视觉搜索任务和调节准确性，并分别通过镜片中央区和/或周边区进行测量。 结果： 共纳入 20 名受试者，其中女性 16 名，平均年龄 22.4 ± 2.72 岁，平均等效球镜为 -2.21 ± 1.10 D。通过镜片周边区测量时，近视控制镜片与标准单光镜片之间的视力存在显著差异，其中 HAL 和 DIMS 在所有测试条件下视力均较低；而 DOT 在高对比度字母测试中与单光镜片表现相当。通过中央区测量时，所有镜片的对比敏感度均有所降低；通过周边区测量时，HAL 和 DIMS 的表现差于单光镜片和 DOT。近距离视力阈值、阅读速度和临界字号方面，周边区下 SV、DOT 和 HAL 表现相近，而 DIMS 的近距离视力阈值和临界字号表现较差。错误评分、调节灵活度重新聚焦次数、视觉搜索时间和调节反应在不同镜片间无显著差异；但在远距离、周边区测量时，SV 的调节反应变异性低于 DOT、HAL 和 DIMS。 结论： 三种近视控制镜片在通过中央区观看时，视觉表现均与标准单光镜片相当。临床医生应注意不同镜片设计在视觉表现上的差异，尤其是通过镜片周边区观看时的视力和阅读速度差异，并结合相应测试结果进行评估。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
Purpose: To assess the efficacy of the Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lens for myopia control and its impact on vision-related quality of life in Chinese children over a 1-year period. Methods: This randomized double-blind prospective controlled clinical trial enrolled 176 myopic subjects aged between seven and 14 years who were randomly assigned into the DIMS group or the control single-vision (SV) group. Refractive error and axial length measurements at baseline, three-, six-, nine-, and 12-month follow-up visits were monitored. The Quality of Life Impact of Refractive Correction (QIRC) questionnaire was used to evaluate the vision-related quality of life at baseline and at 12 months postintervention. Results: Of the initial cohort, a total of 151 children successfully completed the study (DIMS n = 72; SV n = 79). Baseline characteristics were similar between both groups. Average axial elongation and myopia progression after 1 year were 0.17 (95% CI 0.13-0.20) mm and -0.27 (95% CI -0.36 to -0.18) D in the DIMS group and 0.30 (95% CI 0.26-0.33) mm and -0.55 (95% CI -0.64 to -0.47) D in the SV group. The mean differences in axial elongation and myopia progression were 0.13 mm (95% CI 0.08-0.18 mm, p < 0.001) and -0.28 D (95% CI -0.41 to -0.15 D, p < 0.001) between the two groups. No significant difference in the QIRC score was found between the DIMS and SV groups (55.30 (95% CI 53.17-56.90) versus 54.20 (95% CI 51.99-56.41), p=0.854)). Conclusion: The use of DIMS lenses in children was found to slow down myopia progression compared to SV lenses, without negatively affecting their overall quality of life. Trial Registration: Clinical Trial Registry identifier: ChiCTR2000037443.

The Impact of Myopia Control Spectacle Lens Designs on Visual Function

HALT&DIMS&DOT 对视觉功能的影响

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2026年👥 Desiato Alfredo, Lam Hiu Yan, Anand Reena Rani, Chatha Inderjit, Logan Nicola S, Sheppard Amy L, Wolffsohn James S, Laughton Deborah, Davies Leon N
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-13HALT&DIMS&DOT 对视觉功能的影响 研究设计：前瞻性、双盲、四组随机交叉研究 样本量：20人 结论：DOT在高对比度视力和阅读速度上与SVL表现相当，而HAL和DIMS在所有测试条件下均显示出周边视力下降，尤其是在低对比度和低光照条件下，DIMS在近视力阈值和临界字体大小方面表现最差。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-13
原文摘要
摘要 目的： 评估调节离焦和调节对比度的近视控制眼镜镜片对视觉功能的即时影响。 方法： 本研究纳入健康近视年轻成人，平均等效球镜范围为 -4.25 至 -0.50 D。受试者先佩戴隐形眼镜进行屈光矫正，再分别佩戴四种平光试验镜片：扩散光学技术镜片（DOT）、离焦整合多区镜片（DIMS）、高度非球面微透镜镜片（HAL）以及标准单光镜片（SV）。研究采用前瞻性、单次访问、双盲、四方式随机交叉设计。研究评估了远近距离高、低对比度视力、对比敏感度、阅读表现、调节灵活度、视觉搜索任务和调节准确性，并分别通过镜片中央区和/或周边区进行测量。 结果： 共纳入 20 名受试者，其中女性 16 名，平均年龄 22.4 ± 2.72 岁，平均等效球镜为 -2.21 ± 1.10 D。通过镜片周边区测量时，近视控制镜片与标准单光镜片之间的视力存在显著差异，其中 HAL 和 DIMS 在所有测试条件下视力均较低；而 DOT 在高对比度字母测试中与单光镜片表现相当。通过中央区测量时，所有镜片的对比敏感度均有所降低；通过周边区测量时，HAL 和 DIMS 的表现差于单光镜片和 DOT。近距离视力阈值、阅读速度和临界字号方面，周边区下 SV、DOT 和 HAL 表现相近，而 DIMS 的近距离视力阈值和临界字号表现较差。错误评分、调节灵活度重新聚焦次数、视觉搜索时间和调节反应在不同镜片间无显著差异；但在远距离、周边区测量时，SV 的调节反应变异性低于 DOT、HAL 和 DIMS。 结论： 三种近视控制镜片在通过中央区观看时，视觉表现均与标准单光镜片相当。临床医生应注意不同镜片设计在视觉表现上的差异，尤其是通过镜片周边区观看时的视力和阅读速度差异，并结合相应测试结果进行评估。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To profile the immediate effect of defocus-modulating and contrast-modulating myopia control spectacle lens interventions on visual function. METHODS: Healthy myopic (mean spherical equivalent (MSE) -4.25 to -0.50 D) young adults, corrected with contact lenses, wore diffusion optics technology (DOT), defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS), highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) and standard single vision (SV) plano trial spectacle lenses, in a prospective, single-visit, double-blind, four-way randomised crossover study. Distance and near high- and low-contrast visual acuity (VA), contrast sensitivity, reading performance, accommodative facility, visual search task and accommodative accuracy were assessed foveally through the central zone (CZ) and/or peripheral zone (PZ) of the lenses. RESULTS: Twenty participants (16 female) were recruited, with a mean (±SD) age of 22.4 (±2.72) years and MSE -2.21 (±1.10) D. VAs through the PZ differed significantly between myopia control lenses and SV, with the HAL and DIMS exhibiting lower VA across all testing conditions (all p <0.05) and DOT demonstrating equivalence to SV with high contrast letters. Contrast sensitivity was similarly reduced for all lenses through the CZ, while HAL and DIMS performed worse than both SV and DOT through the PZ (p <0.01). Near acuity threshold, reading speed and critical print size through the PZ were comparable for SV, DOT and HAL (all p >0.05), whereas DIMS exhibited worse near acuity threshold and critical print size (p <0.001). No significant differences emerged for error score (p = 0.53), accommodative facility refocusing cycles (all p >0.05) or visual search duration (CZ: p = 0.68; PZ: p = 0.35). Accommodative response was similar across lenses (all p >0.05); however, SV had lower variability at distance through the PZ than DOT, HAL and DIMS (p <0.001). CONCLUSION: All three myopia control lenses exhibited visual performance comparable to standard SV lenses through the CZ. Clinicians should note differences in visual performance, especially VA and reading speed through the lens periphery and their relative testing.

📖 Investigative ophthalmology & visual science📅 2026年👥 Lin Zhenghua, Christaras Dimitrios, Ginis Harilaos, Yang Zhikuan, Lan Weizhong, Artal Pablo
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-14 DIMS和PAUSE各镜片之间视觉表现的对比研究 研究设计：随机、单盲、双眼佩戴的交叉对比研究 样本量：共筛查65名受试，54名入组，49名分析数据 结论：多数P.A.U.S.E.镜片在治疗区近距离视觉表现上优于DIMS，其中T2综合视觉表现最佳，但T1不如 DIMS。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-14
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: Peripheral defocus and image contrast modulation are key strategies in myopia control, but both inherently reduce retinal image contrast. To date, no in vivo study has directly compared these effects. This study evaluated the contrast reduction profiles of different myopia control spectacles to better understand their underlying mechanisms. METHODS: Through-focus images (TFIs) were obtained with a double-pass instrument in a model eye and in human eyes wearing four spectacle designs: DIMS, Stellest, diffusion optics technology (DOT), and MyoCare. The naked eye served as a reference. Thirteen participants (mean age = 29.0 ± 3.5 years) were tested at the fovea and at 10° and 20° eccentricities in the temporal and superior fields. Lenses were decentered by 1.5 cm to assess off-axis effects. Model eye tests included only the central field. Retinal image contrast (RIC) was calculated as the coefficient of variation of pixel intensity in TFIs. RESULTS: In the model eye, RIC ranked from highest to lowest as follows: naked eye, DIMS, DOT, MyoCare, and Stellest. In vivo, DOT results were excluded due to a weak signal. A nonparametric test revealed significant differences in RIC among lenses at the fovea (P = 0.009) and at 10° in the temporal/superior fields (P = 0.05). Post hoc analysis showed that Stellest produced the greatest reduction in RIC, whereas MyoCare and DIMS demonstrated similar levels of contrast loss. CONCLUSIONS: All myopia control lenses reduced retinal image contrast, with Stellest inducing the strongest reduction. MyoCare and DIMS showed comparable effects. Lens-induced optics primarily influenced contrast in the near periphery, while ocular optics dominated at larger eccentricities.
补充中文要点 (AI解析参考)
光学分析：各类近视防控镜均降低视网膜像对比，Stellest降幅最强，MyoCare与DIMS相近。

Lam 试验设计简述：前瞻性交叉研究，38名6-13岁中国近视儿童，随机顺序配戴DIMS TED、DIMS和SV镜片，每种1周；评估远/近高低对比视力、中周边视力、双眼视觉、调节和主观症状 结果：DIMS TED低对比近视力较DIMS/SVL略低约0.06 logMAR，中周边远/近视力较SVL约低0.10 logMAR；差异不太可能具有临床意义。DIMS TED整体视觉表现与DIMS及SVL相近，多数儿童适应和接受良好。

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：比较近视儿童配戴多区正向离焦（DIMS）、三重增强设计DIMS（DIMS TED）和单光（SV）眼镜镜片后的短期视觉功能变化。 方法：招募38名等效球镜度数为-1.00 D至-5.00 D的中国儿童（6至13岁）。受试者按随机顺序配戴DIMS、DIMS TED和SV眼镜镜片。在配戴镜片1周前后评估远近高对比度和低对比度视力（VA）、中周边近VA、双眼功能、调节和视觉症状；并在第二次随访中评估有无眩光条件下的中周边远VA。 结果：大多数视觉功能在戴镜前后未见差异。与SV镜片相比，室内光和暗光条件下的中央远距离高、低对比度VA以及中央近距离高对比度VA均不受DIMS和DIMS TED镜片的影响（均P > 0.05）。在室内光线下，DIMS TED镜片的中央低对比度近VA较DIMS镜片降低0.06±0.10 logMAR（P < 0.01）；在暗光线下，较SV镜片降低0.06±0.11 logMAR（P < 0.01）。与SV镜片相比，DIMS TED和DIMS镜片的中周边远VA和近VA分别下降约0.10 logMAR（P < 0.01）。然而，这些下降不太可能构成具有临床意义的视觉功能损害。大多数儿童对DIMS TED镜片适应并接受良好。 结论：DIMS TED眼镜镜片表现出与DIMS和SV眼镜镜片相当的视觉性能。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To compare short-term visual functions changes in myopic children who had worn the defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS), DIMS with triple enhanced design (DIMS TED), and single-vision (SV) spectacle lenses. Methods: Thirty-eight Chinese children (six to 13 years) with spherical equivalent refractive error −1.00 D to −5.00 D were recruited. Participants wore DIMS, DIMS TED and SV spectacle lenses in random order. High- and low-contrast distance and near visual acuity (VA), mid-peripheral near VA, binocular functions, accommodation and visual symptoms were assessed before and after 1-week of lens wear, while mid-peripheral distance VA was assessed with and without glare in a second visit. Results: Most visual functions showed no differences before and after lens wear. Central high- and low-contrast distance VA and central high-contrast near VA under room and dim lighting were unaffected by DIMS and DIMS TED spectacle lenses compared to SV lenses (all P > 0.05). Central low-contrast near VA was reduced by 0.06 ± 0.10 logMAR in DIMS TED lenses compared to DIMS lenses under room lighting (P < 0.01), and by 0.06 ± 0.11 logMAR compared with SV spectacle lenses under dim lighting (P < 0.01). Mid-peripheral distance VA and near VA were reduced by approximately 0.10 logMAR in DIMS TED and DIMS compared to SV lenses (P < 0.01), respectively. However, these reductions are unlikely to represent a clinically meaningful impairment in visual function. Most children adapted and accepted the DIMS TED spectacle lenses well. Conclusions: DIMS TED spectacle lenses demonstrated visual performance comparable to DIMS and SV spectacle lenses. Translational Relevance: The enhanced design of the DIMS TED spectacle lenses maintains visual performance comparable to DIMS and single vision spectacle lenses, and may potentially increase myopia control efficacy.

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-7-1 DIMS的成本效益分析 样本量：模型模拟包含 10 万名 6-11 岁儿童的假设队列 结果：对儿童使用DIMS光学镜片进行近视控制，与不干预相比，高度近视的累积患病率从10.7%降至5.9%（相对降低44.7%），严重视力损伤从2.7%降至2.2%（相对降低19.2%）。从社会视角看，每获得一个质量调整生命年（QALY）的增量成本为26,407美元，低于世界卫生组织推荐的成本效益阈值（48,359美元），表明该干预具备明确经济性。概率敏感性分析进一步证实，在该阈值下干预具有成本效益的概率高达87%。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-7 社会经济学研究 / 6-7-1
原文摘要
摘要 背景：近视是一种常见的眼部疾病，预计到 2050 年将影响全球一半人口。在儿童期控制近视进展，可能预防成年后相关眼部疾病的发生。部分干预措施可延缓近视进展，但其长期成本与结局尚未明确。本研究旨在评估通过光学手段（使用离焦整合多段镜片，DIMS 镜片）进行近视控制的终身成本效益。 方法：本研究构建了基于个体的状态转换模型，以模拟：1）儿童期近视在干预与无干预情况下的发生与进展；2）近视对成年期四种致盲性并发症发生的影响。从社会视角出发，比较 100% 接受近视控制干预与无近视控制两种策略，判断近视控制是否具有经济价值。 结果：与无近视控制组相比，近视控制组的高度近视累积患病率相对降低 44.7%（5.9% vs. 10.7%），严重视力障碍累积患病率相对降低 19.2%（2.2% vs. 2.7%）。每获得一个质量调整生命年（QALY）的终身成本为 26,407 美元；相较于世界卫生组织（WHO）推荐的 “1 倍人均年度国内生产总值（48,359 美元）” 阈值，该干预措施具有成本效益。概率敏感性分析显示，在 WHO 推荐阈值下，近视控制具有成本效益的概率为 87%。 结论：对所有符合条件的儿童实施近视控制干预具有成本效益。为提高干预可及性，政府补贴近视控制项目是否具有成本效益，仍需进一步研究。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: Myopia is a common eye condition and projected to affect half of the global population by 2050. Controlling its progression during childhood may prevent associated ocular diseases in later life. Certain interventions retard myopia progression but their long-term costs and consequences are not well understood. We evaluated the cost-effectiveness of myopia control via an optical approach using the Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) lens over a lifetime. METHODS: We constructed an individual-based, state-transition model to simulate 1) the development and progression of myopia in childhood with and without control and 2) the impact of myopia on the development of four sight-threatening complications in adulthood. We compared strategies of myopia control with 100% uptake vs. no myopia control from the societal perspective to determine whether myopia control is value for money. RESULTS: With myopia control, the cumulative prevalence of high myopia was relatively reduced by 44.7% (5.9 vs. 10.7%) and severe visual impairment by 19.2% (2.2 vs. 2.7%) compared to no myopia control. The lifetime cost per quality-adjusted life year gained was 26 407 US dollars (USD) and is considered cost-effective compared to the threshold recommended by the World Health Organization (WHO) of one times annual per capita gross domestic product (48 359 USD). Probabilistic sensitivity analysis showed that myopia control had an 87% likelihood of being cost-effective at the WHO threshold. CONCLUSIONS: Myopia control is cost-effective when provided to all eligible children. Further investigation is required to determine if it is cost-effective for the government to subsidise myopia control in order to maximise access.

原文摘要
摘要 重要性：目前有多种用于治疗儿童近视进展的干预措施。尽管这些干预措施的疗效已得到研究，但其成本效益仍不明确，且尚未进行过比较。 目的：确定控制儿童近视进展的具有成本效益的方案。 设计、研究场景与研究对象：本成本效益分析构建了马尔可夫模型，从社会视角出发，在模拟的 10 岁近视儿童假设队列中，比较 5 年内各类控制近视进展干预措施的成本效益。所纳入的近视干预措施包括 0.05% 和 0.01% 阿托品滴眼液、离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS）、户外活动、软性隐形眼镜（日抛型和多焦点型）、硬性透气性隐形眼镜（RGPCLs）、渐进多焦点镜片（PALs）、双光眼镜片（BSLs）、角膜塑形术、高非球面微透镜（HALs）及红光疗法；所有干预措施均以单光镜片（SVLs）为对照。通过确定性和概率性敏感性分析，明确模型不确定性与成本效益之间的关联。成本数据来源于香港医院管理局及香港中文大学眼科中心的收费标准。 主要结果指标：每名儿童的平均成本（以美元计）包括就诊费、药费及光学镜片费用。疗效结局指标为每年的等效球镜度数（SER）降低量和眼轴长度（AL）缩短量。在 5 年研究期内，计算每种干预方案相对于单光镜片的增量成本效益比（ICER）。 结果：户外活动、0.05% 阿托品滴眼液、红光疗法、高非球面微透镜（HALs）及角膜塑形术具有成本效益。其中，0.05% 阿托品滴眼液的增量成本效益比（ICER）为每降低 1 个等效球镜度数（SER）需 220 美元；红光疗法为每降低 1 个 SER 需 846 美元；高非球面微透镜（HALs）为每降低 1 个 SER 需 448 美元。户外活动则实现了成本节约，每降低 1 个 SER 可节省 5 美元，每缩短 1 毫米眼轴长度（AL）可节省 8 美元。角膜塑形术的 ICER 为每缩短 1 毫米 AL 需 2376 美元。 结论与意义：研究结果表明，0.05% 阿托品滴眼液和户外活动在控制儿童近视进展方面具有成本效益。尽管红光疗法、高非球面微透镜（HALs）和角膜塑形术成本更高，但它们也可能具有成本效益。采用这些干预措施有助于以具有成本效益的方式控制近视。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
IMPORTANCE: Several interventions exist for treating myopia progression in children. While these interventions' efficacy has been studied, their cost-effectiveness remains unknown and has not been compared. OBJECTIVE: To determine cost-effective options for controlling myopia progression in children. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: In this cost-effectiveness analysis, a Markov model was designed to compare the cost-effectiveness of interventions for controlling myopia progression over 5 years from a societal perspective in a simulated hypothetical cohort of patients aged 10 years with myopia. Myopia interventions considered included atropine eye drops, 0.05% and 0.01%, defocus incorporated multiple segment spectacles, outdoor activity, soft contact lenses (daily disposable and multifocal), rigid gas-permeable contact lenses, progressive addition lenses, bifocal spectacle lenses, orthokeratology, highly aspherical lenslets (HALs), and red light therapy; all interventions were compared with single-vision lenses. Deterministic and probabilistic sensitivity analysis determined the association of model uncertainties with the cost-effectiveness. Costs were obtained from the charges of the Hospital Authority of Hong Kong and The Chinese University of Hong Kong Eye Center. MAIN OUTCOME AND MEASURES: The mean costs (in US dollars) per child included the cost of hospital visits, medications, and optical lenses. The outcomes of effectiveness were the annual spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) reductions. Incremental cost-effectiveness ratios (ICERs) were calculated for each strategy relative to single-vision lenses over a time horizon of 5 years. RESULTS: Outdoor activity, atropine (0.05%), red light therapy, HALs, and orthokeratology were cost-effective. The ICER of atropine, 0.05%, was US $220/SER reduction; red light therapy, US $846/SER reduction; and HALs, US $448/SER reduction. Outdoor activity yielded a savings of US $5/SER reduction and US $8/AL reduction. Orthokeratology resulted in an ICER of US $2376/AL reduction. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: These findings suggest that atropine eye drops, 0.05%, and outdoor activity are cost-effective for controlling myopia progression in children. Though more expensive, red light therapy, HALs, and orthokeratology may also be cost-effective. The use of these interventions may help to control myopia in a cost-effective way.

参考文献6-8-1 DIMS缓解青少年和成人眼疲劳 样本量：42人（成人20人，青少年22人） 结果：受试者佩戴已适应的 DIMS 镜片时，报告的视疲劳程度显著降低（ DIMS 镜片使青少年组的主观视疲劳降低 26%，成人组降低 18%。）这一效应在青少年组和成人组中均存在，表明无论年龄大小，DIMS 镜片都能减轻搜索任务带来的眼部负担。（受试者报告，DIMS 镜片的主观佩戴舒适度更好，且能让他们在高难度视觉搜索任务中 “更专注”。）DIMS 镜片的缓解效应具有 “即时性”；且在整个实验过程中，两种镜片（DIMS和SVL）的效果差异持续存在。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-1
原文摘要
摘要 过去几十年间，全球儿童近视患病率持续上升，引发了广泛关注。作为针对眼轴长度相关近视的早期干预手段，矫正镜片（如离焦整合多段镜片，DIMS 镜片）已被研发出来，且已证实其在延缓近视进展方面具有效果。然而，除了这一直接作用外，此类镜片是否还会影响佩戴者关注的其他重要方面（如视疲劳），以及这种影响在不同年龄段人群中是否存在差异，目前尚不清楚 —— 因为迄今为止，这类镜片的测试对象通常仅为青少年。因此，本研究通过一项高难度视觉搜索任务（“寻找 Wally”），在两种难度水平（简单、困难）下，依据镜片类型（普通镜片 vs DIMS 镜片）和年龄（青少年 vs 成人），对受试者的主观疲劳程度进行了探究。结果显示，尽管年龄和任务难度并未导致视疲劳出现显著差异，但两个年龄组在佩戴矫正镜片时，其疲劳程度均有明显降低。由此可见，在需要近距离持续用眼移动的任务中，这类镜片的额外调节功能可能会减少眼部负担。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
The steady, world-wide increase in myopia prevalence in children over the past decades has raised concerns. As an early intervention for axial-length-related myopia, correcting lenses have been developed (such as Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segment (DIMS) lenses), which have been shown to be effective in slowing myopia progression. Beyond this direct effect, however, it is not known whether such lenses also affect other aspects important to the wearer, such as eye fatigue, and how such effects may differ across age, as these lenses so far are typically only tested with adolescents. In the present work, we therefore investigated perceived fatigue levels according to lens type (normal vs DIMS) and age (adolescents vs adults) in a demanding visual search task ("Finding Wally") at two difficulty levels (easy vs difficult). Whereas age and difficulty did not result in significant differences in eye fatigue, we found a clear reduction of fatigue levels in both age groups when wearing the correcting lenses. Hence, the additional accommodation of these lens types may result in less strain in a task requiring sustained eye movements at near viewing distances.

Association between myopia progression and cylinder power progression in defocus incorporated multiple segments lens wearers

DIMS对散光的影响

参考文献6-8-2 DIMS对散光的影响 样本量：DIMS组197名 结果：24.02%的儿童在一年内散光度数进展≥0.25D。SE每增加0.25D，DIMS镜片佩戴者发生ΔCP的几率增加73%。CA每增加0.25 D，DIMS镜片佩戴者发生ΔCP的几率增加17%。眼轴长度变化（AL）与散光进展无显著相关性。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-2
原文摘要
摘要 本研究旨在探讨佩戴离焦整合多段镜片（DIMS 镜片）者中，与近视防控相关的参数与柱镜度数（CP）进展之间的相关性。本回顾性队列研究共纳入 179 名（6-12 岁）佩戴 DIMS 镜片 1 年的儿童。对所有研究对象进行散瞳验光，并测量球镜度数当量（SE）、眼轴长度（AL）、柱镜度数（CP）及角膜散光（CA）。采用二元逻辑回归分析、分层分析及交互作用检验，评估近视与柱镜度数（CP）进展之间的关系。这 179 名 DIMS 镜片佩戴者的平均年龄为 9.51±1.48 岁，其中男性占 51.4%。1 年内，24.02% 的参与者柱镜度数（CP）进展≥0.25 屈光度（D）。经完全校正的二元逻辑回归分析显示，在调整潜在混杂因素后，入院时ΔSE（比值比（OR）=1.73，95% 置信区间（95% CI）（1.32,2.27），P<0.001）和CA（OR=1.17，95% CI（1,1.36），P=0.049）与CP进展相关。交互作用分析未发现显著的交互关系。研究结果表明，DIMS 镜片佩戴者的球镜度数变化量（ΔSE）与柱镜度数（CP）进展呈显著正相关。此外，在研究期间，参与者的基线角膜散光（CA）也与ΔCP相关。这提示近视进展和基线角膜散光（CA）水平是导致柱镜度数（CP）进展存在差异的原因。本研究有助于优化 DIMS 镜片佩戴者近视防控中的散光控制策略。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
The aim of this study was to explore the correlation between the parameters associated with the prevention and management of myopia and cylinder power (CP) progression in individuals who wear defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lenses. In total, 179 children (6-12 years old) prescribed DIMS lenses for 1 year were enrolled in this retrospective cohort study. Cycloplegic refraction, spherical equivalent (SE), axial length (AL), CP, and corneal astigmatism (CA) were measured. The relationship between myopia and CP progression was assessed using binary logistic regression analyses, stratified analyses, and interaction tests. These 179 DIMS lens wearers were, on average, 9.51 ± 1.48 years old, and 51.4% were male. In total, 24.02% of these participants had CP progression ≥ 0.25 D within one year. A fully-adjusted binary logistic regression analysis revealed that ΔSE (odds ratio (OR) = 1.73, 95% CI (1.32, 2.27), P < 0.001) and CA at admission (OR = 1.17, 95% CI (1, 1.36), P = 0.049) were associated with CP progression following adjustment for potential confounding factors. Interaction analysis revealed no significant interactive relationships. Our results showed a significant positive association between ΔSE and CP progression in DIMS lens wearers. Furthermore, baseline CA was also associated with ΔCP in participants over the course of the study. This suggested that myopia progression and baseline CA levels contribute to variations in CP progression. This study helps optimize astigmatism control in preventing and controlling myopia in DIMS lens wearers.

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2023年👥 Zhang Han Yu, Lam Carly Siu Yin, Tang Wing Chun, Lee Paul H, Tse Dennis Y, To Chi Ho
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-8-3 DIMS对相对周边屈光度的影响/对眼球形态的影响 样本量：DIMS组：65名儿童（全程佩戴DIMS镜片）；SVL-DIMS：55名儿童（前2年佩戴单光镜片，第3年换为DIMS镜片） 结果：在三年研究中，佩戴DIMS镜片组始终保持稳定、对称的RPR与均匀的眼球生长，近视控制效果持续。而原SV组在前两年呈现出RPR不对称变化（如鼻侧20N、30N处远视性偏移显著），提示非均匀生长；在第三年换用DIMS镜片后，其鼻侧远视性RPR显著减少，整体RPR模式从不对称转为对称，眼球生长也趋于均匀。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-3
原文摘要
摘要 目的：探讨佩戴单光（SV）镜片 2 年后在第 3 年换用离焦整合多段（DIMS）镜片的儿童，与连续佩戴 DIMS 镜片 3 年的儿童相比，其与近视进展相关的相对周边屈光度（RPR）变化情况。 方法：前 2 年，儿童被随机分配至佩戴 DIMS 镜片组或 SV 镜片组。第 3 年，DIMS 组儿童继续佩戴 DIMS 镜片，而 SV 组儿童换用 DIMS 镜片（以下简称 “SV 转 DIMS 组”）。每 6 个月监测一次中心屈光度、周边屈光度及眼轴长度。 结果：3 年期间，DIMS 组（n=65）近视控制效果良好，且 RPR 曲线保持相对稳定和对称，未出现显著变化。前 2 年，佩戴 SV 镜片的儿童（n=55）出现非对称的 RPR 变化，其中鼻侧 20°（20°N）和鼻侧 30°（30°N）处的远视性 RPR 显著增加，均值差分别为 0.88±1.06 D（p<0.0001）和 1.07±1.09 D（p<0.0001）。SV 转 DIMS 组在第 3 年佩戴 DIMS 镜片后，近视进展得到显著延缓。与前 2 年的 RPR 变化相比，该组儿童第 3 年在 20°N（均值差：−1.14±1.93 D，p<0.0001）和 30°N（均值差：−1.07±1.17 D，p<0.0001）处的远视性 RPR 显著降低。然而，第 3 年时该组儿童鼻侧视网膜与颞侧视网膜的 RPR 变化无显著差异（p>0.05）。 结论：从 SV 镜片换用 DIMS 镜片的儿童，其 RPR 呈对称变化；连续佩戴 DIMS 镜片 3 年的儿童，其 RPR 也呈对称模式。通过中周边近视性离焦进行近视控制，可通过改变眼球生长模式影响 RPR 变化，进而延缓近视进展。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate changes in relative peripheral refraction (RPR) associated with myopia progression in children who wore single-vision (SV) lenses for 2 years and switched to Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) lenses in the third year versus children who wore DIMS lenses for 3 years. METHODS: In the first 2 years, children were allocated randomly to wear either DIMS or SV lenses. In the third year, children in the DIMS group continued to wear these lenses, while those in the SV group were switched to DIMS lenses (Control-to-DIMS group). Central and peripheral refraction and axial length were monitored every 6 months. RESULTS: Over 3 years, the DIMS group (n = 65) showed good myopia control and maintained a relatively constant and symmetrical RPR profile without significant changes. In the first 2 years, children who wore SV lenses (n = 55) showed asymmetrical RPR changes, with significant increases in hyperopic RPR at 20° nasal (N) (mean difference: 0.88 ± 1.06 D, p < 0.0001) and 30N (mean difference: 1.07 ± 1.09 D, p < 0.0001). The Control-to-DIMS group showed significant myopia retardation after wearing DIMS lenses in the third year. When compared with the RPR changes in the first 2 years, significant reductions in hyperopic RPR were observed at 20N (mean difference: -1.14 ± 1.93 D, p < 0.0001) and 30N (mean difference: -1.07 ± 1.17 D, p < 0.0001) in the third year. However, no significant difference between the RPR changes found in the nasal retina and temporal retina (p > 0.05) was noted in the third year. CONCLUSION: Symmetrical changes in RPR were found in children switching from SV to DIMS lenses, and a symmetrical pattern of RPR was noted in children who wore DIMS for 3 years. Myopia control using myopic defocus in the mid-periphery influenced the RPR changes and retarded myopia progression by altering the eye's growth pattern.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：比较近视儿童佩戴多焦点离焦框架眼镜（DIMS）与单光框架眼镜（SV）2 年内，与近视进展相关的相对周边屈光（RPR）变化。 方法：对 183 名近视儿童开展为期 2 年的双盲随机对照试验。受试者被随机分为两组，分别佩戴 DIMS 眼镜（n=93）和 SV 框架眼镜（n=90）。每 6 个月监测一次散瞳后鼻侧（10N、20N、30N）和颞侧（10T、20T、30T）视网膜偏心率 10°、20°、30° 处的周边屈光、中心屈光及眼轴长度。 结果：DIMS 组鼻侧与颞侧视网膜的周边近视漂移呈对称性（比较鼻侧与颞侧视网膜的近视漂移，对应偏心率之间的差异无临床意义）。SV 组鼻侧与颞侧视网膜的周边近视漂移呈非对称性，其中颞侧 10°（10T，-0.32±0.62 屈光度 [D]）、20°（20T，-0.69±0.95 D）和 30°（30T，-0.85±1.52 D）处的近视漂移更显著（均 P≤0.001）。DIMS 组的相对周边屈光球镜当量（M）未出现显著变化，而 SV 组鼻侧 10°（10N，0.27±0.45 D）、20°（20N，0.75±0.72 D）和 30°（30N，0.98±0.76 D）处的远视性相对周边屈光球镜当量（M）显著升高（均 P<0.0001）。 结论：与佩戴 SV 眼镜相比，佩戴 DIMS 眼镜可使周边屈光形态和相对周边屈光（RPR）发生显著变化，并具有显著的近视控制效果。在视网膜中周边部采用近视离焦进行近视控制，可影响周边屈光并延缓中心近视进展，其机制很可能是通过改变整体视网膜形态实现的。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To compare changes in relative peripheral refraction (RPR) associated with myopia progression in myopic children wearing Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) lenses and single vision (SV) spectacle lenses over 2 years. METHODS: A 2-year double-blind, randomized controlled trial was conducted on 183 myopic children. Subjects were allocated to either wearing DIMS (n = 93) or SV spectacle lenses (n = 90). Peripheral refraction at 10°, 20°, and 30° of the nasal (10N, 20N, 30N) and temporal (10T, 20T, 30T) retinal eccentricities, central refraction, and axial length after cycloplegia were monitored every 6 months. RESULTS: DIMS group showed symmetrical peripheral myopic shifts between the nasal and temporal retina (comparing myopic shifts between the nasal and temporal retina, the difference between the corresponding eccentricities were nonclinically significance). SV group showed asymmetrical peripheral myopic shifts between the nasal and temporal retina, with more myopic shifts (all P ≤ 0.001) at 10T (-0.32 ± 0.62 diopters [D]), at 20T (-0.69 ± 0.95 D), and 30T (-0.85 ± 1.52 D). No significant changes in RPR spherical equivalent (M) were noted in the DIMS group, whereas significant increases (all P < 0.0001) in hyperopic RPR M were observed at 10N (0.27 ± 0.45 D), 20N (0.75 ± 0.72 D), and 30N (0.98 ± 0.76 D) in the SV group. CONCLUSIONS: Wearing DIMS lenses resulted in a significantly different peripheral refraction profile and RPR changes, as well as significant myopia control effects when compared with SV lenses. Myopia control adopting myopic defocus in the midperiphery influenced peripheral refraction and slowed central myopia progression, most likely through alteration of overall retinal shape.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-5
原文摘要
摘要 目的：探讨使用不同近视管理方案（包括低浓度阿托品、离焦框架眼镜（DIMS）、离焦隐形眼镜、低强度红光光生物调节疗法及联合方案）时，影响良好治疗依从性的相关因素。 设计：回顾性、观察性、单中心病历回顾研究 患者与方法：本单中心回顾性研究分析了 17 岁以下近视患者的临床及人口统计学数据。排除标准包括：存在全身及眼部疾病、显著屈光不正（近视除外）或双眼视功能障碍、随访时间不足 6 个月。从病历中提取年龄、性别、睫状肌麻痹验光结果、近视进展情况、近视控制治疗类型及患者报告的治疗依从性（分为良好、一般、较差）等数据。 结果：本研究共分析 177 名高加索裔儿童患者（女性占 49.2%；平均年龄 11.1±2.78 岁）；其中 84.2% 报告治疗依从性良好，6.8% 为一般，9.0% 为较差。多因素逻辑回归分析显示，DIMS 框架眼镜与依从性的关联性最强（OR=21.17，p=0.003），其次为 DIMS 框架眼镜联合阿托品方案（OR=4.02，p=0.038）。球镜度数（SE）近视进展更快（OR=0.31，p=0.002）及年龄较大（OR=0.78，p=0.05）与较低的依从性显著相关。 结论：研究结果表明，年龄较小及近视进展较慢与更好的治疗依从性相关。在各治疗方案中，单独使用 DIMS 框架眼镜或其与阿托品的联合方案是依从性最强的预测因素，而其他方案未显示出显著相关性。当关注治疗依从性时，光学矫正方案更具优势，同时需加强对青少年患者的咨询指导。 通俗语言摘要：目前有多种用于控制儿童近视进展的治疗方法，但这些方法的有效性依赖于长期坚持使用。本研究旨在明确哪些治疗方案更易坚持，以及哪些因素会影响日常使用依从性。 本研究回顾了米兰某医院的病历资料，纳入使用至少一种近视控制方案满 6 个月的近视儿童，涉及方案包括低浓度阿托品、离焦框架眼镜、近视控制软性隐形眼镜、低强度红光疗法或联合方案。在末次随访时，由儿童及其家属报告治疗使用的一致性。总体而言，84% 的患者报告依从性良好（≥75%）。依从性最高的是离焦框架眼镜（95.7%）和离焦软性隐形眼镜（95.0%），其次是离焦框架眼镜 + 阿托品（90.5%）及离焦框架眼镜 + 隐形眼镜（81.0%）；相比之下，单独使用阿托品（66.7%）和红光疗法（40.0%）的依从性较低。年龄较大的青少年依从性较差，而近视进展较慢的患者依从性更佳。在日常临床实践中，若关注治疗依从性，光学矫正方案（尤其是离焦框架眼镜单独使用或与阿托品联合使用）可能是最实用的选择。简单的使用流程和个性化咨询对青少年维持长期日常治疗尤为重要。本研究结果来自单中心，且依赖自我报告，因此可能无法适用于所有场景。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To identify factors influencing good adherence when using different myopia management solutions, including low-dose atropine, defocus spectacle lenses (DIMS), defocus contact lenses, photobiomodulation with low-intensity red light, and combined approaches. DESIGN: Retrospective, observational, single-center chart review. PATIENTS AND METHODS: This single center retrospective study analyzed clinical and demographic data of myopic patients younger than 17 years. Exclusion criteria were presence of systemic and ocular pathologies, significant refractive (other than myopia) or binocular vision disorders, and follow-up less than 6 months. Data on age, sex, cycloplegic refraction, myopic progression, type of myopia control treatment, and patient-reported adherence to treatment (categorized as good, fair, poor) was obtained from the medical charts. RESULTS: We analyzed 177 Caucasian pediatric patients (49.2% female; mean age 11.1 ± 2.78 years); 84.2% reported good adherence to treatment, 6.8% reported moderate adherence, and 9.0% reported poor adherence. In multivariate logistic regression analysis, DIMS spectacle lenses showed the strongest association with adherence (OR = 21.17, p = 0.003), followed by the combined use of DIMS spectacle lenses and atropine (OR = 4.02, p = 0.038). Higher myopia progression in spherical equivalent (SE) (OR = 0.31, p = 0.002), and older age (OR 0.78, p = 0.05) were significantly associated with lower adherence. CONCLUSION: These findings suggest that younger age and lower myopia progression are associated with better adherence to treatment. Among treatment options, DIMS spectacle lenses alone or combined with atropine, were the strongest predictors of adherence, while other approaches showed no significant associations. This favors optical-based strategies when adherence is a concern and calls for enhanced counseling strategies in adolescents.

原文摘要
摘要 目的：探讨瞳孔面积是否会影响周边离焦眼镜片在控制近视儿童眼轴伸长和屈光度数进展中的效果。 方法：本回顾性分析纳入 310 名 7-14 岁近视儿童，每位参与者至少佩戴三种近视控制镜片中的一种达 12 个月：A 类为多区正向离焦（DIMS）镜片；B 类为高非球面微透镜；C 类为个性化自由曲面光学设计镜片。根据瞳孔面积（高于或低于均值）对参与者进行分组，分别在基线、6 个月和 12 个月时测量眼轴长度和球镜等效屈光度数，并采用线性混合效应模型评估瞳孔面积与镜片类型的交互作用对眼轴伸长的影响。 结果：在瞳孔较大的儿童中，与 A 类和 C 类镜片相比，12 个月时 B 类镜片与更少的眼轴伸长和屈光度数进展相关（P<0.001）；相反，在瞳孔较小的儿童中，未观察到不同镜片类型之间存在显著差异。交互项（β=-0.086，P=0.002）表明，B 类镜片的效果可能受瞳孔面积影响。 结论：瞳孔面积可能会影响周边离焦眼镜片的近视控制效果。瞳孔较大的儿童从高非球面微透镜中获得的益处更显著，提示在临床决策中应考虑瞳孔面积这一因素。 转化相关性：瞳孔面积可能影响周边离焦镜片的临床表现，为儿童个性化近视管理提供支持。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate whether pupil area influences the effectiveness of peripheral defocus spectacle lenses in controlling axial elongation and refractive error progression among myopic children. METHODS: This retrospective analysis included 310 myopic children ages 7 to 14 years. Each participant wore one of three myopia control lens types for at least 12 months: type A, defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lenses; type B, highly aspherical lenslets; or type C, personalized freeform optical design. Participants were grouped by pupil area (above or below the mean). Axial length and spherical equivalent refractive error were measured at baseline, 6 months, and 12 months. A linear mixed-effects model was used to evaluate the effect of the interaction between pupil area and lens type on axial elongation. RESULTS: Among children with larger pupils, lens type B was associated with less axial elongation and refractive error progression at 12 months compared with types A and C (P < 0.001). In contrast, no significant differences among lens types were observed in children with smaller pupils. An interaction term (β = -0.086, P = 0.002) indicated that the efficacy of lens type B may be influenced by pupil area. CONCLUSIONS: Pupil area may influence the efficacy of peripheral defocus spectacle lenses for myopia control. Children with larger pupils demonstrated greater benefit from highly aspherical lenslets, suggesting that pupil area should be considered in clinical decision-making. TRANSLATIONAL RELEVANCE: Pupil area may influence the clinical performance of peripheral defocus lenses, supporting personalized myopia management in children.

The Effect of Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) Spectacle Lenses on Astigmatism in Children with Myopia

DIMS对散光的影响

📖 Scientific Reports📅 2026年👥 Wang Yang, Ouyang Lijuan, Chen Si, Chen Keyu, Xiong Haibo
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-8-8 DIMS对散光的影响 起始时间：2023年1月至2024年12月 研究中心&PI：重庆医科大学附属儿童医院眼科 & 熊海波 样本量：DIMS组192人；SVL组204人 DIMS：Δ角膜散光-0.19D，Δ柱镜屈光度-0.17D SVL：Δ角膜散光-0.20D，Δ柱镜屈光度-0.20D DIMS能有效延缓近视儿童的近视进展和眼轴增长，且不会造成散光的额外进展
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-8
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：本研究旨在探讨佩戴离焦整合多段式（DIMS）眼镜片对近视儿童散光状况的影响。 研究方法：本研究纳入 396 名近视儿童，将受试者分为两组：DIMS 镜片组（192 例）和单光镜片对照组（204 例）。研究分析了佩戴 DIMS 镜片一年后，受试者的等效球镜度、球镜屈光度、柱镜屈光度、眼轴长度及角膜散光的变化情况。 研究结果：对照组的等效球镜度年进展量为 - 0.95±0.57 屈光度，显著高于 DIMS 镜片组的 - 0.30±0.45 屈光度（P<0.001）。DIMS 镜片组与对照组的柱镜屈光度变化量存在轻微差异，分别为 - 0.17±0.28 屈光度和 - 0.20±0.38 屈光度（P=0.010）。DIMS 镜片组的角膜散光变化量为 - 0.19±0.57 屈光度，与对照组的 - 0.20±0.66 屈光度相比，无统计学显著差异（P=0.624）。矢量图分析结果显示，两种镜片对柱镜屈光度和角膜散光的变化无差异性影响（柱镜屈光度：R=0.0237，P=0.329；角膜散光：R=0.0158，P=0.594）。多元线性回归分析（P=0.925）和混合线性模型分析（P=0.464）均显示，镜片类型对散光变化无显著影响。 研究结论：离焦整合多段式（DIMS）眼镜片可延缓近视进展，且不会导致散光额外加重。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
This study aims to explore the impact of wearing Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses on astigmatism in myopic children. This study included 396 myopic children and divided the participants into two groups:the DIMS group (n = 192) and a control group single vision lens (n = 204). The study analysed the effect of wearing DIMS on changes in spherical equivalent (SE),diopter sphere (DS),diopter cylinder (DC), axial length (AL) and corneal astigmatism (CA) after one year. Compared to the DIMS group (-0.30 ± 0.45D), the annual SE progression was faster in the control group (-0.95 ± 0.57D, P < 0.001). There is a slight difference in diopter cylinder between the DIMS group and the control group(-0.17 ± 0.28 VS -0.20 ± 0.38, P = 0.010).The change in corneal astigmatism in the DIMS group (-0.19 ± 0.57D) showed no statistically significant difference compared to that in the control group (-0.20 ± 0.66D, P = 0.624).These vector diagram analysis results indicate that the two types of lenses did not differentially affect the change in diopter cylinder and corneal astigmatism(R = 0.0237, P = 0.329;R = 0.0158, P = 0.594). There was no significant effect of spectacle lenses on astigmatism change in multivariate linear regression (P = 0.925) or mixed linear model (P = 0.464). Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses slow myopia progression with no extra astigmatism progression.
