Optical influence of myopia control spectacles at the retinal level: Effect of local light modulation

HAL vs DIMS vs Aura 3（DSDO） vs Aura 6（DSDO）对视网膜活动的短期影响

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2025年👥 Kaymak Hakan, Mattern Ann-Isabel, Graff Birte, Devenijn Machteld, Seitz Berthold, Schwahn Hartmut
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-8-9 HAL vs DIMS vs Aura 3（DSDO） vs Aura 6（DSDO）对视网膜活动的短期影响 样本量：19人【随机交叉试验，每位参与者先后佩戴四种不同的近视控制镜片，每种镜片佩戴15天，之间设有1周的洗脱期。】 结论：Aura 3、Aura 6、DIMS、HALT，均能诱导视网膜电生理活动的短期变化，其中以HALT和Aura 6镜片在周边视网膜区域引发的改变较一致，表明光学离焦可调节视网膜活动，这一机制可能参与眼部生长的调控。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-9
原文摘要
摘要 目的：探讨当前不同设计的近视控制框架镜所产生的光调制，对视网膜敏感度的影响。 方法：研究者使用 Macular Integrity Assessment（MAIA）微视野仪，对 9 名健康受试者在佩戴当前近视控制框架镜时的视网膜敏感度及扫描激光检眼镜（SLO）眼底图像进行测量。所测试的镜片包括：MyoCare、Stellest、MiYOSMART 和 DOT；相应度数的单光镜片以及 0.8 级 Bangerter 遮挡膜（BF）作为比较对照。 结果：通过 SLO 图像，可以在视网膜层面观察到不同近视控制镜片设计所形成的光调制区域。不同镜片设计的清晰区大小存在差异，其中 DOT 镜片的清晰区最小。在局部光调制区域内，Stellest 和 MyoCare 镜片并未降低视网膜敏感度，而 MiYOSMART 镜片则出现了视网膜敏感度下降，提示其局部光调制作用更为明显。DOT 镜片可导致整体视网膜敏感度显著下降，但这种下降程度仍小于 Bangerter 遮挡膜。在所有情况下，视网膜敏感度均明显高于健康视网膜的正常范围下限。 结论：本研究所测试的镜片均未造成具有临床意义的视网膜敏感度下降，且其结果均显著优于最低等级（即 0.8 级）的 Bangerter 遮挡膜。鉴于目前的近视控制框架镜在长期延缓近视进展方面尚未表现出一致且足够的治疗效果，不同镜片之间在空间光调制方面可能存在细微但关键的差异。对于外观上看似相似的镜片设计，不能想当然地认为其治疗效果等同；必须对这些细微差别进行充分评估，才能准确判断其长期疗效。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate the influence of light modulation conferred by current designs of myopia control spectacles on retinal sensitivity. METHODS: Retinal sensitivity and scanning laser ophthalmoscopy (SLO) fundus images were obtained from nine healthy subjects using a Macular Integrity Assessment microperimeter with current myopia control spectacle lenses: MyoCare, Stellest, MiYOSMART and DOT. Respectively powered single vision lenses and a 0.8-grade Bangerter occlusion foil (BF) served as comparative controls. RESULTS: Using the SLO image, one can visualise the areas of light modulation of the various myopia control lens designs at the level of the retina. Clear zone sizes differ between lens designs, with the DOT lens having the smallest area. Retinal sensitivity in areas of local light modulation was not reduced for the Stellest and MyoCare lenses, but declined with the MiYOSMART lens, suggesting a more prominent local light modulation. The DOT lenses produced a significant reduction in overall retinal sensitivity, although the reduction with the BF was greater. In all instances, retinal sensitivity remained well above the range considered normal for a healthy retina. CONCLUSIONS: None of the lenses tested produced a clinically relevant reduction in retinal sensitivity and all scored significantly better than the lowest (that is, 0.8) grade BF. Given that current myopia control spectacles do not show consistent treatment effects as required to slow progression effectively over extended periods, there appears to be a subtle, yet crucial difference in spatial light modulation among these myopia control spectacle lenses. Seemingly similar lens designs cannot be assumed to have equivalent treatment effects; a thorough assessment of these nuances is essential to ensure accurate claims regarding their long-term efficacy.

A Predictive Model for Personalized Fitting of Peripheral Defocus Spectacles Based on Ocular Biometric Parameters

Halt、DIMS、Myovision三种近视控制框架镜片是否会影响儿童散光变化

📖 Clinical optometry📅 2026年👥 Zhou Peng, Li Yingli, Chen Sitong, Wang Kai, Li Yan
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-8-11：Halt、DIMS、Myovision三种近视控制框架镜片是否会影响儿童散光变化 起始时间：2018 年 3 月至 2021 年 7 月 研究中心：四川大学华西医院Bi Yang（杨必） 试验简述：顾性收集 6–12 岁近视儿童佩戴三种近视控制框架镜片后的临床资料，比较 MyoVision、DIMS、Stellest 镜片佩戴前和佩戴 2 年后的散光变化。主要分析总散光及散光矢量成分 J0、J45。 结论：三种近视控制框架镜片佩戴 2 年后，儿童散光均有轻度增加，但增加幅度 <0.50 D，不具有临床意义；散光变化与镜片类型无关，更可能与近视进展本身相关。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 新乐学MiYOSMART / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-11
原文摘要
摘要 目的：基于眼部生物测量参数，构建用于个性化推荐周边离焦框架眼镜设计的预测模型。 方法：本回顾性队列研究纳入北京大学人民医院眼科中心配戴周边离焦框架眼镜的2824名近视儿童。研究对象按镜片设计分为五组：DSDO、DOT、DIMS、HALT 和 HORI，并按性别、年龄及基线眼部生物测量参数进行匹配。数据集随机分为训练集（80%）和验证集（20%），用于模型评估。研究针对每种镜片设计分别建立基于眼部生物测量参数的多元线性回归预测模型，并最终开发 R 语言函数用于临床个性化推荐。 结果：匹配基线参数后，五种周边离焦框架眼镜在控制眼轴增长方面未观察到统计学显著差异（P=0.28）。训练集决定系数（R²）为0.89–0.96，验证集为0.88–0.97；训练集均方根误差（RMSE）为0.05–0.07 mm，验证集为0.04–0.07 mm。校准图显示预测值与观察值具有良好一致性。 结论：尽管五种镜片设计在平均疗效上未显示显著差异，本研究成功建立了基于眼部生物测量参数的预测模型，可用于指导周边离焦框架眼镜的个性化验配。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To construct a predictive model for personalized recommendation of peripheral defocus spectacle designs based on ocular biometric parameters. METHODS: This retrospective cohort study included 2824 myopic children who wore peripheral defocus spectacles at the Ophthalmology Center of Peking University People's Hospital. Participants were divided into five groups according to the spectacle designs (Diversified Segmental Defocus Optimization [DSDO], Diffusion Optics Technology [DOT], Defocus Induced Multiple Segment [DIMS], Highly Aspherical Lenslets [HALT], Hexagon Optimized Reticular Integration [HORI]) and matched for gender, age, and baseline biometric parameters. The dataset was randomly split into training (80%) and validation (20%) sets for model evaluation. Separate multiple linear regression prediction models based on ocular biometric parameters were constructed for each designs. Finally, an R language function was developed for clinical personalized recommendation. RESULTS: After matching baseline parameters, no statistically significant difference was observed in axial elongation control efficacy among the five peripheral defocus spectacles designs (P = 0.28). The coefficient of determination (R2) ranged from 0.89 to 0.96 in the training set and from 0.88 to 0.97 in the validation set; the root mean square error (RMSE) ranged from 0.05 mm to 0.07 mm in the training set and from 0.04 mm to 0.07 mm in the validation set. Calibration plots showed good agreement between predicted and observed values. CONCLUSION: Although no significant differences in average efficacy were observed among the five designs, this study successfully established predictive models based on ocular biometric parameters to guide personalized fitting of peripheral defocus spectacles.

摘要 目的：回顾性分析两个数据集，探讨在佩戴多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）镜片进行近视管理时，进展性近视与散光之间的相关性，重点关注散光类型对儿童近视进展的影响。 方法：获取了亚洲儿童人群和高加索儿童人群两个匿名数据集的回顾性右眼数据进行分析。受试者基线屈光不正被分为四类：单纯球镜、顺规散光（WTR）、斜向散光或逆规散光（ATR）。通过基线与随访时等效球镜度（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）的变化评估近视进展。 结果：回顾性分析了265名儿童（160名亚洲人和105名高加索人）的右眼数据。合并数据集（n = 184）的线性混合模型（LMM）分析显示，散光类型对SER变化的纵向模式具有统计学显著的主效应（p < 0.001），而时间与散光的交互作用不显著（p = 0.07）。相反，LMM显示散光类型对AL变化无统计学显著主效应（p = 0.06），时间与散光类型的交互项对AL变化亦无显著影响（p = 0.21），表明尽管基线存在差异，各组随时间的近视进展轨迹相当。分析表明，WTR散光与最少的近视进展相关，而ATR散光与最大的进展相关。基线散光的存在并未显著影响佩戴DIMS镜片儿童的近视进展。 结论：散光类型影响近视进展。佩戴DIMS镜片的WTR散光受试者与斜向或ATR散光受试者相比近视进展较少。需要对接受近视管理的不同散光类型受试者进行长期研究，以更好理解进展性近视与散光类型之间的关系。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: This study aimed to retrospectively analyse two datasets to investigate the correlation between progressive myopia and astigmatism focusing on the influence of the type of astigmatism on myopia progression in children undergoing myopia management with Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses. Patients and Methods: Retrospective right eye data from two anonymised datasets were obtained for analysis: an Asian paediatric population, and a Caucasian paediatric population. Participants’ refractive error at baseline was classified into one of four categories: spherical, with-the-rule (WTR), oblique or against-the-rule (ATR) astigmatism. Myopia progression was evaluated by the change in Spherical Equivalent Refraction (SER) and Axial Length (AL) between baseline and follow-up visits. Results: Retrospective analyses were conducted on right eye data from 265 children (160 Asian & 105 Caucasian). Linear Mixed Models (LMM) analysis of the combined datasets (n = 184) demonstrated a statistically significant main effect of astigmatism type on longitudinal patterns on SER change (p < 0.001), interaction between time and astigmatism was not significant (p = 0.07). In contrast, the LMM resulted in no statistically significant main effect of the astigmatism types on AL change (p = 0.06). The interaction term between time and astigmatism type also did not reveal a statistically significant effect on AL change (p = 0.21). This indicates that the trajectory of myopia progression over time was comparable across all groups despite initial differences at baseline. Analyses revealed that WTR-astigmatism was associated with the least myopia progression and ATR-astigmatism was associated with the greatest progression in this study. The presence of astigmatism at baseline did not significantly affect myopia progression in children wearing DIMS spectacles. Conclusion: The type of astigmatism affected myopia progression. Participants with WTR-astigmatism wearing DIMS spectacles showed less myopia progression compared to participants with oblique or ATR-astigmatism. Long-term investigations in participants with different types of astigmatism undergoing myopia management are required to better understand the relationship between progressive myopia and astigmatism type.

DIMS-the long-term patient journey with DIMS spectacle lenses - a mixed-methods study of satisfaction, adherence and socioeconomic barriers

DIMS长期真实世界佩戴体验：满意度高但费用影响持续使用

📖 Ophthalmic and Physiological Optics
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-8-13 DIMS长期真实世界佩戴体验：满意度高但费用影响持续使用 起始时间：2024年4月开始数据收集；距最初DIMS临床试验开始约8-10年，距最后临床试验结束2年 研究中心&PI：香港理工大学视光学院 & Tsz Wing Leung / Han Yu Zhang / Carly S.Y. Lam 研究设计：回顾性混合方法研究，在线问卷+半结构化电话访谈，纳入既往DIMS临床试验儿童参与者（现17-23岁） 样本量：63人 结果：88.9%满意/非常满意，90.4%相信DIMS有效；维护和耐用性是长期满意度最强预测因素。仅34.9%仍继续使用DIMS，高自费成本是停用的主要原因，提示临床疗效与可及性之间仍存在差距。

摘要 目的：虽然多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）眼镜镜片已被证实可有效延缓近视进展，但其长期真实的患者体验尚不明确。本研究旨在对长期佩戴DIMS镜片的人群进行佩戴体验的定量和定性分析。 方法：这项回顾性、融合平行混合方法研究纳入了63名曾在8-10年前参与DIMS镜片临床试验的前儿童受试者（现年龄17-23岁）。数据在最终临床试验结束2年后收集。通过定量在线问卷评估佩戴体验，并通过深入的半结构化电话访谈探索真实的佩戴历程。采用多元线性回归确定满意度的预测因素，并采用系统主题分析法分析定性访谈记录。 结果：定量分析显示佩戴者满意度高，88.9%的佩戴者感到满意或非常满意，90.4%的人坚信DIMS镜片的有效性。回归分析表明，维护与耐用度是长期满意度最强的预测因素，其次是对外观的正面评价（调整后R2 = 0.50，p < 0.001）。定性分析揭示了患者历程特征为父母主导开始佩戴、可控的感官适应期以及基于个人经验的强烈有效感。然而，仅有三分之一的受试者继续使用DIMS镜片，这一决定主要是由眼镜的高昂费用所致。 结论：DIMS镜片提供了高度积极的长期佩戴体验。然而，眼镜的高昂费用构成了治疗持续性的主要社会经济障碍，凸显了临床试验成功与试验外实际获取之间的重大差距。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
PURPOSE: While defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses are clinically proven effective in slowing myopia progression, the long-term, real-world patient experience is poorly understood. This study aimed to provide both quantitative and qualitative analyses of the wearer experience in a long-term cohort of DIMS wearers. METHODS: This retrospective, convergent parallel mixed-methods study included 63 former child participants (now aged 17–23 years) who participated in the previous DIMS spectacle lenses clinical trial 8–10 years earlier. Data were collected 2 years after the final clinical trial concluded. A quantitative online questionnaire assessed wearer experience, while in-depth, semi-structured phone interviews explored the lived wearer journey. Predictors of satisfaction were identified using multiple linear regression and qualitative transcripts were analysed using a systematic thematic approach. RESULTS: Quantitative analysis revealed high satisfaction, with 88.9% of wearers satisfied or very satisfied and 90.4% believing in the efficacy of DIMS spectacle lenses. Regression analysis identified Maintenance and Durability as the strongest predictors of long-term satisfaction, alongside positive perceptions of appearance (adjusted R2 = 0.50, p < 0.001). Qualitative analysis revealed a patient journey defined by parent-driven initiation, a manageable sensory adaptation period and strong perceived efficacy based on personal experience. However, only one-third of participants had continued DIMS use; a decision driven overwhelmingly by the high cost of the spectacles. CONCLUSION: DIMS spectacle lenses provide a highly positive long-term wearer experience. However, the high cost of the spectacles creates a dominant socioeconomic barrier to treatment continuity, highlighting a critical gap between clinical success and access outside the trial setting.

DIMS spectacle lenses slow myopia progression - a 2-year RCT

内容摘要（根据本地文件整理）
摘要 目的：确定多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）眼镜镜片是否能延缓儿童近视进展。 方法：在183名8-13岁、近视度数为-1.00至-5.00 D且散光≤1.50 D的中国儿童中开展了一项为期2年的双盲随机对照试验。受试儿童被随机分配佩戴DIMS镜片（n=93）或单光（SV）镜片（n=90）。DIMS镜片包含+3.50 D近视性离焦的多个微区。每6个月测量一次屈光不正（睫状肌麻痹电脑验光）和眼轴长度。 结果：160名儿童完成了研究，DIMS组79名，SV组81名。2年间DIMS组的平均（SE）近视进展为-0.41±0.06 D，SV组为-0.85±0.08 D。DIMS组和SV组的平均（SE）眼轴增长分别为0.21±0.02 mm和0.55±0.02 mm。与SV组相比，DIMS组儿童的近视进展减慢52%（平均差异-0.44±0.09 D，95% CI -0.73至-0.37，p<0.0001）。同样，DIMS组儿童的眼轴增长比SV组少62%（平均差异0.34±0.04 mm，95% CI 0.22至0.37，p<0.0001）。佩戴DIMS镜片的儿童中有21.5%在2年内无近视进展，而佩戴SV镜片的儿童中仅为7.4%。 结论：日常佩戴DIMS镜片可显著延缓近视儿童的近视进展和眼轴增长。研究结果表明，同时提供清晰视觉与恒定近视性离焦可有效延缓近视进展。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Abstract Aim To determine if ’Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments’ (DIMS) spectacle lenses slow childhood myopia progression. Methods A 2-year double-masked randomised controlled trial was carried out in 183 Chinese children aged 8–13 years, with myopia between −1.00 and −5.00 D and astigmatism ≤1.50 D. Children were randomly assigned to wear DIMS (n=93) or single vision (SV) spectacle lenses (n=90). DIMS lens incorporated multiple segments with myopic defocus of +3.50 D. Refractive error (cycloplegic autorefraction) and axial length were measured at 6month intervals. Results 160 children completed the study, n=79 in the DIMS group and n=81 in the SV group. Average (SE) myopic progressions over 2 years were −0.41±0.06 D in the DIMS group and −0.85±0.08 D in the SV group. Mean (SE) axial elongation was 0.21±0.02 mm and 0.55±0.02 mm in the DIMS and SV groups, respectively. Myopia progressed 52% more slowly for children in the DIMS group compared with those in the SV group (mean difference −0.44±0.09 D, 95% CI −0.73 to −0.37, p<0.0001). Likewise, children in the DIMS group had less axial elongation by 62% than those in the SV group (mean difference 0.34±0.04 mm, 95% CI 0.22 to 0.37, p<0.0001). 21.5% children who wore DIMS lenses had no myopia progression over 2 years, but only 7.4% for those who wore SV lenses. Conclusions Daily wear of the DIMS lens significantly retarded myopia progression and axial elongation in myopic children. Our results demonstrated simultaneous clear vision with constant myopic defocus can slow myopia progression. Trial registration number NCT02206217.

实验室光学检测-PSF&MTF-optical and imaging properties of a novel multi-segment spectacle lens designed to slow myopia progression

内容摘要（根据本地文件整理）
摘要 目的：应用高采样密度的光学计量学结合瞳孔平面和像平面的数值分析，评估一款旨在延缓近视进展、含有多个小微区的新型眼镜镜片。 方法：使用高分辨率像差仪对在周边集成许多正度数小微透镜的新型多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）眼镜镜片的波前斜率进行采样。利用波前斜率和误差图，采用定制MATLAB软件计算双焦光学系统在不同瞳孔大小和目标聚散度下的像平面点扩散函数（PSF）、调制传递函数（MTF）、模拟图像和屈光力分布。 结果：在包含单光远用度数的10 mm中心区外，周边分布着呈六边形排列、直径1 mm且相邻间距0.5 mm的小微透镜。基于矢状面和曲率的屈光力测量未能完全准确反映微透镜产生的恒定+3.50 D附加度数。像平面模拟显示在微透镜焦平面处存在多个PSF且图像质量较差。远用光学焦平面处的模糊与来自远用光学的衍射模糊以及来自直径1 mm近用光学区约+3.50 D离焦的组合一致。 结论：将多个小微透镜（直径1 mm）产生的离焦光束汇聚在远用焦平面的模糊图像上，产生的模糊量由小微透镜直径决定，而非由整体瞳孔直径决定。位于近附加微透镜之间的远用光学区决定了镜片能达到的光学质量极限。与传统同心圆双焦隐形眼镜的光学设计相比，DIMS镜片在低空间频率（<7 cpd）下产生更高对比度的图像，但在高空间频率下对比度较低。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Abstract Purpose: High sampling density optical metrology combined with pupil- and image-plane numerical analyses were applied to evaluate a novel spectacle lens containing multiple small zones designed to slow myopia progression. Methods: High-resolution aberrometry (ClearWave, www.lumetrics.com) was used to sample wavefront slopes of a novel spectacle lens, Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) (www.hoya.com), incorporating many small, positive-powered lenslets in its periphery. Using wavefront slope and error maps, custom MATLAB software (‘Indiana Wavefront Analyzer’) was used to compute image-plane point-spread functions (PSF), modulation transfer functions (MTF), simulated images and power distributions created by the dual-focus optic for different pupil sizes and target vergences. Results: Outside of a central 10 mm zone containing single distance optical power, a hexagonal array of small 1 mm lenslets with nearest-neighbour separations of 0.5 mm were distributed over the lens periphery. Sagittal and curvature-based measures of optical power imperfectly captured the consistent +3.50 D add produced by the lenslets. Image plane simulations revealed multiple PSFs and poor image quality at the lenslet focal plane. Blur at the distance optic focal plane was consistent with a combination of diffraction blur from the distance optic and the approximately +3.50 D of defocus from the 1 mm diameter near optic zones. Conclusion: Converging the defocused beams generated by the multiple small (1 mm diameter) lenslets to a blurred image at the distance focal plane produced a blur magnitude determined by the small lenslet diameter and not the overall pupil diameter. The distance optic located in between the near-add lenslets determines the limits of the optical quality achievable by the lens. When compared to the optics of a traditional concentric-zone dual-focus contact lens, the optics of the DIMS lens generates higher-contrast images at low spatial frequencies (<7 cycles per degree), but lower-contrast at high spatial frequencies.

Myopia control efficacy of second-generation defocus incorporated multiple segments spectacle lenses on fast progressing myopes: Study protocol of a randomised controlled trial

DIMS 2.0对早发/快速进展性近视控制效果-方案

📖 PloS one📅 2025年👥 Hon Ying, Chun Rachel Ka Man, Leung Tsz Wing, Qi Hua, Hasegawa Keigo, Leung Ka Yan, To Chi Ho, Lam Carly Siu Yin, Tse Dennis Yan-Yin
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-1 DIMS 2.0对早发/快速进展性近视控制效果-方案 起始时间：2023年9月1日 研究中心&PI：香港理工大学视光学院近视研究中心polyU & Carly Siu Yin Lam、Dennis Yan-Yin Tse 试验设计简述：前瞻性双盲阳性对照，随机，交叉设计 试验组样本量：DIMS 2.0组65人 第二年（SV→DIMS 2.0 ;DIMS→DIMS 2.0;DIMS 2.0）
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 超乐学 / 1年临床试验 / 2-1
原文摘要
摘要 背景：基于镜片的近视控制干预措施因具有无创性，受到家长和儿童的青睐。然而，其长期效果仍较为有限，且未针对早发性近视、进展快速的高危儿童群体进行研究。本文介绍一项试验的研究方案，该试验旨在评估新一代多段离焦（DIMS）镜片在延缓早发性、快速进展型近视儿童近视进展方面的效果。 方法与设计：本研究为一项前瞻性、双盲、活性对照、随机试验（ClinicalTrials.gov 注册号：NCT05888792 和 NCT05888805）。研究对象为 4-12 岁中国学龄儿童，需满足双眼近视度数至少为−0.75 屈光度（D），且单眼或双眼存在快速进展（每年 0.50 D）或眼轴快速增长（每年≥0.27 毫米）的情况。研究对象按年龄分层，以 1:1:1 的比例随机分配至试验组、对照组或辅助组。试验组佩戴新一代 DIMS 镜片，对照组佩戴单光镜片。对照组受试者在第一年末将交叉改用试验组镜片，所有受试者在第二年均继续佩戴试验组镜片。辅助组则连续两年佩戴市售 DIMS 镜片。主要和次要结局指标为基线至 12 个月时睫状肌麻痹客观验光结果和眼轴长度的变化。同时，将监测周边验光结果和脉络膜厚度，并探究其与近视控制效果的关联。 讨论：本研究将为新一代 DIMS 技术在早发性、快速进展型近视儿童中的近视控制效果提供参考，为近视管理提供循证依据。 实验注册：NCT05888792 和 NCT05888805
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
BACKGROUND: Spectacle-based interventions for myopia control are appealing to parents and children due to their non-invasive nature. However, long-term efficacy results remain modest and do not account for high-risk children with early-onset myopia and fast progression. This paper presents the protocol of a trial designed to evaluate the efficacy of the new-generation Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) spectacle lenses in slowing the progression of myopia in children with early-onset and fast myopia progression. METHODS AND DESIGN: This is a prospective, double-masked, active-controlled, randomised trial (ClinicalTrials.gov identifiers: NCT05888792 and NCT05888805). Participants are Chinese schoolchildren aged 4-12 years with myopia of at least -0.75 diopter (D) in both eyes and with fast progression (≥ 0.50 D per year) or fast axial growth (≥ 0.27 mm per year) in either or both eyes. They are age-stratified and randomly assigned to an experimental arm, a control arm or an auxiliary arm in a 1:1:1 ratio. The experimental arm receives new-generation DIMS spectacle lenses, while the control arm receives single-vision spectacle lenses. The control subjects will crossover to experimental lenses at the end of the first year, and all subjects will continue wearing experimental lenses in the second year. The auxiliary arm receives marketed DIMS spectacle lenses for two years. The primary and secondary outcome measures are the changes in cycloplegic objective refraction and axial length at 12 months from baseline. Peripheral refraction and choroidal thickness will also be monitored, and their relationships with myopia control efficacy will be explored. DISCUSSION: This study will provide insights into the efficacy of a new generation of DIMS technology for controlling myopia in children with early-onset and fast myopia progression, offering evidence-based practice for myopia management. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov identifiers: NCT05888792 and NCT05888805.

Short-term effect of second-generation defocus incorporated multiple segments spectacle lenses on choroidal thickness in children

DIMS2.0两款设计vsSVL-脉络膜厚度-ARVO摘要

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2025年
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-4-1 DIMS2.0两款设计vsSVL-脉络膜厚度-ARVO摘要 结论：第二代DIMS（多区正向光学离焦）眼镜镜片在短期配戴后，能诱导学龄儿童的脉络膜出现显著增厚。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 超乐学 / 6-4 效果预测 （包括脉络膜厚度） / 6-4-1
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：探讨新型近视控制镜片设计对学龄儿童脉络膜厚度的短期影响。 方法：招募6至13岁此前未接受过近视控制干预的近视学龄儿童。分组前采集基线睫状肌麻痹验光、眼轴长度（AL）和脉络膜厚度（ChT）等眼部参数。使用扫频源光学相干断层扫描仪测量ChT。儿童被随机分为D1和D2两组，单眼随机配戴第二代多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）镜片（D1或D2），另一眼配戴单光镜片作为对照。佩戴该副眼镜2周后，双眼改戴单光镜片2周作为恢复期。在第4周收集数据后，双眼根据分组佩戴D1或D2镜片12个月。在佩戴镜片1小时后及随后4周内每周监测两组双眼的AL和ChT。计算并使用单向重复测量方差分析比较两组ChT相对于基线的眼间差异（IOD）。 结果：共招募89名平均年龄相近的近视学龄儿童（D1组：9.78±1.95岁，n=44；另一组：9.72±1.80岁，n=45）。两组治疗眼与对照眼之间的等效球镜度具有可比性（配对t检验，p > 0.05）。佩戴D1和D2镜片1小时后ChT无显著变化。佩戴1周后，治疗眼ChT显著增加（1周时IOD较基线平均变化±SEM：D1组11.32±2.22 µm vs. D2组11.69±2.48 µm，p < 0.001）。佩戴2周时两组脉络膜继续增厚（D1组14.14±2.18 µm vs. D2组15.69±2.60 µm，p < 0.001）。摘除D1和D2镜片后，ChT在第4周下降并恢复至基线水平。 结论：两款镜片在短期佩戴后均诱导了学龄儿童脉络膜显著增厚。所观察到的增厚支持了第二代DIMS眼镜镜片在近视控制方面的潜在有效性。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Abstract Purpose : To investigate the short-term effect of the new designs of myopic control lenses on choroidal thickness in schoolchildren. Methods : Myopic schoolchildren aged 6 to 13 years with no previous myopic control interventions were recruited. Baseline measurement including cycloplegic refraction, ocular parameter such as axial length (AL) and choroidal thickness (ChT) were collected before allocation of the group. Choroidal thickness was measured by a swept-source optical coherence tomographer. Schoolchildren were randomly allocated into 2 groups, D1 and D2 group. One eye was randomly treated with D1 or D2 lens while the other eye was fitted with single vision spectacle lenses as control. D1 and D2 lenses were the second-generation defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lenses. After wearing this pair of lenses for 2 weeks, both eyes were then fitted with single vision lenses for another 2 weeks as recovery. After the data collection at week 4, both eyes were treated with either D1 or D2 lenses according to their grouping for 12 months. AL and ChT were monitored in both eyes of the groups after 1 hour of lens wear and subsequently on a weekly basis for 4 weeks. Interocular difference (IOD) in ChT relative to baseline in both groups were calculated and compared using one-way repeated measures ANOVA. Results : Eight-nine myopic schoolchildren with similar mean age in both D1 (9.78 ± 1.95 years old, n = 44) and D1 group (9.72 ± 1.80 years old, n = 45) were recruited. Spherical equivalent refraction between treated and control eyes in both groups were comparable (paired t-test, p > 0.05). There was no significant change in ChT after wearing D1 and D2 lenses for an hour. ChT of the treated eyes were increased significantly after one week of D1 and D2 lens wear (mean changes in IOD at 1 week relative to baseline ± SEM; D1 vs. D2; 11.32 ± 2.22 µm vs. 11.69 ± 2.48 µm, p < 0.001). The thickening of choroid continued at 2-week lens wear in both groups (D1 vs. D2; 14.14 ± 2.18 µm vs. 15.69 ± 2.60 µm, p < 0.001). After removal of D1 and D2 lenses, ChT decreased and returned to the baseline at week 4. Conclusions : Both lenses induced significant choroidal thickening in schoolchildren after short-term of lens wear. This observed thickening supports the potential effectiveness of the second-generation DIMS spectacle lenses for myopia control.

ARVO-脉络膜厚度研究- Short-term effect of second-generation defocus incorporated multiple segments spectacle lenses on choroidal thickness in children

📖 Investigative Ophthalmology & Visual Science📅 2025年👥 Rachel Ka-man Chun; Kenneth Liu; Tsz Kin Law; Ying Hon; Hua Qi; Keigo Hasegawa; Carly S Y Lam; Chi-ho To; Dennis Yan-yin Tse
内容摘要（根据本地文件整理）
摘要 目的：探讨新型近视控制镜片设计对学龄儿童脉络膜厚度（ChT）的短期影响。 方法：招募6至13岁且此前未接受过近视控制干预的近视学龄儿童。分组前采集睫状肌麻痹验光、眼轴长度（AL）和脉络膜厚度（ChT，使用SS-OCT测量）等基线数据。受试儿童随机分为D1组和D2组，一只眼随机配戴第二代多区正向光学离焦镜片（D1或D2），另一只眼配戴单光镜片（SV）作为对照。配戴2周后，双眼换戴单光镜片2周以恢复。在第4周数据采集后，双眼根据分组配戴D1或D2镜片12个月。在戴镜1小时后以及随后4周内每周监测双眼的AL和ChT。计算两组相对于基线的双眼ChT眼间差（IOD），并采用单因素重复测量方差分析进行比较。 结果：共招募89名学龄近视儿童，D1组（9.78±1.95岁，n=44）与D2组（原文误写为D1 group，9.72±1.80岁，n=45）平均年龄相近。两组治疗眼与对照眼之间的等效球镜度数相当（配对t检验，p>0.05）。配戴D1和D2镜片1小时后ChT无显著变化。配戴1周后，治疗眼ChT显著增加（1周时相对于基线的IOD平均变化量±SEM：D1组11.32±2.22 μm vs D2组11.69±2.48 μm，p<0.001）。配戴2周时两组脉络膜增厚持续存在（D1组14.14±2.18 μm vs D2组15.69±2.60 μm，p<0.001）。停戴D1和D2镜片后，ChT下降并在第4周恢复至基线水平。 结论：两款镜片在短期佩戴后均能诱导学龄儿童显著的脉络膜增厚，此观察结果支持第二代DIMS框架眼镜用于近视控制的潜在有效性。

Purpose : To investigate the short-term effect of the new designs of myopic control lenses on choroidal thickness in schoolchildren. Methods : Myopic schoolchildren aged 6 to 13 years with no previous myopic control interventions were recruited. Baseline measurement including cycloplegic refraction, ocular parameter such as axial length (AL) and choroidal thickness (ChT) were collected before allocation of the group. Choroidal thickness was measured by a swept-source optical coherence tomographer. Schoolchildren were randomly allocated into 2 groups, D1 and D2 group. One eye was randomly treated with D1 or D2 lens while the other eye was fitted with single vision spectacle lenses as control. D1 and D2 lenses were the second-generation defocus incorporated multiple segments (DIMS) lenses. After wearing this pair of lenses for 2 weeks, both eyes were then fitted with single vision lenses for another 2 weeks as recovery. After the data collection at week 4, both eyes were treated with either D1 or D2 lenses according to their grouping for 12 months. AL and ChT were monitored in both eyes of the groups after 1 hour of lens wear and subsequently on a weekly basis for 4 weeks. After removal of D1 and D2 lenses, ChT decreased and returned to the baseline at week 4. Evaluation of the Visual Performance of Two Modified Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) Spectacle Lens Designs

DIMS(DIMS、D1、D2 ) vs SVL 视觉质量-ARVO摘要

📅 2025年 📖 Investigative Ophthalmology & Visual Science👥 Carly S Y Lam; Kenneth Liu; Han Yu Zhang; Hua Qi; Keigo Hasegawa; Shohei Matsuoka; Ka Yan Leung; Dennis Yan-yin Tse; Chi Ho To
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-6-1 DIMS(DIMS、D1、D2 ) vs SVL 视觉质量-ARVO摘要 试验设计：交叉设计【随机顺序佩戴DIMS、D1、D2、SVL，每种佩戴一周】 结论：两种改良型DIMS镜片（D1和D2）在多数视觉功能上与原始DIMS及单光镜片表现相当，但其中央光学区更小的D2镜片会导致近视力轻微下降，且DIMS类镜片都显示出更多的对焦困难症状
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 超乐学 / 6-6 视觉质量研究 / 6-6-1
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：评估基于DIMS镜片设计改造的两款具有不同中央光学区、增加离焦量和扩大近视离焦区面积的框架眼镜（D1和D2）的视觉质量表现。 方法：在一项前瞻性交叉研究中，受试者以随机顺序分别佩戴4种镜片设计（DIMS、D1、D2以及单光镜SV）各1周。镜片根据睫状肌麻痹主觉验光配制。评估受试者在不同照度水平下的高对比度和低对比度视力、隐斜视、立体视和调节功能。在每种镜片佩戴1周后，采用问卷评估各症状的发生频率（0=从不至4=总是）和严重程度（0=完全没有至4=极严重）。除隐斜视和立体视外，右眼数据采用配对t检验和重复测量方差分析，并进行必要的事后检验。 结果：38名受试者完成了研究。各镜片设计之间的远视力无显著差异。然而，中央光学区较小的D2镜片设计与SV相比，在高对比度（室内照明，事后两两比较，p<0.05）和低对比度（暗光照明，事后两两比较，p<0.01）下近视力略有下降（0.04 logMAR）。大多数视觉功能无显著差异（p>0.05）。与SV相比，佩戴DIMS、D1和D2镜片时，聚焦困难等症状的报告频率更高（p<0.01），但整体症状发生频率相似。 结论：增加近视离焦量和离焦区比例在大多数视觉功能上保持了与DIMS及SV相当的视觉质量，但D2设计显示近视力略有下降。这些发现表明个性化定制镜片设计在优化近视控制方面具有潜力。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose : This study evaluates the visual performance of two spectacle lenses (D1 and D2) with, different central optical zones, increased defocus power and increased area of myopic defocus zone, based on the DIMS spectacle lens design. Methods : In a prospective crossover study, participants wore four spectacle lens designs (DIMS, D1, D2 single vision (SV)) for one week each in random order. Spectacles were ordered according to the cycloplegic subjective refraction. The subjects were assessed for visual acuity in high and low contrast with different luminance levels, heterophoria, stereopsis and accommodation function. The methods of measurement followed the previous DIMS RCT and visual performance measurement procedures. A questionnaire was used to evaluate symptoms in terms of frequency and intensity for each spectacle lens design at the end of one-week wear. Subjects needed to score the frequency (0 = Never; 1 = Seldom; 2 = Sometimes; 3 = Often; 4 = Always) and the intensity (0 = Not at all; 1 = Mild; 2 = Moderate; 3 = Severe; 4 = Very Severe) of the listed symptoms if any. Apart from heterophoria and stereopsis, data from the right eye were analysed using paired t-tests and repeated measures ANOVAs, with post-hoc tests as needed. Results : Thirty-eight subjects completed the study. No significant differences in distant VA were observed between the spectacle lens designs. However, D2 spectacle lens design, with a smaller central optical zone, showed slightly reduced near VA (0.04 logMar) under high contrast (room lighting, post-hoc pairwise test, p<0.05) and low contrast (dim lighting, post-hoc pairwise test, p<0.01) when compared to SV spectacle lens. Most visual functions showed no significant differences (p>0.05). Symptoms like difficulty focusing were reported more frequently with DIMS, D1, and D2 spectacle lenses than SV (p<0.01), though overall symptoms frequency was similar. Conclusions : Increase myopic defocus power and defocus zone ratio maintained comparable visual performance to DIMS and SV spectacle lenses for most visual functions but slightly reduced near VA was found in the D2 lens design. These findings suggest potential for tailored lens designs to optimize myopia control.

来源=桌面《框架眼镜SP》/05 豪雅DIMS TED/6-6-1 ARVO-视觉质量研究- Evaluation of the Visual Performance of Two Modified Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (DIMS) Spectacle Lens Designs.pdf 来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：摘要： 研究目的：本研究基于 DIMS 眼镜片设计，评估两款具有不同中央光学区、增强离焦量和扩大近视离焦区面积的眼镜片（D1 和 D2）的视觉表现。 研究方法：在一项前瞻性交叉研究中，受试者按随机顺序佩戴四种眼镜片设计（DIMS、D1、D2、单光镜（SV）），每种佩戴一周。眼镜处方依据睫状肌麻痹主观验光结果确定。评估内容包括不同亮度下的高、低对比度视力、隐斜、立体视及调节功能。测量方法沿用此前 DIMS 随机对照试验及视觉表现评估流程。在每种镜片佩戴一周后，通过问卷评估相关症状的发生频率与严重程度。受试者需对所列症状（若有）的频率（0 = 从未发生；1 = 很少发生；2 = 有时发生；3 = 经常发生；4 = 总是发生）和严重程度（0 = 无任何症状；1 = 轻度；2 = 中度；3 = 重度；4 = 极重度）进行评分。除隐斜和立体视数据外，右眼数据采用配对 t 检验和重复测量方差分析，并在需要时进行事后检验。 研究结果：38 名受试者完成研究。不同镜片设计间的远视力无显著差异。然而，中央光学区更小的 D2 镜片在高对比度（室内照明，事后两两比较，p<0.05）和低对比度（昏暗照明，事后两两比较，p<0.01）条件下，近视力较单光镜略有下降（0.04 logMar）。多数视觉功能无显著差异（p>0.05）。DIMS、D1 和 D2 镜片的聚焦困难等症状发生率显著高于单光镜（p<0.01），但整体症状发生频率相近。 研究结论：增加近视离焦量和离焦区占比后，多数视觉功能表现与 DIMS 及单光镜相当，但 D2 镜片的近视力略有下降。这些结果提示，定制化镜片设计有望进一步优化近视控制效果。

参考文献6-6-2 DIMS TED vs DIMS vs SVL视觉表现-DIMS TED整体可接受 起始时间：2026年发表 研究中心&PI：香港理工大学近视研究中心 & Carly S.Y. Lam 试验设计简述：前瞻性交叉研究，38名6-13岁中国近视儿童，随机顺序配戴DIMS TED、DIMS和SV镜片，每种1周；评估远/近高低对比视力、中周边视力、双眼视觉、调节和主观症状 结果：DIMS TED低对比近视力较DIMS/SVL略低约0.06 logMAR，中周边远/近视力较SVL约低0.10 logMAR；但不太可能构成具有临床意义的视觉损害。DIMS TED整体视觉表现与DIMS及SVL相近，多数儿童适应和接受良好。

摘要 目的：比较佩戴多区正向光学离焦（DIMS）、三重增强设计DIMS（DIMS TED）及单光（SV）眼镜镜片的近视儿童短期视功能变化。 方法：招募38名等效球镜屈光不正为-1.00 D至-5.00 D的中国儿童（6至13岁）。受试者按随机顺序佩戴DIMS、DIMS TED和SV镜片。在配戴镜片1周前后评估室内光线与昏暗光线下的高对比度和低对比度远近视力（VA）、中周边近视力、双眼视功能、调节功能和视觉症状，并在第二次随访中评估有无眩光时的中周边远视力。 结果：大多数视功能在配戴前后无差异。与SV镜片相比，在室内光线和昏暗光线下，中心高对比度与低对比度远视力及中心高对比度近视力均未受到DIMS和DIMS TED镜片的影响（所有P > 0.05）。在室内光线下，DIMS TED镜片比DIMS镜片的中心低对比度近视力下降了0.06±0.10 logMAR（P < 0.01）；在昏暗光线下，比SV镜片下降了0.06±0.11 logMAR（P < 0.01）。与SV镜片相比，DIMS TED和DIMS镜片的中周边远视力和近视力分别下降了约0.10 logMAR（P < 0.01）。然而，这些下降不太可能构成临床上有意义的视功能损害。大多数儿童对DIMS TED镜片适应和接受良好。 结论：DIMS TED镜片展现出与DIMS和SV镜片相当的视觉表现。增强设计维持了视觉表现，并可能提高近视控制效果。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To compare short-term visual functions changes in myopic children who had worn the defocus incorporated multiple segment (DIMS), DIMS with triple enhanced design (DIMS TED), and single-vision (SV) spectacle lenses. Methods: Thirty-eight Chinese children (six to 13 years) with spherical equivalent refractive error −1.00 D to −5.00 D were recruited. Participants wore DIMS, DIMS TED and SV spectacle lenses in random order. High- and low-contrast distance and near visual acuity (VA), mid-peripheral near VA, binocular functions, accommodation and visual symptoms were assessed before and after 1-week of lens wear, while mid-peripheral distance VA was assessed with and without glare in a second visit. Results: Most visual functions showed no differences before and after lens wear. Central high- and low-contrast distance VA and central high-contrast near VA under room and dim lighting were unaffected by DIMS and DIMS TED spectacle lenses compared to SV lenses (all P > 0.05). Central low-contrast near VA was reduced by 0.06 ± 0.10 logMAR in DIMS TED lenses compared to DIMS lenses under room lighting (P < 0.01), and by 0.06 ± 0.11 logMAR compared with SV spectacle lenses under dim lighting (P < 0.01). Mid-peripheral distance VA and near VA were reduced by approximately 0.10 logMAR in DIMS TED and DIMS compared to SV lenses (P < 0.01), respectively. However, these reductions are unlikely to represent a clinically meaningful impairment in visual function. Most children adapted and accepted the DIMS TED spectacle lenses well. Conclusions: DIMS TED spectacle lenses demonstrated visual performance comparable to DIMS and SV spectacle lenses. Translational Relevance: The enhanced design of the DIMS TED spectacle lenses maintains visual performance comparable to DIMS and single vision spectacle lenses, and may potentially increase myopia control efficacy.

Myopia Control Efficacy of Asymmetric Multipoint Defocus Technique Spectacle Lenses: One-Year Double-Masked Randomized Controlled Trial

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2025年👥 Wang Mengyi, Ma Runting, Kuang Longhao, Chen Xiaoqin, Vincent Stephen J, Tan Hongmei, Lai Zhipeng, Xu Shengsong, Hu Yin, Han Mengya, Chen Qiwen, Wang Zixin, Li Lihua, Yang Xiao
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-1 起始时间：2023年1月 研究中心&PI：中山眼科中心-杨晓，天津眼科医院-李丽华 试验设计简述：多中心RCT 试验组样本量：AMDT组72人 SE：进展量-0.16D，控制量0.34D，控制率68% AL：进展量0.17mm，控制量0.15mm,控制率47%
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 轻松控PRO2.0 / 1年临床试验 / 2-1
原文摘要
摘要 目的：评估非对称多点离焦技术（AMDT）镜片 12 个月的近视控制效果。 设计：双盲随机对照试验。 研究对象：140 名研究对象完成了所有随访（平均年龄 10.6±1.5 岁，女性占 50%），其等效球镜度数（SER）介于 - 5.00 至 - 0.75 屈光度（D）之间，散光度数≤1.50 屈光度，屈光参差≤1.50 屈光度。 方法：从 2 个眼科中心招募 144 名 8-13 岁、近视度数为 - 0.75 至 - 5.00 屈光度的儿童，按 1:1 比例随机分为两组，分别佩戴 AMDT 镜片或单光镜片（SVLs）。在基线、6 个月和 12 个月随访时，测量睫状肌麻痹后的等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）。干预期间还发放了适应性和视觉表现调查问卷。 主要结局指标：1 年后等效球镜度数（SER）的变化为主要结局指标；1 年后眼轴长度（AL）、视觉表现及眼部参数的变化为次要结局指标。 结果：12 个月后，单光镜片（SVLs）组（n=69）的等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）平均变化分别为 - 0.50±0.06 屈光度和 0.32±0.02 毫米；而非对称多点离焦技术（AMDT）组（n=71）的上述两项指标平均变化分别为 - 0.16±0.06 屈光度和 0.17±0.02 毫米（均 P<0.001）。校正基线年龄、基线等效球镜度数（SER）、基线眼轴长度（AL）及眼科中心后，与单光镜片（SVLs）组相比，非对称多点离焦技术（AMDT）组研究对象的近视进展显著减缓：等效球镜度数（SER）减少 0.39 屈光度（减缓 74%），眼轴长度（AL）减少 0.17 毫米（减缓 51%）。年龄越小、眼轴增长越快的相关性在单光镜片（SVLs）组中更为显著（r=-0.68；P<0.001），而非对称多点离焦技术（AMDT）组的该相关性较弱（r=-0.37；P=0.002）。非对称多点离焦技术（AMDT）组中有 30 名研究对象（42%）在 1 年后未出现等效球镜度数（SER）进展。未观察到严重不良事件或持续性视觉不适。 结论：与单光镜片（SVLs）相比，非对称多点离焦技术（AMDT）镜片在 1 年内显著减少了等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）的进展，且具有良好的安全性和视觉表现。非对称多点离焦技术（AMDT）干预后，年龄与近视进展的相关性减弱，而单光镜片（SVLs）组未出现这一变化。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate the 12-month myopia control efficacy of an asymmetric multipoint defocus technique (AMDT) spectacle lens. DESIGN: Double-masked randomized controlled trial. PARTICIPANTS: One hundred forty participants completed all visits (mean age, 10.6 ± 1.5 years; 50% female), with spherical equivalent refraction (SER) between -5.00 and -0.75 diopters (D), astigmatism of 1.50 D or less, and anisometropia of 1.50 D or less. METHODS: One hundred forty-four children 8 to 13 years of age with myopia of -0.75 D to -5.00 D recruited from 2 ophthalmic centers were randomized (1:1) to wear AMDT spectacle lenses or single-vision lenses (SVLs). Cycloplegic SER and axial length (AL) were measured at the baseline, 6-month, and 12-month visits. Adaptation and visual performance questionnaires were administered during the intervention. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: The SER change after 1 year was the primary outcome, and the changes in AL, visual performance, and ocular parameters after 1 year were defined as secondary outcomes. RESULTS: After 12 months, the SVL group (n = 69) exhibited mean changes in SER and AL of -0.50 ± 0.06 D and 0.32 ± 0.02 mm, respectively, compared with -0.16 ± 0.06 D and 0.17 ± 0.02 mm (both P < 0.001) in the AMDT group (n = 71). Compared with the SVL group, participants in the AMDT group showed significantly less myopia progression by 0.39 D in SER (74%) and 0.17 mm in AL (51%) after adjustment for baseline age, baseline SER and AL, and ophthalmic center. The correlation between younger age and more rapid AL elongation was more pronounced in the SVL group (r = -0.68; P < 0.001) compared with the AMDT group (r = -0.37; P = 0.002). Thirty participants (42%) in the AMDT group displayed no SER progression after 1 year. No serious adverse events or persistent visual discomfort were observed. CONCLUSIONS: Compared with SVLs, AMDT spectacle lenses significantly reduced SER and AL progression over 1 year, with a favorable safety profile and visual performance. The correlation between age and myopia progression was diminished after AMDT participants intervention, but not for SVLs. FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE(S): The author(s) have no proprietary or commercial interest in any materials discussed in this article.

One-year efficacy of myopia control by the defocus distributed multipoint lens: a multicentric randomised controlled trial

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2024年👥 Chen Xiaoqin, Li Mengdi, Li Jun, Wu Min, Liu Xiaonan, Yu Cui, Guo Xingyi, Wang Yanbo, Wang Yansong, Lu Wenli, Li Lihua, Wang Yan
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-1 起始时间：2024年12月 研究中心&PI：天津市眼科医院、北京同仁医院、沈阳何氏眼科医院 & 王雁、李丽华 试验设计简述：前瞻性、多中心、随机对照研究 试验组样本量：DDM81人 SE：进展量-0.47D，控制量0.24D，控制率34% AL：进展量0.21mm，控制量-0.13mm,控制率38%
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星优学 / 1年临床试验 / 2-1
原文摘要
摘要 目的：报告一项多中心随机对照试验中，离焦分布式多点（DDM）镜片控制儿童近视进展的 1 年疗效结果。 方法：在 3 个研究中心共纳入 168 名 6~13 岁儿童，将其随机分配至 DDM 镜片组（n=84）或单光（SV）镜片组（n=84）。测量所有儿童的睫状肌麻痹自动验光结果（等效球镜度数，SER）和眼轴长度（AL）。采用线性混合模型分析比较两组儿童 SER 和 AL 的变化差异；采用逻辑回归分析比较两组儿童快速近视进展（每年 SER 增加≥0.75 D 或 AL 增长≥0.40 mm）的差异。 结果：1 年后，DDM 组儿童 SER 平均变化量（-0.47±0.37 D）显著低于 SV 组（-0.71±0.42 D）（p<0.001）；同样，DDM 组儿童 AL 平均变化量（0.21±0.17 mm）也显著低于 SV 组（0.34±0.16 mm）（p<0.001）。校正年龄、性别、每日佩戴时间和父母近视情况后，SV 组儿童的快速近视进展风险显著高于 DDM 组（比值比 OR=3.51，95% 置信区间 CI：1.77~6.99）。其中，每日镜片佩戴时间> 12 小时的儿童、男孩以及低龄儿童（6~9 岁）中，SV 组相对 DDM 组的快速近视进展风险更高，OR 值（95% CI）分别为 10.82（3.22~36.37）、5.34（1.93~14.78）和 8.73（2.60~29.33）。 结论：1 年随访结果显示，DDM 镜片可有效延缓儿童近视进展。延长 DDM 镜片的每日佩戴时间可提高其近视控制效果。该结论仍需未来长期研究进一步验证。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
AIMS: To report the 1-year results of the efficacy of a defocus distributed multipoint (DDM) lens in controlling myopia progression in a multicentre, randomised controlled trial. METHODS: Overall, 168 children aged 6-13 years were recruited and randomly assigned to wear a DDM lens (n=84) or single-vision (SV) lens (n=84) in three centres. Cycloplegic autorefraction (spherical equivalent refraction (SER)) and axial length (AL) were measured. Linear mixed model analysis was performed to compare between-group SER and AL changes. Logistic regression analysis was used to analyse the between-group difference in rapid myopia progression (SER increase≥0.75 D per year or AL growth≥0.40 mm per year). RESULTS: After 1 year, mean changes in SER were significantly lower in the DDM group (-0.47±0.37 D) than in the SV group (-0.71±0.42 D) (p<0.001). Similarly, mean changes in AL were significantly lower in the DDM group (0.21±0.17 mm) than in the SV group (0.34±0.16 mm) (p<0.001). After adjusting for age, sex, daily wearing time and parental myopia, rapid myopia progression risk was higher in the SV group than in the DDM group (OR=3.51, 95% CI: 1.77 to 6.99), especially for children who wore a lens for >12 hours per day, boys and younger children (6-9 years) with ORs (95% CIs) of 10.82 (3.22 to 36.37), 5.34 (1.93 to 14.78) and 8.73 (2.6 to 29.33), respectively. CONCLUSIONS: After 1 year, DDM lenses effectively retarded myopia progression in children. Longer daily wearing time of DDM lens improved the efficacy of myopia control. Future long-term studies are needed for validation. TRIAL REGISTRATION NUMBER: NCT05340699.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 星优学 / 5-2 联合红光 / 5-2-1
原文摘要
摘要 目的：评估重复低强度红光（RLRL）疗法联合光学镜片对儿童青少年近视患者的治疗效果。 方法：本回顾性研究纳入 108 例儿童青少年。根据所接受的联合干预方案不同，将研究对象分为 4 组：RLRL + 角膜塑形镜（OK 镜）干预组（RLRL+OK 组）、RLRL + 离焦分布多点（DDM）镜片干预组（RLRL+DDM 组）、RLRL + 单光眼镜（SVS）干预组（RLRL+SVS 组）及对照组。在干预前后分别测量研究对象的视力、等效球镜度数（SER）和眼轴长度（AL），并采用二元 logistic 回归分析筛选影响视力恢复的因素。 结果：基线时，各组的 SER 和 AL 存在统计学差异（P<0.01）。干预后，在各时间点，RLRL+OK 组、RLRL+DDM 组和 RLRL+SVS 组的 AL 增长情况均显著优于对照组（P<0.001）；RLRL+DDM 组和 RLRL+SVS 组的 SER 变化与对照组相比，在各时间点也均存在统计学差异（P<0.001）。干预方式被确定为影响视力恢复的重要因素。 结论：重复低强度红光（RLRL）疗法联合光学镜片对控制儿童青少年近视进展具有显著效果。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate the efficacy of repeated low-level red-light (RLRL) therapy combined with optical lenses in children and adolescents with myopia. METHODS: This retrospective study included 108 children and adolescents. Based on the difference in the combination intervention scheme participants were divided into four groups based on the intervention they received: the RLRL+orthokeratology (OK) lens intervention group (RLRL+OK group), the RLRL+defocus distributed multi-point (DDM) lens intervention group (RLRL+DDM group), the RLRL+single-vision spectacles (SVS) intervention group (RLRL+SVS group), and a control group. Visual acuity, spherical equivalent refraction (SER), and axial length (AL) were measured before and after the intervention. Binary logistic regression was used to identify factors influencing vision recovery. RESULTS: The SER and AL at baseline were statistically different (P<0.01). After the intervention, the AL increase in the RLRL+OK, RLRL+DDM, and RLRL+SVS groups was significantly better than the control group across time points (P<0.001). Changes in SER were also statistically significant in the RLRL+DDM and RLRL+SVS groups compared to the control group across time points (P<0.001). The intervention method was identified as a significant factor influencing vision recovery (P<0.001). CONCLUSION: RLRL therapy combined with optical lenses is effective in controlling myopia progression in children and adolescents.

Novel Lenslet-ARray-Integrated Spectacle Lenses for Myopia Control: A 1-Year Randomized, Double-Masked, Controlled Trial

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-1 起始时间：2022年6月 研究中心&PI：温州医科大学附属眼视光医院 & 姜珺&吕帆 试验设计简述：RCT 试验组样本量：PLARI组80人 ；NLARI组80人 SE：PLARI组进展量-0.30D，控制量0.36D，控制率55% ；NLARI组进展量-0.21D，控制量0.45D，控制率68% AL：PLARI组进展量0.19mm，控制量-0.15mm,控制率44% ；NLARI组进展量0.17mm，控制量-0.17mm,控制率50%
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 艾沐皓锐HORI / 1年临床试验 / 2-1
原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：评估新型微透镜阵列集成（LARI）眼镜镜片（含正屈光力微透镜的 PLARI 镜片与含负屈光力微透镜的 NLARI 镜片）在近视儿童中佩戴 1 年的近视控制效果。 研究设计：随机、双盲、对照临床试验。 研究对象：共 240 名 6-12 岁儿童，其球镜当量屈光度（SER）介于 - 4.00 至 - 1.00 屈光度（D）之间，散光≤1.50 D，屈光参差≤1.00 D。 研究方法：将研究对象按 1:1:1 的比例随机分配至 PLARI 组、NLARI 组和对照组（单光镜片 [SV] 组）。在基线时及佩戴镜片后每 6 个月，分别测量睫状肌麻痹自动验光值与眼轴长度。 主要结果指标：球镜当量屈光度（SER）变化、眼轴增长（AE）及组间差异。 研究结果：1 年后，PLARI 组和 NLARI 组的 SER 变化量与眼轴增长（AE）均显著小于 SV 组（SER 分别为 - 0.30±0.48 D、-0.21±0.35 D 和 - 0.66±0.40 D；AE 分别为 0.19±0.20 mm、0.17±0.14 mm 和 0.34±0.18 mm；所有 P 值均 <0.001）。PLARI 组与 NLARI 组在 SER 变化量和 AE 方面无显著差异（P 值分别为 0.54 和 1.00）。在 SV 组（相关系数 r 分别为 0.40 [P<0.001] 和 - 0.59 [P<0.001]）和 PLARI 组（相关系数 r 分别为 0.46 [P<0.001] 和 - 0.52 [P<0.001]）中，年龄越小，SER 进展越快、AE 越大；而在 NLARI 组中，年龄与 SER 变化量及 AE 无相关性（相关系数 r 分别为 - 0.002 [P=0.98] 和 - 0.08 [P=0.48]）。 研究结论：与 SV 组相比，PLARI 组和 NLARI 组在 SER 和 AE 指标上均表现出显著更慢的近视进展。在 SV 组和 PLARI 组中，年龄越小，近视进展（以 SER 和 AE 衡量）越快；而 NLARI 组中未观察到这一关联。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate the myopia control efficacy of novel Lenslet-ARray-Integrated (LARI) spectacle lenses with positive power lenslets (PLARI) and negative power lenslets (NLARI) worn for 1 year in myopic children. DESIGN: Randomized, double-masked, controlled clinical trial. PARTICIPANTS: A total of 240 children 6 to 12 years of age with spherical equivalent refraction (SER) between -4.00 and -1.00 diopters (D), astigmatism of ≤ 1.50 D, and anisometropia of ≤ 1.00 D. METHODS: Participants were assigned randomly in a 1:1:1 ratio to PLARI, NLARI, and control (single-vision [SV]) groups. Cycloplegic autorefraction and axial length were measured at baseline and 6-month intervals after lens wear. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Changes in SER, axial elongation (AE), and differences between groups. RESULTS: After 1 year, SER changes and AE in the PLARI and NLARI groups were significantly less than those in the SV group (SER: -0.30 ± 0.48 D, -0.21 ± 0.35 D, and -0.66 ± 0.40 D, respectively; AE: 0.19 ± 0.20 mm, 0.17 ± 0.14 mm, 0.34 ± 0.18 mm, respectively; all P < 0.001). No significant differences were found in SER changes and AE between PLARI and NLARI groups (P = 0.54 and P = 1.00, respectively). Younger age was associated with more rapid SER increase and larger AE in the SV group (r = 0.40 [P < 0.001] and r = -0.59 [P < 0.001], respectively) and PLARI group (r = 0.46 [P < 0.001] and r = -0.52 [P < 0.001], respectively), but not in the NLARI group (r = -0.002 [P = 0.98] and r = -0.08 [P = 0.48], respectively). CONCLUSIONS: Compared with the SV group, both PLARI and NARI groups showed significantly slower myopia progression in terms of SER and AE. Faster myopia progression, in terms of both SER and AE, was associated with younger age in the SV and PLARI groups but not the NLARI group. FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE(S): Proprietary or commercial disclosure may be found in the Footnotes and Disclosures at the end of this article.

Two‑year results of Lenslet‑ARray‑Integrated spectacle lenses for myopia control in children

📖 Eye📅 2025年👥 Su Binbin, Cho Pauline, Vincent Stephen J, Zheng Jingwei, Chen Jiaojie, Lin Huiling, Wang Feifu, Sheng Zihao, Wang Xueqian, Lu Fan, Jiang Jun

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 艾沐皓锐HORI / 2年临床试验 / 2-2
原文摘要
摘要 目的：探究含正屈光力（PLARI）和负屈光力（NLARI）微透镜的微透镜阵列集成（LARI）眼镜片的两年近视控制效果，以及更换镜片设计的影响。 方法：第一阶段被随机分配佩戴 PLARI、NLARI 或单光（SV）眼镜片的 218 名儿童，继续参与这项随机、双盲延伸试验，额外随访 1 年（第二阶段）。参与者被随机分配至 6 个组中的 1 组：SV 转 PLARI 组、SV 转 NLARI 组、PLARI 续用 PLARI 组（P-PLARI 组）、PLARI 转 NLARI 组（P-NLARI 组）、NLARI 转 PLARI 组（N-PLARI 组）、NLARI 续用 NLARI 组（N-NLARI 组）。第二年，基于已发表数据外推得出 SV 组的等效球镜度数（SER）变化和眼轴增长（AE）[即外推单光（ESV）组]。采用线性模型分析 2 年期间及仅第二阶段各组间 SER 变化和 AE 的差异。 结果：两年后，P-PLARI 组、P-NLARI 组、N-PLARI 组和 N-NLARI 组的 SER 变化（分别为−0.87±0.68 屈光度、−0.64±0.86 屈光度、−0.68±0.54 屈光度、−0.75±0.62 屈光度）和 AE（分别为 0.44±0.33 毫米、0.33±0.32 毫米、0.36±0.23 毫米、0.39±0.25 毫米）均显著小于 ESV 组（SER：−1.24±0.77 屈光度，均 P<0.05；AE：0.63±0.33 毫米，均 P<0.001）。第二阶段，四个 LARI 组与 ESV 组间的 SER 变化无显著差异（P=0.58）。第二阶段，P-NLARI 组和 N-PLARI 组的 AE 显著小于 ESV 组（分别 P<0.001、P=0.001），P-PLARI 组和 N-NLARI 组的 AE 略小于 ESV 组（分别 P=0.054、P=0.10），但四个 LARI 组间的 AE 无显著差异（均 P>0.05）。 结论：佩戴 LARI 眼镜片 2 年可有效减缓近视进展和眼轴增长。佩戴 1 年后更换为另一种 LARI 设计，在第二年可改善近视控制效果（以眼轴增长为评价指标），但对等效球镜度数进展无改善作用。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate the 2-year myopia control efficacy of Lenslet-ARray-Integrated (LARI) lenses with positive (PLARI) and negative (NLARI) power lenslets and the effect of switching lens designs. METHODS: A total of 218 children, who were randomly assigned to wear PLARI, NLARI, or single-vision (SV) lenses in Phase 1 continued in this randomized, double-masked extended trial for an additional year (Phase 2). Participants were randomly assigned to one of six groups: SV to PLARI, SV to NLARI, PLARI to PLARI (P-PLARI), PLARI to NLARI (P-NLARI), NLARI to PLARI (N-PLARI), and NLARI to NLARI (N-NLARI). In year 2, the change in spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial elongation (AE) from the SV group were extrapolated based on published data [the extrapolated single vision (ESV) group]. Linear models were used to determine differences in SER changes and AE among groups in 2 years and in Phase 2 only. RESULTS: After 2 years, the SER changes (- 0.87 ± 0.68 D, - 0.64 ± 0.86 D, - 0.68 ± 0.54 D, and - 0.75 ± 0.62 D, respectively) and AE (0.44 ± 0.33 mm, 0.33 ± 0.32 mm, 0.36 ± 0.23 mm, and 0.39 ± 0.25 mm, respectively) of P-PLARI, P-NLARI, N-PLARI, and N-NLARI were significantly smaller than those in the ESV group (SER: - 1.24 ± 0.77 D, all P < 0.05; AE: 0.63 ± 0.33 mm, all P < 0.001). In Phase 2, there was no significant difference in SER changes among the four LARI groups and ESV group (P = 0.58). In Phase 2, AE of the P-NLARI and N-PLARI groups was significantly smaller than the ESV group (P < 0.001 and P = 0.001), and AE of the P-PLARI and N-NLARI groups were slightly smaller than that of ESV group (P = 0.054 and P = 0.10), but there were no significant differences in AE among the four LARI groups (all P > 0.05). CONCLUSIONS: Wearing LARI lenses for 2 years effectively slowed myopia progression and AE. Switching to another LARI design after 1 year improved myopia control efficacy, in terms of AE, during the second year, but not SER progression. TRIAL REGISTRATION: Chinese Clinical Trial Registry, ChiCTR2200057210. Registered 03 March 2022, https://www.chictr.org.cn/bin/project/edit?pid=152900 .

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 艾沐皓锐HORI / 4-1 近视预防 / 4-1-1
原文摘要
摘要 引言：既往研究表明，儿童近视前期（premyopia）的患病率较高，且进展为近视的风险较大。因此，本研究旨在探讨 0.01% 阿托品滴眼液与新型正度数微透镜阵列集成眼镜镜片（Lenslet-ARray-Integrated spectacle lenses，简称 LARI）在中国近视前期儿童中延缓近视发生及近视进展的有效性与安全性。 方法：本研究为一项前瞻性随机对照试验。共纳入 400 名 6~12 岁双眼均为近视前期的儿童，将其按 1:1:1:1 的比例随机分为 4 组：0.01% 阿托品滴眼液组（A 组）、LARI 镜片组（S 组）、联合治疗组（AS 组，即阿托品 + LARI 联合干预）及无临床干预的对照组（E 组）。分别在基线期、3 个月、6 个月和 12 个月随访时进行指标测量。主要结局指标为 1 年内的近视发生率及快速近视进展（近视度数进展≥0.50D）患儿比例。次要结局指标为睫状肌麻痹验光球镜度数（cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction，简称 SE）和眼轴长度（axial length，简称 AL）的变化；探索性结局指标为裸眼视力（uncorrected visual acuity，简称 UCVA）、角膜曲率（corneal curvature，简称 CC）、黄斑中心凹下脉络膜厚度（subfoveal choroidal thickness，简称 SFCT）及眼压（intraocular pressure，简称 IOP）的变化。同时记录不良事件发生情况。 结果：A 组、S 组和 AS 组的近视发生率及快速近视进展患儿比例均显著低于 E 组。0.01% 阿托品、LARI 镜片及其联合治疗分别使近视进展减缓 55.88%、64.71% 和 77.94%，使眼轴增长减缓 65.00%、75.00% 和 77.50%。基于年龄分层进行进一步分析显示，各干预组患儿的 SFCT 均显著增加，且本研究未发现严重不良事件。 结论：1 年研究结果表明，结合 SE 进展、AL 缩短及 SFCT 增加等指标可知，0.01% 阿托品滴眼液与 LARI 镜片可作为预防近视前期儿童近视进展的有效且安全的干预方式。在本研究队列中，联合治疗的疗效更优，但 12 个月以上的长期疗效仍有待进一步研究。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
INTRODUCTION: Previous studies have suggested that premyopia shows high prevalence and high risk of progression to myopia among children. Therefore, the purpose of this study was to investigate the efficacy and safety of 0.01% atropine eye drops and novel positive Lenslet-ARray-Integrated spectacle lenses (LARI) in slowing myopia onset and myopic shift among children with premyopia in China. METHODS: This was a prospective randomized controlled trial. A total of 400 children aged 6-12 years with premyopia in both eyes were enrolled. Subjects were randomly divided into four groups in equal proportions: 0.01% atropine eye drops group (group A), LARI group (group S), combination group (group AS), and control group without any clinical intervention (group E). Measurements were conducted at baseline and at 3-, 6-, and 12-month follow-up. The incidence of myopia and the percentage of patients with fast myopic shift over 1 year were the primary outcomes. The secondary outcomes were changes in cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SE) and axial length (AL). Changes in uncorrected visual acuity (UCVA), corneal curvature (CC), subfoveal choroidal thickness (SFCT), and intraocular pressure (IOP) were the exploratory outcomes. Adverse events were also recorded. RESULTS: The incidence of myopia and the percentage of patients with fast myopic shift in groups A, S, and AS were significantly lower than those in group E. Treatment with 0.01% atropine, LARI, and their combination decreased myopia progression by 55.88%, 64.71%, and 77.94%, and axial elongation by 65.00%, 75.00%, and 77.50%, respectively. Further analyses were conducted based on age stratification. SFCT in intervention groups increased significantly. No serious adverse events were detected. CONCLUSIONS: These 1-year results suggest that, combined with the progression of SE, the reduction in AL, and the increase in SFCT, 0.01% atropine and LARI can be used as effective and safe treatments for the prevention of myopia progression in children with premyopia. Combination therapy showed superior efficacy in this cohort, but long-term effects beyond 12 months remain unknown. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ChiCTR2500098887.

原文摘要
摘要 引言：既往研究表明，儿童近视前期（premyopia）的患病率较高，且进展为近视的风险较大。因此，本研究旨在探讨 0.01% 阿托品滴眼液与新型正度数微透镜阵列集成眼镜镜片（Lenslet-ARray-Integrated spectacle lenses，简称 LARI）在中国近视前期儿童中延缓近视发生及近视进展的有效性与安全性。 方法：本研究为一项前瞻性随机对照试验。共纳入 400 名 6~12 岁双眼均为近视前期的儿童，将其按 1:1:1:1 的比例随机分为 4 组：0.01% 阿托品滴眼液组（A 组）、LARI 镜片组（S 组）、联合治疗组（AS 组，即阿托品 + LARI 联合干预）及无临床干预的对照组（E 组）。分别在基线期、3 个月、6 个月和 12 个月随访时进行指标测量。主要结局指标为 1 年内的近视发生率及快速近视进展（近视度数进展≥0.50D）患儿比例。次要结局指标为睫状肌麻痹验光球镜度数（cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction，简称 SE）和眼轴长度（axial length，简称 AL）的变化；探索性结局指标为裸眼视力（uncorrected visual acuity，简称 UCVA）、角膜曲率（corneal curvature，简称 CC）、黄斑中心凹下脉络膜厚度（subfoveal choroidal thickness，简称 SFCT）及眼压（intraocular pressure，简称 IOP）的变化。同时记录不良事件发生情况。 结果：A 组、S 组和 AS 组的近视发生率及快速近视进展患儿比例均显著低于 E 组。0.01% 阿托品、LARI 镜片及其联合治疗分别使近视进展减缓 55.88%、64.71% 和 77.94%，使眼轴增长减缓 65.00%、75.00% 和 77.50%。基于年龄分层进行进一步分析显示，各干预组患儿的 SFCT 均显著增加，且本研究未发现严重不良事件。 结论：1 年研究结果表明，结合 SE 进展、AL 缩短及 SFCT 增加等指标可知，0.01% 阿托品滴眼液与 LARI 镜片可作为预防近视前期儿童近视进展的有效且安全的干预方式。在本研究队列中，联合治疗的疗效更优，但 12 个月以上的长期疗效仍有待进一步研究。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
INTRODUCTION: Previous studies have suggested that premyopia shows high prevalence and high risk of progression to myopia among children. Therefore, the purpose of this study was to investigate the efficacy and safety of 0.01% atropine eye drops and novel positive Lenslet-ARray-Integrated spectacle lenses (LARI) in slowing myopia onset and myopic shift among children with premyopia in China. METHODS: This was a prospective randomized controlled trial. A total of 400 children aged 6-12 years with premyopia in both eyes were enrolled. Subjects were randomly divided into four groups in equal proportions: 0.01% atropine eye drops group (group A), LARI group (group S), combination group (group AS), and control group without any clinical intervention (group E). Measurements were conducted at baseline and at 3-, 6-, and 12-month follow-up. The incidence of myopia and the percentage of patients with fast myopic shift over 1 year were the primary outcomes. The secondary outcomes were changes in cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SE) and axial length (AL). Changes in uncorrected visual acuity (UCVA), corneal curvature (CC), subfoveal choroidal thickness (SFCT), and intraocular pressure (IOP) were the exploratory outcomes. Adverse events were also recorded. RESULTS: The incidence of myopia and the percentage of patients with fast myopic shift in groups A, S, and AS were significantly lower than those in group E. Treatment with 0.01% atropine, LARI, and their combination decreased myopia progression by 55.88%, 64.71%, and 77.94%, and axial elongation by 65.00%, 75.00%, and 77.50%, respectively. Further analyses were conducted based on age stratification. SFCT in intervention groups increased significantly. No serious adverse events were detected. CONCLUSIONS: These 1-year results suggest that, combined with the progression of SE, the reduction in AL, and the increase in SFCT, 0.01% atropine and LARI can be used as effective and safe treatments for the prevention of myopia progression in children with premyopia. Combination therapy showed superior efficacy in this cohort, but long-term effects beyond 12 months remain unknown. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ChiCTR2500098887.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 艾沐皓锐HORI / 6-5 机制探索 / 6-5-1
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：探讨基于微结构图案的近视控制眼镜镜片光学设计，阐明利用视网膜图像模糊控制近视的光学原理。 方法：提出由具有两种相反符号光焦度的阵列式六边形微透镜构建微透镜阵列集成（LARI）眼镜镜片，并基于高阶相位元件（HOPE）设计新型阵列微结构，通过仿真与实验研究LARI和HOPE镜片的光学性能。 结果：研究发现微透镜阵列的微结构诱导的相位调制导致均方根（RMS）波前像差增加，从而引起图像模糊，进而启发了带有高阶相位元件（HOPE）的新型阵列微结构设计。 结论：阐明了通过微透镜阵列相位调制增加波前像差以引入图像模糊的光学原理，并通过实验和仿真评估了LARI与HOPE镜片的光学性能，为利用图像模糊控制近视提供了光学实现方案与设计支持。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Abstract: Using micro-structure components in spectacle lenses has enabled myopia progression control in children and teenagers. However, the optical design of these spectacle lenses has never been discussed, leading to a lack of correct understanding of the underlying optical treatment principles. In this work, array-patterned hexagonal lenslets with two powers of opposite signs were proposed to construct a lenslet array-integrated (LARI) spectacle lens developed for an ongoing, randomized, controlled clinical trial and to support the optical approach to myopia control leveraging retinal image blur. We found that the phase modulation induced by the micro-structures of the lenslet array contributes to the increase in RMS wavefront aberrations, leading to image blur, further inspiring the novel array-patterned micro-structure design with high-order phase elements (HOPEs). The optical performance of both LARI and HOPE spectacle lenses was investigated by simulation and experiment.

本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：探讨微透镜阵列集成（LARI）眼镜镜片对近视儿童屈光散光和角膜散光的影响。 方法：对一项随机双盲试验的数据进行二次分析，调取了209名参与此前两阶段LARI研究的6至12岁儿童数据。第一阶段配戴LARI或单光（SV）镜片12个月；第二阶段均配戴LARI镜片12个月。连续配戴LARI镜片2年的受试者归为LARI组，第二年由SV转为LARI镜片的归为SV-LARI组。每6个月记录一次睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度、屈光散光、眼轴长度和角膜散光，并计算屈光和角膜散光的矢量成分（J0和J45）。 结果：在第一阶段，LARI组和SV组在屈光散光增加、屈光J0和J45、角膜散光以及角膜J0和J45方面均无显著差异（所有P > 0.05）。对于连续2年配戴LARI镜片的受试者，第一阶段与第二阶段之间的屈光散光和屈光J0变化无显著差异（P = 0.23与P = 0.41），但第二阶段J45变化增加了-0.03 D（P = 0.003），且第二年观察到较小的角膜散光增加（0.07±0.36 D vs. 0.20±0.34 D，P = 0.02）。在SV-LARI组中，第二阶段观察到较大的屈光散光变化（-0.12±0.45 D，P = 0.03），但第一阶段与第二阶段之间的屈光J0和J45、角膜散光以及角膜J0和J45变化均无显著差异（所有P > 0.05）。 结论：配戴LARI镜片2年似乎未导致屈光散光和角膜散光出现任何具有临床意义的额外进展。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To investigate the effects of Lenslet-ARray-Integrated (LARI) spectacle lenses on refractive and corneal astigmatism in myopic children. Design: A secondary analysis of data from a randomized, double-masked trial. Participants: Pertinent data were retrieved from the files of 209 participants from the previous 2-phase LARI study, which reported the efficacy of LARI lenses on myopia control in children aged 6 to 12 years. Methods: Data from participants of the LARI study (phase I: wearing LARI lenses or single-vision (SV) lenses for 12 months; phase II: all wore LARI lenses for another 12 months) were retrieved and analyzed. Participants who wore LARI lenses for 2 years were categorized as the LARI group, whereas those who switched from SV to LARI lenses were categorized as the SV lens switched over to LARI lens in the second year (SV-LARI) group. Data retrieved included cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction and refractive astigmatism, axial length, and corneal astigmatism at 6-month intervals, and the vector components (J0 and J45) of refractive and corneal astigmatism were calculated for analysis. Main Outcome Measures: Changes in refractive and corneal astigmatism, J0, and J45. Results: No significant differences were found in increased refractive astigmatism, refractive J0 and J45, corneal astigmatism, and corneal J0 and J45 (all P > 0.05) between the LARI and SV groups in phase I. For participants who wore LARI lenses for 2 consecutive years, there were no significant differences in changes in refractive astigmatism and refractive J0 between phases I and II (P = 0.23 and P = 0.41), but change in J45 in phase II increased by —0.03 D (P = 0.003), and a smaller increase in corneal astigmatism was observed in the second year (0.07 ± 0.36 D vs. 0.20 ± 0.34 D, P = 0.02). In the SV-LARI group, a higher change in refractive astigmatism was observed in phase II (—0.12 ± 0.45 D, P = 0.03), but there were no significant differences in changes in refractive J0 and J45, corneal astigmatism, and corneal J0 and J45 between phases I and II (all P > 0.05). Conclusions: Wearing LARI lenses for 2 years did not seem to lead to any clinically significant additional progression in refractive and corneal astigmatism.

Novel Lenslet-ARray-Integrated Spectacle Lenses for Myopia Control: A 1-Year Randomized, Double-Masked, Controlled Trial

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2024年👥 Su Binbin, Cho Pauline, Vincent Stephen J, Zheng Jingwei, Chen Jiaojie, Ye Cong, Wang Tengfei, Zhang Jingwei, Zhang Kou, Lu Fan, Jiang Jun

参考文献2-1 起始时间：2022年6月 研究中心&PI：温州医科大学附属眼视光医院 & 姜珺&吕帆 试验设计简述：RCT 试验组样本量：PLARI组80人 ；NLARI组80人 SE：PLARI组进展量-0.30D，控制量0.36D，控制率55% ；NLARI组进展量-0.21D，控制量0.45D，控制率68% AL：PLARI组进展量0.19mm，控制量-0.15mm,控制率44% ；NLARI组进展量0.17mm，控制量-0.17mm,控制率50%

原文摘要
摘要 研究目的：评估新型微透镜阵列集成（LARI）眼镜镜片（含正屈光力微透镜的 PLARI 镜片与含负屈光力微透镜的 NLARI 镜片）在近视儿童中佩戴 1 年的近视控制效果。 研究设计：随机、双盲、对照临床试验。 研究对象：共 240 名 6-12 岁儿童，其球镜当量屈光度（SER）介于 - 4.00 至 - 1.00 屈光度（D）之间，散光≤1.50 D，屈光参差≤1.00 D。 研究方法：将研究对象按 1:1:1 的比例随机分配至 PLARI 组、NLARI 组和对照组（单光镜片 [SV] 组）。在基线时及佩戴镜片后每 6 个月，分别测量睫状肌麻痹自动验光值与眼轴长度。 主要结果指标：球镜当量屈光度（SER）变化、眼轴增长（AE）及组间差异。 研究结果：1 年后，PLARI 组和 NLARI 组的 SER 变化量与眼轴增长（AE）均显著小于 SV 组（SER 分别为 - 0.30±0.48 D、-0.21±0.35 D 和 - 0.66±0.40 D；AE 分别为 0.19±0.20 mm、0.17±0.14 mm 和 0.34±0.18 mm；所有 P 值均 <0.001）。PLARI 组与 NLARI 组在 SER 变化量和 AE 方面无显著差异（P 值分别为 0.54 和 1.00）。在 SV 组（相关系数 r 分别为 0.40 [P<0.001] 和 - 0.59 [P<0.001]）和 PLARI 组（相关系数 r 分别为 0.46 [P<0.001] 和 - 0.52 [P<0.001]）中，年龄越小，SER 进展越快、AE 越大；而在 NLARI 组中，年龄与 SER 变化量及 AE 无相关性（相关系数 r 分别为 - 0.002 [P=0.98] 和 - 0.08 [P=0.48]）。 研究结论：与 SV 组相比，PLARI 组和 NLARI 组在 SER 和 AE 指标上均表现出显著更慢的近视进展。在 SV 组和 PLARI 组中，年龄越小，近视进展（以 SER 和 AE 衡量）越快；而 NLARI 组中未观察到这一关联。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To investigate the myopia control efficacy of novel Lenslet-ARray-Integrated (LARI) spectacle lenses with positive power lenslets (PLARI) and negative power lenslets (NLARI) worn for 1 year in myopic children. DESIGN: Randomized, double-masked, controlled clinical trial. PARTICIPANTS: A total of 240 children 6 to 12 years of age with spherical equivalent refraction (SER) between -4.00 and -1.00 diopters (D), astigmatism of ≤ 1.50 D, and anisometropia of ≤ 1.00 D. METHODS: Participants were assigned randomly in a 1:1:1 ratio to PLARI, NLARI, and control (single-vision [SV]) groups. Cycloplegic autorefraction and axial length were measured at baseline and 6-month intervals after lens wear. MAIN OUTCOME MEASURES: Changes in SER, axial elongation (AE), and differences between groups. RESULTS: After 1 year, SER changes and AE in the PLARI and NLARI groups were significantly less than those in the SV group (SER: -0.30 ± 0.48 D, -0.21 ± 0.35 D, and -0.66 ± 0.40 D, respectively; AE: 0.19 ± 0.20 mm, 0.17 ± 0.14 mm, 0.34 ± 0.18 mm, respectively; all P < 0.001). No significant differences were found in SER changes and AE between PLARI and NLARI groups (P = 0.54 and P = 1.00, respectively). Younger age was associated with more rapid SER increase and larger AE in the SV group (r = 0.40 [P < 0.001] and r = -0.59 [P < 0.001], respectively) and PLARI group (r = 0.46 [P < 0.001] and r = -0.52 [P < 0.001], respectively), but not in the NLARI group (r = -0.002 [P = 0.98] and r = -0.08 [P = 0.48], respectively). CONCLUSIONS: Compared with the SV group, both PLARI and NARI groups showed significantly slower myopia progression in terms of SER and AE. Faster myopia progression, in terms of both SER and AE, was associated with younger age in the SV and PLARI groups but not the NLARI group. FINANCIAL DISCLOSURE(S): Proprietary or commercial disclosure may be found in the Footnotes and Disclosures at the end of this article.

Efficacy and Safety of 0.01% Atropine Eye Drops and Novel Lenslet‑ARray‑Integrated Spectacle Lenses for the Prevention of Myopia Progression Among Children with Premyopia: A Randomized Clinical Trial

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2025年👥 Gao Mingjun, Hou Yanhua, Lu Yutong, Shi Zhanhua, Zhao Qi
内容摘要（Excel 原始记录）
摘要 引言：既往研究表明，儿童近视前期（premyopia）的患病率较高，且进展为近视的风险较大。因此，本研究旨在探讨 0.01% 阿托品滴眼液与新型正度数微透镜阵列集成眼镜镜片（Lenslet-ARray-Integrated spectacle lenses，简称 LARI）在中国近视前期儿童中延缓近视发生及近视进展的有效性与安全性。 方法：本研究为一项前瞻性随机对照试验。共纳入 400 名 6~12 岁双眼均为近视前期的儿童，将其按 1:1:1:1 的比例随机分为 4 组：0.01% 阿托品滴眼液组（A 组）、LARI 镜片组（S 组）、联合治疗组（AS 组，即阿托品 + LARI 联合干预）及无临床干预的对照组（E 组）。分别在基线期、3 个月、6 个月和 12 个月随访时进行指标测量。主要结局指标为 1 年内的近视发生率及快速近视进展（近视度数进展≥0.50D）患儿比例。次要结局指标为睫状肌麻痹验光球镜度数（cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction，简称 SE）和眼轴长度（axial length，简称 AL）的变化；探索性结局指标为裸眼视力（uncorrected visual acuity，简称 UCVA）、角膜曲率（corneal curvature，简称 CC）、黄斑中心凹下脉络膜厚度（subfoveal choroidal thickness，简称 SFCT）及眼压（intraocular pressure，简称 IOP）的变化。同时记录不良事件发生情况。 结果：A 组、S 组和 AS 组的近视发生率及快速近视进展患儿比例均显著低于 E 组。0.01% 阿托品、LARI 镜片及其联合治疗分别使近视进展减缓 55.88%、64.71% 和 77.94%，使眼轴增长减缓 65.00%、75.00% 和 77.50%。基于年龄分层进行进一步分析显示，各干预组患儿的 SFCT 均显著增加，且本研究未发现严重不良事件。 结论：1 年研究结果表明，结合 SE 进展、AL 缩短及 SFCT 增加等指标可知，0.01% 阿托品滴眼液与 LARI 镜片可作为预防近视前期儿童近视进展的有效且安全的干预方式。在本研究队列中，联合治疗的疗效更优，但 12 个月以上的长期疗效仍有待进一步研究。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
INTRODUCTION: Previous studies have suggested that premyopia shows high prevalence and high risk of progression to myopia among children. Therefore, the purpose of this study was to investigate the efficacy and safety of 0.01% atropine eye drops and novel positive Lenslet-ARray-Integrated spectacle lenses (LARI) in slowing myopia onset and myopic shift among children with premyopia in China. METHODS: This was a prospective randomized controlled trial. A total of 400 children aged 6-12 years with premyopia in both eyes were enrolled. Subjects were randomly divided into four groups in equal proportions: 0.01% atropine eye drops group (group A), LARI group (group S), combination group (group AS), and control group without any clinical intervention (group E). Measurements were conducted at baseline and at 3-, 6-, and 12-month follow-up. The incidence of myopia and the percentage of patients with fast myopic shift over 1 year were the primary outcomes. The secondary outcomes were changes in cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SE) and axial length (AL). Changes in uncorrected visual acuity (UCVA), corneal curvature (CC), subfoveal choroidal thickness (SFCT), and intraocular pressure (IOP) were the exploratory outcomes. Adverse events were also recorded. RESULTS: The incidence of myopia and the percentage of patients with fast myopic shift in groups A, S, and AS were significantly lower than those in group E. Treatment with 0.01% atropine, LARI, and their combination decreased myopia progression by 55.88%, 64.71%, and 77.94%, and axial elongation by 65.00%, 75.00%, and 77.50%, respectively. Further analyses were conducted based on age stratification. SFCT in intervention groups increased significantly. No serious adverse events were detected. CONCLUSIONS: These 1-year results suggest that, combined with the progression of SE, the reduction in AL, and the increase in SFCT, 0.01% atropine and LARI can be used as effective and safe treatments for the prevention of myopia progression in children with premyopia. Combination therapy showed superior efficacy in this cohort, but long-term effects beyond 12 months remain unknown. TRIAL REGISTRATION: ChiCTR2500098887.

Array-Patterned Micro-Structures in Spectacle Lenses Designed for Myopia Control via Image Blur

📅 2025年
内容摘要（根据本地文件整理）
摘要 目的：探讨用于视网膜图像模糊近视控制的微结构镜片光学设计原理，并提出新型微结构镜片设计。 方法：提出采用两种异号光度的阵列排布六边形微透镜构建集成微透镜阵列（LARI）眼镜镜片，并通过仿真与实验研究 LARI 镜片以及受其启发提出的采用高阶相位元件（HOPEs）的新型微结构镜片的光学性能。 结果：微透镜阵列微结构引起的相位调制导致 RMS 波前像差增加，从而诱发图像模糊。 结论：LARI 与 HOPE 镜片的微结构光学设计可通过相位调制增加波前像差产生图像模糊，为利用视网膜图像模糊控制近视的光学方法提供了理论与实验依据。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Using micro-structure components in spectacle lenses has enabled myopia progression control in children and teenagers. However, the optical design of these spectacle lenses has never been discussed, leading to a lack of correct understanding of the underlying optical treatment principles. In this work, array-patterned hexagonal lenslets with two powers of opposite signs were proposed to construct a lenslet array-integrated (LARI) spectacle lens developed for an ongoing, randomized, controlled clinical trial and to support the optical approach to myopia control leveraging retinal image blur. We found that the phase modulation induced by the micro-structures of the lenslet array contributes to the increase in RMS wavefront aberrations, leading to image blur, further inspiring the novel array-patterned micro-structure design with high-order phase elements (HOPEs). The optical performance of both LARI and HOPE spectacle lenses was investigated by simulation and experiment.

来源=桌面《框架眼镜SP》/10 全适·乐蕊LARI-NLARI/6-5-1 PLARI&NLARI通过图像模糊实现近视控制-Array-Patterned Micro-Structures in Spectacle Lenses Designed for Myopia Control via Image Blur.pdf 来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：摘要 在眼镜镜片中采用微结构组件，已实现对儿童和青少年近视进展的控制。然而，这类眼镜镜片的光学设计尚未得到探讨，导致人们对其潜在的光学治疗原理缺乏正确认识。本研究提出采用两种符号相反屈光力的阵列图案六边形微透镜，构建一种微透镜阵列集成（LARI）眼镜镜片。该镜片用于一项正在进行的随机对照临床试验，同时为借助视网膜图像模糊实现近视控制的光学方法提供支持。研究发现，微透镜阵列的微结构所引发的相位调制会导致均方根（RMS）波前像差增大，进而产生图像模糊；这一发现进一步启发了采用高阶相位元件（HOPEs）的新型阵列图案微结构设计。研究通过仿真与实验，对 LARI 镜片和 HOPE 镜片的光学性能均进行了探究。

two-year changes in astigmatism in myopic children wearing LARI spectacle lenses

LARI配戴2年未导致具有临床意义的额外散光进展

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献6-8-1 LARI配戴2年未导致具有临床意义的额外散光进展 起始时间：2022年7月-2024年8月 研究中心&PI：温州医科大学附属眼视光医院 & 姜珺/吕帆 试验设计简述：既往LARI随机、双盲临床试验的二次分析；第一阶段LARI或SV配戴12个月，第二阶段所有儿童均配戴LARI再随访12个月；分析屈光散光、角膜散光及J0/J45变化。 试验组样本量：共209人；连续LARI组142人，SV-LARI转换组67人。 核心结论：LARI组与SV-LARI组2年内屈光和角膜散光均有一定增加，但组间差异小；散光变化主要与基线屈光散光、基线角膜散光及角膜散光变化相关，LARI未显示较SV额外增加具有临床意义的散光进展。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 全适·乐蕊LARI 上海Gino Optical Spectacle Co Ltd / 6-8其他（包括散光相关） / 6-8-1
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：探讨集成微透镜阵列（LARI）眼镜镜片对近视儿童屈光散光和角膜散光的影响。 方法：对一项随机双盲试验的数据进行二次分析，调取既往两阶段 LARI 研究中 209 名 6-12 岁受试者的资料。第一阶段配戴 LARI 镜片或单光（SV）镜片 12 个月；第二阶段均配戴 LARI 镜片 12 个月。连续配戴 LARI 镜片 2 年者归为 LARI 组，由 SV 转为 LARI 者归为 SV-LARI 组。每 6 个月评估睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度、屈光散光、眼轴长度、角膜散光及散光矢量分量（J0 和 J45）的变化。 结果：第一阶段中，LARI 组与 SV 组在屈光散光增加量、屈光 J0 和 J45、角膜散光以及角膜 J0 和 J45 上的差异均无统计学意义（均 P > 0.05）。连续配戴 2 年 LARI 镜片的受试者，第一阶段与第二阶段之间的屈光散光变化量和屈光 J0 差异无统计学意义（P = 0.23 和 P = 0.41），但第二阶段 J45 变化量增加 -0.03 D（P = 0.003），且第二年角膜散光增加量较小（0.07 ± 0.36 D 对比 0.20 ± 0.34 D，P = 0.02）。在 SV-LARI 组中，第二阶段观察到屈光散光变化量较高（-0.12 ± 0.45 D，P = 0.03），但在屈光 J0 和 J45、角膜散光以及角膜 J0 和 J45 的第一与第二阶段变化量差异无统计学意义（均 P > 0.05）。 结论：配戴 LARI 镜片 2 年似乎不会导致屈光散光和角膜散光发生任何具有临床意义的额外进展。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To investigate the effects of Lenslet-ARray-Integrated (LARI) spectacle lenses on refractive and corneal astigmatism in myopic children. Design: A secondary analysis of data from a randomized, double-masked trial. Participants: Pertinent data were retrieved from the files of 209 participants from the previous 2-phase LARI study, which reported the efficacy of LARI lenses on myopia control in children aged 6 to 12 years. Methods: Data from participants of the LARI study (phase I: wearing LARI lenses or single-vision (SV) lenses for 12 months; phase II: all wore LARI lenses for another 12 months) were retrieved and analyzed. Participants who wore LARI lenses for 2 years were categorized as the LARI group, whereas those who switched from SV to LARI lenses were categorized as the SV lens switched over to LARI lens in the second year (SV-LARI) group. Data retrieved included cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction and refractive astigmatism, axial length, and corneal astigmatism at 6-month intervals, and the vector components (J0 and J45) of refractive and corneal astigmatism were calculated for analysis. Main Outcome Measures: Changes in refractive and corneal astigmatism, J0, and J45. Results: No significant differences were found in increased refractive astigmatism, refractive J0 and J45, corneal astigmatism, and corneal J0 and J45 (all P > 0.05) between the LARI and SV groups in phase I. For participants who wore LARI lenses for 2 consecutive years, there were no significant differences in changes in refractive astigmatism and refractive J0 between phases I and II (P = 0.23 and P = 0.41), but change in J45 in phase II increased by —0.03 D (P = 0.003), and a smaller increase in corneal astigmatism was observed in the second year (0.07 ± 0.36 D vs. 0.20 ± 0.34 D, P = 0.02). In the SV-LARI group, a higher change in refractive astigmatism was observed in phase II (—0.12 ± 0.45 D, P = 0.03), but there were no significant differences in changes in refractive J0 and J45, corneal astigmatism, and corneal J0 and J45 between phases I and II (all P > 0.05). Conclusions: Wearing LARI lenses for 2 years did not seem to lead to any clinically significant additional progression in refractive and corneal astigmatism.

参考文献2-1 起始时间：2022年3月 研究中心&PI：四川大学华西医院眼科 & 刘陇黔 试验设计简述：双盲RCT 试验组样本量：IORC-H组 47人（+4.50 D）；IORC-M组45人（+3.50 D） ；IORC-L:组46人（+2.50 D） SE：L组进展量-0.52D，控制量0.08D，控制率13% ；M进展量-0.36D，控制量0.24D，控制率40% ；H进展量-0.18D，控制量0.42D，控制率70% AL：L进展量0.29mm，控制量0.07mm ； 控制率19% ；M进展量0.23mm，控制量0.13mm,控制率36% ；H进展量0.12mm，控制量0.24mm,控制率67%
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 思问Seewant / 1年临床试验 / 2-1
原文摘要
摘要 目的：本研究旨在探讨 1 年内不同实际周边近视离焦（MD）量的个性化屈光定制（IORC）眼镜片对近视控制的影响。该类镜片通过镜片背面的自由曲面补偿原始周边屈光状态。 方法：本项为期 1 年的双盲随机临床试验纳入 184 名 8-12 岁近视学龄儿童。受试者被随机分配至佩戴高 MD（IORC-H 组，+4.50 D）、中 MD（IORC-M 组，+3.50 D）、低 MD（IORC-L 组，+2.50 D）的 IORC 镜片组或单光（SV）镜片组。在基线时及每 6 个月测量一次球镜等效屈光不正（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）。 结果：1 年后，IORC-H 组、IORC-M 组、IORC-L 组和 SV 组的球镜等效屈光不正（SER）平均变化量（标准差）分别为 - 0.18（0.37）D、-0.36（0.37）D、-0.52（0.39）D 和 - 0.60（0.42）D。与 SV 组相比，IORC-H 组（差值 0.47 D，p<0.001）、IORC-M 组（差值 0.32 D，p=0.001）和 IORC-L 组（差值 0.15 D，p>0.05）延缓近视进展的效果分别为 70%、40% 和 13%。IORC-H 组、IORC-M 组、IORC-L 组和 SV 组的眼轴长度（AL）平均变化量（标准差）分别为 0.12（0.16）mm、0.23（0.17）mm、0.29（0.17）mm 和 0.36（0.17）mm。与 SV 组相比，IORC-H 组（差值 0.25 mm，p<0.001）、IORC-M 组（差值 0.15 mm，p<0.001）和 IORC-L 组（差值 0.10 mm，p=0.04）的眼轴伸长量分别降低 67%、36% 和 19%。IORC-H 组的眼轴伸长量显著低于 IORC-M 组和 IORC-L 组（分别为 p=0.01 和 p<0.001）。 结论：与 IORC-M 和 IORC-L 镜片相比，IORC-H 镜片在抑制学龄儿童近视进展和减缓眼球生长方面效果更优，且对低龄儿童的近视控制效果更佳。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: The aim of this study was to investigate the effect of individualized ocular refraction customized (IORC) spectacle lenses with different actual amounts of peripheral myopic defocus (MD) on myopia control over 1 year. These lenses compensate for the original peripheral refraction via the free-form surface on the back of the lens. METHODS: This 1-year, double-masked randomised clinical trial included 184 myopic schoolchildren aged 8-12 years. Participants were randomised to receive IORC lenses with high (IORC-H group, +4.50 D), medium (IORC-M group, +3.50 D) or low (IORC-L group, +2.50 D) MD or single-vision (SV) lenses. The spherical equivalent refractive error (SER) and axial length (AL) were measured at baseline and 6-monthly intervals. RESULTS: After 1 year, the mean (SD) changes in SER were -0.18 (0.37), -0.36 (0.37), -0.52 (0.39) and -0.60 (0.42) D for the IORC-H, IORC-M, IORC-L and SV groups, respectively. Compared with the SV group, the effects of slowing myopia progression were 70%, 40% and 13% for the IORC-H (difference of 0.47 D, p < 0.001), IORC-M (difference of 0.32 D, p = 0.001) and IORC-L (difference of 0.15 D, p > 0.05) groups, respectively. The mean (SD) changes in AL were 0.12 (0.16), 0.23 (0.17), 0.29 (0.17) and 0.36 (0.17) mm for the IORC-H, IORC-M, IORC-L and SV groups, respectively. The axial elongation was 67%, 36% and 19% lower in the IORC-H (difference of 0.25 mm, p < 0.001), IORC-M (difference of 0.15 mm, p < 0.001) and IORC-L (difference of 0.10 mm, p = 0.04) groups, respectively, compared with the SV group. The IORC-H group exhibited significantly less axial elongation than the IORC-M and IORC-L groups (p = 0.01 and p < 0.001, respectively). CONCLUSION: Compared with the IORC-M and IORC-L lenses, the IORC-H lens was found to have superior efficacy in inhibiting myopic progression and slowing eye growth in schoolchildren, with better myopia control efficacy in younger children.

Myopia control efficacy of individualised ocular refraction customisation spectacle lenses: A 2-year follow-up study

📖 Ophthalmic & physiological optics : the journal of the British College of Ophthalmic Opticians (Optometrists)📅 2025年👥 Kou Ji, Wu Ye, Lei Si, Xiong Ling, Chen Xiaohang, Liu Longqian
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-2 试验组样本量：IORC-H1组43人（连续使用IORC-H） ； IORC-H2组42人（从IORC-M转为IORC-H）；IORC-H3组39人（从IORC-L转为IORC-H）；IORC-H4组43人（从SV转为IORC-H） SE：H1进展量-0.17D，控制量0.39D，控制率70% ； H2进展量-0.25D，控制量0.31D，控制率55% ；H3进展量-0.24D，控制量0.32D，控制率57% ；H4进展量-0.22D，控制量0.34D，控制率60% AL：H1进展量0.19mm，控制量-0.13mm,控制率41% ；H2进展量0.17mm，控制量-0.15mm,控制率47% ；H3进展量0.17mm，控制量-0.15mm,控制率47% ；H4进展量0.14mm，控制量-0.18mm,控制率56%
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 思问Seewant / 2年临床试验 / 2-2
原文摘要
摘要 目的：在为期 1 年的个性化眼屈光定制（IORC）镜片（根据每只眼睛的周边屈光状态定制）随机对照试验后，评估儿童第二年的近视进展情况。 方法：共 161 名儿童被随机分配，分别佩戴具有高度（+4.50 D，IORC-H）、中度（+3.50 D，IORC-M）、低度（+2.50 D，IORC-L）近视性离焦的 IORC 镜片，单光镜片（SV）。在第二年，所有儿童均佩戴 IORC-H，分别形成 IORC-H1、IORC-H2、IORC-H3 和 IORC-H4 组。设置外部单光镜片（eSV，n=42）组，使其与第二年基线参数相匹配。每 6 个月测量一次球镜等效屈光度（SER）和眼轴长度（AL）。 结果：与 eSV 组相比（12 个月平均 [标准差] 变化：SER −0.56 [0.44] D，AL 0.32 [0.16] mm），所有 IORC-H 干预组在第二年的近视进展均更缓慢（IORC-H1：−0.17 [0.37] D，0.19 [0.14] mm；IORC-H2：−0.25 [0.41] D，0.17 [0.16] mm；IORC-H3：−0.24 [0.36] D，0.17 [0.14] mm；IORC-H4：−0.22 [0.40] D，0.14 [0.17] mm；p<0.05），且组间无差异（p>0.05）。与 SV/eSV 组相比，IORC-H1 组在 2 年内的 SER 和 AL 分别减少了 0.84 D 和 0.38 mm（p<0.001），且在初始 0-6 个月期间进展极轻微（p<0.05），随后在之后的三个 6 个月周期内进展稳定（p>0.05）。 结论：在第二年改用 IORC-H 可显著减缓近视进展和眼轴增长。控制效果在最初 6 个月达到最大，此后仍能维持具有临床意义的持续效果。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To assess second-year myopia progression in children after a 1-year randomised controlled trial of individualised ocular refraction customisation (IORC) spectacle lenses, customised to each eye's peripheral refraction. METHODS: A total of 161 children were randomised to wear IORC lenses with high (+4.50 D, IORC-H), medium (+3.50 D, IORC-M) or low (+2.50 D, IORC-L) myopic defocus or single-vision lenses (SV). In year 2, all children received IORC-H, forming the IORC-H1/H2/H3/H4 groups, respectively. An external SV (eSV, n = 42) group was matched to year 2 baseline parameters. Spherical equivalent refraction (SER) and axial length (AL) were measured every 6 months. RESULTS: Compared with the eSV group (12-month mean [SD] changes: SER -0.56 [0.44] D, AL 0.32 [0.16] mm), all IORC-H intervention groups demonstrated slower progression in year 2 (IORC-H1: -0.17 [0.37] D, 0.19 [0.14] mm; IORC-H2: -0.25 [0.41] D, 0.17 [0.16] mm; IORC-H3: -0.24 [0.36] D, 0.17 [0.14] mm; IORC-H4: -0.22 [0.40] D, 0.14 [0.17] mm; p < 0.05), with no intergroup differences (p > 0.05). Compared with the SV/eSV group, the IORC-H1 group presented 2-year reductions of 0.84 D and 0.38 mm in the SER and AL, respectively (p < 0.001) and exhibited minimal progression during the initial 0-6 months (p < 0.05), followed by constant progression over three subsequent 6-month intervals (p > 0.05). CONCLUSIONS: Switching to IORC-H in year 2 significantly reduced myopia progression and axial elongation. Maximal control efficacy occurred in the first 6 months, with sustained clinically meaningful effects thereafter.
