本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：评估多区正负微透镜点阵（GDM）眼镜镜片在近视控制中的有效性和安全性，并比较 GDM 与高非球面微透镜（HAL）眼镜镜片的近视控制效果。 方法：于 2022 年 12 月至 2023 年 7 月在温州医科大学附属眼视光医院杭州院区招募 150 名 6-13 岁儿童，随机分配至 GDM 组和 HAL 组。在基线以及随访期间每隔 6 个月测量一次睫状肌麻痹电脑验光（等效球镜度 [SER]）和眼轴长度（AL），直至 1 年随访。 结果：共 131 名受试者完成研究并纳入最终分析。随访 6 个月时，GDM 组的 SER 和 AL 变化分别为 0.06 ± 0.37 D 和 0.01 ± 0.11 mm，HAL 组分别为 -0.06 ± 0.31 D 和 0.04 ± 0.11 mm；与 HAL 组相比，GDM 组的 SER 变化差异有统计学意义（p = 0.042），但两组间 AL 变化无统计学显著差异（p = 0.266）。随访 1 年时，GDM 组和 HAL 组的 SER 变化分别为 -0.17 ± 0.40 D 和 -0.19 ± 0.36 D，AL 变化分别为 0.07 ± 0.17 mm 和 0.11 ± 0.15 mm；两组间的 SER 和 AL 差异均无统计学意义（分别为 p = 0.980 和 p = 0.131）。在通过广义估计方程调整后，GDM 组与 HAL 组在 AL 变化上的差异具有统计学意义（p = 0.048）。主观视觉质量方面，两组总评分差异无统计学意义（p = 0.436）。各组均未报告不良事件。 结论：GDM 镜片和 HAL 镜片在 1 年内均能有效控制近视进展，其中 GDM 在限制眼轴延长方面显示出略微更优的效果。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To evaluate the efectiveness and safety of grid dimension multiregion (GDM) spectacle lenses in myopia control and compare the myopia control efects between GDM and highly aspherical lenslets (HAL) spectacle lenses. Methods: A total of 150 children aged 6–13 years were enrolled at the Hangzhou Campus of Eye Hospital of Wenzhou Medical University between December 2022 and July 2023 and randomly assigned to the GDM and HAL groups. Cycloplegic autorefraction (spherical equivalent refraction [SER]) and axial length (AL) were measured at baseline and 6-month intervals until one year follow-up. Results: 131 participants completed the study and were included in the fnal analysis. At the six-month follow-up, the changes in SER and AL were 0.06 ± 0.37 D and 0.01 ± 0.11 mm in the GDM group and −0.06 ± 0.31 D and 0.04 ± 0.11 mm in the HAL group, respectively. The GDM group showed a statistically signifcant diference in SER changes compared to the HAL group (p = 0.042). No statistically signifcant diference in AL was observed between the groups (p = 0.266). At the one-year follow-up, the changes in SER were −0.17 ± 0.40 D in the GDM group and −0.19 ± 0.36 D in the HAL group. The changes in AL were 0.07 ± 0.17 mm in the GDM group and 0.11 ± 0.15 mm in the HAL group. No statistically signifcant diferences in SER or AL were observed between the GDM and HAL groups (p = 0.980 and p = 0.131, respectively). After adjustment using generalized estimating equations, a signifcant diference in AL change was observed between the GDM and HAL groups (p = 0.048). In terms of subjective visual quality, there was no statistical diference in the total scores between the GDM and HAL groups (p = 0.436). No adverse events were reported in any group. Conclusions: Both GDM and HAL lenses efectively controlled myopia progression over 1 year, with GDM showing slightly superior efcacy in limiting axial elongation.

DSAIvsSVL-prevention - dual-surface aberration-increasing lenses versus SVL in non-myopic children - a RCT

DSAI vs SVL：DSAI可延缓非近视儿童1年眼轴增长

📖 Eye and Vision📅 2026年👥 Weiwei Lu, Shiqi Zhou, Fan Lu, Jiawei Zhou, Wanqing Jin et al.
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献4-1-1 DSAI vs SVL：DSAI可延缓非近视儿童1年眼轴增长 研究中心/PI：温州医科大学 / 金婉卿 2年RCT的1年计划中期分析；纳入6-12岁非近视儿童，DSAI 46例 vs SV 46例。 AL elongation (DSAI vs SVL): 0.24mm vs 0.39mm; SER progression (DSAI vs SVL): -0.32D vs -0.59D; Incidence of myopia (DSAI vs SVL): 44.8% vs 65.4%. 无镜片相关不良事件。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 菁杰视 / 4-1 近视预防 / 4-1-1
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：探讨双面增像差（DSAI）镜片对非近视儿童眼轴延长和屈光变化的 1 年预防效果。 方法：这是一项为期 2 年的随机、对照、前瞻性试验，并在 1 年随访时进行了计划中的中期分析，以评估 DSAI 镜片的初步有效性和安全性。招募了 100 名年龄在 6-12 岁、睫状肌麻痹等效球镜度在 -0.50 D 至 +2.00 D 之间被划分为非近视的儿童。受试者被随机分配在日常生活中配戴 DSAI 眼镜镜片或单光（SV）眼镜镜片。主要结局指标为相对于基线的眼轴延长和屈光变化，其中眼轴延长为主要结构性结局指标。 结果：入组于 2023 年 6 月开始。共招募 100 名受试者，其中 92 名（DSAI 组：n = 46，平均年龄 ± 标准差：8.15 ± 1.49 岁；SV 组：n = 46，8.32 ± 1.62 岁）完成了 1 年随访。研究期间未观察到与干预相关的不良事件。DSAI 组受试者的眼轴延长（组间差异：0.15 mm；95% 置信区间 [CI]：0.06 至 0.24 mm；P = 0.002）和屈光变化（组间差异：-0.26 D；95% CI：-0.50 至 -0.02 D；P = 0.032）均显著少于 SV 组。亚组分析表明，DSAI 组中的正视儿童、较大年龄儿童（8.1-12.0 岁）以及配戴时间较长（≥ 11 小时/天）的儿童，其模型校正后的眼轴延长显著少于对应的 SV 亚组（均 P < 0.05）。 结论：1 年中期分析结果表明，DSAI 镜片有助于减缓非近视儿童的眼轴延长和屈光变化，且在正视儿童、较大年龄儿童以及配戴时间更长的儿童中效果相对更显著。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To investigate the 1-year preventive efficacy of dual-surface aberration-increasing (DSAI) lenses on axial elongation and refractive change in non-myopic children. Methods: This was a 2-year randomized, controlled, prospective trial with a planned interim analysis at the 1-year follow-up to assess the preliminary efficacy and safety of DSAI lenses. One hundred children aged 6–12 years with cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction between −0.50 diopters (D) and + 2.00 D, classified as non-myopic, were recruited. Participants were randomly assigned to wear either DSAI spectacle lenses or single-vision (SV) spectacle lenses in daily life. The primary outcomes were axial elongation and refractive change relative to baseline measurements, with axial elongation considered the main structural outcome in the results. Results: Enrolment commenced in June 2023. One hundred participants were recruited, and 92 (DSAI group: n = 46, mean ± standard deviation age: 8.15 ± 1.49 years; SV group: n = 46, 8.32 ± 1.62 years) completed the 1-year follow-up. No intervention-related adverse events were observed during the study period. Participants in the DSAI group exhibited significantly less axial elongation (difference: 0.15 mm; 95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.06 to 0.24 mm; P = 0.002) and refractive change (difference: −0.26 D; 95% CI: −0.50 to −0.02 D; P = 0.032) than those in the SV group. Subgroup analysis showed that emmetropic children, older children (8.1–12.0 years), and those wearing lenses for longer durations (≥ 11 h/day) in the DSAI group had significantly less model-adjusted axial elongation than the corresponding SV subgroups (all P < 0.05). Conclusion: The 1-year interim results suggest that DSAI lenses help to slow axial elongation and refractive change in non-myopic children, with a relatively greater effect observed in emmetropic children, older children, and those who wore the lenses for longer durations.

Myopia control efficacy of annular microstructure defocus spectacle lenses: a 1-year multicenter study

（12个月结果）

📖 Ophthalmology📅 2026年👥 Yan Yue, Yang Tianyu, Tian Yu, Du Fen, Yang Yingying, Chen Ruru, Diao Kai, Wang Junfeng, Tao Xiangchen, Yang Jiwen, Bu Limin, Liu Jianjun, Fei Ya, Xie Huimin, Huang Yanlei, Zhang Yang, Li Jun, Wei Wen, Ge Jinling, Gao Xianghong, Bai Ying, Ma Qingkai, Zheng Jie, Wang Xin, Zhang Yankun, Zhang Wenya, Wang Weijuan, Wu Gangyue, Zhou Pei, Li Yongen, Dong Aoting, Liu Ni, Wang Chao, Ji Bingchuang, Liu Yaqin, Wang Yu, Li Haibo, Zhang Chanjuan, Xue Weina, Wu Yuling, Wu Qiong, Liu Longqian
内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-1（12个月结果） 注册号：ChiCTR2200066085 起始时间：2022 年 11 月 至 2023 年 12 月 研究中心&PI：28个研究中心（四川大学华西医院眼科 & 刘陇黔牵头） 试验设计简述：前瞻性、多中心、非随机、对照、单盲研究 试验组样本量：AMD 组1502人 ；SV 611组人 年龄6-18岁，每天戴镜最少12h，每3个月、6个月、9个月、12个月随访一次 AMD 组SE：进展量-0.30D，AL：进展量0.18mm SVL 组SE：进展量-0.79D，AL：进展量0.39mm 结论：AMD 在延缓近视进展和抑制眼轴延长方面的效果优于SVL，且AMD在减缓近视进展和抑制眼轴延长方面的效果随着年龄和基线SER的增加而降低（交互作用）。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 普诺瞳®M系列离焦镜 / 1年临床试验 / 2-1
原文摘要
摘要 目的：评价环形微结构散焦(AMD)眼镜镜片控制儿童青少年近视进展的效果。 方法：对近视度数在−0.50D~−10.00D之间，散光≤为4.00D的6~18岁儿童青少年进行为期1年的前瞻性、多中心、非随机、对照、单盲(盲评)试验。根据受试者/父母的选择，受试者按2：1的比例被分配戴AMD眼镜镜片(n=1,952)或配戴单视(SV)眼镜镜片(n=1,109)。采用近视屈光度(SER)和眼轴长度(AL)一年的变化来评价AMD眼镜的近视控制效果。 结果：在12个月的随访中，共有1,367名受试者(AMD组875人，SV组492人)完成了睫状肌麻痹SER测量。1791名受试者(AMD组1194人，SV组597人)在12个月的随访中完成了AL测量。经倾向性评分匹配后，AMD组睫状肌麻痹SER的平均变化显著小于SV组(-0.30±0.24D vs. -0.79±0.34D，P<0.001)；AMD组AL的平均变化也明显慢于SV组(0.18±0.12 mm vs. 0.39±0.17 mm，P<0.001)。AMD眼镜控制近视进展的有效率为62.0%，延缓眼轴延长的有效率为53.8%。年龄与治疗组之间存在显著的交互作用(ΔSER：β=-0.037，ΔAL：β=0.010，均P<0.05)，基线SER与治疗组之间存在显著的交互作用(ΔSER：β=0.063，ΔAL：β=-0.020，均P<0.05)。
官方英文摘要 (PubMed Abstract)
PURPOSE: To evaluate the efficacy of annular microstructure defocus (AMD) spectacle lenses in controlling myopia progression in children and adolescents. METHODS: This 1-year prospective, multicenter, non-randomized, controlled, single-blind (blind evaluator) trial was carried out in Chinese children and adolescents aged 6 ~ 18 years, with myopia between − 0.50D and − 10.00D and astigmatism ≤ 4.00D. Subjects were assigned in a 2:1 ratio to wear AMD spectacle lenses (n = 1,952) or wear single-vision (SV) spectacle lenses (n = 1,109) based on the choices of the subjects/parents. One-year changes in cycloplegic spherical equivalent refraction (SER) by autorefraction and axial length (AL) were used to evaluate the myopia control efficacy of AMD spectacle lenses. RESULTS: A total of 1,367 subjects (875 in the AMD group and 492 in the SV group) completed cycloplegic SER measurement at the 12-month follow-up visit. 1,791 subjects (1,194 in the AMD group and 597 in the SV group) completed AL measurement at the 12-month follow-up visit. After propensity score matching (PSM), the average change in cycloplegic SER for the subjects in the AMD group was significantly less than that in the SV group (-0.30 ± 0.24D vs. -0.79 ± 0.34D, P<0.001), and the average change in AL for the subjects in the AMD group was significantly slower than that in the SV group (0.18 ± 0.12 mm vs. 0.39 ± 0.17 mm, P<0.001), too. The efficacy of AMD spectacle lenses in controlling myopia progression and slowing axial elongation was 62.0% and 53.8%, respectively. Significant interaction effects were observed between age and treatment group (ΔSER: β = -0.037, ΔAL: β = 0.010, both P < 0.05),and between baseline SER and treatment group (ΔSER: β = 0.063, ΔAL: β = -0.020, both P < 0.05).These results indicated that the efficacy of AMD spectacle lenses in slowing myopia progression and axial elongation diminished with increasing age and baseline SER. CONCLUSIONS: The study confirmed the myopia control efficacy of AMD spectacle lenses based on changes in cycloplegic SER or AL over 1 year. Younger subjects with lower levels of myopia benefited more from wearing AMD spectacle lenses. TRIAL REGISTRATION: Chinese Clinical Trial Registry: ChiCTR2200066085. Registered 23 November 2022, http://www.chictr.org.cn/.

DOE for myopia prevention and control - a small-scale pilot study among younger Chinese children

DOE vs HALT in 近视前期&低度近视-DOE更好 （NCT06927414）

内容摘要（来源：Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx）
参考文献2-1-1 DOE vs HALT in 近视前期&低度近视-DOE更好 （NCT06927414） 起始时间：2024年11月-2025年6月 研究中心&PI：上海市眼病防治中心/上海市眼科医院 & 徐蔚 试验设计简述：随机、研究者遮盲、平行对照、小规模试点研究；6-8岁儿童，SER 0.00D至-1.75D，DOE vs HALT，随访3个月。 试验组样本量：DOE组19人（18人完成），HALT组17人。 结果：3个月时DOE组SER变化-0.031D、AL变化-0.042mm、ChT增加30.4μm；HALT组SER变化-0.332D、AL变化0.027mm、ChT增加18.5μm。DOE较HALT在SER、AL、ChT上差异有统计学意义，但作者认为效应量较小、临床意义有限，需更大样本和更长随访验证。
来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 菁杰视光衍镜片 / 1年临床试验 / 2-1-1
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：评估与中国低龄儿童目前可用的近视控制眼镜镜片相比，衍射光学元件（D.O.E）眼镜镜片在降低近视发病率和进展方面的有效性与安全性。 方法：这项随机、研究者盲、平行对照的小型试点研究纳入了 6-8 岁且任一眼等效球镜度（SER）在 0.00 D 至 -1.75 D 之间的受试者，散光和屈光参差均不超过 1.50 D。受试者被随机分配配戴 D.O.E 镜片（n=19）或高非球面微透镜（H.A.L.T，n=17）眼镜镜片。在基线以及配戴镜片后 1、2、3 个月时测量眼轴长度（AL）、脉络膜厚度（ChT）和睫状肌麻痹 SER。使用线性混合模型分析两组之间 AL、ChT 和睫状肌麻痹 SER 的变化，同时评估依从性和主观评价的差异。 结果：3 个月后，与 H.A.L.T 组相比，D.O.E 组表现出睫状肌麻痹 SER 变化显著更小（p<0.001）、AL 显著缩短（p=0.024）以及 ChT 增加显著更大（p=0.009）。与 H.A.L.T 组相比，估计的最小二乘均值差（95% CI）分别为：睫状肌麻痹 SER 为 0.197（0.068 至 0.326）D；AL 为 -0.027（-0.072 至 0.018）mm；ChT 为 11.098（0.067 至 22.130）μm。两组在依从性或主观评价方面未观察到显著差异。 结论：本试点研究中使用的 D.O.E 眼镜镜片在中国低龄儿童中延缓近视进展方面显示出具有统计学意义但尚不具备临床意义的效果。主要局限性在于样本量小和观察期短，限制了检测临床显著变化的能力。这些发现属于初步结果，在用于指导临床决策前需要进一步验证。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Aim: To assess the efficacy and safety of diffractive optical element (D.O.E) spectacle lenses in reducing the incidence and progression of myopia compared with currently available myopia control spectacle lenses in younger Chinese children. Methods: This randomised, investigator-masked, parallel-controlled, small-scale pilot study included participants aged 6–8 years with a spherical equivalent refraction (SER) between 0.00 D and −1.75 D in either eye. Additionally, astigmatism and anisometropia did not exceed 1.50 D. Participants were randomly assigned to wear either the D.O.E (n=19) or highly aspherical lenslets ((H.A.L.T), n=17) spectacle lenses. Axial length (AL), choroidal thickness (ChT) and cycloplegic SER were measured at baseline and at 1, 2 and 3 months after wearing the spectacle lenses. Changes in AL, ChT and cycloplegic SER between the two groups were analysed using linear mixed models. Differences in compliance and subjective evaluations were also assessed. Results: After 3 months, compared with the H.A.L.T group, the D.O.E group exhibited significantly smaller changes in cycloplegic SER (p<0.001), a significant reduction in AL (p=0.024) and a significantly greater increase in ChT (p=0.009). The estimated least-squares mean differences (95% CIs) compared with the H.A.L.T group were as follows: cycloplegic SER, 0.197 (0.068 to 0.326) D; AL, −0.027 (−0.072 to 0.018) mm; and ChT, 11.098 (0.067 to 22.130) μm. No significant differences were observed between the groups regarding compliance or subjective evaluation. Conclusions: D.O.E spectacle lenses used in this pilot study demonstrated a statistically significant, though not clinically meaningful, effect in slowing myopia progression among younger Chinese children. The primary limitations were the small sample size and the short observation period, which restricted the ability to detect clinically significant changes. These findings are preliminary and require further validation before they can inform clinical decision-making.

摘要 目的：利用双重稳健因果推断框架，比较四种近视控制眼镜镜片干预措施在儿童近视控制中的真实世界有效性。 方法：本研究为一项采用多处理增强逆概率加权的回顾性队列研究。从 2023 年 1 月至 2026 年 1 月成都中医药大学附属银海眼科医院的 13,071 份电子病历中筛选出 2764 名 3-18 岁近视儿童（右眼）。受试者被分配至四种近视控制镜片组和一种单光镜片组：高阶像差离焦组（HOAD，n=912）、多区正向光学离焦组（DIMS，n=800）、高非球面微透镜组（HAL，n=476）、分段离焦优化组（DSDO，n=238）以及单光镜片组（SVL，n=338）。采用结合多项倾向评分加权与结局回归的双重稳健估计量校正混杂因素。主要结局为 1 年眼轴长度和等效球镜度变化，次要结局为快速进展率。 结果：校正后，所有四种近视控制镜片设计的效果均显著优于单光镜片矫正（p < 0.05）。基于高阶像差离焦（HOAD）的设计表现出最显著的有效性，眼轴长度变化为 0.107 mm，等效球镜度变化为 -0.146 D。在该组中，25.5% 的儿童出现眼轴快速增长（≥0.36 mm/年），8.3% 的儿童出现近视快速进展（≥-0.50 D/年）。该治疗效果在低度近视或眼轴长度不超过 26 mm 的儿童中具有统计学意义（p < 0.05），但在高度近视或病理性眼轴延长儿童中无统计学意义。 结论：在真实世界临床实践中，四种近视控制眼镜镜片设计均表现出显著优于单光镜矫正的优势。应特别强调近视控制眼镜在近视早期的作用；随着近视进展为高度近视或病理性眼轴延长，近视控制镜片作为单一干预手段的有效性下降，可能需要结合多种近视管理策略的综合方案。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: We aimed to compare the real-world effectiveness of four myopia-control spectacle lens interventions for childhood myopia control using a doubly robust causal inference framework. Design: This was a retrospective cohort study with multi-treatment augmented inverse probability weighting. Participants: A total of 2764 myopic children (right eyes) aged 3–18 years were included, screened from 13,071 electronic medical records at Ineye Hospital, Chengdu University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, between January 2023 and January 2026. Methods: Participants were allocated to four myopia-control spectacle lens groups and one single-vision spectacle lens group: Higher-Order Aberration Defocus (n = 912), Defocus Incorporated Multiple Segments (n = 800), Highly Aspherical Lenslets (n = 476), Diversified Segmental Defocus Optimization (n = 238), and single-vision lenses (n = 338). A doubly robust estimator combining multinomial propensity-score weighting with outcome regression was applied to adjust for confounding. Outcome Measures: The primary outcomes were one-year changes in axial length and spherical equivalent. The secondary outcomes were the rates of rapid progression. Treatment-effect heterogeneity was explored across prespecified baseline age, refractive error, and axial length subgroups. Results: After adjustment, all four myopia-control designs significantly outperformed single-vision correction (p < 0.05). The design based on Higher-Order Aberration Defocus demonstrated the greatest efficacy, with an axial length change of 0.107 mm and a spherical equivalent change of −0.146 D. Within this group, 25.5% of children exhibited rapid axial elongation (≥0.36 mm/year) and 8.3% exhibited rapid myopic progression (≥−0.50 D/year). The treatment effect was statistically significant in children with low myopia or an axial length no greater than 26 mm (p < 0.05), but not in those with high myopia or pathological axial elongation. Conclusions: All four myopia-control spectacle lens designs demonstrated significant advantages over single-vision correction in real-world clinical practice. Particular emphasis should be placed on the role of myopia-control spectacles during the early stages of myopia. As myopia progresses to high myopia or pathological axial elongation, the efficacy of myopia-control spectacle lenses as a standalone intervention diminishes, and combined approaches incorporating multiple myopia management strategies may be warranted.

来源=Competitor Updates-20261111.xlsx：总表 / 儿童控乐—分区多点离焦近视管理镜片”，官网宣传也简称“儿控乐” / 6-2 对比研究 / 6-2-1
本地文件摘录
摘要 目的：评估与高非球面微透镜（HAL）镜片相比，新型分区多点离焦光学技术（PMDOT）镜片在延缓近视进展方面的 1 年有效性。 方法：这是一项正在进行的为期 2 年的非劣效性随机对照试验的 1 年中期分析，共 194 名 8-13 岁、等效球镜度（SER）为 -0.75 至 -4.5 D 的儿童被随机分配至 PMDOT 组或 HAL 组。全试验的主要结局为 2 年时两组间 SER 变化的平均差异，非劣效界值为 -0.3 D。次要结局包括眼轴长度（AL）、脉络膜厚度（ChT）和其他生物测量参数的变化，以及 2 年时的最佳矫正视力（BCVA）和主观视觉体验。本分析采用右眼数据。 结果：符合方案（PP）分析共纳入 PMDOT 组 102 名儿童和 HAL 组 92 名儿童。1 年后，基于 PP 分析，两组间的平均 SER 和 AL 变化无统计学显著差异（PMDOT 组 vs. HAL 组：SER 分别为 -0.74 ± 0.49 D vs. -0.60 ± 0.48 D，AL 分别为 0.26 ± 0.20 mm vs. 0.19 ± 0.19 mm）。12 个月时两组间 SER 变化的组间差异为 -0.09 D（双侧 97% 置信区间 [CI]：-0.26 至 0.09）。除 PP 分析中的前房深度变化外，所有次要结局均未观察到组间显著差异。 结论：在控制近视进展方面，PMDOT 镜片不劣于 HAL 镜片。
官方英文摘要（来自本地PDF）
Purpose: To evaluate the one-year efficacy of novel partition multipoint defocus optics technology (PMDOT) lenses in slowing myopia progression, compared to lenses with highly aspherical lenslets (HAL). Methods: This is a 1-year interim analysis of an ongoing 2-year, non-inferiority randomized controlled trial, in which 194 children ages 8 to 13 years with spherical equivalent refraction (SER) of −0.75 to −4.5 diopters (D) were randomized to either the PMDOT or HAL group. The primary outcome of the full trial was the mean between-group difference in SER change at 2 years, and the non-inferiority margin was −0.3 D. Secondary outcomes included changes in axial length (AL), choroidal thickness (ChT), and other biometric parameters, as well as best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) at 2 years and subjective visual experience. Data from right eyes were used for the current analysis. Results: The study included 102 children in the PMDOT group and 92 in the HAL group. After 1 year, the mean ± SD changes in SER and AL were not statistically significantly different between the two groups (PMDOT vs. HAL SER −0.74 ± 0.49 D vs. −0.60 ± 0.48 D, AL 0.26 ± 0.20 mm vs. 0.19 ± 0.19 mm) based on per-protocol (PP) analysis. The between-group difference in SER change at 12 months was −0.09 D (two-sided 97% confidence interval [CI], −0.26 to 0.09). Except for the change in anterior chamber depth in the PP analysis, no significant between-group differences were observed for any secondary outcomes. Conclusions: PMDOT lenses were not inferior to HAL lenses in controlling myopia progression. Translational Relevance: This trial demonstrated the clinical potential of PMDOT lenses for myopia control in schoolchildren.
